jobs.title: Underwriting Specialist OR Executive Underwriter- Large Property
jobs.description:
Zurich is seeking an Underwriting Specialist OR Executive Underwriter, Large Property for our National Accounts Large Property Underwriting team in our San Francisco or Seattle. While this position will be based out of a Zurich office, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents. This role will require you to be visible in the marketplace to meet with our agents and brokers and be in the office/market three days per week.

This role will be filled at either the Underwriting Specialist OR Executive Underwriter level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

As an Underwriting Specialist OR Executive Underwriter, Large Property you will have a chance to use your marketing and analytical skills. Specifically, you will analyze and underwrite new and renewal business, under general direction, utilizing The Zurich Way of Underwriting Framework within delegated authority levels on assignments of higher technical complexity ensuring a high level service to customers. This is a market facing position thus we are seeking someone with a strong sales execution mindset and knowledge of commercial property policies.

Some of the key accountabilities of this role include:

- Administer and monitor underwriting rules and guidelines, rating manual rules, and insurance laws and regulations.

- Develop, maintain & collaborate with Line of Business representatives and other business related needs, as appropriate.

- Develop and maintain relationships with distributors (agents & brokers) in support of business retention and acquisition and works with customers and distributors (agents & brokers) to determine their insurance related needs and provide solutions.

- Support the organization's sales culture by being a Help Point for agents, brokers and customers.

- Proactively seek renewal and new account opportunities.

- Complete detailed opportunity assessment with key distributors to identify growth opportunities.

- Qualify accounts to meet with the organization's appetite, balanced with sound business opportunity.

- Make broker/customer and on-sight calls with a planned and well-prepared purpose.

Basic Qualifications – Underwriting Specialist, Large Property:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or
Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

OR

Basic Qualifications - Executive Underwriter, Large Property:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in commercial underwriting or brokerage or market facing area
OR

- High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the claims or underwriting support area
OR

- Zurich approved Apprenticeship program including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich approved Apprenticeship program including an Associate Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office

- Experience working on time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience working in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications (Both levels):

- Bachelors Degree

- Technical knowledge of commercial Property Underwriting

- Established broker relationships (Retail, select brokers) in Western Region

- Sales execution mindset

- Creative problem solving skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The combined salary range for this position is $75,000.00 - $165,000.00. The proposed salary range for the Underwriting Specialist is $75,000.00 - $125,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%. The proposed salary range for the Executive Underwriter is $100,000.00 - $165,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Zurigo è alla ricerca di uno specialista di sottoscrittura o sottoscrittore esecutivo, grande proprietà per il nostro team di sottoscrittura di proprietà di grandi conti nel nostro San Francisco o Seattle. Mentre questa posizione sarà basata su un ufficio di Zurigo, avrete la flessibilità di lavorare su base ibrida. Potrai collaborare con il tuo manager per impostare un programma di lavoro flessibile che ti supporta, i nostri clienti, e i nostri broker e agenti. Questo ruolo richiederà di essere visibile sul mercato per incontrare i nostri agenti e broker e di essere in ufficio / mercato tre giorni alla settimana.

Questo ruolo sarà riempito sia a livello di Underwriting Specialist o Executive Underwriter. Il gestore di assunzione determinerà il livello appropriato in base all’esperienza e alle competenze del richiedente selezionato rispetto alle qualifiche elencate per questa posizione.

Come esperto di sottoscrittura o sottoscrittore esecutivo, grande proprietà avrete la possibilità di utilizzare le vostre abilità di marketing e analitiche. In particolare, si analizza e sottoscriverà nuove e nuove attività di rinnovo, sotto la direzione generale, utilizzando The Zurich Way of Underwriting Framework all'interno dei livelli di autorità delegati su incarichi di maggiore complessità tecnica garantendo un servizio di alto livello ai clienti. Si tratta di una posizione di mercato affrontando così stiamo cercando qualcuno con una forte mentalità di esecuzione di vendita e la conoscenza delle politiche di proprietà commerciale.

Alcune delle principali responsabilità di questo ruolo includono:

- Amministra e monitora le regole e le linee guida di sottoscrizione, le regole manuali di valutazione, e le leggi e le normative di assicurazione.

- Sviluppare, mantenere e collaborare con i rappresentanti di Line of Business e altre esigenze aziendali correlate, come opportuno.

- Sviluppare e mantenere le relazioni con i distributori (agenti & broker) a sostegno della ritenzione aziendale e acquisizione e lavora con clienti e distributori (agenti & broker) per determinare le loro esigenze assicurative e fornire soluzioni.

- Sostenere la cultura di vendita dell'organizzazione essendo un punto di aiuto per agenti, broker e clienti.

- Proattivamente cercare il rinnovamento e nuove opportunità di account.

- Valutazione dettagliata completa delle opportunità con i distributori chiave per identificare le opportunità di crescita.

- Qualificare rappresenta l'incontro con l'appetito dell'organizzazione, equilibrato con l'opportunità di business sano.

- Fare broker / cliente e on-sight chiamate con uno scopo pianificato e ben preparato.

Qualificazioni di base – Specialista di sottoscrizione, Grande proprietà:

- Diploma di High School o Equivalent e 3 o più anni di esperienza nella zona di Underwriting o Market Facing.

- Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta

La tua paga a Zurigo si basa sul tuo ruolo, posizione, competenze e esperienza. Seguiamo le leggi locali per garantire una giusta compensazione. Si può anche essere idonei per bonus e aumenti di merito. Se le vostre aspettative sono al di sopra della gamma elencata, vi incoraggiamo ancora ad applicare – il vostro background unico conta per noi. L'intervallo di pagamento indicato è una media nazionale e può variare in base alla posizione. L'intervallo di stipendio combinato per questa posizione è $75,000,00 - $165,000,00. L'intervallo di stipendio proposto per lo specialista di sottoscrittura è di $ 75,000,00 - $125,000,00, con l'ammissibilità bonus di incentivazione a breve termine impostata al 15%. La gamma di stipendio proposta per l'Executive Underwriter è $100.000,00 - $165,000,00, con bonus di incentivazione a breve termine eleggibilità impostata al 10%.

Offriamo vantaggi competitivi e completi per i dipendenti e le loro famiglie. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Perché Zurigo?

A Zurigo, apprezziamo le tue idee e le tue esperienze. Offriamo crescita, inclusione e un ambiente di supporto, in modo da poter contribuire a plasmare il futuro dell'assicurazione. Zurigo Nord America è leader nella gestione dei rischi, con oltre 150 anni di esperienza e copertura in 25 settori, tra cui il 90% della Fortune 500®.

Unisciti a noi per un futuro più luminoso, per te e per i nostri clienti.

Zurigo in Nord America non discrimina in base a razza, etnia, colore, religione, origine nazionale, sesso, espressione di genere, identità di genere, informazioni genetiche, età, disabilità, stato veterano protetto, stato civile, orientamento sessuale, gravidanza o altre caratteristiche protette dalla legge applicabile. descriptionByLocale.de:
Zürich sucht einen Underwriting Specialist ODER Executive Underwriter, Large Property für unser National Accounts Large Property Underwriting Team in San Francisco oder Seattle. Während diese Position von einem Büro in Zürich aus angesiedelt sein wird, haben Sie die Flexibilität, auf hybrider Basis zu arbeiten. Sie arbeiten mit Ihrem Manager zusammen, um einen flexiblen Arbeitsplan festzulegen, der Sie, unsere Kunden und unsere Makler und Agenten unterstützt. Diese Rolle erfordert, dass Sie auf dem Markt sichtbar sind, um sich mit unseren Agenten und Brokern zu treffen und drei Tage pro Woche im Büro / Markt zu sein.

Diese Rolle wird entweder auf der Ebene des Underwriting Specialist oder des Executive Underwriters besetzt. Der Einstellungsmanager bestimmt das geeignete Niveau basierend auf der Erfahrung und den Fähigkeiten des ausgewählten Bewerbers in Bezug auf die für diese Position aufgeführten Qualifikationen.

Als Underwriting-Spezialist ODER Executive Underwriter, Large Property haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre Marketing- und Analysefähigkeiten zu nutzen. Insbesondere analysieren und versichern Sie Neu- und Erneuerungsgeschäfte unter allgemeiner Leitung unter Verwendung des The Zurich Way of Underwriting Framework innerhalb der delegierten Behördenebenen für Aufträge mit höherer technischer Komplexität, die einen hohen Service für Kunden gewährleisten. Dies ist eine Marktposition, daher suchen wir jemanden mit einer starken Verkaufsausführungsmentalität und Kenntnissen der gewerblichen Immobilienpolitik.

Zu den wichtigsten Verantwortlichkeiten dieser Rolle gehören:

- Verwalten und überwachen Sie Underwriting-Regeln und Richtlinien, Rating-Handbuchregeln und Versicherungsgesetze und -vorschriften.

- Entwickeln, pflegen und arbeiten Sie mit Vertretern von Line of Business und anderen geschäftsbezogenen Bedürfnissen zusammen.

- Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Distributoren (Agenten & Brokern) zur Unterstützung der Unternehmensbindung und -akquisition und arbeitet mit Kunden und Distributoren (Agenten & Brokern) zusammen, um ihre versicherungsbezogenen Bedürfnisse zu ermitteln und Lösungen anzubieten.

- Unterstützen Sie die Verkaufskultur des Unternehmens, indem Sie ein Help Point für Agenten, Broker und Kunden sind.

- Proaktiv suchen Erneuerung und neue Konto Möglichkeiten.

- Führen Sie eine detaillierte Gelegenheitsbewertung mit den wichtigsten Distributoren durch, um Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren.

- Qualifizieren Sie Konten, um den Appetit des Unternehmens zu befriedigen, ausgeglichen mit soliden Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

- Machen Sie Broker / Kunden und On-Sight-Anrufe mit einem geplanten und gut vorbereiteten Zweck.

Grundqualifikationen - Underwriting-Spezialist, Large Property:

- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 3 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Underwriting oder Market Facing Bereich.
ODER

- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 6 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Claims oder Underwriting Support
ODER

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice inklusive Associate Degree und 1 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Underwriting oder Market Facing Bereich
ODER

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice einschließlich eines Associate Degree und 4 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in den Ansprüchen oder
Underwriting Support Bereich
UND

- Kenntnis des Geschäftsbereichs/der Geschäftsbereiche und der rechtlichen und regulatorischen Leitlinien

- Kenntnis der Zeitvorgaben für Kurse für Neu- und Erneuerungsgeschäfte

- Erfahrung mit Microsoft Office

ODER

Grundqualifikationen - Executive Underwriter, Large Property:

- High-School-Diplom oder Äquivalent und 5 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in kommerziellen Underwriting oder Brokerage oder Markt mit Blick auf Bereich
ODER

- High-School-Diplom oder gleichwertig und 10 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in den Ansprüchen oder Underwriting-Support-Bereich
ODER

- Zürich genehmigtes Lehrlingsprogramm mit einem Associate Degree und 3 oder mehr Jahren Erfahrung im Underwriting- oder Market Facing-Bereich
ODER

- Zürich genehmigtes Lehrlingsprogramm einschließlich eines Associate Degree und 8 oder mehr Jahren Erfahrung im Bereich Claims oder Underwriting Support

- Kenntnisse von Microsoft Office

- Erfahrung mit Zeitbeschränkungen für Angebote für Neu- und Erneuerungsgeschäfte

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einer Teamumgebung

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen (beide Stufen):

- Bachelor-Abschluss

- Technische Kenntnisse des gewerblichen Property Underwriting

- Etablierte Broker-Beziehungen (Einzelhandel, ausgewählte Broker) in der westlichen Region

- Sales Execution Mindset

- Kreative Problemlösungsfähigkeiten

- Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Ihre Bezahlung in Zürich basiert auf Ihrer Rolle, Ihrem Standort, Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung. Wir befolgen lokale Gesetze, um eine faire Entschädigung zu gewährleisten. Möglicherweise haben sie auch anspruch auf boni und leistungssteigerungen. Wenn Ihre Erwartungen über dem aufgeführten Bereich liegen, empfehlen wir Ihnen dennoch, sich zu bewerben - Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund ist für uns wichtig. Die gezeigte Lohnspanne ist ein nationaler Durchschnitt und kann je nach Standort variieren. Die kombinierte Gehaltsspanne für diese Position beträgt $ 75.000,00 - $ 165.000.00. Die vorgeschlagene Gehaltsspanne für den Underwriting-Spezialisten beträgt 75.000 $ - 125.000.00 $, wobei die kurzfristige Anreizbonusberechtigung bei 15% liegt. Die vorgeschlagene Gehaltsspanne für den Executive Underwriter beträgt $ 100.000,00 - $ 165,000.00, wobei die kurzfristige Anreizbonusberechtigung auf 10% festgelegt ist.

Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Bezahlung und umfassende Leistungen für Mitarbeiter und ihre Familien. [Erfahren Sie hier mehr über Total Rewards.]

Warum Zürich?

Bei Zurich schätzen wir Ihre Ideen und Erfahrungen. Wir bieten Wachstum, Inklusion und ein unterstützendes Umfeld - damit Sie die Zukunft der Versicherung mitgestalten können. Zurich North America ist führend im Risikomanagement und verfügt über mehr als 150 Jahre Erfahrung und Abdeckung in über 25 Branchen, darunter 90 % der Fortune 500®.

Begleiten Sie uns für eine bessere Zukunft – für Sie und unsere Kunden.

Zürich in Nordamerika diskriminiert nicht aufgrund von Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Religion, nationaler Herkunft, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsausdruck, Geschlechtsidentität, genetischer Information, Alter, Behinderung, geschütztem Veteranenstatus, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung, Schwangerschaft oder anderen durch geltendes Recht geschützten Merkmalen. Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber Behinderung / Vets.

Zürich erfüllt 18 US-Code § 1033.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Zurich est à la recherche d'un spécialiste de la souscription OU Un souscripteur exécutif, Grande propriété pour notre équipe de comptabilité nationale Grande propriété de notre San Francisco ou Seattle. Bien que ce poste soit basé sur un bureau de Zurich, vous aurez la flexibilité de travailler sur une base hybride. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec votre gestionnaire pour établir un horaire de travail flexible qui vous accompagne, nos clients et nos courtiers et agents. Ce rôle exigera que vous soyez visible sur le marché pour rencontrer nos agents et courtiers et être au bureau/marché trois jours par semaine.

Ce rôle sera assumé soit au niveau des sous-traitants soit au niveau des sous-traitants exécutifs. Le gestionnaire d'embauche déterminera le niveau approprié en fonction de l'expérience et des compétences du candidat choisi par rapport aux qualités énumérées pour ce poste.

En tant que spécialiste de la souscription OU sous-traitant exécutif, vous aurez la chance d'utiliser vos compétences en marketing et en analyse. Plus précisément, vous analyserez et souscrireez des activités nouvelles et de renouvellement, sous la direction générale, en utilisant le cadre de souscription de la manière de Zurich dans les niveaux de pouvoirs délégués sur les affectations de complexité technique supérieure assurant un service de haut niveau aux clients. Il s'agit d'une position face au marché, donc nous recherchons quelqu'un avec un fort état d'esprit d'exécution des ventes et la connaissance des politiques de propriété commerciale.

Voici certaines des principales responsabilités de ce rôle :

- Administrer et surveiller les règles et lignes directrices en matière de souscription, les règles du manuel de cotation et les lois et règlements en matière d'assurance.

- Élaborer, maintenir et collaborer avec les représentants du secteur d'activité et d'autres besoins connexes, selon le cas.

- Établir et maintenir des relations avec les distributeurs (agents et courtiers) à l'appui de la rétention et de l'acquisition d'entreprises et travailler avec les clients et les distributeurs (agents et courtiers) pour déterminer leurs besoins en matière d'assurance et fournir des solutions.

- Soutenir la culture de vente de l'organisation en étant un point d'aide pour les agents, les courtiers et les clients.

- Recherche proactive de renouvellement et de nouvelles possibilités de compte.

- Compléter l'évaluation détaillée des possibilités avec les principaux distributeurs pour déterminer les possibilités de croissance.

- Qualifier les comptes pour répondre à l'appétit de l'organisation, équilibré avec de bonnes occasions d'affaires.

jobs.description:
Our opportunity

Azure Data Engineer

Are you a motivated, hands-on, and innovative person interested in working for one of the largest global insurers? Are you passionate about designing scalable data architectures and building robust pipelines that power critical risk decisions? Then this role is definitely something for you. We are looking for a Data Engineer to join the newly formed Risk Accumulation Management Platform (RAMP) team

The position is planned as a 1‑year assignment for now.

Your role
As an Azure Data Engineer , your main responsibilities will involve:

- Design and implement the target data model for risk accumulation, covering both location-based catastrophe exposure and non-location-based lines, including full exposure history.

- Architect and develop data ingestion ETL pipelines to migrate data from legacy accumulation data sources into a modern Databricks based platform.

- Integrate underwriting pipeline data (submissions and quotations) into accumulation reports, ensuring current and in-progress risk views are available to stakeholders.

- Build and optimize long-running batch jobs for data transformation, aggregation, and snapshot management using Databricks and Delta Lake.

- Establish data quality frameworks, automated validation checks, and monitoring for all ingested and transformed datasets.

- Collaborate with and provide backup to the Data Engineer and API Developer on the team, ensuring no key-person dependencies exist across the platform.

- Work in close collaboration with the wider technology and business teams to deliver an excellent, reliable data platform.

Your Skills and Experience

As an Azure Data Engineer, your skills and experience will ideally include:

- 3 years of similar experience

- Strong experience with SQL and relational data modelling, including designing schemas for analytical and reporting workloads.

- Proficiency in Python (preferably with PySpark, Pandas, and NumPy).

- Hands-on experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, Lakehouse architecture, workflows/job orchestration) or similar platforms.

- Demonstrated experience building ETL/ELT pipelines at scale, including data ingestion, transformation, and quality assurance.

- Familiarity with software development best practices (Git, CI/CD, DevOps).

- Strong problem-solving skills and a structured approach to data architecture.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to Have

- Experience with Microsoft Azure data services (Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure SQL).

- Knowledge of insurance data structures, particularly catastrophe exposure, accumulation reporting, or reinsurance.

- Experience with Databricks Feature Serving or Model Serving technologies.

- Familiarity with data governance and data cataloguing practices.

- Prior work experience in insurance or financial services.

- Excellent communication skills and comfort presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

We offer

Compensation for roles at Zurich depends on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific role, skill set, level of experience, and subject to applicable law. Zurich thus provides a range of compensation aligned to internal job architecture and market benchmarks to ensure fair and consistent pay for comparable roles. The starting base salary range for this position is 2330 Eur.

Working time benefits

Personal days off, Concentrated work week, Additional vacation, Home office, Extra days off at occasion of childbirth, Sabbatical leave, Workation

Monetary benefits

Life insurance from Zurich Austria, Compensation for salary loss during sick leave, 3rd pension pillar contribution, Risk Life Insurance, Meal contribution on top of the legally required minimum, Years of service bonus, Wedding bonus, Baby bonus

Other benefits

Electronic cafeteria, Maternity leave benefits, Massages in the office

Learning/Development

Professional Certifications, Online Education Portals, Extensive Onboarding program, Strengths based culture (GALLUP)

- Location: Bratislava

- Schedule: full-time

- Form: hybrid - occasional home office possible

About us

At our company, we recognize the importance of fostering an open-minded, safe and inclusive environment for everyone. We stand with diversity and respect different backgrounds and lifestyles. That's why we've implemented numerous initiatives to ensure our employees feel comfortable, accepted, and respected at all times.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La nostra opportunità

Azure Data Engineer

Sei una persona motivata, pratica e innovativa interessata a lavorare per uno dei più grandi assicuratori globali? Sei appassionato di progettazione di architetture dati scalabili e costruzione di robuste condotte che alimentano decisioni di rischio critiche? Allora questo ruolo è sicuramente qualcosa per voi. Stiamo cercando un Data Engineer per aderire al nuovo team Risk Accumulation Management Platform (RAMP)

La posizione è pianificata come un incarico di un anno per ora.

Il tuo ruolo
In qualità di ingegnere dati Azure, le vostre principali responsabilità coinvolgeranno:

- Progettare e implementare il modello di dati di destinazione per l'accumulo di rischio, coprendo sia l'esposizione di catastrofe basata sulla posizione che le linee non-location-based, tra cui la storia di esposizione completa.

- Architetto e sviluppi l'ingestione dei dati ETL pipelines per migrare i dati da fonti di dati di accumulazione legacy in una moderna piattaforma basata su Databricks.

- Integrare i dati delle pipeline di sottoscrizione (sottomissioni e quotazioni) nelle relazioni di accumulo, assicurando che le opinioni dei rischi attuali e in corso siano disponibili agli stakeholder.

- Costruire e ottimizzare i lavori batch di lunga durata per la trasformazione dei dati, l'aggregazione e la gestione delle snapshot utilizzando Databricks e Delta Lake.

- Stabilire quadri di qualità dei dati, controlli di convalida automatizzati e monitoraggio per tutti i dataset ingeriti e trasformati.

- Collaborare con e fornire il backup al Data Engineer e API Developer del team, assicurando che non esistano dipendenze chiave-persona in tutta la piattaforma.

- Lavora in stretta collaborazione con le più ampie tecnologie e i team aziendali per fornire una piattaforma dati eccellente e affidabile.

Le tue abilità ed esperienza

In qualità di ingegnere dati Azure, le tue abilità e l'esperienza includono idealmente:

- 3 anni di esperienza simile

- Forte esperienza con la modellazione di dati SQL e relazionale, tra cui la progettazione di schemi per carichi di lavoro analitici e di reportistica.

- Proficienza in Python (preferibilmente con PySpark, Pandas e NumPy).

- Esperienza pratica con Databricks (Delta Lake, Lakehouse architecture, workflows/job orchestration) o piattaforme simili.

- Esperienza dimostrata che costruisce condotte ETL/ELT su scala, tra cui ingestione di dati, trasformazione e garanzia di qualità.

- Familiarità con le migliori pratiche di sviluppo software (Git, CI/CD, DevOps).

- Forte capacità di problem solving e un approccio strutturato all'architettura dei dati.

- Ottimo scritto e parlato inglese.

Bello da avere

- Esperienza con i servizi dati di Microsoft Azure (Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure SQL).

- Conoscenza delle strutture di dati assicurativi, in particolare l'esposizione catastrofica, la segnalazione di accumulo, o la riassicurazione.

- Esperienza con le tecnologie Databricks Feature Serving o Model Serving.

- Familiarità con la governance dei dati e le pratiche di catalogazione dei dati.

- Esperienza lavorativa prioritaria nei servizi assicurativi o finanziari.

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e comfort che presentano concetti tecnici agli stakeholder non tecnici.

Offriamo

La compensazione per i ruoli a Zurigo dipende da una vasta gamma di fattori, tra cui, ma non solo, il ruolo specifico, il set di competenze, il livello di esperienza e soggetto alla legge applicabile. Zurigo fornisce così una gamma di compensazioni allineate all'architettura interna del lavoro e ai benchmark di mercato per garantire una paga equa e coerente per ruoli comparabili. La gamma di stipendio base di partenza per questa posizione è 2330 Eur.

Benefici del tempo di lavoro

Giorni liberi, settimana di lavoro concentrata, Vacanza aggiuntiva, Ufficio domestico, Giorni extra in occasione di parto, congedo sabatico, Workation

Benefici monetari

Assicurazione sulla vita da Zurigo Austria, Compensazione per la perdita di stipendio durante il congedo di malattia, 3° contributo pilastro pensione, Risk Life Insurance, Contributo di pagamento al massimo del minimo richiesto, Anni di bonus di servizio, Bonus di nozze, Baby bonus

Altri vantaggi

Caffetteria elettronica, Prestazioni di congedo di maternità, Massaggi in ufficio

Apprendimento/Sviluppo

Certificazioni professionali, Portali di formazione online, programma di onboarding esteso, cultura basata sui punti di forza (GALLUP)

- Posizione: Bratislava

- Orari: a tempo pieno

- Forma: ibrido - ufficio domestico occasionale possibile

Su di noi

Nella nostra azienda, riconosciamo l'importanza di promuovere un ambiente aperto, sicuro e inclusivo per tutti. Siamo con la diversità e rispetto diversi sfondi e stili di vita. Ecco perché abbiamo implementato numerose iniziative per garantire che i nostri dipendenti si sentano comodi, accettati e rispettati in ogni momento.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Unsere Chance

Azure Data Engineer

Sind Sie eine motivierte, praktische und innovative Person, die daran interessiert ist, für einen der größten globalen Versicherer zu arbeiten? Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für skalierbare Datenarchitekturen und den Aufbau robuster Pipelines, die kritische Risikoentscheidungen unterstützen? Dann ist diese Rolle definitiv etwas für dich. Wir suchen einen Data Engineer, der dem neu gegründeten Team der Risk Accumulation Management Platform (RAMP) beitritt

Die Stelle ist vorerst als 1-Jahres-Auftrag geplant.

Deine Rolle
Als Azure Data Engineer sind Ihre Hauptaufgaben:

- Entwurf und Umsetzung des Zieldatenmodells für die Risikoakkumulation, das sowohl standortbezogene Katastrophenrisiken als auch standortunabhängige Strecken abdeckt, einschließlich der vollständigen Expositionsgeschichte.

- Architektur und Entwicklung von ETL-Pipelines zur Datenaufnahme, um Daten aus alten Akkumulationsdatenquellen in eine moderne Databricks-basierte Plattform zu migrieren.

- Integrieren Sie versicherungstechnische Pipelinedaten (Einreichungen und Angebote) in Akkumulationsberichte, um sicherzustellen, dass den Stakeholdern aktuelle und laufende Risikoansichten zur Verfügung stehen.

- Erstellen und optimieren Sie lang laufende Batch-Jobs für Datentransformation, Aggregation und Snapshot-Management mit Databricks und Delta Lake.

- Etablieren Sie Datenqualitäts-Frameworks, automatisierte Validierungsprüfungen und Überwachung für alle aufgenommenen und transformierten Datensätze.

- Arbeiten Sie mit dem Data Engineer und dem API-Entwickler im Team zusammen und stellen Sie ein Backup bereit, um sicherzustellen, dass auf der gesamten Plattform keine Abhängigkeiten zwischen Schlüsselpersonen bestehen.

- Arbeiten Sie eng mit den breiteren Technologie- und Geschäftsteams zusammen, um eine hervorragende, zuverlässige Datenplattform zu liefern.

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen

Als Azure Data Engineer umfassen Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen idealerweise:

- 3 Jahre ähnliche Erfahrung

- Ausgeprägte Erfahrung mit SQL- und relationalen Datenmodellierung, einschließlich der Gestaltung von Schemata für analytische und Reporting-Workloads.

- Kenntnisse in Python (vorzugsweise mit PySpark, Pandas und NumPy).

- Praxiserfahrung mit Databricks (Delta Lake, Lakehouse Architektur, Workflows/Job Orchestrierung) oder ähnlichen Plattformen.

- Demonstrierte Erfahrung beim Aufbau von ETL/ELT-Pipelines in großem Maßstab, einschließlich Datenaufnahme, Transformation und Qualitätssicherung.

- Vertrautheit mit Best Practices für die Softwareentwicklung (Git, CI/CD, DevOps).

- Starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und ein strukturierter Ansatz für die Datenarchitektur.

- Hervorragend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch.

Nizza zu haben

- Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure-Datendiensten (Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure SQL).

- Wissen über Versicherungsdatenstrukturen, insbesondere Katastrophenrisiko, Akkumulationsberichterstattung oder Rückversicherung.

- Erfahrung mit Databricks Feature Serving oder Model Serving Technologien.

- Vertrautheit mit Data Governance und Datenkatalogpraktiken.

- Vorherige Berufserfahrung in Versicherungs- oder Finanzdienstleistungen.

- Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Komfort präsentieren technische Konzepte für nicht-technische Stakeholder.

Wir bieten

Die Vergütung für Rollen in Zürich hängt von einer Vielzahl von Faktoren ab, darunter, aber nicht beschränkt auf die spezifische Rolle, die Fähigkeiten, den Erfahrungsstand und das geltende Recht. Zurich bietet somit eine Reihe von Vergütungen, die auf die interne Jobarchitektur und Marktbenchmarks abgestimmt sind, um eine faire und konsistente Bezahlung vergleichbarer Rollen zu gewährleisten. Die Ausgangsbasis für diese Position ist 2330 Eur.

Arbeitszeitleistungen

Persönliche freie Tage, konzentrierte Arbeitswoche, zusätzlicher Urlaub, Home Office, zusätzliche freie Tage bei Geburt, Sabbaturlaub, Workation

Geldleistungen

Lebensversicherung von Zürich Österreich, Entschädigung für Gehaltsverlust im Krankheitsfall, 3. Rentensäulenbeitrag, Risikolebensversicherung, Mahlzeitenbeitrag zusätzlich zum gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Mindestbetrag, Dienstjahresbonus, Hochzeitsbonus, Babybonus

Sonstige Leistungen

Elektronische Cafeteria, Mutterschaftsurlaub, Massagen im Büro

Lernen/Entwicklung

Professionelle Zertifizierungen, Online-Bildungsportale, umfangreiches Onboarding-Programm, stärkenbasierte Kultur (GALLUP)

- Zeitplan: Vollzeit

Über uns

In unserem Unternehmen erkennen wir die Bedeutung der Förderung einer aufgeschlossenen, sicheren und integrativen Umgebung für alle. Wir stehen zu Vielfalt und respektieren unterschiedliche Hintergründe und Lebensstile. Deshalb haben wir zahlreiche Initiativen umgesetzt, um sicherzustellen, dass sich unsere Mitarbeiter jederzeit wohl fühlen, akzeptiert und respektiert werden.

Notre opportunité

Ingénieur de données Azure

Êtes-vous une personne motivée, pratique et innovante intéressée à travailler pour l'un des plus grands assureurs mondiaux? Êtes-vous passionné par la conception d'architectures de données évolutives et la construction de pipelines robustes qui alimentent les décisions de risque critiques? Alors ce rôle est certainement quelque chose pour vous. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur de données pour rejoindre l'équipe nouvellement formée de la plate-forme de gestion de l'accumulation des risques (RAMP)

Le poste est prévu pour une affectation d'un an.

Votre rôle
En tant qu'ingénieur de données Azure , vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

- Concevoir et mettre en œuvre le modèle de données cibles pour l'accumulation des risques, couvrant à la fois l'exposition aux catastrophes en fonction de l'emplacement et les lignes non basées sur l'emplacement, y compris les antécédents d'exposition complets.

- Architecte et développe des pipelines ETL d'ingestion de données pour migrer les données provenant de sources de données d'accumulation héritées vers une plateforme moderne basée sur Databricks.

- Intégrer les données sur les pipelines de souscription (présentations et citations) dans les rapports d'accumulation, en veillant à ce que les intervenants aient accès aux points de vue actuels et en cours sur les risques.

- Construisez et optimisez les tâches de fabrication de lots à long terme pour la transformation des données, l'agrégation et la gestion des instantanés à l'aide de Databricks et de Delta Lake.

- Établir des cadres de qualité des données, des vérifications automatisées de validation et une surveillance de tous les ensembles de données ingérés et transformés.

- Collaborer avec l'ingénieur de données et développeur d'API et fournir des sauvegardes à l'équipe, en veillant à ce qu'il n'y ait pas de dépendances des personnes clés dans toute la plateforme.

- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'ensemble des équipes technologiques et commerciales pour offrir une excellente plate-forme de données fiable.

Vos compétences et votre expérience

En tant qu'ingénieur de données Azure, vos compétences et votre expérience comprendront idéalement:

- 3 ans d'expérience similaire

- Forte expérience de la modélisation SQL et des données relationnelles, y compris la conception de schémas pour les tâches d'analyse et de rapport.

- Compétence en Python (de préférence avec PySpark, Pandas et NumPy).

- Expérience pratique avec Databricks (Delta Lake, architecture Lakehouse, workflows/job orchestration) ou des plateformes similaires.

- Expérience démontrée de construction de pipelines ETL/ELT à l'échelle, y compris l'ingestion de données, la transformation et l'assurance de la qualité.

- Connaissance des meilleures pratiques de développement de logiciels (Git, IC/CD, DevOps).

- Des compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et une approche structurée de l'architecture des données.

- Excellent anglais écrit et parlé.

Sympa d'avoir

- Expérience avec les services de données Microsoft Azure (Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure SQL).

- Connaissance des structures de données d'assurance, en particulier l'exposition aux catastrophes, la déclaration d'accumulation ou la réassurance.

- Expérience avec Databricks Fonction service ou modèles technologies de service.

- Connaissance de la gouvernance des données et des pratiques de catalogage des données.

- Expérience professionnelle antérieure en assurance ou services financiers.

- Excellentes compétences en communication et confort présentant des concepts techniques aux acteurs non techniques.

Nous offrons

La rémunération des rôles à Zurich dépend d'un large éventail de facteurs, y compris, sans s'y limiter, le rôle spécifique, les compétences, le niveau d'expérience et le droit applicable. Zurich offre ainsi une gamme de rémunérations alignée sur l'architecture interne de l'emploi et les critères du marché pour assurer une rémunération équitable et cohérente pour des rôles comparables. L'échelle salariale de base de départ pour ce poste est de 2330 Eur.

Prestations de temps de travail

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei pronto a contare sul meglio?

A Zurigo, stiamo rivivendo l'assicurazione. Al fine di soddisfare i desideri dei nostri clienti ancora meglio, andiamo nuovi modi, pensare creativamente, lavorare agile. La nostra cultura aziendale vi dà maggiore flessibilità in ogni aspetto – e molta libertà di sviluppare in modo ottimale. Pensate grande – e anche a livello internazionale! Perché le tue possibilità di sviluppo non conoscono limiti con noi. Pronto a prendere il futuro in mano?

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

- Presso la sede di Colonia, si controlla la strategia di test, l'attuazione della governance dei test e la gestione della qualità attraverso treni e progetti, coordinando le parti interessate e le dipendenze

- Con il vostro know-how, sviluppate un panorama di test scalabile, automatizzato e moderno e assicurate così la futura redditività dei progetti strategici nonostante la pressione delle risorse esistenti.

- Il vostro focus è sull'ulteriore sviluppo della garanzia di qualità basata sull'intelligenza artificiale, la valutazione delle tendenze tecnologiche e l'introduzione di nuove tecnologie per ottimizzare i processi di test.

- Con piacere, istruisci e potenzia i tuoi team e agili, crea spazio per l'AI, la tecnologia e gli argomenti futuri e rafforza la garanzia di qualità negli ambienti cloud e DevSecOps

Lo porti con te.

- Forte capacità di comunicazione e coaching, nonché esperienza nelle parti interessate, dipendenza e gestione delle abilitazioni nelle organizzazioni agili

- Diversi anni di esperienza nella gestione dei test di grandi progetti di trasformazione e migrazione, nonché nella gestione della gestione della qualità e della governance dei test

- Conoscenza approfondita nella creazione e nell'attuazione di strategie di test, concetti di test, cancelli di qualità e metodi di test comuni e quadri (ISTQB, Agile Testing, SAFe)

- Conoscenza approfondita nell'assicurazione della qualità basata sull'intelligenza artificiale, la verificabilità dei sistemi AI, la gestione dei test tecnici e l'analisi e l'implementazione di nuove tecnologie

- Competenza in end-to-end, test di integrazione, performance e sicurezza, test di automazione, cloud test management, processi DevSecOps e paesaggi di sistema distribuiti con architetture mainframe, cloud e microservice

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

- Forme di lavoro flessibili per un equilibrio ottimale tra lavoro e casa

- Numerose opportunità di formazione e apprendimento per rimanere in forma per il lavoro quotidiano e consentire lo sviluppo individuale

- Supporto nella pianificazione della tua carriera - da un'analisi potenziale alla promozione individuale

- Un ambiente di lavoro moderno, aperto e trasparente che promuove la creatività e la collaborazione cross-team

- Che si tratti di fitness nel gruppo sul sito o di formazione di consapevolezza virtuale da casa: La nostra vasta gamma di servizi sanitari supporta un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa

- Leasing bici, biglietto Germania scontato, servizi di asset-generazione, un programma azionario dei dipendenti e altri grandi vantaggi

A seconda delle esigenze individuali di lavoro e dell'idoneità personale, il gruppo di Zurigo Germania sostiene generalmente forme di lavoro flessibili e part-time. Se siete interessati a questo punto e la vostra situazione personale non corrisponde abbastanza all'importo specificato (completo e part-time), si prega di contattarci (katina.heeg@zurich.com) per discutere le possibilità potenziali.

- Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno

Benvenuti nel vostro futuro

55.000 colleghi in 215 paesi e territori. Insieme sulla strada per ripensare l'assicurazione ogni giorno – e per modellare il futuro per tutti. Benvenuto in una comunità forte dove ti trasferisci dall'inizio. Insieme continuiamo a svilupparci!

Are you ready to count on the best?

At Zurich, we are re-living insurance. In order to fulfill the wishes of our customers even better, we go new ways, think creatively, work agile. Our corporate culture gives you more flexibility in every respect – and a lot of freedom to develop optimally. Think big – and also internationally! Because your development possibilities know no limits with us. Ready to take the future in hand?

This is what awaits you

- At the Cologne location, you control the test strategy, implementation of test governance and quality management across trains and projects, coordinating stakeholders and dependencies

- With your know-how, you develop a scalable, automated and modern test landscape and thus ensure the future viability of strategic projects despite existing resource pressure.

- Your focus is on the further development of AI-based quality assurance, the evaluation of technological trends and the introduction of new technologies to optimize test processes.

- In your responsible role, you control end-to-end, integration, performance and security tests and establish effective test strategies, test concepts and quality gates.

- With pleasure, you coach and empower your own and agile teams, create space for AI, technology and future topics and strengthen quality assurance in cloud and DevSecOps environments

You bring that with you

- Strong communication and coaching skills as well as experience in stakeholder, dependency and enablement management in agile organizations

- Several years of experience in the test management of large transformation and migration projects as well as in the management of quality management and test governance

- In-depth knowledge in the creation and implementation of test strategies, test concepts, quality gates as well as common test methods and frameworks (ISTQB, Agile Testing, SAFe)

- In-depth knowledge in AI-based quality assurance, the testability of AI systems, technical test management and the analysis and implementation of new technologies

- Expertise in end-to-end, integration, performance and security tests, test automation, cloud test management, DevSecOps processes and distributed system landscapes with mainframe, cloud and microservice architectures

This is what we offer you

- Flexible forms of work for an optimal balance between work at work and from home

- Numerous training and learning opportunities to stay fit for everyday work and enable individual development

- Support in your career planning - from potential analysis to individual promotion

- A modern, open and transparent working environment that promotes creativity and cross-team collaboration

- Whether fitness in the group on site or virtual mindfulness training from home: Our diverse range of health services supports a healthy work-life balance

- Bike leasing, discounted Germany ticket, asset-generating services, an employee share program and other great benefits

Depending on the individual job requirements and personal suitability, the Zurich Group Germany generally supports both flexible and part-time forms of work. Katina Heeg is looking forward to your application documents with your salary expectations and the possible start date via the career portal (“Apply now” button). Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications by e-mail.

Sei pronto a contare sul meglio?

A Zurigo, stiamo rivivendo l'assicurazione. Al fine di soddisfare i desideri dei nostri clienti ancora meglio, andiamo nuovi modi, pensare creativamente, lavorare agile. La nostra cultura aziendale vi dà maggiore flessibilità in ogni aspetto – e molta libertà di sviluppare in modo ottimale. Pensate grande – e anche a livello internazionale! Perché le tue possibilità di sviluppo non conoscono limiti con noi. Pronto a prendere il futuro in mano?

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

- Presso la sede di Colonia o Francoforte, sei la persona di contatto per domande di diritto fiscale nazionale e internazionale, ad esempio nel settore dei prezzi di trasferimento

- Inoltre, supporta le nostre aziende in tutte le questioni fiscali, compresa l'applicazione della legge di conversione (tax)

- Ti supporterai anche nell'audit fiscale, nonché nell'implementazione operativa e nella documentazione delle modifiche legali.

- Inoltre, sei coinvolto in progetti fiscali nazionali e internazionali

- I vostri compiti includono la corrispondenza con le autorità finanziarie e il sostegno di procedure di appello e comprensione

Lo porti con te.

- Forte pensiero analitico e orientato al processo, nonché alti risultati e orientamento al servizio

- Esperienza nel contesto internazionale e conoscenza nel trasferimento prezzi e modellazione e documentazione delle transazioni fiscali/processi

- Molto buona conoscenza dell'inglese in parola e scrittura così come l'esperienza pronunciata nel trattare con MS Office, in particolare Excel, così come se applicabile. SAP FI

- Esperienza professionale nel settore fiscale di una società internazionale, amministrazione finanziaria o consulenza fiscale

- Studi aziendali o legali completi con un focus sulle tasse o qualifiche comparabili, idealmente con un esame consulente fiscale

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

- Forme di lavoro flessibili per un equilibrio ottimale tra lavoro e casa

- Numerose opportunità di formazione e apprendimento per rimanere in forma per il lavoro quotidiano e consentire lo sviluppo individuale

- Supporto nella pianificazione della tua carriera - da un'analisi potenziale alla promozione individuale

- Un ambiente di lavoro moderno, aperto e trasparente che promuove la creatività e la collaborazione cross-team

- Che si tratti di fitness nel gruppo sul sito o di formazione di consapevolezza virtuale da casa: La nostra vasta gamma di servizi sanitari supporta un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa

- Leasing bici, biglietto Germania scontato, servizi di asset-generazione, un programma azionario dei dipendenti e altri grandi vantaggi

Z Informazioni aggiuntive

A seconda delle esigenze individuali di lavoro e dell'idoneità personale, il gruppo di Zurigo Germania sostiene generalmente forme di lavoro flessibili e part-time. descriptionByLocale.en:

At Zurich, we are re-living insurance. In order to fulfill the wishes of our customers even better, we go new ways, think creatively, work agile. Our corporate culture gives you more flexibility in every respect – and a lot of freedom to develop optimally. Think big – and also internationally! Because your development possibilities know no limits with us. Ready to take the future in hand?

This is what awaits you

- At the Cologne or Frankfurt location, you are the contact person for questions of national and international tax law, e.g. in the area of transfer pricing

- In addition, you support our companies in all tax matters including the application of conversion (tax) law

- You will also support you in the tax audit, as well as the operational implementation and documentation of legal changes.

- In addition, you are involved in national and international tax projects

- Your tasks include correspondence with financial authorities and the support of appeal and understanding procedures

You bring that with you

- Strong analytical and process-oriented thinking as well as high results and service orientation

- Experience in the international context as well as knowledge in transfer pricing and modeling and documentation of tax transactions/processes

- Very good knowledge of English in word and writing as well as pronounced experience in dealing with MS Office, in particular Excel, as well as if applicable. SAP FI

- Professional experience in the tax field of an international company, financial administration or tax consultancy

- Completed business or legal studies with a focus on taxes or comparable qualification, ideally with a tax consultant exam

This is what we offer you

- Flexible forms of work for an optimal balance between work at work and from home

- Numerous training and learning opportunities to stay fit for everyday work and enable individual development

- Support in your career planning - from potential analysis to individual promotion

- A modern, open and transparent working environment that promotes creativity and cross-team collaboration

- Whether fitness in the group on site or virtual mindfulness training from home: Our diverse range of health services supports a healthy work-life balance

jobs.description:
Head of Sales and Distribution, General Insurance

Zurich Insurance Europe AG, Ireland Branch is looking for a Head of Sales & Distribution, GI, who will be leading Zurich’s distribution strategy and execution across all channels – with a primary focus on the broker/intermediated market and selected direct and partnership channels.

You will drive profitable growth, strengthen our market position, and ensure we deliver great outcomes for customers and brokers. The role combines strategic leadership, strong market presence and hands‑on sales management, working closely with Underwriting, Product, Operations, Finance and Marketing.

This role may be available part-time or full time. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you may need.

Your Role

As a Head of Sales & Distribution, GI, your main responsibilities will include, but not necessarily be limited to, the following:

1. Strategy & Leadership

- Define and lead the GI distribution and sales strategy for Zurich in Ireland, aligned with Group and local business objectives.

- Set clear direction and priorities for the Sales & Distribution organisation, including regional and key account teams.

- Translate strategy into executable plans with measurable targets, timelines and accountabilities.

- Represent Distribution on the GI Ireland leadership team and actively contribute to the overall business strategy.

2. Sales Management & Growth Delivery

- Own delivery of GI distribution targets (GWP, new business, retention, profitability, mix) across channels.

- Lead the broker and partner engagement strategy, including segmentation, service models and share‑of‑wallet growth plans.

- Oversee key broker and partner relationships, including strategic negotiations, trading agreements and joint business plans.

- Drive disciplined sales management practices (pipeline, activity management, performance reviews, coaching).

- Ensure alignment between sales activity and underwriting appetite, pricing strategy and portfolio steering.

3. Market & Customer Focus

- Maintain deep understanding of the Irish GI market, broker landscape, competitor activity and regulatory developments.

- Champion the voice of the customer and broker within the organisation; ensure their needs are reflected in propositions, service and processes.

- Identify new market opportunities, distribution partnerships and growth segments, including digital and affinity opportunities.

- Support development and launch of new products and propositions from a distribution perspective.

Your Role ctd.

4. Performance Management & Governance

- Work with the Distribution Performance Manager and Finance to set and monitor channel, team and individual targets.

- Review performance regularly, identify gaps and implement corrective actions and growth initiatives.

- Ensure robust governance of distribution activities, including adherence to Zurich’s Code of Conduct, risk appetite and local regulatory requirements.

- Proactively identify and manage distribution‑related risks (e.g. concentration, conduct, conflicts of interest).

5. People Leadership & Culture

- Lead, develop and inspire the Sales & Distribution team to deliver high performance and strong collaboration.

- Build a culture of accountability, customer focus, integrity and continuous improvement.

- Attract, develop and retain talent; ensure succession planning for key roles.

- Promote diversity, inclusion and wellbeing within the team.

6. Collaboration & Change

- Partner closely with Underwriting, Product, Claims, Operations, Finance, Marketing and Digital teams to deliver integrated solutions for brokers and customers.

- Act as a key sponsor or stakeholder for strategic initiatives (e.g. digital distribution, system transformations, customer experience improvements).

- Share best practices and collaborate with peers in other Zurich markets and at Group level.

Your Skills and Experience

As a Head of Sales & Distribution, GI, your skills and qualifications will include:

Essential:

- Extensive experience in senior sales, distribution or commercial leadership roles within General Insurance.

- Strong knowledge of the Irish GI broker market and key intermediaries.

- Proven track record of delivering profitable growth and managing P&L or significant revenue responsibility.

- Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high‑performing sales and account management teams.

- Strong commercial acumen, including understanding of underwriting, pricing, portfolio management and capital considerations.

- Excellent negotiation and relationship‑management skills at senior broker and executive level.

- Strong analytical and decision‑making skills, with the ability to balance growth and profitability.

- Excellent communication and influencing skills, including experience presenting to executive stakeholders.

- Proven track record of people management at all levels, ability to manage key stakeholders and achieve desired result.

Desirable

- Experience working within a global or multinational insurance organisation.

- Familiarity with digital distribution, data‑driven sales management and marketing collaboration.

- Professional insurance qualification or relevant business qualification.

Competencies & Behaviours

- Strategic thinking – sets clear long‑term direction and makes sound strategic choices.

- Customer & broker focus – puts customer and partner needs at the centre of decisions.

- Results orientation – drives execution and holds self and others accountable for outcomes.

- Leadership & collaboration – builds strong teams, fosters collaboration and role‑models Zurich’s values.

- Change leadership – leads transformation and adapts quickly to market and regulatory change as well as change within Zurich

- Integrity & compliance mindset – acts consistently with Zurich’s Code of Conduct and regulatory expectations.

Additional Information

Primary work location is Blackrock, Dublin and travel may be required to other Zurich locations.

If you value an exciting and varied working environment and meet the above requirements, then our recruiter is looking forward to receiving your application by clicking on the button “Apply online”.

Who we are

Zurich is one of Ireland's leading insurance companies providing a wide range of general insurance and life insurance products and services. The company employs over 1,500 people across its locations in Dublin and Wexford.

Zurich Insurance Group (Zurich) is a leading global multi-line insurer founded more than 150 years ago, which has grown into a business serving more than 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories, while delivering industry-leading total shareholder returns.

Reflecting its purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ Zurich offers protection services that go beyond traditional insurance, to support its customers in building resilience. Since 2020, the Zurich Forest project supports reforestation and biodiversity restoration in Brazil’s Atlantic Forest.

The Group has more than 65,000 employees and is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Zurich Insurance Group Ltd (ZURN) is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange and has a level I American Depositary Receipt (ZURVY) program, which is traded over-the-counter on OTCQX. Further information is available at www.zurich.com .

jobs.title: Senior Customer Engagement Consultant
jobs.description:
A new transformational adventure awaits you…

How does 5 weeks leave per year, an impactful career that you’ll truly love, and working for a trustworthy organisation that empowers wellbeing and is accelerating digital transformation sound like to you?

As one of Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ and Fortune's ‘World's Most Admired Companies’ for 2025, Zurich - a leader in the insurance industry - is on a journey towards a brighter future… A brighter future for you - focused on your career, your wellbeing, and your community - as well as our customers and the planet.

This exciting adventure will drive positive impact towards our vision to be Australia’s leading digital insurer. So, if you want to be part of a values led global organisation, where real growth and transformation is happening, along with our track record of making a real difference of continuously taking steps toward a sustainable future for our people, customers, communities, and our planet…read on!

Let’s create a brighter future together, let’s make a difference

It's important to know, what you do matters. At Zurich, we don't just cover, we care.

Are you passionate about helping customers feel confident in their insurance decisions? We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Customer Engagement Consultant to join Zurich’s Ezicover General Advice team, reporting to the Advice Director – General Advice.

In this phone-based role, you’ll support customers with enquiries and fact-based general advice, helping them make informed choices about Zurich’s Ezicover products. You’ll also play an important role in supporting the Advice Director – General Advice and the broader Ezicover team, contributing to a smooth, efficient and customer-focused advice experience.

Important to your success - Unlock your potential

- Customer service, contact centre leadership, insurance, broking or advice experience highly regarded

- Warm, confident communicator who enjoys helping customers

- Able to work at pace and manage competing priorities

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly

- Collaborative team player with a customer-first mindset

- Strong attention to detail and sound judgement

- RG146 accreditation highly preferred

Belong. Zurich is here to support you

There are so many reasons why Zurich is a great place to be and the right choice for you, but here are just a few.

- 5 weeks leave per year for permanent staff through our Z leave initiative, as well as 15 days personal/carer’s leave (as we empower our people to manage their own wellbeing), plus access to Family Care (parental leave)

- Hybrid working arrangement - office 3 days and WFH 2 days p/w standard for FT employees

- Access programs to stay healthy and feel healthier along with receiving a AUD$500 wellbeing payment per year, plus an AUD$295 new starter e-voucher for your WFH set up (flex work - hybrid working), and other great benefits through our Shine portal

- Grow, and thrive in your career (we support and encourage it) with award winning training programs. As our strength is our people and we value your individuality

- Work with global, diverse, and inclusive teams; Explore your passions, fuel innovation, drive equity, collaborate and make a positive difference beyond your role

- Global mobility opportunities across more than 200 countries worldwide

- Volunteer and work in our state-of-the-art Green Star rated offices (when you are in the office) and dress for your day

- We plant a tree for every new employee

- Not to mention our various employer of choice awards/memberships – WGEA; Family Inclusive workplace; Gold AWEI employer, Pride in diversity… to name a few.

We could go on, but the main point is that Zurich is a great place to be, where you can truly belong, be yourself, have work/life balance, and thrive in a supportive environment.

Zurich is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require any special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to please let us know at the time of your application.

So, if you want to come on an adventure that will build a brighter future together, and feel a sense of togetherness, then please apply today to start your adventure !

As one of Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ and Fortune's ‘World's Most Admired Companies’ for 2025, Zurich - a leader in the insurance industry - is on a journey towards a brighter future… A brighter future for you - focused on your career, your wellbeing, and your community - as well as our customers and the planet.

This exciting adventure will drive positive impact towards our vision to be Australia’s leading digital insurer. So, if you want to be part of a values led global organisation, where real growth and transformation is happening, along with our track record of making a real difference of continuously taking steps toward a sustainable future for our people, customers, communities, and our planet…read on!

Let’s create a brighter future together, let’s make a difference

It's important to know, what you do matters. At Zurich, we don't just cover, we care.

Are you passionate about helping customers feel confident in their insurance decisions? We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Customer Engagement Consultant to join Zurich’s Ezicover General Advice team, reporting to the Advice Director – General Advice.

In this phone-based role, you’ll support customers with enquiries and fact-based general advice, helping them make informed choices about Zurich’s Ezicover products. You’ll also play an important role in supporting the Advice Director – General Advice and the broader Ezicover team, contributing to a smooth, efficient and customer-focused advice experience.

Important to your success - Unlock your potential

- Customer service, contact centre leadership, insurance, broking or advice experience highly regarded

- Warm, confident communicator who enjoys helping customers

- Able to work at pace and manage competing priorities

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly

- Collaborative team player with a customer-first mindset

- Strong attention to detail and sound judgement

- RG146 accreditation highly preferred

Belong. Zurich is here to support you

There are so many reasons why Zurich is a great place to be and the right choice for you, but here are just a few.

- 5 weeks leave per year for permanent staff through our Z leave initiative, as well as 15 days personal/carer’s leave (as we empower our people to manage their own wellbeing), plus access to Family Care (parental leave)

- Hybrid working arrangement - office 3 days and WFH 2 days p/w standard for FT employees

- Access programs to stay healthy and feel healthier along with receiving a AUD$500 wellbeing payment per year, plus an AUD$295 new starter e-voucher for your WFH set up (flex work - hybrid working), and other great benefits through our Shine portal

- Grow, and thrive in your career (we support and encourage it) with award winning training programs. As our strength is our people and we value your individuality

- Work with global, diverse, and inclusive teams; Explore your passions, fuel innovation, drive equity, collaborate and make a positive difference beyond your role

- Global mobility opportunities across more than 200 countries worldwide

- Volunteer and work in our state-of-the-art Green Star rated offices (when you are in the office) and dress for your day

- We plant a tree for every new employee

- Not to mention our various employer of choice awards/memberships – WGEA; Family Inclusive workplace; Gold AWEI employer, Pride in diversity… to name a few.

We could go on, but the main point is that Zurich is a great place to be, where you can truly belong, be yourself, have work/life balance, and thrive in a supportive environment.

Zurich is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require any special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to please let us know at the time of your application.

So, if you want to come on an adventure that will build a brighter future together, and feel a sense of togetherness, then please apply today to start your adventure !

jobs.title: Business Analyst Sr
jobs.description:
¿Te apasiona el mundo de los seguros? ¿Te gusta trabajar en ambientes dinámicos y retadores?, Si tu respuesta es Sí, te comentamos que estamos buscando un: Business Analyst Sr

ROL
Analizar procesos e identificar oportunidades de mejora, proponiendo soluciones que contribuyan al logro de los objetivos de la compañía, gestionando y traduciendo los requerimientos del negocio en soluciones funcionales que aseguren su correcta implementación a lo largo del ciclo de vida del proyecto, facilitando la toma de decisiones y garantizando la generación de valor para el negocio.
RESPONSABILIDADES DEL ROL

- Analizar procesos y prácticas de negocio para identificar oportunidades de mejora y proponer soluciones alineadas con los objetivos estratégicos de la compañía.

- Recopilar, interpretar y analizar datos e información de diversas fuentes para generar insights y optimizar procesos, sistemas y resultados del negocio.

- Levantar, documentar y gestionar requerimientos de negocio, elaborando especificaciones funcionales, indicadores y documentación asociada durante el ciclo de vida del proyecto.

- Apoyar la definición de casos de negocio, análisis de costo-beneficio, evaluación de riesgos, pruebas, implementación y adopción de las soluciones propuestas.

- Garantizar el cumplimiento de políticas, estándares de gestión de proyectos, gobernanza y seguridad de la información aplicables a sus funciones.

PERFIL REQUERIDO

- Estudios universitarios concluidos en Ingeniería en Sistemas / Software / TI, Ingeniería Comercial, Administración de empresas, Negocios Internacionales o carreras afines.

-
Experiencia mínima de 3 a 4 años en posiciones similares en empresas de seguros o banca.

Conocimientos técnicos:

- Manejo de paquete office 365

- Metodologías ágiles

- Gestión de procesos

- Análisis de datos

- Seguridad de la información

COMPETENCIAS

- Pensamiento Analítico

- Comunicación Asertiva

- Resolución de conflictos

- Orientación a resultados

Por qué elegir Zurich

En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor!

Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

Enviar candidatura ahora »

jobs.title: Casualty Underwriter - Vancouver or Calgary
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Are you looking for a caring, collaborative, values-driven workplace with inspiring teammates and leaders? Do you have the ambition and desire to be the best and thrive at the most impactful global insurance provider in the world? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have experience in insurance underwriting, customer relationship management, or a related field and are looking for a new challenge, we would love to hear from you.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for a Casualty Underwriter in our Vancouver or Calgary office to analyze and underwrite new and renewal business, regularly interact with the market, and deliver exceptional service to customers.

Reporting to the AVP Liability Manager, Western Region, you will work closely with agents, brokers, and customers to understand their insurance needs, support sales initiatives, and ensure underwriting guidelines and risk assessment standards are met. You will use The Zurich Way of Underwriting Framework within delegated authority, supporting both retention and new business growth while gaining hands-on experience in a collaborative environment.

This is a unique opportunity to build your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice matters. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.

Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring three days per week of in-person presence, which may include time in the office or market-facing engagements.

What you will do

- Administer and monitor underwriting rules, rating manuals, and insurance laws/regulations.

- Build and maintain relationships with distributors (agents and brokers) to support business retention and growth.

- Collaborate with business line representatives to support customer needs.

- Identify and qualify new business and renewal opportunities.

- Analyze exposures, measure risk, and negotiate terms and conditions.

- Calculate and quote target prices using Zurich’s underwriting tools.

- Promote Zurich’s products and services to agents, brokers, and customers.

- Support sales culture as a Help Point for distributors and clients.

- Participate in sales meetings and target account planning.

- Update systems with details of broker/client visits and account statuses.

- Provide technical expertise and clear explanations for underwriting decisions.

- Resolve technical and operational issues by referring to policies and procedures.

- Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory controls governing work practices.

- Travel for business and work extended hours during peak periods, as required.

- Maintain a valid driver’s license.

Job Qualifications - What you bring to the table

Required:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent, with 1 or more years of experience in Insurance or Market-Facing areas (Claims/Underwriting Support, or relevant experience for specialized lines)

OR

-
High School Diploma or Equivalent and 2 or more years of experience in Claims or Underwriting Support area

AND

- Knowledge of the insurance industry and the legal/regulatory environment

- Understanding of underwriting philosophy, techniques, and filing regulations

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Relationship-building, active listening, and negotiation skills

- Microsoft Office proficiency

Preferred:

- Bachelor’s Degree with 1 or more years of underwriting experience

- Financial acumen and analytical skills

- Presentation skills and a solutions/service orientation

Compensation for roles at Zurich varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. The salary range provided is a nationwide market range and has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location where the position may be filled. As required by local law, Zurich provides in good faith a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Compensation may exceed the range listed based on the evaluation of skillset and experience. The starting salary range for this position is $62,500 - $80,000.

Our Culture

-

At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). We want you to bring your whole self to work, and we want our employees to be reflective of the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives are creating an environment where everyone feels welcome.

We have a collaborative culture where diversity of thought is valued. We value your input and strive to give our employees the tools they need to make an impact.

We care about our employees’ well-being and offer a comprehensive health/benefits plan with varying levels of coverage to suit your specific needs and a competitive total compensation package.

We understand how important it is to rest, recharge and do the things you love. At Zurich, all employees receive a minimum of four weeks of vacation per year to do just that.

We also understand that employees require time off for personal reasons. Maybe you have an appointment during a workday, a cultural or religious holiday you would like to observe, or you need time off to focus on your mental health. Zurich employees receive four personal days per year to be used at their discretion.

We are committed to continuous improvement and offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.

We care about our communities. Our communities are where our customers, people, and shareholders live and work. While we can be proud of the contribution to society Zurich makes through our core business of insurance, we must also give back to our communities through our talent, time, and resources.

We have won numerous awards for our workplace culture. We are proud to be one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers and to have received Insurance Business Canada’s 5-Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award.

Make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

About Us

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-line insurer with approximately 55,000 employees worldwide serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada has been a leading insurance provider serving mid-sized and large companies, including multinational corporations, in the Canadian commercial market for 100 years. With over 650 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a top insurance provider combined with in-depth knowledge of industries and local markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be risk management professionals’ first choice as their premier partner to help meet the risk challenges of today and tomorrow. Read more at www.zurichcanada.com .

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich strives to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We recruit talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion bring us closer to our common goal: exceeding our customers’ expectations. Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on behalf of, Zurich. We strive to achieve a workplace free of discrimination of all forms, including discrimination on the basis of physical or mental disability, or medical condition. If you are interested in a job opportunity, please advise if you require an accommodation, so we can work with you to provide a more accessible process.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Any unsolicited resume will become the property of Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. If you are a preferred vendor, please use our Recruiting Agency Portal for resume submission.

Only applicable for Canada: For Zurich Canada's commitment to diversity and accessibility please click here. If you would prefer to not receive future electronic messages from Zurich Insurance Company Ltd's recruitment management system, please email your request to have your job profile deleted from the system by clicking here. Zurich Insurance Company Ltd 100 King St., W., Suite 5500, Toronto, ON, M5X 1C9. www.zurichcanada.co

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

- Remote working:

- Schedule: Full Time
