L’opportunité

Vous recherchez un environnement de travail bienveillant, collaboratif et axé sur des valeurs, avec des collègues et des leaders inspirants? Vous avez l’ambition et le désir d’exceller et de vous épanouir chez le plus influent assureur mondial? Ne cherchez pas plus loin que Zurich Canada.

Si vous possédez une expérience en actuariat et recherchez un nouveau défi, nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature.

Zurich Canada recherche actuellement un Actuaire en tarification automobile - Assurance automobile commerciale, pour soutenir le processus de tarification des assurances automobiles de particuliers et fournir des analyses et des perspectives à l'équipe de tarification automobile et à nos partenaires commerciaux.

Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez également aux modifications tarifaires, aux déclarations et à la communication de ces modifications auprès des partenaires internes. Vous participerez à l'amélioration continue de la sophistication de la tarification et de la segmentation des risques, en mettant en œuvre des changements dans la plateforme de tarification et en effectuant les validations requises.

Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de développer vos connaissances et votre expérience pour l'avenir, dans un environnement stimulant où votre avis compte. Ce poste est nouvellement vacant.

Zurich Canada utilise des outils intégrant l’intelligence artificielle pour soutenir certains aspects du processus de recrutement, notamment l’examen initial et le présélection des candidatures. L’intelligence artificielle ne constitue pas l’unique fondement de la présélection ou de la sélection des candidats. Toutes les décisions d’embauche sont examinées et prises par des professionnels qualifiés en recrutement.

Zurich adopte un modèle de travail hybride qui exige une présence en personne trois jours par semaine, comprenant du temps au bureau ou des rencontres avec le marché.

Ce que vous ferez

• Sous supervision générale, soutenir la tarification des nouvelles affaires et du portefeuille de renouvellement, ainsi que le développement de structures tarifaires et de primes alignés au niveau de risque.
• Contribuer aux interactions avec les régulateurs provinciaux, les partenaires internes et les instances de gouvernance sur les sujets liés à la tarification, avec l’appui de membres plus expérimentés de l’équipe.
• Soutenir le développement et la maintenance des modèles, outils et capacités de production de rapports en tarification.
• Développer une solide compréhension des facteurs influençant les coûts de sinistres et les primes, et contribuer aux initiatives visant à accroître continuellement la sophistication de la tarification, y compris la création de nouveaux modèles prédictifs.
• Aider à la surveillance de la performance et de la rentabilité du portefeuille pour les nouvelles affaires et les renouvellements.
• Préparer et réaliser des analyses actuarielles, incluant des analyses de tendances, des indications, des impacts de taux et d’autres études liées à la tarification, avec une révision appropriée.
• Soutenir les équipes de produits et de souscription en fournissant des analyses et des recommandations variées.
• Participer à la validation, à la mise en œuvre et à la maintenance des algorithmes et outils de tarification.
• Se tenir informé des évolutions réglementaires et du marché et intégrer ces connaissances aux analyses de tarification.
• Opérer conformément aux lignes directrices et procédures de souscription de Zurich.

Qualifications personnelles - Ce que vous apportez

Obligatoires :

• Apprenti certifié en assurance Zurich, incluant un diplôme d’associé

OU

• Baccalauréat

ET

• 5 à 7 ans d’expérience en actuariat, idéalement en tarification des lignes commerciales.
• Progression vers un titre actuariel (ACAS ou certification internationale équivalente)

Souhaitées :

• Expérience en tarification automobile dans une ou plusieurs provinces
• Solides compétences analytiques ainsi que d’excellentes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite
• Capacité à expliquer des résultats techniques à des parties prenantes non techniques

Chez Zurich Canada, nous nous engageons envers l’équité salariale. Nous déterminons la rémunération selon des critères objectifs tels que les compétences, l’expérience et l’équité interne. L’échelle salariale pour ce poste est de 108 000 à 158 000. Cette plage reflète la rémunération prévue pour ce poste partout au Canada et peut varier selon des facteurs comme l’emplacement, les responsabilités spécifiques et les qualifications individuelles. Conformément à la loi locale, Zurich fournit de bonne foi une fourchette de rémunération raisonnable, mais le salaire de départ peut dépasser cette plage selon les compétences et l’expérience du candidat.

La maîtrise de l’anglais parlé et écrit est requise afin de faciliter la communication avec des parties prenantes internes et externes hors Québec.

À propos de nous

Zurich Canada fait partie du Groupe Zurich Insurance, un assureur multibranches comptant environ 55 000 employés dans le monde, au service des clients sur les marchés mondiaux et locaux. Zurich Canada est un chef de file qui dessert les entreprises de taille moyenne et grande, y compris les multinationales, sur le marché commercial canadien depuis 100 ans. Avec plus de 650 employés dans des bureaux partout au pays, Zurich offre la force mondiale d’un assureur de premier plan, alliée à une connaissance approfondie des secteurs et des marchés locaux. Zurich Canada aspire à être le premier choix des professionnels de la gestion des risques comme partenaire privilégié pour relever les défis d’aujourd’hui et de demain. Pour en savoir plus, consultez www.zurichcanada.com .

• Fournit des services actuariels de base sous supervision directe afin de répondre aux exigences commerciales de routine.

• Effectue une analyse statistique, modélise et analyse des données, développe des modèles/programmes de création et d'analyse de modèles, interprète les résultats des modèles et des analyses.

• Compile et classe les données et documents, vérifie les facteurs et hypothèses utilisés dans les calculs afin de garantir la fiabilité des résultats.

• Prépare et gère un plan de développement professionnel annuel pour déployer des compétences au niveau de diverses méthodes et techniques actuarielles, et les mettre à profit pour atteindre les objectifs commerciaux.

• Effectue des analyses actuarielles et établit des rapports visant à soutenir les fonctions de production du secteur.

• Prépare des demandes de prime, le calendrier des statistiques/analyses statistiques et des états financiers, et fait des recommandations pour la préparation de rapports.

• Participe à l'évaluation et à la vérification des processus et systèmes nouveaux/ proposés, lorsque l'analyse a pour objectif de soutenir la mise en œuvre de systèmes mis à niveau.

Un avenir avec Zurich

Il est maintenant temps de progresser et de changer les choses. Zurich veut connaître vos points de vue, vos expériences et vos idées afin que nous puissions grandir ensemble et favoriser un changement durable. Membre d’une organisation mondiale de premier plan, Zurich North America compte plus de 148 années d’expérience dans la gestion des risques et le soutien de la résilience. Nous sommes un chef de file en matière de solutions d’assurance biens et accidents pour les entreprises et nous proposons une vaste gamme de produits et de services de gestion des risques pour les entreprises et les particuliers. Notre clientèle couvre actuellement plus de 25 secteurs d’activité, allant de l’agriculture à la technologie, et nous assurons 90 % des entreprises Fortune 500®. Notre stratégie de croissance ne se limite pas à nos activités. En tant qu’employeur, Zurich a à cœur d’offrir constamment des possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel et de favoriser un environnement diversifié axé sur l’inclusion et l’équité, où les employés éprouvent un véritable sentiment d’appartenance. Participez à la prochaine évolution de l’industrie de l’assurance. Joignez-vous à notre équipe pour bâtir un avenir meilleur pour nos employés, nos clients et les collectivités que nous servons.

En tant que société d’envergure mondiale, Zurich est consciente de l’atout certain que représente une main-d’œuvre diversifiée. Nous recrutons des personnes talentueuses provenant de divers milieux, dont les points de vue uniques seront vraiment les bienvenus. Ensemble, la diversité et l’inclusion nous rapprochent de notre objectif commun : dépasser les attentes de nos clients. Zurich s’engage à mettre en place un environnement inclusif, exempt d’obstacles et favorisant la diversité, afin d’offrir une organisation accessible aux employés, aux clients et aux autres parties qui interagissent avec la société ou en son nom. Nous nous efforçons de créer un milieu de travail exempt de discrimination de tout genre, y compris la discrimination fondée sur tout problème de santé ou sur toute incapacité physique ou mentale. Si une offre d’emploi vous intéresse et que vous avez besoin d’accommodement, veuillez nous en aviser afin que nous prenions des dispositions pour rendre le processus plus accessible.

Zurich n’accepte pas les curriculum vitæ non sollicités provenant d’agences de recrutement ou de placement. Les curriculum vitæ non sollicités deviendront la propriété de Société de portefeuille canadienne Zurich Limitée. Les fournisseurs privilégiés doivent soumettre les curriculum vitæ sur le portail de notre agence de recrutement.

Pour l'engagement de Zurich envers la diversité et l'accessibilité veuillez cliquer ici .

Si vous préférez ne plus recevoir à l’avenir les messages électroniques en provenance du système de gestion du recrutement de Zurich Compagnie d’Assurances SA, veuillez envoyer par courrier électronique votre demande visant à supprimer votre profil d’emploi du système en cliquant ici . Opportunità

Alla ricerca di un ambiente di lavoro attento, collaborativo e basato sui valori con colleghi e leader ispiranti? Avete ambizione e desiderio di eccellere e fiorire nell'insurretore più influente del mondo? Non guardare oltre Zurigo Canada.

Se avete un'esperienza nel lavoro attuariale e siete alla ricerca di una nuova sfida, saremo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione.

Zurigo Canada è attualmente alla ricerca di un Automobile Pricing Actuary - Assicurazione automobilistica commerciale, per sostenere il processo di prezzi per l'assicurazione auto privata e fornire analisi e prospettive per il team di prezzi automobilistici e i nostri partner commerciali.

In questo ruolo, contribuirai anche a cambiamenti tariffari, reporting e comunicazione di questi cambiamenti ai partner interni. Parteciperai al continuo miglioramento della sofisticazione dei prezzi e della segmentazione dei rischi, implementando i cambiamenti nella piattaforma dei prezzi ed eseguendo le validazioni richieste.

Questa è un'opportunità unica per sviluppare la vostra conoscenza e la vostra esperienza per il futuro, in un ambiente stimolante in cui la vostra opinione conta. Questo posto è appena vacante.

Zurigo Canada utilizza strumenti che integrano l'intelligenza artificiale per sostenere alcuni aspetti del processo di reclutamento, tra cui l'esame iniziale e la screening delle applicazioni. L'intelligenza artificiale non è la sola base per la proiezione o la selezione dei candidati. Tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono esaminate e prese da professionisti qualificati di reclutamento.

Zurigo adotta un modello ibrido di lavoro che richiede una presenza persona a persona tre giorni alla settimana, tra cui l'orario di ufficio o gli incontri con il mercato.

Cosa farai

• Sotto la supervisione generale, sostenere i prezzi del nuovo portafoglio business e rinnovo, nonché lo sviluppo di strutture di prezzo e premi allineati al livello di rischio.
• Contribuisci alle interazioni con i regolatori provinciali, i partner interni e gli organismi di governance sui problemi dei prezzi, con il supporto di membri del team più esperti.
• Supporta lo sviluppo e la manutenzione di modelli di report dei prezzi, strumenti e funzionalità.
• Sviluppare una forte comprensione dei fattori che influenzano i costi e i premi dei crediti, e contribuire a iniziative per aumentare continuamente la sofisticazione dei prezzi, tra cui la creazione di nuovi modelli predittivi.
• Assistere nel monitoraggio delle prestazioni del portafoglio e della redditività per nuove imprese e rinnovi.
• Preparare e condurre analisi attuariali, tra cui analisi di tendenza, indicazioni, impatti dei tassi e altri studi di prezzi, con una corretta revisione.
• Sostenere i team di prodotti e abbonamenti fornendo varie analisi e raccomandazioni.
• Partecipa alla validazione, implementazione e manutenzione di algoritmi e strumenti di pricing.
• Tenere informato degli sviluppi normativi e di mercato e integrare queste conoscenze nelle analisi dei prezzi.
• Operare secondo le linee guida e le procedure di abbonamento di Zurigo.

Qualifiche personali - Che cosa porti

Mandatory:

• Imparare certificato in assicurazione Zurigo, compreso il grado associato

O

• Baccalaureato

E

• 5-7 anni di esperienza in actuarial, idealmente in linea commerciale prezzi.
• Progressi verso il titolo attuariale (ACAS o certificazione internazionale equivalente)

Desideri:

• Esperienza nei prezzi delle auto in una o più province
• Forte capacità analitiche e eccellenti capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta
• Capacità di spiegare i risultati tecnici agli stakeholder non tecnici

A Zurigo Canada, siamo impegnati a pagare l'equità. Determinamo la compensazione in base a criteri oggettivi quali competenze, esperienza e correttezza interna. La fascia salariale per questa posizione è 108.000 a 158,000. Questa gamma riflette la paga prevista per questa posizione in tutto il Canada e può variare a seconda di fattori come la posizione, responsabilità specifiche e qualifiche individuali. Secondo la legge locale, Zurigo fornisce in buona fede un range di pagamento ragionevole, ma lo stipendio iniziale può superare questa gamma a seconda delle competenze e dell'esperienza del candidato.

La competenza in inglese parlato e scritto è necessaria per facilitare la comunicazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni al di fuori del Quebec.

Informazioni su di noi

Opportunity

Looking for a caring, collaborative and values-based work environment with inspiring colleagues and leaders? Do you have ambition and desire to excel and flourish in the world's most influential insurer? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have an experience in actuarial work and are looking for a new challenge, we would be happy to receive your application.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for an Automobile Pricing Actuary - Commercial automobile insurance, to support the pricing process for private car insurance and provide analysis and perspectives to the automotive pricing team and our trading partners.

In this role, you will also contribute to tariff changes, reporting and communicating these changes to internal partners. You will participate in the continuous improvement of pricing sophistication and risk segmentation, implementing changes in the pricing platform and performing the required validations.

This is a unique opportunity to develop your knowledge and experience for the future, in a stimulating environment where your opinion counts. This post is newly vacant.

Zurich Canada uses tools that integrate artificial intelligence to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including initial examination and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for the screening or selection of candidates. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified recruitment professionals.

Zurich adopts a hybrid model of work that requires a person-to-person presence three days a week, including office time or meetings with the market.

What You Will Do

• Under general supervision, support the pricing of new business and renewal portfolio, as well as the development of price structures and premiums aligned to the level of risk.
• Contribute to interactions with provincial regulators, internal partners and governance bodies on pricing issues, with the support of more experienced team members.
• Support the development and maintenance of pricing reporting models, tools and capabilities.
• Develop a strong understanding of the factors influencing claims costs and premiums, and contribute to initiatives to continually increase the sophistication of pricing, including the creation of new predictive models.
• Assist in monitoring portfolio performance and profitability for new business and renewals.
• Prepare and conduct actuarial analyses, including trend analyses, indications, rate impacts and other pricing studies, with appropriate revision.
• Support product and subscription teams by providing various analyses and recommendations.
• Participate in the validation, implementation and maintenance of algorithms and pricing tools.
• Keep informed of regulatory and market developments and integrate this knowledge into pricing analyses.
• Operate in accordance with the Zurich Guidelines and Subscription Procedures.

Personal qualifications - What you bring

Mandatory:

• Learned certified in insurance Zurich, including associate degree

OR

• Baccalaureate

AND

• 5-7 years experience in actuarial, ideally in commercial line pricing.
• Progress towards actuarial title (ACAS or equivalent international certification)

Wishes:

• Experience in car pricing in one or more provinces
• Strong analytical skills and excellent oral and written communication skills
• Ability to explain technical results to non-technical stakeholders

At Zurich Canada, we are committed to pay equity. We determine compensation according to objective criteria such as skills, experience and internal fairness. The salary range for this position is 108,000 to 158,000. This range reflects the expected pay for this position across Canada and may vary depending on factors such as location, specific responsibilities and individual qualifications. According to local law, Zurich provides in good faith a reasonable pay range, but the starting salary may exceed this range depending on the candidate's skills and experience.

Proficiency in spoken and written English is required to facilitate communication with internal and external stakeholders outside Quebec.

About us

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-branch insurer with approximately 55,000 employees worldwide, serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada has been a leader in serving medium and large businesses, including multinationals, in the Canadian commercial market for 100 years. With over 650 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a leading insurer, combined with a thorough knowledge of local sectors and markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be the first choice of risk management professionals as a preferred partner to meet the challenges of today and tomorrow. For more information, visit www.zurichcanada.com .

• Provides basic actuarial services under direct supervision to meet routine business requirements.

• Performs statistical analysis, modelling and data analysis, develops models/programs for model creation and analysis, interprets model results and analyses.

• Compiles and classifies data and documents, verifies the factors and assumptions used in calculations to ensure reliability of results.

• Prepares and manages an annual professional development plan to deploy skills in various actuarial methods and techniques and use them to achieve business objectives.

• Conducts actuarial analyses and reports to support the production functions of the sector.

• Prepares premium applications, schedule of statistical statistics/analysis and financial statements, and makes recommendations for reporting.

• Participates in the evaluation and verification of new/proposed processes and systems, where the objective of the analysis is to support the implementation of upgraded systems.

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and change things. Zurich wants to know your views, experiences and ideas so we can grow together and foster sustainable change. A member of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience in risk management and resilience support. We are a leader in property and accident insurance solutions for businesses and we offer a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Our clients currently cover more than 25 business sectors, ranging from agriculture to technology, and we provide 90% of Fortune 500® companies. Our growth strategy is not limited to our activities. As an employer, Zurich is committed to providing continuous career development opportunities and to fostering a diverse, inclusive and equitable environment where employees have a real sense of belonging. Participate in the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join our team to build a better future for our employees, clients and communities.

As a global society, Zurich is aware of the fact that a diverse workforce represents a certain asset. We recruit talented people from a variety of backgrounds, whose unique views are truly welcome. Together, diversity and inclusion bring us closer to our common goal: to exceed the expectations of our customers. Zurich is committed to creating an inclusive, barrier-free and diversity-friendly environment to provide an organization accessible to employees, customers and other parties who interact with or on behalf of the company. We strive to create a workplace free of discrimination of all kinds, including discrimination based on any health problem or physical or mental disability. If you are interested in a job offer and need accommodation, please notify us so that we can make arrangements to make the process more accessible.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment or placement agencies. Unsolicited curricula vitae will become the property of Canadian Holding Corporation Zurich Limited. Preferred suppliers must submit curricula vitae to our recruitment agency portal.

Suchen Sie ein fürsorgliches, kollaboratives und wertebasiertes Arbeitsumfeld mit inspirierenden Kollegen und Führungskräften? Haben Sie den Ehrgeiz und den Wunsch, sich im einflussreichsten Versicherer der Welt zu behaupten und zu gedeihen? Suchen Sie nicht weiter als Zürich Kanada.

Zurich Canada ist derzeit auf der Suche nach einem Automobile Pricing Actuary - Commercial Kfz-Versicherung, um den Preisprozess für private Kfz-Versicherungen zu unterstützen und dem Automobilpreisteam und unseren Handelspartnern Analysen und Perspektiven zu bieten.

Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, Ihr Wissen und Ihre Erfahrung für die Zukunft in einem anregenden Umfeld zu entwickeln, in dem Ihre Meinung zählt. Dieser Posten ist neu vakant.

Zurich Canada verwendet Werkzeuge, die künstliche Intelligenz integrieren, um bestimmte Aspekte des Rekrutierungsprozesses zu unterstützen, einschließlich der Erstprüfung und des Screenings von Bewerbungen. Künstliche Intelligenz ist nicht die einzige Grundlage für das Screening oder die Auswahl von Kandidaten. Alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden von qualifizierten Rekrutierungsexperten überprüft und getroffen.

Zurich verfolgt ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das eine persönliche Präsenz an drei Tagen in der Woche erfordert, einschließlich Bürozeiten oder Treffen mit dem Markt.

Was Sie tun werden

• Beitrag zu Interaktionen mit regionalen Regulierungsbehörden, internen Partnern und Governance-Gremien zu Preisfragen mit der Unterstützung erfahrenerer Teammitglieder.
• Unterstützung der Entwicklung und Pflege von Preisberichtsmodellen, Tools und Fähigkeiten.
• Entwickeln Sie ein starkes Verständnis der Faktoren, die Schadenskosten und Prämien beeinflussen, und tragen Sie zu Initiativen bei, um die Preisentwicklung kontinuierlich zu erhöhen, einschließlich der Schaffung neuer prädiktiver Modelle.
• Unterstützung bei der Überwachung der Portfolio-Performance und Rentabilität für Neugeschäfte und Erneuerungen.
• Erstellung und Durchführung versicherungsmathematischer Analysen, einschließlich Trendanalysen, Indikationen, Zinsauswirkungen und anderer Preisbildungsstudien, mit entsprechender Überarbeitung.
• Unterstützen Sie Produkt- und Abonnementteams durch verschiedene Analysen und Empfehlungen.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Validierung, Implementierung und Wartung von Algorithmen und Preisgestaltungstools.
• Halten Sie sich über regulatorische und Marktentwicklungen auf dem Laufenden und integrieren Sie dieses Wissen in Preisanalysen.
• Arbeiten Sie nach den Zürich Richtlinien und Abonnementverfahren.

Persönliche Qualifikationen - Was Sie mitbringen

Vorgeschrieben:

• Erlernt in Versicherung Zürich, einschließlich Associate Degree

ODER

• Baccalaureat

UND

• 5-7 Jahre Erfahrung in versicherungsmathematischen, idealerweise in kommerziellen Linie Preisgestaltung.
• Fortschritt in Richtung versicherungsmathematischer Titel (ACAS oder gleichwertige internationale Zertifizierung)

Wünsche:

• Erfahrung in der Autopreisgestaltung in einer oder mehreren Provinzen
• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und ausgezeichnete mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• Fähigkeit, technische Ergebnisse nichttechnischen Interessengruppen zu erklären

Bei Zurich Canada sind wir verpflichtet, Gerechtigkeit zu zahlen. Wir bestimmen die Vergütung nach objektiven Kriterien wie Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und interner Fairness. Nach lokalem Recht bietet Zürich in gutem Glauben eine angemessene Lohnspanne, aber das Einstiegsgehalt kann diese Spanne je nach Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung des Kandidaten überschreiten.

Kenntnisse in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch sind erforderlich, um die Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern außerhalb von Quebec zu erleichtern.

Über uns

Zurich Canada ist Teil der Zurich Insurance Group, einem Branchenversicherer mit rund 55.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit, der Kunden in globalen und lokalen Märkten betreut. Zurich Canada ist seit 100 Jahren führend in der Betreuung von mittleren und großen Unternehmen, einschließlich multinationaler Unternehmen, auf dem kanadischen Handelsmarkt. Mit über 650 Mitarbeitern in Büros im ganzen Land bietet Zurich die globale Stärke eines führenden Versicherers, kombiniert mit einer gründlichen Kenntnis der lokalen Sektoren und Märkte. Zurich Canada strebt danach, die erste Wahl von Risikomanagement-Profis als bevorzugter Partner zu sein, um die Herausforderungen von heute und morgen zu meistern. Für weitere Informationen besuchen Sie www.zurichcanada.com .

• Bietet grundlegende versicherungsmathematische Dienstleistungen unter direkter Aufsicht, um routinemäßige Geschäftsanforderungen zu erfüllen.

Jetzt ist es an der Zeit, voranzukommen und die Dinge zu ändern. Zurich möchte Ihre Ansichten, Erfahrungen und Ideen kennen, damit wir gemeinsam wachsen und nachhaltige Veränderungen fördern können. jobs.title: Software Asset Management Analyst
jobs.description:
We Are Waiting for You

Hi there!

I am Álvaro, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you!

First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center : The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich !

First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions.

If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale.

What Can You Expect?

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked.

As a Software Asset Management Analyst you will have the opportunity to:

- Serve as the subject matter expert for Software Asset Management (SAM), providing guidance on complex software licensing topics and producing Effective License Positions (ELPs) across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid IT environments.

- Manage and optimise software licensing for major enterprise vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, Broadcom, IBM, SAP, Red Hat), ensuring compliance and maximising business value.

- Interpret and apply software licensing concepts and product use rights across modern technology landscapes, including containers, cloud platforms, and traditional infrastructure environments.

- Leverage data from enterprise systems and tools such as Azure Active Directory, CMDB, My Access, and Intune to support software asset management, billing, cost allocation, and reporting activities.

- Ensure transparency of software-related costs by managing chargeback processes and enabling fair cost allocation to Business Units and Service Owners based on actual software consumption.

- Build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders and external software vendors, leading negotiations and driving mutually beneficial outcomes.

- Identify, develop, and implement initiatives that generate software cost savings, mitigate compliance risks, and enhance SAM processes, controls, and best practices.

- Lead and support complex software contract negotiations, including demand management, contract renewals and amendments, while collaborating closely with sourcing, procurement, legal, and vendor management teams.

- Support the implementation and continuous improvement of global SAM standards, governance frameworks, controls, reporting capabilities, and performance metrics.

- Drive innovation within SAM by leveraging AI and automation capabilities to reduce manual effort, identify recurring trends, and uncover optimisation opportunities.

- Contribute to the day-to-day operations and strategic initiatives of the global Software Asset Management team, ensuring the delivery of high-quality services and continuous operational excellence.

What Makes You a great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you!

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

- 3+ years of relevant proven experience with:

- direct responsibility for managing software portfolio for least one of major software publishers in enterprise environment (irrespective of industry).

- creating comprehensive fully optimized ELPs from data collection until finish.

- strong understanding of license restrictions, benefits, optimization opportunities.

- proficient use of SAM tools (ideally FlexeraOne) and supporting data sources.

- advanced hands-on MS Excel skills (V/H-Look Ups, Pivots, Complex calculations, …).

- proven track record in adopting and embedding AI solutions in SAM operations.

- profit and Loss (P&L) calculations and accruals for cost impact.

- Fluent spoken and written English (strong B2+).

PROVEN PERSONAL TRAITS

- analytical skills, financial and commercial acumen, attention to detail, AI expertise, ability to process data in a complex global organizational environment.

- organizational, productivity, time and project management skills.

- ability to interface, influence and network with managers, staff and stakeholders inside and outside of the organization.

- communication and negotiation skills with vendors as well as with internal stakeholders.

And… What Makes Us Special?

As well as a competitive salary and a yearly bonus , we offer:

- To support your work-life balance, we have adopted a flexible working model.

- Option to work abroad up to 25 days yearly.

- Over 300 euros to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowance.

- Wide range of internal and external trainings, including English, German and Spanish classes depending on the needs.

- Ticket restaurant and Health Insurance with the flexibility to exchange it for other benefits.

- Life and accident insurance.

- Collective Life retirement Plan

- 2000 referral bonus if you bring other talented people like you to the company.

- Special banking and insurance conditions plus Exclusive Employees discounts

- Functional diversity benefits

- Stock options and mortgage benefits.

Where Are We Located?

Barcelona, Poblenou.

#Li-hybrid

Can you see yourself in this role? Don’t wait any longer! Apply by sending your CV in English .

If not, no worries! We’ll meet again in the future. Feel free to share my contact details with anyone you think would be a great fit.

At Zurich, we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best-qualified individuals available, regardless of race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

Zurich Technology Delivery Center – Your Talent, Our Strength

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

- Schedule: Full Time

- Recruiter name: Alvaro Gallego Zazo

Bonjour !

Je suis Álvaro, le recruteur pour ce poste. Ravi de vous rencontrer !

Notre mentalité technologique favorise l'apprentissage et la croissance continus, créant une atmosphère où chacun peut prospérer. Maintenant, j'ai hâte de partager ce voyage passionnant avec vous à Zurich !

Tout d'abord, merci d'avoir envisagé notre entreprise. Nous comprenons que trouver la bonne occasion peut être difficile, mais je vais essayer de le rendre plus facile.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Laissez-moi nous présenter. Vous lisez sur Zurich Insurance Group , un leader mondial de l'assurance, mais ce rôle concerne spécifiquement notre Centre de livraison de technologie (CDT). Créée à Barcelone en 2006, la TDC fait partie intégrante du groupe d'assurances Zurich, fournissant des solutions technologiques de pointe et un soutien aux entreprises locales et mondiales de Zurich.

En substance, Zurich TDC est l'endroit où la technologie rencontre la vaste portée d'une entreprise multinationale. Nous nous spécialisons dans des domaines comme le développement de logiciels, l'analyse de données, la cybersécurité et l'infrastructure informatique. Notre mission première est de soutenir les objectifs stratégiques de Zurich et d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle grâce à des solutions technologiques innovantes.

Si vous envisagez un rôle avec nous, sachez que vous rejoindrez un pôle d'excellence technologique dédié à la réussite de Zurich à l'échelle mondiale.

Que pouvez - vous attendre?

Et vous pourriez penser : C'est génial, à quoi ressemblera mon quotidien à TDC ? Je suis content que vous ayez demandé.

En tant qu'analyste de la gestion des biens logiciels, vous aurez la possibilité :

- Servir d'expert en matière de gestion d'actifs logiciels (SAM), fournir des conseils sur des sujets complexes de licence de logiciels et produire des positions de licence efficaces (PLE) dans des environnements informatiques sur site, en nuage et hybrides.

- Gérer et optimiser les licences de logiciels pour les principaux fournisseurs d'entreprise (p. ex. Microsoft, Oracle, Broadcom, IBM, SAP, Red Hat), en assurant la conformité et en maximisant la valeur commerciale.

- Interpréter et appliquer les concepts de licences de logiciels et les droits d'utilisation des produits dans les paysages technologiques modernes, y compris les conteneurs, les plates-formes nuageuses et les environnements d'infrastructure traditionnels.

- Tirer parti des données des systèmes et outils d'entreprise comme Azure Active Directory, CMDB, My Access et Intune pour soutenir les activités de gestion d'actifs logiciels, de facturation, de répartition des coûts et de rapport.

- Assurer la transparence des coûts liés aux logiciels en gérant les processus de remise des frais et en permettant une répartition équitable des coûts entre les unités opérationnelles et les propriétaires de services en fonction de la consommation réelle de logiciels.

- Établir et maintenir des relations efficaces avec les intervenants internes et les fournisseurs de logiciels externes, diriger les négociations et obtenir des résultats mutuellement bénéfiques.

- Identifier, élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des initiatives qui permettent de réaliser des économies sur les logiciels, d'atténuer les risques de conformité et d'améliorer les processus, les contrôles et les pratiques exemplaires en matière de MAS.

- Diriger et appuyer les négociations complexes sur les contrats de logiciels, y compris la gestion de la demande, le renouvellement des contrats et les modifications, tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes de gestion de l'approvisionnement, de l'approvisionnement, du droit et des fournisseurs.

- Appuyer la mise en œuvre et l'amélioration continue des normes mondiales de gestion des ressources humaines, des cadres de gouvernance, des contrôles, des capacités d'établissement de rapports et des indicateurs de rendement.

- Favoriser l'innovation au sein de la SAM en tirant parti des capacités d'intelligence artificielle et d'automatisation pour réduire l'effort manuel, identifier les tendances récurrentes et découvrir les possibilités d'optimisation.

- Contribuer aux activités quotidiennes et aux initiatives stratégiques de l'équipe mondiale de gestion des biens logiciels, en assurant la prestation de services de haute qualité et l'excellence opérationnelle continue.

Ce qui fait T'es un super Fit ?

Alors que nous ne cherchons pas la perfection ou vous attendons à sauver le monde, nous croyons que si vous répondez à certaines de ces exigences, vous serez un ajustement fantastique pour notre équipe. Nous vous attendons !

QUALIFICATIONS ET COMPÉTENCES DE BASE

- 3 ans et plus d'expérience pertinente prouvée avec:

- la responsabilité directe de la gestion du portefeuille de logiciels pour au moins un des grands éditeurs de logiciels dans l'environnement d'entreprise (quel que soit l'industrie).

- créer des ELP entièrement optimisés de la collecte de données jusqu'à la fin.

- bonne compréhension des restrictions de licence, des avantages, des possibilités d'optimisation.

- utilisation efficace des outils SAM (idéalement FlexeraOne) et sources de données.

- compétences avancées en MS Excel (V/H-Look Ups, Pivots, calculs complexes, ...).

- Expérience éprouvée dans l'adoption et l'intégration de solutions d'IA dans les opérations SAM.

- calcul des profits et pertes (P&L) et des charges à payer pour l'incidence des coûts.

- Anglais parlé et écrit (B2+ fort).

TRAITEMENTS PERSONNELS PROVENANTS

- compétences analytiques, acuité financière et commerciale, attention aux détails, expertise en matière d'IA, capacité de traiter les données dans un environnement organisationnel mondial complexe.

- compétences en matière d'organisation, de productivité, de temps et de gestion de projet.

- la capacité d'interagir, d'influencer et de mettre en réseau les gestionnaires, le personnel et les intervenants à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de l'organisation.

Qu'est-ce qui nous rend spéciaux ?

Où sommes-nous ?

Barcelone, Poblenou.

Sinon, pas de soucis ! Nous nous retrouverons à l'avenir. N'hésitez pas à partager mes coordonnées avec n'importe qui que vous pensez être un bon ajustement.

jobs.description:
Zurich is seeking a successful Workers’ Compensation Defense Trial Attorney to work out of our Chicago, IL Staff Legal office, 1 day per week in-office attendance should be expected. This Attorney will be responsible for representing the Company in all phases of Workers’ Compensation litigation in the Illinois (including, but not limited to, Chicago, Chicagoland Collar Counties, and Zone 3 Locations including Rock Island, Bloomington, and Peoria). They will be practicing law in compliance with ethical standards as established by state law by preparing and defending moderate to high exposure Workers’ Compensation cases from a challenging and varied caseload. Responsibilities will include working directly with claims professionals providing legal analysis and advice, preparing and filing legal pleadings and documents, performing legal research, preparing for and conducting pre-trial investigations, preparing for and handling pre-trials and Arbitration Hearings before the workers’ compensation Arbitrator, and conducting post-trial activities, including appeals to the Commission, Circuit Court, and/or Appellate Courts where appropriate. Under limited direction, the attorney will work within broad limits and authority on complex assignments requiring specialized knowledge in breadth and/or depth in area of expertise.

At Zurich North America we acknowledge that work life-balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing claims employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, the candidate selected for this opportunity is expected to report to Zurich’s Chicago Illinois Staff Legal Office located in Willis Tower 1 day per week.

If you are ready for a career move, consider working for a company with a global footprint that offers an excellent work/life balance, terrific benefits including a 401K match and a second 401K company contribution, flexible work options and a great culture.

Basic Qualifications:

- Juris Doctor and 5 or more years of experience in the Litigation area
AND

- Member in good standing of the Illinois State Bar Association

- Experience with Microsoft Office and Adobe

- Experience working with Lexis or Westlaw

- Knowledge of the insurance industry, claims and the insurance defense litigation legal environment

- Knowledge of the law and procedure

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.description:
Zurich North America is seeking a Senior Audit Manager to join our Group Audit team in our North American headquarters in Schaumburg, Illinois.

Group Audit (GA) is an international team of 250 colleagues from 33 different nationalities, working as one function. We work with a common purpose: to keep Zurich safe. Together, we look to bring our skills, capabilities, and unique strengths to provide real insights to our stakeholders. We work to be the best we can be at spotting danger for our company; continuously learning and trying to get better and better at what we do.

Working closely with GA leaders this is a unique opportunity to drive the evolution of the function, and to transform our ways of working. We believe that a clear common purpose, promoting authenticity of individuals and creating a learning environment will help our teams bring their best.

Up for a challenge? Interested in becoming a part of our growing team? We would love to hear from you!

As a Senior Audit Manager your main responsibilities will be of a global nature and involve:

- Work with Functional and Regional Audit Executives, as well as country / legal entity heads of audit, to perform risk assessments and develop and shape the audit plan in line with key risks and trends, ensuring appropriate coverage across the group.

- Oversee and manage a diverse portfolio of risk-based audits (local, ‘connected’ and global thematic reviews) in line with quality, time and budget requirements. Ensure appropriate resourcing and technical expertise for delivery of assigned portfolio.

- Provide subject matter expertise and insight across audit processes, including scoping, audit reports and critical stakeholder meetings.

- Oversee relevant tracking and closure of agreed actions.

- Support the continuous evolution of audit capabilities in Group Audit and drive the development of the wider team through upskilling initiatives and technical knowledge sharing sessions.

- Identify trends and themes patterns in results and support influencing key stakeholders in broader actions as well as reporting themes to Group and local executives and Audit Committees. Provide technical input into control environment reporting. Build technical / commercial knowledge and industry awareness across a range of areas by accessing diverse resources and interacting with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.

- Support Business Audit Leaders in stakeholder discussions and develop strong and influential peer relationships with Business stakeholders across the group.

- Oversee the performance of team members assigned (career management responsibilities) and take necessary actions to support their development.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree and 10 or more years of experience in the Audit or Finance area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 12 or more years of experience in the Audit or Finance area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate’s Degree and 10 or more years of experience in the Audit or Finance area

Preferred Qualifications:

- 8-10 years of relevant experience in auditing, and 2-4 years holding senior roles at a Senior Manager level, OR VP/Director level or equivalent.

- Experience in third-party, outsourcing and project management auditing.

- Experience in the Finance Industry, specifically Insurance is an advantage.

- A good track record in implementing change and transformation, as well implementing a learning culture in a flat hierarchy.

- Excellent project management skills, ability to organize teams, prioritize tasks, guide and coach the team to deliver on time to high quality standards.

- Ability to work without close supervision and to take decisions autonomously, subject to verification.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills.

- Experience within complex, global organizations and virtual teams, as well outsourced services.

- Ability to influence teams and senior management executives.

- Collaborative, customer focused, flexible, persistent, and results-oriented mindset.

- International work experience.

At Zurich, compensation for roles is influenced by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. In compliance with local laws, Zurich commits to providing a fair and reasonable compensation range for each role. For more information about our Total Rewards, please click here . Additional rewards may encompass short-term incentive bonuses and merit increases. We encourage candidates with salary expectations beyond the provided range to apply as they will be considered based on their experience, skills, and education. The proposed salary range for this position is $124,500.00 - $203,700.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 20%.

As an insurance company, Zurich is subject to 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

A future with Zurich. What can go right when you apply at Zurich?

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 150 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. Today, Zurich North America is a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. We serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology, and we insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, we strive to provide ongoing career development opportunities, and we foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our colleagues, our customers and the communities we serve. Zurich maintains a comprehensive employee benefits package for employees as well as eligible dependents and competitive compensation. Please click here to learn more.

Zurich in North America is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.description:
Have you completed two or more years of college and are looking to finish your bachelor’s degree? Zurich’s Complete-a-Bachelor’s Apprenticeship offers a unique opportunity to complete your education while launching a career in commercial insurance—with no tuition costs.

Now accepting applications for the January 2027 cohort, this two-year program combines online coursework through the University of Arizona Global Campus (UAGC), with hands-on experience and professional development at Zurich’s Anoka, MN office. There is an additional and separate process of applying for admission to UAGC.

Ideal for those with an associate degree or rising juniors from accredited U.S. colleges, the program allows you to earn your degree while gaining valuable industry experience with a global insurance leader.

Zurich is currently seeking a Data Analytics Bachelor’s Apprentice to work out of our Anoka, MN office.

Come join us in the Crop Analytics Group and try out your skills in data analytics! This is an excellent opportunity to gain insight into a professional environment and the organization’s risk management practices, with exposure to leadership across different levels. This team genuinely cares about growing your professional insights and talents to better prepare you for a solid career!

As an apprentice, you will work under immediate supervision, collaborating with seasoned professionals and participating in a structured program with an assigned mentor.

Key aspects of this apprenticeship include:

- Exposure to common data and information sources

- Understanding the effectiveness of various data pulls

- Learning to pull and analyze data from diverse sources

- Performing duties which are of a mathematical and/or financial nature

Additional development opportunities include:

- Acquiring knowledge of various reporting metrics, their meanings, and pulling techniques

- Gaining hands-on experience with Power BI, SAS, SQL

- Shadowing various departments to deepen understanding of RCIS and the crop insurance industry

- Engaging with various team members to accomplish their work and duties, fostering a collaborative understanding of team dynamics.

This apprenticeship offers a comprehensive learning experience, allowing employees to develop practical skills and insights into the data analytics and risk management field. Upon successful interview you will be contacted to start your application to UAGC.

Basic Qualifications:

- Associate Degree in Business or related field or rising Junior with two years of coursework in Business or related field and no prior years of experience in the insurance area. Contingent on admittance into University of Arizona Global Campus Bachelor of Business Administration program.

- Be legally eligible to work in the U.S indefinitely

Preferred Qualifications:

- Interested in pursuing a bachelor’s degree Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or related field

- Minimum cumulative current grade point average of 3.0 (current could mean last semester GPA)

- Experience with Power BI, Python, SAS, Visual Basic

- Intermediate Microsoft Office

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Problem-solving skills in a customer-focused environment

- Quick Learner

- Experience in a leadership role

- Self-motivated and able to work independently

- Strong interest in the insurance industry

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Hourly range for this position is $23.32-$24.04, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 5%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Haben Sie zwei oder mehr Jahre College abgeschlossen und möchten Ihren Bachelor-Abschluss abschließen? Zurich's Complete-a-Bachelor's Apprenticeship bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, Ihre Ausbildung abzuschließen, während Sie eine Karriere in der gewerblichen Versicherung beginnen - ohne Studiengebühren.

Dieses zweijährige Programm, das jetzt Bewerbungen für die Kohorte vom Januar 2027 annimmt, kombiniert Online-Kurse über den University of Arizona Global Campus (UAGC) mit praktischer Erfahrung und beruflicher Entwicklung im Büro von Anoka in Zürich. Es gibt ein zusätzliches und separates Verfahren für die Zulassung zur UAGC.

Ideal für diejenigen mit einem Associate Degree oder aufstrebende Junioren von akkreditierten US-Colleges, das Programm ermöglicht es Ihnen, Ihren Abschluss zu verdienen, während wertvolle Branchenerfahrung mit einem globalen Versicherungsführer zu gewinnen.

Zurich sucht derzeit einen Data Analytics Bachelor-Lehrling, der von unserem Büro in Anoka, MN, aus arbeiten soll.

Kommen Sie zu uns in der Crop Analytics Group und probieren Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten in der Datenanalyse aus! Dies ist eine hervorragende Gelegenheit, einen Einblick in ein professionelles Umfeld und die Risikomanagementpraktiken des Unternehmens zu erhalten, wobei Führungspositionen auf verschiedenen Ebenen auftreten. Dieses Team kümmert sich wirklich darum, Ihre beruflichen Erkenntnisse und Talente zu erweitern, um Sie besser auf eine solide Karriere vorzubereiten!

Als Auszubildender arbeiten Sie unter unmittelbarer Aufsicht, arbeiten mit erfahrenen Fachleuten zusammen und nehmen an einem strukturierten Programm mit einem zugewiesenen Mentor teil.

Zu den wichtigsten Aspekten dieser Ausbildung gehören:

- Exposition gegenüber gemeinsamen Daten und Informationsquellen

- Verständnis der Effektivität verschiedener Daten zieht

- Lernen, Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen zu ziehen und zu analysieren

- Ausübung mathematischer und/oder finanzieller Aufgaben

Weitere Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sind:

- Erwerb von Wissen über verschiedene Berichtsmetriken, ihre Bedeutungen und Ziehtechniken

- Erfahrungen sammeln mit Power BI, SAS, SQL

- Abschattung verschiedener Abteilungen, um das Verständnis von RCIS und der Ernteversicherungsbranche zu vertiefen

- Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teammitgliedern, um ihre Arbeit und Aufgaben zu erfüllen und ein gemeinsames Verständnis der Teamdynamik zu fördern.

Diese Ausbildung bietet eine umfassende Lernerfahrung, die es den Mitarbeitern ermöglicht, praktische Fähigkeiten und Einblicke in den Bereich Datenanalyse und Risikomanagement zu entwickeln. Nach erfolgreichem Interview werden Sie kontaktiert, um Ihre Bewerbung bei UAGC zu starten.

Grundqualifikationen:

- Associate Degree in Business oder verwandten Bereich oder steigende Junior mit zwei Jahren Kursarbeit in Business oder verwandten Bereich und keine vorherigen Jahre Erfahrung im Versicherungsbereich. Contingent auf Zulassung in University of Arizona Global Campus Bachelor of Business Administration Programm.

- Rechtlich berechtigt sein, auf unbestimmte Zeit in den USA zu arbeiten

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

- Interessiert an einem Bachelor-Abschluss Data Analytics, Informatik, Statistik, Mathematik, Finanzen oder verwandten Bereichen

- Minimaler kumulativer Stromnotendurchschnitt von 3,0 (aktuell könnte im letzten Semester GPA bedeuten)

- Erfahrung mit Power BI, Python, SAS, Visual Basic

- Intermediate Microsoft Office

- Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

- Problemlösungskompetenzen in einer kundenorientierten Umgebung

- Quick Learner

- Erfahrung in einer Führungsrolle

- Selbstmotiviert und unabhängig arbeiten können

- Starkes Interesse an der Versicherungsbranche

Ihre Bezahlung in Zürich basiert auf Ihrer Rolle, Ihrem Standort, Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung. Wir befolgen lokale Gesetze, um eine faire Entschädigung zu gewährleisten. Möglicherweise haben sie auch anspruch auf boni und leistungssteigerungen. Wenn Ihre Erwartungen über dem aufgeführten Bereich liegen, empfehlen wir Ihnen dennoch, sich zu bewerben - Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund ist für uns wichtig.

Die gezeigte Lohnspanne ist ein nationaler Durchschnitt und kann je nach Standort variieren. Die vorgeschlagene stündliche Reichweite für diese Position beträgt 23,32 $ 24,04 $, wobei die kurzfristige Anreizbonusberechtigung auf 5% festgelegt ist.

Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Bezahlung und umfassende Leistungen für Mitarbeiter und ihre Familien. [Erfahren Sie hier mehr über Total Rewards.]

Bei Zurich schätzen wir Ihre Ideen und Erfahrungen. Wir bieten Wachstum, Inklusion und ein unterstützendes Umfeld - damit Sie die Zukunft der Versicherung mitgestalten können. Votre salaire à Zurich est basé sur votre rôle, votre emplacement, vos compétences et votre expérience. Nous suivons les lois locales pour garantir une juste indemnisation. Vous pouvez également être admissible à des primes et à des augmentations de mérite. Si vos attentes sont au-dessus de la fourchette indiquée, nous vous encourageons toujours à présenter votre candidature, ce qui compte pour nous.

L'échelle de rémunération indiquée est une moyenne nationale et peut varier selon l'endroit. La fourchette horaire proposée pour ce poste est de 23,32 $ à 24,04 $, et l'admissibilité aux primes incitatives à court terme est fixée à 5 %.

Nous offrons une rémunération concurrentielle et des avantages complets aux employés et à leur famille. [En savoir plus sur Total Rewards ici .]

À Zurich, nous apprécions vos idées et votre expérience. Nous offrons la croissance, l'inclusion et un environnement favorable, afin que vous puissiez aider à façonner l'avenir de l'assurance. Rejoignez-nous pour un avenir meilleur, pour vous et nos clients.

jobs.description:
We Are Waiting for You

Hi there!

I am Álvaro Gallego, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you!

First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center : The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich !

First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions.

If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale.

What Can You Expect?

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked.

As a UX Researcher Senior you will have the opportunity to:

- Collaborate on strategic and innovative initiatives that improve the experience of internal users, such as underwriters, claims handlers, and other business teams across Zurich.

- Lead end-to-end research activities across multiple projects, from discovery and user interviews to usability testing, insights synthesis, and recommendations.

- Support product and business teams in understanding user needs, behaviours, pain points, and opportunities, helping shape more user-centred solutions.

- Contribute to the design and validation of innovative experiences, including conversational AI, intelligent workflows, and emerging digital solutions.

- Partner with UX/UI designers, product owners, engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure user insights are considered throughout the product lifecycle.

- Drive evidence-based decision making through a combination of user research, business understanding, market trends, and qualitative and quantitative insights.

- Explore new research approaches, tools, and technologies that help the team continuously improve the way we understand and support our users.

- Work across multiple initiatives simultaneously, balancing priorities while maintaining a high standard of research quality and impact.

- Enhance your skills through exposure to complex enterprise products, AI-enabled experiences, and cross-functional collaboration.

- Contribute to a team that values curiosity, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

What Makes You a great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team.

We are particularly interested in someone who sees research not only as a validation activity, but as a way to uncover opportunities, challenge assumptions, and help teams make better-informed decisions.

1. Individual Contribution and Technical Requirements

- You have significant experience as a UX Researcher working on digital products, enterprise platforms, or complex user journeys.

- You are skilled in a wide range of research methodologies, including user interviews, usability testing, discovery research, surveys, workshops, and concept validation.

- You can translate research findings into clear, actionable insights into clear recommendations that support product, business, and design decisions.

- You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and identifying the right questions before jumping to solutions.

- You have experience working with complex stakeholder environments where business objectives, user needs, operational realities, and technical constraints must be balanced.

- You bring a strategic mindset and are able to connect user insights with broader business goals and opportunities.

- You are proactive, curious, and continuously look for opportunities to improve products, services, and ways of working.

- You have strong storytelling and communication skills, allowing you to influence decisions through evidence, insights, and actionable recommendations

- You are comfortable working on multiple initiatives simultaneously and adapting to changing priorities.

- Experience with AI-enabled experiences, conversational interfaces, intelligent assistants, automation, or emerging technologies is highly desirable.

- Experience with UX/UI design, prototyping, Figma, service design, or front-end technologies would be considered a strong advantage.

2. Project Management Skills

- You are able to manage and prioritize research activities across multiple projects simultaneously.

- You can independently plan research initiatives, define objectives, manage timelines, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

- You are organised, adaptable, and comfortable operating in dynamic environments with evolving priorities.

- You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- You can facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and alignment activities that help teams move forward with confidence.

- You are able to identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities throughout the research lifecycle.

- You understand how to influence decisions through evidence, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement.

- You can build alignment among diverse stakeholders while maintaining a strong focus on user needs and business value.

And… What Makes Us Special?

As well as a competitive salary and a yearly bonus , we offer:

- To support your work-life balance, we have adopted a flexible working model.

- Option to work abroad up to 25 days yearly.

- Over 300 euros to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowance.

- Wide range of internal and external trainings, including English, German and Spanish classes depending on the needs.

- Ticket restaurant and Health Insurance with the flexibility to exchange it for other benefits.

- Life and accident insurance.

- Collective Life retirement Plan

- 2000 referral bonus if you bring other talented people like you to the company.

- Special banking and insurance conditions plus Exclusive Employees discounts

- Functional diversity benefits

- Stock options and mortgage benefits.

Where Are We Located?

Barcelona, Poblenou.

#Li-hybrid

Can you see yourself in this role? Don’t wait any longer! Apply by sending your CV in English .

If not, no worries! We’ll meet again in the future. Feel free to share my contact details with anyone you think would be a great fit.

At Zurich, we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best-qualified individuals available, regardless of race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

Zurich Technology Delivery Center – Your Talent, Our Strength

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

- Location(s): ES - Barcelona

- Schedule: Full Time

- Recruiter name: Alvaro Gallego Zazo

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ti stiamo aspettando

Ciao!

Io sono Álvaro Gallego, il reclutatore per questa posizione. Piacere di conoscerti!

In primo luogo, un po 'di quello che mi piace di più di lavorare al Centro di consegna della tecnologia di Zurigo: L'ambiente qui è incredibilmente collaborativo e innovativo. La nostra mentalità tecnologica favorisce l'apprendimento continuo e la crescita, creando un'atmosfera in cui tutti possono prosperare. Non vedo l'ora di condividere questo emozionante viaggio con te a Zurigo!

Prima di tutto, grazie per aver considerato la nostra azienda. Sappiamo che trovare la giusta opportunità può essere difficile, ma cercherò di rendere più facile.

Chi siamo?

Fammi presentarci. Stai leggendo su Zurich Insurance Group , leader globale nell'assicurazione, ma questo ruolo riguarda specificamente il nostro Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Fondata a Barcellona nel 2006, il TDC opera come parte integrante del gruppo assicurativo di Zurigo, fornendo soluzioni tecnologiche all'avanguardia e supporto alle business unit locali e globali di Zurigo.

In sostanza, Zurigo TDC è dove la tecnologia incontra la vasta portata di una multinazionale. Siamo specializzati in settori come lo sviluppo del software, l'analisi dei dati, la sicurezza informatica e l'infrastruttura IT. La nostra missione primaria è quella di sostenere gli obiettivi strategici di Zurigo e migliorare l'efficienza operativa attraverso soluzioni tecnologiche innovative.

Se state considerando un ruolo con noi, sappiate che vi unirete ad un hub di eccellenza tecnologica dedicato alla guida del successo di Zurigo su scala globale.

Cosa puoi aspettarti?

E potresti pensare: E' fantastico, come sara' la mia giornata al TDC? Sono felice che tu abbia chiesto.

Come Ricercatore UX Senior avrete l'opportunità di:

- Collabora con iniziative strategiche e innovative che migliorano l'esperienza degli utenti interni, come sottoscrittrici, gestori di reclami e altri team aziendali di Zurigo.

- Condurre attività di ricerca end-to-end su più progetti, dalla scoperta e le interviste degli utenti a test di usabilità, sintesi di insight e raccomandazioni.

- Sostenere i team di prodotti e di business nella comprensione delle esigenze degli utenti, dei comportamenti, dei punti di dolore e delle opportunità, aiutando a modellare soluzioni più centrate sull'utente.

- Contribuisci alla progettazione e alla validazione di esperienze innovative, tra cui AI conversazione, flussi di lavoro intelligenti e soluzioni digitali emergenti.

- Partner con progettisti UX/UI, proprietari di prodotti, ingegneri, architetti e stakeholder aziendali per garantire che gli insight degli utenti siano considerati durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto.

- Guidare il processo decisionale basato su prove attraverso una combinazione di ricerca utente, comprensione aziendale, tendenze di mercato e insight qualitativi e quantitativi.

- Esplora nuovi approcci di ricerca, strumenti e tecnologie che aiutano il team a migliorare continuamente il modo in cui comprendiamo e supportiamo i nostri utenti.

- Lavorare su più iniziative contemporaneamente, bilanciando le priorità mantenendo un elevato standard di qualità e impatto della ricerca.

- Migliora le tue competenze attraverso l'esposizione a prodotti aziendali complessi, esperienze abilitate all'intelligenza artificiale e collaborazione interfunzionale.

- Contribuisci a un team che valorizza curiosità, innovazione, collaborazione e apprendimento continuo.

Cosa fa Sei un grande Fit?

Mentre non cerchiamo la perfezione o ti aspettiamo di salvare il mondo, crediamo che se si soddisfano alcuni di questi requisiti, sarete una soluzione fantastica per il nostro team.

Siamo particolarmente interessati a qualcuno che vede la ricerca non solo come un'attività di validazione, ma come un modo per scoprire opportunità, sfidare i presupposti e aiutare le squadre a prendere decisioni meglio informate.

1. Contributo individuale e requisiti tecnici

- Hai un'esperienza significativa come ricercatore UX che lavora su prodotti digitali, piattaforme aziendali o viaggi utente complessi.

- Sei esperto in una vasta gamma di metodologie di ricerca, tra cui interviste agli utenti, test di usabilità, ricerca di scoperta, sondaggi, workshop e validazione dei concetti.

- È possibile tradurre i risultati della ricerca in chiari, intuizioni attuabili in chiare raccomandazioni che sostengono le decisioni di prodotto, business e design.

- Sei comodo navigare ambiguità e identificare le domande giuste prima di saltare a soluzioni.

- Hai esperienza di lavoro con ambienti di stakeholder complessi in cui obiettivi aziendali, esigenze degli utenti, realtà operative e vincoli tecnici devono essere bilanciati.

- Si porta una mentalità strategica e sono in grado di collegare le intuizioni degli utenti con obiettivi aziendali più ampi e opportunità.

- Siete proattivi, curiosi e costantemente alla ricerca di opportunità per migliorare prodotti, servizi e modi di lavoro.

- Hai forti capacità di narrazione e comunicazione, permettendo di influenzare le decisioni attraverso prove, intuizioni e raccomandazioni attuabili

- Sei comodo lavorare su più iniziative contemporaneamente e adattarsi alle mutevoli priorità.

- L'esperienza con esperienze abilitate all'IA, interfacce di conversazione, assistenti intelligenti, automazione o tecnologie emergenti è altamente auspicabile.

- L'esperienza con UX/UI design, prototipazione, Figma, progettazione di servizi o tecnologie di front-end sarebbe considerato un vantaggio forte.

2. Abilità di gestione del progetto

- Sei in grado di gestire e dare priorità alle attività di ricerca in più progetti contemporaneamente.

- È possibile pianificare in modo indipendente iniziative di ricerca, definire gli obiettivi, gestire le linee temporali e fornire risultati significativi.

- Sei organizzato, adattabile e confortevole operativo in ambienti dinamici con priorità in evoluzione.

- Si comunica chiaramente con gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici.

- È possibile facilitare workshop, sessioni di scoperta e attività di allineamento che aiutano i team a progredire con fiducia.

- Siete in grado di identificare i rischi, le dipendenze e le opportunità durante il ciclo di vita della ricerca.

- Capisci come influenzare le decisioni attraverso prove, collaborazione e impegno degli stakeholder.

- È possibile creare allineamento tra le diverse parti interessate, mantenendo un forte focus sulle esigenze degli utenti e sul valore aziendale.

E... cosa ci rende speciali?

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo e un bonus annuale, offriamo:

- Per sostenere il vostro equilibrio di vita lavorativa, abbiamo adottato un modello di lavoro flessibile.

- Opzione per lavorare all'estero fino a 25 giorni all'anno.

- Oltre 300 euro per impostare il vostro ufficio di casa e l'indennità mensile di ufficio.

- Ampia gamma di corsi interni ed esterni, tra cui lezioni di inglese, tedesco e spagnolo a seconda delle esigenze.

- Ticket ristorante e assicurazione sanitaria con la flessibilità di scambiarlo per altri benefici.

- Assicurazione sulla vita e sugli incidenti.

- Piano di pensionamento collettivo

- 2000 bonus di riferimento se porti altre persone di talento come te alla società.

- Condizioni bancarie e assicurative speciali più sconti Esclusivi Dipendenti

- Vantaggi della diversità funzionale

- Opzioni di stock e benefici ipotecari.

Dove siamo?

Barcellona, Poblenou.

# Li-hybrid #

Riesci a vederti in questo ruolo? Non aspettare più! Applicare inviando il tuo CV in inglese .

Se no, non preoccuparti! Ci rivedremo in futuro. Sentitevi liberi di condividere i miei dettagli di contatto con chiunque pensi che sarebbe una soluzione perfetta.

A Zurigo, siamo un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Attraiamo e conserviamo le persone più qualificate disponibili, indipendentemente da razza / etnia, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, età, o disabilità.

Centro di consegna della tecnologia di Zurigo – il vostro talento, la nostra forza

Sei il cuore e l'anima di Zurigo!

A Zurigo, ci piace pensare al di fuori della scatola e sfidare lo status quo. Prendiamo un approccio ottimista concentrandoci sui positivi e chiedendo costantemente cosa può andare bene?

Apprezziamo molto l'esperienza e il know-how dei nostri dipendenti e offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità tra le aree di business per incoraggiarti a candidarti per nuove opportunità all'interno di Zurigo quando sei pronto per il tuo prossimo passo di carriera.

Continuiamo a crescere insieme!

- Posizione(i): ES - Barcelona

- Orari: Tempo pieno

- Nome del reclutatore: Alvaro Gallego Zazo
