descriptionByLocale.fr:
Heures de travail: Ce rôle est disponible à temps partiel, en partage d'emploi ou à temps plein.

Salaire : Salaire concurrentiel plus un excellent ensemble de prestations

Lieu: Warminster, hybride avec un minimum de 3 jours dans le bureau chaque semaine et des heures de travail flexibles

Aider à façonner l'avenir du génie logiciel à Zurich Nova

Fondée en 2023 en tant que start-up AI high-tech, Zurich Nova a été acquise avec un mandat clair : conserver tout ce qui a permis à l'entreprise de réussir tout en lui donnant accès à l'échelle, à la portée et au soutien d'un des plus grands assureurs du monde.

Nous nous engageons à préserver une véritable culture de start-up. Nous agissons rapidement, expérimentons souvent, contestons les hypothèses et nous concentrons sans relâche sur les résultats. Nous croyons que les meilleures idées sont testées plutôt que débattues, et nous apprécions les gens qui sont prêts à construire, apprendre et itérer.

Nova est dirigée par des ingénieurs et construite pour des ingénieurs.

Nous croyons que l'ingénierie logicielle subit sa transformation la plus importante depuis l'émergence du cloud computing. Le cycle de vie du développement logiciel traditionnel, où la livraison est mesurée en mois, est remplacé par des flux de travail natifs de l'IA où les idées deviennent des exigences, les exigences deviennent des prototypes et les prototypes deviennent des produits à une vitesse sans précédent.

Chez Nova, nous contribuons à définir à quoi ressemble ce futur.

Notre équipe allie expertise à l'intelligence artificielle, génie logiciel, architecture cloud, développement de produits et transformation d'entreprise. Chaque jour, nous examinons de nouveaux modèles, des outils émergents, des systèmes basés sur des agents et des techniques de pointe qui remodelent la façon dont les logiciels sont construits.

Nous créons activement un espace pour l'expérimentation, l'apprentissage et la recherche parce que rester en avance sur la courbe technologique est fondamental pour notre succès. Les technologies dont nous discutons aujourd'hui deviennent souvent les capacités que nous déployons demain.

Rejoindre Zurich Nova signifie faire partie d'une équipe qui redéfinit comment le logiciel est conçu, construit et livré. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'ingénieurs passionnés par la technologie, obsédés par l'apprentissage et enthousiastes à aider à façonner la prochaine génération d'ingénierie logicielle.

L'opportunité

Ce rôle fait partie de Zurich Nova, une partie de Life, Health and Bank Distribution, et offre une occasion rare d'influencer à la fois la technologie et la culture d'ingénierie.

En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel senior, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le chef de Nova pour aider à définir la stratégie technique, la direction de l'architecture et les pratiques d'ingénierie dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Ce n'est pas simplement un rôle d'ingénierie logicielle.

On s'attend à ce que vous alliez une expertise technique approfondie au leadership, au coaching et à l'innovation. Vous aiderez à construire des produits et des plateformes compatibles avec l'IA tout en défendant de nouvelles façons de travailler qui permettent aux équipes de se déplacer plus rapidement, d'apprendre plus rapidement et d'offrir plus de valeur.

Vous serez un défenseur clé du logiciel 2.0 : un monde où l'IA est intégrée tout au long du cycle de vie de l'ingénierie logicielle et où les ingénieurs peuvent produire des résultats à une vitesse qui était auparavant impossible.

La réussite de ce rôle exige un jugement technique fort, une curiosité, une intelligence émotionnelle et la capacité d'inspirer les autres à adopter de nouvelles façons de penser à la prestation de logiciels.

Ce que vous ferez

- S'associer étroitement avec le chef de Nova pour définir la stratégie technique, la direction architecturale et les normes d'ingénierie.

- Diriger la conception, le développement et la mise en œuvre de solutions logicielles adaptées à l'IA.

- Élaborer des plates-formes évolutives, sécuritaires et durables qui produisent des résultats opérationnels significatifs.

- Former l'architecture future des produits Nova et des écosystèmes d'ingénierie.

- Champion AI-native ingénierie logicielle et les pratiques Software 2.0 dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

- Démontrer comment l'IA peut transformer chaque étape du cycle de développement logiciel.

- Aider les équipes à passer d'une idée à des exigences à un prototype en heures ou en jours plutôt qu'en semaines ou en mois.

- Expérimenter les nouveaux modèles, cadres et approches de développement de l'IA.

- Conception et évolution des cadres, des modèles et des garde-corps pour l'ingénierie assistée par l'IA.

- Mentor ingénieurs et améliorer les normes techniques dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

- Exécuter des ateliers, des séances de coaching et une formation pratique pour les outils d'IA et les workflows d'agents.

- Collaborer avec les intervenants des secteurs des produits, des affaires et des techniques pour résoudre les défis complexes.

- Influencer la culture d'ingénierie et définir à quoi ressemble une grande ingénierie dans une organisation native d'IA.

- Évaluer les nouvelles technologies et identifier les possibilités d'avantage concurrentiel.

- Veiller à ce que les solutions soient conçues en tenant compte de considérations appropriées en matière de gouvernance, de sécurité, de résilience et de commerce.

Ce que nous cherchons

Nous recherchons un ingénieur qui combine l'excellence technique et l'esprit d'un constructeur.

Vous êtes quelqu'un qui aime créer, expérimenter et résoudre des problèmes difficiles. Vous vous souciez des résultats, pas seulement des extrants. Vous êtes excité par la technologie émergente et motivé par l'occasion d'aider à façonner l'avenir de l'ingénierie.

L'état d'esprit que nous apprécions

- Un leader technique – Vous prenez en main, donnez une orientation et aidez d'autres à résoudre des problèmes difficiles.

- Un constructeur de start-up – Vous êtes stimulé par le rythme, la propriété et la possibilité de construire quelque chose de nouveau.

- Un évangéliste de génie – Vous aimez partager les connaissances, enseigner les autres et aider les organisations à adopter de meilleures méthodes de travail

- AI-native – Vous voyez l'IA comme une partie centrale de la boîte à outils d'ingénierie, et non comme une option supplémentaire.

- Naturellement curieux – Vous apprenez constamment, vous expérimentez et vous cherchez à comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent.

- Résilient et adaptable – Vous êtes à l'aise pour naviguer l'incertitude et le changement.

- Un communicateur fort – Vous pouvez expliquer clairement les idées complexes.

- Orientation vers les résultats – Vous vous souciez de résoudre de vrais problèmes et d'avoir un impact.

- Engagement pour la croissance – Vous investissez continuellement dans l'apprentissage.

Ce que nous ne cherchons pas

Nous ne cherchons pas quelqu'un qui critique simplement les idées, se concentre uniquement sur la perfection technique ou préfère des environnements hautement structurés où chaque réponse est connue à l'avance.

Nous cherchons des constructeurs.

Les personnes qui identifient les défis, les communiquent clairement et travaillent en collaboration pour créer des solutions pratiques.

Vous serez quelqu'un qui embrasse l'expérimentation, accueille les retours d'expérience et est excité par l'occasion d'aider à façonner une organisation en évolution rapide.

Notre culture

Notre culture est intentionnellement différente.

Alors que nous sommes soutenus par Zurich, nous opérons avec l'état d'esprit et l'énergie d'une start-up technologique. Nous agissons rapidement, expérimentons constamment et faisons confiance à nos ingénieurs pour prendre des décisions significatives.

Nous croyons que l'ingénierie exceptionnelle vient de donner aux gens talentueux la propriété, l'autonomie et la liberté d'explorer de nouvelles idées.

Nos bureaux sont basés à Warminster et nous travaillons ensemble en personne au moins trois jours par semaine. Nous apprécions la flexibilité et reconnaissons que la créativité et l'innovation ne se produisent pas toujours dans les heures de travail traditionnelles.

L'apprentissage fait partie du travail. Nous encourageons activement l'expérimentation de nouvelles technologies, nous accordons du temps à l'exploration et nous investissons pour aider nos gens à rester à l'avant-garde d'une industrie en évolution rapide.

La possibilité de combiner vitesse de démarrage et impact à l'échelle de l'entreprise est rare.

Chez Nova, vous aurez la chance de faire les deux.

Méthode d'évaluation

Ce rôle est conçu pour un ingénieur expérimenté qui combine profondeur technique, pensée architecturale, potentiel de leadership et une passion pour l'innovation.

Le processus d'évaluation se concentrera sur la façon dont vous pensez, résoudre les problèmes et appliquer le jugement technique dans les situations réelles.

Après une première conversation avec le recruteur, vous rencontrerez l'équipe sur place et effectuerez un exercice d'ingénierie pratique. Il peut s'agir d'examiner une solution technique, de concevoir une approche d'architecture, d'évaluer un défi de livraison de logiciels ou de démontrer comment les outils d'IA peuvent être utilisés pour accélérer le développement de logiciels.

Nous sommes intéressés à comprendre comment vous abordez les problèmes, collaborez avec les autres et équilibrez l'innovation avec la prestation.

Si vous réussissez, vous rejoindrez une équipe qui vous aidera à définir l'avenir de l'ingénierie logicielle grâce à l'IA à Zurich.

.

Nous faisons une différence

jobs.title: New Business Product & Project Specialist (12 months contract)
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

Under direct supervison, performs moderate to complex job duties and responsibilities to contribute to the development and management of underwriting quality and governance processes across business area.

Key Accountabilities

- Provides assurance that the underwriting business operates effectively, and in accordance with agreed rules and regulations.

- Contributes to the ongoing development, implementation and maintenance of governance tools and quality control processes; Assists the development and maintenance of underwriting procedures manuals.

- Handles a range of analysis and advice to support the development of effective local and central governance processes and practices.

- Contributes to the development of business effectiveness through monitoring of activity and making recommendations for change/remedial action.

- Contributes to / assists with business compliance with regulatory compliance.

- Proactively supports development of self and others.

- Contributes to the continuous development of governance tools, processes and supporting activity with respect to efficiency and effectiveness of underwriting operations.

Business Accountabilities

- Carry out tasks, such as the preparation of documentation, to support the implementation of projects to time and quality standards.

- Identify and comply with the main principles relevant to legal and regulatory controls that govern standard work practices.

- Collect evidence from well established sources and deliver accurate decisions to customers and facilitate decision making on wider customer issues.

- Monitor underwriting processes in order to identify opportunities for improvement.

- Provide clear explanations for underwriting decisions, sharing relevant technical information to build and maintain relationships with customers/distributors.

- Resolve operational day-to-day problems referred from other functions of the business, ensuring an efficient and high-quality service is extended to all distributors and customers.

Performance Management Accountabilities

- Model behaviors that demonstrate commitment to corporate values.

- Take accountability for participating in the performance management cycle.

- Participate fully as a team member and contribute to the improved performance of the team.

- Expand knowledge and exchange it with team members and business partners.

- Take action to manage own personal development.

Job Requirements

- Bachelor’s Degree or around 2 years of experience in the Underwriting area.

- Excellent organizational and time management skills

- Strong knowledge of underwriting philosophy/techniques

- Ability to effectively assess risk.

- Ability to work in a team environment.

Job Purpose

Under direct supervison, performs moderate to complex job duties and responsibilities to contribute to the development and management of underwriting quality and governance processes across business area.

Key Accountabilities

- Provides assurance that the underwriting business operates effectively, and in accordance with agreed rules and regulations.

- Contributes to the ongoing development, implementation and maintenance of governance tools and quality control processes; Assists the development and maintenance of underwriting procedures manuals.

- Handles a range of analysis and advice to support the development of effective local and central governance processes and practices.

- Contributes to the development of business effectiveness through monitoring of activity and making recommendations for change/remedial action.

- Contributes to / assists with business compliance with regulatory compliance.

- Proactively supports development of self and others.

- Resolve operational day-to-day problems referred from other functions of the business, ensuring an efficient and high-quality service is extended to all distributors and customers.

Zweck der Tätigkeit

Unter direkter Aufsicht führt mäßige bis komplexe Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten aus, um zur Entwicklung und Verwaltung von versicherungstechnischen Qualitäts- und Governance-Prozessen im gesamten Geschäftsbereich beizutragen.

Hauptbuchhaltung

- Bietet die Sicherheit, dass das Zeichnungsgeschäft effektiv und in Übereinstimmung mit den vereinbarten Regeln und Vorschriften arbeitet.

- Trägt zur laufenden Entwicklung, Implementierung und Pflege von Governance-Tools und Qualitätskontrollprozessen bei; Unterstützt die Entwicklung und Pflege von Zeichnungsverfahren Handbücher.

- Behandelt eine Reihe von Analysen und Ratschlägen, um die Entwicklung effektiver lokaler und zentraler Governance-Prozesse und -Praktiken zu unterstützen.

- Trägt zur Entwicklung der Geschäftseffektivität durch die Überwachung der Aktivität und die Abgabe von Empfehlungen für Veränderungs- / Abhilfemaßnahmen bei.

- Trägt bei / unterstützt bei der Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Vorschriften.

- Proaktiv unterstützt die Entwicklung von sich selbst und anderen.

- Trägt zur kontinuierlichen Entwicklung von Governance-Tools, -Prozessen und unterstützenden Aktivitäten in Bezug auf Effizienz und Effektivität von Zeichnungsgeschäften bei.

Unternehmensbuchhaltung

- Durchführung von Aufgaben, wie der Erstellung von Dokumentationen, um die Umsetzung von Projekten nach Zeit- und Qualitätsstandards zu unterstützen.

- Ermittlung und Einhaltung der wichtigsten Grundsätze, die für die gesetzlichen und regulatorischen Kontrollen relevant sind, die die Standardarbeitspraktiken regeln.

- Sammeln Sie Beweise aus gut etablierten Quellen und liefern Sie den Kunden genaue Entscheidungen und erleichtern Sie die Entscheidungsfindung in umfassenderen Kundenfragen.

- Überwachung von Underwriting-Prozessen, um Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren.

- Geben Sie klare Erklärungen für Zeichnungsentscheidungen und teilen Sie relevante technische Informationen, um Beziehungen zu Kunden / Distributoren aufzubauen und zu pflegen.

- Beheben Sie betriebliche Alltagsprobleme, die aus anderen Funktionen des Unternehmens stammen, und stellen Sie sicher, dass ein effizienter und qualitativ hochwertiger Service auf alle Händler und Kunden ausgedehnt wird.

Leistungsmanagement-Verantwortlichkeiten

- Modellieren Sie Verhaltensweisen, die Engagement für Unternehmenswerte zeigen.

- Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Teilnahme am Leistungsmanagement-Zyklus.

- Beteiligen Sie sich vollständig als Teammitglied und tragen Sie zur verbesserten Leistung des Teams bei.

- Wissen erweitern und mit Teammitgliedern und Geschäftspartnern austauschen.

- Ergreifen Sie Maßnahmen, um die eigene persönliche Entwicklung zu verwalten.

Arbeitsanforderungen

- Bachelor-Abschluss oder etwa 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Underwriting-Bereich.

- Ausgezeichnete Organisations- und Zeitmanagementfähigkeiten

- Starke Kenntnisse der Zeichnung Philosophie / Techniken

- Fähigkeit, Risiken effektiv einzuschätzen.

- Fähigkeit, in einer Teamumgebung zu arbeiten.

Du bist das Herz und die Seele von Zürich!

Bei Zurich denken wir gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hinterfragen den Status Quo. Wir gehen optimistisch vor, indem wir uns auf das Positive konzentrieren und ständig fragen: Was kann richtig gehen?

Lasst uns gemeinsam weiter wachsen!

jobs.description:
At Zurich, we rely on insightful data to power our systems and solutions. We’re seeking an experienced data scientist to deliver insights on a daily basis. The ideal candidate will have mathematical and statistical expertise, a natural curiosity, and a creative mind. While mining, interpreting, and cleaning our data, this person will be relied on to ask questions, connect the dots, and uncover hidden opportunities for realizing the data’s full potential. As part of a team of specialists, the data scientist will “slice and dice” data using various methods and create new visions for the future.

Objectives of this role
• Collaborate with product design and engineering teams to develop an understanding of needs.
• Research and devise innovative statistical models for data analysis, including advanced AI techniques such as LLMs and Agentic AI.
• Communicate findings to all stakeholders.
• Enable smarter business processes by using analytics for meaningful insights.
• Keep current with technical and industry developments, especially in generative AI and autonomous agent systems.

Responsibilities
• Serve as data strategist to identify and integrate new datasets that can be leveraged through our product capabilities, and work closely with the engineering team in the development of data products.
• Execute analytical experiments to help solve problems across various domains and industries.
• Identify relevant data sources and sets to mine for client business needs, and collect large structured and unstructured datasets and variables.
• Devise and utilize algorithms and models to mine big-data stores; perform data and error analysis to improve models; clean and validate data for uniformity and accuracy.
• Analyze data for trends and patterns, and interpret data with clear objectives in mind.
• Implement analytical models/machine learning, including LLMs and agentic AI solutions, in production by collaborating with software developers and IT team.
• Utilize Azure technologies like Azure Cognitive Technologies, Azure Machine Learning, and Azure Bot Services to design, create, and deploy AI-based applications.
• Develop, fine-tune, and deploy large language models and agentic AI systems for automation, knowledge extraction, and conversational AI use cases.
• Stay updated with the latest advancements in generative AI, prompt engineering, and autonomous agents.

Required skills and qualifications
• Five or more years of experience in data science or proven experience.
• Advanced experience in pattern recognition, predictive modeling, and generative AI (LLMs, transformers, etc.).
• Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, OpenAI APIs).
• Familiarity with agentic AI concepts and frameworks (e.g., AutoGPT, BabyAGI, CrewAI).
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, research-oriented group that has several concurrent projects.
• Experience in data mining.
• Understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and operations research.
• Knowledge of R, SQL, and Python; familiarity with Scala, Java.
• Experience using business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI) and data frameworks (e.g., Azure, AWS, Hadoop, RDMS).
• Analytical mind and business acumen.
• Strong math skills
• Problem-solving aptitude.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills.
• BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant field; graduate degree in Data Science or other quantitative field is preferred.
• Able to multitask and manage projects with minimal supervision.
• Professional certification.

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

jobs.description:
Our opportunity

Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Workflows

We're seeking a AI Engineer – Agentic Workflows to build the skills, tools, and agents that power our most advanced products incorporating generative AI—and to bring them together into reliable, production-ready workflows.

You will work closely with business and product teams to translate high-level problems into structured agentic workflows and production-ready solutions.

You'll design multi-step agentic systems using LangGraph and integrate leading LLM providers. You will be asked to work smart and efficiently with Claude Code and similar tools as part of your day-to-day engineering workflow to accelerate delivery and improve code quality.

A key part of the role is establishing strong evaluation practices to measure quality, reliability, and cost, while maintaining a high sense of ownership from design through deployment.

Your role

As Senior AI Engineer, your main responsibilities will involve:

- Design end-to-end agentic workflows (e.g., with LangGraph) to solve complex problems.

- Translate business needs into structured, scalable AI solutions.

- Build and compose reusable skills, tools, and agents.

- Choose the right approach (skill, tool, agent, workflow) for performance and maintainability.

- Integrate multiple LLMs, optimizing cost, speed, and quality.

- Improve performance via prompt design, token use, and inference efficiency.

- Define evaluations, metrics, and guardrails to ensure quality and reliability.

- Structure and validate data using typed schemas (e.g., Pydantic).

- Implement observability, logging, and debugging tools.

- Leverage AI assistants to accelerate development.

- Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver impactful AI solutions.

Your skills and experience

As Senior AI Engineer, your skills and experience will ideally include:

- 5+ years Python development with strong software engineering fundamentals

- Hands-on experience building production systems with Large Language Models

- High ownership & proactive communication: Delivers assigned outcomes autonomously, keeping progress visible and proactively surfacing blockers, changes in approach, and trade-offs—seeking input early when needed

- Proven experience with LangGraph or similar agentic frameworks (LangChain, other orchestration frameworks acceptable)

- Strong understanding of evaluation methodologies for LLM/agent quality (datasets, metrics, human review, regression testing)

- Ability to reason about when to build a skill vs tool vs agent vs workflow, with clear trade-offs

- Proven ability to decompose complex, ambiguous business problems into scalable technical solutions, from high-level requirements to detailed design.

Nice to Have

- Comfort using AI assistants (e.g., Claude Code) as part of the daily engineering workflow

- Familiarity with LLM observability tools (Langfuse, LangSmith, etc.)

- Background with vector databases and RAG patterns

- Understanding of cost optimisation and token accounting in LLM systems

- Production experience with async Python patterns (asyncio, concurrent request handling)

- Experience with Azure deployment and cloud-native architectures

- Knowledge of evaluation frameworks and metrics for AI output quality

Why Join?

- Work on cutting-edge generative AI systems at scale, using cutting-edge AI assistants on your day to day

- Collaborate with a specialized AI team (Data Scientists, AI Engineers, ML Optimization specialists)

- Build foundational patterns and frameworks that define how the organization approaches agentic AI

We offer

Compensation for roles at Zurich depends on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific role, skill set, level of experience, and subject to applicable law. Zurich thus provides a range of compensation aligned to internal job architecture and market benchmarks to ensure fair and consistent pay for comparable roles.

The starting base salary range for this position is 3300 EUR.

Working time benefits
Personal days off, Concentrated work week, Additional vacation, Home office, Extra days off at occasion of childbirth, Sabbatical leave, Workcation

Monetary benefits
Life insurance from Zurich Austria, Compensation for salary loss during sick leave, 3rd pension pillar contribution, Risk Life Insurance, Meal contribution on top of the legally required minimum, Years of service bonus, Wedding bonus, Baby bonus

Other benefits
Edenred electronic cafeteria, Public Transport contribution, Maternity leave benefits, Massages in the office

Learning/Development
Professional Certifications, Online Education Portals, Extensive Onboarding program, Strengths based culture (GALLUP)

About us

At our company, we recognize the importance of fostering an open-minded, safe and inclusive environment for everyone. We stand with diversity and respect different backgrounds and lifestyles. That's why we've implemented numerous initiatives to ensure our employees feel comfortable, accepted and respected at all times.

You'll design multi-step agentic systems using LangGraph and integrate leading LLM providers. You will be asked to work smart and efficiently with Claude Code and similar tools as part of your day-to-day engineering workflow to accelerate delivery and improve code quality.

A key part of the role is establishing strong evaluation practices to measure quality, reliability, and cost, while maintaining a high sense of ownership from design through deployment.

Your role

- Translate business needs into structured, scalable AI solutions.

- Build and compose reusable skills, tools, and agents.

- Integrate multiple LLMs, optimizing cost, speed, and quality.

- Improve performance via prompt design, token use, and inference efficiency.

- Define evaluations, metrics, and guardrails to ensure quality and reliability.

- Structure and validate data using typed schemas (e.g., Pydantic).

- Implement observability, logging, and debugging tools.

- Leverage AI assistants to accelerate development.

- Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver impactful AI solutions.

Your skills and experience

As Senior AI Engineer, your skills and experience will ideally include:

- 5+ years Python development with strong software engineering fundamentals

- Hands-on experience building production systems with Large Language Models

- High ownership & proactive communication: Delivers assigned outcomes autonomously, keeping progress visible and proactively surfacing blockers, changes in approach, and trade-offs—seeking input early when needed

- Proven experience with LangGraph or similar agentic frameworks (LangChain, other orchestration frameworks acceptable)

- Strong understanding of evaluation methodologies for LLM/agent quality (datasets, metrics, human review, regression testing)

- Ability to reason about when to build a skill vs tool vs agent vs workflow, with clear trade-offs

- Proven ability to decompose complex, ambiguous business problems into scalable technical solutions, from high-level requirements to detailed design.

Nice to Have

- Comfort using AI assistants (e.g., Claude Code) as part of the daily engineering workflow

- Familiarity with LLM observability tools (Langfuse, LangSmith, etc.)

- Background with vector databases and RAG patterns

- Understanding of cost optimisation and token accounting in LLM systems

- Production experience with async Python patterns (asyncio, concurrent request handling)

- Experience with Azure deployment and cloud-native architectures

- Knowledge of evaluation frameworks and metrics for AI output quality

Why Join?

jobs.description:
Imagina trabajar en una empresa que realmente se preocupa por sus colaboradores, clientes, partes interesadas y toda la comunidad involucrada. ¡Imagínate trabajar para una empresa que se compromete con hacer lo correcto y que tiene como objetivo ser el mejor proveedor de seguros del mundo!

Zurich es una de las principales compañías de seguros del mundo y una de las pocas que opera a escala global. Con alrededor de 55.000 empleados, dedicados a comprender las necesidades de nuestros clientes y ofrecer soluciones para particulares y empresas, desde pequeñas empresas hasta multinacionales.

Aquí, apostamos por la Sostenibilidad, innovando en las políticas de desarrollo y uniéndonos cada vez más con los cambios del mundo. Nos preocupamos por la confianza en la sociedad y en la forma en que estamos constantemente innovando, buscando tecnología y estrategias que nos permitan brindar una experiencia memorable a nuestro cliente.

También fomentamos una cultura de diversidad e inclusión. Nuestra declaración de propósito y valores está diseñada para proteger, inspirar confianza y ayudar a nuestros colaboradores a alcanzar su máximo potencial. Por eso, contamos con una política de inclusión laboral que promueve la selección de personas con discapacidad que cumplan con los requisitos de la vacante

#LI-Remote, #LI-Hybrid, #LI-Onsite

¡Ven a ser un Zuricher y forma parte de nuestro equipo como Lider de licitaciones!

Tu objetivo será liderar end-to-end el ciclo de vida de las licitaciones de seguros para el segmento masivos (bancarias, retails y otras empresas), actuando como punto unico de coordinación entre el convocante y las areas internas de la compañía. Es responsable de profesionalizar el proceso licitatorio asegurando rigor analitico, enfoque estratégico, atención al detalle y aprovechamiento de oportunidades, para maximizar la tasa de éxito y la rentabilidad de los negocios adjudicados.

Responsabilidades:

- Liderazgo del proceso licitatorio. Liderar de extremo a extremo el ciclo de vida de las licitaciones (inteligencia, Go/No-Go, análisis de pliego, estrategia, admisibilidad, construcción de oferta, radicación, post-radicación, lecciones aprendidas), de acuerdo con la Guía y el Manual operativo del área.
- Inteligencia de mercado. Mantener el mapa anual de oportunidades de procesos target. Monitorear el marco regulatorio y el comportamiento competitivo. Anticipar oportunidades y construir relacionamiento previo con convocantes y corredores.
- Análisis estratégico de pliegos. Liderar el análisis dimensional (jurídico, técnico, económico, operativo, propuesta de valor) de cada pliego. Identificar y clasificar barreras de participación. Diseñar la estrategia de oferta y formular preguntas estratégicas al convocante que abran espacio de participación.
- Coordinación interna. Convocar y conducir la mesa técnica para la generación de la oferta. Coordinar a las áreas internas involucradas (Suscripción, Pricing Analytics, Legales, Operaciones, Tecnología, Claims, Proposition, Customer Office, Finanzas, Riesgos, Reaseguro) sin tener autoridad jerárquica sobre ellas. Garantizar la coherencia técnica, económica y jurídica de la oferta consolidada.
- Interlocución externa. Actuar como interlocutor único de la compañía frente al convocante. Canalizar todas las comunicaciones formales del proceso. Representar a la compañía en audiencias públicas, reuniones técnicas con convocantes y relacionamiento con corredores.
- Gobierno y reporte. Presentar al Comité de licitaciones en los tres hitos obligatorios (confirmación Go/No-Go, aprobación final de oferta, revisión post-adjudicación). Gestionar el escalamiento interno cuando se superen umbrales del apetito de riesgo. Elaborar el informe trimestral consolidado del portafolio de licitaciones.
- Transición y aprendizaje. Acompañar la transición a operaciones cuando se adjudica una licitación y/o acompañamiento al area de implementaciones. Liderar las sesiones de lecciones aprendidas dentro de los 15 días hábiles siguientes al resultado. Mantener actualizadas las plantillas, la base de competidores y el manual operativo del área.

jobs.title: API Developer
jobs.description:
Our opportunity

API & Model Serving Developer

Are you a motivated, hands-on, and innovative person interested in working for one of the largest global insurers? Are you excited by building high-performance APIs and serving real-time calculations that drive critical risk decisions? Then this role is definitely something for you. We are looking for an API & Model Serving Developer to join the newly formed Risk Accumulation Management Platform (RAMP) team.

The position is planned as a 1‑year assignment for now.

Your role
As an API & Model Serving Developer , your main responsibilities will involve:

- Design, build, and deploy high-performance catastrophe modelling calculations exposed as APIs using Databricks Model Serving technology.

- Develop geospatial lookup APIs for risk classification, distance measurements, geocoding, etc.

- Implement and optimize real-time and near-real-time serving endpoints using Databricks Feature Serving for low-latency risk data retrieval.

- Ensure API performance, reliability, and scalability through automated health monitoring, load testing, and alerting.

- Design API contracts and integration patterns for downstream consumers such as accumulation dashboards, underwriting tools, and reporting systems.

- Collaborate with and provide backup to the Data Engineer on the team, ensuring no key-person dependencies exist across the platform.

- Work in close collaboration with the wider technology and business teams to deliver excellent user experience.

Your Skills and Experience

As an API & Model Serving Developer , your skills and experience will ideally include:

- Strong experience with Python (preferably with Pandas, NumPy, and geospatial libraries such as GeoPandas, Shapely, or H3).

- Hands-on experience with Databricks, particularly Model Serving and/or Feature Serving.

- Experience designing and building RESTful APIs with a focus on performance and scalability.

- Familiarity with SQL and working with structured data in Lakehouse or data warehouse environments.

- Understanding of geospatial concepts (coordinate systems, geocoding, spatial indexing, proximity calculations).

- Familiarity with software development best practices (Git, CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing).

- Strong problem-solving skills and a performance-optimization mindset.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

Good to Have

- Experience with catastrophe modelling concepts or exposure management.

- Experience with Microsoft Azure services (Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Azure Storage).

- Knowledge of MLFlow for model lifecycle management.

- Experience with .NET (C#) or other compiled languages for performance-critical components.

- Familiarity with Databricks Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, and ETL workflows.

- Prior work experience in insurance or financial services.

We offer

Compensation for roles at Zurich depends on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific role, skill set, level of experience, and subject to applicable law. Zurich thus provides a range of compensation aligned to internal job architecture and market benchmarks to ensure fair and consistent pay for comparable roles. The starting base salary range for this position is 2930 Eur.

Working time benefits

Personal days off, Concentrated work week, Additional vacation, Home office, Extra days off at occasion of childbirth, Sabbatical leave, Workation

Monetary benefits

Life insurance from Zurich Austria, Compensation for salary loss during sick leave, 3rd pension pillar contribution, Risk Life Insurance, Meal contribution on top of the legally required minimum, Years of service bonus, Wedding bonus, Baby bonus

Other benefits

Electronic cafeteria, Maternity leave benefits, Massages in the office

Learning/Development

Professional Certifications, Online Education Portals, Extensive Onboarding program, Strengths based culture (GALLUP)

- Location: Bratislava

- Schedule: full-time

- Form: hybrid - occasional home office possible

About us

At our company, we recognize the importance of fostering an open-minded, safe and inclusive environment for everyone. We stand with diversity and respect different backgrounds and lifestyles. That's why we've implemented numerous initiatives to ensure our employees feel comfortable, accepted, and respected at all times.

Our opportunity

API & Model Serving Developer

Are you a motivated, hands-on, and innovative person interested in working for one of the largest global insurers? Are you excited by building high-performance APIs and serving real-time calculations that drive critical risk decisions? Then this role is definitely something for you. We are looking for an API & Model Serving Developer to join the newly formed Risk Accumulation Management Platform (RAMP) team.

The position is planned as a 1‑year assignment for now.

Your role
As an API & Model Serving Developer , your main responsibilities will involve:

- Design, build, and deploy high-performance catastrophe modelling calculations exposed as APIs using Databricks Model Serving technology.

- Develop geospatial lookup APIs for risk classification, distance measurements, geocoding, etc.

- Implement and optimize real-time and near-real-time serving endpoints using Databricks Feature Serving for low-latency risk data retrieval.

- Ensure API performance, reliability, and scalability through automated health monitoring, load testing, and alerting.

- Design API contracts and integration patterns for downstream consumers such as accumulation dashboards, underwriting tools, and reporting systems.

- Collaborate with and provide backup to the Data Engineer on the team, ensuring no key-person dependencies exist across the platform.

- Work in close collaboration with the wider technology and business teams to deliver excellent user experience.

Your Skills and Experience

- Strong experience with Python (preferably with Pandas, NumPy, and geospatial libraries such as GeoPandas, Shapely, or H3).

- Hands-on experience with Databricks, particularly Model Serving and/or Feature Serving.

- Experience designing and building RESTful APIs with a focus on performance and scalability.

- Familiarity with SQL and working with structured data in Lakehouse or data warehouse environments.

- Understanding of geospatial concepts (coordinate systems, geocoding, spatial indexing, proximity calculations).

- Familiarity with software development best practices (Git, CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing).

- Strong problem-solving skills and a performance-optimization mindset.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

Good to Have

- Experience with catastrophe modelling concepts or exposure management.

- Experience with Microsoft Azure services (Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Azure Storage).

- Experience with .NET (C#) or other compiled languages for performance-critical components.

Role Overview:

Promotes an ethics-based culture, delivering practical solutions, guidance and training, identifies and manages less moderately complex Compliance Risks implementing policies, processes and controls related to the Compliance Risk Universe, including Shariah Compliance. Interacts with supervisory bodies whenever required.

Key Accountabilities

- Ensure the compliance strategy is aligned with the business strategy, regulatory requirements, and emerging industry trends.

- Assess new laws, regulations and trends, their applicability, and implementation to Zurich’s operations in the jurisdiction, in alignment with Legal, to ensure all Compliance Risks are appropriately identified, evaluated and managed.

- Perform compliance review and assessment for BAU activities including (but not limited to) product development, assurance activities, projects and initiatives, regulatory requests, management of non-compliance incident, and regulatory change assessment.

- Support the implementation of financial crime compliance controls, including AML/CFT risk assessments, transaction monitoring, policy execution and advisory support to business units to maintain regulatory compliance and mitigate financial crime risks.

- Prepare Management Information and compliance reports for the local management committee, the Shariah Committee, Audit Committee, Board and Regional/Group Compliance.

- Promote an ethics-based and compliance-driven culture through training, communications, and awareness activities, and provide relevant metrics to management.

- Support the Compliance team in planning, executing and monitoring continuous improvement initiatives and ad-hoc projects until implementation.

- Perform any other duties or responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor to support departmental objectives and on-going regulatory compliance.

Requirements

- A solid understanding of Insurance and/or Takaful laws and regulations, best practices in compliance, and knowledge of financial products and systems.

- Bachelor’s degree holder with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.

- Possession of relevant compliance certifications will be an added advantage.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a self-motivated attitude.

- Proactive, demonstrating initiative and continuously seeking areas for improvement.

- Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English and the local language.

- Strong analytical and presentation skills.

- Valutare nuove leggi, regolamenti e tendenze, la loro applicabilità e implementazione alle operazioni di Zurigo nella giurisdizione, in allineamento con Legale, per garantire che tutti i rischi di conformità siano adeguatamente identificati, valutati e gestiti.

- Eseguire la revisione e la valutazione della conformità per le attività di BAU, tra cui (ma non solo) sviluppo dei prodotti, attività di assicurazione, progetti e iniziative, richieste di regolamentazione, gestione di incidente non conformità e valutazione dei cambiamenti normativi.

- Sostenere l'attuazione dei controlli di conformità della criminalità finanziaria, comprese le valutazioni dei rischi AML/CFT, il monitoraggio delle transazioni, l'esecuzione delle politiche e il supporto consultivo alle unità aziendali per mantenere la conformità normativa e mitigare i rischi di criminalità finanziaria.

- Preparare le relazioni di gestione e di conformità per il comitato di gestione locale, il comitato Shariah, il comitato di controllo, il comitato di consiglio e la conformità regionale/gruppo.

- Promuovere una cultura basata sull'etica e basata sulla conformità attraverso attività di formazione, comunicazione e sensibilizzazione e fornire metriche rilevanti alla gestione.

- Sostenere il team Compliance nella pianificazione, esecuzione e monitoraggio di iniziative di miglioramento continuo e progetti ad-hoc fino all'implementazione.

- Eseguire qualsiasi altro dovere o responsabilità come assegnato dal supervisore per sostenere gli obiettivi dipartimentali e la conformità normativa in corso.

Requisiti

- Il possesso di certificazioni di conformità pertinenti sarà un vantaggio aggiuntivo.

- Forte capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione, con un atteggiamento auto-motivato.

- Proattiva, dimostrante iniziativa e continuamente alla ricerca di aree di miglioramento.

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e parlata in inglese e la lingua locale.

- Forte capacità analitiche e di presentazione.

Promouvoir une culture fondée sur l'éthique, fournir des solutions pratiques, des conseils et de la formation, identifier et gérer des risques de conformité moins modérément complexes mettant en œuvre des politiques, des processus et des contrôles liés à l'univers de risque de conformité, y compris la conformité à la charia. - Effectuer l'examen et l'évaluation de la conformité pour les activités liées aux UAB, y compris (mais sans s'y limiter) la mise au point de produits, les activités d'assurance, les projets et les initiatives, les demandes réglementaires, la gestion des incidents de non-conformité et l'évaluation des changements réglementaires.

- Appuyer la mise en oeuvre de contrôles de conformité en matière de criminalité financière, y compris l'évaluation des risques liés à la LAM/FT, la surveillance des transactions, l'exécution des politiques et le soutien consultatif aux unités opérationnelles afin de maintenir la conformité réglementaire et d'atténuer les risques de criminalité financière.

- Préparer des rapports sur l'information de gestion et la conformité pour le comité de gestion local, le comité de la charia, le comité de vérification, le conseil d'administration et la conformité régionale/groupe.

- Promouvoir une culture fondée sur l'éthique et axée sur la conformité au moyen d'activités de formation, de communication et de sensibilisation, et fournir des mesures pertinentes à la direction.

- Aider l'équipe de conformité à planifier, exécuter et surveiller les initiatives d'amélioration continue et les projets ponctuels jusqu'à leur mise en oeuvre.

- S'acquitter de toutes les autres fonctions ou responsabilités assignées par le superviseur pour appuyer les objectifs ministériels et la conformité continue à la réglementation.

Exigences

- Une bonne compréhension des lois et règlements sur l'assurance et/ou Takaful, des meilleures pratiques en matière de conformité et de la connaissance des produits et systèmes financiers.

- Titulaire d'un baccalauréat avec un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience pertinente.

- La possession des certifications de conformité pertinentes sera un avantage supplémentaire.

- Fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une attitude automotivée.

- Proactive, faisant preuve d'initiative et cherchant continuellement des domaines à améliorer.

- Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale en anglais et dans la langue locale.

- Forte capacité d'analyse et de présentation.

jobs.description:
Senior Surety Underwriter

Place of work: Warsaw

Senior Underwriter Surety

Shape the future of Surety business in our new Polish branch! If you enjoy making decisions, negotiating with business partners, and want to have a tangible impact on the industrial/large corporate surety segment, this opportunity is for you.

- Independently manage facility and bond underwriting for corporate clients Conduct creditworthiness and risk analyses, prepare quotations, and negotiate terms, bond wordings, indemnities, and other recourse documents in line with local and group standards

- Monitor market trends and emerging risks; adapt strategies to maintain competitiveness

- Deep understanding of surety market, products, and regulations

jobs.title: Claims Handler - Commercial Insurance (Mid to Expert Level)
jobs.description:
Claims Handler – Commercial Insurance (Mid to Expert Level)

Job Purpose

Drive excellence in claims management for commercial insurance in Poland!
If you are passionate about finding fair solutions for our customers, enjoy working in a dynamic environment, and want to make a measurable impact within the commercial and industrial insurance sector, this opportunity is for you.

Your Responsibilities

- Handle, analyze and resolve claims for commercial business (Property, Liability, and related lines) independently and in line with Zurich’s service standards

- Review policy coverage, gather facts, assess losses, and negotiate settlements with customers, brokers, and other partners

- Ensure accurate, timely claims handling, balancing customer focus with adherence to legal and regulatory requirements

- Collaborate closely with Underwriting, Risk Engineering, and Legal to resolve complex cases and identify process improvements

- Support digitalization and continuous development of claims processes

- Act as a point of escalation for particularly complex or high-value claims (for Senior/Expert level)

- Contribute to sharing knowledge and best practices within the Claims team

Your Profile

- 5+ years (mid-level) or 8+ years (expert level) claims handling experience in commercial, industrial, or corporate insurance

- Solid understanding of Polish insurance law, policy wordings, and the regulatory environment

- Experience managing complex or high-value claims with a customer and solutions-oriented approach

- Degree in Law, Insurance, Business, or related discipline; professional insurance qualifications are a plus

- Analytical, decisive, and able to manage multiple stakeholders under time pressure

- Excellent communication and negotiation skills

- Strong team player with proactive, reliable, and collaborative work style

- Fluent in Polish and English (spoken and written); German language skills are an advantage

We offer:

- Private medical care

- Life Insurance

- Hybrid work opportunities

- Flexible working time

- Integration events

- No dress code

- Annual Bonus

- Competitive Salary

- Learning & Development Programs

- Friendly and collaborative working atmosphere

Who we are:

Zurich Insurance Group (Zurich) is a leading global multi-line insurer founded more than 150 years ago, which has grown into a business serving more than 75 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories, while delivering industry-leading total shareholder returns. We set benchmarks in Commercial Insurance and are committed to delivering high-quality services for our customers every day. At our new Future Branch in Warsaw, we’re looking for colleagues who want to help shape Zurich’s next chapter in Poland. Join us to create a brighter future for insurance - together.

Does this role feel like the right next step in your career? We look forward to receiving your online application (CV; cover letter optional) via the ‘Apply now’ button.

.

- Examiner la couverture de la politique, recueillir des faits, évaluer les pertes et négocier des règlements avec les clients, les courtiers et d'autres partenaires

- Veiller à ce que les demandes soient traitées avec exactitude et en temps opportun, en conciliant l'attention des clients et le respect des exigences légales et réglementaires.

- Collaborer étroitement avec la souscription, l'ingénierie des risques et le droit pour résoudre les cas complexes et identifier les améliorations des processus

- Soutenir la numérisation et le développement continu des processus de réclamation

- Agir comme un point d'escalade pour les réclamations particulièrement complexes ou de grande valeur (pour le niveau senior/expert)

- Contribuer au partage des connaissances et des pratiques exemplaires au sein de l'équipe des réclamations

Votre profil

- 5 ans et plus (niveau intermédiaire) ou 8 ans et plus (niveau expert) d'expérience dans le traitement des réclamations en assurance commerciale, industrielle ou d'entreprise

- Une bonne compréhension du droit polonais des assurances, du libellé des politiques et de l'environnement réglementaire

- Expérience de gestion de revendications complexes ou de grande valeur avec une approche axée sur le client et les solutions

- Diplôme en droit, assurance, affaires ou discipline connexe; qualifications professionnelles en assurance sont un plus

- Analyse, détermination et capacité de gérer plusieurs parties prenantes sous pression temporelle

- Excellentes compétences en communication et en négociation

- Solide joueur d'équipe avec un style de travail proactif, fiable et collaboratif

- La maîtrise du polonais et de l'anglais (parlé et écrit); les compétences linguistiques en allemand sont un avantage

Nous offrons:

- Soins médicaux privés

- Assurance vie

- Possibilités de travail hybride

- Temps de travail flexible

- Manifestations d'intégration

- Pas de code vestimentaire

- Bonus annuel

- Salaire concurrentiel

- Programmes d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement

- Ambiance de travail amicale et collaborative

Qui nous sommes :

Zurich Insurance Group (Zurich) est un assureur multiligne mondial de premier plan fondé il y a plus de 150 ans, qui est devenu une entreprise desservant plus de 75 millions de clients dans plus de 200 pays et territoires, tout en offrant un rendement total des actionnaires leader de l'industrie. Nous fixons des points de repère en assurance commerciale et nous nous engageons à fournir des services de haute qualité à nos clients chaque jour. Dans notre nouvelle filiale Future à Varsovie, nous recherchons des collègues qui veulent aider à façonner le prochain chapitre de Zurich en Pologne. Rejoignez-nous pour créer un avenir meilleur pour l'assurance - ensemble.

Ce rôle est-il la prochaine étape de votre carrière? Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre demande en ligne (CV; lettre de motivation facultative) via le bouton «Appliquer maintenant».

jobs.description:
A new transformational adventure awaits you…

How does 5 weeks of annual leave, a fulfilling career you'll genuinely enjoy, and working for a reputable organization that promotes wellbeing and drives digital transformation sound to you?

As one of Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ and Fortune’s ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ for 2025, Zurich - a leader in the insurance industry, is on a journey towards a brighter future… A brighter future for you - focused on your career, your wellbeing, and your community - as well as our customers and the planet.

Join us on this thrilling journey as we work towards our vision of becoming Australia's leading digital insurer. If you're eager to be part of a values-driven global organisation that's experiencing real growth and transformation, and if you share our commitment to making a tangible difference and taking continuous steps towards a sustainable future for our people, customers, communities, and our planet, then keep reading!

Let’s create a brighter future together, let’s make a difference

It’s important to know, what you do matters. At Zurich, we don’t just cover, we care.

As Account Engineer, Property Risk, you will play a senior technical leadership role within Zurich Resilience Solutions, partnering with some of our largest and most complex property customers. This role exists to deepen Zurich’s technical engagement, strengthen resilience outcomes, and ensure customers receive trusted, high ‑ quality risk engineering insight that supports safer, more sustainable operations.

Sitting within the Property Line of Business, you will balance deep technical expertise with strong client partnership, acting as a trusted advisor to customers, brokers and internal stakeholders while shaping how Zurich delivers risk engineering solutions across complex portfolios.

You will also be responsible for the following:

- Providing senior-level property risk engineering expertise across large and complex customer portfolios

- Acting as technical account lead for major clients, coordinating risk engineering inputs and outcomes

- Leading and peer reviewing detailed property risk assessments and improvement recommendations

- Overseeing the delivery of clear, high-quality technical reports and insights for senior stakeholders

- Building trusted technical relationships with customers, brokers, underwriters and internal partners

- Contributing to the development of innovative risk engineering solutions and technical standards

Important to your success – let’s grow together

You are a confident technical leader who enjoys working closely with customers and stakeholders to solve complex problems. You bring a collaborative mindset, commercial awareness, and a genuine passion for improving resilience and risk outcomes.

In order to be successful, you will have the following:

- Senior-level experience in property risk engineering or managing complex property risk portfolios

- Strong technical knowledge across property hazards including fire, natural hazards and resilience

- Experience acting as a technical account lead or senior risk engineer for major customers

- Confidence presenting complex technical information to senior stakeholders

- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high technical standards

Belong. Zurich is here to support you

There are so many reasons why Zurich is a great place to be and the right choice for you, but here are just a few.

- Enjoy 5 weeks of annual leave for permanent staff through our Z leave initiative, along with 15 days of personal/carer’s leave as we empower our people to manage their own wellbeing. Plus, access to Family Care (parental leave).

- Benefit from a hybrid working arrangement – 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home per week for full-time employees.

- Access programs to stay healthy and feel healthier, receive an AUD$500 wellbeing payment per year, and a AUD$295 new starter e-voucher for your work-from-home setup (flex work - hybrid working), along with other great benefits through our Shine portal.

- Grow and thrive in your career with our award-winning training programs. We support and encourage your development because our strength lies in our people, and we value your individuality.

- Work with global, diverse, and inclusive teams; explore your passions, fuel innovation, drive equity, collaborate, and make a positive difference beyond your role.

- Take advantage of global mobility opportunities across more than 200 countries worldwide.

- Volunteer and work in our state-of-the-art Green Star rated offices (when you are in the office) and dress for your day.

- We plant a tree for every new employee.

- Not to mention our various employer of choice awards/memberships – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity… to name a few.

We could go on, but the main point is that Zurich is a great place to be, where you can truly belong, be yourself, maintain work/life balance, and thrive in a supportive environment.

Zurich is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require any special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to please let us know at the time of your application.

So, if you want to come on an adventure that will build a brighter future together, and feel a sense of togetherness, then please apply today to start your adventure!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una nuova avventura trasformazionale vi aspetta...

Come fa 5 settimane di congedo annuale, una carriera soddisfacente ti piacerà davvero, e lavorare per un'organizzazione rispettabile che promuove il benessere e guida il suono di trasformazione digitale a te?

Come uno dei Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ e ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ di Fortune per il 2025, Zurigo - leader nel settore assicurativo, è in un viaggio verso un futuro più luminoso... Un futuro più luminoso per voi - focalizzato sulla vostra carriera, il vostro benessere, e la vostra comunità - così come i nostri clienti e il pianeta.

Unisciti a noi in questo viaggio emozionante mentre lavoriamo verso la nostra visione di diventare l'insurretore digitale leader dell'Australia. Se siete desiderosi di far parte di un'organizzazione globale orientata ai valori che sta vivendo una reale crescita e trasformazione, e se condividete il nostro impegno a fare una differenza tangibile e a compiere passi continui verso un futuro sostenibile per la nostra gente, clienti, comunità e il nostro pianeta, continuate a leggere!

Creiamo un futuro più luminoso insieme, facciamo la differenza

E 'importante sapere, quello che fai conta. A Zurigo, non basta coprire, ci interessa.

In qualità di Account Engineer, Property Risk, svolgerai un ruolo di leadership tecnica senior all'interno di Zurich Resilience Solutions, collaborando con alcuni dei nostri clienti di proprietà più grandi e complessi. Questo ruolo esiste per approfondire l'impegno tecnico di Zurigo, rafforzare i risultati di resilienza e garantire ai clienti di ricevere informazioni affidabili e di alta qualità di ingegneria del rischio che supporta operazioni più sicure e sostenibili.

Seduto all'interno della Property Line of Business, si equilibrerà profonda competenza tecnica con una forte partnership con i clienti, fungendo da consulente affidabile per i clienti, i broker e le parti interessate interne, mentre si delinea come Zurigo offre soluzioni di ingegneria dei rischi attraverso portafogli complessi.

Sarete anche responsabili per quanto segue:

- Fornire competenze di ingegneria del rischio di proprietà di alto livello in portafogli di clienti grandi e complessi

- Agire come account tecnico piombo per i principali clienti, coordinando input di ingegneria del rischio e risultati

- Leading e peer reviewing dettagliate valutazioni dei rischi di proprietà e raccomandazioni di miglioramento

- supervisionare la consegna di report tecnici chiari e di alta qualità e approfondimenti per gli stakeholder senior

- Costruire relazioni tecniche di fiducia con clienti, broker, sottoscrittori e partner interni

- Contribuire allo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative di ingegneria dei rischi e standard tecnici

Importante per il vostro successo – cresciamo insieme

Sei un leader tecnico fiducioso che gode di lavorare a stretto contatto con i clienti e gli stakeholder per risolvere problemi complessi. Porti una mentalità collaborativa, la consapevolezza commerciale, e una vera passione per migliorare la resilienza e i risultati dei rischi.

Per avere successo, avrai le seguenti:

- Esperienza di alto livello nell'ingegneria dei rischi di proprietà o nella gestione di portafogli di rischio di proprietà complessi

- Forte conoscenza tecnica attraverso i pericoli di proprietà tra cui fuoco, pericoli naturali e resilienza

- Esperienza che agisce come lead di account tecnico o ingegnere di rischio senior per i principali clienti

- Confidenza che presenta informazioni tecniche complesse agli stakeholder senior

- Prova capacità di gestire più priorità mantenendo elevati standard tecnici

Da un po'. Zurigo è qui per sostenervi

Ci sono tanti motivi per cui Zurigo è un ottimo posto per essere e la scelta giusta per voi, ma qui ci sono solo alcuni.

- Approfitta di 5 settimane di congedo annuale per il personale permanente attraverso la nostra iniziativa di congedo Z, insieme a 15 giorni di congedo personale/carer, in modo che il nostro popolo possa gestire il proprio benessere. Inoltre, l'accesso a Family Care (partita genitoriale).

- Approfitta di un accordo di lavoro ibrido – 3 giorni in ufficio e 2 giorni di lavoro da casa a settimana per i dipendenti a tempo pieno.

- Programmi di accesso per rimanere sano e sentirsi più sano, ricevere un pagamento di benessere AUD$500 all'anno, e un nuovo e-voucher AUD$295 per il vostro lavoro-da-home setup (lavoro flessibile - lavoro ibrido), insieme ad altri grandi benefici attraverso il nostro portale Shine.

- Crescere e prosperare nella tua carriera con i nostri programmi di formazione pluripremiati. Sosteniamo e incoraggiamo il vostro sviluppo perché la nostra forza è nella nostra gente, e apprezziamo la vostra individualità.

- Lavorare con team globali, diversi e inclusivi; esplorare le vostre passioni, innovazione del carburante, guidare l'equità, collaborare e fare una differenza positiva al di là del vostro ruolo.

- Approfitta delle opportunità di mobilità globale in oltre 200 paesi in tutto il mondo.

- Volontariato e lavoro nei nostri uffici all'avanguardia Green Star (quando sei in ufficio) e vestire per la tua giornata.

- Pianifichiamo un albero per ogni nuovo dipendente.

- Per non parlare dei nostri diversi datori di lavoro di assegnazioni / borse di studio – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity... per citarne alcuni.

Potremmo andare avanti, ma il punto principale è che Zurigo è un ottimo posto per essere, dove si può veramente appartenere, essere te stesso, mantenere l'equilibrio lavoro / vita, e prosperare in un ambiente di supporto.

Zurigo è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a garantire che il nostro processo di reclutamento sia equo e accessibile a tutti i candidati. Se avete bisogno di alloggi speciali per partecipare al nostro processo di reclutamento, vi invitiamo a farci sapere al momento della vostra applicazione.

Quindi, se si vuole venire in un'avventura che costruirà un futuro più luminoso insieme, e sentire un senso di insieme, quindi si prega di applicare oggi per iniziare la vostra avventura!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Ein neues transformatives Abenteuer erwartet Sie...

Wie klingen 5 Wochen Jahresurlaub, eine erfüllende Karriere, die Sie wirklich genießen werden, und die Arbeit für eine seriöse Organisation, die das Wohlbefinden fördert und die digitale Transformation vorantreibt?

Als eines der Forbes 2024 "World's Best Employers" und Fortune's "World's Most Admired Companies" für 2025 ist Zurich - ein führendes Unternehmen der Versicherungsbranche - auf dem Weg in eine bessere Zukunft. Eine bessere Zukunft für Sie - konzentriert auf Ihre Karriere, Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Gemeinschaft - sowie unsere Kunden und den Planeten.

Begleiten Sie uns auf dieser aufregenden Reise, während wir auf unsere Vision hinarbeiten, Australiens führender digitaler Versicherer zu werden. Wenn Sie Teil einer werteorientierten globalen Organisation sein möchten, die echtes Wachstum und Transformation erlebt, und wenn Sie unser Engagement teilen, einen spürbaren Unterschied zu machen und kontinuierliche Schritte in Richtung einer nachhaltigen Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeiter, Kunden, Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten zu unternehmen, dann lesen Sie weiter!

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schaffen, lasst uns einen Unterschied machen

Es ist wichtig zu wissen, was du tust. Bei Zürich decken wir nicht nur ab, wir kümmern uns.

Als Account Engineer, Property Risk, übernehmen Sie eine leitende technische Führungsrolle bei Zurich Resilience Solutions und arbeiten mit einigen unserer größten und komplexesten Immobilienkunden zusammen. Diese Rolle besteht darin, das technische Engagement von Zurich zu vertiefen, die Resilienzergebnisse zu stärken und sicherzustellen, dass Kunden vertrauenswürdige, qualitativ hochwertige Risikomanagement-Einblicke erhalten, die einen sichereren und nachhaltigeren Betrieb unterstützen.

Mit Sitz in der Property Line of Business werden Sie umfassende technische Expertise mit einer starken Kundenpartnerschaft in Einklang bringen und als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Kunden, Makler und interne Stakeholder fungieren und gleichzeitig die Art und Weise gestalten, wie Zurich Risk Engineering-Lösungen in komplexen Portfolios liefert.

Sie sind auch für Folgendes verantwortlich:

- Bereitstellung von Expertise im Bereich Immobilienrisiko-Engineering auf leitender Ebene in großen und komplexen Kundenportfolios

- Als technischer Account Lead für Großkunden fungieren und Inputs und Ergebnisse des Risk Engineering koordinieren

- Führendes und Peer-Reviewing detaillierter Bewertungen des Immobilienrisikos und Verbesserungsempfehlungen

- Überwachung der Bereitstellung klarer, qualitativ hochwertiger technischer Berichte und Erkenntnisse für leitende Stakeholder

- Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger technischer Beziehungen zu Kunden, Brokern, Underwritern und internen Partnern

- Beitrag zur Entwicklung innovativer Risk Engineering Lösungen und technischer Standards

Wichtig für Ihren Erfolg – wachsen wir zusammen

Sie sind eine selbstbewusste technische Führungskraft, die gerne eng mit Kunden und Stakeholdern zusammenarbeitet, um komplexe Probleme zu lösen. Sie bringen eine kollaborative Denkweise, ein kommerzielles Bewusstsein und eine echte Leidenschaft für die Verbesserung der Widerstandsfähigkeit und der Risikoergebnisse mit.

Um erfolgreich zu sein, haben Sie Folgendes:

- Senior-Level-Erfahrung im Property Risk Engineering oder Management komplexer Immobilienrisikoportfolios

- Starkes technisches Wissen über Sachgefahren wie Feuer, Naturgefahren und Widerstandsfähigkeit

- Erfahrung als technischer Account Lead oder Senior Risk Engineer für Großkunden

- Vertrauen in die Präsentation komplexer technischer Informationen für leitende Stakeholder

- Bewährte Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten und gleichzeitig hohe technische Standards einzuhalten

Belong. Zürich ist da, um Sie zu unterstützen

Es gibt so viele Gründe, warum Zürich ein großartiger Ort ist und die richtige Wahl für Sie, aber hier sind nur einige.

- Genießen Sie 5 Wochen Jahresurlaub für ständige Mitarbeiter durch unsere Z-Urlaubsinitiative, zusammen mit 15 Tagen persönlichen / Pflegeurlaub, während wir unsere Mitarbeiter befähigen, ihr eigenes Wohlbefinden zu verwalten. Plus, Zugang zur Familienbetreuung (Elternurlaub).

- Profitieren Sie von einer hybriden Arbeitsvereinbarung - 3 Tage im Büro und 2 Tage Arbeit von zu Hause pro Woche für Vollzeitmitarbeiter.

- Zugang zu Programmen, um gesund zu bleiben und sich gesünder zu fühlen, erhalten eine AUD $ 500 Wohlbefindenszahlung pro Jahr und einen AUD $ 295 neuen Starter-E-Gutschein für Ihr Work-from-Home-Setup (Flex-Arbeit - Hybrid-Arbeit), zusammen mit anderen großen Vorteilen durch unser Shine-Portal.

- Wachsen und gedeihen Sie in Ihrer Karriere mit unseren preisgekrönten Trainingsprogrammen. Wir unterstützen und fördern Ihre Entwicklung, weil unsere Stärke in unseren Mitarbeitern liegt und wir Ihre Individualität schätzen.

- Arbeiten Sie mit globalen, vielfältigen und integrativen Teams zusammen; entdecken Sie Ihre Leidenschaften, fördern Sie Innovationen, fördern Sie Gerechtigkeit, arbeiten Sie zusammen und machen Sie einen positiven Unterschied über Ihre Rolle hinaus.

- Nutzen Sie globale Mobilitätsmöglichkeiten in mehr als 200 Ländern weltweit.

- Freiwillige und arbeiten Sie in unseren hochmodernen Green Star Büros (wenn Sie im Büro sind) und kleiden Sie sich für Ihren Tag.

- Wir pflanzen einen Baum für jeden neuen Mitarbeiter.

- Ganz zu schweigen von unseren verschiedenen Arbeitgeberpreisen / Mitgliedschaften - WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Arbeitgeber, Stolz auf Vielfalt ... um nur einige zu nennen.

Wir könnten weitermachen, aber der Hauptpunkt ist, dass Zürich ein großartiger Ort ist, an dem Sie wirklich dazugehören, Sie selbst sein, die Work-Life-Balance aufrechterhalten und in einer unterstützenden Umgebung gedeihen können.

Zürich ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, dass unser Rekrutierungsprozess fair und für alle Kandidaten zugänglich ist. Wenn Sie spezielle Unterkünfte benötigen, um an unserem Rekrutierungsprozess teilzunehmen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, uns dies zum Zeitpunkt Ihrer Bewerbung mitzuteilen.

Wenn Sie also auf ein Abenteuer kommen möchten, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft aufbauen und ein Gefühl der Zusammengehörigkeit spüren wird, dann bewerben Sie sich bitte noch heute, um Ihr Abenteuer zu beginnen!

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary
1. Define scope and manage business requirements for assigned projects from high level user journeys to detailed functional requirements for system development/enhancement or process improvement throughout the project lifecycle.

Key
• Responsibilities
1. Plan, prepare and conduct/facilitate sessions for business requirements gathering and ensure requirements specifications/project deliverables are produced with quality on timely basis.
2. Prepare and present/propose to stakeholders as-is and to-be models relevant to project scope, including modeling process flow/system flow, defining functional requirements & data specifications and system integrations logics, as part of the requirements specifications documentation/user story preparation process with consideration to optimize user journey and enhance user experience where feasible.
3. Identify functional improvement & technical development areas and ideate & define to-be model / solution design with technical teams.
4. Develop and maintain requirement traceability matrix and prioritize requirements with stakeholders with alignment to project objectives and timeline.
5. Collaborate with project manager and technology team to define project scope, develop high-level project plan and perform risk assessment.
6. Perform quality review checks on project deliverables from project teams where required.
7. Design test scope & develop test plans, manage/perform and support testing, and conduct training/change management activities.
8. Manage post implementation activities including incident resolution/problem solving with root cause analysis, stakeholder engagement activities, lessons learnt for improvement, etc.
9. Adapt and apply appropriate delivery methodologies such as SCRUM or Waterfall, where assessed to be best suited for the specific project.

Education & Experience
1. Bachelor’s degree in Business IT, Business Information Systems, IT Management, Computing, Business Administration or related fields.
2. Minimum 8-10 or more years’ experience in a Business Analyst / System Analyst / Product Owner role in system development/delivery or process improvement projects.
3. Experience in General and/or Life insurance with in-depth understanding of insurance products and processes.
4. Experience in Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
5. Good understanding of project management, requirements analysis & solution design, system testing, implementation/change management, stakeholder management best practices, techniques and approaches.
6. Proficiency with Ms Visio or other process modeling tools, JIRA, Confluence and other tools for project/system delivery.

Preferred
1. Strong process modeling, analytical/numeracy, problem-solving and system design skills.
2. Experience in digital transformation or system/platform modernization projects in General and/or Life insurance.

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi del lavoro
1. Definire la portata e gestire i requisiti aziendali per i progetti assegnati da viaggi di utenti di alto livello a requisiti funzionali dettagliati per lo sviluppo del sistema / ottimizzazione o miglioramento del processo durante il ciclo di vita del progetto.

chiave
• responsabilità
1. Pianificare, preparare e condurre/facilitare le sessioni per la raccolta dei requisiti aziendali e garantire i requisiti specifiche / progetti consegnabili sono prodotti con qualità su base tempestiva.
2. Preparare e presentare/proporre alle parti interessate modelli as-is e to-be pertinenti allo scopo del progetto, compreso il flusso di processo di modellazione / flusso di sistema, definendo requisiti funzionali e specifiche dei dati e le logiche di integrazione del sistema, nell'ambito del processo di documentazione delle specifiche esigenze / processo di preparazione della storia dell'utente con la considerazione di ottimizzare il viaggio dell'utente e migliorare l'esperienza dell'utente, dove possibile.
3. Identificare il miglioramento funzionale & aree di sviluppo tecnico e ideate & definire il modello to-be / design soluzione con team tecnici.
4. Sviluppare e mantenere la matrice di tracciabilità dei requisiti e privilegiare i requisiti con gli stakeholder con allineamento agli obiettivi del progetto e la timeline.
5. Collabora con project manager e team di tecnologia per definire lo scopo del progetto, sviluppare un piano di progetto di alto livello ed eseguire la valutazione del rischio.
6. Eseguire controlli di qualità sui progetti consegnabili da team di progetto dove richiesto.
7. Campo di prova di progettazione & sviluppare piani di prova, gestire / eseguire e sostenere test, e condurre attività di formazione / gestione del cambiamento.
8. Gestisci le attività di implementazione post tra cui risoluzione degli incidenti / problem solving con l'analisi delle cause principali, le attività di coinvolgimento degli stakeholder, le lezioni imparate per il miglioramento, ecc.
9. Adattare e applicare metodologie di consegna appropriate come SCRUM o Waterfall, dove valutato per essere più adatto per il progetto specifico.

Istruzione e esperienza
1. Laurea in Business IT, Sistemi di informazione aziendale, Gestione IT, Computing, Business Administration o campi correlati.
2. Minimo 8-10 o più anni di esperienza in un Business Analyst / System Analyst / Product Owner ruolo nei progetti di sviluppo del sistema / consegna o miglioramento del processo.
3. Esperienza nell'assicurazione generale e/o vita con una profonda comprensione dei prodotti e dei processi assicurativi.
4. Esperienza nelle metodologie Agile e Cascata.
5. Buona comprensione della gestione dei progetti, analisi dei requisiti e progettazione delle soluzioni, test di sistema, gestione dell'implementazione/cambiamento, migliori pratiche di gestione delle parti interessate, tecniche e approcci.
6. Competenza con la sig.ra Visio o altri strumenti di modellazione di processo, JIRA, Confluence e altri strumenti per la consegna di progetti/sistemi.

Preferito
1. Forte modellazione di processo, analitica/numeracy, problem-solving e capacità di progettazione di sistema.
2. Esperienza nei progetti di trasformazione digitale o di modernizzazione del sistema/piattaforma nell'assicurazione generale e/o vita.

Sei il cuore e l'anima di Zurigo!

A Zurigo, ci piace pensare al di fuori della scatola e sfidare lo status quo. Prendiamo un approccio ottimista concentrandoci sui positivi e chiedendo costantemente cosa può andare bene?

Apprezziamo molto l'esperienza e il know-how dei nostri dipendenti e offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità tra le aree di business per incoraggiarti a richiedere nuove opportunità all'interno di Zurigo quando sei pronto per il tuo prossimo passo di carriera.

Continuiamo a crescere insieme!
