Stellenbeschreibung
1. Definieren Sie den Umfang und verwalten Sie die Geschäftsanforderungen für zugewiesene Projekte, von High-Level-User-Journeys bis hin zu detaillierten funktionalen Anforderungen für die Systementwicklung / -verbesserung oder Prozessverbesserung während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus.

Schlüssel
• Zuständigkeiten
1. Planen, Vorbereiten und Führen / Erleichtern von Sitzungen für die Erfassung von Geschäftsanforderungen und stellen Sie sicher, dass Anforderungen Spezifikationen / Projektergebnisse rechtzeitig mit Qualität erstellt werden.
2. Vorbereiten und Präsentieren/Vorschlagen von Stakeholdern als Ist- und To-Be-Modelle, die für den Projektumfang relevant sind, einschließlich Modellierung des Prozessflusses/Systemflusses, Definition funktionaler Anforderungen & Datenspezifikationen und Systemintegrationslogiken, als Teil des Prozesses der Dokumentation der Anforderungen Spezifikationen/Anwendergeschichte unter Berücksichtigung der Optimierung der Benutzerreise und der Verbesserung der Benutzererfahrung, wo dies möglich ist.
3. Identifizieren Sie funktionale Verbesserungs- und technische Entwicklungsbereiche und Ideate & Definieren Sie das zukünftige Modell / Lösungsdesign mit technischen Teams.
4. Entwickeln und pflegen Sie die Anforderungsrückverfolgbarkeitsmatrix und priorisieren Sie die Anforderungen mit den Stakeholdern, die an den Projektzielen und dem Zeitplan ausgerichtet sind.
5. Arbeiten Sie mit dem Projektmanager und dem Technologieteam zusammen, um den Projektumfang zu definieren, einen hochrangigen Projektplan zu entwickeln und eine Risikobewertung durchzuführen.
6. Führen Sie bei Bedarf Qualitätsüberprüfungen der Projektergebnisse von Projektteams durch.
7. Entwerfen Sie den Testumfang und entwickeln Sie Testpläne, verwalten Sie / führen Sie Tests durch und unterstützen Sie diese und führen Sie Schulungs- / Change-Management-Aktivitäten durch.
8. Verwalten Sie Post-Implementierungsaktivitäten, einschließlich Incident-Lose / Problemlösung mit Ursachenanalyse, Stakeholder-Engagement-Aktivitäten, Lektionen für Verbesserungen usw.
9. Anpassen und Anwenden geeigneter Liefermethoden wie SCRUM oder Wasserfall, wenn sie für das jeweilige Projekt als am besten geeignet erachtet werden.

Bildung & Erfahrung
1. Bachelor-Abschluss in Business IT, Business Information Systems, IT Management, Computing, Business Administration oder verwandten Bereichen.
2. Mindestens 8-10 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in einem Business Analyst / System Analyst / Product Owner Rolle in Systementwicklung / Lieferung oder Prozessverbesserung Projekte.
3. Erfahrung in der allgemeinen und / oder Lebensversicherung mit einem tiefen Verständnis der Versicherungsprodukte und -prozesse.
4. Erfahrung in Agile und Waterfall Methoden.
5. Gutes Verständnis von Projektmanagement, Anforderungsanalyse & Lösungsdesign, Systemtests, Implementierung / Change Management, Best Practices, Techniken und Ansätzen für das Stakeholder-Management.
6. Kenntnisse mit Frau Visio oder anderen Prozessmodellierungstools, JIRA, Confluence und anderen Tools für die Projekt-/Systembereitstellung.

Bevorzugt
1. Starke Prozessmodellierung, analytische / numerische Fähigkeiten, Problemlösung und Systemdesign.
2. Erfahrung in digitalen Transformations- oder System-/Plattform-Modernisierungsprojekten in der Allgemein- und/oder Lebensversicherung.

Du bist das Herz und die Seele von Zürich!

Bei Zurich denken wir gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hinterfragen den Status Quo. Wir gehen optimistisch vor, indem wir uns auf das Positive konzentrieren und ständig fragen: Was kann richtig gehen?

Wir legen großen Wert auf die Erfahrung und das Know-how unserer Mitarbeiter und bieten eine breite Palette von Möglichkeiten in allen Geschäftsbereichen, um Sie zu ermutigen, sich für neue Möglichkeiten innerhalb von Zürich zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit für Ihren nächsten Karriereschritt sind.

Lasst uns gemeinsam weiter wachsen!

jobs.description:
¡Hola!

Soy Paula, recruiter de esta posición. Me encanta viajar, especialmente a destinos internacionales, y el sushi es mi comida favorita. Además, me encanta la moda flamenca y disfruto bailando sevillanas. Como ves, el entusiasmo y la diversidad forman parte de mi día a día. ¡Encantada de saludarte!

Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales.

¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo.

Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega!

¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN:

- Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2024 hicimos más de 20.000 horas de activismo.

- En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección).

¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas.

Y te preguntarás: Paula, ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento):

- Te encargarás del mantenimiento, control, mejora continua y gestión de la red de proveedores y profesionales externos, que en tu zona de actuación dan servicio a los siniestros de Riesgos Diversos de la Compañía.

- Negociarás con esas redes externas los niveles óptimos de servicio y las tarifas, hasta los niveles de autoridad acordados y ateniéndote a la política de Global de Siniestros de la Compañía. También prestarás apoyo en las negociaciones que superen tu límite de autonomía.

- Analizarás las nuevas candidaturas conforme a las políticas fijadas.

- Servirás de enlace entre la compañía y los proveedores o profesionales externos, garantizarás que se cumplen los acuerdos que determina la compañía y auditarás periódicamente su servicio.

- Vigilarás el correcto cumplimiento de las normativas existentes y colaborarás en su desarrollo y optimización. Buscarás la mejora continua e implementarás las mejores prácticas, revisando y analizando los procesos y las políticas de gestión de proveedores/profesionales externos.

- Serás el responsable, en tu zona de actuación, de la segmentación, dimensionamiento idóneo de la red de proveedores y profesionales de Riesgos Diversos y del correcto flujo de volúmenes (trabajos) de ésta. Con el principal objetivo de controlar la evolución del coste medio y garantizar un nivel óptimo de servicio y satisfacción a los clientes de Zurich.

- Realizarás reuniones y viajes para la corrección de incidencias o problemas en la red de proveedores y profesionales de Riesgos Diversos de tu zona de actuación. Periódicamente efectuarás auditorias in-situ.

- Potenciarás el uso de nuevas tecnologías de peritación y ayudarás a fomentar el direccionamiento a colaboradores.

- Apoyarás y fomentarás la lucha contra el fraude.

- Ofrecerás de asesoramiento técnico a la estructura de siniestros y las Direcciones Territoriales como persona de contacto clave, garantizando el respeto a los procesos de conformidad y buen gobierno de siniestros.

- Mantendrás una comunicación fluida con equipos internos con el fin de obtener la información necesaria para favorecer el buen rendimiento de los proveedores.

- Mantendrás la atención sobre la actividad de la competencia para garantizar que la compañía mantiene una ventaja competitiva y buscarás gestionar a nuestros proveedores conforme a los mejores estándares y prácticas del sector.

- Mantendrás siempre actualizados los conocimientos profesionales y técnicos asistiendo a seminarios formativos, desarrollando el networking y participando en eventos sectoriales.

A estas alturas, te estarás preguntando, ¿Cómo sé si encajo?

¡Hola!

Soy Paula, recruiter de esta posición. Me encanta viajar, especialmente a destinos internacionales, y el sushi es mi comida favorita. Además, me encanta la moda flamenca y disfruto bailando sevillanas. Como ves, el entusiasmo y la diversidad forman parte de mi día a día. ¡Encantada de saludarte!

Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2024 hicimos más de 20.000 horas de activismo.

- En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección).

¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas.

Y te preguntarás: Paula, ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento):

- Te encargarás del mantenimiento, control, mejora continua y gestión de la red de proveedores y profesionales externos, que en tu zona de actuación dan servicio a los siniestros de Riesgos Diversos de la Compañía.

jobs.description:
Zurich, aseguradora líder a nivel internacional te invita a ser parte de su equipo como:

“Coordinación de Compliance”

Objetivo:

Coordinar la implementación, seguimiento y mejora del sistema de cumplimiento de la compañía, asegurando la adhesión a la normativa externa e interna (regulatoria, corporativa y ética), así como la mitigación de riesgos de cumplimiento (regulatorios, de conducta, lavado de dinero, sanciones, protección al consumidor, etc.). Actúa como enlace entre el área de Compliance, el negocio y las funciones de control, promoviendo una cultura de integridad y cumplimiento.

Tus habilidades y experiencia:

- Escolaridad: Lic. Administrativa- económica, Derecho, Relaciones Internacionales

- Experiencia: 2-3 años de experiencia en temas de Compliance, Riesgos No Financieros, Control Interno, Auditoría, Legal regulatorio o funciones similares, preferentemente en sector asegurador o financiero.

- Conocimientos técnicos: Regulación de seguros, intermediación, regulación de privacidad y protección de datos personales. Conocimiento de políticas y estándares corporativos de compliance y ética, gestión de riesgos de cumplimiento, procesos y controles.

- Inglés: Intermedio - Avanzado

Responsabilidades:

- Apoyar la implementación y actualización del programa de compliance (políticas, procedimientos, controles y reportes).

- Identificar y dar seguimiento a riesgos de compliance: regulatorios, de conducta, protección de datos y reputacionales.

- Realizar monitoreos de cumplimiento para identificar posibles riesgos operativos, financieros y regulatorios; definir planes de acción y dar seguimiento a su implementación y cierre.

- Preparar información y reportes de compliance para la dirección, comités internos y funciones regionales/globales.

- Coordinar revisiones y pruebas de controles de cumplimiento, asegurando la adecuada documentación y evidencia de su funcionamiento.

- Apoyar al cumplimiento del marco de protección de datos personales conforme a la LFPDPPP (avisos de privacidad, gestión de incidentes, derechos ARCO).

- Coordinar y ejecutar el plan anual de capacitación en Compliance.

- Brindar asesoría de compliance a las diferentes áreas de la compañía, así como a proyectos y campañas comerciales.

Ofertamos:

- Programa de bienestar

- Esquema de trabajo flexible

- Desarrollo y Crecimiento

Zurich reconoce las diferentes dimensiones que individualizan a una persona en identidad y/o expresión de género, edad, raza, capacidad física, orientación sexual, experiencia, línea de pensamiento y cultura; no aceptando acto alguno de discriminación.

Por qué elegir Zurich

En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor!

Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

jobs.title: ZURICH BANK | Stage Organization & Processes
jobs.description:
Come parte della Direzione HR & Organization di Zurich Italy Bank e, nello specifico, all’interno dell’Ufficio Organization & Processes , la persona che stiamo cercando svolgerà uno stage (curriculare/extracurriculare) di 6 mesi , eventualmente rinnovabile di altri 6 mesi e non finalizzato all’assunzione, in affiancamento al tutor aziendale.

Principali Attività :

La persona che stiamo cercando opererà a riporto del Responsabile dell’Ufficio Organization & Processes, con l’obiettivo di mantenere e sviluppare l’adeguatezza nonché l’efficienza e l’efficacia organizzativa della Banca, presidiando lo sviluppo dei processi interni e del relativo impianto regolamentare e normativo; nonché la struttura organizzativa e il conseguente dimensionamento identificazione delle norme applicabili del settore banking e valutazione del loro impatto su processi e procedure

Requisiti :

- Preferenza laurea in discipline economico-finanziarie o giuridiche;

- Attitudine alla digital transformation

- Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto office;

- Padronanza della lingua inglese;

- Capacità di adattamento al cambiamento, predisposizione al lavoro in team e alla gestione dei clienti interni ed esterni;

Sede di lavoro:

Milano - Via Benigno Crespi, 23 - 20159

Cosa offriamo:

Si offre uno stage della durata di 6 mesi, con possibilità di proroga.

Sono previsti rimborso spese mensile e ticket restaurant .

Siamo uno dei principali gruppi assicurativi al mondo e uno dei pochi che opera a livello globale. La nostra missione è quella di aiutare i nostri clienti a comprendere e a tutelarsi dai rischi. Con circa 53'000 collaboratori al servizio dei clienti in tutto il mondo, aspiriamo a diventare la migliore società assicurativa secondo i parametri dei nostri azionisti, clienti e collaboratori. Noi aiutiamo i clienti privati, le piccole e medie imprese e le società globali in tutto il mondo a comprendere i rischi e a tutelarsi dagli stessi offrendo un ampio ventaglio di prodotti assicurativi, soluzioni e servizi di consulenza.

In Zurich promuoviamo la cultura della diversità e dell'inclusione. Il nostro scopo e i nostri valori sono concepiti per proteggere, ispirare fiducia e aiutare i nostri dipendenti a raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Diamo importanza e difendiamo ciò che è giusto promuovendo l’uguaglianza tra i nostri professionisti, indipendentemente da sesso, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, etnia, generazione, convinzioni, ecc. I nostri processi d’acquisizione ed assunzione di talenti rispettano questo impegno quotidianamente.

Potrai usufruire di strumenti di “ Work life Balance ” utili per assicurare una corretta conciliazione lavoro-vita privata a tutti i dipendenti. Tra questi per noi assumono particolare rilevanza lo smart working , la palestra, il servizio di counselling, la possibilità di effettuare visite specialistiche all’interno dell’azienda e la disponibilità di utilizzare le biciclette in pausa pranzo, ma anche tanto altro!

Unisciti alla Zurich e diventa parte di questa cultura!

Per ulteriori informazioni su Zurich come datore di lavoro così come sul processo di candidatura può fare riferimento a http://www.zurich.it/lavora-con-noi/IlmondoZurich.htm

As part of the HR & Organization of Zurich Italy Bank and, in particular, within the Organization & Processes Office, the person we are looking for will take a 6-month (curricular/extracurricular) internship, possibly renewable for another 6 months and not aimed at recruiting, alongside the company tutor.

Main Activities:

The person we are looking for will carry out the Responsible of the Organization & Processes Office, with the aim of maintaining and developing the adequacy as well as the efficiency and effectiveness of the Bank, chairing the development of internal processes and its regulatory and regulatory system; as well as the organizational structure and the consequent dimensional identification of the applicable rules of the banking sector and evaluation of their impact on processes and procedures

Requirements:

- Preference degree in economic and financial or legal disciplines;

- Digital transformation attitude

- Excellent knowledge of the office package;

- English Language Mastery;

- Ability to adapt to change, to work in team and to manage internal and external customers;

Workplace:

Milan - Via Benigno Crespi, 23 - 20159

What we offer:

It offers an internship lasting 6 months, with possibility of extension.

Monthly reimbursement and ticket restaurant are provided.

We are one of the world's leading insurance groups and one of the few that operates globally. Our mission is to help our customers understand and protect themselves from risks. With about 53,000 employees at customer service worldwide, we aspire to become the best insurance company according to the parameters of our shareholders, customers and employees. We help private customers, small and medium-sized enterprises and global companies around the world to understand risks and protect themselves by offering a wide range of insurance products, solutions and consulting services.

In Zurich we promote the culture of diversity and inclusion. Our purpose and values are designed to protect, inspire confidence and help our employees achieve their full potential. We give importance and defend what is right by promoting equality among our professionals, regardless of sex, disability, sexual orientation, ethnicity, generation, convictions, etc. Our processes of acquisition and recruitment of talent respect this commitment daily.

You can use “Work life Balance” tools to ensure proper work-life reconciliation for all employees. Among them, smart working, gym, counselling service, the possibility to make specialist visits within the company and the availability to use bicycles on lunch break, but also much more!

Join Zurich and become part of this culture!

For further information on Zurich as an employer and the application process, please refer to http://www.zurich.it/work-con-noi/IlmondoZurich.htm
descriptionByLocale.de:
Als Teil der HR & Organisation der Zurich Italy Bank und insbesondere innerhalb des Organization & Processes Office wird die gesuchte Person neben dem Unternehmenstutor ein 6-monatiges (curricular/extracurriculares) Praktikum absolvieren, das möglicherweise für weitere 6 Monate verlängert werden kann und nicht auf die Rekrutierung abzielt.

Haupttätigkeiten:

Zurich, aseguradora líder a nivel internacional te invita a ser parte de su equipo como:

“Underwriter IV P&C”

Objetivo del puesto

El objetivo del suscriptor IV es evaluar, seleccionar y administrar riesgos complejos dentro de las políticas y apetito de riesgo de Zurich, asegurando la rentabilidad sostenible del portafolio y contribuyendo al crecimiento del negocio. Actúa como referente técnico en suscripción, liderando la definición de condiciones y precios para cuentas medianas y grandes, participando en la estructuración de programas —incluyendo soluciones multinacionales y con reaseguro, cuando aplique— y fortaleciendo la relación con brokers y clientes clave.

Tus habilidades y experiencia:

- Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Administración, Finanzas, Economía, Actuaría, Ingeniería o carrera afín

- Experiencia requerida: Mínimo 3 años suscribiendo riesgos en la línea P&C

- Conocimientos técnicos: Principios de suscripción (selección de riesgos, pricing técnico, límites y sublímites, deducibles). Políticas, guías de suscripción y apetito de riesgo. Productos y coberturas de P&C

- Herramientas: S istemas CRM (p. ej. Salesforce u otros) manejo de paquetería Office (Excel avanzado)

- Competencias y habilidades: Capacidad analítica y atención al detalle. Evaluar impactos técnicos y financieros (loss ratios, tendencias de siniestralidad, escenarios). Estructurar programas y wording (condiciones especiales, cláusulas adicionales, reaseguro facultativo).

Responsabilidades principales

- Analizar propuestas complejas, revisando: i nformación técnica del riesgo (ubicaciones, valores asegurados, procesos, controles), historial de siniestros y tendencias, perfil financiero y de gestión de riesgos del cliente.

- Determinación de condiciones de pricing: definir términos y condiciones de la póliza (coberturas, exclusiones, cláusulas especiales), límites y sublímites, deducibles y franquicias, tarifas y primas adecuadas.

- Gestión de portafolio

- Proponer ajustes en guías de suscripción o pricing para mantener rentabilidad, estrategias de selección de negocio.

- Ser punto de contacto técnico para brokers y clientes clave.

- Asegurar documentación de suscripción completa y conforme a estándares ( ASD42)

- Colocación de reaseguro facultativo y coaseguro.

Ofertamos:

- Atractivo esquema de compensación.

- Prestaciones superiores a la ley

- Grandes oportunidades de desarrollo y crecimiento

Zurich reconoce las diferentes dimensiones que individualizan a una persona en identidad y/o expresión de género, edad, raza, capacidad física, orientación sexual, experiencia, línea de pensamiento y cultura; no aceptando acto alguno de discriminación.

Por qué elegir Zurich

En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor!

Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

jobs.title: Berater für digitale Vertriebsprozesse in Versicherungsagenturen Region Nord Ost (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bist du bereit, mit dem Besten zu rechnen ?

Bei Zurich leben wir Versicherung neu. Um die Wünsche unserer Kunden noch besser zu erfüllen, gehen wir neue Wege, denken kreativ, arbeiten agil. Unsere Unternehmenskultur schenkt dir in jeder Hinsicht mehr Flexibilität – und viel Freiraum, dich optimal zu entfalten. Think big – und gerne auch international! Denn deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten kennen bei uns keine Grenzen. Bereit, die Zukunft in die Hand zu nehmen?

Das erwartet dich

- Du berätst im Großraum Berlin/Leipzig Agenturen unseres Ausschließlichkeitsvertriebs vor Ort bei der digitalen Strategie und technischen Vertriebsprozessen

- Dein Aufgabenfeld umfasst die Qualifizierung und das Onboarding neuer Agenturen sowie Vermittlerinnen und Vermittler

- Bei der Einführung neuer Vertriebskonzepte und Produkte in den Bereichen Sach- und Lebensversicherung wirkst du aktiv mit

- Du initiierst und setzt zentrale sowie regionale Kampagnen um

- Die Sicherstellung gesetzlicher Beratungsanforderungen und die Erreichung qualitativer sowie quantitativer Ziele gehören zu deinen Verantwortlichkeiten

- Du arbeitest eng mit Regionalmanagern und der Vertriebsdirektion zusammen, um Verkaufskonzepte zu entwickeln und umzusetzen

Das bringst du mit

- Hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative, Teamfähigkeit sowie Ergebnisorientierung

- Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung im Bereich Wirtschaft, Vertrieb oder Versicherungen

- Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen im Vertrieb, Kenntnisse in Microsoft Dynamics - CRM Systemen sind von Vorteil - aber nicht zwingend notwendig

- Ausgeprägten Kommunikations- und Beratungsfähigkeiten sowie eine technische Affinität

- Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Schulungen und Präsentationen

- Du kennst die gesetzlichen Vorgaben im Versicherungs- und Finanzdienstleistungsbereich und setzt diese sicher um

Diese Stelle ist IDD-relevant. Die Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD) richtet sich als Vertriebsrichtlinie an alle Personen, die am Vertrieb von Versicherungen beteiligt sind. Bei Einstellung benötigen wir gem. § 48 VAG deine Erklärung zu deiner Zuverlässigkeit und deinen Vermögensverhältnissen sowie den Nachweis deiner angemessenen Qualifikation.

Das bieten wir dir

- Flexible Arbeitsformen, um eine optimale Balance zwischen Arbeiten am Arbeitsplatz und von zu Hause auszugestalten

jobs.description:
Job Summary
To act as the strategic relationship manager for designated Key Accounts across Partnerships and drive the acquisition and development of partnerships to deliver innovative insurance solutions and contribute to the development of profitable growth.
Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

- Act as main contact person towards the cooperation partners and internal functions.

- Acquisition of partnerships in the field of cooperation and maintaining existing partnerships.

- Lead the end-to-end process during planning and implementation of all partner-related development measures, ensuring the market working with importers and financial companies, as well as the on-site garage companies.

- Coordinate the elaboration and subsequent implementation of the desired solutions together with the relevant internal authorities and assuming responsibility for the results of partnerships allocated to.

- Develop new insurance solutions.

- Participate as well as manage partner and market specific projects.-Overtake outcome responsibility for allocated accounts.

Job Qualifications

Required:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or a related field (Master’s or MBA is an added advantage)Minimum

- 10–15 years of relevant experience in partnerships, business development, or strategic alliances

- At least 5 years in a leadership role, managing teams and cross-functional stakeholders

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

- Location(s): MY - Kuala Lumpur

- Schedule: Full Time

jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Corporate Actuary & Portfolio Management professional to lead actuarial initiatives and provide critical business insights. This role will be responsible for delivering actuarial analyses, supporting strategic decision-making, and ensuring robust risk and financial management across the organization.

The successful candidate will lead a team, oversee actuarial processes, and contribute to risk-based capital modeling, while continuously improving systems, methodologies, and talent capability within the actuarial function

Job Qualifications

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.

- Qualified or nearly qualified actuary (FSAI of recognized actuarial body preferred).

- Proven experience in actuarial work such as reserving, pricing, capital modeling, or risk management.

- Strong analytical, statistical, and modeling skills.

- Proficiency in actuarial tools/programming (e.g., Excel, R, Python, SAS, Prophet, etc.).

- Solid understanding of risk-based capital frameworks and financial reporting standards.

- Demonstrated leadership and people management experience.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

- Lead and develop the actuarial team, ensuring timely delivery of both routine tasks and more complex analyses with appropriate oversight.

- Perform actuarial analyses across reserving, financial reporting, pricing, and quantitative risk management.

- Build, maintain, and enhance statistical models; analyze data and interpret results to provide actionable business insights.

- Provide actuarial advice to stakeholders, including insights into business performance and financial implications.

- Manage actuarial data flow and quality to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of outputs.

- Support the development, calibration, and enhancement of risk-based capital (RBC) models.

- Ensure compliance with internal actuarial policies and standards, while driving improvements in systems, processes, and methodologies

jobs.title: Senior Risk Engineering Consultant- Construction Casualty
jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for a Senior Construction Risk Engineering Consultant for the Casualty Lines of Business in our Southern region. This is a Remote work from home role. The preferred region is either middle to southern Texas , or also Eastern Tennessee, with additional consideration given to Northern Georgia and the western areas of both North and South Carolina. Travel may be required across these states within the designated territory. We would also like to see some experience with both Regulated and Non-Regulated Fleets and Data Center construction.

The position includes a company car, with expected travel of 30% to 50% of your time depending on business needs.

In this role as a Senior Construction Risk Engineering Consultant, you will be responsible for:

- Adapting Zurich's Innovative Solutions to the Construction Industry with the objective of minimizing impacts to customer losses, and overall improvement of Sustainability & Business Resiliency at the Corporate Level.

- Leveraging Zurich’s risk engineering tools and services to improve customer risk and general account management of customers who purchase Zurich Construction Insurance products such as: Workers Compensation, General Liability and Auto Liability.

- Delivering high quality construction consultative services for customers, including identifying exposures and program risk control gaps to form the basis of risk mitigation recommendations, investigation of cause/effect of major losses for hazard/safety management programs.

- Developing and maintaining positive customer and business partner relationships and collaborate with both customers and business partners to develop appropriate service plans.

- Marketing and selling a wide range of fee services to customers that support their risk mitigation efforts.

- Producing advanced level presentations and delivering risk management training for customers and internal business partners.

- Providing appropriate risk improvement advice, conduct loss investigations (including both trend and root cause analysis), and implement risk improvement programs.

- Assisting customers with developing corporate and project specific QA/QC plans, safety plans, investigating construction defects when applicable, building envelope reviews and moisture mitigation identification.

- Participate in Sales Team meetings and presentations to brokers and customers while contributing to fee income sales through opportunity spotting and cross-selling.

Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) background check because this position will include a company car.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree and 6 or more years of experience in the Construction Risk Engineering, Safety/ Risk Management, or Construction Field Operations.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 8 or more years of experience in the Construction Risk Engineering, Safety/ Risk Management, or Construction Field Operations.
AND

- Experience working in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- Construction Safety/Risk preferrable with Project Management, and/or Superintendent experience- mid to senior level position.

- Regulated and Non-Regulated Fleet Experience

- Data Center construction experience

- Large commercial construction experience with industrial, medical, and educational projects.

- Advanced level knowledge of construction safety, operations, quality management and associated construction risks and exposures.

- Professional certifications such as: CRIS, ARM, CHST, CSP, ASP, P.E. etc.

- Have a high level of computer literacy and be proficient in Microsoft Office and IOS platforms.

- Proficiency in technical writing to create customer and internal business partner work products.

- Be experienced working in both independent and team environments.

- Excellent interpersonal, communication and consulting skills with the ability to communicate and consult at both the corporate and project site levels effectively and professionally.

- Leadership and involvement in extracurricular activities, organizations and/or community, public service, or similar activities.

- Willingness to embrace the Zurich Basics, including our values of integrity, Sustainability, Customer Centricity, Excellence and Teamwork.

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $100,200.00 - $164,100.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

- Sfruttando gli strumenti e i servizi di ingegneria dei rischi di Zurigo per migliorare il rischio del cliente e la gestione generale degli account dei clienti che acquistano prodotti di assicurazione per le costruzioni di Zurigo come: Compensazione dei lavoratori, responsabilità generale e responsabilità automatica.

- Fornire servizi consultivi di costruzione di alta qualità per i clienti, tra cui l'individuazione di esposizioni e lacune di controllo del rischio di programma per formare la base di raccomandazioni di mitigazione del rischio, l'indagine di causa / effetto di perdite principali per i programmi di gestione del rischio / sicurezza.

- Produrre presentazioni di livello avanzato e fornire formazione di gestione del rischio per i clienti e partner aziendali interni.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Zürich sucht derzeit einen Senior Construction Risk Engineering Consultant für die Casualty Lines of Business in unserer Region Süd. Dies ist eine Remote-Arbeit von zu Hause Rolle. Die bevorzugte Region ist entweder mitten im südlichen Texas (Texas), oder auch das Östliche Tennessee (Das östliche Tennessee), mit der zusätzlichen Betrachtung, die dem Nördlichen Georgia und den Westgebieten sowohl des Nördlichen als auch des Südlichen Carolinas gegeben ist. Reisen können in diesen Staaten innerhalb des ausgewiesenen Territoriums erforderlich sein. Wir möchten auch einige Erfahrungen mit regulierten und nicht regulierten Flotten und dem Bau von Rechenzentren sehen.

Die Position umfasst ein Firmenauto, mit einer erwarteten Reise von 30% bis 50% Ihrer Zeit, abhängig von geschäftlichen Bedürfnissen.

In dieser Rolle als Senior Construction Risk Engineering Consultant sind Sie verantwortlich für:

- Anpassung der innovativen Lösungen von Zurich an die Bauindustrie mit dem Ziel, die Auswirkungen auf Kundenverluste zu minimieren und die Nachhaltigkeit und Geschäftsresilienz auf Unternehmensebene insgesamt zu verbessern.

- Die Nutzung der Risk-Engineering-Tools und -Services von Zurich zur Verbesserung des Kundenrisikos und des allgemeinen Kontomanagements von Kunden, die Zürich Bauversicherungsprodukte kaufen, wie z. B. Arbeitnehmerentschädigung, allgemeine Haftung und Autohaftung.

- Bereitstellung hochwertiger Bauberatungsdienste für Kunden, einschließlich der Ermittlung von Expositionen und Programmrisikokontrolllücken, um die Grundlage für Risikominderungsempfehlungen zu bilden, Untersuchung der Ursache / Wirkung von Großschäden für Gefahren- / Sicherheitsmanagementprogramme.

- Entwicklung und Pflege positiver Kunden- und Geschäftspartnerbeziehungen und Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Geschäftspartnern, um geeignete Servicepläne zu entwickeln.

- Marketing und Verkauf einer breiten Palette von Gebührendiensten an Kunden, die ihre Bemühungen zur Risikominderung unterstützen.

- Erstellung von Präsentationen auf fortgeschrittenem Niveau und Bereitstellung von Risikomanagement-Schulungen für Kunden und interne Geschäftspartner.

- Bereitstellung geeigneter Risikoverbesserungsberatung, Durchführung von Verlustuntersuchungen (einschließlich Trend- und Ursachenanalyse) und Implementierung von Risikoverbesserungsprogrammen.

- Unterstützung der Kunden bei der Entwicklung unternehmens- und projektspezifischer QA / QC-Pläne, Sicherheitspläne, gegebenenfalls bei der Untersuchung von Baufehlern, Überprüfungen von Gebäudehüllen und Identifizierung von Feuchtigkeitsminderungen.

- Nehmen Sie an Sitzungen und Präsentationen des Verkaufsteams für Broker und Kunden teil und tragen Sie gleichzeitig zum Umsatz von Gebühreneinnahmen durch Gelegenheitserkennung und Cross-Selling bei.

Endgültige Kandidaten werden auch einer Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Hintergrundprüfung unterzogen, da diese Position ein Firmenauto enthalten wird.

- Bachelor-Abschluss und 6 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Construction Risk Engineering, Safety / Risk Management oder Construction Field Operations.
ODER

- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 8 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Construction Risk Engineering, Safety / Risk Management oder Construction Field Operations.
UND

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einer Teamumgebung

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

- Bausicherheit / Risiko bevorzugt mit Projektmanagement und / oder Superintendent Erfahrung - mittlere bis leitende Position.

- Regulierte und nicht regulierte Flottenerfahrung

- Bau von Rechenzentren

- Große gewerbliche Bauerfahrung mit industriellen, medizinischen und Bildungsprojekten.

- Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse der Bausicherheit, des Betriebs, des Qualitätsmanagements und der damit verbundenen Baurisiken und -expositionen.

- Professionelle Zertifizierungen wie: CRIS, ARM, CHST, CSP, ASP, P.E. etc.

jobs.title: Risk Engineering Consultant -Construction Casualty
jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for a Construction Risk Engineer Consultant for the Casualty Lines of Business. This is a Minnesota based remote role supporting the upper Midwest region. Ideal location includes Minneapolis and surrounding areas. The position includes a company car, with expected travel of 30% to 50% and overnight travel of 20% to 30% of your time depending on business needs. This role could be filled at either a Risk Engineering Consultant or at the Sr. Risk Engineering Consultant level, this will be at the manager’s discretion.

As a Construction Risk Engineering Consultant, you will be responsible for:

- Apply Zurich risk engineering solutions to construction customers to help reduce losses and improve risk management outcomes.

- Leverage Zurich’s risk engineering tools and services to improve customer risk and general account management of customers who purchase Zurich Construction Insurance products such as: Workers Compensation, General Liability and Auto Liability.

- Deliver high-quality consultative services, including exposure identification, evaluation of risk control gaps, and development of practical risk mitigation recommendations.

- Develop and maintain positive customer and business partner relationships, collaborating to create appropriate service plans.

- Partner with Construction Underwriting to evaluate and assess existing and prospective customers.

- Identify opportunities to provide fee-based services that support customer risk mitigation and performance improvement efforts.

- Develop and deliver advanced presentations and risk management training for customers and internal business partners.

- Providing appropriate risk improvement advice, conduct loss investigations (including both trend and root cause analysis), and implementing risk improvement programs.

- Assist customers with corporate and project specific safety plans, QA/QC programs, construction defect investigations when applicable, building envelope reviews, and moisture mitigation strategies.

- Actively participate and engage in local construction industry associations.

Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle record background check, because this position will include a company car.

Basic Qualifications:

Risk Engineering Consultant:

- Bachelors Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering area
OR

- Zurich Certified Apprentice, including an Associates degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering area
AND

- Experience working in a team environment

- Relevant experience in the assessment of risk, based on what is required by LOB specific competency standards

OR

Senior Risk Engineering Consultant:

- Bachelors Degree and 6 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering, Safety/ Risk Management, Construction Field Operations, Engineering or relatable field.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 8 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering, Safety/ Risk Management, Construction Field Operations, Engineering or relatable field.
OR

- Zurich Certified Apprentice, including an Associates degree and 6 or more years of experience in the Risk Engineering, Safety/ Risk Management, Construction Field Operations, Engineering, or relatable field.
AND

Preferred Qualifications:

- Advanced knowledge of construction safety, operations, quality management, and associated risks, exposures and controls.

- Experience with large commercial construction, data center construction, and regulated or non-regulated fleets.

- Strong technical writing and presentation skills for customer-facing and internal work products.

- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and consulting skills with the ability to engage effectively at both corporate and project site levels.

- Have a high level of computer literacy and be proficient in Microsoft Office, including Copilot, and mobile IOS devices.

- Professional certifications: CHST, ASP, CSP, CRIS, ARM

- Relevant experience as a corporate safety professional, site safety leader, project manager, or superintendent with safety responsibilities.

- Demonstrated leadership and involvement in professional, community, or public service activities.

- Willingness to embrace Zurich Basics, including our values of integrity, sustainability, customer centricity, excellence, and teamwork.

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The combined salary range for this position is $79,600.00 - $172,300.00. The proposed salary range for the Risk Engineering Consultant is $79,600.00 - $130,300.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%. The proposed salary range for the Senior Risk Engineering Consultant is $105,200.00 - $172,300.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Relevant du(de la) vice‑président(e) adjoint(e), Biens – général, vous agirez à la fois comme coordonnateur(trice) de comptes et représentant(e) sur le terrain pour plusieurs comptes. Vous collaborerez avec les partenaires de souscription pour gérer la qualité des risques du portefeuille de biens de Zurich, soutenir les programmes de contrôle des risques des clients, réaliser des évaluations des risques sur place, élaborer des analyses de comptes et coordonner les rencontres de suivi, tout en respectant les normes techniques globales de Zurich et les codes reconnus.

Il s’agit d’une occasion unique de développer vos connaissances et votre expérience pour l’avenir dans un environnement de soutien où votre voix compte. Cet affichage vise à combler un poste déjà vacant.

Zurich Canada utilise des outils technologiques reposant sur l’intelligence artificielle pour soutenir certains aspects du processus de recrutement, notamment l’examen initial et le tri des candidatures. L’intelligence artificielle ne constitue pas la seule base pour la présélection ou la sélection des candidats. Toutes les décisions d’embauche sont examinées et prises par des professionnels qualifiés en recrutement.

Zurich applique un modèle de travail hybride exigeant une présence en personne trois jours par semaine.

Ce que vous ferez

• Évaluer la qualité de risques complexes, en mettant l’accent sur les actifs clés et stratégiques tels que définis par les normes de Zurich Resilience Solutions.
• Évaluer les potentiels de pertes conformément aux définitions de Zurich et de l’industrie.
• Soutenir les clients externes en identifiant, en évaluant et en réduisant les risques liés à leurs actifs clés/stratégiques et à l’ensemble de leurs comptes.
• Fournir des recommandations appropriées en matière d’amélioration des risques, mener des enquêtes sur les pertes (y compris l’analyse des tendances et des causes profondes) et mettre en œuvre des programmes d’amélioration des risques.
• Communiquer efficacement avec les ingénieurs en risques sur le terrain; entretenir des relations avec les partenaires en souscription, les courtiers, les consultants sectoriels, les organisations professionnelles et les autorités d’homologation.
• Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans de service aux clients pour les comptes coordonnés afin de favoriser l’efficacité des services sur le terrain.
• Assurer la cohérence et la qualité des services offerts au compte, y compris les évaluations, les recommandations en matière d’amélioration des risques, les rapports ainsi que la gestion du temps et des dépenses.
• Explorer de nouvelles possibilités de services, développer de nouveaux services pour les clients et identifier le potentiel de ventes croisées.
• Soutenir la croissance commerciale de Zurich Resilience Solutions en offrant des services de consultation de pointe et des services vendus, en identifiant les occasions et en favorisant de solides relations avec les clients.
• Gérer le changement au sein des comptes en demeurant en contact étroit avec les équipes de direction des clients et les partenaires d’affaires, notamment en examinant les nouveaux projets et les plans de changement.

OU
• Diplôme d’études secondaires ou équivalent et au moins 10 ans d’expérience en ingénierie des risques liés aux biens
OU
• Programme d’apprenti certifié Zurich, incluant un diplôme collégial et au moins 8 ans d’expérience en ingénierie des risques liés aux biens
ET
• Expérience avec Microsoft Office

• Expérience de travail au sein d’une équipe

• Désignation en gestion des risques (CRM – Canadian Risk Management)
• Expérience de gestion de comptes à titre de consultant(e) en services de gestion des risques pour des entreprises de taille moyenne ou de grands clients en assurances de biens et programmes connexes
• Excellentes aptitudes en communication et solides compétences en consultation orientée vers les résultats
• Excellentes compétences en collaboration
• Maîtrise du français parlé et écrit
• Maîtrise de l’anglais parlé et écrit requise pour faciliter la communication avec les parties prenantes internes et externes à l’extérieur du Québec.

Notre culture

• Chez Zurich, nous sommes fiers de notre culture. Nous sommes passionnés par la diversité, l’inclusion, l’équité et le sentiment d’appartenance (DIEB). Nous souhaitons que vous puissiez être vous‑même au travail et que nos employés reflètent les communautés dans lesquelles nous vivons et travaillons. Nos initiatives DIEB visent à créer un environnement où chacun se sent bienvenu.
• Nous entretenons une culture de collaboration où la diversité de pensée est valorisée. Nous accordons de l’importance à vos idées et nous nous efforçons de donner à nos employés les outils dont ils ont besoin pour avoir un impact.
• Nous nous soucions du bien‑être de nos employés et offrons un régime complet d’avantages sociaux et de soins de santé avec différents niveaux de couverture adaptés à vos besoins, ainsi qu’un programme de rémunération globale concurrentiel.
• Nous comprenons l’importance de se reposer, de recharger ses batteries et de faire ce que l’on aime. Chez Zurich, tous les employés bénéficient d’un minimum de quatre semaines de vacances par année à cette fin.
• Nous comprenons également que les employés ont parfois besoin de congés pour des raisons personnelles. Vous pouvez avoir un rendez‑vous pendant une journée de travail, une fête culturelle ou religieuse à souligner ou simplement besoin de temps pour vous concentrer sur votre santé mentale. Les employés de Zurich disposent de quatre journées personnelles par année à utiliser à leur discrétion.
• Nous sommes résolus à nous améliorer en continu et offrons un accès à une vaste gamme de possibilités de formation et de développement.
• Nous nous soucions de nos communautés. Nos communautés sont les lieux où vivent et travaillent nos clients, nos employés et nos actionnaires. Même si nous pouvons être fiers de la contribution à la société que Zurich apporte par le biais de son activité principale d’assurance, nous devons aussi redonner à nos communautés par notre talent, notre temps et nos ressources.
• Nous avons remporté de nombreux prix pour notre culture de travail. Nous sommes fiers de faire partie des meilleurs employeurs de la grande région de Toronto et d’avoir reçu le prix « 5-Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion » d’Insurance Business Canada.

Faites une différence. Relevez des défis. Laissez‑vous inspirer. Soyez soutenu(e). Aimez ce que vous faites. Travaillez avec nous.

À propos de nous

Zurich Canada fait partie du Zurich Insurance Group, un assureur multibranche comptant environ 55 000 employés dans le monde au service de clients sur les marchés mondiaux et locaux. Zurich Canada est un important fournisseur d’assurance qui dessert depuis 100 ans des entreprises de taille moyenne et de grandes sociétés, y compris des multinationales, sur le marché canadien de l’assurance des entreprises. Avec plus de 650 employés dans des bureaux partout au pays, Zurich offre la solidité mondiale d’un important assureur, combinée à une connaissance approfondie des secteurs d’activité et des marchés locaux. Zurich Canada aspire à être le premier choix des professionnels de la gestion des risques comme partenaire de référence pour les aider à relever les défis de risques d’aujourd’hui et de demain. Pour en savoir plus, visitez le site www.zurichcanada.com .

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich strives to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We recruit talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion bring us closer to our common goal: exceeding our customers’ expectations. Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on behalf of, Zurich. We strive to achieve a workplace free of discrimination of all forms, including discrimination on the basis of physical or mental disability, or medical condition. If you are interested in a job opportunity, please advise if you require an accommodation, so we can work with you to provide a more accessible process.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Any unsolicited resume will become the property of Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. If you are a preferred vendor, please use our Recruiting Agency Portal for resume submission.

Occasioni

Alla ricerca di un posto di lavoro attento, collaborativo e orientato ai valori con colleghi e leader ispiranti? Avete l'ambizione e il desiderio di essere tra i migliori e prosperare nel fornitore di assicurazione più influente del mondo? Non guardare oltre Zurigo Canada.

Se avete esperienza nei servizi di asset risk management e siete alla ricerca di una nuova sfida, saremo lieti di incontrarvi.

Zurigo Canada è attualmente alla ricerca di un vice-presidente aggiunto, Senior Asset Risk Management Consultant, per fornire competenze di valutazione del rischio e servizi di consulenza per sostenere i nostri conti ad alto rischio legati alle attività.

Segnalando al vice-presidente aggiunto, General Assets, lei agirà come coordinatore del conto e rappresentante del campo per diversi conti. Potrai collaborare con partner di sottoscrizione per gestire la qualità dei rischi del portafoglio patrimoniale di Zurigo, sostenere i programmi di controllo dei rischi dei clienti, condurre valutazioni dei rischi in loco, sviluppare l'analisi dei conti e coordinare gli incontri di follow-up, rispettando gli standard tecnici globali di Zurigo e i codici riconosciuti.

Questa è un'opportunità unica per sviluppare la vostra conoscenza e l'esperienza per il futuro in un ambiente di supporto in cui la vostra voce conta. Lo scopo di questa pubblicazione è quello di riempire una posizione già vacante.

Zurigo Canada utilizza strumenti informatici artificiali per supportare alcuni aspetti del processo di reclutamento, tra cui l'esame iniziale e la screening delle applicazioni. L'intelligenza artificiale non è l'unica base per lo screening o la selezione dei candidati. Tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono esaminate e prese da professionisti qualificati di reclutamento.

Zurigo applica un modello di lavoro ibrido che richiede una presenza di persona tre giorni alla settimana.

Cosa farai

• Valuta la qualità dei rischi complessi, concentrandosi sui beni chiave e strategici definiti dagli standard di Zurich Resilience Solutions.
• Valutare le potenziali perdite secondo le definizioni di Zurigo e del settore.
• Sostenere i clienti esterni identificando, valutando e riducendo i rischi relativi ai loro beni chiave/strategici e ai loro conti generali.
• Fornire raccomandazioni appropriate di miglioramento del rischio, condurre indagini di perdita (compresa l'analisi di tendenza e di causa principale) e implementare programmi di miglioramento del rischio.
• Comunicare efficacemente con gli ingegneri del rischio nel campo; mantenere le relazioni con i partner di sottoscrizione, i broker, i consulenti del settore, le organizzazioni professionali e le autorità di licenza.
• Sviluppare e implementare piani di servizio client per account coordinati per supportare l'efficacia dei servizi di campo.
• Assicurare la coerenza e la qualità dei servizi forniti al conto, comprese le valutazioni, raccomandazioni di miglioramento del rischio, reporting e gestione del tempo e delle spese.
• Esplora nuove opportunità di servizio, sviluppa nuovi servizi per i clienti e identifica il potenziale di cross-sales.
• Sostenere la crescita aziendale di Zurich Resilience Solutions fornendo servizi di consulenza e vendita all'avanguardia, identificare opportunità e promuovere forti rapporti con i clienti.
• Gestisci il cambiamento all'interno dei conti mantenendo stretto contatto con i team di gestione del cliente e i partner commerciali, inclusa la revisione di nuovi progetti e piani di cambiamento.

Qualifiche di posizione – Che cosa porti

Requisiti:
• Laurea e almeno 8 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria del rischio immobiliare
O
• Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente e almeno 10 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria dei rischi di proprietà
O
• Programma di apprendistato certificato di Zurigo, tra cui una laurea e almeno 8 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria dei rischi di proprietà
E
• Esperienza con Microsoft Office
• Conoscenza avanzata dei rischi e dei controlli nel settore industriale
• Esperienza di lavoro in un team

Benefici:
• Bachelor of Engineering, Ingegneria civile o Discipline correlate
• Progettazione della gestione del rischio (RMC)
• Esperienza nella gestione dei conti come consulente di servizi di gestione del rischio per le aziende di medie dimensioni o grandi clienti in assicurazione di beni e programmi correlati
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e forti capacità di consultazione orientate ai risultati
• Competenze di collaborazione eccellenti
• Mastery di francese parlato e scritto
• Mastery di inglese parlato e scritto richiesto per facilitare la comunicazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni al di fuori del Quebec.

La nostra cultura

• A Zurigo siamo orgogliosi della nostra cultura. Siamo appassionati di diversità, inclusione, correttezza e sentimento di appartenenza (DIEB). Vogliamo che siate al lavoro voi stessi e i nostri dipendenti a riflettere le comunità in cui viviamo e lavoriamo. Le nostre iniziative DIEB mirano a creare un ambiente in cui tutti si sentono benvenuti.
• Manteniamo una cultura di collaborazione dove la diversità del pensiero è apprezzata. Apprezziamo le vostre idee e ci sforziamo di dare ai nostri dipendenti gli strumenti di cui hanno bisogno per fare un impatto.
• Ci preoccupiamo del benessere dei nostri dipendenti e offriamo un piano completo di benefici e assistenza sanitaria con diversi livelli di copertura su misura per le vostre esigenze, così come un programma di compensazione globale competitivo.
• Comprendiamo l'importanza di riposare, ricaricare le batterie e fare ciò che amiamo. A Zurigo, tutti i dipendenti beneficiano di un minimo di quattro settimane di vacanza all'anno per questo scopo.
• Sappiamo anche che i dipendenti a volte hanno bisogno di lasciare per motivi personali. Si può avere un appuntamento durante una giornata lavorativa, una celebrazione culturale o religiosa per evidenziare o semplicemente bisogno di tempo per concentrarsi sulla vostra salute mentale. I dipendenti di Zurigo hanno quattro giorni personali all'anno da utilizzare a loro discrezione.
• Ci impegniamo a migliorare continuamente e a fornire l'accesso a una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione e sviluppo.
• Ci preoccupiamo delle nostre comunità. Le nostre comunità sono i luoghi in cui vivono e lavorano i nostri clienti, dipendenti e azionisti. Anche se possiamo essere orgogliosi del contributo di Zurigo alla società attraverso la sua attività di assicurazione fondamentale, dobbiamo anche restituire alle nostre comunità attraverso il nostro talento, il tempo e le risorse.
• Abbiamo vinto molti premi per la nostra cultura del lavoro. Siamo orgogliosi di essere uno dei migliori datori di lavoro nella Greater Toronto Area e di aver ricevuto il 5-Star Diversity, Equity e Inclusion Award da Assicurazione Business Canada.

Fai la differenza. Alza le sfide. Sii ispirato. Sii supportato. Adoro quello che fai. Lavora con noi.

Informazioni su di noi

Zurigo Canada fa parte del Zurich Insurance Group, un'assicurazione multi-branch con circa 55.000 dipendenti globali che servono clienti nei mercati globali e locali. Zurigo Canada è un importante fornitore di assicurazioni che ha servito società di medie e grandi dimensioni, comprese le multinazionali, nel mercato delle assicurazioni commerciali canadese per 100 anni. Con oltre 650 dipendenti in uffici in tutto il paese, Zurigo offre la forza globale di un importante assicuratore, insieme a una conoscenza approfondita dei settori e dei mercati aziendali locali. Zurigo Canada aspira ad essere la prima scelta per i professionisti della gestione del rischio come partner di riferimento per aiutarli a soddisfare le sfide dei rischi di oggi e di domani. Per ulteriori informazioni, visitare il sito www.zurichcanada.com .

Un futuro con Zurigo

Ora è il momento di andare avanti e fare la differenza. A Zurigo, vogliamo che tu condivida le tue prospettive, esperienze e idee uniche in modo da poter crescere e guidare un cambiamento sostenibile insieme. Nell'ambito di un'organizzazione globale leader, Zurigo Nord America ha oltre 148 anni di esperienza nella gestione del rischio e nel supporto alla resilienza. Siamo un fornitore leader di soluzioni di assicurazione proprietà-casualty commerciali e una vasta gamma di prodotti e servizi di gestione del rischio per le imprese e gli individui. Oggi, serviamo più di 25 industrie, dall'agricoltura alla tecnologia e assicuriamo il 90% della Fortune 500®. La nostra strategia di crescita non è limitata al nostro business. Come datore di lavoro, Zurigo porta a fornire opportunità di sviluppo della carriera in corso e promuovere un ambiente in cui le voci sono diverse, i comportamenti sono inclusi, le azioni guidare equità, e la nostra gente sente un senso di appartenenza. Fai parte della prossima evoluzione del settore assicurativo. Unisciti a noi nella costruzione di un futuro più luminoso per la nostra gente, i nostri clienti e le comunità che serviamo.

Come società globale, Zurigo riconosce la diversità della nostra forza lavoro come risorsa. Diamo il benvenuto a persone di talento da una varietà di background con prospettive uniche che sono veramente benvenuti qui. Assunto insieme, la diversità e l'inclusione ci avvicinino al nostro obiettivo comune: l'espulsione dei nostri clienti Zurigo si impegna a fornire un ambiente diversificato, inclusivo e privo di barriere, con un'organizzazione accessibile per dipendenti, clienti e altre parti che interagiscono con, o su necessità, Zurigo. Colpiamo a un lavoratore libero dalla discriminazione di tutte le forme, compresa la discriminazione in base alla disabilità fisica o mentale, o condizione medica. Se siete interessati a un'opportunità di lavoro, si prega di consigliare se avete bisogno di un alloggio, in modo da poter lavorare con voi per fornire un processo più accessibile.

Zurigo non accetta risultati non sollecitati da società di ricerca o agenzie di lavoro. Qualsiasi sommario non richiesto diventerà di proprietà di Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. Occasion

Looking for a caring, collaborative and values-driven workplace with inspiring colleagues and leaders? Do you have ambition and desire to be among the best and to thrive in the world's most influential insurance provider? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have experience in asset risk management services and are looking for a new challenge, we would be happy to meet you.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for an Assistant Vice-President, Senior Asset Risk Management Consultant, to provide risk assessment expertise and consulting services to support our asset-related high-risk accounts.

Reporting to the Deputy Vice-President, General Assets, you will act as both an account coordinator and a field representative for several accounts. You will work with underwriting partners to manage the risk quality of the Zurich asset portfolio, support client risk control programs, conduct on-site risk assessments, develop account analysis and coordinate follow-up meetings, while respecting Zurich's global technical standards and recognized codes.

This is a unique opportunity to develop your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice counts. The purpose of this posting is to fill an already vacant position.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence technology tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including initial examination and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the only basis for screening or selecting candidates. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified recruitment professionals.

Zurich applies a hybrid work model requiring a presence in person three days a week.

What You Will Do

• Assess the quality of complex risks, focusing on key and strategic assets as defined by Zurich Resilience Solutions standards.
• Evaluate potential losses according to Zurich and industry definitions.
• Support external clients by identifying, assessing and reducing risks related to their key/strategic assets and their overall accounts.
• Provide appropriate risk improvement recommendations, conduct loss investigations (including trend and root cause analysis) and implement risk improvement programs.
• Communicate effectively with risk engineers in the field; maintain relations with underwriting partners, brokers, sector consultants, professional organisations and licensing authorities.
• Develop and implement client service plans for coordinated accounts to support the effectiveness of field services.
• Ensure the consistency and quality of the services provided to the account, including assessments, risk improvement recommendations, reporting, and time and expenditure management.
• Explore new service opportunities, develop new services for customers, and identify cross-sales potential.
• Support the business growth of Zurich Resilience Solutions by providing leading-edge consulting and sales services, identifying opportunities and fostering strong customer relationships.
• Manage change within accounts by maintaining close contact with client management teams and business partners, including reviewing new projects and change plans.

Position qualifications – What You Bring

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree and at least 8 years of experience in property risk engineering
OR
• High school diploma or equivalent and at least 10 years of experience in property risk engineering
OR
• Zurich Certified Apprenticeship Program, including a college degree and at least 8 years of experience in property risk engineering
AND
• Experience with Microsoft Office
• Advanced knowledge of risks and controls in the industrial sector
• Work experience within a team

Assets:
• Bachelor of Engineering, Civil Engineering or Related Discipline
• Risk Management Designation (RMC)
• Experience in managing accounts as a risk management services consultant for medium-sized companies or large clients in insurance of related goods and programs
• Excellent communication skills and strong results-oriented consultation skills
• Excellent collaboration skills
• Mastery of spoken and written French
• Mastery of spoken and written English required to facilitate communication with internal and external stakeholders outside Quebec.

Our culture

• At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about diversity, inclusion, fairness and feeling of belonging (DIEB). We want you to be at work yourself and our employees to reflect the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives aim to create an environment where everyone feels welcome.
• We maintain a culture of collaboration where diversity of thought is valued. We value your ideas and strive to give our employees the tools they need to make an impact.
• We care about the well-being of our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits and health care plan with different levels of coverage tailored to your needs, as well as a competitive overall compensation program.
• We understand the importance of resting, reloading batteries and doing what we love. At Zurich, all employees benefit from a minimum of four weeks' vacation per year for this purpose.
• We also understand that employees sometimes need leave for personal reasons. You can have an appointment during a working day, a cultural or religious celebration to highlight or simply need time to focus on your mental health. Zurich employees have four personal days per year to use at their discretion.
• We are committed to continuous improvement and provide access to a wide range of training and development opportunities.
• We care about our communities. Our communities are the places where our clients, employees and shareholders live and work. Although we can be proud of Zurich's contribution to society through its core insurance activity, we must also give back to our communities through our talent, time and resources.
• We have won many awards for our work culture. We are proud to be one of the top employers in the Greater Toronto Area and to have received the 5-Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award from Insurance Business Canada.

Make a difference. Raise challenges. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work with us.

About us

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-branch insurer with approximately 55,000 global employees serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada is a major insurance provider that has served medium-sized and large companies, including multinationals, in the Canadian business insurance market for 100 years. With more than 650 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a major insurer, combined with a thorough knowledge of local business sectors and markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be the first choice for risk management professionals as a reference partner to help them meet the risks challenges of today and tomorrow. For more information, visit www.zurichcanada.com .

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich leads to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We welcome talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion brig us closer to our common goal: exeeding our customers Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on need of, Zurich. We strike to a worker free of discrimination of all forms, including discrimination on the basis of physical or mental disability, or medical condition. If you are interested in a job opportunity, please advise if you require an accommodation, so we can work with you to provide a more accessible process.
