jobs.title: Retail Claims Consultant
jobs.description:
A new transformational adventure awaits you…

How does 5 weeks of annual leave, a fulfilling career you'll genuinely enjoy, and working for a reputable organization that promotes wellbeing and drives digital transformation sound to you?

As one of Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ and Fortune’s ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ for 2025, Zurich - a leader in the insurance industry, is on a journey towards a brighter future… A brighter future for you - focused on your career, your wellbeing, and your community - as well as our customers and the planet.

Join us on this thrilling journey as we work towards our vision of becoming Australia's leading digital insurer. If you're eager to be part of a values-driven global organisation that's experiencing real growth and transformation, and if you share our commitment to making a tangible difference and taking continuous steps towards a sustainable future for our people, customers, communities, and our planet, then keep reading!

Let’s create a brighter future together, let’s make a difference

It’s important to know, what you do matters. At Zurich, we don’t just cover, we care.

In this role, you’ll play a key part in supporting customers during some of life’s most challenging moments. As a Claims Consultant within our Retail Life business, you will be responsible for assessing and managing a portfolio of Retail Income Protection claims, with fairness, empathy, and professionalism. Your work will contribute to timely, accurate decisions that help deliver certainty to customers when they need it most. You will also have the opportunity to expand your skills in other areas of Life Insurance claims such as TPD, Trauma, and Terminal Illness.

You will also be responsible for the following:

- Manage the end-to-end claims process with a proactive and customer-focused approach.

- Analyse medical, financial, and policy information to make fair and timely claim decisions.

- Communicate clearly with customers and stakeholders to keep them informed throughout the process.

- Build positive relationships with internal teams and external providers to support better claim outcomes.

- Prepare accurate documentation and maintain high-quality file management.

- Identify opportunities to improve claims processes and support continuous enhancement.

- Uplift the capabilities of our claims administrators by developing their knowledge and skills across the claims management process.

Important to your success - let's grow together

You’re someone who brings empathy, sound judgment, and a calm, organised approach to complex situations. You collaborate with care, communicate with clarity, and understand the importance of delivering a genuine human experience to every customer and stakeholder.

In order to be successful, you will have the following:

- Experience with end-to-end assessment of retail income protection claims. A background in workers’ compensation or injury management also relevant.

- Understanding of life insurance policies, products, and regulatory requirements.

- Ability to interpret medical, legal, and financial information to support decision-making.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills across diverse audiences.

- Proven ability to manage competing priorities and maintain accuracy under pressure.

- Proficiency with claims systems, documentation processes, and digital tools.

- A commitment to continuous improvement.

Belong. Zurich is here to support you

There are so many reasons why Zurich is a great place to be and the right choice for you, but here are just a few.

- Enjoy 5 weeks of annual leave for permanent staff through our Z leave initiative, along with 15 days of personal/carer’s leave as we empower our people to manage their own wellbeing. Plus, access to Family Care (parental leave).

- Benefit from a hybrid working arrangement – 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home per week for full-time employees.

- Access programs to stay healthy and feel healthier, receive an AUD$500 wellbeing payment per year, and a AUD$295 new starter e-voucher for your work-from-home setup (flex work - hybrid working), along with other great benefits through our Shine portal.

- Grow and thrive in your career with our award-winning training programs. We support and encourage your development because our strength lies in our people, and we value your individuality.

- Work with global, diverse, and inclusive teams; explore your passions, fuel innovation, drive equity, collaborate, and make a positive difference beyond your role.

- Take advantage of global mobility opportunities across more than 200 countries worldwide.

- Volunteer and work in our state-of-the-art Green Star rated offices (when you are in the office) and dress for your day.

- We plant a tree for every new employee.

- Not to mention our various employer of choice awards/memberships – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity… to name a few.

We could go on, but the main point is that Zurich is a great place to be, where you can truly belong, be yourself, maintain work/life balance, and thrive in a supportive environment.

Zurich is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require any special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to please let us know at the time of your application.

So, if you want to come on an adventure that will build a brighter future together, and feel a sense of togetherness, then please apply today to start your adventure!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una nuova avventura trasformazionale vi aspetta...

Come fa 5 settimane di congedo annuale, una carriera appagante ti piacerà davvero, e lavorare per un'organizzazione rispettabile che promuove il benessere e guida il suono di trasformazione digitale a te?

Come uno dei Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ e ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ di Fortune per il 2025, Zurigo - leader nel settore assicurativo, è in un viaggio verso un futuro più luminoso... Un futuro più luminoso per voi - focalizzato sulla vostra carriera, il vostro benessere, e la vostra comunità - così come i nostri clienti e il pianeta.

Unisciti a noi in questo viaggio emozionante mentre lavoriamo verso la nostra visione di diventare l'insurretore digitale leader dell'Australia. Se siete desiderosi di far parte di un'organizzazione globale orientata ai valori che sta vivendo una reale crescita e trasformazione, e se condividete il nostro impegno a fare una differenza tangibile e a compiere passi continui verso un futuro sostenibile per la nostra gente, clienti, comunità e il nostro pianeta, continuate a leggere!

Creiamo un futuro più luminoso insieme, facciamo la differenza

E 'importante sapere, quello che fai è importante. A Zurigo, non basta coprire, ci interessa.

In questo ruolo, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel supportare i clienti durante alcuni dei momenti più impegnativi della vita. In qualità di consulente legale all'interno del nostro business di vita al dettaglio, sarete responsabili di valutare e gestire un portafoglio di reclami di protezione dei redditi al dettaglio, con correttezza, empatia e professionalità. Il vostro lavoro contribuirà a decisioni tempestive e accurate che aiutano a garantire ai clienti quando ne hanno più bisogno. Avrete anche la possibilità di espandere le vostre competenze in altre aree di Life Insurance rivendicazioni come TPD, Trauma e Terminal Illness.

Sarete anche responsabili per quanto segue:

- Gestire il processo di reclamo end-to-end con un approccio proattivo e focalizzato sul cliente.

- Analizzare le informazioni mediche, finanziarie e politiche per prendere decisioni giuste e tempestive.

- Comunicare con chiarezza con i clienti e gli stakeholder per tenerli informati durante il processo.

- Costruire relazioni positive con i team interni e i fornitori esterni per sostenere i risultati di reclamo migliori.

- Preparare la documentazione accurata e mantenere la gestione dei file di alta qualità.

- Identificare le opportunità per migliorare i processi di reclamo e sostenere il miglioramento continuo.

- Elevare le capacità dei nostri amministratori crediti sviluppando le loro conoscenze e competenze attraverso il processo di gestione dei crediti.

Importante per il vostro successo - cresciamo insieme

Sei qualcuno che porta empatia, giudizio sonoro, e un approccio calmo e organizzato a situazioni complesse. Collaborate con cura, comunicate con chiarezza e comprendete l'importanza di offrire un'esperienza umana genuina ad ogni cliente e stakeholder.

Per avere successo, avrai le seguenti:

- Esperienza con la valutazione end-to-end dei crediti di protezione del reddito al dettaglio. Un background nella compensazione dei lavoratori o nella gestione delle lesioni anche rilevante.

- Comprensione delle politiche di assicurazione sulla vita, dei prodotti e dei requisiti normativi.

- Capacità di interpretare informazioni mediche, legali e finanziarie per sostenere il processo decisionale.

- Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale attraverso il pubblico vario.

- Prove capacità di gestire le priorità concorrenti e mantenere l'accuratezza sotto pressione.

- Competenza con sistemi di reclamo, processi di documentazione e strumenti digitali.

- Impegno al miglioramento continuo.

Addio. Zurigo è qui per sostenervi

Ci sono così tante ragioni per cui Zurigo è un ottimo posto per essere e la scelta giusta per voi, ma qui ci sono solo alcuni.

- Approfitta di 5 settimane di congedo annuale per il personale permanente attraverso la nostra iniziativa di congedo Z, insieme a 15 giorni di congedo personale/carer, in modo da consentire al nostro popolo di gestire il proprio benessere. Inoltre, l'accesso a Family Care (partita genitoriale).

- Approfitta di un accordo di lavoro ibrido – 3 giorni in ufficio e 2 giorni di lavoro da casa a settimana per i dipendenti a tempo pieno.

- Programmi di accesso per rimanere sano e sentirsi più sano, ricevere un pagamento di benessere AUD$500 all'anno, e un nuovo e-voucher AUD$295 per il vostro lavoro-da-home setup (lavoro flessibile - lavoro ibrido), insieme ad altri grandi benefici attraverso il nostro portale Shine.

- Crescere e prosperare nella tua carriera con i nostri programmi di formazione pluripremiati. Sosteniamo e incoraggiamo il vostro sviluppo perché la nostra forza è nella nostra gente, e apprezziamo la vostra individualità.

- Lavorare con team globali, diversi e inclusivi; esplorare le vostre passioni, innovazione del carburante, guidare l'equità, collaborare e fare una differenza positiva oltre il vostro ruolo.

- Approfitta delle opportunità di mobilità globale in oltre 200 paesi in tutto il mondo.

- Volontariato e lavoro nei nostri uffici di valutazione Green Star all'avanguardia (quando sei in ufficio) e vestire per la tua giornata.

- Pianifichiamo un albero per ogni nuovo dipendente.

- Per non parlare dei nostri vari datori di lavoro di premi di scelta / assegnazioni – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity... per citarne alcuni.

Potremmo andare avanti, ma il punto principale è che Zurigo è un ottimo posto per essere, dove si può veramente appartenere, essere te stesso, mantenere l'equilibrio lavoro / vita, e prosperare in un ambiente di supporto.

Zurigo è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a garantire che il nostro processo di reclutamento sia equo e accessibile a tutti i candidati. Se avete bisogno di alloggi speciali per partecipare al nostro processo di reclutamento, vi invitiamo a farci sapere al momento della vostra applicazione.

Quindi, se si vuole venire in un'avventura che costruirà un futuro più luminoso insieme, e sentire un senso di insieme, allora si prega di applicare oggi per iniziare la vostra avventura!

Ein neues transformatives Abenteuer erwartet Sie...

Wie klingen 5 Wochen Jahresurlaub, eine erfüllende Karriere, die Sie wirklich genießen werden, und die Arbeit für eine seriöse Organisation, die das Wohlbefinden fördert und die digitale Transformation vorantreibt?

Als eines der Forbes 2024 "World's Best Employers" und Fortune's "World's Most Admired Companies" für 2025 ist Zurich - ein führendes Unternehmen der Versicherungsbranche - auf dem Weg in eine bessere Zukunft. Eine bessere Zukunft für Sie - konzentriert auf Ihre Karriere, Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Gemeinschaft - sowie unsere Kunden und den Planeten.

Begleiten Sie uns auf dieser aufregenden Reise, während wir auf unsere Vision hinarbeiten, Australiens führender digitaler Versicherer zu werden. Wenn Sie Teil einer werteorientierten globalen Organisation sein möchten, die echtes Wachstum und Transformation erlebt, und wenn Sie unser Engagement teilen, einen spürbaren Unterschied zu machen und kontinuierliche Schritte in Richtung einer nachhaltigen Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeiter, Kunden, Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten zu unternehmen, dann lesen Sie weiter!

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schaffen, lasst uns einen Unterschied machen

Es ist wichtig zu wissen, was du tust. Bei Zürich decken wir nicht nur ab, wir kümmern uns.

In dieser Rolle spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Unterstützung von Kunden in einigen der herausforderndsten Momente des Lebens. Als Claims Consultant in unserem Retail Life-Geschäft sind Sie für die Bewertung und Verwaltung eines Portfolios von Retail Income Protection-Ansprüchen mit Fairness, Empathie und Professionalität verantwortlich. Ihre Arbeit wird zu zeitnahen, genauen Entscheidungen beitragen, die den Kunden Sicherheit bieten, wenn sie sie am dringendsten benötigen. Sie haben auch die Möglichkeit, Ihre Fähigkeiten in anderen Bereichen der Lebensversicherung wie TPD, Trauma und Terminal-Krankheit zu erweitern.

Sie sind auch für Folgendes verantwortlich:

- Verwalten Sie den End-to-End-Claim-Prozess mit einem proaktiven und kundenorientierten Ansatz.

- Analysieren Sie medizinische, finanzielle und politische Informationen, um faire und rechtzeitige Anspruchsentscheidungen zu treffen.

- Kommunizieren Sie klar mit Kunden und Stakeholdern, um sie während des gesamten Prozesses zu informieren.

- Bauen Sie positive Beziehungen zu internen Teams und externen Anbietern auf, um bessere Claim-Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

- Erstellen Sie eine genaue Dokumentation und pflegen Sie eine qualitativ hochwertige Dateiverwaltung.

- Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Schadenprozesse und unterstützen Sie die kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

- Erhöhen Sie die Fähigkeiten unserer Schadenverwalter, indem Sie ihre Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten im gesamten Schadenmanagementprozess weiterentwickeln.

Wichtig für Ihren Erfolg - wachsen wir zusammen

Du bist jemand, der Empathie, gesundes Urteilsvermögen und eine ruhige, organisierte Herangehensweise an komplexe Situationen mitbringt. Sie arbeiten mit Sorgfalt zusammen, kommunizieren mit Klarheit und verstehen, wie wichtig es ist, jedem Kunden und Stakeholder eine echte menschliche Erfahrung zu bieten.

Um erfolgreich zu sein, haben Sie Folgendes:

- Erfahrung mit der End-to-End-Bewertung von Einkommensschutzforderungen für Privatkunden. Ein Hintergrund in der Arbeitnehmer Entschädigung oder Verletzungsmanagement auch relevant.

- Verständnis von Lebensversicherungen, Produkten und regulatorischen Anforderungen.

- Fähigkeit, medizinische, rechtliche und finanzielle Informationen zu interpretieren, um die Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen.

- Starke schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten über verschiedene Zielgruppen hinweg.

- Bewährte Fähigkeit, konkurrierende Prioritäten zu verwalten und Genauigkeit unter Druck zu halten.

- Kenntnisse in Anspruchssystemen, Dokumentationsprozessen und digitalen Tools.

- Eine Verpflichtung zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

gehört dazu. Zürich ist da, um Sie zu unterstützen

Es gibt so viele Gründe, warum Zürich ein großartiger Ort ist und die richtige Wahl für Sie, aber hier sind nur einige.

- Genießen Sie 5 Wochen Jahresurlaub für ständige Mitarbeiter durch unsere Z-Urlaubsinitiative, zusammen mit 15 Tagen persönlichen / Pflegeurlaub, während wir unsere Mitarbeiter befähigen, ihr eigenes Wohlbefinden zu verwalten. Plus, Zugang zur Familienbetreuung (Elternurlaub).

- Profitieren Sie von einer hybriden Arbeitsvereinbarung - 3 Tage im Büro und 2 Tage Arbeit von zu Hause pro Woche für Vollzeitmitarbeiter.

- Zugang zu Programmen, um gesund zu bleiben und sich gesünder zu fühlen, erhalten eine AUD $ 500 Wohlbefindenszahlung pro Jahr und einen AUD $ 295 neuen Starter-E-Gutschein für Ihr Work-from-Home-Setup (Flex-Arbeit - Hybrid-Arbeit), zusammen mit anderen großen Vorteilen durch unser Shine-Portal.

- Wachsen und gedeihen Sie in Ihrer Karriere mit unseren preisgekrönten Trainingsprogrammen. Wir unterstützen und fördern Ihre Entwicklung, weil unsere Stärke in unseren Mitarbeitern liegt und wir Ihre Individualität schätzen.

- Arbeiten Sie mit globalen, vielfältigen und integrativen Teams zusammen; entdecken Sie Ihre Leidenschaften, fördern Sie Innovationen, fördern Sie Gerechtigkeit, arbeiten Sie zusammen und machen Sie einen positiven Unterschied über Ihre Rolle hinaus.

- Nutzen Sie globale Mobilitätsmöglichkeiten in mehr als 200 Ländern weltweit.

- Freiwillige und arbeiten Sie in unseren hochmodernen Green Star Büros (wenn Sie im Büro sind) und kleiden Sie sich für Ihren Tag.

- Wir pflanzen einen Baum für jeden neuen Mitarbeiter.

- Ganz zu schweigen von unseren verschiedenen Arbeitgeberpreisen / Mitgliedschaften - WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Arbeitgeber, Stolz auf Vielfalt ... um nur einige zu nennen.

Wir könnten weitermachen, aber der Hauptpunkt ist, dass Zürich ein großartiger Ort ist, an dem Sie wirklich dazugehören, Sie selbst sein, die Work-Life-Balance aufrechterhalten und in einer unterstützenden Umgebung gedeihen können.

Zürich ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, dass unser Rekrutierungsprozess fair und für alle Kandidaten zugänglich ist. Wenn Sie spezielle Unterkünfte benötigen, um an unserem Rekrutierungsprozess teilzunehmen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, uns dies zum Zeitpunkt Ihrer Bewerbung mitzuteilen.

Wenn Sie also auf ein Abenteuer kommen möchten, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft aufbauen und ein Gefühl der Zusammengehörigkeit spüren wird, dann bewerben Sie sich bitte noch heute, um Ihr Abenteuer zu beginnen!

jobs.title: Line of Business Head, Engineering
jobs.description:
Purpose

To manage and lead the assigned Engineering underwriting line of business for Singapore. The role is responsible for developing and executing underwriting strategy, delivering profitable portfolio performance, acting as a senior referral point for complex underwriting decisions, and building strong broker, customer, and internal stakeholder relationships.

Key Accountabilities

Underwriting Management

- Manage the selection, denial, acceptance, and renewal of Engineering business in line with underwriting appetite and delegated authority.

- Underwrite and analyze new and renewal business within delegated authority levels.

- Act as a senior referral point for underwriting decisions requiring empowerment at this level.

- Demonstrate specialized and advanced technical knowledge in Engineering insurance.

- Administer and monitor underwriting rules, guidelines, insurance laws and regulations, and rating manual rules.

- Ensure consistency and adherence to underwriting standards across the Engineering portfolio.

Portfolio Strategy and Performance

- Lead the development of the underwriting strategy for the Engineering line of business and oversee execution to deliver required portfolio performance.

- Identify opportunities and risks using data, market insights, distribution dynamics, and portfolio analysis.

- Recommend and implement action plans after reviewing agency books of business, profit/growth results, and emerging trends.

- Establish and agree key performance targets and financial budgets to optimize business performance in line with agreed objectives.

- Review themes from complex analysis conducted by others and make informed, authoritative technical recommendations to improve business performance in the medium and longer term.

- Contribute to the business strategy within own area, aligning Engineering underwriting strategy with wider business goals.

Governance, Risk and Process Improvement

- Educate and influence senior colleagues on relevant policies and governance processes to ensure the business is not exposed to undue risk.

- Develop processes and review policies relevant to Engineering underwriting to ensure alignment with strategic business objectives.

- Assure the development and implementation of policies, procedures, and standards to produce profitable underwriting results.

- Lead the implementation of complex projects, typically as part of major change or business improvement initiatives involving multidisciplinary teams and timescales in excess of one year that impact underwriting.

- Improve underwriting processes and efficiency for the Engineering line of business.

- Oversee the design and implementation of rating tools and methodologies that deliver value to customers while remaining commercially viable for the organization.

Distribution, Customer and Stakeholder Management

- Develop and maintain distribution relationships in support of business retention and acquisition.

- Work with customers, agents, and brokers where appropriate to determine insurance-related needs and provide solutions.

- Support the organization’s sales culture by acting as a help point for agents, brokers, and customers.

- Manage relationships with key internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for service improvement, commercial viability, and customer satisfaction.

- Participate in leadership team meetings of the assigned area to provide specialist guidance and enable the implementation of policy, projects, and change initiatives.

- Participate in global or regional underwriting proposition communities to share best practice and continue meeting customer needs.

People Leadership and Capability Development

- Lead, manage, and develop underwriters within the assigned Engineering line of business.

- Oversee development plans for underwriters across the area of business to ensure the capability exists to drive business results.

- Build underwriting talent and ensure the organization remains sustainable and fit for the future.

- Demonstrate excellent managerial, team-building, and organizational skills.

Business Accountabilities

- Establish key performance targets and financial budgets for the Engineering portfolio.

- Drive underwriting performance in line with profitability, growth, retention, and risk appetite objectives.

- Lead underwriting-related transformation or improvement initiatives across multidisciplinary teams.

- Provide technical/professional recommendations based on insights, trends, and portfolio analysis.

- Align underwriting policies, processes, ratings, and governance with strategic business objectives.

- Develop propositions and underwriting capabilities that meet evolving customer and market needs.

- Ensure underwriting tools, pricing methodologies, and governance frameworks support commercial viability.

Required Experience and Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification.

- Minimum 10 years of experience in underwriting, insurance, or a related field.

- Strong technical expertise in Engineering insurance underwriting .

- Extensive management experience, ideally leading underwriting teams or portfolios.

- Proven experience managing portfolio performance, underwriting strategy, distribution relationships, and governance.

- Experience working with brokers, agents, customers, and senior internal stakeholders.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggetto

Per gestire e guidare la linea di attività di sottoscrizione di Engineering assegnata per Singapore. Il ruolo è responsabile per lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione della strategia di sottoscrizione, offrendo prestazioni di portafoglio redditizie, agendo come punto di riferimento senior per decisioni di sottoscrizione complesse, e la costruzione di forti rapporti di broker, cliente e stakeholder interni.

Capacità di contabilità chiave

Gestione della sottoscrizione

- Gestire la selezione, la negazione, l'accettazione e il rinnovo del business Engineering in linea con la sottoscrizione dell'appetito e dell'autorità delegata.

- Sottoscrivi e analizza nuovi e rinnova il business all'interno dei livelli di autorità delegati.

- Agire come punto di riferimento senior per sottoscrivere le decisioni che richiedono l'empowerment a questo livello.

- Dimostrare conoscenze tecniche specializzate e avanzate nell'assicurazione Ingegneria.

- Amministrare e monitorare le regole di sottoscrizione, le linee guida, le leggi di assicurazione e i regolamenti, e le regole manuali di valutazione.

- Assicurare coerenza e aderenza agli standard di scrittura in tutto il portafoglio Engineering.

Portfolio Strategia e Prestazioni

- Condurre lo sviluppo della strategia di sottoscrizione per la linea di business Engineering e supervisionare l'esecuzione per fornire le prestazioni del portafoglio richieste.

- Identificare opportunità e rischi utilizzando dati, intuizioni di mercato, dinamiche di distribuzione e analisi del portafoglio.

- Raccomandare e implementare piani d'azione dopo aver esaminato i libri di agenzia di affari, risultati di profitto / crescita e tendenze emergenti.

- Stabilire e concordare obiettivi di performance chiave e budget finanziari per ottimizzare le prestazioni aziendali in linea con gli obiettivi concordati.

- Rivedere i temi di complessa analisi condotta da altri e fare raccomandazioni tecniche informate e autorevoli per migliorare le prestazioni aziendali a medio e lungo termine.

- Contribuisci alla strategia aziendale all'interno della propria area, allineando la strategia di scrittura di ingegneria con obiettivi aziendali più ampi.

Governance, Rischio e Miglioramento del Processo

- Educare e influenzare i colleghi senior sulle politiche e processi di governance rilevanti per garantire che l'azienda non sia esposta a rischi indebiti.

- Sviluppare processi e rivedere politiche rilevanti per la sottoscrizione di Ingegneria per garantire l'allineamento con gli obiettivi strategici aziendali.

- Assicurare lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di politiche, procedure e standard per produrre risultati di scrittura redditizia.

- Guidare l'implementazione di progetti complessi, in genere come parte di importanti cambiamenti o iniziative di miglioramento di business che coinvolgono team e scadenze multidisciplinari in oltre un anno che impatto sottoscrittura.

- Migliorare i processi di sottoscrizione e l'efficienza per la linea di business Engineering.

- Superare la progettazione e l'implementazione di strumenti di valutazione e metodologie che forniscono valore ai clienti pur rimanendo commercialmente fattibile per l'organizzazione.

Gestione della distribuzione, del cliente e degli stakeholder

- Sviluppare e mantenere relazioni di distribuzione a sostegno della ritenzione aziendale e acquisizione.

- Lavorare con clienti, agenti e broker, se del caso per determinare le esigenze relative all'assicurazione e fornire soluzioni.

- Sostenere la cultura di vendita dell'organizzazione agendo come punto di aiuto per agenti, broker e clienti.

- Gestisci i rapporti con le principali parti interessate interne per identificare le opportunità di miglioramento del servizio, la redditività commerciale e la soddisfazione del cliente.

- Partecipa alle riunioni del team di leadership dell'area assegnata per fornire una guida specialistica e consentire l'attuazione di politiche, progetti e iniziative di cambiamento.

- Partecipare a comunità di proposizione di sottoscrizione globale o regionale per condividere le migliori pratiche e continuare a soddisfare le esigenze dei clienti.

Leadership e sviluppo della capacità

- Guidare, gestire e sviluppare sottoscrittori all'interno della linea di business di Engineering assegnata.

- Superare i piani di sviluppo per i sottoscrittori in tutta la zona di business per garantire la capacità esiste per guidare i risultati aziendali.

- Costruire talento di sottoscrizione e garantire l'organizzazione rimane sostenibile e adatto per il futuro.

- Dimostrare eccellenti capacità manageriali, team-building e organizzative.

Capacità di contabilità aziendale

- Stabilire obiettivi di performance chiave e budget finanziari per il portafoglio Engineering.

- Guidare le prestazioni di sottoscrizione in linea con gli obiettivi di redditività, crescita, ritenzione e rischio appetito.

- Condurre iniziative di trasformazione o miglioramento legate alla sottoscrittura in team multidisciplinari.

- Fornire raccomandazioni tecniche/professionali basate su approfondimenti, tendenze e analisi del portafoglio.

- Allineare le politiche di sottoscrizione, i processi, le valutazioni e la governance con gli obiettivi strategici aziendali.

- Sviluppare proposizioni e competenze di sottoscrizione che soddisfano le esigenze del cliente e del mercato in evoluzione.

- Assicurare strumenti di sottoscrizione, metodologie di prezzi e framework di governance supportano la fattibilità commerciale.

Esperienza e qualifiche richieste

- Laurea o qualifica equivalente.

- Minimo 10 anni di esperienza nella sottoscrizione, assicurazione, o un campo correlato.

- Forte competenza tecnica in Ingegneria assicurazione sottoscrizione .

- Esperienza di gestione estesa, team di sottoscrittura o portfolio leader idealmente.

- Esperienza comprovata che gestisce le prestazioni del portafoglio, sottoscrive strategia, relazioni di distribuzione e governance.

- Esperienza di lavoro con broker, agenti, clienti e stakeholder interni senior.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Zweck

Management und Leitung des zugewiesenen Engineering Underwriting-Geschäftsbereichs für Singapur. Die Rolle ist dafür verantwortlich, eine Underwriting-Strategie zu entwickeln und auszuführen, eine profitable Portfolio-Performance zu liefern, als Senior Referral Point für komplexe Underwriting-Entscheidungen zu fungieren und starke Broker-, Kunden- und interne Stakeholder-Beziehungen aufzubauen.

Hauptbuchhaltung

Zeichnungsmanagement

- Verwalten Sie die Auswahl, Ablehnung, Akzeptanz und Erneuerung des Engineering-Geschäfts im Einklang mit Underwriting-Appetit und delegierter Autorität.

- Unterschreiben und analysieren Sie Neu- und Erneuerungsgeschäfte auf Ebene der delegierten Behörden.

- Handeln Sie als hochrangige Referenzstelle für Zeichnungsentscheidungen, die eine Ermächtigung auf dieser Ebene erfordern.

- Demonstrieren Sie spezialisierte und fortgeschrittene technische Kenntnisse in Engineering Insurance.

- Verwalten und überwachen Sie Underwriting-Regeln, Richtlinien, Versicherungsgesetze und -vorschriften sowie Rating-Handbuchregeln.

- Gewährleistung der Konsistenz und Einhaltung der Zeichnungsstandards im gesamten Engineering-Portfolio.

Portfoliostrategie und Performance

- Führen Sie die Entwicklung der Underwriting-Strategie für die Engineering-Branche und beaufsichtigen Sie die Ausführung, um die erforderliche Portfolio-Performance zu liefern.

- Identifizieren Sie Chancen und Risiken mithilfe von Daten, Marktinformationen, Verteilungsdynamik und Portfolioanalyse.

- Empfehlung und Umsetzung von Aktionsplänen nach Überprüfung der Geschäftsbücher der Agentur, der Gewinn- / Wachstumsergebnisse und der aufkommenden Trends.

- Festlegung und Vereinbarung wesentlicher Leistungsziele und Finanzbudgets zur Optimierung der Geschäftsleistung im Einklang mit den vereinbarten Zielen.

- Überprüfen Sie Themen aus komplexen Analysen, die von anderen durchgeführt werden, und geben Sie fundierte, verbindliche technische Empfehlungen, um die Geschäftsleistung mittel- und langfristig zu verbessern.

- Tragen Sie zur Geschäftsstrategie im eigenen Bereich bei und richten Sie die Engineering Underwriting-Strategie auf breitere Geschäftsziele aus.

Governance, Risiko- und Prozessverbesserung

- Informieren und beeinflussen Sie ältere Kollegen über relevante Richtlinien und Governance-Prozesse, um sicherzustellen, dass das Unternehmen keinem unangemessenen Risiko ausgesetzt ist.

- Entwicklung von Prozessen und Überprüfungsrichtlinien, die für das Engineering Underwriting relevant sind, um die Ausrichtung auf strategische Geschäftsziele sicherzustellen.

- Sicherstellen der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Richtlinien, Verfahren und Standards, um profitable Underwriting-Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

- Führen Sie die Umsetzung komplexer Projekte, in der Regel als Teil großer Veränderungs- oder Geschäftsverbesserungsinitiativen mit multidisziplinären Teams und Zeitskalen von mehr als einem Jahr, die sich auf das Underwriting auswirken.

- Verbessern Sie die Underwriting-Prozesse und die Effizienz für die Engineering-Branche.

- Beaufsichtigen Sie die Gestaltung und Implementierung von Rating-Tools und -Methoden, die den Kunden einen Mehrwert bieten und gleichzeitig für das Unternehmen wirtschaftlich rentabel bleiben.

Vertrieb, Kunden- und Stakeholdermanagement

- Aufbau und Pflege von Vertriebsbeziehungen zur Unterstützung der Unternehmensbindung und -akquisition.

- Arbeiten Sie gegebenenfalls mit Kunden, Agenten und Brokern zusammen, um versicherungsbezogene Bedürfnisse zu ermitteln und Lösungen anzubieten.

- Unterstützen Sie die Verkaufskultur des Unternehmens, indem Sie als Hilfestellung für Agenten, Broker und Kunden fungieren.

- Verwalten Sie die Beziehungen zu wichtigen internen Stakeholdern, um Möglichkeiten für Serviceverbesserungen, kommerzielle Rentabilität und Kundenzufriedenheit zu identifizieren.

- Nehmen Sie an Sitzungen des Führungsteams des zugewiesenen Bereichs teil, um eine fachliche Beratung zu bieten und die Umsetzung von Politik, Projekten und Veränderungsinitiativen zu ermöglichen.

- Nehmen Sie an globalen oder regionalen Underwriting-Propositions-Communities teil, um Best Practices auszutauschen und die Kundenbedürfnisse weiterhin zu erfüllen.

People Leadership und Capability Development

- Führen, verwalten und entwickeln Sie Underwriter innerhalb des zugewiesenen Engineering-Geschäftsbereichs.

- Beaufsichtigen Sie Entwicklungspläne für Underwriter im gesamten Geschäftsbereich, um sicherzustellen, dass die Fähigkeit besteht, Geschäftsergebnisse zu erzielen.

- Bauen Sie Underwriting-Talente auf und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Unternehmen nachhaltig und fit für die Zukunft bleibt.

- Demonstrieren Sie hervorragende Management-, Teambuilding- und Organisationsfähigkeiten.

Unternehmensbuchhaltung

- Festlegung wesentlicher Leistungsziele und Finanzbudgets für das Engineering-Portfolio.

- Steigern Sie die Underwriting-Performance im Einklang mit den Zielen Rentabilität, Wachstum, Bindung und Risikobereitschaft.

- Führen Sie versicherungsbezogene Transformations- oder Verbesserungsinitiativen in multidisziplinären Teams.

- Geben Sie technische / professionelle Empfehlungen basierend auf Erkenntnissen, Trends und Portfolioanalyse.

- Ausrichtung von Underwriting-Richtlinien, -Prozessen, Ratings und Governance auf strategische Geschäftsziele.

- Entwicklung von Angeboten und Underwriting-Fähigkeiten, die den sich ändernden Kunden- und Marktbedürfnissen entsprechen.

- Sicherstellen, dass Underwriting-Tools, Preisgestaltungsmethoden und Governance-Rahmenbedingungen die kommerzielle Lebensfähigkeit unterstützen.

Erforderliche Erfahrung und Qualifikationen

- Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation.

- Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in Underwriting, Versicherung oder einem verwandten Bereich.

- Starke technische Expertise im Engineering Insurance Underwriting .

- Umfangreiche Managementerfahrung, idealerweise Führung von Underwriting-Teams oder Portfolios.

- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Management der Portfolio-Performance, der Underwriting-Strategie, der Vertriebsbeziehungen und der Governance.

- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Brokern, Agenten, Kunden und leitenden internen Stakeholdern.

Principales responsabilités

- Gérer la sélection, le refus, l'acceptation et le renouvellement des activités d'ingénierie conformément à l'appétit de souscription et aux pouvoirs délégués.

- Inscrire et analyser les activités nouvelles et les activités de renouvellement dans les limites des pouvoirs délégués.

- Agissez en tant que point de référence principal pour les décisions de souscription exigeant l'habilitation à ce niveau.

- Démontrer des connaissances techniques spécialisées et avancées en assurance-ingénierie.

- Administrer et surveiller les règles de souscription, les lignes directrices, les lois et règlements d'assurance et les règles du manuel de cotation.

- Assurer la cohérence et le respect des normes de souscription dans l'ensemble du portefeuille d'ingénierie.

Stratégie et rendement du portefeuille

- Diriger l'élaboration de la stratégie de souscription pour le secteur d'activité du génie et superviser l'exécution afin d'assurer le rendement du portefeuille requis.

- Identifier les possibilités et les risques à l'aide de données, de perspectives de marché, de dynamiques de distribution et d'analyses de portefeuille.

- Recommander et mettre en oeuvre des plans d'action après avoir examiné les carnets d'activités des agences, les résultats des profits et de la croissance et les tendances émergentes.

- Établir et convenir des principaux objectifs de rendement et des budgets financiers pour optimiser le rendement opérationnel conformément aux objectifs convenus.

- Examiner les thèmes de l'analyse complexe menée par d'autres et formuler des recommandations techniques éclairées et faisant autorité afin d'améliorer la performance des entreprises à moyen et à long terme.

- Contribuer à la stratégie opérationnelle dans son propre secteur, en alignant la stratégie de souscription de l'ingénierie avec des objectifs commerciaux plus larges.

Gouvernance, risques et amélioration des processus

- Éduquer et influencer les collègues supérieurs sur les politiques et les processus de gouvernance pertinents pour s'assurer que l'entreprise n'est pas exposée à un risque indu.

- Élaborer des processus et examiner les politiques pertinentes pour la souscription en génie afin d'assurer l'harmonisation avec les objectifs opérationnels stratégiques.

- Assurer l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de politiques, de procédures et de normes pour produire des résultats de souscription rentables.

- Diriger la mise en œuvre de projets complexes, généralement dans le cadre d'initiatives de changement ou d'amélioration des activités impliquant des équipes multidisciplinaires et des échéances supérieures à un an qui ont une incidence sur la souscription.

- Améliorer les processus de souscription et l'efficacité pour le secteur d'activité Ingénierie.

- Superviser la conception et la mise en oeuvre d'outils et de méthodologies de notation qui offrent de la valeur aux clients tout en demeurant commercialement viable pour l'organisation.

Distribution, gestion des clients et des intervenants

- Établir et maintenir des relations de distribution à l'appui de la rétention et de l'acquisition d'entreprises.

- Travailler avec les clients, les agents et les courtiers, le cas échéant, pour déterminer les besoins liés à l'assurance et fournir des solutions.

- Soutenir la culture de vente de l'organisation en agissant comme point d'aide pour les agents, les courtiers et les clients.

- Gérer les relations avec les principaux intervenants internes afin de cerner les possibilités d'amélioration du service, de viabilité commerciale et de satisfaction de la clientèle.

- Participer aux réunions de l'équipe de direction du secteur désigné pour fournir des conseils spécialisés et permettre la mise en oeuvre des politiques, des projets et des initiatives de changement.

- Participer aux communautés de propositions de souscription mondiale ou régionale pour partager les meilleures pratiques et continuer à répondre aux besoins des clients.

Leadership des gens et développement des capacités

- Diriger, gérer et développer des sous-traitants dans le secteur d'activité du génie.

- Superviser les plans de développement des assureurs dans l'ensemble du secteur d'activité pour s'assurer qu'il existe une capacité de produire des résultats commerciaux.

- Bâtir des talents de souscription et veiller à ce que l'organisation demeure durable et apte à l'avenir.

- Démontrer d'excellentes compétences en gestion, en team-building et en organisation.

Responsabilités des entreprises

- Établir des objectifs de rendement et des budgets financiers clés pour le portefeuille du génie.

- Conduire la performance de souscription en fonction des objectifs de rentabilité, de croissance, de rétention et d'appétit pour les risques.

- Diriger les initiatives de transformation ou d'amélioration liées à la souscription dans les équipes multidisciplinaires.

- Fournir des recommandations techniques et professionnelles fondées sur des idées, des tendances et une analyse de portefeuille.

- Harmoniser les politiques, les processus, les cotes et la gouvernance en matière de souscription avec les objectifs opérationnels stratégiques.

- Élaborer des propositions et des capacités de souscription qui répondent aux besoins changeants des clients et du marché.

- Assurer la viabilité commerciale des outils de souscription, des méthodes de tarification et des cadres de gouvernance.

Expérience et qualifications requises

- Licence ou diplôme équivalent.

- Au moins 10 ans d'expérience en souscription, en assurance ou dans un domaine connexe.

- Forte expertise technique en assurance d'ingénierie .

- Une vaste expérience de gestion, idéalement des équipes de souscription ou des portefeuilles.

- Expérience éprouvée en gestion du rendement du portefeuille, stratégie de souscription, relations de distribution et gouvernance.

- Expérience de travail avec les courtiers, les agents, les clients et les principaux intervenants internes.

jobs.description:
Bist du bereit, mit dem Besten zu rechnen ?

Bei Zurich leben wir Versicherung neu. Um die Wünsche unserer Kunden noch besser zu erfüllen, gehen wir neue Wege, denken kreativ, arbeiten agil. Unsere Unternehmenskultur schenkt dir in jeder Hinsicht mehr Flexibilität – und viel Freiraum, dich optimal zu entfalten. Think big – und gerne auch international! Denn deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten kennen bei uns keine Grenzen. Bereit, die Zukunft in die Hand zu nehmen?

Das erwartet dich

- Am Standort Köln begleitest du unsere Führungskräfte und Mitarbeitenden bei Transformationsprojekten im Business mit Hilfe bedarfsgerechter Change-Interventionen, die notwendige Verhaltensveränderungen fördern und nachhaltig etablieren

Das bringst du mit

- Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeit, Umsetzungsstärke sowie ein souveränes Auftreten, gepaart mit eigenständiger Arbeitsweise und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

- Eine gute Balance zwischen echter Menschenorientierung und Empathie sowie strategisch-unternehmerischer Denkweise

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Personal- und Organisationsentwicklung sowie nachweisbare Erfolge in der Begleitung und Durchführung von größeren Veränderungsprozessen, idealerweise im Konzernumfeld

- Fundierte Erfahrung in der Beratung und im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen

- Begeisterung für Künstliche Intelligenz und Interesse daran, innovative Technologien lösungsorientiert einzusetzen

- Systemische Ausbildung (z. B. Systemisches Coaching oder Systemische Organisationsberatung) von Vorteil

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der BWL oder Psychologie, idealerweise mit HR-Schwerpunkt, sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse

Das bieten wir dir

- Flexible Arbeitsformen für eine optimale Balance zwischen Arbeiten im Büro und von zu Hause aus

- Zahlreiche Trainings- und Lernangebote, um fit für den Arbeitsalltag zu bleiben und eine individuelle Weiterentwicklung zu ermöglichen

- Unterstützung bei deiner Karriereplanung - von der Potenzialanalyse bis hin zur individuellen Förderung

- Eine moderne, offene und transparente Arbeitsumgebung, die Kreativität und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit fördert

- Ob Fitness in der Gruppe vor Ort oder virtuelles Achtsamkeitstraining von zu Hause: Unser vielfältiges Gesundheitsangebot unterstützt eine gesunde Work‑Life‑Balance

- Bikeleasing, vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, ein Mitarbeitenden‑Aktienprogramm und weitere tolle Benefits

Z usätzliche Informationen

Die Zurich Gruppe Deutschland unterstützt in Abhängigkeit zur individuellen Stellenanforderung und der persönlichen Eignung grundsätzlich sowohl flexible als auch Teilzeit-Arbeitsformen. Wenn du Interesse an dieser Stelle hast und deine persönliche Situation nicht ganz mit dem angegebenen Pensum (Voll- und Teilzeit) zusammenpasst, wende dich gerne an uns ( frederick.kortmann@zurich.com ), um die Möglichkeiten zu besprechen.

- Arbeitsort: Köln

- Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: Vollzeit

Frederick Kortmann freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellungen und des möglichen Starttermins über das Karriereportal (“Jetzt Bewerben”-Button). Leider können wir Bewerbungen per E-Mail nicht berücksichtigen.

Willkommen in deiner Zukunft

55.000 Kolleginnen und Kollegen in 215 Ländern und Gebieten. Gemeinsam auf dem Weg, Versicherung jeden Tag neu zu denken – und die Zukunft für alle zu gestalten. Willkommen in einer starken Gemeinschaft, in der du von Anfang an etwas bewegst. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir uns weiter!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei pronto a contare sul meglio?

A Zurigo, stiamo rivivendo l'assicurazione. Al fine di soddisfare i desideri dei nostri clienti ancora meglio, andiamo nuovi modi, pensare creativamente, lavorare agile. La nostra cultura aziendale vi dà maggiore flessibilità in ogni aspetto – e molta libertà di sviluppare in modo ottimale. Pensate grande – e anche a livello internazionale! Perché le tue possibilità di sviluppo non conoscono limiti con noi. Pronto a prendere il futuro in mano?

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

- Presso la sede di Colonia, accompagnerete i nostri manager e dipendenti in progetti di trasformazione nel business con l'aiuto di interventi di cambiamento basati sulle esigenze che promuovono i cambiamenti comportamentali necessari e li stabiliscono in modo sostenibile.

- In stretta collaborazione con le parti interessate (ad esempio, HR Business Partner, Works Council e Business), progetta soluzioni di cambiamento efficaci e supporta i nostri manager nel loro ruolo.

Lo porti con te.

- Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione, forza di implementazione e aspetto sovrano, abbinato a metodi di lavoro indipendenti e un senso di responsabilità

- Un buon equilibrio tra orientamento e empatia e pensiero strategico-imprenditoriale

- Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel personale e nello sviluppo organizzativo e successi dimostrabili nel supporto e nell'implementazione di importanti processi di cambiamento, idealmente nell'ambiente aziendale

- Esperienza approfondita nella consulenza e nella gestione di diversi stakeholder a tutti i livelli

- Entusiasmo per l'intelligenza artificiale e interesse nell'uso di tecnologie innovative in modo orientato alla soluzione

- La formazione sistemica (ad esempio, coaching sistemico o consulenza organizzativa sistemica) è vantaggiosa

- Studio completato con successo dell'amministrazione aziendale o della psicologia, idealmente con il focus HR, così come le competenze inglesi fluenti

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

- Forme di lavoro flessibili per un equilibrio ottimale tra lavoro in ufficio e da casa

- Numerose opportunità di formazione e apprendimento per rimanere in forma per il lavoro quotidiano e consentire lo sviluppo individuale

- Supporto nella pianificazione della tua carriera - da un'analisi potenziale alla promozione individuale

- Un ambiente di lavoro moderno, aperto e trasparente che promuove la creatività e la collaborazione cross-team

- Che si tratti di fitness nel gruppo sul sito o di formazione di consapevolezza virtuale da casa: La nostra vasta gamma di servizi sanitari supporta un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa

- Leasing bici, biglietto Germania scontato, servizi di asset-generazione, un programma azionario dei dipendenti e altri grandi vantaggi

Z Informazioni aggiuntive

A seconda delle esigenze individuali di lavoro e dell'idoneità personale, il gruppo di Zurigo Germania sostiene generalmente forme di lavoro flessibili e part-time. Se siete interessati a questo punto e la vostra situazione personale non corrisponde abbastanza all'importo specificato (completo e part-time), si prega di contattarci (frederick.kortmann@zurich.com) per discutere le possibilità.

- Luogo di lavoro: Colonia

- Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno

Frederick Kortmann non vede l'ora di presentare i documenti applicativi con le vostre aspettative di stipendio e la data di inizio possibile tramite il portale di carriera (“Applica ora” pulsante). Purtroppo non possiamo considerare le applicazioni via e-mail.

Benvenuti nel vostro futuro

55.000 colleghi in 215 paesi e territori. Insieme sulla strada per ripensare l'assicurazione ogni giorno – e per modellare il futuro per tutti. Benvenuto in una comunità forte dove ti trasferisci dall'inizio. Insieme continuiamo a svilupparci!

Are you ready to count on the best?

At Zurich, we are re-living insurance. In order to fulfill the wishes of our customers even better, we go new ways, think creatively, work agile. Our corporate culture gives you more flexibility in every respect – and a lot of freedom to develop optimally. Think big – and also internationally! Because your development possibilities know no limits with us. Ready to take the future in hand?

This is what awaits you

- At the Cologne location, you will accompany our managers and employees in transformation projects in the business with the help of needs-based change interventions that promote necessary behavioural changes and establish them sustainably.

- You ensure the sustainable anchoring of change processes, evaluate measures and continuously develop the procedure

- In close cooperation with relevant stakeholders (e.g. HR Business Partner, Works Council and Business), you will design effective change solutions and support our managers in their role.

- You design and implement measures and instruments for the further development of the leadership and corporate culture, actively maintain your network and coordinate internal company interfaces

You bring that with you

- Excellent communication and presentation ability, implementation strength and a sovereign appearance, coupled with independent working methods and a sense of responsibility

- A good balance between real people orientation and empathy as well as strategic-entrepreneurial thinking

- Several years of professional experience in personnel and organizational development as well as demonstrable successes in the support and implementation of major change processes, ideally in the corporate environment

- In-depth experience in consulting and dealing with different stakeholders at all levels

- Enthusiasm for Artificial Intelligence and interest in using innovative technologies in a solution-oriented way

- Systemic training (e.g. systemic coaching or systemic organizational consulting) is advantageous

- Successfully completed study of business administration or psychology, ideally with HR focus, as well as fluent English skills

This is what we offer you

- Flexible forms of work for an optimal balance between work in the office and from home

- Numerous training and learning opportunities to stay fit for everyday work and enable individual development

- Support in your career planning - from potential analysis to individual promotion

- A modern, open and transparent working environment that promotes creativity and cross-team collaboration

- Whether fitness in the group on site or virtual mindfulness training from home: Our diverse range of health services supports a healthy work-life balance

- Bike leasing, discounted Germany ticket, asset-generating services, an employee share program and other great benefits

Z Additional information

Depending on the individual job requirements and personal suitability, the Zurich Group Germany generally supports both flexible and part-time forms of work. If you are interested at this point and your personal situation does not quite match the specified amount (full and part-time), please contact us (frederick.kortmann@zurich.com) to discuss the possibilities.

- Place of work: Cologne

- Part-time or full-time

Frederick Kortmann is looking forward to your application documents with your salary expectations and the possible start date via the career portal (“Apply now” button). Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications by e-mail.

Welcome to your future

55,000 colleagues in 215 countries and territories. Together on the way to rethink insurance every day – and to shape the future for everyone. Welcome to a strong community where you move from the beginning. Together we continue to develop!

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Are you looking for a caring, collaborative, values-driven workplace with inspiring teammates and leaders? Do you have the ambition and desire to be the best and thrive at the most impactful global insurance provider in the world? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have experience in large property risk services, and are looking for a new challenge, we would love to hear from you.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for an AVP, Sr. Property Risk Consultant to provide expert risk assessment and consultative services supporting our Large Property accounts.

Reporting to the AVP, General Property, you will serve as both an account coordinator and field representative for multiple accounts. You will collaborate with underwriting partners to manage Zurich’s property portfolio’s risk quality, support customer risk control programs, conduct site risk assessments, develop account analysis, and coordinate stewardship meeting adhering to Zurich global technical standards and recognized codes.

This is a unique opportunity to build your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice matters. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.

Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring three days per week of in-person presence.

What you will do

• Assess the quality of complex risks, focusing on key and strategic assets as outlined by Zurich Resilience Solutions standards.
• Evaluate loss potentials in accordance with Zurich and industry definitions.
• Support external customers by identifying, assessing, and reducing the risks to their key/strategic assets and on an overall account basis.
• Provide appropriate risk improvement advice, conduct loss investigations (including trend and root cause analysis), and implement risk improvement programs.
• Communicate effectively with field risk engineers; nurture relationships with underwriting partners, brokers, industry consultants, professional organizations, and approval authorities.
• Develop and implement Customer Service Plans for coordinated accounts to drive efficient field service.
• Ensure consistency and quality of services to the account, including assessments, risk improvement advice, reporting, and time/expense management.
• Explore new service area opportunities, develop new customer services, and identify cross-selling potential.
• Support the commercial growth of Zurich Resilience Solutions by delivering expert consulting and sold services, identifying opportunities, and fostering strong client relationships.
• Manage change within accounts by staying in close contact with customer management and business partners, including reviewing new projects and plans for change.

Job Qualifications - What you bring to the table

Required:
• Bachelor’s Degree and 8 or more years of experience in Risk Engineering related to Property
OR
• High School Diploma or Equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in Risk Engineering related to Property
OR
• Zurich Certified Apprentice, including an Associate’s Degree and 8 or more years of experience in Risk Engineering related to Property
AND
• Experience with Microsoft Office
• Advanced knowledge of industrial hazards and controls
• Experience working in a team environment

Preferred:
• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Civil, or related discipline
• Canadian Risk Management (CRM) designation
• Account management experience as a Risk Services consultant with middle market or large customer property lines of business and programs
• Strong communication and results-oriented consultative skills
• Outstanding collaboration skills
• Fluency in both spoken and written French
• Fluency in both spoken and written English is required to facilitate communication with internal and external stakeholders outside Quebec.

Our Culture

• At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). We want you to bring your whole self to work, and we want our employees to be reflective of the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives are creating an environment where everyone feels welcome.
• We have a collaborative culture where diversity of thought is valued. We value your input and strive to give our employees the tools they need to make an impact.
• We care about our employees’ well-being and offer a comprehensive health/benefits plan with varying levels of coverage to suit your specific needs and a competitive total compensation package.
• We understand how important it is to rest, recharge and do the things you love. At Zurich, all employees receive a minimum of four weeks of vacation per year to do just that.
• We also understand that employees require time off for personal reasons. Maybe you have an appointment during a workday, a cultural or religious holiday you would like to observe, or you need time off to focus on your mental health. Zurich employees receive four personal days per year to be used at their discretion.
• We are committed to continuous improvement and offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.
• We care about our communities. Our communities are where our customers, people, and shareholders live and work. While we can be proud of the contribution to society Zurich makes through our core business of insurance, we must also give back to our communities through our talent, time and resources.
• We have won numerous awards for our workplace culture. We are proud to be one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers and to have received Insurance Business Canada’s 5-Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award.

Make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

About Us

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-line insurer with approximately 55,000 employees worldwide serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada has been a leading insurance provider serving mid-sized and large companies, including multinational corporations, in the Canadian commercial market for 100 years. With over 650 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a top insurance provider combined with in-depth knowledge of industries and local markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be risk management professionals’ first choice as their premier partner to help meet the risk challenges of today and tomorrow. Read more at www.zurichcanada.com .

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich strives to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We recruit talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion bring us closer to our common goal: exceeding our customers’ expectations. Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on behalf of, Zurich. We strive to achieve a workplace free of discrimination of all forms, including discrimination on the basis of physical or mental disability, or medical condition. If you are interested in a job opportunity, please advise if you require an accommodation, so we can work with you to provide a more accessible process.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Any unsolicited resume will become the property of Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. If you are a preferred vendor, please use our Recruiting Agency Portal for resume submission.

Only applicable for Canada: For Zurich Canada's commitment to diversity and accessibility please click here . If you would prefer to not receive future electronic messages from Zurich Insurance Company Ltd's recruitment management system, please email your request to have your job profile deleted from the system by clicking here .
