descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Stai cercando un posto di lavoro attento, collaborativo e orientato ai valori con compagni di squadra e leader ispiranti? Hai l'ambizione e il desiderio di essere il migliore e prosperare presso il fornitore di assicurazioni globali più efficace nel mondo? Non guardare oltre Zurigo Canada.

Se avete esperienza in grandi servizi di rischio di proprietà, e sono alla ricerca di una nuova sfida, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.

Zurigo Canada è attualmente alla ricerca di un AVP, Sr. Property Risk Consultant per fornire un'esperta valutazione del rischio e servizi consultivi che supportano i nostri grandi conti di proprietà.

Segnalando all'AVP, General Property, servirai sia come coordinatore del conto che come rappresentante del campo per conti multipli. Collaborerai con partner di sottoscrizione per gestire la qualità dei rischi del portafoglio di proprietà di Zurigo, sostenere i programmi di controllo del rischio del cliente, condurre valutazioni dei rischi del sito, sviluppare l'analisi dei conti e coordinare la riunione di stewardship aderente agli standard tecnici globali di Zurigo e ai codici riconosciuti.

Questa è un'opportunità unica per costruire la vostra conoscenza ed esperienza per il futuro in un ambiente di supporto in cui la vostra voce conta. Questa pubblicazione è per un posto vacante esistente.

Zurigo Canada utilizza strumenti di intelligenza artificiale abilitati a sostenere alcuni aspetti del processo di reclutamento, tra cui la revisione iniziale e la screening delle applicazioni. L'intelligenza artificiale non è l'unica base per la shortlist o la selezione dei candidati. Tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono esaminate e prese da professionisti qualificati di assunzione.

Zurigo segue un modello di lavoro ibrido che richiede tre giorni alla settimana di presenza in persona.

Cosa farai

• Valutare la qualità dei rischi complessi, concentrandosi su risorse chiave e strategiche come descritto dagli standard di Zurich Resilience Solutions.
• Valutare i potenziali di perdita secondo le definizioni di Zurigo e del settore.
• Sostenere i clienti esterni identificando, valutando e riducendo i rischi per i loro beni chiave/strategici e su una base di conto globale.
• Fornire consigli adeguati di miglioramento del rischio, condurre indagini di perdita (compresa l'analisi di tendenza e causa radice), e implementare programmi di miglioramento del rischio.
• Comunicare efficacemente con gli ingegneri del rischio di campo; creare relazioni con partner di sottoscrizione, broker, consulenti del settore, organizzazioni professionali e autorità di approvazione.
• Sviluppare e implementare i piani di servizio clienti per i conti coordinati per guidare un servizio di campo efficiente.
• Assicurare coerenza e qualità dei servizi al conto, comprese le valutazioni, consigli di miglioramento del rischio, reporting e gestione del tempo / spesa.
• Esplora nuove opportunità di area di servizio, sviluppa nuovi servizi ai clienti e identifica il potenziale di cross-selling.
• Sostenere la crescita commerciale di Zurich Resilience Solutions, offrendo servizi di consulenza e vendita esperti, identificando opportunità e promuovendo forti relazioni con i clienti.
• Gestisci il cambiamento all'interno dei conti rimanendo in stretto contatto con la gestione del cliente e i partner commerciali, inclusa la revisione di nuovi progetti e piani di cambiamento.

Qualifiche di lavoro - Cosa porti al tavolo

Richiesto:
• Corso di laurea e 8 o più anni di esperienza in Ingegneria del rischio legato alla proprietà
O
• Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente e 10 o più anni di esperienza in Ingegneria del rischio legato alla proprietà
O
• Apprendistato di Zurigo, tra cui un Associate’s Degree e 8 o più anni di esperienza in Ingegneria dei Rischi relativi alla Proprietà
E
• Esperienza con Microsoft Office
• Conoscenza avanzata dei rischi e dei controlli industriali
• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente di team

Preferito:
• Laurea in Ingegneria, Civile, o disciplina relativa
• Canadian Risk Management (CRM) designazione
• Esperienza di gestione account come consulente di Risk Services con il mercato medio o grandi linee di proprietà del cliente di affari e programmi
• Forte comunicazione e competenze consultive orientate ai risultati
• Competenze di collaborazione eccezionali
• Fluency in francese parlato e scritto
• Per facilitare la comunicazione con le parti interessate interne ed esterne al di fuori del Québec è necessaria una fluenza in inglese parlato e scritto.

La nostra cultura

• A Zurigo siamo orgogliosi della nostra cultura. Siamo appassionati di Diversità, Inclusione, Equità e Belonging (DIEB). Vogliamo che tu porti tutto il tuo lavoro, e vogliamo che i nostri dipendenti siano riflessivi delle comunità in cui viviamo e lavoriamo. Le nostre iniziative DIEB stanno creando un ambiente in cui tutti si sentono benvenuti.
• Abbiamo una cultura collaborativa dove la diversità del pensiero è apprezzata. Apprezziamo il vostro contributo e ci sforziamo di dare ai nostri dipendenti gli strumenti di cui hanno bisogno per fare un impatto.
• Ci preoccupiamo del benessere dei nostri dipendenti e offriamo un piano completo di salute/benefici con diversi livelli di copertura per soddisfare le vostre esigenze specifiche e un pacchetto di compensazione totale competitivo.
• Sappiamo quanto sia importante riposare, ricaricare e fare le cose che ami. A Zurigo, tutti i dipendenti ricevono un minimo di quattro settimane di vacanza all'anno per farlo.
• Sappiamo anche che i dipendenti richiedono tempo libero per motivi personali. Forse avete un appuntamento durante una giornata di lavoro, una vacanza culturale o religiosa che si desidera osservare, o avete bisogno di tempo libero per concentrarsi sulla vostra salute mentale. I dipendenti di Zurigo ricevono quattro giorni all'anno per essere utilizzati a loro discrezione.
• Siamo impegnati a un miglioramento continuo e offriamo l'accesso a una gamma completa di opportunità di formazione e sviluppo.
• Ci preoccupiamo delle nostre comunità. Le nostre comunità sono dove vivono e lavorano i nostri clienti, persone e azionisti. Mentre possiamo essere orgogliosi del contributo alla società che Zurigo fa attraverso il nostro core business dell'assicurazione, dobbiamo anche restituire alle nostre comunità attraverso il nostro talento, il tempo e le risorse.
• Abbiamo vinto numerosi premi per la nostra cultura del posto di lavoro. Siamo orgogliosi di essere uno dei più grandi datori di lavoro di Toronto e di aver ricevuto il premio per la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione di Insurance Business Canada.

Fai la differenza. Sii sfidato. Sii ispirato. Sii supportato. Adoro quello che fai. Lavora per noi.

Informazioni su di noi

Zurigo Canada fa parte del Zurich Insurance Group, un'assicurazione multi-linea con circa 55.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo che servono clienti nei mercati globali e locali. Zurigo Canada è stato un fornitore di assicurazioni leader che serve società di medie e grandi dimensioni, comprese le multinazionali, nel mercato commerciale canadese per 100 anni. Con oltre 650 dipendenti in uffici in tutto il paese, Zurigo offre la forza globale di un fornitore di assicurazione superiore combinato con la conoscenza approfondita delle industrie e dei mercati locali. Zurigo Canada aspira ad essere la prima scelta dei professionisti della gestione del rischio come partner principale per soddisfare le sfide di rischio di oggi e domani. Leggi tutto su www.zurichcanada.com .

Un futuro con Zurigo

Ora è il momento di andare avanti e fare la differenza. A Zurigo, vogliamo che tu condivida le tue prospettive, esperienze e idee uniche in modo da poter crescere e guidare un cambiamento sostenibile insieme. Nell'ambito di un'organizzazione globale leader, Zurigo Nord America ha oltre 148 anni di esperienza nella gestione del rischio e nel supporto alla resilienza. Siamo un fornitore leader di soluzioni di assicurazione proprietà-casualty commerciali e una vasta gamma di prodotti e servizi di gestione del rischio per le imprese e gli individui. Oggi, serviamo più di 25 industrie, dall'agricoltura alla tecnologia e assicuriamo il 90% della Fortune 500®. La nostra strategia di crescita non è limitata al nostro business. Come datore di lavoro, Zurigo si sforza di fornire opportunità di sviluppo della carriera in corso e promuovere un ambiente in cui le voci sono diverse, i comportamenti sono inclusi, le azioni guidare equità, e la nostra gente sente un senso di appartenenza. Fai parte della prossima evoluzione del settore assicurativo. Unisciti a noi nella costruzione di un futuro più luminoso per la nostra gente, i nostri clienti e le comunità che serviamo.

Come società globale, Zurigo riconosce la diversità della nostra forza lavoro come risorsa. Assumiamo persone di talento da una varietà di background con prospettive uniche che sono veramente benvenuti qui. Insieme, la diversità e l’inclusione ci avvicinano al nostro obiettivo comune: superare le aspettative dei nostri clienti. Zurigo si impegna a fornire un ambiente diverso, inclusivo e privo di barriere, con l'obiettivo di un'organizzazione accessibile per dipendenti, clienti e altre parti che interagiscono con, o per conto di Zurigo. Ci sforziamo di raggiungere un posto di lavoro privo di discriminazione di tutte le forme, compresa la discriminazione sulla base di disabilità fisica o mentale, o condizione medica. Se siete interessati a un'opportunità di lavoro, si prega di consigliare se avete bisogno di un alloggio, in modo da poter lavorare con voi per fornire un processo più accessibile.

Zurigo non accetta curriculum non sollecitati da società di ricerca o agenzie di lavoro. Qualsiasi curriculum non richiesto diventerà di proprietà di Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. Se sei un fornitore preferito, utilizza il nostro Recruiting Agency Portal per la presentazione del curriculum.

Solo applicabile per il Canada: Per l'impegno di Zurigo Canada per la diversità e l'accessibilità clicca qui . Se si preferisce non ricevere messaggi elettronici futuri dal sistema di gestione delle assunzioni di Zurich Insurance Company Ltd, si prega di e-mail la vostra richiesta di avere il vostro profilo di lavoro cancellato dal sistema facendo clic qui . Zurich Insurance Company Ltd 100 King St., W., Suite 5500, Toronto, ON, M5X 1C9. www.zurichcanada.com
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Suchen Sie einen fürsorglichen, kollaborativen, werteorientierten Arbeitsplatz mit inspirierenden Teamkollegen und Führungskräften? Haben Sie den Ehrgeiz und den Wunsch, der Beste zu sein und bei dem wirkungsvollsten globalen Versicherungsanbieter der Welt erfolgreich zu sein? Suchen Sie nicht weiter als Zürich Kanada.

Wenn Sie Erfahrung in großen Immobilienrisikodiensten haben und nach einer neuen Herausforderung suchen, würden wir uns freuen, von Ihnen zu hören.

Zurich Canada ist derzeit auf der Suche nach einem AVP, Sr. Property Risk Consultant, der Experten für Risikobewertung und Beratungsdienste zur Unterstützung unserer Large Property-Konten bereitstellt.

Wenn Sie dem AVP, General Property, Bericht erstatten, werden Sie sowohl als Kontokoordinator als auch als Außendienstmitarbeiter für mehrere Konten fungieren. Sie arbeiten mit Underwriting-Partnern zusammen, um die Risikoqualität des Zürcher Immobilienportfolios zu verwalten, Kundenrisikokontrollprogramme zu unterstützen, Standortrisikobewertungen durchzuführen, Kontoanalysen zu entwickeln und Stewardship-Meetings zu koordinieren, die sich an die globalen technischen Standards und anerkannten Codes von Zürich halten.

Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, Ihr Wissen und Ihre Erfahrung für die Zukunft in einer unterstützenden Umgebung aufzubauen, in der Ihre Stimme wichtig ist. Dieses Posting ist für eine bestehende Vakanz.

Zurich Canada verwendet künstliche Intelligenz-fähige Tools, um bestimmte Aspekte des Rekrutierungsprozesses zu unterstützen, einschließlich der Erstprüfung und des Screenings von Bewerbungen. Künstliche Intelligenz ist nicht die einzige Grundlage für die Auswahl oder Auswahl von Kandidaten. Alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden von qualifizierten Einstellungsexperten überprüft und getroffen.

Zurich folgt einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell, das drei Tage pro Woche persönliche Präsenz erfordert.

Was du tun wirst

• Bewerten Sie die Qualität komplexer Risiken und konzentrieren Sie sich auf wichtige und strategische Vermögenswerte, wie in den Zurich Resilience Solutions Standards beschrieben.
• Bewerten Sie Verlustpotenziale nach Zürich und Branchendefinitionen.
• Unterstützung externer Kunden durch die Identifizierung, Bewertung und Reduzierung der Risiken für ihre wichtigsten / strategischen Vermögenswerte und auf Gesamtkontobasis.
• Bereitstellung angemessener Risikoverbesserungsberatung, Durchführung von Verlustuntersuchungen (einschließlich Trend- und Ursachenanalyse) und Implementierung von Risikoverbesserungsprogrammen.
• Kommunizieren Sie effektiv mit Field Risk Engineers; Pflegen Sie Beziehungen zu Underwriting-Partnern, Brokern, Branchenberatern, Berufsverbänden und Genehmigungsbehörden.
• Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Kundendienstpläne für koordinierte Konten, um einen effizienten Außendienst zu ermöglichen.
• Gewährleistung der Konsistenz und Qualität der Dienstleistungen für das Konto, einschließlich Bewertungen, Risikoverbesserungsberatung, Berichterstattung und Zeit- / Ausgabenmanagement.
• Entdecken Sie neue Servicebereichsmöglichkeiten, entwickeln Sie neue Kundenservices und identifizieren Sie Cross-Selling-Potenziale.
• Unterstützen Sie das kommerzielle Wachstum von Zurich Resilience Solutions, indem Sie kompetente Beratung und verkaufte Dienstleistungen anbieten, Chancen identifizieren und starke Kundenbeziehungen pflegen.
• Verwalten Sie Änderungen in Konten, indem Sie in engem Kontakt mit dem Kundenmanagement und Geschäftspartnern bleiben, einschließlich der Überprüfung neuer Projekte und Änderungspläne.

Job Qualifikationen - Was Sie an den Tisch bringen

Vorgeschrieben:
• Bachelor-Abschluss und 8 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in Risk Engineering im Zusammenhang mit Immobilien
ODER
• High School Diplom oder Äquivalent und 10 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in Risk Engineering im Zusammenhang mit Immobilien
ODER
• Zurich Certified Apprentice, einschließlich eines Associate's Degree und 8 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in Risk Engineering im Zusammenhang mit Immobilien
UND
• Erfahrung mit Microsoft Office
• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse über industrielle Gefahren und Kontrollen
• Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einer Teamumgebung

Bevorzugt:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Engineering, Civil oder verwandten Disziplin
• Bezeichnung Canadian Risk Management (CRM)
• Account Management Erfahrung als Risk Services Berater mit mittelständischen oder großen Kundenimmobilien Geschäftsfeldern und Programmen
• Starke Kommunikation und ergebnisorientierte Beratungskompetenz
• Hervorragende Collaboration Skills
• fließend in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Französisch
• Fließend in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch ist erforderlich, um die Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern außerhalb von Quebec zu erleichtern.

Unsere Kultur

• Bei Zürich sind wir stolz auf unsere Kultur. Wir sind begeistert von Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). Wir möchten, dass Sie sich ganz in die Arbeit einbringen, und wir möchten, dass unsere Mitarbeiter die Gemeinschaften widerspiegeln, in denen wir leben und arbeiten. Unsere DIEB-Initiativen schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sich jeder willkommen fühlt.
• Wir haben eine kollaborative Kultur, in der die Vielfalt des Denkens geschätzt wird. Wir schätzen Ihren Input und bemühen uns, unseren Mitarbeitern die Werkzeuge zu geben, die sie benötigen, um etwas zu bewirken.
• Wir kümmern uns um das Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeiter und bieten einen umfassenden Gesundheits- / Leistungsplan mit unterschiedlichen Deckungsniveaus für Ihre spezifischen Bedürfnisse und ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gesamtvergütungspaket.
• Wir verstehen, wie wichtig es ist, sich auszuruhen, aufzuladen und die Dinge zu tun, die Sie lieben. In Zürich erhalten alle Mitarbeiter mindestens vier Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr, um genau das zu tun.
• Wir verstehen auch, dass Mitarbeiter aus persönlichen Gründen eine Auszeit benötigen. Vielleicht haben Sie einen Termin während eines Arbeitstages, einen kulturellen oder religiösen Feiertag, den Sie einhalten möchten, oder Sie brauchen eine Auszeit, um sich auf Ihre psychische Gesundheit zu konzentrieren. Zurich Mitarbeiter erhalten vier persönliche Tage pro Jahr, die nach eigenem Ermessen genutzt werden können.
• Wir setzen uns für kontinuierliche Verbesserung ein und bieten Zugang zu einem umfassenden Angebot an Ausbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
• Wir kümmern uns um unsere Gemeinschaften. Unsere Gemeinden sind, wo unsere Kunden, Menschen und Aktionäre leben und arbeiten. Während wir stolz auf den Beitrag sein können, den Zurich durch unser Kerngeschäft Versicherungen für die Gesellschaft leistet, müssen wir auch durch unser Talent, unsere Zeit und unsere Ressourcen unseren Gemeinden etwas zurückgeben.
• Wir haben zahlreiche Auszeichnungen für unsere Arbeitsplatzkultur gewonnen. Wir sind stolz darauf, einer der Top-Arbeitgeber von Greater Toronto zu sein und den 5-Sterne Diversity, Equity und Inclusion Award von Insurance Business Canada erhalten zu haben.

Machen Sie einen Unterschied. Werden Sie herausgefordert. Lassen Sie sich inspirieren. Unterstützt werden. Liebe, was du tust. Arbeitet für uns.

Über uns

Zurich Canada ist Teil der Zurich Insurance Group, einem Multiline-Versicherer mit rund 55.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit, der Kunden in globalen und lokalen Märkten betreut. Zurich Canada ist seit 100 Jahren ein führender Versicherungsanbieter für mittelständische und große Unternehmen, einschließlich multinationaler Unternehmen, auf dem kanadischen Handelsmarkt. Mit über 650 Mitarbeitern in Büros im ganzen Land bietet Zurich die globale Stärke eines Top-Versicherungsanbieters in Kombination mit fundierten Kenntnissen der Industrie und der lokalen Märkte. Zurich Canada strebt danach, die erste Wahl für Risikomanagement-Profis als erstklassiger Partner zu sein, um die Risikoherausforderungen von heute und morgen zu meistern. Lesen Sie mehr unter www.zurichcanada.com.

Eine Zukunft mit Zürich

Jetzt ist es an der Zeit, voranzukommen und einen Unterschied zu machen. Bei Zurich möchten wir, dass Sie Ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und Ideen teilen, damit wir gemeinsam wachsen und nachhaltige Veränderungen vorantreiben können. Als Teil einer führenden globalen Organisation verfügt Zurich North America über mehr als 148 Jahre Erfahrung im Management von Risiken und der Unterstützung von Resilienz. Wir sind ein führender Anbieter von gewerblichen Unfallversicherungslösungen und einer breiten Palette von Risikomanagementprodukten und -dienstleistungen für Unternehmen und Einzelpersonen. Heute bedienen wir mehr als 25 Branchen, von der Landwirtschaft bis zur Technologie und versichern 90% der Fortune 500®. Unsere Wachstumsstrategie beschränkt sich nicht auf unser Geschäft. Als Arbeitgeber ist Zurich bestrebt, kontinuierliche Karriereentwicklungsmöglichkeiten zu bieten und ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Stimmen vielfältig sind, Verhaltensweisen inklusiv sind, Handlungen Gerechtigkeit fördern und unsere Mitarbeiter sich zugehörig fühlen. Seien Sie Teil der nächsten Entwicklung der Versicherungsbranche. Begleiten Sie uns beim Aufbau einer besseren Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeiter, unsere Kunden und die Gemeinschaften, denen wir dienen.

Als globales Unternehmen erkennt Zurich die Vielfalt unserer Belegschaft als Aktivposten an. Wir rekrutieren talentierte Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen mit einzigartigen Perspektiven, die hier wirklich willkommen sind. Diversität und Inklusion bringen uns unserem gemeinsamen Ziel näher: die Erwartungen unserer Kunden zu übertreffen. Zurich verpflichtet sich, ein vielfältiges, integratives und barrierefreies Umfeld zu schaffen, das zu einer barrierefreien Organisation für Mitarbeiter, Kunden und andere Parteien führt, die mit oder im Auftrag von Zurich interagieren. Wir sind bestrebt, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, der frei von Diskriminierung jeglicher Art ist, einschließlich Diskriminierung aufgrund von körperlicher oder geistiger Behinderung oder Gesundheitszustand. Wenn Sie an einer Jobmöglichkeit interessiert sind, informieren Sie bitte, wenn Sie eine Unterkunft benötigen, damit wir mit Ihnen zusammenarbeiten können, um einen zugänglicheren Prozess bereitzustellen.

Zurich akzeptiert keine unaufgeforderten lebensläufe von suchfirmen oder arbeitsagenturen. Jeder unaufgeforderte Lebenslauf wird Eigentum der Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. Wenn Sie ein bevorzugter Anbieter sind, nutzen Sie bitte unser Recruiting Agency Portal für die Einreichung von Lebensläufen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité

Cherchez-vous un milieu de travail bienveillant, collaboratif et axé sur les valeurs avec des coéquipiers et des leaders inspirants? Avez-vous l'ambition et le désir d'être le meilleur et de prospérer auprès du fournisseur d'assurance le plus impacté du monde? Ne cherchez pas plus loin que Zurich Canada.

Si vous avez de l'expérience dans les grands services de risque immobilier, et êtes à la recherche d'un nouveau défi, nous aimerions entendre parler de vous.

Zurich Canada est actuellement à la recherche d'un AVP, Sr. Property Risk Consultant pour fournir des services d'évaluation des risques et de consultation spécialisés à l'appui de nos comptes de grands biens.

Vous serez à la fois coordonnateur de compte et représentant sur le terrain pour plusieurs comptes. Vous collaborerez avec des partenaires de souscription pour gérer le portefeuille immobilier de Zurich.

C'est une occasion unique de développer vos connaissances et votre expérience pour l'avenir dans un environnement favorable où votre voix compte. Cette affectation correspond à un poste vacant.

Zurich Canada utilise des outils d'intelligence artificielle pour appuyer certains aspects du processus de recrutement, y compris l'examen initial et la présélection des demandes. L'intelligence artificielle n'est pas la seule base pour la présélection ou la sélection des candidats. Toutes les décisions d'embauche sont examinées et prises par des professionnels qualifiés.

Zurich suit un modèle de travail hybride exigeant trois jours par semaine de présence en personne.

Ce que vous ferez

• Évaluer la qualité des risques complexes, en mettant l'accent sur les actifs clés et stratégiques tels que décrits par les normes Zurich Resilience Solutions.
• Évaluer les potentiels de perte conformément aux définitions de Zurich et de l'industrie.
• Soutenir les clients externes en identifiant, en évaluant et en réduisant les risques pour leurs actifs clés/stratégiques et sur une base de compte global.
• Fournir des conseils appropriés sur l'amélioration des risques, mener des enquêtes sur les pertes (y compris l'analyse des tendances et des causes profondes) et mettre en oeuvre des programmes d'amélioration des risques.
• Communiquer efficacement avec les ingénieurs des risques sur le terrain; entretenir des relations avec les partenaires de souscription, les courtiers, les consultants de l'industrie, les organisations professionnelles et les autorités d'approbation.
• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des plans de service à la clientèle pour des comptes coordonnés afin de favoriser l'efficacité du service sur le terrain.
• Assurer l'uniformité et la qualité des services au compte, y compris les évaluations, les conseils en matière d'amélioration des risques, les rapports et la gestion du temps et des dépenses.
• Explorer de nouvelles possibilités de secteur de service, développer de nouveaux services à la clientèle et identifier le potentiel de vente croisée.
• Soutenir la croissance commerciale de Zurich Resilience Solutions en fournissant des services de conseil et de vente d'experts, en identifiant les opportunités et en favorisant des relations client solides.
• Gérer le changement dans les comptes en restant en contact étroit avec la gestion de la clientèle et les partenaires commerciaux, y compris l'examen de nouveaux projets et plans de changement.

Qualifications d'emploi - Ce que vous apportez à la table

Requis :
• Baccalauréat Diplôme et 8 ans ou plus d'expérience en Ingénierie du Risque lié à la Propriété
OU
• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 10 ans ou plus d'expérience en génie des risques liés à la propriété
OU
• Zurich Apprentis certifié, y compris un diplôme d'associé et 8 ans ou plus d'expérience en génie des risques liés à la propriété
PAYS
• Expérience avec Microsoft Office
• Connaissance avancée des dangers et des contrôles industriels
• Expérience de travail en équipe

Préféré:
• Baccalauréat en génie, civil ou discipline connexe
• Désignation de la gestion du risque au Canada
• Expérience de la gestion des comptes en tant que consultant en services de gestion des risques avec des secteurs d'activité et des programmes de propriété des grands clients ou du marché intermédiaire
• Forte capacité de communication et de consultation axée sur les résultats
• Compétences exceptionnelles en collaboration
• Connaissance du français parlé et écrit
• La maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit est nécessaire pour faciliter la communication avec les intervenants internes et externes à l'extérieur du Québec.

Notre culture

• À Zurich, nous sommes fiers de notre culture. Nous sommes passionnés par la diversité, l'inclusion, l'équité et l'appartenance (DIEB). Nous voulons que vous mettiez tout votre moi au travail, et nous voulons que nos employés reflètent les communautés dans lesquelles nous vivons et travaillons. Nos initiatives DIEB créent un environnement où tout le monde se sent bienvenu.
• Nous avons une culture de collaboration où la diversité de pensée est appréciée. Nous apprécions vos commentaires et nous nous efforçons de donner à nos employés les outils dont ils ont besoin pour avoir un impact.
• Nous nous soucions du bien-être de nos employés et offrons un régime complet de soins de santé et d'avantages sociaux avec des niveaux de couverture variables pour répondre à vos besoins spécifiques et un régime de rémunération totale concurrentiel.
• Nous comprenons combien il est important de se reposer, de se recharger et de faire ce que vous aimez. À Zurich, tous les employés reçoivent un minimum de quatre semaines de vacances par année pour ce faire.
• Nous comprenons également que les employés ont besoin de congés pour des raisons personnelles. Peut-être que vous avez un rendez-vous pendant une journée de travail, une fête culturelle ou religieuse que vous souhaitez observer, ou vous avez besoin de temps libre pour vous concentrer sur votre santé mentale. Les employés de Zurich reçoivent quatre jours personnels par an à leur discrétion.
• Nous nous engageons à améliorer continuellement et à offrir un large éventail de possibilités de formation et de perfectionnement.
• Nous nous soucions de nos communautés. Nos collectivités sont là où vivent et travaillent nos clients, nos gens et nos actionnaires. Bien que nous puissions être fiers de la contribution de Zurich à la société grâce à notre activité principale d'assurance, nous devons aussi redonner à nos communautés par notre talent, notre temps et nos ressources.
• Nous avons remporté de nombreux prix pour notre culture du travail. Nous sommes fiers d'être l'un des meilleurs employeurs du Grand Toronto et d'avoir reçu le Prix de la diversité, de l'équité et de l'inclusion 5 étoiles d'Entreprise d'assurance Canada.

Faites une différence. Soyez défiés. Soyez inspiré. Soyez soutenu. J'adore ce que tu fais. Travaille pour nous.

À propos de nous

Zurich Canada fait partie du Zurich Insurance Group, un assureur multiligne comptant environ 55 000 employés dans le monde qui servent des clients sur les marchés mondiaux et locaux. Zurich Canada est l'un des principaux fournisseurs d'assurance au service des grandes et moyennes entreprises, y compris les multinationales, sur le marché commercial canadien depuis 100 ans. Avec plus de 650 employés dans des bureaux à travers le pays, Zurich offre la force mondiale d'un fournisseur d'assurance de premier plan combiné avec une connaissance approfondie des industries et des marchés locaux. Zurich Canada aspire à être un professionnel de la gestion des risques.Le premier choix est d'aider à relever les défis d'aujourd'hui et de demain. En savoir plus à www.zurichcanada.com .

Un avenir avec Zurich

Il est temps d'avancer et de faire une différence. À Zurich, nous voulons que vous partagiez vos perspectives, vos expériences et vos idées uniques afin que nous puissions grandir et conduire ensemble un changement durable. Dans le cadre d'une organisation mondiale de premier plan, Zurich Amérique du Nord a plus de 148 ans d'expérience en gestion des risques et en soutien de la résilience. Nous sommes un fournisseur de premier plan de solutions d'assurance de la propriété commerciale et une large gamme de produits et de services de gestion des risques pour les entreprises et les particuliers. Aujourd'hui, nous servons plus de 25 industries, de l'agriculture à la technologie et nous assurons 90 % du Fortune 500®. Notre stratégie de croissance ne se limite pas à nos activités. En tant qu'employeur, Zurich s'efforce d'offrir des possibilités de développement continu de carrière et de favoriser un environnement où les voix sont diverses, les comportements sont inclusifs, les actions stimulent l'équité, et nos gens se sentent un sentiment d'appartenance. Faites partie de la prochaine évolution du secteur de l'assurance. Rejoignez-nous pour bâtir un avenir meilleur pour nos gens, nos clients et les communautés que nous servons.

En tant qu'entreprise mondiale, Zurich reconnaît la diversité de ses effectifs comme un atout. Nous recrutons des personnes talentueuses de divers horizons avec des perspectives uniques qui sont vraiment les bienvenues ici. Ensemble, la diversité et l'inclusion nous rapprochent de notre objectif commun : dépasser les attentes de nos clients. Zurich s'engage à offrir un environnement diversifié, inclusif et sans obstacles, ce qui permettra d'offrir une organisation accessible aux employés, aux clients et aux autres parties qui interagissent avec Zurich ou pour son compte. Nous nous efforçons de parvenir à un lieu de travail exempt de discrimination de toutes les formes, y compris de discrimination fondée sur un handicap physique ou mental ou un état de santé. Si vous êtes intéressé par une possibilité d'emploi, veuillez vous informer si vous avez besoin d'un logement, afin que nous puissions travailler avec vous pour offrir un processus plus accessible.

Zurich n'accepte pas les curriculum vitae non sollicités des agences de recherche ou d'emploi. Tout CV non sollicité deviendra la propriété de Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. Si vous êtes un fournisseur privilégié, veuillez utiliser notre portail de recrutement pour soumettre un curriculum vitae.

Seulement applicable pour le Canada : Pour l'engagement de Zurich Canada en matière de diversité et d'accessibilité, cliquez ici . Si vous préférez ne pas recevoir de futurs messages électroniques du système de gestion du recrutement de Zurich Insurance Company Ltd, veuillez envoyer votre demande par courriel afin que votre profil d'emploi soit supprimé du système en cliquant ici. Zurich Insurance Company Ltd 100, rue King, W., bureau 5500, Toronto (Ontario) M5X 1C9. www.zurichcanada.com

jobs.title: Auto Litigation Claims Specialist
jobs.description:
At Zurich North America Claims we acknowledge that work life-balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA Claims hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing claims employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, occasional circumstances requiring in-office attendance should be expected. The candidate selected for this opportunity should be able to report into [one of] the following North American Claims office[s]: Atlanta, GA; Schaumburg, IL; Addison, TX; or Omaha, NE.

Zurich North America is currently hiring an Auto Litigation Claims Specialist, and this person will report to an Auto Claims Handling Manager. This role offers flexibility to work out of any Zurich North America office in the United States.

Responsibilities:

- Work closely with attorneys internally and externally

- Partner with attorneys on complex claims cases

- Claims process management, work closely with attorney

- Handle auto litigated claims

- Can handle high exposure claims

- Document claims file by accurately capturing and updating claims data/information in compliance with best practices for low to moderate exposure and complexity personal or commercial line claims.

- Exercise judgement to determine liability by gathering and analyzing relevant facts; utilizing applicable law; establishing basic principles of negligence.

- Exercise judgment to determine policy verification and coverage determination by analyzing applicable coverage for claims and determining whether the loss falls within the coverage.

- Work to have a timely resolution to claims by developing case strategy; developing a case evaluation; escalating issues as appropriate.

- Establish timely reserves and perform ongoing review throughout claims cycle within authority limit by estimating and validating value of claims.

- Assess damages by calculating applicable damages or range of damages allowed by law.

- Negotiate settlement of claim by establishing appropriate negotiation strategy and utilizing available tools and resources within authority limits.

- Meet quality standards by following best practices.

- Ensure customer service by proactively communicating information; responding to inquiries; following customer protocols and may participating in customer marketing efforts.

- Ensure legal compliance by following state and federal laws and regulations and internal control requirements.

- Refer claim to subrogation and fraud teams by identifying potential subrogation and fraud.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Claims or Insurance area OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in Claims or Insurance area OR

- Completion of Zurich Claims Training Program and 2 or more years of experience in the Claims or Insurance area OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Claims or Insurance area AND

- Must obtain and maintain required adjuster license(s)

- Knowledge of insurance regulations, markets and products

- Microsoft Office experience

Preferred Qualifications:

- Auto commercial experience

- Personal lines auto experience

- Effective verbal and written communication skills

- Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills

- Solid time management, prioritization and multi-tasking skills

- Experience collaborating in a team environment and building cross functional working relationships

- Adept in identifying and explaining complex claims and moderately complex claims

- Ability to determine the scope and exposure for moderately complex claims

- Ability to develop and execute a negotiation strategy and plan for resolution

- Ability to identify subtleties in customer/client and/or business partner interactions

- Ability to present information necessary to propose a claim resolution to stakeholders

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed salary range for this position is $59,900.00 - $98,200.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

jobs.description:
¡Hola!

Soy Leyre, recruiter de esta posición. Me encanta escribir y leer historias de terror, pero de lo que más disfruto es de una buena comida familiar con las personas que más quiero. Si te gusta la música de los setenta y ochenta tanto como a mí, ¡conectaremos seguro!

Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales.

¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo.

Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega!

¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN:

- Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2024 hicimos más de 20.000 horas de activismo.

- En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección). ¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas.

Y te preguntarás: Leyre, ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento):

Tu misión será ayudar a transformar la forma en que desarrollamos software en Zurich mediante la creación de agentes de Inteligencia Artificial que permitan a nuestros equipos trabajar de forma más eficiente y dedicar más tiempo a lo que realmente aporta valor.

Participarás en el diseño, construcción y mejora de agentes especializados capaces de apoyar actividades como el análisis y conceptualización de soluciones, desglose de las tareas que implican las soluciones, estimaciones de esfuerzos de los desarrollos, la generación de documentación, el desarrollo de software, el testing o la gestión del conocimiento. Además, colaborarás en la captura y estructuración del conocimiento de nuestros equipos para que estos agentes sean cada vez más precisos y útiles.

¿Qué harás?

- Participar en el diseño y desarrollo de agentes basados en Inteligencia Artificial Generativa.

- Colaborar en la automatización de procesos y tareas dentro del ciclo de vida de desarrollo de software.

- Ayudar a conectar agentes con distintas fuentes de información, herramientas y aplicaciones corporativas.

- Trabajar con equipos técnicos y de negocio para identificar, documentar y estructurar conocimiento clave.

- Colaborar en la creación de bases de conocimiento, repositorios de información y documentación reutilizable.

- Participar en pruebas de concepto, pilotos y experimentos relacionados con IA Generativa y automatización.

Bei Zurich leben wir Versicherung neu. Um die Wünsche unserer Kunden noch besser zu erfüllen, gehen wir neue Wege, denken kreativ, arbeiten agil. Unsere Unternehmenskultur schenkt dir in jeder Hinsicht mehr Flexibilität – und viel Freiraum, dich optimal zu entfalten. Think big – und gerne auch international! Denn deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten kennen bei uns keine Grenzen. Bereit, die Zukunft in die Hand zu nehmen?

Das erwartet dich

- Am Standort Frankfurt übernimmst du die Verantwortung für einen festen Kunden- bzw. Maklerbestand im Bereich Haftpflicht im Commercial Insurance Mid Market Segment

- Dabei kümmerst du dich eigenverantwortlich um sämtliche Vorgänge rund um die Vertragsführung –insbesondere unter Nutzung der Bestands-/ fachspezifischen Systeme & Tools

- Du erstellst alle relevanten Versicherungsdokumente im Rahmen der Vertragsführung selbstständig, z.B. Policen, Nachträge, Rechnungen oder Versicherungsbestätigungen

- In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Underwriting und dem Vertrieb prüfst du, ob individuelle Lösungen auch administrativ umsetzbar sind

- Für deine Kunden bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson und berätst diese in allen versicherungstechnischen Fragestellungen der Sparte Haftpflicht

- Wir wollen uns stetig verbessern - Deine Ideen und dein Engagement helfen uns dabei, unsere Service-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

Das bringst du mit

- Ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie Spaß daran, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

- Sicherer Umgang mit MS-Office

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; gute Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

- Idealerweise bereits Spartenkenntnisse im Bereich der Betriebs- und Produkthaftpflicht oder Erfahrungswerte im Firmen- bzw. Industriekundensegment

- Abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder versicherungstechnische Ausbildung, ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

Das bieten wir dir

- Flexible Arbeitsformen für eine optimale Balance zwischen Arbeiten am Arbeitsplatz und von zu Hause aus

- Zahlreiche Trainings- und Lernangebote, um fit für den Arbeitsalltag zu bleiben und eine individuelle Weiterentwicklung zu ermöglichen

- Unterstützung bei deiner Karriereplanung - von der Potenzialanalyse bis hin zur individuellen Förderung

- Eine moderne, offene und transparente Arbeitsumgebung, die Kreativität und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit fördert

- Ob Fitness in der Gruppe vor Ort oder virtuelles Achtsamkeitstraining von zu Hause: Unser vielfältiges Gesundheitsangebot unterstützt eine gesunde Work ‑ Life ‑ Balance

- Bikeleasing, vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, ein Mitarbeitenden ‑ Aktienprogramm und weitere tolle Benefits

Z usätzliche Informationen

Die Zurich Gruppe Deutschland unterstützt in Abhängigkeit zur individuellen Stellenanforderung und der persönlichen Eignung grundsätzlich sowohl flexible als auch Teilzeit-Arbeitsformen. Wenn du Interesse an dieser Stelle hast und deine persönliche Situation nicht ganz mit dem angegebenen Pensum (Voll- und Teilzeit) zusammenpasst, wende dich gerne an uns ( k.schmidt@zurich.com ) um die potenziellen Möglichkeiten zu besprechen.

- Arbeitsort: Frankfurt

- Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: Vollzeit

Kim Schmidt freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellungen und des möglichen Starttermins über das Karriereportal (“Jetzt Bewerben”-Button). Leider können wir Bewerbungen per E-Mail nicht berücksichtigen.

Willkommen in deiner Zukunft

55.000 Kolleginnen und Kollegen in 215 Ländern und Gebieten. Gemeinsam auf dem Weg, Versicherung jeden Tag neu zu denken – und die Zukunft für alle zu gestalten. Willkommen in einer starken Gemeinschaft, in der du von Anfang an etwas bewegst. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir uns weiter!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei pronto a contare sul meglio?

A Zurigo riviviamo l'assicurazione. Al fine di soddisfare i desideri dei nostri clienti ancora meglio, andiamo nuovi modi, pensare creativamente, lavorare agile. La nostra cultura aziendale vi dà maggiore flessibilità in ogni aspetto – e molta libertà di sviluppare in modo ottimale. Pensate grande – e anche a livello internazionale! Perché le tue possibilità di sviluppo non conoscono limiti con noi. Pronto a prendere il futuro in mano?

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

- Presso la sede di Francoforte, si assume la responsabilità di un cliente permanente o portafoglio di responsabilità nel segmento di mercato delle assicurazioni commerciali

- Ti occupi di tutti i processi relativi alla gestione dei contratti – in particolare utilizzando i sistemi e gli strumenti esistenti / specifici per soggetto

- L'utente crea tutti i documenti assicurativi rilevanti nell'ambito della gestione del contratto in modo indipendente, ad esempio politiche, integratori, fatture o conferme assicurative

- In stretta collaborazione con la sottoscrizione e le vendite, si controlla se le soluzioni individuali possono essere implementate anche amministrativamente

- Per i vostri clienti, siete la persona di contatto centrale e li consiglia su tutti i problemi di sottoscrizione della divisione di responsabilità.

- Vogliamo migliorare costantemente - le vostre idee e impegno ci aiutano a sviluppare continuamente i nostri processi di servizio

Lo porti con te.

- Forte orientamento al cliente e al servizio e divertimento per sviluppare continuamente

- Gestione sicura di MS-Office

- Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco in parola e scrittura; Buone abilità inglesi sono utili

- Idealmente, già la conoscenza del settore nel settore della responsabilità operativa e del prodotto o dell'esperienza nel segmento della società o del cliente industriale

- Istruzione, studio o qualificazione equivalente completa commerciale o sottoscrittura

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

- Forme di lavoro flessibili per un equilibrio ottimale tra lavoro e casa

- Numerose opportunità di formazione e apprendimento per rimanere in forma per il lavoro quotidiano e consentire lo sviluppo individuale

- Supporto nella pianificazione della tua carriera - da un'analisi potenziale alla promozione individuale

- Un ambiente di lavoro moderno, aperto e trasparente che promuove la creatività e la collaborazione cross-team

- Che si tratti di fitness nel gruppo sul sito o di formazione di consapevolezza virtuale da casa: La nostra vasta gamma di servizi sanitari supporta un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa

- Leasing bici, biglietto Germania scontato, servizi di asset-generazione, un programma azionario dei dipendenti e altri grandi vantaggi

Z informazioni aggiuntive

A seconda delle esigenze individuali di lavoro e dell'idoneità personale, il gruppo di Zurigo Germania sostiene generalmente sia il lavoro flessibile che quello part-time. Se siete interessati a questo punto e la vostra situazione personale non corrisponde abbastanza all'importo specificato (completo e part-time), si prega di contattarci (k.schmidt@zurich.com) per discutere le possibilità potenziali.

- Luogo di lavoro: Francoforte

- Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: a tempo pieno

Kim Schmidt non vede l'ora di presentare i documenti delle vostre applicazioni con le vostre aspettative di stipendio e la data di inizio possibile tramite il portale di carriera (“Applica ora” pulsante). Purtroppo non possiamo considerare le applicazioni via e-mail.

Benvenuti nel vostro futuro

55.000 colleghi in 2515 paesi e territori. Insieme sulla strada per ripensare l'assicurazione ogni giorno – e per modellare il futuro per tutti. Benvenuto in una comunità forte dove ti trasferisci dall'inizio. Insieme continuiamo a svilupparci!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you ready to count on the best?

At Zurich we are re-living insurance. In order to fulfill the wishes of our customers even better, we go new ways, think creatively, work agile. Our corporate culture gives you more flexibility in every respect – and a lot of freedom to develop optimally. Think big – and also internationally! Because your development possibilities know no limits with us. Ready to take the future in hand?

This is what awaits you

- At the Frankfurt location, you assume responsibility for a permanent customer or Liability portfolio in the Commercial Insurance Mid Market Segment

- You take care of all processes relating to contract management – in particular using the existing / subject-specific systems & tools

- You create all relevant insurance documents within the framework of the contract management independently, e.g. policies, supplements, invoices or insurance confirmations

- In close cooperation with underwriting and sales, you check whether individual solutions can also be implemented administratively

- For your customers, you are the central contact person and advise them on all underwriting issues of the liability division.

- We want to constantly improve - your ideas and commitment help us to continuously develop our service processes

You bring that with you

- Strong customer and service orientation as well as fun to continuously develop

- Safe handling of MS-Office

- Very good knowledge of German in word and writing; Good English skills are beneficial

- Ideally, already knowledge of the sector in the area of operational and product liability or experience in the company or Industrial customer segment

- Completed commercial or underwriting education, study or equivalent qualification

This is what we offer you

- Flexible forms of work for an optimal balance between work at work and from home

- Numerous training and learning opportunities to stay fit for everyday work and enable individual development

- Support in your career planning - from potential analysis to individual promotion

- A modern, open and transparent work environment that promotes creativity and cross-team collaboration

- Whether fitness in the group on site or virtual mindfulness training from home: Our diverse range of health services supports a healthy work-life balance

- Bike leasing, discounted Germany ticket, asset-generating services, an employee share program and other great benefits

Z additional information

Depending on the individual job requirements and personal suitability, the Zurich Group Germany generally supports both flexible and part-time work. If you are interested at this point and your personal situation does not quite match the specified amount (full and part-time), please contact us (k.schmidt@zurich.com ) to discuss the potential possibilities.

- Place of work: Frankfurt

- Part-time or full-time: full-time

Kim Schmidt is looking forward to your application documents with your salary expectations and the possible start date via the career portal (“Apply now” button). Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications by e-mail.

Welcome to your future

55,000 colleagues in 215 countries and territories. Together on the way to rethink insurance every day – and to shape the future for everyone. Welcome to a strong community where you move from the beginning. Together we continue to develop!

jobs.title: Business Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
We Are Waiting for You

Hi there future intern!

I am Alba, the recruiter for this position (and hopefully, your future colleague!).

First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center : The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich !

Let me take a wild guess: you’ve probably sifted through countless job offers today, and they all seem to blur together. Sound familiar? Well, here’s the scoop: At Zurich, we might not have all the answers (and we’re not striving for perfection!), but we’ve got something special. Curious? Keep reading!

First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions.

If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale.

What can you expect?

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked – I asked myself the same question at the time.

As a Business Analyst Intern you will have the opportunity to:

- Collaborate on exciting international projects, working by hand by hand with the Senior Scrum Master and learning from Insurance Business experts & IT Leads.

- Develop and deploy innovative tech solutions into Azure Cloud or AWS.

- Work alongside experts in various technological domains.

- Enhance your skills with real-world experience

- Contribute to a team that values your input and creativity

What Makes You a great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you!

- Active student status with a Spanish University/School is mandatory.

- Passionate about a tech career.

- Available for at least a 6-month part-time/internship program.

- Tech-savvy with a curious mind.

- Enthusiastic, capable, and eager to learn.

- A good team player with a responsible, can-do attitude.

- Agile knowledge or certification will be very valuable.

And… What Makes Us Special?

- Paid Internship, up to 30 hours weekly with a flexible schedule.

- LinkedIn and internal training opportunities.

- Special discounts on various brands and products, plus great banking and insurance conditions.

- A welcome pack filled with amazing gadgets.

- A dynamic workspace with tasty coffee and fruit and featuring gaming, gym, and other fun areas!

- Summer and Christmas events and different social clubs such as hiking, investment, beach volley and many more

Looking for a place to start or further develop your career? This is for you! Zurich offers a comprehensive career plan providing a great opportunity to build and enhance your career from the start. You will have the chance to work on global projects, guided by experts and leveraging innovative technologies. Learn from very well-known experts in the field, ensuring you gain valuable experience and knowledge.

Where Are We Located?

Barcelona, Poblenou.

#Li-hybrid

It’s a match? Don’t wait any longer! Apply by sending your CV in English .

If not, no worries! We’ll meet again in the future. Feel free to share this amazing opportunity with anyone you think would be a great fit.

At Zurich, we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best-qualified individuals available, regardless of race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

Zurich Technology Delivery Center – Your Talent, Our Strength

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

- Location(s): ES - Barcelona

- Schedule: Full Time

- Recruiter name: Alba Marin Sola
requirements: Learn from very well-known experts in the field, ensuring you gain valuable experience and knowledge.
Apply by sending your CV in English .

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Are you looking for a caring, collaborative, values-driven workplace with inspiring teammates and leaders? Do you have the ambition and desire to be the best and thrive at the most impactful global insurance provider in the world? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have experience in insurance underwriting, customer relationship management, or a related field and are looking for a new challenge, we would love to hear from you.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for a Bilingual Automobile Senior Underwriter / Underwriter in our Montreal office to analyze and underwrite new and renewal business, regularly interact with the market, and deliver exceptional service to customers.

Reporting to the VP, Liability Manager, Eastern Region, you will be responsible for a portfolio of existing medium to large complex commercial auto risks, but you will also have the ability to develop your automobile portfolio further. Leveraging your broad broker network and your in-depth underwriting knowledge of all automobile products regionally and nationally to grow your book of business. You will use The Zurich Way of Underwriting to analyze and underwrite new and renewal business, under limited direction, within delegated authority levels on highly complex assignments ensuring a high-level service to customers.

This is a unique opportunity to build your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice matters. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.

Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring three days per week of in-person presence, which may include time in the office or market-facing engagements.

What you will do

- Proactively seek renewal and new account opportunities with key broker partners.

- Complete detailed opportunity assessments with key distributors to identify growth opportunities.

- Qualify accounts to meet with the organization's appetite, balanced with sound business opportunity.

- Make agent / broker / customer and on-sight calls with a planned and well-prepared purpose.

- Negotiate Terms & Conditions and close deals.

- Cross-Sell other lines of business to increase product density with the account.

- Participate in Sales Team meeting as related to assigned brokers and / or territory.

- Proactively engage in the target account process, managing a qualified list of opportunities 90 to 120 days prior to effective date.

- Update required systems with details of broker / client visits and account status within specified time frame.

- Serve as key contact for assigned target accounts.

- Develop strong broker and client networks as related to industries underwritten by Business Unit.

- Calculate Target Price accurately by utilizing underwriting tools appropriately.

- Measure exposure / analyze risk.

- Assist in training and developing staff.

- Provide expertise on coverage issues with claims programs and guidelines.

- Travel for business and work extended hours during peak periods, as required.

- Maintain a valid driver’s license.

Job Qualifications - What you bring to the table

Required:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.

OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area.

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area

AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

- Bilingual in French & English

Preferred:

- Bachelor’s Degree

- 5 or more years of experience with commercial lines auto underwriting

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Experience in:

- Medium to large sized, bulk rated fleet risks;

- Loss rated accounts;

- Heavy commercial US exposure and/or US plated

Fluency in both spoken and written English is required to facilitate communication with internal and external stakeholders outside Quebec.

Our Culture

- At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). We want you to bring your whole self to work, and we want our employees to be reflective of the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives are creating an environment where everyone feels welcome.

- We have a collaborative culture where diversity of thought is valued. We value your input and strive to give our employees the tools they need to make an impact.

- We care about our employees’ well-being and offer a comprehensive health/benefits plan with varying levels of coverage to suit your specific needs and a competitive total compensation package.

- We understand how important it is to rest, recharge and do the things you love. At Zurich, all employees receive a minimum of four weeks of vacation per year to do just that.

- We also understand that employees require time off for personal reasons. Maybe you have an appointment during a workday, a cultural or religious holiday you would like to observe, or you need time off to focus on your mental health. Zurich employees receive four personal days per year to be used at their discretion.

- We are committed to continuous improvement and offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.

- We care about our communities. Our communities are where our customers, people, and shareholders live and work. While we can be proud of the contribution to society Zurich makes through our core business of insurance, we must also give back to our communities through our talent, time, and resources.

- We have won numerous awards for our workplace culture. We are proud to be one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers and to have received Insurance Business Canada’s 5-Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award.

Make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

About Us

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-line insurer with approximately 55,000 employees worldwide serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada has been a leading insurance provider serving mid-sized and large companies, including multinational corporations, in the Canadian commercial market for over 100 years. With over 900 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a top insurance provider combined with in-depth knowledge of industries and local markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be risk management professionals’ first choice as their premier partner to help meet the risk challenges of today and tomorrow. Read more at www.zurichcanada.com .

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich strives to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We recruit talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion bring us closer to our common goal: exceeding our customers’ expectations. Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on behalf of, Zurich. We strive to achieve a workplace free of discrimination of all forms, including discrimination on the basis of physical or mental disability, or medical condition. If you are interested in a job opportunity, please advise if you require an accommodation, so we can work with you to provide a more accessible process.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Any unsolicited resume will become the property of Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. If you are a preferred vendor, please use our Recruiting Agency Portal for resume submission.

Only applicable for Canada: For Zurich Canada's commitment to diversity and accessibility please click here . If you would prefer to not receive future electronic messages from Zurich Insurance Company Ltd's recruitment management system, please email your request to have your job profile deleted from the system by clicking here . Zurich Insurance Company Ltd 100 King St., W., Suite 5500, Toronto, ON, M5X 1C9. www.zurichcanada.com

Leveraging your broad broker network and your in-depth underwriting knowledge of all automobile products regionally and nationally to grow your book of business. You will use The Zurich Way of Underwriting to analyze and underwrite new and renewal business, under limited direction, within delegated authority levels on highly complex assignments ensuring a high-level service to customers.

This is a unique opportunity to build your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice matters. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.

Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring three days per week of in-person presence, which may include time in the office or market-facing engagements.

What you will do

- Proactively seek renewal and new account opportunities with key broker partners.

- Complete detailed opportunity assessments with key distributors to identify growth opportunities.

- Qualify accounts to meet with the organization's appetite, balanced with sound business opportunity.

- Make agent / broker / customer and on-sight calls with a planned and well-prepared purpose.

- Negotiate Terms & Conditions and close deals.

- Cross-Sell other lines of business to increase product density with the account.

- Participate in Sales Team meeting as related to assigned brokers and / or territory.

- Proactively engage in the target account process, managing a qualified list of opportunities 90 to 120 days prior to effective date.

- Update required systems with details of broker / client visits and account status within specified time frame.

- Serve as key contact for assigned target accounts.

- Develop strong broker and client networks as related to industries underwritten by Business Unit.

- Calculate Target Price accurately by utilizing underwriting tools appropriately.

- Measure exposure / analyze risk.

- Assist in training and developing staff.

- Provide expertise on coverage issues with claims programs and guidelines.

- Travel for business and work extended hours during peak periods, as required.

- Maintain a valid driver’s license.

Job Qualifications - What you bring to the table

Required:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.

OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area.

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area

AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

- Bilingual in French & English

Preferred:

- Bachelor’s Degree

- 5 or more years of experience with commercial lines auto underwriting

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Experience in:

- Medium to large sized, bulk rated fleet risks;

- Loss rated accounts;

- Heavy commercial US exposure and/or US plated

Fluency in both spoken and written English is required to facilitate communication with internal and external stakeholders outside Quebec.

Our Culture

- At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). We want you to bring your whole self to work, and we want our employees to be reflective of the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives are creating an environment where everyone feels welcome.

- We have a collaborative culture where diversity of thought is valued. We value your input and strive to give our employees the tools they need to make an impact.

- We care about our employees’ well-being and offer a comprehensive health/benefits plan with varying levels of coverage to suit your specific needs and a competitive total compensation package.

- We understand how important it is to rest, recharge and do the things you love. At Zurich, all employees receive a minimum of four weeks of vacation per year to do just that.

- We also understand that employees require time off for personal reasons. Maybe you have an appointment during a workday, a cultural or religious holiday you would like to observe, or you need time off to focus on your mental health. Zurich employees receive four personal days per year to be used at their discretion.

- We are committed to continuous improvement and offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.

- We care about our communities. Our communities are where our customers, people, and shareholders live and work. While we can be proud of the contribution to society Zurich makes through our core business of insurance, we must also give back to our communities through our talent, time, and resources.

- We have won numerous awards for our workplace culture. We are proud to be one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers and to have received Insurance Business Canada’s 5-Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award.

Make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

About Us

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-line insurer with approximately 55,000 employees worldwide serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada has been a leading insurance provider serving mid-sized and large companies, including multinational corporations, in the Canadian commercial market for over 100 years. With over 900 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a top insurance provider combined with in-depth knowledge of industries and local markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be risk management professionals’ first choice as their premier partner to help meet the risk challenges of today and tomorrow. Read more at www.zurichcanada.com .

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich strives to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We recruit talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion bring us closer to our common goal: exceeding our customers’ expectations. Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on behalf of, Zurich. We strive to achieve a workplace free of discrimination of all forms, including discrimination on the basis of physical or mental disability, or medical condition. If you are interested in a job opportunity, please advise if you require an accommodation, so we can work with you to provide a more accessible process.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Any unsolicited resume will become the property of Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. If you are a preferred vendor, please use our Recruiting Agency Portal for resume submission.

Only applicable for Canada: For Zurich Canada's commitment to diversity and accessibility please click here . If you would prefer to not receive future electronic messages from Zurich Insurance Company Ltd's recruitment management system, please email your request to have your job profile deleted from the system by clicking here . Zurich Insurance Company Ltd 100 King St., W., Suite 5500, Toronto, ON, M5X 1C9. www.zurichcanada.com
