jobs.title: Underwriter
jobs.description:
A new transformational adventure awaits you…

How does 5 weeks of annual leave, a fulfilling career you'll genuinely enjoy, and working for a reputable organization that promotes wellbeing and drives digital transformation sound to you?

As one of Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ and Fortune’s ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ for 2025, Zurich - a leader in the insurance industry, is on a journey towards a brighter future… A brighter future for you - focused on your career, your wellbeing, and your community - as well as our customers and the planet.

Join us on this thrilling journey as we work towards our vision of becoming Australia's leading digital insurer. If you're eager to be part of a values-driven global organisation that's experiencing real growth and transformation, and if you share our commitment to making a tangible difference and taking continuous steps towards a sustainable future for our people, customers, communities, and our planet, then keep reading!

Let’s create a brighter future together, let’s make a difference

It’s important to know, what you do matters. At Zurich, we don’t just cover, we care.

As a Life Underwriter in our Retail Underwriting team, you’ll play a key role in helping customers protect what matters most. Working closely with advisers, customers and internal partners, you’ll assess risk thoughtfully and make balanced underwriting decisions that support sustainable outcomes.

This role sits at the heart of our life insurance business. It’s where technical judgement, customer care and collaboration come together, and where you’ll have the opportunity to build your capability, contribute to continuous improvement, and grow your career as we continue our digital transformation journey.

You will also be responsible for the following:

- Assessing new business, policy additions and alterations across life risk products.

- Making timely, high-quality underwriting decisions aligned to Zurich’s risk appetite and philosophy.

- Providing technical underwriting guidance and support to advisers and internal stakeholders.

- Building strong, trusted relationships with internal teams, reinsurers and distribution partners.

- Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and capability uplift across the team.

- Acting as a positive ambassador for the Retail Underwriting team and Zurich values.

This is an initial 12-month contract

Important to your success – let’s grow together

You’re someone who brings curiosity, resilience, and sound judgement to your work. You enjoy collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders, balance detail with perspective, and stay focused on delivering fair, customer-led outcomes in a changing environment.

In order to be successful, you will have the following:

- Experience in individual life underwriting, ideally within a retail environment.

- Demonstrated underwriting authority and sound technical decision-making capability.

- Strong understanding of life insurance products, risk assessment and industry practices.

- Knowledge of relevant legislation, regulation and underwriting frameworks.

- Ability to manage workload effectively while maintaining quality and turnaround times.

- Confidence using underwriting systems and working in a digitally enabled environment.

Belong. Zurich is here to support you

There are so many reasons why Zurich is a great place to be and the right choice for you, but here are just a few.

- Enjoy 5 weeks of annual leave for permanent staff through our Z leave initiative, along with 15 days of personal/carer’s leave as we empower our people to manage their own wellbeing. Plus, access to Family Care (parental leave).

- Benefit from a hybrid working arrangement – 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home per week for full-time employees.

- Access programs to stay healthy and feel healthier, receive a AUD$500 wellbeing payment per year, and a AUD$295 new starter e-voucher for your work-from-home setup (flex work - hybrid working), along with other great benefits through our Shine portal.

- Grow and thrive in your career with our award-winning training programs. We support and encourage your development because our strength lies in our people, and we value your individuality.

- Work with global, diverse, and inclusive teams; explore your passions, fuel innovation, drive equity, collaborate, and make a positive difference beyond your role.

- Take advantage of global mobility opportunities across more than 200 countries worldwide.

- Volunteer and work in our state-of-the-art Green Star rated offices (when you are in the office) and dress for your day.

- We plant a tree for every new employee.

- Not to mention our various employer of choice awards/memberships – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity… to name a few.

We could go on, but the main point is that Zurich is a great place to be, where you can truly belong, be yourself, maintain work/life balance, and thrive in a supportive environment.

Zurich is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require any special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to please let us know at the time of your application.

So, if you want to come on an adventure that will build a brighter future together, and feel a sense of togetherness, then please apply today to start your adventure!

Una nuova avventura trasformazionale vi aspetta...

Come fa 5 settimane di congedo annuale, una carriera soddisfacente ti piacerà davvero, e lavorare per un'organizzazione rispettabile che promuove il benessere e guida il suono di trasformazione digitale a te?

Come uno dei Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ e ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ di Fortune per il 2025, Zurigo - leader nel settore assicurativo, è in un viaggio verso un futuro più luminoso... Un futuro più luminoso per voi - focalizzato sulla vostra carriera, il vostro benessere, e la vostra comunità - così come i nostri clienti e il pianeta.

Unisciti a noi in questo viaggio emozionante mentre lavoriamo verso la nostra visione di diventare l'insurretore digitale leader dell'Australia. Se siete desiderosi di far parte di un'organizzazione globale orientata ai valori che sta vivendo una reale crescita e trasformazione, e se condividete il nostro impegno a fare una differenza tangibile e a compiere passi continui verso un futuro sostenibile per la nostra gente, clienti, comunità e il nostro pianeta, continuate a leggere!

Creiamo un futuro più luminoso insieme, facciamo la differenza

E 'importante sapere, quello che fai conta. A Zurigo, non basta coprire, ci interessa.

Come Life Underwriter nel nostro team di sottoscrittura al dettaglio, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nell'aiutare i clienti a proteggere ciò che conta di più. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i consulenti, i clienti e i partner interni, valuterai con pensiero il rischio e prendere decisioni di sottoscrizione equilibrate che supportano i risultati sostenibili.

Questo ruolo si trova nel cuore della nostra attività di assicurazione sulla vita. È dove si uniscono giudizi tecnici, assistenza clienti e collaborazione, e dove avrete la possibilità di costruire la vostra capacità, contribuire al miglioramento continuo, e crescere la vostra carriera mentre continuiamo il nostro viaggio di trasformazione digitale.

Sarete anche responsabili per quanto segue:

- Valutare nuove attività, aggiunte politiche e modifiche nei prodotti a rischio di vita.

- Prendere decisioni di scrittura tempestive e di alta qualità allineate all’appetito e alla filosofia di rischio di Zurigo.

- Fornire assistenza tecnica di sottoscrizione e supporto ai consulenti e agli stakeholder interni.

- Costruire relazioni forti e affidabili con team interni, reassicuratori e partner di distribuzione.

- Contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento continuo e potenziamento della capacità in tutto il team.

- Agire come ambasciatore positivo per il team Retail Underwriting e i valori di Zurigo.

Questo è un contratto iniziale di 12 mesi

Importante per il vostro successo – cresciamo insieme

Sei qualcuno che porta curiosità, resilienza e giudizio sonoro al tuo lavoro. Ti piace collaborare con una vasta gamma di stakeholder, dettagli di equilibrio con la prospettiva, e rimanere concentrati sulla fornitura di risultati equi e guidati dal cliente in un ambiente in evoluzione.

Per avere successo, avrai le seguenti:

- Esperienza nella scrittura della vita individuale, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente di vendita al dettaglio.

- Autorità di sottoscrittura dimostrata e buona capacità di decisione tecnica.

- Forte comprensione dei prodotti di assicurazione sulla vita, valutazione del rischio e pratiche industriali.

- Conoscenza della legislazione, della regolamentazione e dei quadri di scrittura.

- Capacità di gestire il carico di lavoro in modo efficace mantenendo la qualità e i tempi di rotazione.

- Confidenza utilizzando sistemi di sottoscrizione e lavorando in un ambiente digitalmente abilitato.

Da un po'. Zurigo è qui per sostenervi

Ci sono tanti motivi per cui Zurigo è un ottimo posto per essere e la scelta giusta per voi, ma qui ci sono solo alcuni.

- Approfitta di 5 settimane di congedo annuale per il personale permanente attraverso la nostra iniziativa di congedo Z, insieme a 15 giorni di congedo personale/carer, in modo che il nostro popolo possa gestire il proprio benessere. Inoltre, l'accesso a Family Care (partita genitoriale).

- Approfitta di un accordo di lavoro ibrido – 3 giorni in ufficio e 2 giorni di lavoro da casa a settimana per i dipendenti a tempo pieno.

- Programmi di accesso per rimanere sano e sentirsi più sano, ricevere un pagamento AUD $ 500 benessere all'anno, e un AUD $ 295 nuovo starter e-voucher per il vostro lavoro-da-home setup (lavoro flessibile - lavoro ibrido), insieme ad altri grandi benefici attraverso il nostro portale Shine.

- Crescere e prosperare nella tua carriera con i nostri programmi di formazione pluripremiati. Sosteniamo e incoraggiamo il vostro sviluppo perché la nostra forza è nella nostra gente, e apprezziamo la vostra individualità.

- Lavorare con team globali, diversi e inclusivi; esplorare le vostre passioni, innovazione del carburante, guidare l'equità, collaborare e fare una differenza positiva al di là del vostro ruolo.

- Approfitta delle opportunità di mobilità globale in oltre 200 paesi in tutto il mondo.

- Volontariato e lavoro nei nostri uffici all'avanguardia Green Star (quando sei in ufficio) e vestire per la tua giornata.

- Pianifichiamo un albero per ogni nuovo dipendente.

- Per non parlare dei nostri diversi datori di lavoro di assegnazioni / borse di studio – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity... per citarne alcuni.

Potremmo andare avanti, ma il punto principale è che Zurigo è un ottimo posto per essere, dove si può veramente appartenere, essere te stesso, mantenere l'equilibrio lavoro / vita, e prosperare in un ambiente di supporto.

Zurigo è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a garantire che il nostro processo di reclutamento sia equo e accessibile a tutti i candidati. Se avete bisogno di alloggi speciali per partecipare al nostro processo di reclutamento, vi invitiamo a farci sapere al momento della vostra applicazione.

Quindi, se si vuole venire in un'avventura che costruirà un futuro più luminoso insieme, e sentire un senso di insieme, quindi si prega di applicare oggi per iniziare la vostra avventura!

Ein neues transformatives Abenteuer erwartet Sie...

Wie klingen 5 Wochen Jahresurlaub, eine erfüllende Karriere, die Sie wirklich genießen werden, und die Arbeit für eine seriöse Organisation, die das Wohlbefinden fördert und die digitale Transformation vorantreibt?

Als eines der Forbes 2024 "World's Best Employers" und Fortune's "World's Most Admired Companies" für 2025 ist Zurich - ein führendes Unternehmen der Versicherungsbranche - auf dem Weg in eine bessere Zukunft. Eine bessere Zukunft für Sie - konzentriert auf Ihre Karriere, Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Gemeinschaft - sowie unsere Kunden und den Planeten.

Begleiten Sie uns auf dieser aufregenden Reise, während wir auf unsere Vision hinarbeiten, Australiens führender digitaler Versicherer zu werden. Wenn Sie Teil einer werteorientierten globalen Organisation sein möchten, die echtes Wachstum und Transformation erlebt, und wenn Sie unser Engagement teilen, einen spürbaren Unterschied zu machen und kontinuierliche Schritte in Richtung einer nachhaltigen Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeiter, Kunden, Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten zu unternehmen, dann lesen Sie weiter!

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schaffen, lasst uns einen Unterschied machen

Es ist wichtig zu wissen, was du tust. Bei Zürich decken wir nicht nur ab, wir kümmern uns.

Als Life Underwriter in unserem Retail Underwriting-Team spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle dabei, Kunden dabei zu helfen, das Wichtigste zu schützen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Beratern, Kunden und internen Partnern bewerten Sie das Risiko sorgfältig und treffen ausgewogene Zeichnungsentscheidungen, die nachhaltige Ergebnisse unterstützen.

Diese Rolle steht im Mittelpunkt unseres Lebensversicherungsgeschäfts. Hier kommen technisches Urteilsvermögen, Kundenbetreuung und Zusammenarbeit zusammen und Sie haben die Möglichkeit, Ihre Fähigkeiten auszubauen, zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung beizutragen und Ihre Karriere auszubauen, während wir unsere digitale Transformation fortsetzen.

Sie sind auch für Folgendes verantwortlich:

- Bewertung von Neugeschäften, politischen Ergänzungen und Änderungen bei Lebensrisikoprodukten.

- Rechtzeitige, qualitativ hochwertige Zeichnungsentscheidungen, die sich an der Risikobereitschaft und -philosophie von Zurich orientieren.

- Bereitstellung technischer Zeichnungsberatung und Unterstützung für Berater und interne Stakeholder.

- Aufbau starker, vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu internen Teams, Rückversicherern und Vertriebspartnern.

- Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen und Fähigkeiten im gesamten Team.

- Als positiver Botschafter für das Retail Underwriting Team und Zürich Werte.

Dies ist ein erster 12-Monats-Vertrag

Wichtig für Ihren Erfolg – wachsen wir zusammen

Du bist jemand, der Neugier, Resilienz und gesundes Urteilsvermögen in deine Arbeit bringt. Sie arbeiten gerne mit einer Vielzahl von Stakeholdern zusammen, balancieren Details mit Perspektiven und konzentrieren sich weiterhin auf faire, kundenorientierte Ergebnisse in einem sich verändernden Umfeld.

Um erfolgreich zu sein, haben Sie Folgendes:

- Erfahrung im individuellen Leben Underwriting, idealerweise in einem Retail-Umfeld.

- Nachgewiesene versicherungstechnische Autorität und solide technische Entscheidungsfähigkeit.

- Starkes Verständnis von Lebensversicherungsprodukten, Risikobewertung und Branchenpraktiken.

- Kenntnis der einschlägigen Rechtsvorschriften, Vorschriften und Zeichnungsrahmen.

- Fähigkeit, die Arbeitsbelastung effektiv zu verwalten und gleichzeitig die Qualität und Durchlaufzeiten beizubehalten.

- Vertrauen mit Underwriting-Systemen und Arbeiten in einer digital aktivierten Umgebung.

Belong. Zürich ist da, um Sie zu unterstützen

Es gibt so viele Gründe, warum Zürich ein großartiger Ort ist und die richtige Wahl für Sie, aber hier sind nur einige.

- Genießen Sie 5 Wochen Jahresurlaub für ständige Mitarbeiter durch unsere Z-Urlaubsinitiative, zusammen mit 15 Tagen persönlichen / Pflegeurlaub, während wir unsere Mitarbeiter befähigen, ihr eigenes Wohlbefinden zu verwalten. Plus, Zugang zur Familienbetreuung (Elternurlaub).

- Profitieren Sie von einer hybriden Arbeitsvereinbarung - 3 Tage im Büro und 2 Tage Arbeit von zu Hause pro Woche für Vollzeitmitarbeiter.

- Zugang zu Programmen, um gesund zu bleiben und sich gesünder zu fühlen, erhalten eine AUD $ 500 Wohlbefindenszahlung pro Jahr und einen AUD $ 295 neuen Starter-E-Gutschein für Ihr Work-from-Home-Setup (Flex-Arbeit - Hybrid-Arbeit), zusammen mit anderen großen Vorteilen durch unser Shine-Portal.

- Wachsen und gedeihen Sie in Ihrer Karriere mit unseren preisgekrönten Trainingsprogrammen. Wir unterstützen und fördern Ihre Entwicklung, weil unsere Stärke in unseren Mitarbeitern liegt und wir Ihre Individualität schätzen.

- Arbeiten Sie mit globalen, vielfältigen und integrativen Teams zusammen; entdecken Sie Ihre Leidenschaften, fördern Sie Innovationen, fördern Sie Gerechtigkeit, arbeiten Sie zusammen und machen Sie einen positiven Unterschied über Ihre Rolle hinaus.

- Nutzen Sie globale Mobilitätsmöglichkeiten in mehr als 200 Ländern weltweit.

- Freiwillige und arbeiten Sie in unseren hochmodernen Green Star Büros (wenn Sie im Büro sind) und kleiden Sie sich für Ihren Tag.

- Wir pflanzen einen Baum für jeden neuen Mitarbeiter.

- Ganz zu schweigen von unseren verschiedenen Arbeitgeberpreisen / Mitgliedschaften - WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Arbeitgeber, Stolz auf Vielfalt ... um nur einige zu nennen.

Wir könnten weitermachen, aber der Hauptpunkt ist, dass Zürich ein großartiger Ort ist, an dem Sie wirklich dazugehören, Sie selbst sein, die Work-Life-Balance aufrechterhalten und in einer unterstützenden Umgebung gedeihen können.

Zürich ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, dass unser Rekrutierungsprozess fair und für alle Kandidaten zugänglich ist. Wenn Sie spezielle Unterkünfte benötigen, um an unserem Rekrutierungsprozess teilzunehmen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, uns dies zum Zeitpunkt Ihrer Bewerbung mitzuteilen.

Wenn Sie also auf ein Abenteuer kommen möchten, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft aufbauen und ein Gefühl der Zusammengehörigkeit spüren wird, dann bewerben Sie sich bitte noch heute, um Ihr Abenteuer zu beginnen!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une nouvelle aventure transformationnelle vous attend...

Comment 5 semaines de congé annuel, une carrière épanouissante que vous apprécierez vraiment, et travailler pour une organisation de bonne réputation qui favorise le bien-être et entraîne la transformation numérique pour vous ?

Comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs de Forbes 2024 ‘World's et Fortune's ‘World's Les sociétés les plus admirées de 2025, Zurich - un leader dans le secteur de l'assurance, est sur un chemin vers un avenir plus brillant... Un avenir meilleur pour vous - axé sur votre carrière, votre bien-être et votre communauté - ainsi que nos clients et la planète.

Joignez-vous à nous pour ce passionnant voyage alors que nous travaillons vers notre vision de devenir le premier assureur numérique australien. Si vous êtes désireux de faire partie d'une organisation mondiale axée sur les valeurs qui connaît une croissance et une transformation réelles, et si vous partagez notre engagement à faire une différence tangible et à prendre des mesures continues en vue d'un avenir durable pour nos gens, nos clients, nos communautés et notre planète, continuez à lire!

Laissez-les créer un avenir meilleur ensemble, laissez faire une différence

C'est important de savoir ce que vous faites. A Zurich, on ne couvre pas, on s'en fiche.

En tant que souscripteur de vie dans notre équipe de souscription au détail, vous jouerez un rôle clé pour aider les clients à protéger ce qui compte le plus. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des conseillers, des clients et des partenaires internes, vous évaluerez les risques avec soin et prendrez des décisions équilibrées de souscription qui soutiennent des résultats durables.

Ce rôle est au cœur de notre entreprise d'assurance-vie. C'est là que le jugement technique, le service à la clientèle et la collaboration se rassemblent, et où vous aurez l'occasion de renforcer votre capacité, de contribuer à l'amélioration continue et de développer votre carrière alors que nous poursuivons notre parcours de transformation numérique.

Vous serez également responsable de ce qui suit :

- Évaluer les nouvelles activités, les ajouts aux politiques et les modifications à apporter aux produits à risque pour la vie.

- Faire des décisions de souscription opportunes et de haute qualité alignées sur Zurich risque l'appétit et la philosophie.

- Fournir des conseils et un appui techniques aux conseillers et aux intervenants internes.

- Établir des relations solides et fiables avec les équipes internes, les réassureurs et les partenaires de distribution.

- Contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration continue et accroître les capacités dans l'ensemble de l'équipe.

- En tant qu'ambassadeur positif pour l'équipe de souscription de détail et les valeurs de Zurich.

C'est un contrat initial de 12 mois

Important pour votre succès – laissez grandir ensemble

Vous êtes quelqu'un qui apporte la curiosité, la résilience et le jugement sain à votre travail. Vous aimez collaborer avec un large éventail d'intervenants, équilibrer les détails avec la perspective et rester concentré sur l'obtention de résultats équitables et dirigés par les clients dans un environnement en évolution.

Pour réussir, vous aurez :

- Expérience de la souscription individuelle, idéalement dans un environnement de vente au détail.

- Pouvoir de souscription prouvé et bonne capacité de décision technique.

- Bonne compréhension des produits d'assurance-vie, de l'évaluation des risques et des pratiques de l'industrie.

- Connaissance des cadres législatifs, réglementaires et de souscription pertinents.

- Capacité de gérer efficacement la charge de travail tout en maintenant la qualité et les délais d'exécution.

- Confiance en utilisant des systèmes de souscription et en travaillant dans un environnement numérique.

C'est moi. Zurich est là pour vous soutenir

Il y a tant de raisons pour lesquelles Zurich est un endroit idéal et le bon choix pour vous, mais voici quelques-uns.

- Profitez de 5 semaines de congé annuel pour le personnel permanent par le biais de notre initiative de congé Z, ainsi que 15 jours de congé personnel/porteur pendant que nous autorisons nos gens à gérer leur propre bien-être. De plus, accès aux soins familiaux (congé parental).

- Bénéficiez d'un arrangement de travail hybride – 3 jours au bureau et 2 jours de travail à domicile par semaine pour les employés à temps plein.

- Programmes d'accès pour rester en bonne santé et se sentir en meilleure santé, recevoir un paiement de bien-être de 500 $ AUD par année, et un nouvel e-voucher AUD $ 295 pour votre travail de la maison (travail flexible - travail hybride), ainsi que d'autres grands avantages à travers notre portail Shine.

- Développez et prospèrez dans votre carrière grâce à nos programmes de formation primés. Nous soutenons et encourageons votre développement parce que notre force réside dans notre peuple, et nous apprécions votre individualité.

- Travailler avec des équipes globales, diversifiées et inclusives; explorer vos passions, stimuler l'innovation, stimuler l'équité, collaborer et faire une différence positive au-delà de votre rôle.

- Profitez des possibilités de mobilité mondiale dans plus de 200 pays du monde.

- Volontariat et travail dans nos bureaux à la fine pointe de la technologie Green Star (lorsque vous êtes au bureau) et habillez-vous pour votre journée.

- Nous plantons un arbre pour chaque nouvel employé.

- Sans parler de nos divers employeurs de choix – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity... pour n'en nommer que quelques-uns.

Nous pourrions continuer, mais le point principal est que Zurich est un endroit idéal pour être, où vous pouvez vraiment appartenir, être vous-même, maintenir l'équilibre travail/vie personnelle, et prospérer dans un environnement favorable.

Zurich est un employeur à chances égales. Nous nous engageons à faire en sorte que notre processus de recrutement soit équitable et accessible à tous les candidats. Si vous avez besoin d'adaptations spéciales pour participer à notre processus de recrutement, nous vous encourageons à nous en informer au moment de votre candidature.

Donc, si vous voulez venir sur une aventure qui va construire un avenir plus brillant ensemble, et sentir un sentiment d'union, alors s'il vous plaît appliquer aujourd'hui pour commencer votre aventure!

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Programs
jobs.description:
Zurich North America is hiring a Senior Program Manager to join our Middle Markets Programs team! We are open to hiring strong Underwriting talent in a hybrid (or fully remote) work environment & will consider talent in the following cities: Chicago IL, Schaumburg IL, Omaha NE, or Atlanta GA and open to others.

As a member of Zurich’s Programs underwriting team, you will enjoy the opportunity to develop your portfolio management skills and collaborate with many stakeholders.

This Senior Program Manager will be responsible for:

- Working with stakeholders to resolve issues and concerns for various Programs within Middle Markets

- Assisting with Dashboard completion and Game Plan updates

- Supporting the Underwriting and product development process

- Executing on referrals from Program Administrators

- Project work as necessary

- Participate in underwriting, sales, claims meetings

Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 7 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 14 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 12 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support are

Preferred Qualifications:

- Good problem-solving skills

- Strong verbal, listening and written communication skills

- Ability to handle multiple and varied assignments

- Eager to learn

- Networking ability

- Embraces change

- Self-starter

- Ownership minded

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The compensation indicated represents a nationwide market range and has not been adjusted for geographic differentials pertaining to the location where the position may be filled. The proposed salary range for this position is $130,000.00 - $190,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 20%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

jobs.description:
【Job Responsibility】

1)AIソリューションエンジニアとして、部内関係者および IT 部門と連携し、LLM／生成AIを活用したオペレーション高度化・自動化を推進する。
2)オペレーション領域の課題を把握し、LLM／生成AIを活用した業務プロセスの改善・自動化を企画・実行する。
3)LLM／生成AIアプリケーションのアーキテクチャ・標準・ガバナンスの整備に寄与する。

【Key Tasks & Accountabilities】

1)LLM／生成AIを活用した業務自動化・業務支援ソリューションの設計・実装（ハンズオン中心）。
2)LLMアプリケーション（RAG構成、プロンプト管理、API連携、ログ・監査基盤など）の開発・標準化への寄与。

4)LLM出力の品質・安全性・コンプライアンスチェックの実装・運用。
5)データサイエンスチーム、IT部門、業務部門と連携したユースケースの実装支援。
6)ジュニアメンバーへの技術的ガイドおよびナレッジ共有。

【
• Qualifications / Experience】

1)AIソリューション開発、データサイエンス、またはソフトウェア／クラウドエンジニアリングのいずれかの分野での実務経験（3年以上が望ましい）。
2)オペレーションの自動化やAI活用に関する実装経験。
3)AzureまたはAWS上でのアプリケーションもしくはデータ基盤の構築・運用経験。
4)RAG、プロンプトエンジニアリング、API連携等に関する基礎的な理解。
5)PythonおよびSQLの実務経験。
6)統計解析や機械学習などのデータ分析経験があれば尚可。
7)保険業界、特に損害保険業界での業務経験があれば尚可。
8)日本語：ビジネスレベル 英語：ビジネスレベル

【募集要項】

・勤務地：東京本社オフィス（東京都中野区東中野3-14-20）または在宅勤務のハイブリッド勤務

・雇用形態：正社員

・勤務時間：フレックスタイム制；始業および終業の時刻は社員の決定に委ねる（標準となる１日の労働時間：7時間）

フレキシブルタイム6時00分から22時00分、コアタイム なし、1日における最低勤務時間 4時間

休憩時間60分（1日の実労働時間が4時間を超える場合）

・給与：当社規程により決定

・休日休暇：年末年始休暇、ペアレンタル・リーブ（6週間の特別有給休暇。社員の性別を問わず取得できる制度）、慶弔休暇、産前産後休暇、ボランティア休暇、Re-Creation休暇

jobs.description:
Zurich, aseguradora líder a nivel internacional te invita a ser parte de su equipo:

SUBDIRECTOR (A) DE RECURSOS HUMANOS

Buscamos un líder capaz de construir e integrar la estrategia de Capital Humano de una alianza entre una institución financiera y una aseguradora, impulsando el crecimiento, la rentabilidad y la transformación organizacional mediante una gestión estratégica del talento y una toma de decisiones basada en resultados.

Objetivo de la posición

Liderar la estrategia integral de Capital Humano de una alianza entre una institución financiera y una aseguradora, definiendo la visión, estructura, cultura y modelo organizacional que impulse el crecimiento, la rentabilidad y la consolidación del negocio.

Será responsable de integrar equipos, procesos y culturas organizacionales, alineando la estrategia de talento con los objetivos del negocio y facilitando la toma de decisiones basada en resultados.

Habilidades y experiencia:

Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Recursos Humanos, Psicología, Administración o afín. Deseable Posgrado.

Experiencia:

- Más de 10 años en posiciones de liderazgo de Recursos Humanos.

- Experiencia en sectores financiero, bancario, asegurador, fintech o empresas reguladas.

- Participación en procesos de integración organizacional, alianzas estratégicas, fusiones o transformación de negocios.

- Experiencia liderando equipos multidisciplinarios y gestionando culturas organizacionales diversas.

- Conocimientos en nómina, compensaciones, relaciones laborales, cumplimiento laboral y estructuras organizacionales.

- Experiencia generando estrategias de talento orientadas al crecimiento, rentabilidad y resultados del negocio.

Principales responsabilidades:

- Definir e implementar la estrategia de Capital Humano de la alianza.

- Integrar equipos, estructuras y culturas organizacionales.

- Alinear la estrategia de personas con los objetivos del negocio.

- Liderar atracción, desarrollo, sucesión y retención del talento.

- Supervisar los procesos de nómina, compensaciones y cumplimiento laboral.

- Impulsar una cultura de alto desempeño y orientación a resultados.

- Generar indicadores y análisis para la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

- Actuar como socio estratégico de la Alta Dirección en iniciativas de crecimiento y transformación.

Competencias clave:

- Visión estratégica y orientación al negocio.

- Toma de decisiones bajo incertidumbre.

- Liderazgo e influencia.

- Pensamiento analítico y gestión por indicadores.

- Gestión del cambio e integración cultural.

- Adaptabilidad, resiliencia e inteligencia emocional.

- Orientación a resultados y rentabilidad.

- Capacidad para integrar perfiles y equipos diversos.

Ofertamos:

- Atractivo esquema de compensación.

- Prestaciones superiores a ley.

- Trabajo Flexible

- Zona de empleo: Toreo de cuatro caminos / Montes Urales

Zurich reconoce la diversidad de nuestra fuerza laboral como una fortaleza, por lo que contamos con políticas y programas de diversidad e inclusión, donde buscamos igualdad de oportunidades sin importar la edad, etnia, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, discapacidades, etc. Como empleador inclusivo, queremos asegurarnos de que todos los candidatos se sientan cómodos y puedan rendir al máximo durante la entrevista.

Por qué elegir Zurich

En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor!

Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

Enviar candidatura ahora »

jobs.title: Fullstack Senior Developer, APAC
jobs.description:
We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity, working as our Fullstack Senior Developer
within the Asia Pacific region. Within the role you’ll build and unit/integration testing of Web
App, APIs and integration.

You will have a chance to be part of new project that will build a new end-to-end Zurich Edge
Insurance Platform to enable new distribution models. Insurance offerings on this platform will
be specifically designed for high levels of automation and straight through processing across
the full insurance value chain.

Key Responsibilities:

- Build a strong understanding of business requirements and translate them into scalable
technical solutions.

- Design and develop fullstack web applications using Nextjs and Nestjs.

- Build responsive, secure, and reusable frontend components aligned with modern
UI/UX standards.

- Develop server-side functionality using Nestjs capabilities, including API routes, server
components, middleware, and backend-for-frontend patterns.

- Design and build domain-centric APIs and integrations.

- Develop REST/JSON APIs and microservices to support platform capabilities.

- Build integrations with internal Zurich systems and external partner platforms.

- Implement synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns, including queue-based
and event-driven flows.

- Integrate with AWS services such as S3, SQS, and other cloud-native components.

- Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, including schema design, query
optimization, and data access patterns.

- Create and maintain API documentation using tools such as Swagger/OpenAPI.

- Perform unit, integration, and end-to-end testing for frontend and backend components.

- Collaborate with product owners, architects, DevOps engineers, QA teams, and other development teams.

- Promote good engineering practices, including clean code, secure coding, code reviews, and maintainable architecture.

- Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code responsibly to improve delivery efficiency.

Your skills and experience:

- 5+ years programming experience.

- Experience with Typescript.

- Strong experience building fullstack applications with Next.js.

- Experience with NestJS Framework.

- Experience integrating with AWS Components eg: S3,SQS, etc.

- Experience with PostgreSql Database.

- Strong experience with API development using REST/JSON, Swagger & Postman

- Synchronous Design Pattern

- Asynchronous Design Pattern

- Experience with SOAP, JavaScript programming, design patterns

- Experience with JIRA, Sonarqube.

- Experience with AI Tools: Github Copilot, Claude Code.

- Knowledge of object-oriented modelling.

- Sound understanding of IT project delivery and agile / DevOps methodologies

Skills:

- Problem solving skills

- Experience with integration design patterns

- Passion for new and emerging technologies. Ability to investigate these in depth.

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

Aquí, apostamos por la Sostenibilidad, innovando en las políticas de desarrollo y uniéndonos cada vez más con los cambios del mundo. Experiencia: Mínimo 6 meses en compañia de seguros

jobs.title: Plan de Carrera para Agentes Profesionales
jobs.description:
Tu Negocio con Zurich | Programa de Desarrollo de Nuevos Agentes

¿Buscas algo más que un empleo? ¿Y si tu próximo paso profesional fuera construir tu propio negocio con el respaldo de Zurich?

Si buscas algo más que un trabajo tradicional, quieres tener más autonomía y te atrae la idea de desarrollar tu propio proyecto profesional, estás en el lugar correcto.

En Zurich lanzamos nuestro Programa de Desarrollo para Agentes Exclusivos en [Málaga / Valencia / Sevilla / Tenerife / Alicante / Mallorca / Castellón].

Se trata de una oportunidad para desarrollar tu propio negocio como autónomo siendo agente exclusivo para Zurich, creando así tu propia agencia, con el respaldo, la formación, las herramientas y el acompañamiento de una compañía sólida, reconocida y con una apuesta clara por el crecimiento de su red de agentes.

Esta oportunidad no va solo de vender seguros.

Va de crear tu propia actividad profesional, desarrollar una cartera de clientes y crecer acompañado desde el primer día.

¿Cómo será tu día a día?

Asesoramiento de alto valor: Asesorarás a personas, familias y empresas para ayudarles a proteger lo que más les importa, ofreciendo soluciones aseguradoras adaptadas a sus necesidades.

Desarrollo de tu propio negocio
Construirás tu propia cartera de clientes y desarrollarás una actividad profesional con recorrido, apoyándote en una marca reconocida y en un modelo pensado para crecer.

Una propuesta de valor pensada para ayudarte a crecer
Tendrás una propuesta de valor sólida y servicios de apoyo pensados para que puedas centrarte en lo importante: generar confianza, asesorar bien a tus clientes y hacer crecer tu negocio.

Gestión comercial con herramientas digitales
Contarás con herramientas, datos y recursos comerciales que te ayudarán a gestionar oportunidades, hacer seguimiento de clientes y dedicar más tiempo a generar negocio.

Autonomía con acompañamiento
Organizarás tu actividad con autonomía, pero no estarás solo. Tendrás el apoyo de profesionales expertos que te acompañarán en tu arranque, planificación comercial y evolución como agente.

¿Encajas en esta propuesta?

No buscamos la perfección, ¡buscamos actitud, iniciativa y ganas reales de construir algo propio!

Este plan es ideal si tienes estudios mínimos (Bachillerato, FP o Grado), aptitudes comunicativas y en servicio al cliente y tienes vocación comercial.

Valoramos la experiencia previa en el sector asegurador o en posiciones comerciales, pero no es imprescindible.
Lo importante es que tengas ambición, compromiso y ganas de aprender.

¿Qué te ofrecemos en Zurich?

Un programa para ayudarte a construir tu propio negocio
No se trata solo de empezar como agente. Se trata de hacerlo acompañado, con un programa diseñado para ayudarte a arrancar, aprender, ganar confianza comercial y crecer paso a paso.

Formación y certificación oficial
Financiamos tu curso homologado de mediación (Nivel 2 DGSFP) y te acompañaremos para que puedas iniciar tu actividad profesional con una base sólida.

Acompañamiento desde el primer día
Contarás con apoyo experto para orientarte en tus primeros pasos, ayudarte a planificar tu actividad comercial y acompañarte en el desarrollo de tu negocio

Tranquilidad Financiera Inicial y elevado potencial de crecimiento: modelo de comisiones e incentivos altamente competitivo, complementado con un esquema de apoyo económico durante el arranque

Una carrera con futuro
Queremos acompañarte para que puedas construir una cartera, consolidar tu actividad profesional y desarrollar una agencia con recorrido.

¿Por qué Zurich?

Porque no queremos que seas un agente más.

Queremos acompañarte en la construcción de tu propio negocio, con formación, herramientas, apoyo comercial y una marca que apuesta por el desarrollo de nuevos agentes como una palanca clave de crecimiento.

Estamos construyendo la nueva generación de agentes Zurich.

Y queremos contar con personas que quieran formar parte de este proyecto desde el inicio.

¿Sientes que esto es para ti?

Si te ves construyendo tu propio negocio, no lo pienses más, haz clic en inscribirte. Estaré encantada de conocerte, tomar un café (virtual o real) y contarte cómo puedes empezar a construir tu carrera como agente profesional independiente con el respaldo de Zurich.

Empieza a construir tu propio negocio con Zurich.

Enviar candidatura ahora »

Hola!

Soy Maschio, recuit from este proyecto

Me encanta la música, ir a la playa y conocer a gente nueva. Y hoy estoy aquí para contarte algo que, si estás empezando tu camino profesional (o replanteándotelo), puede interesarte mucho.

Antes de nada, gracias por leer esta oferta . Verdad.

A Zurigo estamos lanzando a Plan de Carrera para Agents Profesionales en Málaga y Valencia (aunque si no estás en alguna de estas Provinces, sigue leyendo que a lo mejor te interesa) , pensado para personas jóvenes con ganas de aprender, crecer y construir un proyecto profesional con futuro. Nessun hablamos solo de un trabajo, sino de una oportunidad para desarrollarte paso a paso, con acompañamiento real y el respaldo de una compañía sólida y cercana.

Un proyecto parabuilder tu futuro

Este plan no es un puesto comercial al uso. Es un itinerario desarrollo profesional , diseñado para que puedas aprender el negocio desde dentro, ganar experiencia, confianza y autonomía, y construir tu propia cartera de clients de forma sostenible.

A Zurigo creemos que nadie nace sabiendo y que el crecimiento se logra con formación, apoyo y tiempo. Por eso, este plan combina aprendizaje costante, acompañamiento cerca y la libertad necesaria para que vayas creando tu propio camino.

¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Misión será acompañar a personas y empresas en epocas importantes de su vida, ayudándoles a proteger lo que más import. Aprenderás a rilevaar sus necessides, a asesorarles de forma cercana y profesional y a ofrecer soluciones aseguradoras adattaadas a cada situazioneción.

Tu día a día combinará actividad comercial, aprendizaje continuo y desarrollo de tu propio proyecto. Irás construyendo relaciones de confianza, haciendo crecer tu cartera de clientelas y trabajando con objetivos claros, siempre con el apoyo de formación, herramientas digitales y un equipo que estará ahí para acompañarte.

Qual e' il problema?

No si vede pedir che cumblas el 100% los requisitis o vienes del settore asegurador. Lo que buscamos es actitud, curiosità y ganas de crecer . Aunque estamos Ethicisme principalmente a personas en Málaga y Valencia, siempre estamos abiertos a encontrar el Talento más TOP, independientemente de dónde esté ubicado.

Este plan es para ti si te motiva el trato con personas, si te organizas bien, te responsibilizas de tus objetivos y atrae un proyecto con visión a largo plazo. Valoraremos experiencia previa en ventas o atención al cliente, pero no es imprescindibile. Davvero importante sei potencial y tus ganas da prendere.

¿Qué te ofrecemos desde Zurich?

Te ofrecemos un plan de carrera estructurado, con una evolución clara y real. Desde el primer día contarás con formación incial y continua, acompañamiento cerca y soporte comercial, tecnico y de marketing para que nunca te sientas solo/a.

Además, disfrutarás de un modelo económico competitivo orientaledo al crecimiento progresivo, flexibilidad para organizar tu actividad y el respaldo de una compañía líder, sólida y con una clara visión de futuro.

Se ha llegado hasta aquí... Gracias por leerme hasta el finale.

jobs.title: RCIS Crop Field Service Representative - Indiana
jobs.description:
RCIS provides insurance and superior services through leading agents to protect America’s farmers and ranchers. It’s been an innovator in crop insurance since the crop insurance business was privatized by the federal government in 1980. Today it’s one of the nation’s largest crop insurance providers, offering risk management protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 4,000 professionally trained and licensed agents.

We are currently looking for a Field Service Representative to handle a book of business with accounts in Indiana. Estimated windshield time is 50%. This is a work from home role with a company car provided. The ideal candidate must live in the territory. However, we may consider other locations within the region.

In this critical role you will be responsible for but not limited to:

- Delivers profitable growth through selling a broad and differentiated suite of solutions in a unified way and manage the existing Crop Insurance portfolio.

- Develops intimate knowledge of agent’s business model and proposition, and creates a business plan which optimizes identified opportunities that align with our growth strategies

- Leads and manages holistic agent and customer value propositions to deliver profitable growth.

- Retain business and grow market share in assigned territory by providing an enhanced customer experience for RCIS agents.

- Educate agents on RCIS products and provide consultation on how to more effectively market RCIS products to their customers and grow their business.

- Identify new or enhanced products and services that will assist agencies in maintaining and growing their business with RCIS.

- Identify training needs and take a lead role in training agents on RCIS products and software. Coordinate and present at agent training meetings.

- Identify and analyze processing & servicing issues, make recommendations for solutions and collaborate with applicable departments to drive toward resolution.

- Ensure that agents are complying with all regulatory requirements related to processing their business, working with other departments to establish quality control processes as needed.

- Provide subject matter expertise and assist in the development of SOPs as appropriate.

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s Degree with 6 or more years of experience in the Crop Insurance, sales or market-facing area

OR
• Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including Associates Degree with 6 or more years of experience in the Crop Insurance, sales or market-facing area

OR
• High School Diploma or equivalent with 8 or more years of experience in the insurance sales or market-facing area

AND
• Experience building and managing relationships externally and internally and meeting sales, retention and profitability goals
• Experience identifying business trends, changes in market conditions and competitor activity

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience in Crop Insurance
• Ability to execute effective sales strategies

• Market and distribution experience in the insurance industry
• Strong understanding of insurance industry from a market and underwriting perspective
• Strong verbal and written communication skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The combined salary range for this positionis between $87,200 and $117,000, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set between 10% to 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

descriptionByLocale.it:
RCIS fornisce assicurazioni e servizi superiori attraverso agenti leader per proteggere gli agricoltori e gli allevatori americani. È stato un innovatore nell’assicurazione delle colture dal momento che il commercio di assicurazione delle colture è stato privatizzato dal governo federale nel 1980. Oggi è uno dei più grandi fornitori di assicurazione coltura della nazione, offrendo protezione di gestione del rischio in tutti i 50 stati attraverso una rete nazionale di circa 4.000 agenti professionalmente addestrati e licenziati.

Stiamo attualmente cercando un rappresentante del servizio di campo per gestire un libro di affari con i conti in Indiana. Tempo stimato del parabrezza è del 50%. Questo è un lavoro da casa ruolo con un'auto aziendale fornito. Il candidato ideale deve vivere nel territorio. Tuttavia, possiamo considerare altre località all'interno della regione.

In questo ruolo critico sarai responsabile ma non limitato a:

- Fornisce una crescita redditizia attraverso la vendita di una vasta e differenziata suite di soluzioni in modo unificato e gestire il portafoglio di assicurazione cropa esistente.

- Sviluppa la conoscenza intima del modello e della proposta di business dell'agente, e crea un business plan che ottimizza le opportunità identificate che si allineano con le nostre strategie di crescita

- Conduce e gestisce l'agente olistico e proposizioni di valore del cliente per offrire una crescita redditizia.

- Mantenere la quota di mercato e crescere nel territorio assegnato fornendo una migliore esperienza di cliente per gli agenti RCIS.

- Educare gli agenti sui prodotti RCIS e fornire consulenza su come commercializzare più efficacemente i prodotti RCIS ai loro clienti e far crescere il loro business.

- Identificare nuovi o potenziati prodotti e servizi che aiuteranno le agenzie a mantenere e crescere il loro business con RCIS.

- Identificare le esigenze di formazione e assumere un ruolo guida negli agenti di formazione sui prodotti e software RCIS. Coordinate e presenti alle riunioni di formazione degli agenti.

- Identificare e analizzare i problemi di elaborazione e manutenzione, formulare raccomandazioni per le soluzioni e collaborare con i dipartimenti applicabili per guidare verso la risoluzione.

- Assicurarsi che gli agenti sono conformi a tutti i requisiti normativi relativi al trattamento della loro attività, lavorando con altri dipartimenti per stabilire processi di controllo della qualità secondo le necessità.

- Fornire competenze in materia e assistere allo sviluppo delle SOP come appropriato.

Qualifiche di base:
• Corso di laurea con 6 o più anni di esperienza nel Crop Assicurazione, vendite o area di mercato

O
• Apprendistato di assicurazione certificato di Zurigo, tra cui Associates Degree con 6 o più anni di esperienza nella zona di assicurazione, vendite o mercato

O
• Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente con 8 o più anni di esperienza nel settore delle vendite di assicurazione o mercato

E
• Esperienza di costruzione e gestione dei rapporti esternamente e internamente e incontri obiettivi di vendita, ritenzione e redditività
• Esperienza che identifica le tendenze aziendali, i cambiamenti delle condizioni di mercato e l'attività dei concorrenti

Preferiti:
• Esperienza in Crop Assicurazione
• Capacità di eseguire strategie di vendita efficaci

• Esperienza di mercato e distribuzione nel settore assicurativo
• Forte comprensione dell'industria assicurativa da una prospettiva di mercato e di sottoscrizione
• Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta

La tua paga a Zurigo si basa sul tuo ruolo, posizione, competenze e esperienza. Seguiamo le leggi locali per garantire una giusta compensazione. Si può anche essere idonei per bonus e aumenti di merito. Se le vostre aspettative sono al di sopra della gamma elencata, vi incoraggiamo ancora ad applicare – il vostro background unico conta per noi.

L'intervallo di stipendio combinato per questa posizione è tra $87,200 e $117,000, con l'ammissibilità bonus di incentivazione a breve termine impostata tra il 10% e il 15%.

Offriamo vantaggi competitivi e completi per i dipendenti e le loro famiglie. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Perché Zurigo?

A Zurigo, apprezziamo le tue idee e le tue esperienze. Offriamo crescita, inclusione e un ambiente di supporto, in modo da poter contribuire a plasmare il futuro dell'assicurazione. Zurigo Nord America è leader nella gestione dei rischi, con oltre 150 anni di esperienza e copertura in 25 settori, tra cui il 90% della Fortune 500®.

Unisciti a noi per un futuro più luminoso, per te e per i nostri clienti.

Zurigo in Nord America non discrimina in base a razza, etnia, colore, religione, origine nazionale, sesso, espressione di genere, identità di genere, informazioni genetiche, età, disabilità, stato veterano protetto, stato civile, orientamento sessuale, gravidanza o altre caratteristiche protette dalla legge applicabile. Pari opportunità Disabilità del datore di lavoro/vet.

Zurigo è conforme al codice 18 degli Stati Uniti § 1033.

Nota bene: Zurigo non accetta CV non richiesti dalle agenzie. I fornitori preferiti dovrebbero utilizzare il nostro Recruiting Agency Portal.

RCIS bietet Versicherungen und erstklassige Dienstleistungen durch führende Agenten an, um Amerikas Landwirte und Viehzüchter zu schützen. Es ist ein Innovator in der Ernteversicherung, seit das Ernteversicherungsgeschäft 1980 von der Bundesregierung privatisiert wurde. Heute ist es einer der größten Ernteversicherungsanbieter des Landes und bietet Risikomanagementschutz in allen 50 Staaten durch ein nationales Netzwerk von etwa 4.000 professionell ausgebildeten und lizenzierten Agenten.

Wir suchen derzeit einen Außendienstmitarbeiter, um ein Geschäftsbuch mit Konten in Indiana zu verwalten. Geschätzte Windschutzscheibenzeit beträgt 50%. Dies ist eine Arbeit von zu Hause Rolle mit einem Dienstwagen zur Verfügung gestellt. Der ideale Kandidat muss auf dem Territorium leben. Wir können jedoch andere Standorte in der Region in Betracht ziehen.

In dieser kritischen Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf:

- Ermöglicht profitables Wachstum durch den Verkauf einer breiten und differenzierten Lösungssuite auf einheitliche Weise und die Verwaltung des bestehenden Crop Insurance Portfolios.

- Entwickelt ein intimes Wissen über das Geschäftsmodell und den Vorschlag des Agenten und erstellt einen Geschäftsplan, der identifizierte Chancen optimiert, die mit unseren Wachstumsstrategien übereinstimmen

- Leitet und verwaltet ganzheitliche Agenten- und Kundenwertversprechen, um profitables Wachstum zu erzielen.

- Behalten Sie das Geschäft und erhöhen Sie den Marktanteil in zugewiesenen Gebieten, indem Sie RCIS-Agenten ein verbessertes Kundenerlebnis bieten.

- Erziehen Sie Agenten zu RCIS-Produkten und beraten Sie, wie Sie RCIS-Produkte effektiver an ihre Kunden vermarkten und ihr Geschäft ausbauen können.

- Identifizieren Sie neue oder verbesserte Produkte und Dienstleistungen, die Agenturen bei der Aufrechterhaltung und dem Wachstum ihres Geschäfts mit RCIS unterstützen.

- Identifizieren Sie den Schulungsbedarf und übernehmen Sie eine führende Rolle in den Schulungsmitarbeitern für RCIS-Produkte und -Software. Koordinieren und präsentieren Sie sich bei Agentenschulungen.

- Identifizieren und analysieren Sie Verarbeitungs- und Serviceprobleme, geben Sie Empfehlungen für Lösungen und arbeiten Sie mit den zuständigen Abteilungen zusammen, um eine Lösung zu erreichen.

- Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Agenten alle regulatorischen Anforderungen in Bezug auf die Verarbeitung ihres Geschäfts erfüllen, und arbeiten Sie mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen, um bei Bedarf Qualitätskontrollprozesse einzurichten.

- Bereitstellung von Fachkenntnissen und gegebenenfalls Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von SOPs.

Grundqualifikationen:
• Bachelor-Abschluss mit 6 oder mehr Jahren Erfahrung in den Bereichen Crop Insurance, Sales oder Market-facing

ODER
• Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, einschließlich Associates Degree mit 6 oder mehr Jahren Erfahrung in den Bereichen Crop Insurance, Sales oder Market-facing

ODER
• High School Diplom oder gleichwertig mit 8 oder mehr Jahren Erfahrung im Versicherungsverkauf oder Marktbereich

UND
• Erleben Sie den Aufbau und die Verwaltung von Beziehungen nach außen und intern und die Erfüllung von Umsatz-, Bindungs- und Rentabilitätszielen
• Erfahrung bei der Identifizierung von Geschäftstrends, Veränderungen der Marktbedingungen und der Aktivität der Wettbewerber

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:
• Erfahrung in Crop Insurance
• Fähigkeit, effektive Verkaufsstrategien auszuführen

• Markt- und Vertriebserfahrung in der Versicherungsbranche
• Starkes Verständnis der Versicherungsbranche aus einer Markt- und Zeichnungsperspektive
• Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Möglicherweise haben sie auch anspruch auf boni und leistungssteigerungen. Wenn Ihre Erwartungen über dem aufgeführten Bereich liegen, empfehlen wir Ihnen dennoch, sich zu bewerben - Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund ist für uns wichtig.

Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Bezahlung und umfassende Leistungen für Mitarbeiter und ihre Familien. [Erfahren Sie hier mehr über Total Rewards.]

Bei Zurich schätzen wir Ihre Ideen und Erfahrungen. Wir bieten Wachstum, Inklusion und ein unterstützendes Umfeld - damit Sie die Zukunft der Versicherung mitgestalten können. Zurich North America ist ein führendes Unternehmen im Risikomanagement mit über 150 Jahren Erfahrung und Abdeckung in über 25 Branchen, darunter 90 % der Fortune 500®.

Begleiten Sie uns für eine bessere Zukunft – für Sie und unsere Kunden.

jobs.title: Branch Sales Manager- Seremban
jobs.description:
Job Summary

To drive growth and profitability in all assigned products through risk selection, pricing, negotiation, sales, retention, and quality service.

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

• Actively manage daily work processes of designated territory to achieve operational and strategic objectives.
• Analyze needs, develop and recommend alternatives for improvements to processes, customer service or products.
• Lead short term (3 to 9 months), defined scope projects.
• Develop and maintain profitable relationships with new and existing customers.
• Assist customers with loss prevention meetings, claims issues, and product training.
• Provide training to customer and Strategic Business Unit personnel on products and services.
• Provide technical advice that enables a customer to solve a problem or improve business.
• Develop and maintain positive customer relationships by meeting regularly with customers when no specific initiative is underway.
• Anticipate customer needs, monitor trends in order to recommend changes.
• Resolve technical issues within function or unit.

Business Accountabilities

• Carry out tasks, such as the preparation of customer and distributor reports, to support the implementation of projects to time and quality standards.
• Assess and evaluate business processes in order to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Investigate and drive research/analysis around potential business development opportunities.
• Review assigned customer cases, prioritize case load and interpret established policies, applying discretion within authority limits in order to resolve customer issues.

Job Requirements

Required:

• High School Diploma or Equivalent and 4 or more years of experience in the Sales area

OR

• Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and No prior experience required in the Sales area

AND

• Knowledge of principles of sales, sales techniques, and sales terminology

• Knowledge of requirements within insurance industry regulatory environment

• Knowledge of Microsoft Office

• The ability to be licensed to sell insurance in the states where required

Preferred:

• 4 or more years of sales experience

• Licensed to sell insurance in the states where required

• Experience analyzing financial statements

• Analizzare le esigenze, sviluppare e consigliare alternative per il miglioramento dei processi, del servizio clienti o dei prodotti.

• Assistere i clienti con riunioni di prevenzione della perdita, problemi di reclamo e formazione del prodotto.
• Fornire formazione al personale del cliente e dell'unità aziendale strategica sui prodotti e servizi.
• Fornire consulenza tecnica che consente al cliente di risolvere un problema o migliorare il business.
• Sviluppare e mantenere relazioni positive con i clienti incontrando regolarmente con i clienti quando non è in corso alcuna iniziativa specifica.
• Anticipate esigenze del cliente, monitorare le tendenze al fine di raccomandare modifiche.

• Valutare e valutare i processi aziendali al fine di identificare le opportunità di miglioramento.
• Indagare e guidare la ricerca / analisi intorno potenziali opportunità di sviluppo aziendale.
• Verificare casi assegnati ai clienti, privilegiare il carico del caso e interpretare le politiche stabilite, applicando la discrezione entro limiti di autorità al fine di risolvere i problemi del cliente.

jobs.title: Executive Underwriter - Energy Property
jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking to hire a Underwriting Specialist or Executive Property Underwriter to join the team in Houston, TX.

The Energy Property Underwriter will analyze and underwrite highly complex new and renewal business, under minimal direction, utilizing The Zurich Way of Underwriting Framework as a subject matter expert, ensuring a high-level service to customers. As a Senior Underwriter you will serve as a leader and mentor to the team offering technical guidance on key coverage issues and forms. In this role you will handle Texas and will be tasked with building strong broker relationships. As a member of Zurich's Underwriting Team, you will enjoy the opportunity to fully apply and hone your underwriting and marketing skills while building relationships with Select Brokers across the regions.

Zurich’s Energy group provides comprehensive energy risk solutions, risk engineering services and claims support tailored to the individual needs of oil and gas, petrochemical, natural resources, mining and power generation customers virtually worldwide.

Responsibilities include:

jobs.title: Surety Underwriting Specialist
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Are you looking for a caring, collaborative, values-driven workplace with inspiring teammates and leaders? Do you have the ambition and desire to be the best and thrive at the most impactful global insurance provider in the world? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have experience in Surety Underwriting and are looking for a new challenge, we would love to hear from you.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for a Surety Underwriting Specialist to enhance and fully apply their underwriting, marketing, and financial & credit analysis skills, and contribute to our ongoing success as a member of our dynamic Toronto Contract Surety team.

Reporting directly to the National Director, Core Contract Surety, and collaborating with an experienced team of underwriters, this role is both technical and market facing, requiring experience in Contract Surety as you will be responsible for new business production, underwriting and retention of existing accounts under limited direction while actively engaging in the marketplace to elevate the Zurich Canada brand. Your goal will be to maximize underwriting profitability with The Zurich Way of Underwriting Framework within delegated authority levels on accounts of moderate to high technical complexity, while ensuring a high-level service to customers.

As the Surety Business Unit continues to grow, so will your personal learning and development opportunities. You will develop your underwriting and portfolio optimization skills, all while contributing to Zurich Canada’s overall results. This role offers a flexible, dynamic, and challenging environment for motivated professionals looking to advance their careers in surety underwriting.

This is a unique opportunity to build your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice matters. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.

Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring three days per week of in-person presence, which may include time in the office or market-facing engagements.

What you will do

- Production and underwriting of new and existing contract surety business.

- Serve as key contact and underwrite an assigned portfolio of accounts with a modest to high level of autonomy.

- Conduct thorough assessments of customer’s financial, technical, and organizational capacity within Zurich’s appetite, balanced with sound business opportunity, in accordance with department policies and procedures.

- Provide detailed recommendations of bond and account support utilizing your skills in financial and credit analysis.

- Proactively seek new account opportunities by managing existing and developing new relationships with key brokers.

- Make broker / customer and on-site calls with a planned and well-prepared purpose.

- Negotiate account and / or bond specific terms & conditions.

- Participate in team meetings, providing updates related to assigned portfolio of accounts, brokers, territory, and market intelligence.

- Proactively engage in the target account process, developing and managing a qualified list of opportunities.

- Internal marketing and production in support of cross-sell efforts.

- External marketing to new and existing broker partners.

- Contribute to development of underwriting manuals, programs, and guidelines.

- Regularly attend industry, broker and customer events and functions.

- Model behaviors that demonstrate commitment to corporate values.

- Provide guidance and support for team members.

- Take action to manage your own personal development.

- Engage in business travel as required.

- Work extended hours during peak periods as required.

- Maintain a valid driver’s license as required.

- Ensure regular predictable attendance.

- Maintain visibility in the office, as required.

Job Qualifications - What you bring to the table

Required:

- University degree or post-secondary education in finance, accounting, banking (credit) or construction-related experience.

- Industry and surety product knowledge including legal and regulatory environment.

- Well-developed broker network and superior understanding of broker relationship model.

- Experience with tight deadlines for requests and new account submissions.

- Effective risk assessment skills.

- Independent and strategic thinker with strong negotiation skills.

- Confident decision-maker with attention to detail.

- Excellent listening, verbal, written communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to work independently and/or collaboratively in a team environment.

- Effective in relationship building, active listening, needs analysis, multi-tasking, and negotiation.

- High level of customer service.

AND

- Minimum of five years of relevant surety experience.

Preferred:

- Banking and / or construction industry experience

- Developer Surety experience

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite.

At Zurich Canada, we are committed to pay equity. We determine compensation based on objective criteria such as skills, experience, and internal equity. The salary range for this position is $125,000 – 150,000. This range reflects the expected pay for the role across Canada and may vary depending on factors like office location, specific responsibilities, and individual qualifications. As required by local law, Zurich provides in good faith a reasonable compensation range, but starting salaries may exceed this range based on a candidate’s skills and experience.

Our Culture

- At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). We want you to bring your whole self to work, and we want our employees to be reflective of the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives are creating an environment where everyone feels welcome.

- We have a collaborative culture where diversity of thought is valued. We value your input and strive to give our employees the tools they need to make an impact.

- We care about our employees’ well-being and offer a comprehensive health/benefits plan with varying levels of coverage to suit your specific needs and a competitive total compensation package.

- We understand how important it is to rest, recharge and do the things you love. At Zurich, all employees receive a minimum of four weeks of vacation per year to do just that.

- We also understand that employees require time off for personal reasons. Maybe you have an appointment during a workday, a cultural or religious holiday you would like to observe, or you need time off to focus on your mental health. Zurich employees receive four personal days per year to be used at their discretion.

- We are committed to continuous improvement and offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.

- We care about our communities. Our communities are where our customers, people, and shareholders live and work. While we can be proud of the contribution to society Zurich makes through our core business of insurance, we must also give back to our communities through our talent, time and resources.

- We have won numerous awards for our workplace culture. We are proud to be one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers and to have received Insurance Business Canada’s 5-Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award.

Make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

About Us

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-line insurer with approximately 55,000 employees worldwide serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada has been a leading insurance provider serving mid-sized and large companies, including multinational corporations, in the Canadian commercial market for 100 years. With over 500 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a top insurance provider combined with in-depth knowledge of industries and local markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be risk management professionals’ first choice as their premier partner to help meet the risk challenges of today and tomorrow. Read more at www.zurichcanada.com .

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich strives to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We recruit talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion bring us closer to our common goal: exceeding our customers’ expectations. Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on behalf of, Zurich. We strive to achieve a workplace free of discrimination of all forms, including discrimination on the basis of physical or mental disability, or medical condition. If you are interested in a job opportunity, please advise if you require an accommodation, so we can work with you to provide a more accessible process.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Any unsolicited resume will become the property of Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. If you are a preferred vendor, please use our Recruiting Agency Portal for resume submission.

Only applicable for Canada: For Zurich Canada's commitment to diversity and accessibility please click here . If you would prefer to not receive future electronic messages from Zurich Insurance Company Ltd's recruitment management system, please email your request to have your job profile deleted from the system by clicking here . Zurich Insurance Company Ltd 100 King St., W., Suite 5500, Toronto, ON, M5X 1C9. www.zurichcanada.com
