For our Center of Competence Services Personal Insurance team, we are looking for a person who wants to actively shape change, take responsibility and build something that has an impact together.

If you enjoy building a consistent data and key figures landscape as well as the associated control and reporting instruments, anchoring them in the area of PV services and continuously developing them further, then you are at the right place.

In this expert role in the field of PV services at the headquarters in Zurich, you have the opportunity to set accents, actively bring about change and primarily support line managers and the head of department. Teamwork makes the dream work! In this important interface function, you are able to promote a motivating cooperation culture in a dynamic and successful environment.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as Portfolio & Business Intelligence Manager Center of Competence Claims Personal Insurance.

What you do

- You are the central contact person for line managers and act as a “SPOC” for cross-claim performance management in all questions regarding analysis, control and data use within PV services; you are also in coordination with the specialist department, finance (reserve), underwriting and performance management in order to establish an integral financial view on a common data basis.

- You work at the interface between department, process management and technical demands, support the development of clear control and reporting instruments for the entire PV services area, commission the implementation of dashboards and reporting solutions and closely accompany them in order to optimally control our core process landscape.

- You build a consistent, area-wide anchored data and key performance landscape for all levels of PV services, analyze technical data requirements and translate them into meaningful (process) key performance indicators, ensure their continuous development and ensure their empowerment and use across all management levels.

- You will analyze existing data and control tools, identify potential for optimization, provide the basis for decision-making for line managers and department managers and make a significant contribution to enabling data-based decisions in the area of PV services.

- You promote a motivating culture of cooperation and change in the team, work closely with cross-claim performance management and ensure that key figures and reports are anchored in the everyday life of managers and are actively used for steering.

What you bring

- Several years of experience (about 3–6 years) in a performance management role, ideally in personal insurance (KTG/UVG/UVG‐Z) or in a similar environment.

- Solid project management skills (e.g. in managing projects, coordinating stakeholders, dealing with change) and a profound understanding of the industry-specific requirements at the interface of discipline, technology and finance

- university degree (Uni/FH) in economics, business administration, data analytics, finance, consulting or an equivalent area; Experience in the insurance environment.

- An open, resilient and team-oriented personality with a positive and creative attitude – even if it gets hectic – as well as pleasure in empowering others and passing on knowledge.

- Very good knowledge of German and English; French is a plus.

Your contact

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Bernd Makasy (044 628 42 14)

Additional information

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Zurich, Oerlikon

Hybrid work: up to 40%

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. Are you passionate about building real-world AI products powered by GenAI, large language models (LLMs) and intelligent automation? Then this role could be a great fit for you.
As an AI Engineer, you will be part of the AI Engineering team within Zurich Customer Active Management (ZCAM). The team designs, builds and operates AI-powered solutions that enhance decision-making, automate processes and improve both customer and employee experiences.

We focus on delivering enterprise-grade AI products using modern GenAI technologies, including conversational AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise search and AI-driven workflow automation. You will work at the intersection of data, software engineering and AI product development, helping bring GenAI solutions from prototype to scalable, production-ready systems.

This role is based in Ljubljana (Slovenia) with a hybrid working model.

What will you do

- Design, build and operationalize GenAI applications such as conversational assistants, copilots and AI-powered tools for business users.

- Develop intelligent document processing solutions leveraging NLP, information extraction and GenAI techniques to classify, extract, structure and enrich information from unstructured content.

- Build AI-driven automation workflows and smart intake solutions that route, validate and process business information across systems.

- Integrate LLMs and AI APIs into enterprise applications and workflows to enable intelligent decision support and automation.

- Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems to enable context-aware AI responses over enterprise data.

- Build enterprise search and knowledge base solutions across structured and unstructured data sources.

- Develop document ingestion and processing pipelines, including chunking, embedding generation and semantic retrieval.

- Implement guardrails, evaluation frameworks and monitoring systems to ensure safe, reliable and high-quality AI behavior.

- Support deployment, scaling and lifecycle management of production AI solutions in cloud environments.

- Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, architects and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end AI solutions.

- Contribute to reusable frameworks, best practices and standards for enterprise GenAI development at Zurich.

What you bring

- At least 3 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning engineering or related technical roles.

- Strong programming skills in Python.

- Knowledge of SQL and/or other domain specific languages for managing, retrieving, and interacting with data systems.

- Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI-powered solutions in production environments (for example, applications based on NLP, machine learning or GenAI).

- Solid understanding of large language model (LLM) application development, prompt engineering and orchestration patterns.

- Hands-on experience with vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems for semantic search and RAG applications.

- Experience integrating APIs, cloud services and enterprise systems into scalable solutions.

- Experience with cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure (for example Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service or similar services).

- Understanding of evaluation, monitoring, observability and reliability considerations for production AI systems.

- Ability to design end-to-end AI solutions that combine data, models, infrastructure and business workflows.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business domains.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

- Background in insurance, financial services or other regulated enterprise environments.

- Hands-on use of GenAI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Azure AI Agent Framework or similar technologies.

- Exposure to low-code AI development and automation platforms, such as Microsoft Copilot Studio or Power Automate.

- Experience with MLOps / LLMOps practices (for example CI/CD for AI applications, experiment tracking, model or prompt versioning).

- Familiarity with knowledge graph-based approaches for semantic retrieval and reasoning in AI applications.

Additional information

We look forward to receiving your online application.

Zurich supports flexible working arrangements and recognizes that talent comes in many forms. Please feel free to discuss any flexibility needs during the interview process.

At Zurich, we focus on using AI responsibly to improve processes, enhance customer experience and support better decision-making. We invest in practical, scalable AI solutions that deliver measurable business value, while ensuring that our use of AI is transparent, fair and aligned with our values.

.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

- Location(s): SI - Ljubljana

- Remote working: Hybrid

- Schedule: Full Time

- Recruiter name: Vesna Pivk

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di costruire prodotti AI reali alimentati da GenAI, modelli di grande lingua (LLMs) e automazione intelligente? Allora questo ruolo potrebbe essere una grande misura per voi.
In qualità di AI Engineer, sarai parte del team AI Engineering all'interno della Customer Active Management di Zurigo (ZCAM). Il team progetta, costruisce e gestisce soluzioni basate su AI che migliorano il processo decisionale, automatizzano i processi e migliorano le esperienze dei clienti e dei dipendenti.

Ci concentriamo sulla fornitura di prodotti AI di livello aziendale utilizzando le moderne tecnologie GenAI, tra cui l'AI conversazione, la generazione aumentata di recupero (RAG), la ricerca di impresa e l'automazione del flusso di lavoro guidato da AI. Potrai lavorare all'incrocio di dati, ingegneria del software e sviluppo di prodotti AI, aiutando a portare soluzioni GenAI dal prototipo a sistemi scalabili e pronti alla produzione.

Questo ruolo ha sede a Lubiana (Slovenia) con un modello di lavoro ibrido.

Cosa farai

- Progettazione, costruzione e operativizzazione di applicazioni GenAI come assistenti di conversazione, copiloti e strumenti AI-powered per gli utenti aziendali.

- Sviluppare soluzioni di elaborazione di documenti intelligenti che sfruttano le tecniche di NLP, estrazione di informazioni e GenAI per classificare, estrarre, strutturare e arricchire le informazioni da contenuti non strutturati.

- Costruire flussi di lavoro di automazione basati su AI e soluzioni di assunzione intelligente che tracciano, convalidano e elaborano le informazioni aziendali attraverso i sistemi.

- Integra le API LLM e AI in applicazioni e flussi di lavoro aziendali per consentire il supporto e l'automazione delle decisioni intelligenti.

- Progettare e implementare sistemi di generazione aumentata (RAG) per consentire risposte AI contestuali sui dati aziendali.

- Costruire soluzioni di base di ricerca e conoscenza aziendali attraverso fonti di dati strutturate e non strutturate.

- Sviluppare le tubazioni di ingestione e di elaborazione dei documenti, tra cui il blocco, la generazione di incorporazione e il recupero semantico.

- Implement guardrails, framework di valutazione e sistemi di monitoraggio per garantire un comportamento AI sicuro, affidabile e di alta qualità.

- Supporto di distribuzione, scaling e gestione del ciclo di vita delle soluzioni AI di produzione in ambienti cloud.

- Collabora con ingegneri di dati, scienziati di dati, architetti e stakeholder aziendali per fornire soluzioni AI end-to-end.

- Contribuire a strutture riutilizzabili, best practice e standard per lo sviluppo GenAI aziendale a Zurigo.

Cosa porti

- Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in ingegneria del software, ingegneria dei dati, ingegneria del machine learning o ruoli tecnici correlati.

- Forte capacità di programmazione in Python.

- Conoscenza di SQL e/o altre lingue specifiche di dominio per la gestione, il recupero e l'interazione con i sistemi di dati.

- Hands-on esperienza progettazione e fornitura di soluzioni AI-powered in ambienti di produzione (ad esempio, applicazioni basate su NLP, machine learning o GenAI).

- Solida comprensione del modello di lingua grande (LLM) sviluppo dell'applicazione, ingegneria rapida e modelli di orchestrazione.

- Esperienza pratica con database vettoriali e sistemi di recupero basati su embedding per applicazioni di ricerca semantica e RAG.

- Scopri l'integrazione di API, servizi cloud e sistemi enterprise in soluzioni scalabili.

- Esperienza con piattaforme cloud, idealmente Microsoft Azure (per esempio Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Funzioni, Azure Kubernetes Service o servizi simili).

- Comprensione di considerazioni di valutazione, monitoraggio, osservanza e affidabilità per i sistemi AI di produzione.

- Capacità di progettare soluzioni AI end-to-end che combinano dati, modelli, infrastrutture e flussi di lavoro aziendali.

- Forte capacità di problem solving e la capacità di lavorare efficacemente attraverso i domini tecnici e aziendali.

- Fluente scritto e parlato inglese.

Che bello avere

- Sfondo in assicurazioni, servizi finanziari o altri ambienti aziendali regolamentati.

- Utilizzo manuale di framework di orchestrazione GenAI come LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Azure AI Agent Framework o tecnologie simili.

- Esposizione a piattaforme di sviluppo e automazione AI a basso codice, come Microsoft Copilot Studio o Power Automate.

- Esperienza con le pratiche MLOps / LLMOps (per esempio CI/CD per applicazioni AI, monitoraggio degli esperimenti, modello o versione rapida).

- Familiarità con conoscenze approcci basati sui grafi per il recupero semantico e il ragionamento nelle applicazioni AI.

Ulteriori informazioni

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online.

Zurigo supporta le modalità di lavoro flessibili e riconosce che il talento viene in molte forme. Si prega di sentirsi liberi di discutere qualsiasi esigenza di flessibilità durante il processo di intervista.

A Zurigo, ci concentriamo sull'utilizzo dell'IA responsabilmente per migliorare i processi, migliorare l'esperienza del cliente e supportare un migliore processo decisionale. Investiamo in soluzioni AI pratiche e scalabili che offrono un valore commerciale misurabile, garantendo al contempo che il nostro utilizzo dell'IA sia trasparente, equo e allineato ai nostri valori.

.

Perché Zurigo

A Zurigo, ci piace pensare al di fuori della scatola e sfidare lo status quo. Prendiamo un approccio ottimista concentrandoci sui positivi e chiedendo costantemente cosa può andare bene?

Siamo un datore di lavoro pari opportunità che sa che ogni dipendente è unico - questo è ciò che rende il nostro team così grande!
Unisciti a noi mentre esploriamo costantemente nuovi modi per proteggere i nostri clienti e il pianeta.

- Posizione(i): SI - Lubiana

- Funzionamento remoto: ibrido

- Orari: Tempo pieno

- Nome del reclutatore: Vesna Pivk
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie begeistert von der Entwicklung realer KI-Produkte mit GenAI, großen Sprachmodellen (LLMs) und intelligenter Automatisierung? Dann könnte diese Rolle gut zu Ihnen passen.
Als AI Engineer sind Sie Teil des AI Engineering Teams innerhalb von Zurich Customer Active Management (ZCAM). Das Team entwickelt, baut und betreibt KI-basierte Lösungen, die die Entscheidungsfindung verbessern, Prozesse automatisieren und sowohl die Kunden- als auch die Mitarbeitererfahrung verbessern.

Wir konzentrieren uns auf die Bereitstellung von KI-Produkten für Unternehmen mit modernen GenAI-Technologien, darunter Konversations-KI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Unternehmenssuche und KI-gesteuerte Workflow-Automatisierung. Sie arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Daten, Software-Engineering und KI-Produktentwicklung und helfen, GenAI-Lösungen vom Prototyp zu skalierbaren, produktionsfähigen Systemen zu bringen.

Diese Rolle hat ihren Sitz in Ljubljana (Slowenien) mit einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell.

Was wirst du tun

- Entwerfen, erstellen und operationalisieren Sie GenAI-Anwendungen wie Konversationsassistenten, Copiloten und KI-basierte Tools für Geschäftsanwender.

- Entwicklung intelligenter Dokumentenverarbeitungslösungen unter Nutzung von NLP-, Informationsextraktions- und GenAI-Techniken zur Klassifizierung, Extraktion, Strukturierung und Anreicherung von Informationen aus unstrukturierten Inhalten.

- Erstellen Sie KI-gesteuerte Automatisierungsworkflows und intelligente Ansauglösungen, die Geschäftsinformationen systemübergreifend weiterleiten, validieren und verarbeiten.

- Integrieren Sie LLMs und KI-APIs in Unternehmensanwendungen und Workflows, um intelligente Entscheidungsunterstützung und Automatisierung zu ermöglichen.

- Entwerfen und Implementieren von RAG-Systemen (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), um kontextbewusste KI-Reaktionen über Unternehmensdaten zu ermöglichen.

- Erstellen Sie Unternehmenssuch- und Wissensdatenbanklösungen für strukturierte und unstrukturierte Datenquellen.

- Entwicklung von Dokumentenaufnahme- und -verarbeitungspipelines, einschließlich Chunking, Einbettungserzeugung und semantischem Abruf.

- Implementieren Sie Leitplanken, Evaluierungs-Frameworks und Überwachungssysteme, um ein sicheres, zuverlässiges und qualitativ hochwertiges KI-Verhalten zu gewährleisten.

- Unterstützung der Bereitstellung, Skalierung und des Lifecycle-Managements von Produktions-KI-Lösungen in Cloud-Umgebungen.

- Arbeiten Sie mit Dateningenieuren, Datenwissenschaftlern, Architekten und Geschäftsinteressenten zusammen, um durchgängige KI-Lösungen zu liefern.

- Beitrag zu wiederverwendbaren Frameworks, Best Practices und Standards für die GenAI-Entwicklung von Unternehmen in Zürich.

Was du mitbringst

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering oder verwandten technischen Rollen.

- Starke Programmierkenntnisse in Python.

- Kenntnisse von SQL und/oder anderen domänenspezifischen Sprachen zum Verwalten, Abrufen und Interagieren mit Datensystemen.

- Praktische Erfahrung bei der Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von KI-basierten Lösungen in Produktionsumgebungen (z. B. Anwendungen auf NLP-Basis, maschinelles Lernen oder GenAI).

- Solides Verständnis der Anwendungsentwicklung von großen Sprachmodellen (LLM), promptes Engineering und Orchestrierungsmuster.

- Praktische Erfahrung mit Vektordatenbanken und Einbettungs-basierten Abrufsystemen für semantische Such- und RAG-Anwendungen.

- Erfahrung in der Integration von APIs, Cloud-Services und Unternehmenssystemen in skalierbare Lösungen.

- Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen, idealerweise Microsoft Azure (z.B. Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service oder ähnliche Dienste).

- Verständnis von Bewertungs-, Überwachungs-, Beobachtbarkeits- und Zuverlässigkeitsüberlegungen für Produktions-KI-Systeme.

- Fähigkeit, durchgängige KI-Lösungen zu entwerfen, die Daten, Modelle, Infrastruktur und Geschäftsprozesse kombinieren.

- Starke Problemlösungskompetenzen und die Fähigkeit, effektiv in technischen und geschäftlichen Bereichen zu arbeiten.

- fließend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch.

Nizza zu haben

- Hintergrund in Versicherungen, Finanzdienstleistungen oder anderen regulierten Unternehmensumgebungen.

- Praktische Nutzung von GenAI-Orchestrierungs-Frameworks wie LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Azure AI Agent Framework oder ähnlichen Technologien.

- Exposition gegenüber Low-Code-KI-Entwicklungs- und Automatisierungsplattformen wie Microsoft Copilot Studio oder Power Automate.

- Erfahrung mit MLOps / LLMOps-Praktiken (z.B. CI/CD für KI-Anwendungen, Experiment-Tracking, Modellierung oder prompte Versionierung).

- Vertrautheit mit wissensgraphenbasierten Ansätzen für semantisches Abrufen und Argumentieren in KI-Anwendungen.

Zusätzliche Angaben

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung.

Zurich unterstützt flexible Arbeitsvereinbarungen und erkennt an, dass Talente in vielen Formen vorkommen. Bitte fühlen sie sich frei, alle flexibilitätsbedürfnisse während des interviewprozesses zu besprechen.

Bei Zurich konzentrieren wir uns darauf, KI verantwortungsvoll einzusetzen, um Prozesse zu verbessern, das Kundenerlebnis zu verbessern und eine bessere Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen. Wir investieren in praktische, skalierbare KI-Lösungen, die einen messbaren Geschäftswert liefern und gleichzeitig sicherstellen, dass unser Einsatz von KI transparent, fair und auf unsere Werte ausgerichtet ist.

.

Warum Zürich

Bei Zurich denken wir gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hinterfragen den Status Quo. Wir gehen optimistisch vor, indem wir uns auf das Positive konzentrieren und ständig fragen: Was kann richtig gehen?

Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit, der weiß, dass jeder Mitarbeiter einzigartig ist - das macht unser Team so großartig!
Begleiten Sie uns, während wir ständig neue Wege erkunden, um unsere Kunden und den Planeten zu schützen.

- Ort(e): SI - Ljubljana

- Fernarbeit: Hybrid

- Zeitplan: Vollzeit

- Name des Personalvermittlers: Vesna Pivk
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous passionné par la construction de produits d'IA du monde réel alimentés par GenAI, les grands modèles de langage (LLM) et l'automatisation intelligente? Alors ce rôle pourrait vous convenir.
En tant qu'ingénieur de l'IA, vous faites partie de l'équipe d'ingénierie de l'IA au sein de Zurich Customer Active Management (ZCAM). L'équipe conçoit, construit et exploite des solutions alimentées par l'IA qui améliorent la prise de décision, automatisent les processus et améliorent l'expérience des clients et des employés.

Nous nous concentrons sur la livraison de produits AI de qualité entreprise à l'aide de technologies GenAI modernes, y compris l'IA conversationnelle, la génération augmentée de récupération (RAG), la recherche d'entreprise et l'automatisation de flux de travail pilotée par l'IA. Vous travaillerez à l'intersection des données, de l'ingénierie logicielle et du développement de produits AI, aidant à apporter des solutions GenAI du prototype à des systèmes évolutifs et prêts à la production.

Ce rôle est basé à Ljubljana (Slovénie) avec un modèle de travail hybride.

Que ferez-vous ?

- Concevoir, construire et opérationnaliser des applications GenAI telles que des assistants de conversation, des copilotes et des outils alimentés par l'IA pour les entreprises.

- Développer des solutions intelligentes de traitement de documents à partir de NLP, d'extraction d'information et de techniques GenAI pour classer, extraire, structurer et enrichir l'information à partir de contenus non structurés.

- Construisez des flux de travail d'automatisation pilotés par l'IA et des solutions d'admission intelligentes qui orientent, valident et traitent l'information opérationnelle entre les systèmes.

- Intégrer les LLM et les API d'IA dans les applications et les flux de travail d'entreprise pour permettre une prise de décision intelligente et l'automatisation.

- Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des systèmes de génération augmentée par récupération (RAG) pour permettre une réponse d'IA contextuelle sur les données d'entreprise.

- Élaborer des solutions de recherche et de base de connaissances pour les entreprises à partir de sources de données structurées et non structurées.

- Élaborer des pipelines d'ingestion et de traitement des documents, y compris le broyage, la génération d'intégration et la récupération sémantique.

- Mettre en place des garde-corps, des cadres d'évaluation et des systèmes de surveillance pour assurer un comportement d'IA sûr, fiable et de haute qualité.

- Soutenir le déploiement, l'échelle et la gestion du cycle de vie des solutions d'IA de production dans les environnements cloud.

- Collaborer avec les ingénieurs des données, les data savants, les architectes et les parties prenantes pour fournir des solutions d'IA de bout en bout.

- Contribuer à la réutilisation des cadres, des meilleures pratiques et des normes pour le développement de l'entreprise GenAI à Zurich.

Ce que vous apportez

- Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en génie logiciel, en génie des données, en ingénierie de l'apprentissage automatique ou en rôles techniques connexes.

- Fortes compétences en programmation en Python.

- Connaissance de SQL et/ou d'autres langages spécifiques de domaine pour gérer, récupérer et interagir avec les systèmes de données.

- Expérience pratique de la conception et de la fourniture de solutions alimentées par l'IA dans les environnements de production (par exemple, applications basées sur NLP, machine learning ou GenAI).

- Compréhension solide du développement d'applications de grands modèles de langage (LLM), de l'ingénierie rapide et des modèles d'orchestration.

- Expérience pratique des bases de données vectorielles et des systèmes d'extraction basés sur l'intégration pour la recherche sémantique et les applications RAG.

- Expérimentez l'intégration des API, des services cloud et des systèmes d'entreprise dans des solutions évolutives.

- Expérience avec les plateformes cloud, idéalement Microsoft Azure (par exemple Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service ou services similaires).

- Compréhension de l'évaluation, du suivi, de l'observabilité et de la fiabilité des systèmes d'IA de production.

- Capacité de concevoir des solutions d'IA de bout en bout qui combinent données, modèles, infrastructure et flux de travail.

- De solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et la capacité de travailler efficacement dans les domaines technique et commercial.

- L'anglais parlé et écrit couramment.

Sympa d'avoir

- Contexte en matière d'assurance, de services financiers ou d'autres environnements d'entreprises réglementés.

- Utilisation pratique de cadres d'orchestration GenAI tels que LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Azure AI Agent Framework ou des technologies similaires.

- Exposition à des plates-formes de développement et d'automatisation à faible code AI, telles que Microsoft Copilot Studio ou Power Automate.

- Expérience des pratiques MLOps/LLMOps (par exemple IC/CD pour les applications d'IA, le suivi d'expériences, le modèle ou la version rapide).

- Connaissance des approches fondées sur les graphiques de connaissances pour la recherche sémantique et le raisonnement dans les applications d'IA.

Informations complémentaires

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre demande en ligne.

Zurich soutient des formules de travail flexibles et reconnaît que le talent prend de nombreuses formes. N'hésitez pas à discuter de tout besoin de flexibilité pendant le processus d'entrevue.

À Zurich, nous nous concentrons sur l'utilisation responsable de l'IA pour améliorer les processus, améliorer l'expérience client et soutenir une meilleure prise de décision. Nous investissons dans des solutions d'IA pratiques et évolutives qui offrent une valeur commerciale mesurable, tout en veillant à ce que notre utilisation de l'IA soit transparente, juste et alignée sur nos valeurs.

.

Pourquoi Zurich

À Zurich, nous aimons penser en dehors de la boîte et défier le statu quo. Nous adoptons une approche optimiste en nous concentrant sur les positifs et nous demandons constamment ce qui peut aller bien?

Nous sommes un employeur à chances égales qui sait que chaque employé est unique - c'est ce qui rend notre équipe si géniale!
Rejoignez-nous en explorant constamment de nouvelles façons de protéger nos clients et la planète.

Als Senior Data Solutions Engineer spielst du eine Schlüsselrolle in der Information Technology und trägst dazu bei, die Datenstrategie von Zurich Schweiz Leben in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Einzelleben Fachbereich voranzutreiben. Fasziniert dich die Welt der Daten und möchtest du innovative Lösungen entwickeln, die einen echten Unterschied machen? Wenn du starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten hast, kommunikativ bist und dir die Arbeit in multidisziplinären Teams Spass macht, ist diese Stelle genau das Richtige für dich.

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als Senior Data Solutions Engineer Einzelleben .

- Du konzipierst, entwickelst und implementierst skalierbare, zuverlässige und flexible Lösungen mit Microsoft Azure / Fabric Komponenten, um unsere Datenplattform weiterzuentwickeln

- Du entwickelst und betreibst zuverlässige Datapipelines, die für Analyse- Anwendungsfälle genutzt werden

- Du führst Datenqualitätsprüfungen durch und förderst die kontinuierliche Verbesserung entlang des gesamten Lebenszyklus unserer Datenprodukte

- Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Data Governance Richtlinien eingehalten werden und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Datenproduktstandard ein.

Was du mitbringst

- Hochschulabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Bereich sowie mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung

- Fundierte Kenntnisse mit modernen Datentechnologien mit Schwerpunkt auf Microsoft Azure & Datenmodellierung (Star Schema, Snowflake, Data Vault)

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Arbeit mit Datenverarbeitungs-Programmierungssprachen, insbesondere in Python, PySpark und SQL

- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Probleme zu lösen

- Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch

Zurich ist eine starke Marke – mehr als 1,4 Millionen Schweizer Kundinnen und Kunden vertrauen auf unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen. descriptionByLocale.it:
Formare il futuro dell'assicurazione vita con noi!

Vuoi utilizzare la tua esperienza tecnica per creare soluzioni innovative per i nostri clienti? State cercando un ambiente in cui formate attivamente complesse applicazioni aziendali e la nostra strategia di digitalizzazione? Allora siete nel posto giusto con noi in IT Life Svizzera e nel programma "Digital Individual Life Insurer" (DILI).

Come IT Life of Zurich Insurance Svizzera, forniamo tutti i servizi IT specifici per l'assicurazione per la divisione Swiss Life. Come parte del programma DILI, forniamo il futuro servizio IT per gestire il nostro business di vita individuale. Per rafforzare il nostro team dedicato, ti stiamo cercando come Senior Data Solution Engineer.

In qualità di Senior Data Solutions Engineer, si svolge un ruolo chiave nella tecnologia dell'informazione e contribuisce a promuovere la strategia dei dati di Zurigo Schweiz Leben in collaborazione con il dipartimento di vita individuale. Sviluppi e mantieni entrambi i prodotti di dati curati – ovvero i set di dati chiaramente definiti e facili da usare dell'unità aziendale di vita individuale – e i prodotti di dati complessi utilizzati da altre unità aziendali. In questo modo, si utilizza e migliorare la nostra moderna piattaforma Data & Insight Generation (DIG) e lavorare in collaborazione con i vari dipartimenti per creare una migliore comprensione dei nostri clienti e delle loro esigenze.

Sei affascinato dal mondo dei dati e vuoi sviluppare soluzioni innovative che fanno una vera differenza? Se avete forti capacità di problem solving, sono comunicativi e godere di lavorare in team multidisciplinari, questo lavoro è per voi.

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro "Top 3" in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e applica come Senior Data Solutions Engineer.

Cosa fai

- L'utente integra i dati e lavora a stretto contatto con gli esperti IT & Business e i proprietari di prodotti provenienti da varie aree di business (compresa la vita individuale, la finanza, l'ufficio clienti, l'agente, i partenariati di broker e partnership, la sottoscrizione, la tecnologia di gruppo & operazioni)

- Progetti, sviluppi e implementa soluzioni scalabili, affidabili e flessibili con i componenti Microsoft Azure / Fabric per sviluppare ulteriormente la nostra piattaforma dati

- Sviluppare e utilizzare datadotti affidabili utilizzati per applicazioni di analisi

- Conduci controlli di qualità dei dati e promuovi un miglioramento continuo durante il ciclo di vita dei nostri prodotti dati

- Assicurarsi che le nostre linee guida sulla governance dei dati siano rispettate e siano attivamente coinvolte nell'ulteriore sviluppo del nostro standard di prodotto.

Cosa porti

- Laurea in informatica, informatica aziendale o un campo correlato e almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante

- Conoscenza approfondita delle moderne tecnologie dei dati con un focus su Microsoft Azure & Data Modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake, Data Vault)

- Diversi anni di esperienza professionale lavorando con i linguaggi di programmazione del trattamento dei dati, in particolare in Python, PySpark e SQL

- Forte capacità analitiche e la capacità di risolvere problemi complessi

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese

Il tuo contatto

Talent Acquisizione Consulente: Marco Stettler (+41 44 628 31 62)

Ulteriori informazioni

Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: 80 - 100%

Luogo di lavoro: Zurigo, Oerlikon

Ibridi di lavoro: fino al 40%

#LI-Hybrid #

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online – anche senza una lettera di richiesta.
Siete invitati a convincerci della vostra motivazione durante un incontro personale.

Chi siamo

Zurigo è un marchio forte – oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti svizzeri si affidano ai nostri prodotti e servizi. La base del nostro successo è la nostra 53.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, che aiutano i nostri clienti in 210 paesi e territori a comprendere e proteggere meglio se stessi dai loro rischi. Al fine di fornire prestazioni quotidiane, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti modelli di lavoro flessibili e interessanti opportunità di formazione. Come dipendente di Zurigo, si beneficia di una moltitudine di vantaggi e di una forte cultura caratterizzata da accettazione, diversità e orientamento del team.

A Zurigo, coltiviamo una cultura della diversità e dell'inclusione. I nostri obiettivi e valori sono progettati per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, promuovere la fiducia e aiutarli a raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Siamo per la giustizia e l'uguaglianza tra i nostri dipendenti, indipendentemente dal sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, origine, etnia, religione, ecc. L'acquisizione dei nostri talenti e dei processi di reclutamento riflettono questo impegno nella vita quotidiana. Unisciti a noi e diventare parte di questa cultura.

Perché Zurigo ha avuto successo da oltre 150 anni? Vedere qui e diventare parte di esso.

Informazioni per i reclutatori

Zurigo non accetta applicazioni non richieste dai reclutatori per questa posizione. Pertanto, i reclutatori non inviano documenti candidati ai nostri dipendenti o tramite il nostro portale di carriera online. Rifiutiamo ogni responsabilità per applicazioni non richieste e qualsiasi commissione e ringraziamo per la vostra comprensione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Shape the future of life insurance with us!

Do you want to use your technical expertise to create innovative solutions for our customers? Are you looking for an environment in which you actively shape complex business applications and our digitalization strategy? Then you are in the right place with us in IT Life Switzerland and in the program "Digital Individual Life Insurer" (DILI).

As IT Life of Zurich Insurance Switzerland, we provide all insurance-specific IT services for the Swiss Life division. As part of the DILI program, we provide the future IT service for handling our individual life business. To strengthen our dedicated team, we are looking for you as a Senior Data Solution Engineer.

As a Senior Data Solutions Engineer, you play a key role in Information Technology and contribute to advancing the data strategy of Zurich Schweiz Leben in cooperation with the individual life department. You develop and maintain both curated data products – i.e. clearly defined, easy-to-use data sets from the individual life business unit – and complex data products used by other business units. In doing so, you use and improve our modern Data & Insight Generation Platform (DIG) and work in partnership with the various departments to create a better understanding of our customers and their needs.

Are you fascinated by the world of data and do you want to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference? If you have strong problem-solving skills, are communicative and enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams, this job is for you.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become a part of it and apply as a Senior Data Solutions Engineer.

What you do

- You integrate data and work closely with IT & Business experts as well as product owners from various business areas (including individual life, finance, customer office, agent, broker & partnerships, underwriting, Group Technology & Operations)

- You design, develop and implement scalable, reliable and flexible solutions with Microsoft Azure / Fabric components to further develop our data platform

- Develop and operate reliable data pipelines used for analytics applications

- You conduct data quality checks and promote continuous improvement throughout the life cycle of our data products

- You ensure that our data governance guidelines are adhered to and are actively involved in the further development of our data product standard.

What you bring

- University degree in computer science, business informatics or a related field and at least 5 years of relevant professional experience

- In-depth knowledge of modern data technologies with a focus on Microsoft Azure & Data Modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake, Data Vault)

- Several years of professional experience working with data processing programming languages, especially in Python, PySpark and SQL

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to solve complex problems

- Excellent communication skills in German and English

Your contact

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Marco Stettler (+41 44 628 31 62)

Additional information

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Zurich, Oerlikon

Hybrids working: up to 40%

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. The basis of our success is our 53,000 employees worldwide, who help our customers in 210 countries and territories to better understand and protect themselves against their risks. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. We stand for justice and equality among our employees, regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, religion, etc. The acquisition of our talents and the recruitment processes reflect this commitment in everyday life. Join us and become part of this culture.

jobs.description:
Fasziniert dich die Entwicklung und Steuerung von innovativen Produktstrategien im Bereich Individual Life? Möchtest du ein Team von fünf motivierten Mitarbeitenden führen und deren Weiterentwicklung fördern?

In dieser Rolle hast du die Möglichkeit, Markttrends zu analysieren, neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit von Zurich zu stärken. Du arbeitest eng mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Produktangebote den Kundenanforderungen entsprechen.

Wenn du über ausgeprägte Führungsfähigkeiten und strategisches Denken verfügst, ist dies deine Chance, einen bedeutenden Einfluss auf die Zukunft von Zurich zu nehmen.

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als Head of Proposition Management Individual Life.

Was du tust

- Du entwickelst und steuerst die Produktstrategie für den Bereich Individual Life, um innovative und kundenorientierte Lösungen zu schaffen

- Du leitest ein Team von Product Managern, förderst deren Weiterentwicklung und stellst eine effektive Zusammenarbeit sicher

- Du analysierst Markttrends, Kundenbedürfnisse und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten, um strategische Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren

- Du arbeitest eng mit Vertrieb, Marketing und weiteren Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Produkte den Marktanforderungen entsprechen

- Du überwachst die Performance der Produkte und leitest Optimierungsmassnahmen ein, um die Profitabilität und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu sichern

Was du mitbringst

- Abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Versicherungswesen, Mathematik oder einem verwandten Bereich

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Produktentwicklung oder im Produktmanagement, idealerweise im Bereich Lebensversicherungen

- Führungserfahrung und die Fähigkeit, ein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln

- Ausgeprägte analytische und strategische Fähigkeiten, kombiniert mit einer kundenorientierten Denkweise

- Fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil

Dein Kontakt

Arbeitsort: Zürich, Oerlikon

Zurich ist eine starke Marke - mehr als 1,4 Millionen Schweizer Kundinnen und Kunden vertrauen auf unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen. Die Basis unseres Erfolgs bilden unsere 53‘000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit, die unseren Kunden in 210 Ländern und Gebieten helfen, ihre Risiken besser zu verstehen und sich gegen diese zu schützen. Um die tägliche Leistung zu erbringen, bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden flexible Arbeitsmodelle und interessante Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Als Zurich-Mitarbeitender profitierst du von einer Vielzahl an Vorteilen und einer starken Kultur, geprägt von Akzeptanz, Vielfältigkeit und Teamorientierung.

Bei Zurich pflegen wir eine Kultur der Vielfalt und Inklusion. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei affascinato dallo sviluppo e dal controllo di strategie di prodotto innovative nel settore della vita individuale? Vuoi guidare un team di cinque dipendenti motivati e promuovere il loro ulteriore sviluppo?

In questo ruolo, avrete l’opportunità di analizzare le tendenze del mercato, identificare nuove opportunità di business e rafforzare la competitività di Zurigo. Si lavora a stretto contatto con le parti interessate interne per garantire che le offerte di prodotto soddisfino i requisiti del cliente.

Se avete forti capacità di leadership e pensiero strategico, questa è la vostra occasione per fare un impatto significativo sul futuro di Zurigo.

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro "Top 3" in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e applica come Capo della Proposition Management Individual Life.

Cosa fai

- Sviluppi e controlli la strategia del prodotto di vita individuale per creare soluzioni innovative e orientate al cliente

- Lei guida un team di product manager, promuove il loro sviluppo e assicura una collaborazione efficace

- Analizzare le tendenze del mercato, le esigenze dei clienti e le attività competitive per prendere decisioni strategiche e identificare nuove opportunità di business

- Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con vendite, marketing e altri team per garantire i prodotti soddisfare le richieste di mercato

- Monitorare le prestazioni dei prodotti e avviare misure di ottimizzazione per garantire redditività e competitività

Cosa porti

- Studi completi in amministrazione aziendale, assicurazione, matematica o un campo correlato

- Diversi anni di esperienza nello sviluppo del prodotto o nella gestione del prodotto, idealmente nel settore dell'assicurazione sulla vita

- Esperienza di leadership e la capacità di motivare e sviluppare un team

- Forte capacità analitiche e strategiche combinate con una mentalità orientata al cliente

- Conoscenza fluente del tedesco e dell'inglese in parole e scrittura, altre lingue benefiche

Il tuo contatto

Talent Acquisizione Consulente: Jasmina Pipic (044 628 42 50)

Ulteriori informazioni

Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: 80 - 100%

Luogo di lavoro: Zurigo, Oerlikon

Lavoro ibrido: fino al 40%

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online - anche senza una lettera di richiesta.

Siete invitati a convincerci della vostra motivazione durante un incontro personale.

Chi siamo

Zurigo è un marchio forte – oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti svizzeri si affidano ai nostri prodotti e servizi. La base del nostro successo è la nostra 53.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, che aiutano i nostri clienti in 210 paesi e territori a comprendere e proteggere meglio se stessi dai loro rischi. Al fine di fornire prestazioni quotidiane, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti modelli di lavoro flessibili e interessanti opportunità di formazione. Come dipendente di Zurigo, si beneficia di una moltitudine di vantaggi e di una forte cultura caratterizzata da accettazione, diversità e orientamento del team.

A Zurigo, coltiviamo una cultura della diversità e dell'inclusione. I nostri obiettivi e valori sono progettati per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, promuovere la fiducia e aiutarli a raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Siamo per la giustizia e l'uguaglianza tra i nostri dipendenti, indipendentemente dal sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, origine, etnia, religione, ecc. L'acquisizione dei nostri talenti e dei processi di reclutamento riflettono questo impegno nella vita quotidiana. Unisciti a noi e diventare parte di questa cultura.

Perché Zurigo ha avuto successo da oltre 150 anni? Vedere qui e diventare parte di esso.

Informazioni per i reclutatori

Zurigo non accetta applicazioni non richieste dai reclutatori per questa posizione. Pertanto, i reclutatori non inviano documenti candidati ai nostri dipendenti o tramite il nostro portale di carriera online. Rifiutiamo ogni responsabilità per applicazioni non richieste e qualsiasi commissione e ringraziamo per la vostra comprensione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you fascinated by the development and control of innovative product strategies in the area of Individual Life? Do you want to lead a team of five motivated employees and promote their further development?

In this role, you will have the opportunity to analyze market trends, identify new business opportunities and strengthen Zurich’s competitiveness. You work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure that product offerings meet customer requirements.

If you have strong leadership skills and strategic thinking, this is your chance to make a significant impact on the future of Zurich.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as Head of Proposition Management Individual Life.

What you do

- You develop and control the individual life product strategy to create innovative and customer-oriented solutions

- You lead a team of product managers, promote their development and ensure effective collaboration

- Analyze market trends, customer needs and competitive activities to make strategic decisions and identify new business opportunities

- You’ll work closely with sales, marketing and other teams to ensure products meet market demands

- You monitor the performance of the products and initiate optimization measures to ensure profitability and competitiveness

What you bring

- Completed studies in business administration, insurance, mathematics or a related field

- Several years of experience in product development or product management, ideally in the area of life insurance

- Leadership experience and the ability to motivate and develop a team

- Strong analytical and strategic skills combined with a customer-centric mindset

- Flowing knowledge of German and English in words and writing, other languages beneficial

Your contact

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Jasmina Pipic (044 628 42 50)

Additional information

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Zurich, Oerlikon

Hybrid work: up to 40%

We look forward to your online application - even without an application letter.

You are welcome to convince us of your motivation during a personal meeting.

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. The basis of our success is our 53,000 employees worldwide, who help our customers in 210 countries and territories to better understand and protect themselves against their risks. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. We stand for justice and equality among our employees, regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, religion, etc. The acquisition of our talents and the recruitment processes reflect this commitment in everyday life. Join us and become part of this culture.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? See here and become part of it.

Information for recruiters

Zurich does not accept unsolicited applications from recruiters for this position. Therefore, recruiters do not submit applicant documents to our employees or via our online career portal. We reject any responsibility for unsolicited applications and any fees and thank you for your understanding.

Êtes-vous fasciné par le développement et le contrôle de stratégies de produits innovantes dans le domaine de la vie individuelle? Voulez-vous diriger une équipe de cinq employés motivés et promouvoir leur perfectionnement?

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la possibilité d'analyser les tendances du marché, d'identifier de nouvelles opportunités commerciales et de renforcer la compétitivité de Zurich. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants internes pour vous assurer que les offres de produits répondent aux exigences des clients.

Si vous avez de solides compétences en leadership et une pensée stratégique, c'est votre chance d'avoir un impact significatif sur l'avenir de Zurich.

Découvrez ici pourquoi Zurich Suisse est l'un des employeurs "Top 3" en Suisse. Devenez membre et appliquez comme chef de la gestion de la proposition Vie individuelle.

Ce que tu fais

- Vous développez et contrôlez la stratégie individuelle de produit de vie pour créer des solutions innovantes et orientées vers le client

- Vous dirigez une équipe de gestionnaires de produits, favorisez leur développement et assurez une collaboration efficace

- Analyser les tendances du marché, les besoins des clients et les activités concurrentielles pour prendre des décisions stratégiques et identifier de nouvelles possibilités d'affaires

- Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les ventes, le marketing et d'autres équipes pour s'assurer que les produits répondent aux exigences du marché

- Vous surveillez les performances des produits et lancez des mesures d'optimisation pour assurer la rentabilité et la compétitivité

Ce que vous apportez

- Études terminées en administration des affaires, assurance, mathématiques ou un domaine connexe

- Plusieurs années d'expérience dans le développement de produits ou la gestion de produits, idéalement dans le domaine de l'assurance vie

- Expérience en leadership et capacité de motiver et de développer une équipe

- Fortes compétences analytiques et stratégiques associées à une mentalité centrée sur le client

- Connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en mots et en écriture, autres langues bénéfiques

Votre contact

Consultant en acquisition de talents : Jasmina Pipic (044 628 42 50)

Informations complémentaires

Temps partiel ou temps plein: 80 - 100%

Lieu de travail: Zurich, Oerlikon

Travail hybride: jusqu'à 40%

Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature en ligne - même sans lettre de candidature.

Vous êtes invités à nous convaincre de votre motivation lors d'une réunion personnelle.

Qui nous sommes

Zurich est une marque forte – plus de 1,4 million de clients suisses dépendent de nos produits et services. Notre succès repose sur nos 53 000 collaborateurs dans le monde entier, qui aident nos clients dans 210 pays et territoires à mieux comprendre et se protéger contre leurs risques. Afin de fournir des performances quotidiennes, nous offrons à nos employés des modèles de travail flexibles et des possibilités de formation intéressantes. En tant qu'employé de Zurich, vous bénéficiez d'une multitude d'avantages et d'une culture forte caractérisée par l'acceptation, la diversité et l'orientation de l'équipe.

À Zurich, nous cultivons une culture de diversité et d'inclusion. Nos objectifs et nos valeurs sont conçus pour protéger nos employés, promouvoir la confiance et les aider à réaliser leur plein potentiel. Nous défendons la justice et l'égalité entre nos employés, quel que soit leur sexe, leur identité, leur orientation sexuelle, leur origine, leur appartenance ethnique, leur religion, etc. L'acquisition de nos talents et les processus de recrutement reflètent cet engagement dans la vie quotidienne. Rejoignez-nous et faites partie de cette culture.

Pourquoi Zurich réussit-elle depuis plus de 150 ans ? Voyez ici et devenez partie intégrante.

Information des recruteurs

Zurich n'accepte pas les candidatures spontanées des recruteurs pour ce poste. Par conséquent, les recruteurs ne soumettent pas de documents de candidature à nos employés ou via notre portail de carrière en ligne. Nous rejetons toute responsabilité pour les demandes non sollicitées et les frais et nous vous remercions de votre compréhension.

- Aktive Bearbeitung von Reiseschadenfällen und Pannenfälle im In- und Ausland

jobs.description:
Zurich Insurance is on an exciting journey to become a truly customer led organization.

Zurich’s Group Customer Office is playing a pivotal role on that journey and is involved in a broad range of activities - working with all our regions and markets across the globe to shape the customer agenda.

To support this effort, we are looking for a passionate, data-driven, and innovative insights expert to join our Customer, Market & Brand Insights team. This role is paramount in evaluating our brand health and customer experience through our continuous Global Brand tracking study and Relationship NPS studies that inform decision making across 20+ markets and at every level of the business. These fundamental studies enable us to diagnose brand perceptions and deep dive into the customer experience (CX) shaping future strategies and improving how we deliver against customer needs. Working closely with local markets, as well as regional management and other Group functions, this role will include planning, delivery and evolving these tools to ensure data-based insights are generated to influence business decisions and actions. As the volume and volume and complexity of data grows, we’re evolving how we work - embracing AI tools to accelerate data processing and transform how insight is presented to the business. Our intention is to spend less time on production and more time on interpretation, implementation and communication that drives action.

Reporting to the Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS, the candidate’s key responsibilities will focus on consistently delivering these important insights platforms, so they evolve with the business needs and drive change.

What you will do

- Act as customer champion, raising awareness, providing guidance and training to the organization on key dimensions and insights of our program to drive actions.

- Take ownership of the two continuous global studies and ad hoc retail RNPS studies ensuring smooth project management and delivery of robust and relevant data and KPIs into the business.

- Apply AI and emerging technology to insight work to increase efficiency in data processing, synthesis and reporting, enabling shaper focus on interpretation, narrative and business implication.

- Define, evolve and conduct global studies, coordinating between multitude of markets and partnering with the respective agency.

- Analyze feedback, derive insight, report and present to stakeholders across the organization, including senior management at global, regional and local level.

- Drive the combination of data sources to strengthen relevance to decision making and impact on performance e.g. correlation analysis linking customer experience with financials.

- Ensure programs are technically strong and appropriate from questionnaire development, sample, weighting rules, and data uploads building confidence in the tool’s robustness.

- Translate analytic insights into concrete actionable recommendations, drawing conclusions for business improvement and influencing strategy effectively, including workshop facilitation.

- Maintain and promote our data hosting platform to democratize insights across the business.

- Manage external research agencies and budgets.

- Input support to Senior Insight Manager in identifying, communicating and activating insights.

- Keep up with best practice in the field and transfer relevant topics into Zurich’s programs.

Work location is Zurich with travel potentially required up to 10%

What you bring

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree (e.g., in business studies/administration, research, data science, psychology, behaviour science, customer or change management), 5+ years of experience in managing insights to actions programs.

- Expertise in managing customer research as part of an in-house customer insight team or as part of a consulting practice, ideally coupled with solid expertise in NPS and/or brand tracking methodology.

- A curiosity and experience exploring or applying AI tools in a research/insight context (e.g. verbatim analysis, automated reporting, cross market synthesis).

- Passionate and curious about data analysis & identifying insights to facilitate action planning.

- Program management and coordination skills to build and drive studies across 19+ markets including managing study preparation and execution (e.g. study set up and design, sampling strategy definition, execution, reporting), driving alignment between markets and ensuring global study framework is applied and adhered to.

- Ability to work with larger sets of data (Excel, SPSS) to provide additional/ad-hoc analysis (creating cuts of data based on different stakeholder requirements in addition to agency results packs).

- Experience in working with markets across the globe as well as ability to build and manage relationships across different cultural clusters.

- Strong analytical, (insights) writing/communications as well as workshop facilitation skills.

- Ability to guide virtual teams, e.g., establish and run global VOC community.

- Solid knowledge of insurance market, operations, products and services.

- Working language is primarily English.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.

For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.

Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!
