descriptionByLocale.it:
Su di noi:

A Zurigo Assicurazione Benelux, la nostra ambizione è di diventare una delle aziende più responsabili e d’impatto del mondo. Come specialista leader nell'assicurazione non-vita per le aziende locali e internazionali operanti nei Paesi Bassi, Belgio e Lussemburgo, Zurich Insurance Benelux fornisce soluzioni su misura che soddisfano le esigenze uniche dei nostri clienti. Un'emozionante opportunità è a vostra disposizione per unirvi al nostro team come Coordinatore di Eccellenza di Sottoscrittura, dove gestirete il nostro quadro di conformità di sottoscrizione e contribuire attivamente al miglioramento continuo dei nostri processi di sottoscrizione. In questo ruolo, non solo sovrintenderai alla “Zurich Way” di sottoscrivere, ma collaborerai anche con i colleghi per sostenere una forte governance di sottoscrizione e guidare l’eccellenza in tutta l’organizzazione.

Questo è un ruolo ibrido a tempo pieno dove lavorerai dal nostro ufficio a L'Aia, Paesi Bassi. L'orario di lavoro può essere discusso (minimo di 4 giorni alla settimana).

Panoramica del ruolo:

Come Coordinatore di Eccellenza di Sottoscrittura, potrai sfruttare la tua passione e la tua esperienza nella scrittura per gestire il nostro quadro di conformità e i miglioramenti dei campioni nei nostri processi di sottoscrizione. Sarete responsabili di supervisionare il business attraverso il Beneux, attingendo alla vostra motivazione per approfondire la conoscenza specializzata di prodotti assicurativi, industrie e mercati. Insieme ai vostri colleghi sarete attivamente a supporto dello sviluppo di politiche, governance e standard normativi all'interno della sottoscrizione, aiutando a definire la posizione politica di Zurigo e garantire costantemente la conformità normativa a livello organizzativo.

Responsabilità chiave:

- Sostenere lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di una strategia di sottoscrizione allineata alla gestione globale del portafoglio assicurativo generale.

- Coordinare e supportare il portafoglio e la gestione delle prestazioni, tra cui l'analisi della redditività e della crescita, raccomandando modifiche o azioni correttive necessarie.

- Campione La Via di Sottoscrittura e Prezzi di Zurigo in collaborazione con i contatti di business unit designati.

- Promuovere la coerenza della sottoscrizione tra le unità aziendali attraverso la metodologia comune, strumenti, presupposti e governance.

- Mantenere la politica di sottoscrizione e il quadro di controllo della linea guida, fornendo input nelle politiche generali di assicurazione e linee guida.

- Monitorare la conformità e intervenire per indagare o correggere violazioni o fraintendimenti.

- Controllare il quadro di controllo interno per la sottoscrizione, condurre regolari valutazioni dei rischi e garantire il rispetto delle azioni di mitigazione dei rischi del Gruppo.

Qualifiche:

- Corso di laurea (o esperienza equivalente) e l'esperienza fondamentale nella sottoscrizione.

- Altamente organizzato, con una forte gestione del tempo e capacità multi-progetto.

- Fluente sia in inglese che in olandese.

- Comunicatore persuasivo e sicuro in grado di connettersi con gli stakeholder.

- Dettaglio orientato con forti capacità analitiche.

- Efficace giocatore di squadra così come un collaboratore indipendente.

- Proattivo e capace di mostrare l'iniziativa.

- Ottimi competenze amministrative e di elaborazione.

Cosa puoi aspettarti da noi

A Zurich Insurance Benelux, riconosciamo il valore che i professionisti esperti portano alla nostra organizzazione. Offriamo un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e di supporto in cui le tue competenze saranno valutate e le tue aspirazioni di carriera supportate. Unisciti a noi e approfitta di:

- Compensazione competitiva e benefici che corrispondono alla vostra esperienza e responsabilità.

- Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale, imprenditoriale e informale.

- La possibilità di avere un impatto significativo come parte di un leader di assicurazione globale in crescita.

Unisciti a Zurich Benelux e fai il passo successivo nella tua carriera. È possibile applicare inviando il vostro CV; ci sarebbe molto apprezzare se si potrebbe fornire una breve motivazione accanto alla vostra applicazione o caricare una motivazione separata una volta che avete presentato la vostra domanda. Possiamo creare un futuro più luminoso insieme!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Über uns:

Bei Zurich Insurance Benelux ist es unser Ziel, eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt zu werden. Als führender Spezialist für Nichtlebensversicherungen für lokale und internationale Unternehmen, die in den Niederlanden, Belgien und Luxemburg tätig sind, bietet Zurich Insurance Benelux maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die den einzigartigen Bedürfnissen unserer Kunden gerecht werden. Eine spannende Gelegenheit besteht für Sie, sich unserem Team als Underwriting Excellence Coordinator anzuschließen, wo Sie unser Underwriting Compliance Framework verwalten und aktiv zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Underwriting-Prozesse beitragen. In dieser Rolle beaufsichtigen Sie nicht nur den „Zürich-Weg des Underwritings, sondern arbeiten auch mit Kollegen zusammen, um eine starke Underwriting-Governance zu gewährleisten und Exzellenz in der gesamten Organisation zu fördern.

Dies ist eine Vollzeit-Hybrid-Rolle, bei der Sie von unserem Büro in Den Haag, Niederlande, aus arbeiten werden. Teilzeitarbeit kann diskutiert werden (mindestens 4 Tage pro Woche).

Rollenübersicht:

Als Underwriting Excellence Coordinator nutzen Sie Ihre Leidenschaft und Erfahrung im Underwriting, um unser Compliance-Framework zu verwalten und Verbesserungen in unseren Underwriting-Prozessen voranzutreiben. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, das Geschäft in den Beneux zu beaufsichtigen, und nutzen Ihre Motivation, das Fachwissen über Versicherungsprodukte, Branchen und Märkte zu vertiefen. Gemeinsam mit Ihren Kollegen unterstützen Sie aktiv die Entwicklung von Richtlinien, Governance und regulatorischen Standards innerhalb des Underwritings, tragen dazu bei, die politische Position von Zurich zu definieren und die Einhaltung von Vorschriften organisatorisch konsequent sicherzustellen.

Wichtigste Aufgaben:

- Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Underwriting-Strategie, die auf das globale Management von General Insurance Portfolios ausgerichtet ist.

- Koordinieren und unterstützen Sie das Portfolio- und Performance-Management, einschließlich Rentabilitäts- und Wachstumsanalysen, und empfehlen Sie bei Bedarf Änderungen oder Abhilfemaßnahmen.

- Champion The Zurich Way of Underwriting and Pricing in Zusammenarbeit mit ausgewiesenen Business Unit-Kontakten.

- Förderung der Konsistenz des Underwritings in allen Geschäftsbereichen durch gemeinsame Methodik, Tools, Annahmen und Governance.

- Behalten Sie die Versicherungspolitik und den Rahmen für die Richtlinienkontrolle bei und liefern Sie einen Beitrag zu den allgemeinen Versicherungspolicen und -richtlinien.

- Beobachten Sie die Einhaltung und greifen Sie ein, um Verstöße oder Fehlinterpretationen zu untersuchen oder zu korrigieren.

- Überwachung des internen Kontrollrahmens für die Zeichnung, die Durchführung regelmäßiger Risikobewertungen und die Einhaltung der Maßnahmen zur Risikominderung für die Gruppe.

Qualifikationen:

- Bachelor-Abschluss (oder gleichwertige Erfahrung) und grundlegende Erfahrung im Underwriting.

- Hoch organisiert, mit starkem Zeitmanagement und Multiprojektfähigkeiten.

- Fließend in Englisch und Niederländisch.

- Überzeugender, selbstbewusster Kommunikator, der in der Lage ist, sich mit Stakeholdern zu verbinden.

- Detailorientiert mit starken analytischen Fähigkeiten.

- Effektiver Teamplayer sowie ein unabhängiger Mitwirkender.

- Proaktiv und fähig, Initiative zu zeigen.

- Hervorragende Verwaltungs- und Verarbeitungsfähigkeiten.

Was Sie von uns erwarten können

Bei Zurich Insurance Benelux erkennen wir den Wert, den erfahrene Fachleute in unsere Organisation einbringen. Wir bieten ein dynamisches und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Ihre Expertise geschätzt und Ihre Karriereziele unterstützt werden. Begleiten Sie uns und nutzen Sie:

- Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung und Vorteile, die Ihren Erfahrungen und Verantwortlichkeiten entsprechen.

- Arbeiten in einem internationalen, unternehmerischen und informellen Umfeld.

- Die Chance, als Teil eines wachsenden globalen Versicherungsführers eine sinnvolle Wirkung zu erzielen.

Treten Sie Zurich Benelux bei und machen Sie den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere. Sie können sich bewerben, indem Sie Ihren Lebenslauf einreichen; wir würden uns sehr freuen, wenn Sie neben Ihrer Bewerbung eine kurze Motivation angeben oder eine separate Motivation hochladen könnten, sobald Sie Ihre Bewerbung eingereicht haben. Wir können gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schaffen!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À propos de nous :

Chez Zurich Assurance Benelux, notre ambition est de devenir l'une des entreprises les plus responsables et les plus influentes du monde. En tant que spécialiste de l'assurance non-vie pour les entreprises locales et internationales opérant aux Pays-Bas, en Belgique et au Luxembourg, Zurich Assurance Benelux propose des solutions sur mesure répondant aux besoins uniques de nos clients. Vous aurez l'occasion de vous joindre à notre équipe en tant que coordonnateur de l'excellence de la souscription, où vous gérerez notre cadre de conformité de la souscription et contribuerez activement à l'amélioration continue de nos processus de souscription. Dans ce rôle, vous superviserez non seulement la manière de souscrire de Zurich, mais aussi collaborerez avec vos collègues pour maintenir une solide gouvernance de souscription et stimuler l'excellence dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

C'est un rôle hybride à plein temps où vous travaillerez de notre bureau à La Haye, Pays-Bas. Le travail à temps partiel peut être discuté (au minimum 4 jours par semaine).

Aperçu du rôle :

En tant que coordonnateur de l'excellence de la souscription, vous tirerez parti de votre passion et de votre expérience en matière de souscription pour gérer notre cadre de conformité et promouvoir les améliorations dans nos processus de souscription. Vous serez responsable de la supervision de l'entreprise à travers le Beneux, en s'appuyant sur votre motivation à approfondir les connaissances spécialisées des produits d'assurance, des industries et des marchés. En collaboration avec vos collègues, vous soutiendrez activement l'élaboration de politiques, de normes de gouvernance et de normes réglementaires dans le cadre de la souscription, contribuant ainsi à définir la position politique de Zurich et assurant systématiquement la conformité réglementaire à l'échelle de l'organisation.

Principales responsabilités :

- Appuyer l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre d'une stratégie de souscription alignée sur la gestion globale du portefeuille des assurances générales.

- Coordonner et appuyer la gestion du portefeuille et du rendement, y compris l'analyse de la rentabilité et de la croissance, en recommandant des changements ou des mesures correctives au besoin.

- Champion Le mode de souscription et de tarification de Zurich en collaboration avec les contacts désignés des unités commerciales.

- Promouvoir la cohérence de la souscription entre les unités opérationnelles au moyen de méthodes, d'outils, d'hypothèses et de gouvernance communes.

- Maintenir la politique de souscription et le cadre de contrôle des lignes directrices, en fournissant des commentaires sur les politiques et les lignes directrices de l'assurance générale.

- Surveiller la conformité et intervenir pour enquêter ou corriger les infractions ou les interprétations erronées.

- Superviser le cadre de contrôle interne pour la souscription, effectuer des évaluations régulières des risques et veiller à la conformité aux mesures d'atténuation des risques du Groupe.

Qualifications

- Baccalauréat (ou expérience équivalente) et expérience fondamentale dans la souscription.

- Très organisé, avec une forte gestion du temps et des capacités multi-projets.

- En anglais et en néerlandais.

- Un communicateur persuasif et confiant capable de communiquer avec les intervenants.

- Des compétences analytiques solides.

- Joueur d'équipe efficace ainsi qu'un contributeur indépendant.

- Proactive et capable de faire preuve d'initiative.

- Excellentes compétences en administration et en traitement.

Ce que vous pouvez attendre de nous

Chez Zurich Assurance Benelux, nous reconnaissons la valeur que les professionnels expérimentés apportent à notre organisation. Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et solidaire où votre expertise sera valorisée et vos aspirations de carrière soutenues. Rejoignez-nous et profitez de:

- Rémunération concurrentielle et avantages qui correspondent à votre expérience et vos responsabilités.

- Travailler dans un environnement international, entrepreneurial et informel.

- La chance d'avoir un impact significatif dans le cadre d'un leader mondial en matière d'assurance.

Rejoignez Zurich Benelux et faites le prochain pas dans votre carrière. Vous pouvez présenter votre candidature en soumettant votre CV; nous vous serions très reconnaissants de bien vouloir fournir une brève motivation à côté de votre candidature ou télécharger une motivation distincte une fois que vous avez soumis votre candidature. Nous pouvons créer ensemble un avenir meilleur !

jobs.title: Underwriter - Cyber & Tech PI
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We’re looking for a Cyber/Tech PI Underwriter or Broker (or someone with strong Cyber/Tech PI/Financial Lines experience looking to specialise) to help grow our Cyber portfolio in Milan. You’ll join our Global Speciality business as a key member of the Cyber /Tech PI team, supporting the delivery of our underwriting plan and building your expertise in a fast‑moving and innovative class.

You’ll develop strong technical Cyber/Tech PI underwriting skills, business and financial acumen, and a confident trading mindset, while working closely with senior underwriters, brokers and customers.

What will you be doing?

- Supporting the delivery of the Cyber/Tech PI underwriting plan in Milan, contributing to sound risk selection, pricing discipline and portfolio performance.

- Underwriting a mix of mid‑market and, with support, more complex Cyber/Tech PI risks in line with our appetite, guidelines and pricing frameworks, with a clear commitment to risk quality, governance and pro-active pipeline management / business development.

- Assisting senior underwriters with larger or more complex accounts, including data gathering, analysis, preparation of quotes and documentation.

- Using available tools, data and portfolio insights to inform underwriting decisions and help identify trends and opportunities.

- Building and maintaining strong working relationships with brokers and customers, acting as a reliable and responsive point of contact for day‑to‑day Cyber/Tech PI enquiries.

- Collaborating with colleagues across the team and wider functions (claims, actuarial, portfolio management and operations) to support effective case handling and portfolio management.

- Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, including process enhancement, use of new tools and ways of working, and sharing lessons learned.

- Taking ownership of your development plan, actively building your technical knowledge, market understanding and underwriting skills.

What are we looking for?

Technical expertise

- Experience as a Cyber/Tech PI Underwriter, Cyber Broker or in a related line (e.g. Financial Lines / Professional Indemnity) with an interest in specialising in Cyber.

- A good understanding of Cyber/Tech PI risks, exposures, controls and coverages, or a strong appetite and capability to build this quickly.

- Developing technical underwriting skills, with a commitment to risk quality, underwriting discipline and robust governance.

Breadth of business experience

- Demonstrable commercial awareness and an interest in how underwriting decisions impact portfolio performance and profitability.

- Ability to work with financial information and data to support underwriting decisions and reporting.

- Drive to deliver results, take responsibility for your portfolio and contribute to team targets.

Leadership capabilities (at an individual contributor level)

- A positive, trading mindset with the confidence to engage in broker discussions, supported by senior colleagues where needed.

- Willingness to take initiative, own tasks and follow through to completion.

- Collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively as part of a team and support peers.

Market orientation & agile stakeholder management

- Clear customer and broker focus, with strong relationship‑building skills and a professional, service‑oriented approach.

- Effective communication skills—numerical, verbal and written—with the ability to explain Cyber/Tech PI underwriting concepts clearly and simply.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and stakeholders in a fast‑moving environment, escalating appropriately and “managing up” by keeping senior underwriters informed.

- A commitment to continuous learning, knowledge sharing and adopting best practice across the team.

Key Information

- Language Requirements: Fluency in both Italian and English (written and spoken) is essential for this role, as you will interact with local brokers/clients as well as international stakeholders.

- Location: Milan, Italy (with hybrid working options).

- Compensation & Benefits:

- Base Salary Range: from 35.000 EUR per Year

Chi siamo

Siamo uno dei principali gruppi assicurativi al mondo e uno dei pochi che opera a livello globale. La nostra missione è quella di aiutare i nostri clienti a comprendere e a tutelarsi dai rischi. Con circa 53'000 collaboratori al servizio dei clienti in tutto il mondo, aspiriamo a diventare la migliore società assicurativa secondo i parametri dei nostri azionisti, clienti e collaboratori. Noi aiutiamo i clienti privati, le piccole e medie imprese e le società globali in tutto il mondo a comprendere i rischi e a tutelarsi dagli stessi offrendo un ampio ventaglio di prodotti assicurativi, soluzioni e servizi di consulenza.

In Zurich promuoviamo la cultura della diversità e dell'inclusione. Il nostro scopo e i nostri valori sono concepiti per proteggere, ispirare fiducia e aiutare i nostri dipendenti a raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Diamo importanza e difendiamo ciò che è giusto promuovendo l’uguaglianza tra i nostri professionisti, indipendentemente da sesso, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, etnia, generazione, convinzioni, ecc. I nostri processi d’acquisizione ed assunzione di talenti rispettano questo impegno quotidianamente.

Unisciti alla Zurich e diventa parte di questa cultura!

Per ulteriori informazioni su Zurich come datore di lavoro così come sul processo di candidatura può fare riferimento a http://www.zurich.it/lavora-con-noi/IlmondoZurich.htm

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Stiamo cercando un un underwriter o un broker Cyber/Tech PI/Financial Lines (o qualcuno con una forte esperienza Cyber/Tech PI/Financial Lines che si occupa di tirologia) per aiutare a far crescere il nostro portafoglio Cyber a Milano. Entrerete a far parte del nostro business Speciality Global come membri chiave del team Cyber/Tech PI, supportando la consegna del nostro piano di sottoscrizione e sviluppando la vostra esperienza in una classe innovativa e in rapida evoluzione.

You.ll sviluppare forti tecniche Cyber / Tech PI competenze di sottoscrizione, business e acumen finanziario, e una mentalità di trading fiduciosa, mentre lavorare a stretto contatto con i sottoscrittori senior, broker e clienti.

Cosa farai?

- Sostenere la realizzazione del piano di sottoscrizione Cyber/Tech PI a Milano, contribuendo a una sana selezione dei rischi, disciplina dei prezzi e performance di portafoglio.

- Sfruttare un mix di mercati medi e, con il supporto, rischi più complessi Cyber/Tech PI in linea con la nostra appetito, linee guida e quadri di tariffazione, con un chiaro impegno a qualità dei rischi, governance e gestione proattiva dei gasdotti / sviluppo aziendale.

- Assistenza agli autori senior con account più grandi o più complessi, tra cui raccolta dati, analisi, preparazione di preventivi e documentazione.

- Costruire e mantenere solide relazioni di lavoro con i broker e i clienti, fungendo da punto di contatto affidabile e reattivo per le indagini quotidiane Cyber/Tech PI.

Die Chance

Wir suchen einen Cyber/Tech PI Underwriter oder Broker (oder jemanden mit starker Cyber/Tech PI/Financial Lines Erfahrung, der sich spezialisiert) um unser Cyber-Portfolio in Mailand zu erweitern. Sie werden als Schlüsselmitglied des Cyber/Tech PI Teams unser Global Speciality-Geschäft unterstützen und die Lieferung unseres Underwriting-Plans unterstützen und Ihre Expertise in einer schnelllebigen und innovativen Klasse aufbauen.

Sie entwickeln starke technische Cyber/Tech PI-Verbriefungskompetenzen, Geschäfts- und Finanz-Akumene und eine vertrauensvolle Trading-Denkkraft, während Sie eng mit Senior Underwritern, Brokern und Kunden zusammenarbeiten.

Was wirst du tun?

- Unterstützung der Umsetzung des Cyber/Tech PI-Bestimmungsplans in Mailand, der zu einer soliden Risikoauswahl, Preisdisziplin und Portfolioleistung beiträgt.

- Schaffung eines Mixs aus mittleren Märkten und mit Unterstützung komplexeren Cyber/Tech-PI-Risiken, die unserem Appetit, unseren Leitlinien und unseren Preisgestaltungs-Rahmenwerken entsprechen, mit einem klaren Bekenntnis zu Risikoqualität, Governance und proaktivem Pipeline-Management/-Geschäftsentwicklung.

- Unterstützung älterer Underwriters mit größeren oder komplexeren Konten, einschließlich Datenerhebung, Analyse, Erstellung von Zitaten und Dokumentation.

- Mit verfügbaren Tools, Daten und Portfolio-Insights, um Entscheidungen zu informieren und Trends und Chancen zu identifizieren.

- Aufbau und Pflege starker Arbeitsbeziehungen mit Maklern und Kunden, die als verlässlicher und reaktionsschneller Ansprechpartner für tägliche Cyber/Tech-PI-Anfragen dienen.

- Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen im gesamten Team und breiteren Funktionen (Claims, versicherungsmathematische, Portfolio-Management und Operationen) zur Unterstützung eines effektiven Fallhandling und Portfolio-Management.

- Beitrag zu Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, einschließlich der Verbesserung der Prozesse, der Nutzung neuer Instrumente und Arbeitsweisen und des Austauschs der gewonnenen Erkenntnisse.

- Besitznahme Ihres Entwicklungsplans, aktiv Aufbau Ihrer technischen Kenntnisse, Marktverständnis und Underwriting Fähigkeiten.

Wonach suchen wir?

Technische Fachkompetenz

- Erfahrung als Cyber/Tech PI Underwriter, Cyber Broker oder in einer verwandten Linie (z.B. Financial Lines / Professional*) mit einem Interesse an der Spezialisierung auf Cyber.

- Ein gutes Verständnis von Cyber/Tech PI Risiken, Expositionen, Kontrollen und Abdeckungen, oder ein starker Appetit und Fähigkeit, dies schnell aufzubauen.

- Entwicklung technischer Fähigkeiten, mit dem Engagement für Risikoqualität, Underwriting-Disziplin und robuste Governance.

Breadth of business experience

- Nachweisbares kommerzielles Bewusstsein und Interesse daran, wie die Entscheidungen zur Unternehmensunterzeichnung die Portfolioleistung und Rentabilität beeinflussen.

- Fähigkeit, mit finanziellen Informationen und Daten zu arbeiten, um die Erstellung von Entscheidungen und Berichterstattung zu unterstützen.

- Antrieb, um Ergebnisse zu liefern, übernehmen Verantwortung für Ihr Portfolio und tragen zu Teamzielen.

Führungskompetenzen (auf individueller Ebene)

- Eine positive, Trading-Gesinnung mit dem Vertrauen, in Broker-Diskussionen, unterstützt von hochrangigen Kollegen, wo nötig.

- Bereitschaft, Initiative zu ergreifen, eigene Aufgaben zu übernehmen und bis zur Vollendung zu folgen.

- Zusammenarbeit, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv als Teil eines Teams und unterstützen Peers arbeiten.

Marktorientierung & agiles Stakeholder-Management

- Klare Kunden- und Maklerorientierung mit starken Beziehungsbildungskompetenzen und einem professionellen, serviceorientierten Ansatz.

- Effektive Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – numerisch, verbale und geschrieben – mit der Fähigkeit, Cyber/Tech PI-Unterschriftskonzepte klar und einfach zu erklären.

- Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben und Interessenträger in einem sich schnell bewegenden Umfeld zu verwalten, indem sie angemessen und unter Kontrolle sind, indem sie die leitenden Unterstützer informieren.

- Engagement für kontinuierliches Lernen, Wissensaustausch und die Übernahme bewährter Verfahren im gesamten Team.

- Sprachanforderungen: Die fließende Sprache in Italienisch und Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen) ist für diese Rolle von entscheidender Bedeutung, da Sie mit lokalen Broker/Kunden sowie internationalen Stakeholdern interagieren.

Expertise technique

jobs.description:
The opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced Cyber/Tech PI Underwriter or Broker to play a key role in shaping the future of our Cyber portfolio. You’ll join our Global Speciality business as a senior member of the Cyber team, with significant authority on complex risks and a clear mandate to drive profitable, sustainable growth. Tech PI Underwriting forms part of the Cyber Vertical at Global Specialty.

You’ll combine deep technical Cyber / Tech PI underwriting expertise with strong business and financial acumen, a winning trading mindset and a clear focus on customer and broker relationships.

What will you be doing?

- Leading and executing the Cyber underwriting plan, ensuring strong technical risk selection, pricing discipline and portfolio optimisation.

- Underwriting complex and high-value Cyber / Tech PI risks in line with our appetite, guidelines and pricing frameworks, with a clear commitment to risk quality, governance and best-in-class pipeline management / business development.

- Using data, portfolio insights and market intelligence to inform underwriting decisions, identify trends and support innovation in products, propositions and underwriting approach.

- Building, developing and maintaining strong relationships with key brokers and customers, acting as a visible and trusted point of contact for Cyber & Tech PI.

- Collaborating closely with the Head of Cyber and wider leadership to shape and deliver underwriting strategy, bringing commercial insight and experience across different market cycles.

- Providing technical leadership, coaching and mentoring to less experienced colleagues, helping to build capability and foster a high-performance, learning culture.

- Working effectively with a wide range of stakeholders (including claims, actuarial, portfolio management, operations and senior leaders), managing priorities and “managing up” with credibility and confidence.

- Supporting a culture of continuous improvement, including process enhancement, knowledge sharing and the use of new tools, data and ways of working.

What are we looking for?

Technical Expertise:

- Proven experience as a Cyber and/or Tech PI Underwriter or Broker, with strong market contacts and a track record of delivering profitable growth.

- Deep understanding of Cyber & Tech PI exposures, controls, coverages and emerging trends.

- Strong technical underwriting skills and commitment to risk quality and governance.

Breadth of Business Experience:

- Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to interpret financial information, understand P&L drivers and make decisions that support sustainable portfolio performance.

- Experience operating across different market and business cycles, with the ability to adapt trading strategies accordingly.

- Demonstrated ability to drive results, take ownership of targets and contribute to planning and portfolio steering.

Leadership Capabilities:

- A winning / trading mindset, with the confidence to take well-judged underwriting positions and negotiate effectively.

- Experience of providing technical leadership, coaching or mentoring to others.

- Ability to translate strategy into execution, prioritising effectively and delivering through collaboration.

Market Orientation & Agile Stakeholder Management:

- Clear market orientation: customer focus, relationship-building and openness to innovation.

- Confident, data-driven communicator who can influence multiple stakeholders and inspire credibility.

- Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-moving environment

- A commitment to continuous learning, knowledge sharing and driving best practice across the team.

Key Information

- Language Requirements: Fluency in both Italian and English (written and spoken) is essential for this role, as you will interact with local brokers/clients as well as international stakeholders.

- Location: Milan, Italy (with hybrid working options).

- Compensation & Benefits:

- Base Salary Range: from 55.000 EUR per Year

Siamo uno dei principali gruppi assicurativi al mondo e uno dei pochi che opera a livello globale. La nostra missione è quella di aiutare i nostri clienti a comprendere e a tutelarsi dai rischi. jobs.description:
At Zurich North America Claims we acknowledge that work life balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA Claims hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing claims employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location including the ability to work from a home office, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, occasional circumstances requiring in-office attendance should be expected. The candidate selected for this opportunity should be able to report to our Irvine CA Office once per week.

Zurich North America is hiring a Chief General Liability Attorney to join our team!

With minimal direction, The Chief Trial General Liability Attorney will represent the Company's insureds in all phases of litigation for matters of the highest technical complexity and engage in the practice of and the representation of Zurich insureds in litigation to protect their interests.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Achieving best outcomes for clients by demonstrating a high level of technical expertise in case handling, trial preparation and presentation for cases of the highest level of complexity.

- Driving positive results by correctly applying the law and legal trends, conducting legal analysis and research, preparing legal pleadings and documents, preparing for and managing pre-trial discovery, and participating in judicial or administrative hearings and trials.

- Documenting case files by accurately capturing and updating relevant information in compliance with best practices.

- Working to have a timely resolution to matters by collaborating with the claims adjuster, developing a case strategy and escalating issues as appropriate.

- Ensuring customer service to clients by proactively communicating information; responding to inquiries; and following customer protocols.

- Determining and implementing alternative dispute resolution techniques as appropriate, by using effective mediation and negotiation skills within authority limits.

- Maintaining professional and technical knowledge by participating in educational opportunities, staying current with industry trends, establishing personal networks and participating in professional societies.

- Contributing to the team effort by accomplishing related results and collaborating on matters as needed.

- Serving as a technical resource by providing guidance, and/or mentoring to lower-level attorneys on legal strategies and use of tools and resources.

- Identifying and suggesting improvement to tools and resources to contribute to continuous improvements and operational efficiencies.

- Ensuring legal compliance by following state and federal laws and regulations.

- Protecting Zurich’s reputation by keeping claims information confidential.

Basic Qualifications include:

- Juris Doctor and 10 or more years of experience in the Litigation area

- Extensive experience handling complex liability litigation, including trials, arbitrations, and mediations

- Strong record of successful jury trial outcomes, preferably in insurance defense or liability matters
AND

- Member of the California Bar in good standing

- Experience with Microsoft Office suite and Adobe

- Experience with Lexis or Westlaw

- Knowledge of the insurance industry, claims and the insurance defense litigation legal environment

- Knowledge of the law and procedure

Preferred Qualifications include:

- Effective communication skills

- Effective information technology skills

- Strong negotiation skills

- Experience working in a team-based environment

- Strong collaboration skills

- Effective problem solving and analytical skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The proposed Salary range for this position is $175,000 - $210,000, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 20%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

jobs.description:
At Zurich North America Claims we acknowledge that work life balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA Claims hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing claims employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location including the ability to work from a home office, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, occasional circumstances requiring in-office attendance should be expected. The candidate selected for this opportunity should be able to report to our Irvine CA Office once per week.

Zurich North America is seeking a successful Liability Trial Attorney.

If you are ready for a career move, consider working for a company with a global footprint that offers an excellent work/life balance, reasonable billable hours, including an incentive plan, 401K match, flexible work options, summer hours and a great culture.

The selected candidate will perform duties encompassing all aspects of insurance defense, including initial investigation and legal analysis and advice, preparing and filing legal pleadings and documents, performing legal research, preparing for and conducting pre-trial discovery, preparing for and aggressively handling hearings and trials, and conducting post-trial activities where appropriate. We are looking for demonstrated case analysis ability, a track record of proven trial and settlement skills and the ability to work independently without substantial supervision.

Additional responsibilities will include:

- Achieve best outcomes for clients by demonstrating a high level of technical excellence in case handling, trial preparation and presentation for matters of moderate to high complexity

- Drive positive outcomes by correctly applying the law and legal trends, conducting legal analysis and research, preparing legal pleadings and documents, preparing for and managing pre-trial discovery, and participating in judicial or administrative hearings and trials

- Document case files by accurately capturing and updating relevant information in compliance with best practices

- Work to have a timely resolution to matters by collaborating with the claims adjuster, developing a case strategy and escalating issues as appropriate

- Ensure customer service to clients by proactively communicating information; responding to inquiries; and following customer protocols

- Determine and implement alternative dispute resolution techniques as appropriate, by using effective mediation and negotiation skills within authority limit

- Maintain professional and technical knowledge by participating in educational opportunities, staying current with industry trends, establishing personal networks and participating in professional societies

- Contribute to the team effort by accomplishing related results and collaborating on matters as needed

- Serve as a technical resource by providing guidance and/or mentoring lower level attorneys on legal strategies and use of tools and resources

- Ensure legal compliance by following state and federal laws and regulations

- Protect Zurich’s reputation by keeping claims information confidential

Basic Qualifications:

- Juris Doctor and 5 or more years of experience in the Litigation area
AND

- Member in good standing of the California State Bar Association

- Experience with Microsoft Office and Adobe

- Experience working with Lexis or Westlaw

- Knowledge of the insurance industry, claims and the insurance defense litigation legal environment

- Knowledge of the law and procedure

Preferred Qualifications:

- Effective communication skills

- Effective negotiation skills

- Experience working in a team-based environment

- Collaboration skills

- Effective problem solving and analytical skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed salary range for this position is $150,000.00 - $190,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

- Festlegung und Umsetzung alternativer Streitbeilegungstechniken, wenn angemessen, durch den Einsatz effektiver Mediations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten innerhalb der Autoritätsgrenze

- Pflegen Sie professionelles und technisches Wissen, indem Sie an Bildungsmöglichkeiten teilnehmen, mit Branchentrends auf dem Laufenden bleiben, persönliche Netzwerke aufbauen und an Fachgesellschaften teilnehmen

jobs.description:
Over the past five years, Zurich North America has built a world-class Middle Market operation that serves key industries across the U.S. We strive to assemble a team of dedicated Middle Market leaders and underwriters who understand this space very deeply and who grasp the unique challenges of the various industry segments and the individual customers we serve. We are looking to add to our team in Chicago, IL.

While this position is based out of the Chicago office, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents.

In this role, you will serve as a customer advocate with a focus on improving customer experience by understanding their unique risks and offering the best end-to-end solution for their Property & Casualty insurance needs.

What you can expect in a Market Facing, Middle Market Underwriting position at Zurich:

- You will develop and maintain relationships with broker partners and customers across all industries in support of business objectives.

- You will leverage your Property and Casualty underwriting acumen across risk assessment, exposure evaluation and pricing to generate and maintain a profitable book of new and renewal business.

- You will work collaboratively across business units including but not limited to; claims, finance, risk engineering, actuary, and technical underwriting while gaining extensive knowledge in a growing and innovative industry.

- You will be empowered to use your technical underwriting, negotiation and interpersonal skills to grow and develop relationships with preferred distribution partners in an assigned territory.

This role will be filled at either the Executive Underwriter or AVP Underwriting Director level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Executive Underwriter Required Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support are
AND

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office

- Experience working on time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience working in a team environment

OR

AVP, Underwriting Director Required Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 7 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 14 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 12 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelors Degree

- Experience handling all lines of business in the Middle Market space (Auto, GL, Workers Compensation, Umbrella, Inland Marine and Property)

- Broker relationships in the Chicago Market

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Microsoft Office proficiency

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $110,200.00 - $238,700.00. The proposed salary range for the Executive Underwriter is $110,200.00 - $180,500.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15 %. The proposed salary range for the AVP Underwriting Director is $145,800.00 - $238,700.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 20%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

jobs.title: Underwriting Specialist OR Executive Underwriter - Middle Market
jobs.description:
Over the past five years, Zurich North America has built a world-class Middle Market operation that serves key industries across the U.S. We strive to assemble a team of dedicated Middle Market leaders and underwriters who understand this space very deeply and who grasp the unique challenges of the various industry segments and the individual customers we serve. We are looking to add to our team in Dallas, TX.

While this position is based out of the Dallas/Addison office, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents in the Dallas & Oklahoma territories. This role requires visibility in the marketplace, with the expectation of being in the office or market three days per week.

In this role, you will serve as a customer advocate with a focus on improving customer experience by understanding their unique risks and offering the best end-to-end solution for their Property & Casualty insurance needs.

What you can expect in a Market Facing, Middle Market Underwriting position at Zurich:

- You will develop and maintain relationships with broker partners and customers across all industries in support of business objectives.

- You will leverage your Property and Casualty underwriting acumen across risk assessment, exposure evaluation and pricing to generate and maintain a profitable book of new and renewal business.

- You will work collaboratively across business units including but not limited to; claims, finance, risk engineering, actuary, and technical underwriting while gaining extensive knowledge in a growing and innovative industry.

- You will be empowered to use your technical underwriting, negotiation and interpersonal skills to grow and develop relationships with preferred distribution partners in an assigned territory.

This role will be filled at either the Underwriting Specialist or Executive Underwriter level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Underwriting Specialist Required Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

OR

Executive Underwriter Required Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support are
AND

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office

- Experience working on time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience working in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelors Degree

- Broker relationships in the region

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Microsoft Office experience

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $79,600.00 -- $172,300.00. The proposed salary range for the Underwriting Specialist is $79,600.00 - $130,300.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%. The proposed salary range for the Executive Underwriter is $105,200.00 - $172,300.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

jobs.title: AI Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Senior Engineer

Place of work: Cracow

Job purpose:

Are you a motivated, hands-on, and innovative person, interested in working for one of the largest global insurers? Are you obsessed with developing great AI/LLM-powered analytics software, which helps addressing daily business challenges of one of the biggest global insurers? Then this job is something for you.

We are looking for an AI Senior Engineer with strong engineering skills to join the global Commercial Insurance team. In this role, you will:

- Solve high impact business problems with a particular focus on Underwriting, for example: understanding claims drivers, portfolio optimization or improving our risk selection,

- Learn how Commercial Insurance works at its core, including dedicated training,

- Be part of a fast-paced entrepreneurially minded global team, which is daring to challenge the status quo,

- Developing and driving adoption of our main global Underwriting analytical product suite,

- Excelling on your technical skills by working with internal and external experts.

Responsibilities:

- Working on high impact projects with end-to-end responsibility for their success

- Evaluating and applying the right cloud and foundation model capabilities (e.g., Azure OpenAI and open-source models) to solve specific business problems, including RAG, tool-use/agents, and orchestration

- Generating insights from internal and external data sources, using a wide range of tools and methodologies, e.g., from building robust big data pipelines in Spark/Databricks to applying LLMs, retrieval, embeddings, and classical ML/statistics, and extending our front-end applications

- Building applications loved by internal and external users: from implementing proof of concepts to full-scale solutions; from portfolio management applications used by senior Zurich executives to API services embedded into the core Underwriting processes

- Making sure our platform expands and runs reliably in Production: build or help build AI models, add new and further optimize existing data pipelines, expand our automation architecture (e.g., web scrapers, automated user alerts)

- Coordinating directly with product managers and application users globally (with particular focus on adoption)

- Mentoring and developing more junior team members on all matters above

Candidate’s profile:

- Technically strong:

- Has professional experience across data science and data engineering (shipping production grade analytics/AI applications)

- Hands-on experience building LLM applications (e.g., prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector stores, evaluation & guardrails, cost/performance tuning) and willingness to engineer the full stack to get them into production

- Familiarity with agentic patterns (tool use, planning, function calling, document workflows) and LLM orchestration frameworks

- Solid statistical foundations (e.g. regression, time series, uncertainty estimation)

- Any Dataframe API (like Spark or Pandas) and SQL

- Query optimizations (RDBMS or Spark) and indexing

- Strong Python (production-grade). Java and/or Scala are a plus; functional programming experience is a plus

- Knowledge of scripting languages, such as Python, R, bash

- Experience working on all stages of the software development lifecycle

- Can-do attitude, with a clear focus on the end-product and user experience and the specific business use case

- Passion to tackle real business problems and persistence to follow through with your recommendations

- Good team player and communicator

- Excellent written and spoken English, other European languages are a plus

Preferred skills/experience:

- Experience with cloud-based technology and solution design: e.g., experience with Microsoft Azure Products, Databricks, Kubernetes, Docker

- Front-end development experience is a strong plus

- Experience in designing, running, and expanding AI models (in particular, text classification, entity extraction, clustering & topic modeling) in production; with a main focus on Natural Language processing

- Experience with web scraping, e.g., Selenium/Playwright

We offer:

- Real life opportunities to develop and grow with us and contribute to the world around us

- Competitive salaries, language allowance and an employee benefits package that includes among others medical insurance, life insurance and sport-card

- Annual bonus depending on company annual results and individual performance

- Wide range of learning programs and personal development opportunities including also possibility to apply for up to 80% of educational trainings reimbursement

- Referral awards

- Online fitness trainings

- Hybrid work

- Nice and friendly atmosphere

Who we are:

Zurich Insurance Group (Zurich) is a leading multi-line insurer serving people and businesses in more than 200 countries and territories. Founded 150 years ago, Zurich is transforming insurance. In addition to providing insurance protection, Zurich is increasingly offering prevention services such as those that promote wellbeing and enhance climate resilience. Reflecting its purpose to ‘create a brighter future together’, Zurich aspires to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. It is targeting net-zero emissions by 2050 and has the highest-possible ESG rating from MSCI. In 2020, Zurich launched the Zurich Forest project to support reforestation and biodiversity restoration in Brazil. The Group has about 60,000 employees and is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Zurich Insurance Group Ltd (ZURN), is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange and has a level I American Depositary Receipt (ZURVY) program, which is traded over-the-counter on OTCQX. Further information is available at www.zurich.com .

In March 2016 we established a Shared Service Centre in Kraków, in Poland to support our global strategy. It is from this location that we have created a global shared service platform, focusing on advanced business functions such as financial accounting and reporting, planning and performance management, ICFR testing, financial systems management as well as HR integrated talent management operations.

This role is related to the key area of Zurich’s activity in Kraków. We are committed to complete the recruitment process as soon as possible, however in some occasions it may take up to 6 months and the requirements for the position may be subject to some clarification or modification during the recruitment process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
AI Senior Engineer

Luogo di lavoro: Cracovia

Scopo di lavoro:

Sei una persona motivata, pratica e innovativa, interessata a lavorare per uno dei più grandi assicuratori globali? Sei ossessionato dallo sviluppo di un grande software di analisi basato su AI/LLM, che aiuta ad affrontare le sfide aziendali quotidiane di uno dei più grandi assicuratori globali? Allora questo lavoro e' qualcosa per te.

Siamo alla ricerca di un AI Senior Engineer con forti competenze ingegneristiche per aderire al team di assicurazione commerciale globale. In questo ruolo, voi:

- Risolvere problemi di business ad alto impatto con una particolare attenzione alla sottoscrizione, ad esempio: comprensione dei crediti driver, ottimizzazione del portafoglio o miglioramento della nostra selezione di rischi,

- Scopri come funziona l'assicurazione commerciale al suo centro, compresa la formazione dedicata,

- Essere parte di un team globale di mentalità imprenditoriale veloce, che è l'onere di sfidare lo status quo,

- Sviluppare e guidare l'adozione della nostra principale suite di prodotti analitici di scrittura globale,

- Eccellenza sulle tue competenze tecniche lavorando con esperti interni ed esterni.

Responsabilità:

- Lavorare a progetti ad alto impatto con responsabilità end-to-end per il loro successo

- Valutare e applicare le giuste funzionalità del modello cloud e di base (ad esempio, Azure OpenAI e modelli open-source) per risolvere specifici problemi di business, tra cui RAG, tool-use/agents, e orchestrazione

- Generando informazioni provenienti da fonti di dati interne ed esterne, utilizzando una vasta gamma di strumenti e metodologie, ad esempio, dalla costruzione di grandi datadotti robusti in Spark/Databricks per l'applicazione di LLM, retrival, embeddings, e ML/statistics classica, e estendendo le nostre applicazioni front-end

- Applicazioni costruttive amate dagli utenti interni ed esterni: dall'implementazione della prova dei concetti alle soluzioni su larga scala; dalle applicazioni di gestione del portafoglio utilizzate dai dirigenti senior di Zurigo ai servizi API incorporati nei processi fondamentali di scrittura

- Assicurarsi che la nostra piattaforma si espanda e funziona in modo affidabile in Produzione: costruire o aiutare a costruire modelli AI, aggiungere nuovi e ulteriormente ottimizzare i datadotti esistenti, espandere la nostra architettura di automazione (ad esempio, raschietti web, avvisi utente automatizzati)

- Coordinare direttamente con i product manager e gli utenti delle applicazioni a livello globale (con particolare attenzione all'adozione)

- Mentoring e sviluppo di più membri della squadra junior su tutte le questioni sopra

Profilo del candidato:

- Tecnicamente forte:

- Ha esperienza professionale attraverso la scienza dei dati e l'ingegneria dei dati (struzioni di analisi del grado di produzione / applicazioni AI)

- Hands-on experience building applicazioni LLM (ad esempio, progettazione rapida, generazione aumentata, incorporazione, negozi vettoriali, valutazione & guardrails, tuning di costi/prestazioni) e la volontà di progettare lo stack completo per farli entrare in produzione

- Familiarità con modelli agentici (uso dello strumento, pianificazione, chiamata della funzione, flussi di lavoro documentali) e quadri di orchestrazione LLM

- solide basi statistiche (ad esempio regressione, serie temporali, stima dell'incertezza)

- Qualsiasi API Dataframe (come Spark o Pandas) e SQL

- Ottimizzazione delle query (RDBMS o Spark) e indicizzazione

- Forte Python (produzione-grade). Java e/o Scala sono un plus; l'esperienza di programmazione funzionale è un plus

- Conoscenza delle lingue di scrittura, come Python, R, bash

- Esperienza di lavoro su tutte le fasi del ciclo di vita di sviluppo software

- atteggiamento Can-do, con una chiara attenzione al prodotto finale e l'esperienza utente e il caso di uso aziendale specifico

- Passione per affrontare problemi di business reali e persistenza a seguire con le vostre raccomandazioni

- Buon giocatore di squadra e comunicatore

- Ottimo scritto e parlato inglese, altre lingue europee sono un plus

Preferite competenze/esperienza:

- Esperienza con tecnologia basata su cloud e progettazione di soluzioni: ad esempio, esperienza con prodotti Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Kubernetes, Docker

- L'esperienza di sviluppo di front-end è un vantaggio forte

- Esperienza nella progettazione, esecuzione e espansione dei modelli AI (in particolare, classificazione del testo, estrazione dell'entità, clustering e modellazione dell'argomento) in produzione; con un focus principale sull'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale

- Esperienza con web scraping, ad esempio, Selenium/Playwright

Offriamo:

- Real life opportunità di sviluppare e crescere con noi e contribuire al mondo intorno a noi

- Retribuzioni competitive, indennità di lingua e un pacchetto di prestazioni dei dipendenti che include tra gli altri assicurazione medica, assicurazione sulla vita e sport-card

- Bonus annuale a seconda dei risultati annuali aziendali e delle prestazioni individuali

- Ampia gamma di programmi di apprendimento e opportunità di sviluppo personale, tra cui anche la possibilità di richiedere fino all'80% di formazione di rimborso

- Premi di riferimento

- Corsi di fitness online

- Lavoro ibrido

- Atmosfera piacevole e accogliente

Chi siamo:

Zurich Insurance Group (Zurich) è un'assicurazione multi-linea leader che serve persone e imprese in oltre 200 paesi e territori. Fondata 150 anni fa, Zurigo sta trasformando l'assicurazione. Oltre a fornire protezione assicurativa, Zurigo offre sempre più servizi di prevenzione come quelli che promuovono il benessere e migliorano la resilienza climatica. Riflettendo il suo scopo di “creare insieme un futuro più luminoso”, Zurigo aspira ad essere una delle imprese più responsabili e d’impatto al mondo. È mirato alle emissioni di net-zero entro il 2050 e ha il più alto grado di ESG possibile da MSCI. Nel 2020 Zurigo ha lanciato il progetto Forest di Zurigo per sostenere il rimboschimento e il ripristino della biodiversità in Brasile. Il Gruppo ha circa 60.000 dipendenti e ha sede a Zurigo, in Svizzera. Zurich Insurance Group Ltd (ZURN), è elencato sulla SIX Swiss Exchange e ha un programma di livello I American Depositary Receipt (ZURVY), che viene scambiato sul conto su OTCQX. Ulteriori informazioni sono disponibili su www.zurich.com .

Nel marzo 2016 abbiamo istituito un Centro Servizi Condiviso a Cracovia, in Polonia, per sostenere la nostra strategia globale. È da questa posizione che abbiamo creato una piattaforma di servizio condivisa globale, concentrandosi su funzioni aziendali avanzate come contabilità finanziaria e reporting, pianificazione e gestione delle prestazioni, test ICFR, gestione dei sistemi finanziari e operazioni di gestione dei talenti integrati HR.

Questo ruolo è legato all’area chiave dell’attività di Zurigo a Cracovia. Ci impegniamo a completare il processo di reclutamento il prima possibile, tuttavia in alcune occasioni può richiedere fino a 6 mesi e i requisiti per la posizione possono essere soggetti a qualche chiarificazione o modifica durante il processo di reclutamento.

- Erfahren Sie, wie Commercial Insurance im Kern funktioniert, einschließlich dedizierter Schulungen,

- Seien Sie Teil eines schnelllebigen, unternehmerisch denkenden globalen Teams, das es wagt, den Status quo in Frage zu stellen.

- Entwicklung und Förderung der Einführung unserer wichtigsten globalen Analyseproduktsuite Underwriting,

- Hervorhebung Ihrer technischen Fähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Experten.

Zuständigkeiten:

- Arbeiten an einflussreichen Projekten mit End-to-End-Verantwortung für ihren Erfolg

- Bewertung und Anwendung der richtigen Cloud- und Foundation-Modellfunktionen (z. B. Azure OpenAI und Open-Source-Modelle), um spezifische Geschäftsprobleme wie RAG, Tool-Use/Agents und Orchestrierung zu lösen

- Erzeugen von Erkenntnissen aus internen und externen Datenquellen mit einer breiten Palette von Tools und Methoden, z. B. vom Aufbau robuster Big-Data-Pipelines in Spark / Databricks über die Anwendung von LLMs, Abrufen, Einbetten und klassischer ML / Statistik bis hin zur Erweiterung unserer Frontend-Anwendungen

- Erstellen von Anwendungen, die von internen und externen Benutzern geliebt werden: von der Implementierung von Proof-of-Concepts bis hin zu Full-Scale-Lösungen; von Portfoliomanagement-Anwendungen, die von leitenden Zürcher Führungskräften verwendet werden, bis hin zu API-Services, die in die zentralen Underwriting-Prozesse eingebettet sind

- Sicherstellen, dass unsere Plattform in der Produktion zuverlässig erweitert und läuft: KI-Modelle erstellen oder mithelfen, neue Datenpipelines hinzufügen und bestehende Daten weiter optimieren, unsere Automatisierungsarchitektur erweitern (z. B. Web Scraper, automatisierte Benutzerbenachrichtigungen)

- Direkte Koordination mit Produktmanagern und Anwendungsbenutzern weltweit (mit besonderem Fokus auf Adoption)

- Mentoring und Entwicklung von mehr Junior-Teammitgliedern zu allen oben genannten Themen

Profil des Kandidaten:

- Technisch stark:

- Verfügt über Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Data Science und Data Engineering (Versand von Production Grade Analytics / AI-Anwendungen)

- Hands-on-Erfahrung beim Erstellen von LLM-Anwendungen (z. B. promptes Design, retrieval-augmented Generation, Einbettungen, Vektorspeicher, Evaluation & Leitplanken, Kosten-/Leistungs-Tuning) und Bereitschaft, den gesamten Stack zu entwickeln, um sie in die Produktion zu bringen

- Vertrautheit mit agentischen Mustern (Tool-Nutzung, Planung, Funktionsaufruf, Dokumenten-Workflows) und LLM-Orchestrierungs-Frameworks

- Solide statistische Grundlagen (z. B. Regression, Zeitreihen, Unsicherheitsschätzung)

- Jede Dataframe-API (wie Spark oder Pandas) und SQL

- Query-Optimierungen (RDBMS oder Spark) und Indexierung

- Starkes Python (Produktionsqualität). Java und/oder Scala sind ein Plus; funktionale Programmiererfahrung ist ein Plus

- Kenntnisse in Skriptsprachen wie Python, R, Bash

- Erfahrung in allen Phasen des Softwareentwicklungslebenszyklus

- Can-do-Haltung, mit einem klaren Fokus auf das Endprodukt und die Benutzererfahrung und den spezifischen Business Use Case

- Leidenschaft für die Bewältigung echter Geschäftsprobleme und Beharrlichkeit, um Ihre Empfehlungen zu befolgen

- Guter Teamplayer und Kommunikator

- Hervorragend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch, andere europäische Sprachen sind ein Plus

Bevorzugte Fähigkeiten/Erfahrung:

- Erfahrung mit Cloud-basierter Technologie und Lösungsdesign: z.B. Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure Products, Databricks, Kubernetes, Docker

- Frontend-Entwicklungserfahrung ist ein starkes Plus

- Erfahrung in der Gestaltung, Ausführung und Erweiterung von KI-Modellen (insbesondere Textklassifizierung, Entitätsextraktion, Clustering & Themenmodellierung) in der Produktion; mit Schwerpunkt auf Natural Language Processing

- Erfahrung mit Web Scraping, z.B. Selenium/Playwright

Wir bieten:

- Reale Lebenschancen, um sich mit uns zu entwickeln und zu wachsen und zur Welt um uns herum beizutragen

- Wettbewerbsfähige Gehälter, Sprachzulage und ein Arbeitnehmerleistungspaket, das unter anderem Krankenversicherung, Lebensversicherung und Sportkarte umfasst

- Jährlicher Bonus abhängig von Unternehmensjahresergebnissen und individueller Leistung

- Breites Spektrum an Lernprogrammen und Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen Entwicklung, einschließlich der Möglichkeit, bis zu 80% der Erstattung von Bildungsausbildungen zu beantragen

- Verweisungszuschüsse

- Online-Fitnesstrainings

- Hybridarbeit

- Schöne und freundliche Atmosphäre

Wer wir sind:

Die Zurich Insurance Group (Zürich) ist ein führender Multiline-Versicherer, der Menschen und Unternehmen in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen betreut. Vor 150 Jahren gegründet, verändert Zürich die Versicherung. Neben dem Versicherungsschutz bietet Zürich zunehmend auch Präventionsleistungen an, die das Wohlbefinden fördern und die Klimaresistenz stärken. Mit dem Ziel, „gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft zu schaffen, strebt Zürich danach, eines der verantwortungsvollsten und einflussreichsten Unternehmen der Welt zu sein. Es strebt bis 2050 Netto-Null-Emissionen an und hat das höchstmögliche ESG-Rating von MSCI. Im Jahr 2020 startete Zürich das Projekt „Zürcher Wald zur Unterstützung der Wiederaufforstung und der Wiederherstellung der biologischen Vielfalt in Brasilien. Die Gruppe beschäftigt rund 60.000 Mitarbeiter und hat ihren Hauptsitz in Zürich, Schweiz. Zurich Insurance Group Ltd (ZURN), ist an der SIX Swiss Exchange notiert und verfügt über ein American Depositary Receipt (ZURVY) Programm der Stufe I, das an OTCQX rezeptfrei gehandelt wird. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter www.zurich.com .

Im März 2016 haben wir in Krakau, Polen, ein Shared Service Center eingerichtet, um unsere globale Strategie zu unterstützen. Von diesem Standort aus haben wir eine globale Shared-Service-Plattform geschaffen, die sich auf fortschrittliche Geschäftsfunktionen wie Finanzbuchhaltung und -berichterstattung, Planung und Leistungsmanagement, ICFR-Tests, Finanzsystemmanagement sowie HR-integrierte Talentmanagement-Operationen konzentriert.

Diese Rolle steht im Zusammenhang mit dem Kernbereich der Zürcher Tätigkeit in Krakau. Wir verpflichten uns, den Rekrutierungsprozess so schnell wie möglich abzuschließen, in einigen Fällen kann es jedoch bis zu 6 Monate dauern und die Anforderungen für die Position können während des Rekrutierungsprozesses einer Klarstellung oder Änderung unterliegen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ingénieur principal AI

Lieu de travail: Cracovie

Emploi:

Êtes-vous une personne motivée, pratique et innovante, intéressée à travailler pour l'un des plus grands assureurs mondiaux? Êtes-vous obsédé par le développement d'un excellent logiciel d'analyse alimenté par AI/LLM, qui aide à relever les défis quotidiens de l'un des plus grands assureurs mondiaux? Alors ce travail est quelque chose pour vous.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur senior AI avec de solides compétences en ingénierie pour rejoindre l'équipe mondiale d'assurance commerciale. Dans ce rôle, vous :

- Résoudre les problèmes d'affaires à fort impact avec un accent particulier sur la souscription, par exemple: comprendre les moteurs de réclamations, optimiser le portefeuille ou améliorer notre sélection de risques,

- Découvrez comment l'assurance commerciale fonctionne à son cœur, y compris la formation spécialisée,

- Faire partie d'une équipe mondiale d'esprit d'entreprise rapide, qui ose défier le statu quo,

- Développer et piloter l'adoption de notre principale suite mondiale de produits d'analyse,

- Excellentez vos compétences techniques en travaillant avec des experts internes et externes.

Responsabilités :

- Travailler sur des projets à haut impact avec la responsabilité de bout en bout de leur succès

- Évaluer et appliquer les bonnes capacités du modèle de cloud et de fondation (p. ex., les modèles Azure OpenAI et open-source) pour résoudre des problèmes d'affaires spécifiques, y compris le RAG, l'utilisation d'outils/agents et l'orchestration

- Générer des informations à partir de sources de données internes et externes, à l'aide d'un large éventail d'outils et de méthodologies, p. ex., de la construction de pipelines de mégadonnées robustes dans Spark/Databricks à l'application de LLM, la récupération, l'intégration et la ML/statistique classique, et l'extension de nos applications front-end

- Bâtir des applications appréciées des utilisateurs internes et externes : de la mise en œuvre de preuves de concepts aux solutions à grande échelle ; des applications de gestion de portefeuille utilisées par les cadres supérieurs de Zurich aux services API intégrés dans les processus de base de souscription

- S'assurer que notre plateforme se développe et fonctionne de manière fiable dans Production: construire ou aider à construire des modèles d'IA, ajouter de nouveaux pipelines de données existants et encore optimiser, étendre notre architecture d'automatisation (par exemple, racleurs web, alertes automatisées des utilisateurs)

- Coordination directe avec les gestionnaires de produits et les utilisateurs d'applications à l'échelle mondiale (en mettant l'accent sur l'adoption)

- Mentoring et développement d'un plus grand nombre de membres de l'équipe junior sur toutes les questions ci-dessus

Profil du candidat:

- Techniquement fort:

- A une expérience professionnelle dans les domaines de la science des données et de l'ingénierie des données (analyse de qualité de production/applications AI)

- Expérience pratique de construction d'applications LLM (p. ex. conception rapide, génération augmentée de récupération, emboîtements, magasins vectoriels, évaluation et garde-corps, réglage coût/performance) et volonté d'ingénierie de la pile complète pour les mettre en production

- Familiarité avec les modèles d'agents (utilisation des outils, planification, appel de fonctions, flux de travail des documents) et les cadres d'orchestration LLM

- Fondements statistiques solides (p. ex. régression, séries chronologiques, estimation de l'incertitude)

- Toute API Dataframe (comme Spark ou Pandas) et SQL

- Optimisations des requêtes (RDBMS ou Spark) et indexation

- Python fort (grade de production). Java et/ou Scala sont un plus; expérience de programmation fonctionnelle est un plus

- Connaissance des langages de script, tels que Python, R, bash

- Expérience de travail sur toutes les étapes du cycle de développement logiciel

- Faire preuve d'attitude, en mettant clairement l'accent sur le produit final et l'expérience utilisateur, ainsi que sur l'analyse de rentabilité spécifique

- Passion de s'attaquer à de vrais problèmes d'affaires et persévérance à suivre vos recommandations

- Bon joueur d'équipe et communicateur

- Excellent anglais écrit et parlé, d'autres langues européennes sont un plus

Compétences/expérience privilégiées:

- Expérience avec la technologie basée sur le cloud et la conception de solutions: par exemple, expérience avec Microsoft Azure Products, Databricks, Kubernetes, Docker

- L'expérience de développement de l'avant-garde est un plus fort

- Expérience dans la conception, l'exploitation et l'expansion des modèles d'IA (en particulier la classification textuelle, l'extraction d'entités, le regroupement et la modélisation de sujets) dans la production; l'accent étant mis sur le traitement du langage naturel

- Expérience avec le grattage de toile, par exemple, Sélénium/Playwright

Nous offrons:

- Possibilités réelles de se développer et de grandir avec nous et de contribuer au monde qui nous entoure

- Salaires concurrentiels, allocation linguistique et régime d'avantages sociaux des employés qui comprend notamment l'assurance maladie, l'assurance-vie et la carte de sport

- Prime annuelle selon les résultats annuels de l'entreprise et les performances individuelles

- Un large éventail de programmes d'apprentissage et d'occasions de perfectionnement personnel, y compris la possibilité de demander jusqu'à 80 % du remboursement de la formation

- Primes de renvoi

- Cours de fitness en ligne

- Travail hybride

- Ambiance agréable et conviviale

Qui nous sommes :

Zurich Insurance Group (Zurich) est un assureur multiligne leader au service des personnes et des entreprises dans plus de 200 pays et territoires. Fondée il y a 150 ans, Zurich transforme l'assurance. En plus d'offrir une protection d'assurance, Zurich offre de plus en plus des services de prévention tels que ceux qui favorisent le bien-être et améliorent la résilience climatique. Reflétant son objectif de « créer ensemble un avenir meilleur », Zurich aspire à être l'une des entreprises les plus responsables et les plus influentes du monde. Il cible les émissions nettes nulles d'ici 2050 et a la cote ESG la plus élevée possible de MSCI. En 2020, Zurich a lancé le projet de la forêt de Zurich pour soutenir le reboisement et la restauration de la biodiversité au Brésil. Le Groupe compte environ 60 000 salariés et a son siège social à Zurich, en Suisse. Zurich Insurance Group Ltd (ZURN), est coté sur la SIX Swiss Exchange et possède un programme de niveau I American Depositary Receipt (ZURVY), qui est échangé en vente libre sur OTCQX. De plus amples informations sont disponibles sur le site www.zurich.com.

En mars 2016, nous avons créé un centre de services partagés à Cracovie, en Pologne, pour soutenir notre stratégie mondiale. C'est à partir de cet endroit que nous avons créé une plateforme de services partagés à l'échelle mondiale, qui met l'accent sur les fonctions opérationnelles avancées telles que la comptabilité et l'établissement de rapports financiers, la planification et la gestion du rendement, l'essai du CIRF, la gestion des systèmes financiers et les opérations de gestion intégrée des talents en RH.

Ce rôle est lié au domaine clé de l'activité de Zurich à Cracovie. Nous nous engageons à terminer le processus de recrutement le plus tôt possible, mais dans certains cas, il peut prendre jusqu'à six mois et les exigences relatives au poste peuvent faire l'objet de précisions ou de modifications au cours du processus de recrutement.
