descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi del lavoro

Zurich Insurance Europe AG, Irlanda Branch sta cercando un Esecutivo per lo Sviluppo delle Aziende Agricole di aderire al team in un contratto a termine fisso di 12 mesi.

Il ruolo centrale dell’Esecutivo per lo Sviluppo Agricolo è quello di supportare i nostri nove manager per lo sviluppo aziendale e The Head of Farm Sales per costruire la quota di Zurigo nel settore agricolo.

Questo ruolo può essere disponibile a tempo parziale o a tempo pieno. Questo perché vogliamo le persone migliori per i nostri ruoli, e riconosciamo che a volte quelle persone non sono disponibili a tempo pieno. Si prega di parlare con noi durante l'intervista sulla flessibilità che potrebbe essere necessario.

Il tuo ruolo

Come un Business Development Executive Farms le vostre responsabilità principali includono, ma non necessariamente essere limitato a, i seguenti:

Cliente

• Sviluppare e ideare un piano aziendale appropriato con i manager dello sviluppo aziendale.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i nostri partner Dairygold, ICMSA & FDC, gestione del rinvio, domande urgenti e report MI.
• Sostenere i clienti su base giornaliera.
• Contattare ogni riferimento all’interno della SLA concordata.
• Consulenza potenziali clienti della nostra azienda agricola e prodotti connessi disponibili.
• Sostenere i manager di sviluppo aziendale fattoria per raggiungere il nostro piano GWP.
• Assicurarsi che tutte le informazioni sulle aree di segnalazione chiave siano aggiornate su Salesforce
• Viaggia agli eventi se necessario

Persone

• Lavorare in modo proattivo con i responsabili dello sviluppo aziendale per aiutare ad ampliare le relazioni di Zurigo in tutto il settore agricolo.
• Supporto team collegaues per raggiungere il successo complessivo
• Contribuisci ad un processo di comunicazione efficace.
• Sfida sottoscritti sull'appetito di rischio.
• La croce di lavoro funzionalmente con il personale linee motore e team di famiglia in un'offerta per garantire conti generali.

Relazione

• Fornire statistiche di gestione regolari e tempestive per i rinvii, preventivi, casi legati, GWP e tassi di conversione al nostro rappresentante chiave del conto e gestione interna come richiesto.
• Monitorare le prestazioni del libro di rinnovo del business che può coinvolgere il lavoro cross funzionale con altri team
• Escalation di questioni importanti per quanto riguarda i rinnovi e le questioni importanti, agendo in modo proattivo per ridurre l'impatto sul business

Le tue abilità e esperienza

• Minimo di 2 onori in soggetti di livello superiore nel certificato di abbandono (o equivalente) o terza qualifica di livello
• CIP auspicabile
• Capacità di acquisizione vendite auspicabile
• Eccellente acume aziendale tra assicurazioni e altre industrie insieme ad un approccio professionale alle relazioni commerciali
• · Una conoscenza di lavoro e comprensione di tutte le linee di prodotto.
· Forte capacità di gestione del progetto

Informazioni aggiuntive

La posizione di lavoro primaria è basata su Wexford, ma i viaggi occasionali possono essere richiesti ad altre località di Zurigo.

Se si apprezza un ambiente di lavoro emozionante e vario e soddisfare i requisiti di cui sopra, allora il nostro recruiter è impaziente di ricevere la vostra applicazione facendo clic sul pulsante “Applicare online”.

Chi siamo

Zurigo è una delle principali compagnie assicurative irlandesi che offrono una vasta gamma di assicurazioni generali e di prodotti e servizi assicurativi per la vita. L'azienda impiega oltre 1.000 persone in tutte le sue sedi a Dublino e Wexford.

Zurigo è un marchio forte – con i nostri 53.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo formano la base del nostro successo, aiutando i nostri clienti in 210 paesi e territori a comprendere e proteggere se stessi dal rischio. Al fine di fornire i nostri servizi, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti modelli di lavoro flessibili e interessanti opportunità di ulteriore formazione e sviluppo. Come dipendente di Zurigo beneficiate di una moltitudine di vantaggi e di una cultura forte, caratterizzata da accettazione, diversità e spirito di squadra.

A Zurigo, adottiamo una cultura della diversità e dell'inclusione. Il nostro scopo e i nostri valori sono progettati per proteggere, ispirare la fiducia e aiutare i nostri dipendenti a raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Apprezziamo e difendiamo ciò che è giusto e promuoviamo opportunità di equità tra i nostri professionisti, indipendentemente dal sesso, dalla disabilità, LGBTQ +, dalla razza, dall'etnia, dalle generazioni, dalla fede, ecc. Unisciti a Zurigo e partecipiamo a questa cultura. Insieme siamo impegnati a fornire sul nostro scopo - Creare un futuro più luminoso insieme!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Stellenbeschreibung

Zurich Insurance Europe AG, Zweigniederlassung Irland, sucht einen Manager für die Geschäftsentwicklung von Farmen, der sich dem Team für einen 12-monatigen befristeten Vertrag anschließt.

Die Kernaufgabe der Farm Development Executive besteht darin, unsere neun Business Development Manager und The Head of Farm Sales dabei zu unterstützen, den Anteil von Zurich am Agrarsektor aufzubauen.

Diese Rolle kann Teilzeit oder Vollzeit verfügbar sein. Das liegt daran, dass wir die besten leute für unsere rollen wollen, und wir erkennen, dass diese leute manchmal nicht vollzeit verfügbar sind. Bitte sprechen Sie mit uns im Interview über die Flexibilität, die Sie möglicherweise benötigen.

Deine Rolle

Als Farms Business Development Executive umfassen Ihre Hauptaufgaben, sind aber nicht unbedingt auf Folgendes beschränkt:

Kunde

• Entwickeln und erarbeiten Sie einen geeigneten Businessplan mit den Business Development Managern.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Partnern Dairygold, ICMSA & FDC, Empfehlungsmanagement, dringende Anfragen und MI-Berichterstattung.
• Kunden täglich zu unterstützen.
• Kontaktaufnahme mit jeder Empfehlung innerhalb der vereinbarten SLAs.
• Beratung potenzieller Kunden unserer Farm und der verfügbaren vernetzten Produkte.
• Unterstützung der Manager der Betriebsentwicklung bei der Umsetzung unseres GWP-Plans.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Informationen zu wichtigen Berichtsbereichen auf dem neuesten Stand von Salesforce sind
• Reisen zu Veranstaltungen bei Bedarf

Menschen

• Arbeiten Sie proaktiv mit den Business Development Managern zusammen, um die Beziehungen von Zurich im Agrarsektor zu stärken.
• Unterstützen Sie Teamkollegen, um Gesamterfolg zu erzielen
• Tragen Sie zu einem effektiven Kommunikationsprozess bei.
• Fordern Sie Underwriter auf Risiko Appetit.
• Arbeiten funktionsübergreifend mit den persönlichen Linien Motor und Haushaltsteam in einem Angebot, um Gesamtkonten zu sichern.

Berichterstattung

• Regelmäßige und zeitnahe Management-Statistiken in Bezug auf Empfehlungen, Zitate, Fälle, GWP und Konversionsraten an unseren Key Account-Vertreter und das interne Management nach Bedarf.
• Überwachen Sie die Leistung des Erneuerungsbuchs, das möglicherweise funktionsübergreifend mit anderen Teams arbeitet
• Eskalation wichtiger Themen in Bezug auf Erneuerungen und wichtige Themen, proaktiv handeln, um die Auswirkungen auf das Geschäft zu minimieren

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen

• Mindestens 2 Auszeichnungen in höheren Fächern in der Abschlussbescheinigung (oder gleichwertig) oder Third Level Qualification
• CIP wünschenswert
• Sales Acquisition Fähigkeiten wünschenswert
• Ausgezeichneter Geschäftssinn in Versicherungs- und anderen Branchen zusammen mit einem professionellen Ansatz für Geschäftsbeziehungen
• · Ein funktionierendes Wissen und Verständnis aller Produktlinien.
· Starke Projektmanagementfähigkeiten

Zusätzliche Informationen

Der Hauptarbeitsort ist Wexford-basiert, aber gelegentliche Reisen können zu anderen Standorten in Zürich erforderlich sein.

Wenn Sie Wert auf ein spannendes und abwechslungsreiches Arbeitsumfeld legen und die oben genannten Anforderungen erfüllen, dann freut sich unser Recruiter auf Ihre Bewerbung per Klick auf den Button „Online bewerben.

Wer wir sind

Zürich ist eines der führenden Versicherungsunternehmen Irlands, das eine breite Palette von allgemeinen Versicherungs- und Lebensversicherungsprodukten und -dienstleistungen anbietet. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt über 1.000 Mitarbeiter an seinen Standorten in Dublin und Wexford.

Zürich ist eine starke Marke – mit unseren 53.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit bilden wir die Basis unseres Erfolgs und helfen unseren Kunden in 210 Ländern und Territorien, sich selbst zu verstehen und vor Risiken zu schützen. Um unsere Leistungen erbringen zu können, bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitern flexible Arbeitsmodelle und interessante Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Als Zürcher Mitarbeiter profitieren Sie von einer Vielzahl von Vorteilen sowie einer starken Kultur, die sich durch Akzeptanz, Vielfalt und Teamgeist auszeichnet.

Bei Zurich fördern wir eine Kultur der Vielfalt und Inklusion. Unsere Ziele und Werte sind darauf ausgerichtet, zu schützen, Vertrauen zu schaffen und unseren Mitarbeitern zu helfen, ihr volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Wir schätzen und verteidigen, was richtig ist und fördern Chancen für Gerechtigkeit unter unseren Fachleuten, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Behinderung, LGBTQ +, Rasse, Ethnie, Generationen, Überzeugung usw. Schließen Sie sich Zürich an und werden Sie Teil dieser Kultur. Gemeinsam sind wir entschlossen, unseren Zweck zu erfüllen - Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schaffen!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Résumé de l'emploi

Zurich Insurance Europe AG, Ireland Branch est à la recherche d'un responsable du développement des fermes pour rejoindre l'équipe sur un contrat à durée déterminée de 12 mois.

Le rôle principal de l'Exécutif de développement agricole est de soutenir nos neuf directeurs de développement d'entreprise et le responsable des ventes agricoles pour construire la part de Zurich dans le secteur agricole.

Ce rôle peut être disponible à temps partiel ou à temps plein. C'est parce que nous voulons les meilleures personnes pour nos rôles, et nous reconnaissons que parfois ces personnes ne sont pas disponibles à temps plein. Veuillez nous parler à l'entrevue de la flexibilité dont vous pourriez avoir besoin.

Votre rôle

En tant que dirigeant du développement des entreprises agricoles, vos principales responsabilités comprennent, mais pas nécessairement, les suivantes :

Client

• Élaborer et élaborer un plan d'affaires approprié avec les gestionnaires du développement des entreprises.
• Collaborer étroitement avec nos partenaires Dairygold, ICMSA & FDC, gestion des renvois, demandes urgentes et rapports d'IM.
• Soutien quotidien aux clients .
• Contacter chaque référence dans les SLA.
• Conseiller les clients potentiels de notre ferme et les produits connectés disponibles.
• Aider les gestionnaires du développement des entreprises agricoles à réaliser notre plan de PRG.
• Veiller à ce que toutes les informations sur les principaux domaines de déclaration soient tenues à jour sur Salesforce
• Voyages à des événements si nécessaire

Personnes

• Travailler de manière proactive avec les responsables du développement des entreprises pour aider à élargir les relations avec Zurich dans l'ensemble du secteur agricole.
• L'équipe de soutien collégiale pour atteindre le succès global
• Contribuer à un processus de communication efficace.
• Défier les souscripteurs sur l'appétit à risque.
• Travailler fonctionnellement avec l'équipe du moteur et du ménage pour obtenir des comptes globaux.

Rapports

• Fournir régulièrement et en temps opportun des statistiques de gestion concernant les renvois, les citations, les cas liés, le PRG et les taux de conversion à notre principal représentant de compte et la gestion interne au besoin.
• Surveiller la performance du carnet d'affaires de renouvellement qui peut impliquer de travailler en collaboration avec d'autres équipes
• Accélération des questions importantes concernant les renouvellements et les questions importantes, en agissant de manière proactive pour minimiser l'impact sur les entreprises

Vos compétences et votre expérience

• Minimum de 2 distinctions dans les matières de niveau supérieur du certificat de départ (ou équivalent) ou de la qualification de troisième niveau
• PIC souhaitable
• Capacités d'acquisition des ventes souhaitables
• Excellente concentration des entreprises dans les secteurs de l'assurance et d'autres secteurs ainsi qu'une approche professionnelle des relations d'affaires
• · Une connaissance et une compréhension pratiques de toutes les gammes de produits.
· Fortes compétences en gestion de projet

Renseignements supplémentaires

Le lieu de travail principal est Wexford-based, mais des voyages occasionnels peuvent être nécessaires à d'autres endroits de Zurich.

Si vous appréciez un environnement de travail passionnant et varié et répondez aux exigences ci-dessus, alors notre recruteur est impatient de recevoir votre candidature en cliquant sur le bouton « Appliquer en ligne ».

Qui nous sommes

Zurich est l'une des principales compagnies d'assurance irlandaises fournissant une large gamme de produits et services d'assurance générale et d'assurance-vie. L'entreprise emploie plus de 1 000 personnes sur ses sites de Dublin et Wexford.

Zurich est une marque forte – avec ses 53 000 employés dans le monde entier, elle constitue la base de notre succès, aidant nos clients dans 210 pays et territoires à se comprendre et à se protéger des risques. Afin de fournir nos services, nous offrons à nos employés des modèles de travail flexibles et des opportunités intéressantes pour la formation et le développement. En tant qu'employé de Zurich, vous bénéficiez d'une multitude d'avantages ainsi que d'une culture forte, caractérisée par l'acceptation, la diversité et l'esprit d'équipe.

À Zurich, nous favorisons une culture de la diversité et de l'inclusion. Notre but et nos valeurs sont conçus pour protéger, inspirer confiance et aider nos employés à réaliser leur plein potentiel. Nous apprécions et défendons ce qui est juste et promouvons les opportunités d'équité parmi nos professionnels, indépendamment du sexe, handicap, LGBTQ +, race, ethnie, générations, croyances, etc. Rejoignez Zurich et faites partie de cette culture. Ensemble, nous sommes déterminés à réaliser notre objectif - Laissez-nous créer un avenir plus brillant ensemble!

jobs.title: Training Admin Executive
jobs.description:
Training Management & Support Center – General Admin

The incumbent is responsible to manage all admin matters and ensure adherence to compliance for TMDC and responsible to update and organize all training related matters pertaining to Zurich Malaysia.

Job Description

• To coordinate all pre-training related matters i.e. training announcement, communicating & answering queries from sales team & agents, compiling registration nationwide, booking of training room in branches & hotel (if required), preparing attendance manually, preparing training material & courier to branch on-time
• Post training Administration i.e. follow-up on attendance listing, data entry on completion of training & updating CPD's accordingly
• Monitoring e-Learning, e-video completion & updating agents’ system accordingly for CPD (Life & Takaful),
• General admin matters: managing training stock, validating trainer's TARF & IT equipment handling, stationaries
• Liaise with 3rd party for outsourcing efforts i.e. printers, hotel, caterers.
• Liaise with internal and external customers i.e. departments in Zurich, LIAM, Aii, BNM, NAMLIFA, FPAM and MFPC.
• Ensure filing and documentation is up to date.
• Manages any ad-hoc and on-going projects in TMDC i.e. UAT Testing

Requirements:

• A bachelor’s degree from a recognized University specializing in Business Administration / Management, Insurance, Education & related disciplines
• Have at least 2 years of working experience in life insurance and/or retail financial services business in the areas of Training, Sales & Marketing
• Good command of spoken and written English & Bahasa Malaysia
• Enthusiastic, self-motivated and passionate
• Detail in work, has a sense of urgency & able to work independently

At Zurich we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity and Inclusion. We want you to bring your whole self to work we have a diverse mix of customers, and we want our employee base to reflect that.

With the above in mind, we accept applications from everyone regardless of your background, beliefs, or culture.

So, make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work for us.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei pronto a contare sul meglio?

A Zurigo, stiamo rivivendo l'assicurazione. Al fine di soddisfare i desideri dei nostri clienti ancora meglio, andiamo nuovi modi, pensare creativamente, lavorare agile. La nostra cultura aziendale vi dà maggiore flessibilità in ogni aspetto – e molta libertà di sviluppare in modo ottimale. Pensate grande – e anche a livello internazionale! Perché le tue possibilità di sviluppo non conoscono limiti con noi. Pronto a prendere il futuro in mano?

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

- Presso la sede di Colonia, si consiglia il business, analizzare i requisiti professionali e garantire l'implementazione IT ottimale tenendo conto dell'architettura di destinazione e degli stakeholder rilevanti nel processo end-to-end.

- Nel vostro ruolo, siete responsabili della creazione di progetti tecnici, nonché della preparazione, implementazione e documentazione delle specifiche e dei test di accettazione per i processi di business del motore

- Monitora la produzione delle applicazioni specialistiche e in caso di errori, la loro analisi e adattamento, compresa la gestione dei biglietti

- Con il tuo know-how, analizza e documenta l'applicazione per quanto riguarda il potenziale di ottimizzazione e implementa misure appropriate

- Insieme al proprietario del prodotto, si controlla il fornitore di sviluppo

- Il vostro compito comprende anche garantire la conformità (VAIT, DORA)

Lo porti con te.

- Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca e forte comunicazione e presentazione – anche in inglese solido

- Gestione sicura di strumenti di analisi e modellazione comuni come UML, DevOps, JIRA, Confluence, EPK ecc.

- Familiare con i processi di business, sviluppo software e produzione del nostro Motor-IT

- Paesaggio del sistema – soprattutto nel settore delle linee di distribuzione

- Conoscenza sana IT nello sviluppo e nel funzionamento, idealmente integrata da esperienza nel test

- Esperienza professionale approfondita come analista di business IT, in ingegneria dei requisiti o in una funzione paragonabile

- Studio completo di informatica aziendale, informatica o una qualificazione comparabile o esperienza professionale rilevante nell'ambiente IT

Questo corpo e' iDD-relevant. La direttiva sulla distribuzione delle assicurazioni (IDD) è una linea guida di distribuzione per tutte le persone coinvolte nella distribuzione dell'assicurazione. Quando assunto, abbiamo bisogno secondo § 48 VAG la vostra dichiarazione sulla vostra affidabilità e la vostra situazione finanziaria e la prova della vostra qualifica appropriata.

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

- Forme di lavoro flessibili per un equilibrio ottimale tra lavoro e casa

- Numerose opportunità di formazione e apprendimento per rimanere in forma per il lavoro quotidiano e consentire lo sviluppo individuale

- Supporto nella pianificazione della tua carriera - da un'analisi potenziale alla promozione individuale

- Un ambiente di lavoro moderno, aperto e trasparente che promuove la creatività e la collaborazione cross-team

- Che si tratti di fitness nel gruppo sul sito o di formazione di consapevolezza virtuale da casa: La nostra vasta gamma di servizi sanitari supporta un sano equilibrio tra lavoro e vita

- Leasing bici, biglietto Germania scontato, servizi di asset-generazione, un programma azionario dei dipendenti e altri grandi vantaggi

Ulteriori informazioni

A seconda dei requisiti di lavoro individuali e dell'idoneità personale, il gruppo di Zurigo Germania sostiene generalmente sia il lavoro flessibile che quello part-time. Se siete interessati a questo punto e la vostra situazione personale non corrisponde abbastanza all'importo specificato (completo e part-time), si prega di contattarci (katina.heeg@zurich.com) per discutere le possibilità potenziali.

- Luogo di lavoro: Colonia

- Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: a tempo pieno

Katina Heeg non vede l'ora che i tuoi documenti applicativi con le tue aspettative di stipendio e la data di inizio possibile tramite il portale di carriera (“Applica ora” pulsante). Purtroppo non possiamo considerare le applicazioni via e-mail.

Benvenuti nel vostro futuro

55.000 colleghi in 215 paesi e territori. Insieme sulla strada per ripensare l'assicurazione ogni giorno – e per modellare il futuro per tutti. Benvenuto in una comunità forte dove ti trasferisci dall'inizio. Insieme continuiamo a svilupparci!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you ready to count on the best?

At Zurich, we are re-living insurance. In order to fulfill the wishes of our customers even better, we go new ways, think creatively, work agile. Our corporate culture gives you more flexibility in every respect – and a lot of freedom to develop optimally. Think big – and also internationally! Because your development possibilities know no limits with us. Ready to take the future in hand?

This is what awaits you

- At the Cologne location, you will advise the business, analyze professional requirements and ensure optimal IT implementation taking into account the target architecture and relevant stakeholders in the end-to-end process.

- In your role, you are responsible for the creation of technical designs, as well as the preparation, implementation and documentation of specification and acceptance tests for the motor business processes

- You monitor the production of the specialist applications and in case of errors, their analysis and adaptation including ticket management

- With your know-how, you analyze and document the application with regard to the optimization potential and implement appropriate measures

- Together with the product owner, you control the development provider

- Your task also includes ensuring compliance (VAIT, DORA)

You bring that with you

- Very good knowledge of German as well as strong communication and presentation – also in solid English

- Secure handling of common analysis and modeling tools such as UML, DevOps, JIRA, Confluence, EPK etc.

- Familiar with the business, software development and production processes of our Motor-IT

- System landscape – especially in the area of distribution lines

- Sound IT knowledge in development and operation, ideally supplemented by experience in testing

- In-depth professional experience as an IT business analyst, in requirements engineering or in a comparable function

- Completed study of business informatics, computer science or a comparable qualification or relevant professional experience in the IT environment

This body is IDD-relevant. The Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD) is a distribution guideline for all persons involved in the distribution of insurance. When recruited, we require according to § 48 VAG your statement on your reliability and your financial situation as well as proof of your appropriate qualification.

This is what we offer you

- Flexible forms of work for an optimal balance between work at work and from home

- Numerous training and learning opportunities to stay fit for everyday work and enable individual development

- Support in your career planning - from potential analysis to individual promotion

- A modern, open and transparent work environment that promotes creativity and cross-team collaboration

- Whether fitness in the group on site or virtual mindfulness training from home: Our diverse range of health services supports a healthy work-life balance

- Bike leasing, discounted Germany ticket, asset-generating services, an employee share program and other great benefits

Additional information

Depending on the individual job requirements and personal suitability, the Zurich Group Germany generally supports both flexible and part-time work. If you are interested at this point and your personal situation does not quite match the specified amount (full and part-time), please contact us (katina.heeg@zurich.com ) to discuss the potential possibilities.

- Place of work: Cologne

- Part-time or full-time: full-time

Katina Heeg is looking forward to your application documents with your salary expectations and the possible start date via the career portal (“Apply now” button). Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications by e-mail.

Welcome to your future

55,000 colleagues in 215 countries and territories. Together on the way to rethink insurance every day – and to shape the future for everyone. Welcome to a strong community where you move from the beginning. Together we continue to develop!

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for Policy Servicing operational support, business process analysis and other responsibilities / duties periodically assigned by supervisor to meet operational and/or other requirements for Digital Servicing, Automation and System Enhancement initiatives/projects.

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

1.Participate in Digital Servicing, automation, system enhancement and process improvement projects. Role and Responsibilities including:

- Perform process review and opportunity identification.

- Liaise and coordinate with superior and IT or system support.

- Assist superior in participating project meeting.

- Assist superior in prepare system/business requirement and business process review.

- Prepare test script and perform User Acceptance Testing

- Prepare sign off document from stakeholder and implementation sign off document.

- Assist superior to monitor the result.

- Perform all activities achieved the reasonable quality, performance and within the agreed timeline given.

- Review and recommend measure to improve the existing process and system.

2. Prepare business case and presentation slides for related initiatives and projects.

3.Perform data analysis and presentation to support business decision.

4.Establish and update guidelines, working instructions and standard operating procedures.

5.Ensure that timeline and objectives as agreed with superior for any other assignments / projects that may be assigned are met or exceeded.

Job Qualifications

Required:

- Bachelor Degree in Business Administration or equivalent

Preferred:

- 5 years’ experience in Insurance Industry

jobs.description:
Job Summary

To drive growth and profitability in all assigned products through risk selection, pricing, negotiation, sales, retention, and quality service.

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

• Actively manage daily work processes of designated territory to achieve operational and strategic objectives.

• Analyze needs, develop and recommend alternatives for improvements to processes, customer service or products.

• Lead short term (3 to 9 months), defined scope projects.

• Develop and maintain profitable relationships with new and existing customers.

• Assist customers with loss prevention meetings, claims issues, and product training.

• Provide training to customer and Strategic Business Unit personnel on products and services.

• Provide technical advice that enables a customer to solve a problem or improve business.

• Develop and maintain positive customer relationships by meeting regularly with customers when no specific initiative is underway.

• Anticipate customer needs, monitor trends in order to recommend changes.

• Resolve technical issues within function or unit.

Business Accountabilities

• Carry out tasks, such as the preparation of customer and distributor reports, to support the implementation of projects to time and quality standards.
• Assess and evaluate business processes in order to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Investigate and drive research/analysis around potential business development opportunities.
• Review assigned customer cases, prioritize case load and interpret established policies, applying discretion within authority limits in order to resolve customer issues.

Job Qualifications

Required:

• High School Diploma or Equivalent and 1 or more years of experience in the Sales area

OR

• Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and No prior experience required in the Sales area

AND

• Knowledge of principles of sales, sales techniques, and sales terminology

• Knowledge of requirements within insurance industry regulatory environment

• Knowledge of Microsoft Office

• The ability to be licensed to sell insurance in the states where required

Preferred:

• 2 or more years of sales experience

• Licensed to sell insurance in the states where required

• Experience analyzing financial statements

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives.

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

- Location(s): MY - Kuala Lumpur

- Remote working:

- Schedule: Full Time

- Recruiter name: Taren Kaur

- Closing date:

descriptionByLocale.it:
Riepilogo lavoro

Guidare la crescita e la redditività in tutti i prodotti assegnati attraverso la selezione del rischio, i prezzi, la negoziazione, le vendite, la conservazione e il servizio di qualità.

Responsabilità del lavoro - Responsabilità chiave

• Gestire attivamente i processi di lavoro quotidiani del territorio designato per raggiungere obiettivi operativi e strategici.

• Analizzare le esigenze, sviluppare e consigliare alternative per migliorare i processi, il servizio clienti o i prodotti.

• Guidare progetti a breve termine (da 3 a 9 mesi) e con ambito definito.

• Sviluppare e mantenere relazioni proficue con clienti nuovi ed esistenti.

• Assistere i clienti con riunioni di prevenzione delle perdite, problemi di reclami e formazione sui prodotti.

• Fornire formazione al personale del cliente e della Business Unit Strategica su prodotti e servizi.

• Fornire consulenza tecnica che consenta a un cliente di risolvere un problema o migliorare il business.

• Sviluppare e mantenere relazioni positive con i clienti incontrandoli regolarmente quando non è in corso alcuna iniziativa specifica.

• Anticipa le esigenze dei clienti, monitora le tendenze per suggerire i cambiamenti.

• Risolvere i problemi tecnici all'interno della funzione o dell'unità.

Responsabilità aziendale

• Svolgere compiti, come la preparazione di report di clienti e distributori, per supportare l'implementazione dei progetti secondo gli standard di tempo e qualità.
• Valutare e valutare i processi aziendali al fine di identificare opportunità di miglioramento.
• Indagare e guidare la ricerca/analisi sul potenziale sviluppo del business
descriptionByLocale.de:
Zusammenfassung der Aufgaben

Wachstum und Rentabilität aller zugeordneten Produkte durch Risikoauswahl, Preisgestaltung, Verhandlung, Vertrieb, Retention und Qualitätsservice zu fördern.

Job-Verbindlichkeiten - Schlüsselkonten

• Die täglichen Arbeitsprozesse des ausgewiesenen Territoriums aktiv zu verwalten, um operative und strategische Ziele zu erreichen.

• Analysieren Sie Bedürfnisse, entwickeln und empfehlen Sie Alternativen für Verbesserungen an Prozessen, Kundendienst oder Produkten.

• Kurzfristige Leitlaufzeiten (3 bis 9 Monate), definierte Ziel bereiche.

• Entwicklung und Pflege profitabler Beziehungen zu neuen und bestehenden Kunden.

• Kunden bei Verlustpräventionssitzungen, Schadenbehebungen und Produktschulungen unterstützen.

• Schulung des Personals der Kunden- und strategischen Business Unit in Produkten und Dienstleistungen.

• technische Beratung, die es einem Kunden ermöglicht, ein Problem zu lösen oder das Geschäft zu verbessern.

• Entwicklung und Pflege positiver Kundenbeziehungen durch regelmäßige Treffen mit Kunden, wenn keine spezifische Initiative im Gange ist.

• Kundenbedürfnisse antizipieren, Trends überwachen, um Änderungen zu empfehlen.

• Technische Probleme innerhalb der Funktion oder Einheit lösen.

Geschäftsbuchhaltung

• Durchführung von Aufgaben, wie die Erstellung von Kunden- und Händlerberichten, um die Umsetzung von Projekten nach Zeit- und Qualitätsstandards zu unterstützen.
• Assess und Evaluierung von Geschäftsprozessen, um Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu ermitteln.
• Untersuchung und Förderung der Forschung/Analyse von potenziellen Geschäftsentwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
• Überprüfung zugewiesener Kundenfälle, Priorisierung der Falllast und Interpretation etablierter Richtlinien, Anwendung von Ermessen innerhalb von Kompetenzgrenzen, um Kundenprobleme zu lösen.

Qualifikation der Arbeitsplätze

Erforderlich:

• High School Diplom oder Äquivalent und 1 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Vertrieb

ODER

• Zürcher zertifizierter Versicherungs-Lehrer mit Associate Degree und keine Vorkenntnisse im Vertrieb erforderlich

UND

• Kenntnisse der Grundsätze des Verkaufs, der Verkaufstechniken und der Verkaufsterminologie

• Kenntnisse über Anforderungen im regulatorischen Umfeld der Versicherungsbranche

• Kenntnisse von Microsoft Office

• die Möglichkeit, in den Staaten, wo erforderlich, eine Lizenz zum Verkauf von Versicherungen zu erhalten

Bevorzugt:

• 2 oder mehr Jahre Vertriebserfahrung

• Lizenziert, um Versicherung in den Staaten zu verkaufen, wenn erforderlich

• Erfahrung mit der Analyse von Abschlüssen

Du bist das Herz & die Seele von Zürich!

In Zürich denken wir gerne über die Grenzen hinaus und fordern den Status quo heraus. Wir gehen optimistisch auf die positiven Aspekte ein.

Wir schätzen die Erfahrung und das Know-how unserer Mitarbeiter sehr und bieten Ihnen vielfältige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, um Sie zu ermutigen, sich innerhalb von Zürich für neue Chancen zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit sind für Ihren nächsten Karriereschritt.

Lasst uns zusammen wachsen!

• Développer et maintenir des relations rentables avec les clients nouveaux et existants.

• Offrir une formation aux clients et au personnel du Groupe stratégique des affaires sur les produits et les services.

• Fournir des conseils techniques qui permettent à un client de résoudre un problème ou d'améliorer son entreprise.

• Développer et maintenir des relations positives avec les clients en rencontrant régulièrement les clients lorsqu'aucune initiative spécifique n'est en cours.

• Anticiper les besoins des clients, suivre les tendances afin de recommander des changements.

• Résoudre les problèmes techniques au sein de la fonction ou de l'unité.

Responsabilités des entreprises

• Mener des tâches, telles que la préparation de rapports clients et distributeurs, pour soutenir la mise en œuvre de projets selon les normes de temps et de qualité.
• Évaluer et évaluer les processus d'affaires afin de déterminer les possibilités d'amélioration.
• Étudier et orienter la recherche/analyse autour des possibilités de développement commercial.
• Examiner les cas clients assignés, classer par ordre de priorité les cas et interpréter les politiques établies, en appliquant des pouvoirs discrétionnaires dans les limites des pouvoirs afin de résoudre les problèmes des clients.

Qualifications d'emploi

Requis :

• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 1 ou plusieurs années d'expérience dans le domaine des ventes

OU

• Zurich Apprenti certifié en assurance comprenant un diplôme associé et aucune expérience préalable requise dans le domaine des ventes

PAYS

• Connaissance des principes de vente, des techniques de vente et de la terminologie des ventes

• Connaissance des exigences dans le cadre réglementaire de l'industrie de l'assurance

• Connaissance de Microsoft Office

• La possibilité d'être agréé pour vendre une assurance dans les États où elle est nécessaire

Préféré:

• 2 ans ou plus d'expérience en vente

• Concédant pour vendre une assurance dans les États où elle est nécessaire

• Expérience de l'analyse des états financiers

jobs.description:
Du stellst gern Schadenfälle auf den Prüfstand und suchst nach intelligenten Wegen, Regresspotenziale konsequent und fair zu nutzen? In dieser Rolle fokussierst du dich auf die gezielte Durchsetzung von Regressen in der Sach- und Haftpflichtversicherung und trägst damit wesentlich zur Ergebnisqualität und Professionalität unseres Schadenbereichs bei. Du kombinierst juristisches und versicherungstechnisches Know-how und setzt deine Verhandlungskompetenz ein, um tragfähige Lösungen mit unterschiedlichsten Anspruchsgruppen zu erzielen.

Als Regressspezialist beurteilst Du Regresspotenziale, führst Aktivregresse nach Rechtslage eigenständig durch und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Fachspezialisten unsere systematische Regesserkennung weiter. Gleichzeitig sorgst du mit Partnerfirmen für eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Regressen im Ausland und stellst das Inkasso sicher. Du gibst dein Wissen in Schulungen und Coachings an Kolleginnen und Kollegen weiter und trägst so dazu bei, Regressprozesse zu professionalisieren und für Zurich wie auch für unsere Kundschaft einen nachhaltigen Mehrwert zu schaffen.

Du hast Freude an analytischer Arbeit, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und möchtest die Schadenwelt mit modernen Methoden und datenbasiertem Arbeiten voranbringen? Dann erwartet dich bei uns eine abwechslungsreiche Aufgabe, in der du deine Fachkompetenz, deine Verhandlungssicherheit und deinen Teamgeist voll einbringen kannst.

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als Regressspezialist Sach- und Haft.

Was du tust

- Du prüfst und tätigst Aktivregresse nach Rechtslage– mit Fokus auf Sach- und technische Versicherungen.

- Du verhandelst zielorientiert mit anderen Versicherungsgesellschaften sowie Regressschuldnern aus dem Privat- und Unternehmensbereich.

- Du arbeitest eng mit internen Partnern und externen Partnerfirmen zusammen, insbesondere bei Auslandregressen, und stellst das Inkasso von Forderungen sicher.

- Du erarbeitest die Grundlagen für Rechtsöffnungsklagen und unterstützt damit eine effiziente rechtliche Durchsetzung.

- Du trägst zur Weiterentwicklung einer modernen,System-gestützten Regresserkennung bei und bringst dein Know-how in Projekte und Arbeitsgruppen ein.

Was du mitbringst

- Ein schweizerisches Rechtsstudium oder eine Versicherungslaufbahn mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung im Komplexschaden

- Fundierte Kenntnisse im Haftpflicht- und Regressrecht im Sachschadenbereich.

- Freude am Verhandeln mit Versicherern und weiteren Parteien sowie ausgeprägtes Durchsetzungsvermögen.

- Deutsch als Muttersprache und gute Französischkenntnisse; Englisch und Italienisch sind von Vorteil.

- Hohe Sozialkompetenz, Teamfähigkeit sowie Bereitschaft, Wissen zu teilen – z.B. durch Schulungen und fachlichen Support zu Regressthemen.

Dein Kontakt

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Bernd Makasy (044 628 42 14)

Zusätzliche Informationen

Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 80 - 100%

Arbeitsort: Zürich, Oerlikon

Hybrides Arbeiten: bis zu 40%

#LI-Hybrid

Wir freuen uns auf deine Onlinebewerbung – auch ohne Bewerbungsschreiben.
Gerne kannst du uns bei einem persönlichen Kennenlernen von deiner Motivation überzeugen.

Wer wir sind

Zurich ist eine starke Marke – mehr als 1,4 Millionen Schweizer Kundinnen und Kunden vertrauen auf unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen. Die Basis unseres Erfolgs bilden unsere 53‘000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit, die unseren Kunden in 210 Ländern und Gebieten helfen, ihre Risiken besser zu verstehen und sich gegen diese zu schützen. Um die tägliche Leistung zu erbringen, bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden flexible Arbeitsmodelle und interessante Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Als Zurich-Mitarbeitender profitierst du von einer Vielzahl an Vorteilen und einer starken Kultur, geprägt von Akzeptanz, Vielfältigkeit und Teamorientierung.

Bei Zurich pflegen wir eine Kultur der Vielfalt und Inklusion. Unsere Ziele und Werte sind geschaffen, um unsere Mitarbeitenden zu schützen, Vertrauen zu fördern und zu helfen, ihr volles Potential auszuschöpfen. Wir stehen ein für Gerechtigkeit und Gleichheit unter unseren Angestellten, unabhängig vom Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Religion, etc. Die Gewinnung unserer Talente sowie die Rekrutierungsprozesse spiegeln dieses Bekenntnis im Alltag. Steige bei uns ein und werde Teil dieser Kultur.

Weshalb ist Zurich seit über 150 Jahren erfolgreich? Siehe hier selbst und werde Teil davon .

Information für Personalvermittler

Zurich nimmt für diese Position keine unaufgeforderten Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlern entgegen. Personalvermittler reichen daher bitte keine Bewerberunterlagen an unsere Mitarbeitenden oder über unser Online-Karriere-Portal ein. Wir lehnen jegliche Verantwortung für unaufgefordert eingereichte Bewerbungen sowie etwaige Gebühren ab und danken für das Verständnis.

Ti piace mettere casi di danno alla prova e cercare modi intelligenti per utilizzare il potenziale di regressione in modo coerente e corretto? In questo ruolo, si concentra sull'applicazione mirata dei ricorsi nell'assicurazione di proprietà e responsabilità e quindi contribuire in modo significativo alla qualità dei risultati e la professionalità del nostro settore crediti. Unisci il know-how legale e assicurativo e utilizzi le tue capacità di negoziazione per raggiungere soluzioni valide con una vasta gamma di stakeholder.

In qualità di specialista del ricorso, si valutano i potenziali ricorsi, indipendentemente effettuare i ricorsi attivi secondo la situazione legale e sviluppare il nostro sistematico riconoscimento di ricorso insieme a specialisti. Allo stesso tempo, si lavora con le aziende partner per garantire una riuscita implementazione del ricorso all'estero e garantire la raccolta del debito. Trasferisci la tua conoscenza ai colleghi nelle sessioni di formazione e nelle sessioni di coaching e contribuisci così alla professionalizzazione dei processi di regressione e alla creazione di valore aggiunto sostenibile per Zurigo e i nostri clienti.

Ti piace il lavoro analitico, come assumerti la responsabilità e vuoi far avanzare il mondo dei danni con metodi moderni e lavoro basato sui dati? Poi un variegato compito vi aspetta con noi, in cui potete contribuire pienamente alla vostra esperienza, alla vostra fiducia di negoziazione e al vostro spirito di squadra.

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro "Top 3" in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e applica come specialista di ricorso per proprietà e detenzione.

Cosa fai

- Controllare e attivare i ricorsi attivi secondo la situazione legale – con un focus sull'assicurazione materiale e tecnica.

- Si negoziano obiettivi orientati con altre compagnie di assicurazione e debitori di ricorso dai settori privato e societario.

- Si lavora a stretto contatto con partner interni e società partner esterne, soprattutto nei rapporti esteri, e garantire la raccolta del debito.

- Si svilupperà la base per i procedimenti legali e quindi sostenere l'applicazione legale efficiente.

- Contribuisci all'ulteriore sviluppo di un moderno riconoscimento di un ricorso basato sul sistema e porta il tuo know-how a progetti e gruppi di lavoro.

- Conoscenza approfondita della responsabilità e del diritto di ricorso nel campo dei danni di proprietà.

- Goditi di negoziare con gli assicuratori e altre parti, così come forte assertività.

- Tedesco come lingua madre e buona conoscenza del francese; inglese e italiano sono benefiche.

Do you like to put damage cases to the test and look for intelligent ways to use regression potential consistently and fairly? In this role, you focus on the targeted enforcement of recourses in property and liability insurance and thus contribute significantly to the quality of results and professionalism of our claims area. You combine legal and insurance know-how and use your negotiating skills to achieve viable solutions with a wide range of stakeholders.

As a recourse specialist, you assess potential recourses, independently carry out active recourses according to the legal situation and develop our systematic recourse recognition together with specialists. At the same time, you work with partner companies to ensure a successful implementation of recourse abroad and ensure debt collection. You pass on your knowledge to colleagues in training sessions and coaching sessions and thus contribute to professionalizing processes of regression and creating sustainable added value for Zurich and our customers.

You enjoy analytical work, like to take on responsibility and want to advance the damage world with modern methods and data-based work? Then a varied task awaits you with us, in which you can fully contribute your expertise, your negotiating confidence and your team spirit.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become a part of it and apply as a recourse specialist for property and detention.

What you do

- You check and activate active recourses according to the legal situation – with a focus on material and technical insurance.

- You negotiate goal-oriented with other insurance companies and recourse debtors from the private and corporate sectors.

- You work closely with internal partners and external partner companies, especially in foreign recourses, and ensure debt collection.

- You will develop the basis for legal proceedings and thus support efficient legal enforcement.

- You contribute to the further development of a modern, system-based recourse recognition and bring your know-how to projects and working groups.

What you bring

- A Swiss law degree or an insurance career with several years of experience in complex damage

- In-depth knowledge of liability and recourse law in the field of property damage.

- Enjoy negotiating with insurers and other parties as well as strong assertiveness.

- German as a mother tongue and good knowledge of French; English and Italian are beneficial.

- High level of social competence, teamwork and willingness to share knowledge – e.g. through training and professional support on regress topics.

Your contact

Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant: Bernd Makasy (044 628 42 14)

Additional information

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Zurich, Oerlikon

Hybrid work: up to 40%

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. - Connaissance approfondie du droit de la responsabilité et des recours dans le domaine des dommages matériels.

- Profitez des négociations avec les assureurs et d'autres parties ainsi que d'une solide assurance.

- L'allemand comme langue maternelle et la bonne connaissance du français; l'anglais et l'italien sont bénéfiques.

- Un niveau élevé de compétence sociale, de travail d'équipe et de volonté de partager des connaissances – par exemple par la formation et le soutien professionnel sur des sujets de régression.

Zurich North America is currently hiring a Underwriting Analyst - E&S Financial Lines in our Scottsdale, AZ; Chicago, IL; and Atlanta, GA office! While this role is based out of our Scottsdale, AZ office, the position will provide you the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis, requiring to be in office 3 days a week. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you and our E&S Financial Lines team members.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Reviews, evaluates and analyzes risk exposures, controls, loss history, financial condition and recommends or executes, underwriting decisions around submission acceptance or declination within established risk appetite.

- Anticipates underwriting exposure information needs, and proactively seeks out alternative, relevant data sources using underwriting tools to improve understanding of risks.

- Analyze and recommends input in areas of policy rating, subjective pricing, policy construction, coverages and exclusions, mandatory forms, etc. that are needed to accurately quote and/or renew policies (bonds).

- Develops and executes account servicing solutions independently and in collaboration with Underwriter, with responsibility for end-to-end servicing processes for new business, renewals, and endorsements for more complex business accounts.

- Drives broker/agent/distributor/customer interactions and on-site calls related to account servicing matters with a planned and well-prepared purpose. Builds strong working relationships outside the team and with broker counterparts.

- Develops new team members and provides support and coaching to peers, based on quality results. Provides coaching and problem solving for complex transactions / issues while educating peers on the context behind the solution.

- Supports special projects as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree and 2 or more years of experience in the Insurance, Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including Associate Degree and 2 or more years of experience in the Insurance, Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 4 or more years of experience in the Insurance, Underwriting or Market Facing area.
AND

- Knowledge of the insurance industry and the legal and regulatory environment.

- Experience with data collection and analysis

- Experience with processing, rating and policy management systems used in the insurance industry.

- Customer service experience

- Problem solving experience

- Experience servicing product portfolios for multiple lines of business for insurance.

- Microsoft Office experience

Preferred Qualifications:

- Knowledge of underwriting philosophy and techniques

- Knowledge of national and local insurance filing regulations and guidelines

- Knowledge of international insurance programs

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $54,500.00 - $89,200.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Analyst
jobs.description:
Zurich Group and Cover-More Group have agreed to acquire AIG’s global personal travel insurance and assistance business (AIG Travel). This acquisition strengthens Cover-More Group’s global footprint and positions us as a leading travel insurer in both the U.S. and globally. By expanding our global travel business platform, we will significantly grow our customer base.

Zurich North America currently is seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Tax Analyst to join our Finance team in Schaumburg, IL.

As a Senior Tax Analyst, you would, under guidance, lead or perform complex tax transactional tasks and resolve a range of problems in tax accounting, reporting, planning, audits, research and/or compliance to ensure actions are completed to appropriate service levels or defined procedures.

The responsibilities for the role are as follows:

- Prepares or reviews complex tax returns and supporting workpapers, estimated tax payments and various other tax compliance.

- Prepares or reviews quarterly tax provisions, including reports to management and the external auditor, account reconciliations, tax basis balance sheet support, and execution of internal controls.

- Supports company tax audits, responses to tax notices, and timely resolution of other tax controversy matters.

- Performs technical research to address complex tax issues, including planning opportunities.

- Provides other tax support, which may include analyses of pending legislation, preparation of required transfer pricing documentation and reporting, and implementation of legislative changes.

- Analyzes processes and recommends improvements in the immediate area of responsibility.

- Monitors legislative and organization developments related to the selected functions.

- May manage or supervise selected functions, including planning, implementation, scheduling, and timely completion.

- Analyze processes and recommend improvements in the immediate area of responsibility.

- Participate in local projects or initiatives, evaluates potential impact on local reporting units, performs local implementation of changes.

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelors Degree 4 or more years of experience in the Corporate Tax area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Corporate Tax area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Caproate Tax area
AND

- Experience in income tax

- Statutory accounting knowledge

Preferred Qualifications:

- Insurance industry experience

- CPA

- Strong prioritization skills and organization skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The proposed Salary range for this position is $65,900.00 - $107,900.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Il Gruppo di Zurigo e il Gruppo Cover-More hanno accettato di acquisire il business globale dell’assicurazione e dell’assistenza personale di AIG (AIG Travel). Questa acquisizione rafforza l’impronta globale di Cover-More Group e ci pone come leader insurrezione di viaggio negli Stati Uniti e a livello globale. Espandendo la nostra piattaforma di business di viaggio globale, cresceremo in modo significativo la nostra base clienti.

Zurigo Nord America attualmente sta cercando un analista fiscale senior dinamico ed esperto per aderire al nostro team di finanza a Schaumburg, IL.

In qualità di analista fiscale senior, sotto la guida, condurre o eseguire complesse operazioni fiscali e risolvere una serie di problemi nella contabilità fiscale, reporting, pianificazione, audit, ricerca e/o conformità per garantire che le azioni siano completate a livelli di servizio appropriati o procedure definite.

Le responsabilità del ruolo sono le seguenti:

- Prepara o recensioni complesse dichiarazioni fiscali e di supporto documenti di lavoro, i pagamenti fiscali stimati e varie altre norme fiscali.

- Prepara o valuta le disposizioni fiscali trimestrali, comprese le relazioni alla gestione e all'auditor esterno, le conciliazioni dei conti, il sostegno del bilancio delle basi fiscali e l'esecuzione dei controlli interni.

- Supporta i controlli fiscali delle società, le risposte alle comunicazioni fiscali e la risoluzione tempestiva di altre controversie fiscali.

- Esegui la ricerca tecnica per affrontare questioni fiscali complesse, comprese le opportunità di pianificazione.

- Fornisce un altro supporto fiscale, che può includere analisi della legislazione in sospeso, preparazione della documentazione dei prezzi di trasferimento richiesto e la relazione, e l'attuazione delle modifiche legislative.

- Analizza i processi e raccomanda miglioramenti nell'area di responsabilità immediata.

- Monitora gli sviluppi legislativi e organizzativi relativi alle funzioni selezionate.

- Può gestire o supervisionare le funzioni selezionate, compresa la pianificazione, l'implementazione, la pianificazione e il completamento tempestivo.

- Analizzare i processi e consigliare miglioramenti nell'area di responsabilità immediata.

- Partecipare a progetti o iniziative locali, valuta il potenziale impatto sulle unità di reporting locali, esegue l'implementazione locale dei cambiamenti.

Qualificazioni richieste:

- Laurea 4 o più anni di esperienza nell'area fiscale aziendale
O

- Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente e 6 o più anni di esperienza nell'area fiscale aziendale
O

- Apprendistato di assicurazione certificato di Zurigo, tra cui un diploma associato e 4 o più anni di esperienza nell'area Tasse di Caproate
E

- Esperienza nell'imposta sul reddito

- Conoscenza contabile legale

Preferiti:

- Esperienza del settore assicurativo

- CPA

- Forti competenze di priorità e capacità organizzative

La tua paga a Zurigo si basa sul tuo ruolo, posizione, competenze e esperienza. Seguiamo le leggi locali per garantire una giusta compensazione. Si può anche essere idonei per bonus e aumenti di merito. Se le vostre aspettative sono al di sopra della gamma elencata, vi incoraggiamo ancora ad applicare – il vostro background unico conta per noi. La gamma Salary proposta per questa posizione è $65,900.00 - $107,900.00, con l'ammissibilità bonus di incentivazione a breve termine impostata al 10%.

Offriamo vantaggi competitivi e completi per i dipendenti e le loro famiglie. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Perché Zurigo?

A Zurigo, apprezziamo le tue idee e le tue esperienze. Offriamo crescita, inclusione e un ambiente di supporto, in modo da poter contribuire a plasmare il futuro dell'assicurazione. Zurigo Nord America è leader nella gestione dei rischi, con oltre 150 anni di esperienza e copertura in 25 settori, tra cui il 90% della Fortune 500®.

Unisciti a noi per un futuro più luminoso, per te e per i nostri clienti.

Zurigo è conforme al codice 18 degli Stati Uniti § 1033.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Zurich Group und die Cover-More Group haben vereinbart, das globale Personal Travel Insurance and Assistance-Geschäft von AIG zu übernehmen. Diese Akquisition stärkt die globale Präsenz der Cover-More Group und positioniert uns als führenden Reiseversicherer sowohl in den USA als auch weltweit. Durch den Ausbau unserer globalen Reise-Business-Plattform werden wir unseren Kundenstamm deutlich ausbauen.

Zurich North America sucht derzeit einen dynamischen und erfahrenen Senior Tax Analysten, der sich unserem Finanzteam in Schaumburg, IL, anschließt.

Als Senior Tax Analyst würden Sie unter Anleitung komplexe steuerliche Transaktionsaufgaben leiten oder durchführen und eine Reihe von Problemen in der Steuerbuchhaltung, Berichterstattung, Planung, Audits, Forschung und / oder Compliance lösen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Maßnahmen auf angemessenen Service-Levels oder definierten Verfahren durchgeführt werden.

Die Verantwortlichkeiten für die Rolle sind wie folgt:

- Bereitet oder überprüft komplexe Steuererklärungen und unterstützende Arbeitspapiere, geschätzte Steuerzahlungen und verschiedene andere Steuerkonformitäten.

- Erstellt oder überprüft vierteljährliche Steuervorschriften, einschließlich Berichte an das Management und den externen Rechnungsprüfer, Kontoabgleiche, steuerliche Bilanzunterstützung und Durchführung interner Kontrollen.

- Unterstützt Unternehmenssteuerprüfungen, Antworten auf Steuerbescheide und rechtzeitige Lösung anderer Steuerstreitigkeiten.

- Führt technische Forschung durch, um komplexe Steuerfragen, einschließlich Planungsmöglichkeiten, anzugehen.

- Bietet andere steuerliche Unterstützung, die Analysen der anhängigen Gesetzgebung, die Vorbereitung der erforderlichen Verrechnungspreisdokumentation und -berichterstattung sowie die Umsetzung von Gesetzesänderungen umfassen kann.

- Analysiert Prozesse und empfiehlt Verbesserungen im unmittelbaren Verantwortungsbereich.

- Überwacht die legislativen und organisatorischen Entwicklungen im Zusammenhang mit den ausgewählten Funktionen.

- Kann ausgewählte Funktionen verwalten oder überwachen, einschließlich Planung, Implementierung, Terminplanung und rechtzeitiger Fertigstellung.

- Analysieren Sie Prozesse und empfehlen Sie Verbesserungen im unmittelbaren Verantwortungsbereich.

- Beteiligen Sie sich an lokalen Projekten oder Initiativen, bewertet mögliche Auswirkungen auf lokale Berichtseinheiten und führt lokale Änderungen durch.

Benötigte Qualifikationen:

- Bachelorstudium 4 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Körperschaftsteuer
ODER

- High School Diplom oder Äquivalent und 6 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Körperschaftsteuerbereich
ODER

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, einschließlich eines Associate Degree und 4 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Caproate Tax Bereich
UND

- Erfahrung in der Einkommensteuer

- Gesetzliche Rechnungslegungskenntnisse

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

- Erfahrung in der Versicherungsbranche

- CPA

- Starke Priorisierungskompetenzen und Organisationsfähigkeiten

Ihre Bezahlung in Zürich basiert auf Ihrer Rolle, Ihrem Standort, Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung. Wir befolgen lokale Gesetze, um eine faire Entschädigung zu gewährleisten. Möglicherweise haben sie auch anspruch auf boni und leistungssteigerungen. Wenn Ihre Erwartungen über dem aufgeführten Bereich liegen, empfehlen wir Ihnen dennoch, sich zu bewerben - Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund ist für uns wichtig. Die vorgeschlagene Gehaltsspanne für diese Position beträgt 65.900.00 $ - 107.900.00 $, wobei die kurzfristige Anreizbonusberechtigung auf 10% festgelegt ist.

Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Bezahlung und umfassende Leistungen für Mitarbeiter und ihre Familien. [Erfahren Sie hier mehr über Total Rewards.]

Warum Zürich?

Bei Zurich schätzen wir Ihre Ideen und Erfahrungen. Wir bieten Wachstum, Inklusion und ein unterstützendes Umfeld - damit Sie die Zukunft der Versicherung mitgestalten können. Zurich North America ist ein führendes Unternehmen im Risikomanagement mit über 150 Jahren Erfahrung und Abdeckung in über 25 Branchen, darunter 90 % der Fortune 500®.

Begleiten Sie uns für eine bessere Zukunft – für Sie und unsere Kunden.

Zürich in Nordamerika diskriminiert nicht aufgrund von Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Religion, nationaler Herkunft, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsausdruck, Geschlechtsidentität, genetischer Information, Alter, Behinderung, geschütztem Veteranenstatus, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung, Schwangerschaft oder anderen durch geltendes Recht geschützten Merkmalen. Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber Behinderung / Vets.

Zürich erfüllt 18 US-Code § 1033.

Le groupe Zurich et le groupe Cover-More ont accepté d'acquérir l'assurance voyage et l'assistance personnelles AIG (AIG Travel). Cette acquisition renforce l'empreinte mondiale de Cover-Plus Group et nous positionne comme un assureur de voyage leader aux États-Unis et dans le monde. En élargissant notre plate-forme mondiale d'affaires de voyage, nous augmenterons considérablement notre clientèle.

Zurich L'Amérique du Nord cherche actuellement un analyste fiscal senior dynamique et expérimenté pour rejoindre notre équipe Finance à Schaumburg, IL.

En tant qu'analyste principal de l'impôt, vous dirigeriez ou exécuteriez des tâches transactionnelles fiscales complexes et régleriez toute une gamme de problèmes liés à la comptabilité fiscale, à la déclaration, à la planification, aux vérifications, à la recherche et/ou à la conformité afin de s'assurer que les mesures sont prises à des niveaux de service appropriés ou à des procédures définies.

Les responsabilités pour ce rôle sont les suivantes :

- Préparer ou examiner des déclarations de revenus complexes et des documents de travail à l'appui, des paiements fiscaux estimatifs et diverses autres conditions fiscales.

- Préparer ou examiner les dispositions fiscales trimestrielles, y compris les rapports à la direction et à l'auditeur externe, les rapprochements de comptes, l'appui au bilan de la base fiscale et l'exécution des contrôles internes.

- Appuyer les vérifications fiscales des sociétés, les réponses aux avis d'imposition et le règlement en temps opportun d'autres questions de controverse fiscale.

- Effectuer des recherches techniques sur des questions fiscales complexes, y compris des possibilités de planification.

- Fournit un autre soutien fiscal, qui peut comprendre des analyses de la législation en suspens, la préparation des documents et des rapports sur les prix de transfert requis et la mise en oeuvre des modifications législatives.

- Analyser les processus et recommander des améliorations dans le domaine de responsabilité immédiat.

- Surveille les développements législatifs et organisationnels liés aux fonctions choisies.

- Peut gérer ou superviser certaines fonctions, y compris la planification, la mise en oeuvre, le calendrier et l'achèvement en temps opportun.

- Participer à des projets ou à des initiatives locaux, évaluer l'impact potentiel sur les unités hiérarchiques locales, effectuer la mise en œuvre locale des changements.

Qualifications requises :

- Baccalauréat 4 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de l'impôt sur les sociétés
OU

- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de l'impôt sur les sociétés
OU

- Zurich Apprenti certifié en assurance, y compris un diplôme associé et 4 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la taxe Caproate
PAYS

- Expérience en matière d'impôt sur le revenu

- Connaissances en comptabilité légale

Qualifications préférées :

- Expérience du secteur de l'assurance

- CPA

- Compétences élevées en matière de hiérarchisation et d'organisation

Votre salaire à Zurich est basé sur votre rôle, votre emplacement, vos compétences et votre expérience. Nous suivons les lois locales pour garantir une juste indemnisation. Vous pouvez également être admissible à des primes et des augmentations de mérite. Si vos attentes sont supérieures à la fourchette indiquée, nous vous encourageons toujours à présenter votre candidature, ce qui compte pour nous. L'échelle salariale proposée pour ce poste est de 65 900,00 $ - 107 900,00 $, et la prime incitative à court terme est fixée à 10 %.

Nous offrons une rémunération concurrentielle et des avantages complets aux employés et à leur famille. [En savoir plus sur Total Rewards ici .]

Pourquoi Zurich ?

À Zurich, nous apprécions vos idées et votre expérience. Nous offrons la croissance, l'inclusion et un environnement favorable, afin que vous puissiez aider à façonner l'avenir de l'assurance. Zurich L'Amérique du Nord est un chef de file en gestion des risques, avec plus de 150 ans d'expertise et de couverture dans plus de 25 industries, dont 90% du Fortune 500®.

Rejoignez-nous pour un avenir meilleur, pour vous et nos clients.

En Amérique du Nord, Zurich ne fait pas de discrimination fondée sur la race, l'ethnicité, la couleur, la religion, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'expression sexuelle, l'identité de genre, l'information génétique, l'âge, le handicap, le statut de vétéran protégé, l'état matrimonial, l'orientation sexuelle, la grossesse ou d'autres caractéristiques protégées par la loi applicable. Égalité des chances Invalidité/veuves de l'employeur.

Zurich est conforme au code américain 18 § 1033.

Veuillez noter que Zurich n'accepte pas les CV non sollicités des agences. Les fournisseurs préférés devraient utiliser notre portail de recrutement.

jobs.description:
AI Change & Adoption Lead

Place of work: Cracow

Job Purpose:

As an AI Change & Adoption Lead , you will play a pivotal role within the Shared Services Leadership Team in Kraków, driving both continuous improvement and AI-enabled transformation initiatives across multiple services & processes. These include but are not limited to: Financial Services (e.g. Financial Accounting, Performance & Planning Management), HR, Administration, Procurement, and other business operations functions.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of our operations by embedding artificial intelligence into business processes, promoting a culture of innovation, and collaborating with business partners across Zurich Insurance Ltd. to share best practices and influence long-term continuous improvement strategy.

You will lead initiatives from concept to execution in process optimisation and AI adoption.

Responsibilities:

- Lead end-to-end (define, design, implement, report to leadership) continuous improvement and AI transformation projects.

- Identify and prioritise business improvement opportunities, develop AI-driven solutions, and manage cross-functional initiatives to deliver measurable impact.

- Increase AI awareness and adoption opportunities across the organisation by promoting practical use cases and success stories.

- Deliver tailored, cost-effective solutions using appropriate methodologies, including automation, Agentic AI, Power Apps, Microsoft Copilot, and other emerging tools to drive efficiency gains across ZCC Kraków and relevant Business Units.

- Facilitate business process workshops to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for AI-driven optimisation and waste elimination.

- Provide expert guidance on best practices in AI and stay up to date with the latest updates / features and assess possibility of implementation in ZCC Krakow incl. communication, knowledge sharing, scaling across organization.

- Act as a champion of AI and operational excellence, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning within the centre.

Candidate's profile

- Proven experience in leading continuous improvement and/or AI transformation projects, ideally within shared services.

- Strong understanding of artificial intelligence concepts and hands-on experience with AI tools in business operations (e.g. Microsoft Copilot, Agents, , ML/AI models) and other tools: Power Platform or UiPath.

- Stakeholder management experience and cross-functional collaboration.

- Awareness of Lean, Six Sigma, or other process improvement methodologies

- Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value.

- Passion for innovation, emerging technologies, and driving digital change.

We offer:

- Real life opportunities to develop and grow with us and contribute to the world around us.

- Competitive salaries, language allowance and an employee benefits package that includes among others medical insurance, life insurance and sport-card.

- Annual bonus depending on company annual results and individual performance.

- Wide range of learning programs and personal development opportunities including also possibility to apply for up to 80% of educational trainings reimbursement.

- Referral awards.

- Online fitness trainings.

- Hybrid Work.

- Nice and Friendly atmosphere.

Who we are:

Zurich Insurance Group (Zurich) is a leading multi-line insurer serving people and businesses in more than 200 countries and territories. Founded 150 years ago, Zurich is transforming insurance. In addition to providing insurance protection, Zurich is increasingly offering prevention services such as those that promote wellbeing and enhance climate resilience. Reflecting its purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ Zurich aspires to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. It is targeting net-zero emissions by 2050 and has the highest-possible ESG rating from MSCI. In 2020, Zurich launched the Zurich Forest project to support reforestation and biodiversity restoration in Brazil. The Group has about 60,000 employees and is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Zurich Insurance Group Ltd (ZURN), is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange and has a level I American Depositary Receipt (ZURVY) program, which is traded over-the-counter on OTCQX. Further information is available at www.zurich.com .

In March 2016 we established a Shared Service Centre in Kraków, in Poland to support our global strategy. It is from this location that we have created a global shared service platform, focusing on advanced business functions such as financial accounting and reporting, planning and performance management, ICFR testing, financial systems management as well as HR integrated talent management operations.

This role is related to the key area of Zurich’s activity in Kraków. We are committed to complete the recruitment process as soon as possible, however in some occasions it may take up to 6 months and the requirements for the position may be subject to some clarification or modification during the recruitment process.
requirements: communication, knowledge sharing, scaling across organization.
Stakeholder management experience and cross-functional collaboration.

- Deliver tailored, cost-effective solutions using appropriate methodologies, including automation, Agentic AI, Power Apps, Microsoft Copilot, and other emerging tools to drive efficiency gains across ZCC Kraków and relevant Business Units.

- Facilitate business process workshops to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for AI-driven optimisation and waste elimination.

- Provide expert guidance on best practices in AI and stay up to date with the latest updates / features and assess possibility of implementation in ZCC Krakow incl. communication, knowledge sharing, scaling across organization.

- Act as a champion of AI and operational excellence, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning within the centre.

Candidate's profile

- Proven experience in leading continuous improvement and/or AI transformation projects, ideally within shared services.

- Strong understanding of artificial intelligence concepts and hands-on experience with AI tools in business operations (e.g. Microsoft Copilot, Agents, , ML/AI models) and other tools: Power Platform or UiPath.

- Stakeholder management experience and cross-functional collaboration.

- Awareness of Lean, Six Sigma, or other process improvement methodologies

- Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value.

- Passion for innovation, emerging technologies, and driving digital change.

We offer:

- Real life opportunities to develop and grow with us and contribute to the world around us.

- Competitive salaries, language allowance and an employee benefits package that includes among others medical insurance, life insurance and sport-card.

- Annual bonus depending on company annual results and individual performance.

- Wide range of learning programs and personal development opportunities including also possibility to apply for up to 80% of educational trainings reimbursement.

- Referral awards.

- Online fitness trainings.

- Hybrid Work.

- Nice and Friendly atmosphere.

Who we are:

Zurich Insurance Group (Zurich) is a leading multi-line insurer serving people and businesses in more than 200 countries and territories. Founded 150 years ago, Zurich is transforming insurance. In addition to providing insurance protection, Zurich is increasingly offering prevention services such as those that promote wellbeing and enhance climate resilience. Reflecting its purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ Zurich aspires to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. It is targeting net-zero emissions by 2050 and has the highest-possible ESG rating from MSCI. In 2020, Zurich launched the Zurich Forest project to support reforestation and biodiversity restoration in Brazil. The Group has about 60,000 employees and is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Zurich Insurance Group Ltd (ZURN), is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange and has a level I American Depositary Receipt (ZURVY) program, which is traded over-the-counter on OTCQX. Further information is available at www.zurich.com .

In March 2016 we established a Shared Service Centre in Kraków, in Poland to support our global strategy. It is from this location that we have created a global shared service platform, focusing on advanced business functions such as financial accounting and reporting, planning and performance management, ICFR testing, financial systems management as well as HR integrated talent management operations.

This role is related to the key area of Zurich’s activity in Kraków. We are committed to complete the recruitment process as soon as possible, however in some occasions it may take up to 6 months and the requirements for the position may be subject to some clarification or modification during the recruitment process.
