descriptionByLocale.de:
Wir suchen derzeit einen wissbegierigen Performance Analysten oder Senior Performance Analysten für das Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) US Finance Team. Diese Rolle spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Bereitstellung zeitnaher, genauer und umsetzbarer finanzieller Erkenntnisse, die die strategische Entscheidungsfindung unterstützen und die Geschäftsleistung steigern.

Die Person wird mit dem Leiter der Finanzen und dem ZRS-Führungsteam zusammenarbeiten, um Unterstützung und Beratung bei der Umsetzung strategischer Prioritäten zu bieten. Diese Position berichtet an den Head of Finance.

Diese Rolle wird entweder auf der Ebene des Performance Analyst oder des Senior Performance Analyst besetzt. Der Einstellungsmanager bestimmt das geeignete Niveau basierend auf der Erfahrung und den Fähigkeiten des ausgewählten Bewerbers in Bezug auf die für diese Position aufgeführten Qualifikationen.

Diese Rolle hat einen hybriden Zeitplan mit 3 Tagen pro Woche Präsenz in der Schaumburger Zentrale.

Als wichtiger Finanzpartner arbeiten Sie segment- und führungsübergreifend zusammen, um die Ausrichtung der finanziellen Ziele auf die Geschäftsziele sicherzustellen. Diese Rolle wird die Budgetierung, Prognose und Leistungsanalyse unterstützen. Darüber hinaus wird es Ad-hoc-Anfragen, Projekte und Cross-Training mit anderen Mitgliedern des Teams unterstützen.

Der ideale Kandidat verfügt über mittlere Erfahrung in Excel und PowerPoint und ein starkes Verständnis von Finanzen und eine P & L-Anweisung. Andere Fähigkeiten umfassen gute Kommunikation (sowohl schriftlich als auch verbal) und kritisches Denken mit einer analytischen Denkweise.

In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für:

- Kommunizieren komplexer Finanzinformationen und Einblicke an Geschäftspartner über mehrere Funktionen hinweg.

- Bereiten Sie wichtige Botschaften, Berichte und Finanzanalysen vor, um den Managementteams Erkenntnisse zu liefern.

- Unterstützung des Planungs- und Prognoseprozesses und Zusammenarbeit mit der Unternehmensleitung, um Veränderungen und Auswirkungen zu erklären.

- Bereitstellung fortgeschrittener Finanzanalyse und -modellierung.

- Überwachung/Überprüfung des Geschäftsfortschritts in Bezug auf Geschäfts-/Betriebspläne.

- Bewerten Sie wichtige Projekte / Initiativen, um festzustellen, ob die wichtigsten Ergebnisse erreicht werden.

- Identifizierung von Analyselücken und zusätzlichen Analysen, die durchgeführt werden sollten.

- Wenden Sie Branchenwissen auf die eigene Arbeit an und bringen Sie Wissen mit anderen Analysten zusammen.

- Entwicklung einer schriftlichen Kommunikation, die Analysen und Erkenntnisse in einer zusammenhängenden Geschichte vermittelt.

- Festlegung von Datenanforderungen und Ermittlung geeigneter Quellen.

- Bauen Sie eine Beziehung zu Stakeholdern / leitenden Führungskräften auf und erzählen Sie eine überzeugende Geschichte der Ergebnisse

- Teilnahme an der Ausbildung und Entwicklung neuer Mitarbeiter.

- Bachelor-Abschluss und 4 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Rechnungswesen oder Finanzen
ODER

- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 6 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Rechnungswesen oder Finanzen
ODER

- Abschluss des Zurich Finance Development Program, einschließlich eines Bachelor-Abschlusses und 2 oder mehr Jahren Erfahrung im Bereich Rechnungswesen oder Finanzen
ODER

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice mit 4 oder mehr Jahren Erfahrung im Bereich Rechnungswesen oder Finanzen

ODER

Senior Performance Analyst Grundqualifikationen:

- Bachelor-Abschluss und 6 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Rechnungswesen oder Finanzen
ODER

- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 8 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Rechnungswesen oder Finanzen
ODER

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice inklusive Associate Degree und 6 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Accounting oder Finance

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

- Erfahrung in der Versicherungsbranche

- Bachelor in Finanzen oder Rechnungswesen

- Wissen über P&L

- Projektmanagementerfahrung

- CPA, CPCU, CFA oder CTP

- Starke Microsoft Office Erfahrung

- Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

- Erfahrung mit Power BI, SAP und BPC

- Erleben Sie die erfolgreiche Navigation von Co-Piloten

Ihre Bezahlung in Zürich basiert auf Ihrer Rolle, Ihrem Standort, Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung. Wir befolgen lokale Gesetze, um eine faire Entschädigung zu gewährleisten. Nous recherchons actuellement un analyste de performance curieux ou un analyste de performance senior pour rejoindre l'équipe de Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS) US Finance. Ce rôle joue un rôle crucial dans la prestation de renseignements financiers opportuns, exacts et exploitables qui appuient la prise de décisions stratégiques et stimulent le rendement des entreprises.

La personne travaillera avec le chef des finances et l'équipe de direction du ZRS pour fournir du soutien et des conseils afin d'aider à réaliser les priorités stratégiques. Cette position relève du chef des Finances.

Ce rôle sera assumé soit par l'analyste du rendement, soit par l'analyste principal du rendement. Le gestionnaire d'embauche déterminera le niveau approprié en fonction de l'expérience et des compétences du candidat choisi par rapport aux qualités énumérées pour ce poste.

Ce rôle a un calendrier hybride avec 3 jours par semaine de présence au siège de Schaumburg.

En tant que partenaire financier clé, vous collaborerez à travers les segments et le leadership pour assurer l'alignement des objectifs financiers sur les objectifs opérationnels. Ce rôle appuiera la budgétisation, les prévisions et l'analyse du rendement. En outre, il appuiera les demandes ponctuelles, les projets et les échanges de formation avec d'autres membres de l'équipe.

Le candidat idéal aura une expérience intermédiaire dans Excel et PowerPoint et une bonne compréhension de la finance et une déclaration de P&L. D'autres compétences comprennent une bonne communication (écrite et verbale) et une pensée critique avec un état d'esprit analytique.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable:

- Communiquer de l'information financière et des renseignements financiers complexes aux partenaires commerciaux dans le cadre de fonctions multiples.

- Préparer des messages clés, des rapports et des analyses financières afin de fournir des renseignements aux équipes de gestion.

- Appuyer le processus de planification et de prévision et collaborer avec le leadership des unités opérationnelles pour expliquer les changements et les répercussions.

- Fournir une analyse financière et une modélisation avancées.

- Surveiller/examiner les progrès des activités par rapport aux plans opérationnels.

- Évaluer les projets/initiatives clés afin de déterminer si les principaux résultats sont atteints.

- Identifier les lacunes dans l'analyse et les analyses supplémentaires qui devraient être effectuées.

- Appliquer les connaissances de l'industrie à son propre travail et mettre en valeur les connaissances avec d'autres analystes.

- Développer des communications écrites qui transmettent des analyses et des idées dans une histoire cohésive.

- Définir les besoins en données et identifier les sources appropriées.

- Établir des rapports avec les intervenants et les cadres supérieurs et raconter une histoire convaincante des résultats

- Participation à la formation et au perfectionnement des nouveaux employés.

Analyste du rendement Qualifications de base :

- Baccalauréat et 4 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la comptabilité ou des finances
OU

- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la comptabilité ou des finances
OU

- Achèvement du programme de développement financier de Zurich, y compris un baccalauréat et 2 années d'expérience ou plus dans le domaine de la comptabilité ou des finances
OU

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice avec 4 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la comptabilité ou des finances

OU

Analyste principal du rendement Qualifications de base :

- Baccalauréat et 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la comptabilité ou des finances
OU

- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la comptabilité ou des finances
OU

- Zurich Apprentis certifié en assurance comprenant un diplôme associé et 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la comptabilité ou des finances

Qualifications préférées :

- Expérience du secteur de l'assurance

- Baccalauréat en finance ou en comptabilité

- Connaissance des P&L

- Expérience de gestion de projet

- CPA, CPCU, FCA ou CTP

- Forte expérience de Microsoft Office

- Fortes compétences en communication verbale et écrite

- Expérience avec Power BI, SAP et BPC

- Expérience de navigation avec succès copilote

Votre salaire à Zurich est basé sur votre rôle, votre emplacement, vos compétences et votre expérience. Nous suivons les lois locales pour garantir une juste indemnisation. Vous pouvez également être admissible à des primes et des augmentations de mérite. Si vos attentes sont supérieures à la fourchette indiquée, nous vous encourageons toujours à présenter votre candidature, ce qui compte pour nous. L'échelle salariale combinée pour ce poste est de 72 500 $ - 157 000 $. L'échelle salariale proposée pour l'analyste du rendement est de 72 500,00 $ - 118 700,00 $, et l'admissibilité à la prime incitative à court terme est fixée à 10 %. L'échelle salariale proposée pour l'analyste principal du rendement est de 95 900,00 $ à 157 000,00 $, et la prime incitative à court terme est fixée à 15 %.

Nous offrons une rémunération concurrentielle et des avantages complets aux employés et à leur famille. [En savoir plus sur Total Rewards ici .]

Pourquoi Zurich ?

À Zurich, nous apprécions vos idées et votre expérience. Nous offrons la croissance, l'inclusion et un environnement favorable, afin que vous puissiez aider à façonner l'avenir de l'assurance. Zurich L'Amérique du Nord est un chef de file en gestion des risques, avec plus de 150 ans d'expertise et de couverture dans plus de 25 industries, dont 90% du Fortune 500®.

Rejoignez-nous pour un avenir meilleur, pour vous et nos clients.

En Amérique du Nord, Zurich ne fait pas de discrimination fondée sur la race, l'ethnicité, la couleur, la religion, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'expression sexuelle, l'identité de genre, l'information génétique, l'âge, le handicap, le statut de vétéran protégé, l'état matrimonial, l'orientation sexuelle, la grossesse ou d'autres caractéristiques protégées par la loi applicable. • Support the team’s growth by strengthening capabilities across technical and business areas.

• Communicate clearly and proactively with other IT teams to ensure that solutions are aligned with overall business objectives.

•Bachelor degree of Computer Sciences, Information Technology, or related disciplines.

•Proficient in Procedural SQL Programming (PL/SQL, T-SQL, PL/pgSQL, SQL/PL and etc).

•Experience in Web Services (REST & SOAP Web Services), JSON, XML is a plus.

•Be proactive, open minded, responsible, able to work independently and with good problem-solving skills.

•Effective communication in English or Cantonese is added advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Accountant
jobs.description:
A new transformational adventure awaits you…

How does 5 weeks of annual leave, a fulfilling career you'll genuinely enjoy, and working for a reputable organization that promotes wellbeing and drives digital transformation sound to you?

As one of Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ and Fortune’s ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ for 2025, Zurich - a leader in the insurance industry, is on a journey towards a brighter future… A brighter future for you - focused on your career, your wellbeing, and your community - as well as our customers and the planet.

Join us on this thrilling journey as we work towards our vision of becoming Australia's leading digital insurer. If you're eager to be part of a values-driven global organisation that's experiencing real growth and transformation, and if you share our commitment to making a tangible difference and taking continuous steps towards a sustainable future for our people, customers, communities, and our planet, then keep reading!

Let’s create a brighter future together, let’s make a difference

It’s important to know, what you do matters. At Zurich, we don’t just cover, we care.

As a Senior Financial Accountant, you’ll play a key role in helping Zurich deliver accurate, timely and insightful financial reporting across the business. Working within the Life Insurance & Financial Reporting team, you’ll partner with a broad range of stakeholders and contribute to finance projects that support business growth, operational excellence and our ongoing digital transformation. This is an opportunity to make a genuine impact by strengthening financial governance, improving processes and helping ensure the integrity of financial information that supports strategic decision-making. You’ll join a collaborative team that values curiosity, innovation and continuous improvement. Backed by supportive leadership and clear pathways for growth, this is an opportunity to build a rewarding career while developing future-ready skills. We invest in your growth through access to global learning, technical pathways, and opportunities to build digital and AI capability.

You will also be responsible for the following:

- Lead and support finance projects that enhance financial reporting and drive innovation

- Deliver accurate month end activities, reconciliations and financial control processes

- Contribute to internal and external financial reporting in line with group and regulatory requirements

- Build strong partnerships with finance and business stakeholders across the organisation

- Support financial governance activities, audits and compliance obligations

- Identify and implement opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

Important to your success – let’s grow together

You’re a proactive and collaborative finance professional who enjoys working across teams to solve problems and improve outcomes. You bring a continuous improvement mindset, communicate confidently with stakeholders and take ownership of delivering high-quality results in a changing environment.

To be successful, you will have the following :

- Experience in financial accounting, reporting and month end processes

- Strong capability in statutory and regulatory accounting environments

- Advanced Excel skills with the ability to analyse and interpret financial data

- Experience supporting or delivering finance related projects and business initiatives

- Working knowledge of SAP general ledger systems or similar enterprise finance platforms

- Well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail

Belong. Zurich is here to support you

There are so many reasons why Zurich is a great place to be and the right choice for you, but here are just a few.

- Enjoy 5 weeks of annual leave for permanent staff through our Z leave initiative, along with 15 days of personal/carer’s leave as we empower our people to manage their own wellbeing. Plus, access to Family Care (parental leave).

- Benefit from a hybrid working arrangement – 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home per week for full-time employees.

- Access programs to stay healthy and feel healthier, receive an AUD$500 wellbeing payment per year, and a AUD$295 new starter e-voucher for your work-from-home setup (flex work - hybrid working), along with other great benefits through our Shine portal.

- Grow and thrive in your career with our award-winning training programs. We support and encourage your development because our strength lies in our people, and we value your individuality.

- Work with global, diverse, and inclusive teams; explore your passions, fuel innovation, drive equity, collaborate, and make a positive difference beyond your role.

- Take advantage of global mobility opportunities across more than 200 countries worldwide.

- Volunteer and work in our state-of-the-art Green Star rated offices (when you are in the office) and dress for your day.

- We plant a tree for every new employee.

- Not to mention our various employer of choice awards/memberships – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity… to name a few.

We could go on, but the main point is that Zurich is a great place to be, where you can truly belong, be yourself, maintain work/life balance, and thrive in a supportive environment.

Zurich is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require any special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to please let us know at the time of your application.

So, if you want to come on an adventure that will build a brighter future together, and feel a sense of togetherness, then please apply today to start your adventure!

Working within the Life Insurance & Financial Reporting team, you’ll partner with a broad range of stakeholders and contribute to finance projects that support business growth, operational excellence and our ongoing digital transformation. This is an opportunity to make a genuine impact by strengthening financial governance, improving processes and helping ensure the integrity of financial information that supports strategic decision-making. You’ll join a collaborative team that values curiosity, innovation and continuous improvement. Backed by supportive leadership and clear pathways for growth, this is an opportunity to build a rewarding career while developing future-ready skills. We invest in your growth through access to global learning, technical pathways, and opportunities to build digital and AI capability.

You will also be responsible for the following:

- Lead and support finance projects that enhance financial reporting and drive innovation

- Deliver accurate month end activities, reconciliations and financial control processes

- Contribute to internal and external financial reporting in line with group and regulatory requirements

- Build strong partnerships with finance and business stakeholders across the organisation

- Support financial governance activities, audits and compliance obligations

- Identify and implement opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

Important to your success – let’s grow together

You’re a proactive and collaborative finance professional who enjoys working across teams to solve problems and improve outcomes. You bring a continuous improvement mindset, communicate confidently with stakeholders and take ownership of delivering high-quality results in a changing environment.

To be successful, you will have the following :

- Experience in financial accounting, reporting and month end processes

- Strong capability in statutory and regulatory accounting environments

- Advanced Excel skills with the ability to analyse and interpret financial data

- Experience supporting or delivering finance related projects and business initiatives

- Working knowledge of SAP general ledger systems or similar enterprise finance platforms

- Well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail

Belong. Zurich is here to support you

There are so many reasons why Zurich is a great place to be and the right choice for you, but here are just a few.

- Enjoy 5 weeks of annual leave for permanent staff through our Z leave initiative, along with 15 days of personal/carer’s leave as we empower our people to manage their own wellbeing. Plus, access to Family Care (parental leave).

- Benefit from a hybrid working arrangement – 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home per week for full-time employees.

- Access programs to stay healthy and feel healthier, receive an AUD$500 wellbeing payment per year, and a AUD$295 new starter e-voucher for your work-from-home setup (flex work - hybrid working), along with other great benefits through our Shine portal.

- Grow and thrive in your career with our award-winning training programs. We support and encourage your development because our strength lies in our people, and we value your individuality.

- Work with global, diverse, and inclusive teams; explore your passions, fuel innovation, drive equity, collaborate, and make a positive difference beyond your role.

- Take advantage of global mobility opportunities across more than 200 countries worldwide.

- Volunteer and work in our state-of-the-art Green Star rated offices (when you are in the office) and dress for your day.

- We plant a tree for every new employee.

- Not to mention our various employer of choice awards/memberships – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity… to name a few.

We could go on, but the main point is that Zurich is a great place to be, where you can truly belong, be yourself, maintain work/life balance, and thrive in a supportive environment.

Zurich is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require any special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to please let us know at the time of your application.

So, if you want to come on an adventure that will build a brighter future together, and feel a sense of togetherness, then please apply today to start your adventure!

- Leiten und unterstützen Sie Finanzierungsprojekte, die die Finanzberichterstattung verbessern und Innovationen vorantreiben

- Unterstützung von Finanz-Governance-Aktivitäten, Audits und Compliance-Pflichten

- Identifikation und Umsetzung von Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Prozessen und Arbeitsweisen

Wichtig für Ihren Erfolg – wachsen wir zusammen

Sie sind ein proaktiver und kooperativer Finanzprofi, der es genießt, in Teams zu arbeiten, um Probleme zu lösen und Ergebnisse zu verbessern. Sie bringen eine kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmentalität mit, kommunizieren selbstbewusst mit Stakeholdern und übernehmen die Verantwortung, qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse in einem sich verändernden Umfeld zu liefern.

Um erfolgreich zu sein, haben Sie folgendes:

- Erfahrung in Finanzbuchhaltung, Reporting und Monatsendprozessen

- Starke Fähigkeiten im gesetzlichen und regulatorischen Rechnungslegungsumfeld

- Erweiterte Excel-Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Finanzdaten zu analysieren und zu interpretieren

- Gut entwickelte analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit starker Liebe zum Detail

Belong. Zürich ist da, um Sie zu unterstützen

- Ganz zu schweigen von unseren verschiedenen Arbeitgeberpreisen / Mitgliedschaften - WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Arbeitgeber, Stolz auf Vielfalt ... um nur einige zu nennen.

Wir könnten weitermachen, aber der Hauptpunkt ist, dass Zürich ein großartiger Ort ist, an dem Sie wirklich dazugehören, Sie selbst sein, die Work-Life-Balance aufrechterhalten und in einer unterstützenden Umgebung gedeihen können.

Wenn Sie spezielle Unterkünfte benötigen, um an unserem Rekrutierungsprozess teilzunehmen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, uns dies zum Zeitpunkt Ihrer Bewerbung mitzuteilen.

Wenn Sie also auf ein Abenteuer kommen möchten, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft aufbauen und ein Gefühl der Zusammengehörigkeit spüren wird, dann bewerben Sie sich bitte noch heute, um Ihr Abenteuer zu beginnen!

jobs.title: Underwriting Specialist OR Executive Underwriter - Middle Market
jobs.description:
Over the past five years, Zurich North America has built a world-class Middle Market operation that serves key industries across the U.S. We strive to assemble a team of dedicated Middle Market leaders and underwriters who understand this space very deeply and who grasp the unique challenges of the various industry segments and the individual customers we serve. We are looking to add to our team in Maitland, FL and hire an experienced Market Facing Property & Casualty Underwriter. We will also consider someone virtual within the State of Florida.

In this role, you will serve as a customer advocate with a focus on improving customer experience by understanding their unique risks and offering the best end-to-end solution for their Property & Casualty insurance needs.

What you can expect in a Market Facing, Middle Markets Underwriting position at Zurich:

- You will develop and maintain relationships with broker partners and customers across all industries in support of business objectives.

- You will leverage your Property and Casualty underwriting acumen across risk assessment, exposure evaluation and pricing to generate and maintain a profitable book of new and renewal business.

- You will work collaboratively across business units including but not limited to; claims, finance, risk engineering, actuary, and technical underwriting while gaining extensive knowledge in a growing and innovative industry.

- You will be empowered to use your technical underwriting, negotiation and interpersonal skills to grow and develop relationships with preferred distribution partners in an assigned territory.

This role will be filled at either the Underwriting Specialist or Executive Underwriter level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Underwriting Specialist Required Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

OR

Executive Underwriter Required Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support are
AND

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office

- Experience working on time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience working in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelors Degree

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Microsoft Office experience

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The combined salary range for this position is $75,000.00 - $165,000.00. jobs.title: Engineer Surveyor, LEV/Electrical: Castle Donnington
jobs.description:
Working Hours: This role is available on a part-time, job-share and full-time basis

Location:

Salary: Total Package value of over £65,000, including a competitive salary of up to £57,594 depending on experience.

Car: Essential Car User

So what’s it all about:

At Zurich, our Engineer Surveyor workforce is central to our continued success, being the ‘Face of Zurich’ to our large and varied client base. You’ll find a fully flexible offering that means you can manage your own diary to service your own client area. This will allow you to broker and develop your relationships whilst representing Zurich Engineering.

No two days will ever be the same, as you’ll work in a variety of interesting environments and you will have control over your own work/life balance, as we believe our people are what makes us successful.

Our Engineer Surveyor roles allow you to develop your mechanical engineering skills further and work for a market-leading engineering inspection provider.

Zurich Engineering is looking to expand our highly skilled, field-based, Engineer Surveyor team, and we currently have a vacancy for the Castle Donnington area for a LEV (Local Exhaust Ventilation)/Electrical Engineer Surveyor.

What will I be doing?

You’ll start with our industry-leading, bespoke training and move swiftly to carrying out hands-on statutory inspections, providing your expert opinion on a wide range of equipment, enabling our clients to comply with all relevant legislation and to the exacting standards both we and our clients demand. Following your inspection, we’ll need you to report back using a rugged laptop, and then issue electronically to our clients, so good IT skills and high levels of literacy are required. You will be an excellent communicator, and confident in your ability to make sound engineering judgements.

What skills/qualifications will I have?

You will be an experienced engineer with a sound knowledge of your engineering discipline and be part of our multi-disciplined inspection team within your geographic area. You will report to a Team Manager and be based from home, with your client base a reasonable travelling distance from your home.

Because this role is SAFEd governed, we need you to ideally have obtained:

- A Level 3 qualification in a relevant engineering field, support is available to allow you to achieve IEng status whilst working as we want to help you gain professional membership.

- Compex qualified - advantageous

- A P601 LEV qualification is advantageous

- You will have completed, either a time served or Modern Apprenticeship

- Hands-on experience in a relevant engineering discipline

- A background, working with pumps and motors - preferable

- A full valid UK driving licence.

- Be willing and able to work paid overtime.

What will you get in return?

Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich, we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday.

Follow the link for more information about our benefits - Employee benefits | Working at Zurich Insurance UK

As an inclusive employer we want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply.

Who we are:

At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world and the best global insurer. Together we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet.

With over 55,000 employees in more than 170 countries , you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company who are a long-standing player in the insurance industry.

We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee; to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future.

If you're interested in working in a dynamic and challenging environment for a company that recognises and rewards your creativity, initiatives and contributions - then Zurich could be just the place for you. Be part of something great.

Our Culture

At Zurich, our sense of community is strong and we’re particularly passionate about diversity and inclusion, which we’ve won numerous awards for. We want our people to bring the whole of themselves to work and ensure everybody is made to feel welcome, regardless of their background, beliefs or culture. We want our employees to reflect the diversity of our customers, and so are committed to treating all of our applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, disability or any other protected characteristic.

We’ve an environment that places a real importance on our people’s wellbeing from a physical, mental, social and financial perspective. We work with our wellbeing partners and industry experts to provide the best advice and access to a wealth of lifestyle support. We’re also committed to continuous improvement and we offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.

We’re passionate about supporting employees to help others by getting involved in volunteering, charitable and community activity. Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, is one of the longest-established corporate trusts in the UK. In that time, we’ve awarded grants and volunteered time to deserving causes in the UK valued at over £90 million.

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work for us.

The financials

- 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme.

- Annual company bonus.

- Income Protection.

- Life cover - four times your salary.

Time away

- 28 days holiday a year plus bank holidays.

- You can also request to swap UK bank holidays for days off that have cultural or religious significance to you.

- The option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday.

- Three days paid volunteering.

- Up to 16 weeks' full pay for maternity, paternity and adoption leave.

Your health is important to us

- Access to Private medical insurance.

- Virtual GP appointments.

- Discounted gym membership.

- Free flu jab.

- Access to a wealth of support from our wellbeing partners.

We're making a difference

- Creating a brighter, more sustainable future underpins all that we do here in Zurich. We were the first insurer to sign the ‘UN Business Ambition for 1.5˚C’ pledge.

- Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, has awarded grants and volunteered time to deserving causes in the UK valued at over £90 million.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ore lavorative: Questo ruolo è disponibile a tempo parziale, a tempo pieno e a tempo pieno

Posizione:

Salario: Valore totale del pacchetto di oltre £65.000, compreso uno stipendio competitivo fino a £57,594 a seconda dell'esperienza.

Auto: Utente di auto essenziale

Allora, di cosa si tratta:

A Zurigo, la nostra forza lavoro di Ingegnere Surveyor è centrale per il nostro continuo successo, essendo la ‘Face of Zurich’ alla nostra grande e variegata base clienti. Troverete un'offerta completamente flessibile che significa che è possibile gestire il proprio diario per servire la propria area cliente. Questo vi permetterà di mediare e sviluppare le vostre relazioni mentre rappresentate l'ingegneria di Zurigo.

Nessun due giorni sarà mai lo stesso, come si lavorerà in una varietà di ambienti interessanti e si avrà il controllo sul proprio equilibrio lavoro / vita, come crediamo che la nostra gente è ciò che ci rende di successo.

I nostri ruoli di Ingegnere Surveyor consentono di sviluppare ulteriormente le tue capacità di ingegneria meccanica e di lavorare per un fornitore di ispezione di ingegneria leader di mercato.

Zurigo Engineering sta cercando di espandere il nostro team di Ingegneri, altamente qualificato, e attualmente abbiamo un posto vacante per l'area del Castello di Donnington per un LEV (Local Exhaust Ventilation)/Ingegnere Elettrico Surveyor.

Cosa faro'?

Potrai iniziare con la nostra formazione leader del settore, formazione su misura e muoversi rapidamente per eseguire le ispezioni legali hands-on, fornendo la tua opinione esperta su una vasta gamma di attrezzature, consentendo ai nostri clienti di rispettare tutte le leggi pertinenti e agli standard esigenti sia noi che i nostri clienti richiedono. A seguito della vostra ispezione, avremo bisogno di riportare indietro utilizzando un computer portatile robusto, e poi emettere elettronicamente ai nostri clienti, così buone competenze IT e alti livelli di alfabetizzazione sono necessari. Sarete un eccellente comunicatore, e fiducioso nella vostra capacità di fare giudizi di ingegneria sana.

Quali competenze/qualifica avro'?

Sarete un ingegnere esperto con una solida conoscenza della vostra disciplina di ingegneria e far parte del nostro team di ispezione multi-disciplinata all'interno della vostra area geografica. Ti riferirai a un Team Manager e sarai basato da casa, con la tua base clienti a una distanza di viaggio ragionevole da casa tua.

Poiché questo ruolo è governato da SAFEd, abbiamo bisogno che tu abbia ottenuto idealmente:

- Una qualifica di livello 3 in un campo di ingegneria rilevante, il supporto è disponibile per consentire di raggiungere lo stato IEng mentre lavoriamo come vogliamo aiutarvi a ottenere l'adesione professionale.

- Compex qualificato - vantaggioso

- Una qualifica P601 LEV è vantaggiosa

- Avrete completato, sia un tempo servito o Modern Apprenticeship

- Esperienza pratica in una disciplina ingegneristica rilevante

- Uno sfondo, che lavora con pompe e motori - preferibile

- Una patente di guida del Regno Unito.

- Essere disposti e in grado di lavorare pagato straordinario.

Cosa otterrai in cambio?

Ognuno è diverso. Ecco perché a Zurigo offriamo una vasta gamma di vantaggi per i nostri dipendenti in modo che i nostri clienti possano scegliere ciò che si adatta a loro e alla loro vita. I nostri vantaggi offrono una reale flessibilità in modo che le nostre persone possano fare scelte considerate e personalizzare i loro benefici durante tutto l'anno. I nostri benefici includono 12% di pensione non contributiva definita, bonus annuale dell'azienda, assicurazione medica privata e la possibilità di acquistare fino a un ulteriore 20 giorni o vendere alcuni della vostra vacanza.

Seguire il link per maggiori informazioni sui nostri vantaggi - Vantaggi del dipendente | Lavorare presso l'assicurazione di Zurigo UK

Come datore di lavoro inclusivo vogliamo garantire che tutti i candidati si sentano a proprio agio e siano in grado di eseguire al meglio durante l'intervista. Avrete la possibilità di farci sapere qualsiasi ragionevole adattamento o supporto pratico necessario quando si applica.

Chi siamo:

A Zurigo aspiriamo ad essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d'impatto del mondo e il migliore assicuratore globale. Insieme stiamo creando un futuro più luminoso per i nostri clienti, la nostra gente e il nostro pianeta.

Con oltre 55.000 dipendenti in più di 170 paesi, sentirete il supporto di essere parte di una società forte e stabile che sono un giocatore di lunga data nel settore assicurativo.

Abbiamo fatto una promessa l’uno all’altro e ogni dipendente; per concentrarsi sull’impatto sostenibile, per prendersi cura del benessere degli altri, per utilizzare le nostre diverse competenze per essere curiosi e ottimisti e per sviluppare le competenze necessarie per il nostro futuro.

Se sei interessato a lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e stimolante per un'azienda che riconosce e premia la tua creatività, iniziative e contributi - allora Zurigo potrebbe essere il posto giusto per te. Fai parte di qualcosa di grande.

La nostra cultura

A Zurigo, il nostro senso di comunità è forte e siamo particolarmente appassionati di diversità e inclusione, per cui abbiamo vinto numerosi premi. Vogliamo che il nostro popolo porti tutto il loro lavoro e assicuri che tutti siano accolti, indipendentemente dal loro background, dalle loro convinzioni o dalla loro cultura. Vogliamo che i nostri dipendenti riflettano la diversità dei nostri clienti, e così si impegnano a trattare tutti i nostri candidati in modo equo e rispettoso, indipendentemente dal loro reale o presunto background, disabilità o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta.

Abbiamo un ambiente che pone una reale importanza sul benessere della nostra gente da una prospettiva fisica, mentale, sociale e finanziaria. Lavoriamo con i nostri partner di benessere e gli esperti del settore per fornire i migliori consigli e l'accesso a una ricchezza di supporto allo stile di vita. Ci impegniamo anche a un miglioramento continuo e offriamo l’accesso a una gamma completa di opportunità di formazione e sviluppo.

Siamo appassionati di sostenere i dipendenti per aiutare gli altri, coinvolgendoci nell’attività di volontariato, caritativa e comunitaria. Il nostro braccio caritativo, Zurich Community Trust, è uno dei più consolidati trust aziendali nel Regno Unito. In quel periodo, abbiamo concesso borse di studio e tempo di volontariato per meritare cause nel Regno Unito valutato a oltre 90 milioni di sterline.

Quindi fai la differenza. Sii sfidato. Sii ispirato. Siate sostenuti, Amate quello che fate. Lavora per noi.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Arbeitszeit: Diese Rolle ist auf Teilzeit-, Job-Share- und Vollzeitbasis verfügbar

Standort:

Gehalt: Gesamtpaketwert von über 65.000 £, einschließlich eines wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalts von bis zu 57.594 £ je nach Erfahrung.

Auto: Essential Car User

Worum geht es also:

Bei Zurich ist unsere Engineer Surveyor Belegschaft von zentraler Bedeutung für unseren anhaltenden Erfolg und das „Face of Zurich für unseren großen und vielfältigen Kundenstamm. Sie werden ein völlig flexibles Angebot finden, das bedeutet, dass Sie Ihr eigenes Tagebuch verwalten können, um Ihren eigenen Kundenbereich zu bedienen. Dies ermöglicht es Ihnen, Ihre Beziehungen zu vermitteln und zu entwickeln, während Sie Zurich Engineering vertreten.

Keine zwei Tage werden jemals die gleichen sein, da Sie in einer Vielzahl von interessanten Umgebungen arbeiten und die Kontrolle über Ihre eigene Work-Life-Balance haben werden, da wir glauben, dass unsere Mitarbeiter das sind, was uns erfolgreich macht.

Unsere Engineer Surveyor-Rollen ermöglichen es Ihnen, Ihre Fähigkeiten im Maschinenbau weiterzuentwickeln und für einen marktführenden Anbieter von technischen Inspektionen zu arbeiten.

Zurich Engineering ist bestrebt, unser hochqualifiziertes, feldbasiertes Engineer Surveyor-Team zu erweitern, und wir haben derzeit eine freie Stelle für den Bereich Castle Donnington für einen LEV (Local Exhaust Ventilation) / Electric Engineer Surveyor.

Was werde ich tun?

Sie beginnen mit unserem branchenführenden, maßgeschneiderten Training und gehen schnell zu praktischen gesetzlichen Inspektionen über, geben Ihr Expertengutachten zu einer breiten Palette von Geräten und ermöglichen es unseren Kunden, alle relevanten Gesetze und die anspruchsvollen Standards einzuhalten, die sowohl wir als auch unsere Kunden verlangen. Nach Ihrer Inspektion müssen Sie sich mit einem robusten Laptop melden und dann elektronisch an unsere Kunden ausstellen, so dass gute IT-Kenntnisse und ein hohes Maß an Alphabetisierung erforderlich sind. Sie werden ein ausgezeichneter Kommunikator sein und auf Ihre Fähigkeit vertrauen, fundierte technische Urteile zu fällen.

Welche Fähigkeiten/Qualifikationen werde ich haben?

Sie werden ein erfahrener Ingenieur mit fundierten Kenntnissen Ihrer Ingenieurdisziplin sein und Teil unseres multidisziplinären Inspektionsteams in Ihrem geografischen Gebiet sein. Sie werden einem Teammanager berichten und von zu Hause aus arbeiten, wobei Ihre Kundenbasis eine angemessene Reiseentfernung von Ihrem Zuhause hat.

Da diese Rolle SAFEd geregelt ist, müssen Sie idealerweise erhalten haben:

- Eine Stufe 3 Qualifikation in einem relevanten Engineering-Bereich, Unterstützung ist verfügbar, damit Sie IEng Status zu erreichen, während Sie arbeiten, wie wir Ihnen helfen wollen, professionelle Mitgliedschaft zu gewinnen.

- Compex qualifiziert - vorteilhaft

- Eine P601 LEV-Qualifikation ist vorteilhaft

- Sie werden abgeschlossen haben, entweder eine Zeit serviert oder Modern Apprentice

- Praxiserfahrung in einer relevanten Ingenieurdisziplin

- Ein Hintergrund, Arbeiten mit Pumpen und Motoren - bevorzugt

- Einen voll gültigen britischen Führerschein.

- Seien Sie bereit und in der Lage, bezahlte Überstunden zu machen.

Was bekommen Sie im Gegenzug?

Jeder ist anders. Deshalb bieten wir in Zürich ein breites Spektrum an Mitarbeiterleistungen, damit unsere Mitarbeiter wählen können, was zu ihnen und ihrem Leben passt. Unsere Vorteile bieten echte Flexibilität, damit unsere Mitarbeiter überlegte Entscheidungen treffen und ihre Vorteile das ganze Jahr über anpassen können. Unsere Leistungen umfassen 12% beitragsunabhängige Altersvorsorge, jährlichen Unternehmensbonus, private Krankenversicherung und die Option, bis zu 20 Tage mehr zu kaufen oder einen Teil Ihres Urlaubs zu verkaufen.

Weitere Informationen zu unseren Leistungen - Mitarbeiterleistungen | Arbeiten bei Zurich Insurance UK

Als inklusiver Arbeitgeber möchten wir sicherstellen, dass sich alle Kandidaten wohl fühlen und während des Interviews ihre besten Leistungen erbringen können. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, uns jede angemessene Anpassung oder praktische Unterstützung mitzuteilen, die bei Ihrer Bewerbung erforderlich ist.

Wer wir sind:

Bei Zurich streben wir danach, eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt und der beste globale Versicherer zu sein. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Kunden, unsere Menschen und unseren Planeten.

Mit über 55.000 Mitarbeitern in mehr als 170 Ländern werden Sie die Unterstützung spüren, Teil eines starken und stabilen Unternehmens zu sein, das ein langjähriger Akteur in der Versicherungsbranche ist.

Wir haben uns gegenseitig und jedem Mitarbeiter ein Versprechen gegeben, uns auf nachhaltige Auswirkungen zu konzentrieren, uns um das Wohlergehen des anderen zu kümmern, unser vielfältiges Fachwissen zu nutzen, um neugierig und optimistisch zu sein und die Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die für unsere Zukunft erforderlich sind.

Wenn Sie daran interessiert sind, in einem dynamischen und herausfordernden Umfeld für ein Unternehmen zu arbeiten, das Ihre Kreativität, Initiativen und Beiträge anerkennt und belohnt - dann könnte Zürich genau der richtige Ort für Sie sein. Sei Teil von etwas Großem.

Unsere Kultur

Bei Zürich ist unser Gemeinschaftsgefühl stark und wir sind besonders leidenschaftlich für Vielfalt und Inklusion, für die wir zahlreiche Auszeichnungen erhalten haben. Wir wollen, dass unsere Leute sich ganz an die Arbeit machen und sicherstellen, dass sich jeder willkommen fühlt, unabhängig von seinem Hintergrund, Glauben oder seiner Kultur. Wir möchten, dass unsere Mitarbeiter die Vielfalt unserer Kunden widerspiegeln, und sind daher verpflichtet, alle unsere Bewerber fair und respektvoll zu behandeln, unabhängig von ihrem tatsächlichen oder angenommenen Hintergrund, Behinderung oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen.

Wir haben ein Umfeld, das dem Wohlbefinden unserer Menschen aus körperlicher, geistiger, sozialer und finanzieller Sicht einen echten Stellenwert einräumt. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Wohlfühlpartnern und Branchenexperten zusammen, um die beste Beratung und den Zugang zu einer Fülle von Lifestyle-Unterstützung zu bieten. Wir sind auch der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung verpflichtet und bieten Zugang zu einer umfassenden Palette von Schulungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Wir sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, Mitarbeiter dabei zu unterstützen, anderen zu helfen, indem wir uns in Freiwilligenarbeit, gemeinnützigen und gemeinschaftlichen Aktivitäten engagieren. Unser gemeinnütziger Arm, Zurich Community Trust, ist einer der am längsten etablierten Corporate Trusts in Großbritannien. In dieser Zeit haben wir Zuschüsse und freiwillige Zeit für verdienstvolle Zwecke in Großbritannien im Wert von über 90 Millionen Pfund vergeben.

Machen Sie also einen Unterschied. Werden Sie herausgefordert. Lassen Sie sich inspirieren. Sei unterstützt, liebe, was du tust. Arbeitet für uns.

- Eine bessere, nachhaltigere Zukunft zu schaffen, untermauert alles, was wir hier in Zürich tun. Wir waren der erste Versicherer, der die Zusage „UN Business Ambition for 1.5 ̊C unterzeichnet hat.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Heures de travail: Ce rôle est disponible à temps partiel, en partage d'emploi et à temps plein

Lieu:

Salaire : Montant total de plus de 65 000 £, y compris un salaire compétitif pouvant atteindre 57 594 £ selon l'expérience.

Voiture: Utilisateur essentiel de voiture

Alors qu'est-ce que c'est :

À Zurich, notre équipe d'ingénieurs-géomètres est au cœur de notre succès continu, étant le « Face de Zurich » pour notre vaste et varié clientèle. Vous trouverez une offre entièrement flexible qui signifie que vous pouvez gérer votre propre journal pour servir votre propre zone client. Cela vous permettra de négocier et de développer vos relations tout en représentant Zurich Engineering.

Pas deux jours ne seront jamais les mêmes, car vous travaillerez dans une variété d'environnements intéressants et vous aurez le contrôle sur votre propre équilibre travail/vie personnelle, car nous croyons que nos gens sont ce qui nous fait réussir.

Nos rôles d'expert en génie vous permettent de développer vos compétences en génie mécanique et de travailler pour un fournisseur d'inspection en génie leader sur le marché.

Zurich Engineering cherche à développer notre équipe hautement qualifiée, basée sur le terrain, Ingénieur Surveyor, et nous avons actuellement un poste vacant pour la région de Castle Donnington pour un LEV (Local Exhaust Ventilation) / Ingénieur Electrique Surveyor.

Que vais-je faire ?

Vous commencerez par notre formation sur mesure, leader de l'industrie, et passerez rapidement à la réalisation d'inspections légales pratiques, fournissant votre avis d'expert sur un large éventail d'équipements, permettant à nos clients de se conformer à toutes les lois pertinentes et aux normes exigeantes que nous et nos clients exigeons. Après votre inspection, nous avons besoin que vous rapportiez à l'aide d'un ordinateur portable robuste, puis de délivrer électroniquement à nos clients, de bonnes compétences en TI et des niveaux élevés de littératie sont nécessaires. Vous serez un excellent communicateur, et confiant dans votre capacité à faire des jugements d'ingénierie solide.

Quelles compétences/qualifications dois-je posséder?

Vous serez un ingénieur expérimenté avec une bonne connaissance de votre discipline d'ingénierie et faites partie de notre équipe d'inspection multidisciplinaire dans votre région géographique. Vous ferez rapport à un gestionnaire d'équipe et serez basé de chez vous, avec votre base de clients à une distance raisonnable de votre domicile.

Parce que ce rôle est régi par SAFEd, nous avons besoin que vous ayez idéalement obtenu:

- Une qualification de niveau 3 dans un domaine d'ingénierie pertinent, un support est disponible pour vous permettre d'obtenir le statut d'Ing tout en travaillant comme nous voulons vous aider à obtenir une adhésion professionnelle.

- Compex qualifié - avantageux

- Une qualification P601 LEV est avantageuse

- Vous aurez terminé, soit un temps servi, soit un apprentissage moderne

- Expérience pratique dans une discipline d'ingénierie pertinente

- Un fond, travaillant avec des pompes et des moteurs - préférable

- Un permis de conduire britannique valide.

- Être disposé et capable de travailler des heures supplémentaires rémunérées.

Qu'obtiendras-tu en retour ?

Tout le monde est différent. C'est pourquoi à Zurich, nous offrons un large éventail d'avantages sociaux afin que nos gens puissent choisir ce qui leur convient et leur vie. Nos avantages offrent une réelle flexibilité afin que nos employés puissent faire des choix réfléchis et adapter leurs avantages tout au long de l'année. Nos prestations comprennent un régime de retraite non contributif défini de 12%, une prime annuelle d'entreprise, une assurance médicale privée et l'option d'acheter jusqu'à 20 jours supplémentaires ou de vendre une partie de vos vacances.

Suivez le lien pour plus d'informations sur nos avantages sociaux - Avantages sociaux

En tant qu'employeur inclusif, nous voulons nous assurer que tous les candidats et candidates se sentent à l'aise et qu'ils sont en mesure de s'acquitter au mieux de leurs fonctions pendant l'entrevue. Vous aurez l'occasion de nous faire part de tout ajustement raisonnable ou soutien pratique nécessaire lorsque vous postulerez.

Qui nous sommes :

À Zurich, nous souhaitons être l'une des entreprises les plus responsables et les plus influentes au monde et le meilleur assureur mondial. Ensemble, nous créons un avenir meilleur pour nos clients, nos gens et notre planète.

Avec plus de 55 000 employés dans plus de 170 pays, vous ressentirez le soutien d'une entreprise forte et stable qui est un acteur de longue date dans le secteur de l'assurance.

Nous avons fait une promesse l'un envers l'autre et envers chaque employé; de nous concentrer sur l'impact durable, de nous soucier de notre bien-être, d'utiliser notre expertise diversifiée pour être curieux et optimiste et de développer les compétences nécessaires à notre avenir.

Si vous êtes intéressé à travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant pour une entreprise qui reconnaît et récompense votre créativité, vos initiatives et vos contributions, Zurich pourrait être l'endroit idéal pour vous. Faites partie de quelque chose de génial.

Notre culture

À Zurich, notre sens de la communauté est fort et nous sommes particulièrement passionnés par la diversité et l'inclusion, pour lesquelles nous avons remporté de nombreux prix. Nous voulons que notre peuple apporte l'ensemble d'eux-mêmes au travail et nous veillons à ce que tout le monde se sente accueilli, quels que soient son origine, ses croyances ou sa culture. Nous voulons que nos employés reflètent la diversité de nos clients, et nous nous engageons donc à traiter tous nos candidats avec équité et respect, indépendamment de leurs antécédents réels ou supposés, de leur handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée.

Nous avons un environnement qui accorde une réelle importance au bien-être de notre population dans une perspective physique, mentale, sociale et financière. Nous travaillons avec nos partenaires bien-être et des experts de l'industrie pour fournir les meilleurs conseils et l'accès à une multitude de soutien de style de vie. Nous sommes également attachés à l'amélioration continue et nous offrons l'accès à une gamme complète de possibilités de formation et de développement.

Nous sommes passionnés de soutenir les employés pour aider les autres en nous engageant dans des activités bénévoles, caritatives et communautaires. Notre bras charitable, Zurich Community Trust, est l'une des fiducies les plus anciennes au Royaume-Uni. À cette époque, nous avons accordé des subventions et du temps bénévole à des causes méritoires au Royaume-Uni, évaluées à plus de 90 millions de livres.

Alors faites une différence. Soyez défiés. Soyez inspiré. Soyez soutenu, aimez ce que vous faites. Travaille pour nous.

- Notre bras charitable, Zurich Community Trust, a accordé des subventions et du temps bénévole à des causes méritantes au Royaume-Uni d'une valeur de plus de 90 millions de livres.

jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for an Underwriting Specialist within the Direct Markets area this person is responsible for managing a portfolio of franchised auto dealer accounts, with accountability for risk selection, pricing, and overall profitability. This role independently evaluates new business and renewal opportunities, assessing exposures, financials, and loss experience to determine appropriate terms and conditions in alignment with underwriting guidelines and business strategy. The Underwriter Specialist partners closely with Sales, Operations, and internal stakeholders to support growth and retention objectives while ensuring disciplined decision-making and accurate documentation. With moderate account complexity and increasing autonomy, this role demonstrates consistent underwriting judgment, identifies referral needs, contributes to team performance, and builds strong relationships with customers and internal partners to drive sustainable portfolio results.

Key Accountabilities of this role:

- Administer and monitor underwriting rules and guidelines, rating manual rules, and insurance laws and regulations.

- Develop, maintain & collaborate with Line of Business representatives and other business-related needs, as appropriate.

- Develop and maintain relationships with distributors (agents & brokers) in support of business retention and acquisition and works with customers and distributors (agents & brokers) to determine their insurance related needs and provide solutions.

- Support the organization's sales culture by being a Help Point for agents, brokers and customers.

- Proactively seek renewal and new account opportunities.

- Complete detailed opportunity assessment with key distributors to identify growth opportunities.

- Qualify accounts to meet with the organization's appetite, balanced with sound business opportunity.

- Make broker/customer and on-sight calls with a planned and well-prepared purpose.

- Mentor team members.

Basic Qualifications:

Underwriting Specialist:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an associate degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an associate degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Strong relationship building skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The proposed Salary range for this position is $75,000.00 - $125,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

- Responsible for the large and complex Financial Lines and Cyber claims portfolio

- Deliver an effective, efficient customer centric claims service in a manner which supports the Purpose, Values and Strategy of Zurich

Job Accountabilities

- Proactively and promptly handle Financial Lines and Cyber claims

- Handle claims within the Zurich Multi-National program

- Collaborate with external legal panel and supply partners

- Collaborate with the Regional and Group Claims teams

- Monitor portfolio performance and ensure proper and timely reserving

- Engage, build and manage internal and external stakeholder and broker relationships and organize regular meetings

- Prepare management or broker reports, presentations and data analytics

- Follow customer specific claims handling protocol and/or customer proposition service charters to ensure that we understand & fulfil the needs and expectations of our customers

- Adhere to company policies, local regulatory and governance requirements throughout the life of the claim to ensure that we make decisions using the right standards

- Assist the Team Head with managerial tasks, reporting and projects

- Engage with internal functions such as Underwriting, Actuarial, Finance

Job Qualifications

- Bachelor degree or above

- Recognized industry standard (e.g. Snr Asso. of ANZIIF)

- 5 years or above experience in the Financial Lines field

- Strong legal knowledge with relevant qualifications

- Extensive experience with all major aspects of the claims adjustment process

- Large and complex claims management skills and handling coverage issues

- Understand local legislation and legal liability

- Understand industry standards and protocol

- Experience of managing broker relationships

- Proficient in written & spoken English and Chinese (including Cantonese and/or Mandarin)

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

- Location(s): HK - Hong Kong

- Remote working: Hybrid

Qualifications professionnelles

- Baccalauréat ou supérieur

- Norme reconnue de l'industrie (p. ex. Snr Asso. d'ANZIIF)

- Comprendre les normes et le protocole de l'industrie

- Expérience de la gestion des relations de courtage

- Maîtrise de l'anglais et du chinois (y compris le cantonais et/ou le mandarin)

Pourquoi Zurich

À Zurich, nous aimons penser en dehors de la boîte et défier le statu quo. Nous adoptons une approche optimiste en nous concentrant sur les positifs et nous demandons constamment ce qui peut aller bien?

Nous sommes un employeur à chances égales qui sait que chaque employé est unique - c'est ce qui rend notre équipe si géniale!

A Zurigo riviviamo l'assicurazione. Al fine di soddisfare i desideri dei nostri clienti ancora meglio, andiamo nuovi modi, pensare creativamente, lavorare agile. La nostra cultura aziendale vi dà maggiore flessibilità in ogni aspetto – e molta libertà di sviluppare in modo ottimale. Pensate grande – e anche a livello internazionale! Perché le tue possibilità di sviluppo non conoscono limiti con noi. Pronto a prendere il futuro in mano?

- Nel vostro ruolo nella sede di Colonia, progettate, progettate e implementate campagne di stampa e digitale, nonché i viaggi dei clienti nel segmento clienti esistente per i clienti privati e aziendali, incluso il supporto professionale per l'identificazione e la selezione del gruppo target.

Lo porti con te.

- Studi tecnici o universitari in assicurazione, marketing o amministrazione aziendale

- affinità tecnica e conoscenza ideale delle soluzioni di automazione di marketing (ad esempio Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights)

- Forte comprensione analitica delle cifre, in particolare indicatori economici

- Buone capacità di gestione del progetto e gestione sicura di MS Office, in particolare Excel e PowerPoint

- Molto buone capacità di comunicazione e l'esperienza nella collaborazione trasversale

Termine temporaneo: Il post è limitato fino al 31.12.2027.

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

- Forme di lavoro flessibili per un equilibrio ottimale tra lavoro e casa

- Supporto nella pianificazione della tua carriera - da un'analisi potenziale alla promozione individuale

- Un ambiente di lavoro moderno, aperto e trasparente che promuove la creatività e la collaborazione cross-team

- Che si tratti di fitness nel gruppo sul sito o di formazione di consapevolezza virtuale da casa: La nostra vasta gamma di servizi sanitari supporta un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa

- Leasing bici, biglietto Germania scontato, servizi di asset-generazione, un programma azionario dei dipendenti e altri grandi vantaggi

A seconda delle esigenze individuali di lavoro e dell'idoneità personale, il gruppo di Zurigo Germania sostiene generalmente sia il lavoro flessibile che quello part-time. Se siete interessati a questo punto e la vostra situazione personale non corrisponde abbastanza all'importo specificato (completo e part-time), si prega di contattarci ( marisa.schell@zurich.com) per discutere le possibilità potenziali.

- Luogo di lavoro: Colonia

- Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: a tempo pieno

55.000 colleghi in 2515 paesi e territori. Insieme sulla strada per ripensare l'assicurazione ogni giorno – e per modellare il futuro per tutti. Benvenuto in una comunità forte dove ti trasferisci dall'inizio. Insieme continuiamo a svilupparci!

Are you ready to count on the best?

At Zurich we are re-living insurance. In order to fulfill the wishes of our customers even better, we go new ways, think creatively, work agile. Our corporate culture gives you more flexibility in every respect – and a lot of freedom to develop optimally. Think big – and also internationally! Because your development possibilities know no limits with us. Ready to take the future in hand?

This is what awaits you

- In your role at the Cologne location, you plan, design and implement print and digital campaigns as well as customer journeys in the existing customer segment for private and corporate customers – including professional support for target group identification and selection.

- You coordinate campaigns and customer journeys closely with internal stakeholders such as Legal, Brand and Sales

- Campaign reporting and controlling including budget responsibility are also part of your area of responsibility

- You create and control campaigns and customer journeys in our marketing automation solution (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights)

- You identify new lead sources in the private and corporate customer segment with a focus on inventory expansion and security, coordinate relevant interfaces (especially website) and actively participate in the further development of our marketing and lead strategy

You bring that with you

- Technical or university studies in insurance, marketing or business administration

- Technical affinity and ideally first knowledge of marketing automation solutions (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights)

- Strong analytical understanding of figures, in particular economic indicators

- Good project management skills as well as safe handling of MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint

- Very good communication skills and experience in cross-sector collaboration

Temporary term: The post is limited until 31.12.2027.

This is what we offer you

- Flexible forms of work for an optimal balance between work at work and from home

- Numerous training and learning opportunities to stay fit for everyday work and enable individual development

- Support in your career planning - from potential analysis to individual promotion

- A modern, open and transparent work environment that promotes creativity and cross-team collaboration

- Whether fitness in the group on site or virtual mindfulness training from home: Our diverse range of health services supports a healthy work-life balance

- Bike leasing, discounted Germany ticket, asset-generating services, an employee share program and other great benefits

Z additional information

Depending on the individual job requirements and personal suitability, the Zurich Group Germany generally supports both flexible and part-time work. If you are interested at this point and your personal situation does not quite match the specified amount (full and part-time), please contact us ( marisa.schell@zurich.com ) to discuss the potential possibilities.

- Place of work: Cologne

- Part-time or full-time: full-time

55,000 colleagues in 215 countries and territories. Together on the way to rethink insurance every day – and to shape the future for everyone. Welcome to a strong community where you move from the beginning. Together we continue to develop!

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
We Are Waiting for You

Hi there!

I am Laura , the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you!

First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center : The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich !

First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions.

If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale.

What Can You Expect?

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help build, operate, and improve the internal platform services that our teams rely on every day. You will work on the foundation layer: the tooling, automation, and infrastructure that make it easier for others to deliver their own products safely and efficiently.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will spend most of your time designing and automating backend processes, improving reliability, and removing manual work from the way the platform is run.

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked.

As a Senior Platform Engineer you will have the opportunity to:

- Design, build, and maintain platform services and the automation around them

- Develop backend automations that replace manual, repetitive operational tasks

- Improve deployment, provisioning, and configuration processes so they are repeatable and self-service

- Monitor platform health and contribute to reliability, performance, and cost improvements

- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand their needs and translate them into platform capabilities

- Document what you build so others can use and extend it

- Work alongside experts in various technological domains.

- Enhance your skills with real-world experience

- Contribute to a team that values your input and creativity

What Makes You a great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you!

- Solid engineering fundamentals: you can reason about systems, not just configure tools

- Practical experience automating backend processes end to end, from design to production

- Comfort working in cloud environments and with infrastructure managed as code

- Ability to write clean, maintainable scripts and services in at least one general-purpose language

- A pragmatic mindset: you prefer simple, robust solutions over clever ones

- Clear communication and the ability to work across teams

- Fluent English and Spanish

- Nice to have

- Experience supporting internal platforms used by multiple teams

- Exposure to data-intensive or regulated environments

- Experience improving developer or user self-service experiences

How we assess

We care about how you think and work, not how well your CV matches a keyword list. The selection process includes a practical exercise where you will walk us through a real automation or platform problem you have solved.

And… What Makes Us Special?

As well as a competitive salary and a yearly bonus , we offer:

- To support your work-life balance, we have adopted a flexible working model.

- Option to work abroad up to 25 days yearly.

- Over 300 euros to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowance.

- Wide range of internal and external trainings, including English, German and Spanish classes depending on the needs.

- Ticket restaurant and Health Insurance with the flexibility to exchange it for other benefits.

- Life and accident insurance.

- Collective Life retirement Plan

- 2000 referral bonus if you bring other talented people like you to the company.

- Special banking and insurance conditions plus Exclusive Employees discounts

- Functional diversity benefits

- Stock options and mortgage benefits.

Where Are We Located?

Barcelona, Poblenou.

Can you see yourself in this role? Don’t wait any longer! Apply by sending your CV in English .

If not, no worries! We’ll meet again in the future. Feel free to share my contact details with anyone you think would be a great fit.

At Zurich, we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best-qualified individuals available, regardless of race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

Zurich Technology Delivery Center – Your Talent, Our Strength

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

- Location(s): ES - Barcelona

- Remote working: Hybrid
