First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center : The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich !

First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions.

If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale.

What Can You Expect?

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help build, operate, and improve the internal platform services that our teams rely on every day. You will work on the foundation layer: the tooling, automation, and infrastructure that make it easier for others to deliver their own products safely and efficiently.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will spend most of your time designing and automating backend processes, improving reliability, and removing manual work from the way the platform is run.

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked.

As a Senior Platform Engineer you will have the opportunity to:

- Design, build, and maintain platform services and the automation around them

- Develop backend automations that replace manual, repetitive operational tasks

- Improve deployment, provisioning, and configuration processes so they are repeatable and self-service

- Monitor platform health and contribute to reliability, performance, and cost improvements

- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand their needs and translate them into platform capabilities

- Document what you build so others can use and extend it

- Work alongside experts in various technological domains.

- Enhance your skills with real-world experience

- Contribute to a team that values your input and creativity

What Makes You a great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you!

- Solid engineering fundamentals: you can reason about systems, not just configure tools

- Practical experience automating backend processes end to end, from design to production

- Comfort working in cloud environments and with infrastructure managed as code

- Ability to write clean, maintainable scripts and services in at least one general-purpose language

- A pragmatic mindset: you prefer simple, robust solutions over clever ones

- Clear communication and the ability to work across teams

- Fluent English and Spanish

- Nice to have

- Experience supporting internal platforms used by multiple teams

- Exposure to data-intensive or regulated environments

- Experience improving developer or user self-service experiences

How we assess

We care about how you think and work, not how well your CV matches a keyword list. The selection process includes a practical exercise where you will walk us through a real automation or platform problem you have solved.

And… What Makes Us Special?

As well as a competitive salary and a yearly bonus , we offer:

- To support your work-life balance, we have adopted a flexible working model.

- Option to work abroad up to 25 days yearly.

- Over 300 euros to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowance.

- Wide range of internal and external trainings, including English, German and Spanish classes depending on the needs.

- Ticket restaurant and Health Insurance with the flexibility to exchange it for other benefits.

- Life and accident insurance.

- Collective Life retirement Plan

- 2000 referral bonus if you bring other talented people like you to the company.

- Special banking and insurance conditions plus Exclusive Employees discounts

- Functional diversity benefits

- Stock options and mortgage benefits.

Where Are We Located?

Barcelona, Poblenou.

Can you see yourself in this role? Don’t wait any longer! Apply by sending your CV in English .

If not, no worries! We’ll meet again in the future. Feel free to share my contact details with anyone you think would be a great fit.

At Zurich, we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best-qualified individuals available, regardless of race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

Zurich Technology Delivery Center – Your Talent, Our Strength

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

Barcelona, Poblenou.

Bist du bereit, mit dem Besten zu rechnen ?

Bei Zurich leben wir Versicherung neu. Um die Wünsche unserer Kunden noch besser zu erfüllen, gehen wir neue Wege, denken kreativ, arbeiten agil. Unsere Unternehmenskultur schenkt dir in jeder Hinsicht mehr Flexibilität – und viel Freiraum, dich optimal zu entfalten. Think big – und gerne auch international! Denn deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten kennen bei uns keine Grenzen. Bereit, die Zukunft in die Hand zu nehmen?

Das erwartet dich

- Am Standort Köln entwickelst und konfigurierst du unsere Input-Management-Plattform kontinuierlich weiter und integrierst diese in bestehende Systemlandschaften

- Du gestaltest aktiv die Zukunft der intelligenten Dokumentenverarbeitung bei Zurich und evaluierst sowie implementierst moderne KI-Technologien für produktive Dokumentenprozesse

- Dabei optimierst du KI-gestützte Verfahren zur Dokumentenklassifikation, Informationsextraktion und Automatisierung dokumentenbasierter Prozesse

- Mit deinem Know-how entwickelst und pflegst du Skripte sowie technische Erweiterungen (z. B. in Python oder C++) zur Unterstützung und Automatisierung von Prozessen

- Du analysierst und verarbeitest strukturierte Datenformate und Schnittstellen (z. B. XML, JSON, CSV, APIs) und stellst deren reibungslose Nutzung sicher

- In produktiven Workflows identifizierst du Fehler, analysierst Ursachen und stellst den stabilen Betrieb sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Plattform sicher

- Du arbeitest eng mit Prozessspezialist:innen, Fachbereichen, agilen Trains, externen Dienstleister:innen und der IT zusammen

Das bringst du mit

- Praktische Erfahrung in der technischen Implementierung, Konfiguration oder Weiterentwicklung von Inputmanagement- bzw. Intelligent-Document-Processing-Plattformen (z.B. DocProStar, SmartFix, Kofax, ABBYY oder e-flow)

- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python zur Entwicklung technischer Erweiterungen und Automatisierungen; idealerweise bringst du zusätzlich Erfahrung in C++ mit

- Sicherer Umgang mit strukturierten Datenformaten und -transformationen (XML, JSON, CSV, Regex)

- Erfahrung in der technischen Integration von Systemen über APIs, Webservices und Datenbanken

- Idealerweise Erfahrung im Umfeld OCR, Dokumentenklassifikation oder der Automatisierung dokumentenbasierter Prozesse

- Analytische Denkweise und Freude an der Lösung komplexer technischer Fragestellungen

- Kommunikationsstärke sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams – kombiniert mit einer eigenständigen und strukturierten Arbeitsweise

- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

Das bieten wir dir

- Flexible Arbeitsformen für eine optimale Balance zwischen Arbeiten am Arbeitsplatz und von zu Hause aus

- Zahlreiche Trainings- und Lernangebote, um fit für den Arbeitsalltag zu bleiben und eine individuelle Weiterentwicklung zu ermöglichen

- Unterstützung bei deiner Karriereplanung - von der Potenzialanalyse bis hin zur individuellen Förderung

- Eine moderne, offene und transparente Arbeitsumgebung, die Kreativität und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit fördert

- Ob Fitness in der Gruppe vor Ort oder virtuelles Achtsamkeitstraining von zu Hause: Unser vielfältiges Gesundheitsangebot unterstützt eine gesunde Work ‑ Life ‑ Balance

- Bikeleasing, vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, ein Mitarbeitenden ‑ Aktienprogramm und weitere tolle Benefits

Z usätzliche Informationen

Die Zurich Gruppe Deutschland unterstützt in Abhängigkeit zur individuellen Stellenanforderung und der persönlichen Eignung grundsätzlich sowohl flexible als auch Teilzeit-Arbeitsformen. Wenn du Interesse an dieser Stelle hast und deine persönliche Situation nicht ganz mit dem angegebenen Pensum (Voll- und Teilzeit) zusammenpasst, wende dich gerne an uns ( elif.yabas@zurich.com ), um die potenziellen Möglichkeiten zu besprechen.

- Arbeitsort: Köln

- Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: Vollzeit

Elif Yabas freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellungen und des möglichen Starttermins über das Karriereportal (“Jetzt Bewerben”-Button). Leider können wir Bewerbungen per E-Mail nicht berücksichtigen.

Willkommen in deiner Zukunft

55.000 Kolleginnen und Kollegen in 215 Ländern und Gebieten. Gemeinsam auf dem Weg, Versicherung jeden Tag neu zu denken – und die Zukunft für alle zu gestalten. Willkommen in einer starken Gemeinschaft, in der du von Anfang an etwas bewegst. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir uns weiter!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei pronto a contare sul meglio?

A Zurigo riviviamo l'assicurazione. Al fine di soddisfare i desideri dei nostri clienti ancora meglio, andiamo nuovi modi, pensare creativamente, lavorare agile. La nostra cultura aziendale vi dà maggiore flessibilità in ogni aspetto – e molta libertà di sviluppare in modo ottimale. Pensate grande – e anche a livello internazionale! Perché le tue possibilità di sviluppo non conoscono limiti con noi. Pronto a prendere il futuro in mano?

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

- Nella posizione di Colonia, svilupperai e configura la nostra piattaforma di gestione degli input e la integrerai in paesaggi di sistema esistenti

- Formate attivamente il futuro della elaborazione intelligente dei documenti a Zurigo e valutate e implementate le moderne tecnologie AI per i processi produttivi dei documenti

- Ottimizzare i metodi basati su AI per la classificazione dei documenti, l'estrazione delle informazioni e l'automazione dei processi basati sui documenti.

- Con il tuo know-how, sviluppi e mantieni script e miglioramenti tecnici (ad esempio in Python o C++) per supportare e automatizzare i processi.

- Analizzi e tratti formati e interfacce di dati strutturati (ad esempio XML, JSON, CSV, API) e garantisci il loro uso regolare

- Nei flussi di lavoro produttivi, si identificano errori, analizzano cause e garantiscono un funzionamento stabile e uno sviluppo continuo della piattaforma.

- Lavori a stretto contatto con specialisti di processo: interno, reparti, treni agili, fornitori di servizi esterni: interno e IT

Lo porti con te.

- Esperienza pratica nell'implementazione tecnica, configurazione o ulteriore sviluppo di piattaforme di elaborazione di documenti intelligenti (ad esempio DocProStar, SmartFix, Kofax, ABBYY o e-flow)

- Ottima conoscenza in Python per sviluppare miglioramenti tecnici e automazione; Idealmente, si porta un'esperienza aggiuntiva in C++

- Gestione sicura dei formati e delle trasformazioni di dati strutturati (XML, JSON, CSV, Regex)

- Esperienza nell'integrazione tecnica dei sistemi tramite API, servizi web e database

- Idealmente, l'esperienza nel campo dell'OCR, la classificazione dei documenti o l'automazione dei processi basati sui documenti

- Il pensiero analitico e il piacere di risolvere complessi problemi tecnici

- La forza della comunicazione e il godimento di lavorare insieme in team interdisciplinari – uniti a un modo di lavoro indipendente e strutturato

- Laurea completa in informatica, informatica aziendale o una qualifica comparabile

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

- Forme di lavoro flessibili per un equilibrio ottimale tra lavoro e casa

- Numerose opportunità di formazione e apprendimento per rimanere in forma per il lavoro quotidiano e consentire lo sviluppo individuale

- Supporto nella pianificazione della tua carriera - da un'analisi potenziale alla promozione individuale

- Un ambiente di lavoro moderno, aperto e trasparente che promuove la creatività e la collaborazione cross-team

- Che si tratti di fitness nel gruppo sul sito o di formazione di consapevolezza virtuale da casa: La nostra vasta gamma di servizi sanitari supporta un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa

- Leasing bici, biglietto Germania scontato, servizi di asset-generazione, un programma azionario dei dipendenti e altri grandi vantaggi

Z informazioni aggiuntive

A seconda delle esigenze individuali di lavoro e dell'idoneità personale, il gruppo di Zurigo Germania sostiene generalmente sia il lavoro flessibile che quello part-time. Se siete interessati a questo punto e la vostra situazione personale non corrisponde abbastanza all'importo specificato (completo e part-time), si prega di contattarci (elif.yabas@zurich.com) per discutere le potenziali possibilità.

- Luogo di lavoro: Colonia

- Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: a tempo pieno

Elif Yabas non vede l'ora di presentare i tuoi documenti di applicazione con le tue aspettative di stipendio e la possibile data di inizio tramite il portale di carriera (“Applica ora” pulsante). Purtroppo non possiamo considerare le applicazioni via e-mail.

Benvenuti nel vostro futuro

55.000 colleghi in 2515 paesi e territori. Insieme sulla strada per ripensare l'assicurazione ogni giorno – e per modellare il futuro per tutti. Benvenuto in una comunità forte dove ti trasferisci dall'inizio. Insieme continuiamo a svilupparci!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you ready to count on the best?

At Zurich we are re-living insurance. In order to fulfill the wishes of our customers even better, we go new ways, think creatively, work agile. Our corporate culture gives you more flexibility in every respect – and a lot of freedom to develop optimally. Think big – and also internationally! Because your development possibilities know no limits with us. Ready to take the future in hand?

This is what awaits you

- At the Cologne location, you will continuously develop and configure our input management platform and integrate it into existing system landscapes

- You actively shape the future of intelligent document processing at Zurich and evaluate and implement modern AI technologies for productive document processes

- You will optimize AI-based methods for document classification, information extraction and automation of document-based processes.

- With your know-how, you develop and maintain scripts and technical enhancements (e.g. in Python or C++) to support and automate processes.

- You analyze and process structured data formats and interfaces (e.g. XML, JSON, CSV, APIs) and ensure their smooth use

- In productive workflows, you identify errors, analyze causes and ensure stable operation and continuous development of the platform.

- You work closely with process specialists: inside, departments, agile trains, external service providers: inside and IT

You bring that with you

- Practical experience in the technical implementation, configuration or further development of input management Intelligent document processing platforms (e.g. DocProStar, SmartFix, Kofax, ABBYY or e-flow)

- Very good knowledge in Python to develop technical enhancements and automations; Ideally, you bring additional experience in C++

- Secure handling of structured data formats and transformations (XML, JSON, CSV, Regex)

- Experience in technical integration of systems via APIs, web services and databases

- Ideally, experience in the field of OCR, document classification or the automation of document-based processes

- Analytical thinking and pleasure in solving complex technical problems

- Strength of communication and enjoyment of working together in interdisciplinary teams – combined with an independent and structured way of working

- Completed degree in computer science, business informatics or a comparable qualification

This is what we offer you

- Flexible forms of work for an optimal balance between work at work and from home

- Numerous training and learning opportunities to stay fit for everyday work and enable individual development

- Support in your career planning - from potential analysis to individual promotion

- A modern, open and transparent work environment that promotes creativity and cross-team collaboration

- Whether fitness in the group on site or virtual mindfulness training from home: Our diverse range of health services supports a healthy work-life balance

- Bike leasing, discounted Germany ticket, asset-generating services, an employee share program and other great benefits

Z additional information

Depending on the individual job requirements and personal suitability, the Zurich Group Germany generally supports both flexible and part-time work. If you are interested at this point and your personal situation does not quite match the specified amount (full and part-time), please contact us (elif.yabas@zurich.com ) to discuss the potential possibilities.

- Place of work: Cologne

- Part-time or full-time: full-time

Elif Yabas is looking forward to your application documents with your salary expectations and the possible start date via the career portal (“Apply now” button). Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications by e-mail.

Welcome to your future

55,000 colleagues in 215 countries and territories. Together on the way to rethink insurance every day – and to shape the future for everyone. Welcome to a strong community where you move from the beginning. Together we continue to develop!

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous prêt à compter sur le meilleur ?

À Zurich, nous revivons l'assurance. Afin de satisfaire encore mieux les souhaits de nos clients, nous allons de nouvelles façons, pensons créativement, travail agile. Notre culture d'entreprise vous donne plus de flexibilité à tous égards – et beaucoup de liberté pour se développer de manière optimale. Pensez grand – et aussi international! Parce que vos possibilités de développement ne connaissent aucune limite avec nous. Prêt à prendre le futur en main ?

C'est ce qui vous attend

- Sur le site de Cologne, vous développerez et configurerez en permanence notre plateforme de gestion des entrées et l'intégrerez dans les paysages système existants.

- Vous façonnez activement l'avenir du traitement intelligent des documents à Zurich et évaluez et implémentez les technologies modernes d'IA pour les processus de documents productifs

- Vous optimiserez les méthodes basées sur l'IA pour la classification des documents, l'extraction de l'information et l'automatisation des processus basés sur les documents.

- Avec votre savoir-faire, vous développez et maintenez des scripts et des améliorations techniques (par exemple dans Python ou C++) pour prendre en charge et automatiser les processus.

- Vous analysez et traitez les formats de données structurés et les interfaces (p. ex. XML, JSON, CSV, API) et assurez leur utilisation en douceur

- Dans les workflows productifs, vous identifiez les erreurs, analysez les causes et assurez un fonctionnement stable et un développement continu de la plateforme.

- Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des spécialistes des processus : à l'intérieur, des départements, des trains agiles, des prestataires de services externes : à l'intérieur et à l'informatique

Apporte ça avec toi.

- Expérience pratique dans la mise en œuvre technique, la configuration ou le développement ultérieur de la gestion des entrées Plates-formes intelligentes de traitement de documents (par exemple DocProStar, SmartFix, Kofax, ABBYY ou e-flow)

- Très bonne connaissance en Python pour développer des améliorations techniques et des automatisations; Idéalement, vous apportez une expérience supplémentaire en C++

- Gestion sécurisée des formats de données structurés et des transformations (XML, JSON, CSV, Regex)

- Expérience de l'intégration technique des systèmes via les API, les services web et les bases de données

- Idéalement, l'expérience dans le domaine de la ROC, de la classification des documents ou de l'automatisation des processus fondés sur des documents

- Pensée analytique et plaisir à résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes

- La force de la communication et la jouissance de travailler ensemble au sein d'équipes interdisciplinaires – associées à une manière de travailler indépendante et structurée

- Diplôme d'informatique, d'informatique commerciale ou d'une qualification comparable

C'est ce que nous vous offrons.

- Formes flexibles de travail pour un équilibre optimal entre travail au travail et travail à domicile

- De nombreuses possibilités de formation et d'apprentissage pour rester apte au travail quotidien et permettre le développement individuel

- Soutien dans votre planification de carrière - de l'analyse potentielle à la promotion individuelle

- Un environnement de travail moderne, ouvert et transparent qui favorise la créativité et la collaboration entre les équipes

- Que ce soit la forme physique dans le groupe sur place ou la formation de pleine conscience virtuelle de la maison: Notre gamme diversifiée de services de santé favorise un équilibre sain entre le travail et la vie personnelle

- Location de vélos, billet Allemagne à prix réduit, services générateurs d'actifs, un programme d'actionnariat salarié et d'autres grands avantages

Z Informations supplémentaires

En fonction des exigences de l'emploi et des qualités personnelles, le groupe de Zurich Allemagne soutient généralement le travail flexible et à temps partiel. Si vous êtes intéressé à ce point et que votre situation personnelle ne correspond pas tout à fait au montant spécifié (à temps plein et à temps partiel), veuillez nous contacter (elif.yabas@zurich.com ) pour discuter des possibilités potentielles.

- Lieu de travail: Cologne

- Temps partiel ou temps plein: temps plein

Elif Yabas attend avec impatience vos documents de candidature avec vos attentes salariales et la date de début possible via le portail de carrière (Appliquer maintenant). Malheureusement, nous ne pouvons pas examiner les demandes par courriel.

Bienvenue dans votre futur

55 000 collègues dans 215 pays et territoires. Ensemble sur la voie de repenser l'assurance chaque jour – et de façonner l'avenir pour tous. Bienvenue dans une communauté forte où vous déménagez depuis le début. Ensemble, nous continuons à nous développer!

Sintesi del lavoro

Elabora le richieste dei clienti (sia tramite una telefonata o una richiesta scritta) per soddisfare le aspettative dei loro clienti fornendo un servizio leader di mercato e mantenendo eccellenti relazioni con i clienti.

Capacità di lavoro - Capacità di contabilità chiave

- Imposta e raggiunge gli obiettivi per mantenere la produttività, l'efficienza e gli standard di qualità.

- Essi soddisfano i requisiti dei loro clienti, costruiscono e mantengono eccellenti relazioni con i clienti attraverso l'elaborazione di una serie di compiti e servizi, dimostrando al contempo la conoscenza di sistemi, prodotti, processi e procedure pertinenti.

- Contribuiscono a una cultura positiva e solidale del team, e dimostrano una chiara adesione al focus del cliente, lavorano in collaborazione in tutte le aree operative.

- Si assumono la responsabilità personale per risolvere query di base da clienti e agenti. Aiutano a identificare e a portare avanti opportunità di miglioramento continuo.

Sei il cuore e l'anima di Zurigo!

A Zurigo, ci piace pensare al di fuori della scatola e sfidare lo status quo. Prendiamo un approccio ottimista concentrandoci sui positivi e chiedendo costantemente cosa può andare bene?

Apprezziamo molto l'esperienza e il know-how dei nostri dipendenti e offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità tra le aree di business per incoraggiarti a richiedere nuove opportunità all'interno di Zurigo quando sei pronto per il tuo prossimo passo di carriera.

Continuiamo a crescere insieme!

jobs.title: Business Analyst Document Operations German fluent (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bist du bereit, mit dem Besten zu rechnen ?

Bei Zurich leben wir Versicherung neu. Um die Wünsche unserer Kunden noch besser zu erfüllen, gehen wir neue Wege, denken kreativ, arbeiten agil. Unsere Unternehmenskultur schenkt dir in jeder Hinsicht mehr Flexibilität – und viel Freiraum, dich optimal zu entfalten. Think big – und gerne auch international! Denn deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten kennen bei uns keine Grenzen. Bereit, die Zukunft in die Hand zu nehmen?

Das erwartet dich

- Am Standort Köln wirkst du aktiv an der strategischen und operativen Weiterentwicklung des Input- und Output Managements im Konzern mit und bringst innovative Impulse zur Weiterentwicklung des Dokumentenmanagements ein

- Du analysierst, modellierst und optimierst End-to-End-Prozesse im Dokumentenmanagement (Input & Output) - von eingehenden Dokumenten über Verarbeitung, Klassifizierung und Fachdatenextraktion bis hin zu Versand- und Kommunikationsprozessen

- Du schaffst Transparenz über Dokumenten-, Informations- und Kommunikationsflüsse und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungs-, Standardisierungs- und Digitalisierungspotenziale ab

- Für die IT, Plattformen und externe Dienstleister übersetzt du fachliche Anforderungen in strukturierte Konzepte, User Stories, Entscheidungsvorlagen und umsetzbare Lösungen

- Du begleitest die fachliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Input-Management-Plattform sowie relevanter Lösungen im Output Management und unterstützt deren Implementierung aus Business-Sicht

- Du moderierst Workshops, strukturierst Anforderungen unterschiedlicher Stakeholder und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Plattformverantwortliche und Dienstleister zusammen, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen

Das bringst du mit

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium mit wirtschaftswissenschaftlicher, technischer, informationswissenschaftlicher oder vergleichbarer Ausrichtung

- Erfahrung in Business Analyse, Prozessmanagement, Projektarbeit oder der fachlichen Begleitung von Digitalisierungs- und IT-/Plattformvorhaben

- Verständnis für End-to-End-Prozesse, idealerweise im Input Management, Output Management oder vergleichbaren Operations-/Serviceprozessen

- Fähigkeit zur Analyse, Modellierung und Visualisierung komplexer End-to-End-Prozesse, Datenflüsse und fachlicher Anforderungen sowie deren Übersetzung in tragfähige Soll-Konzepte

- Ausgeprägte analytische Stärke sowie gutes Verständnis für Daten, Kennzahlen, Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungspotenziale

- Kommunikations- und Moderationsstärke in der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, IT und Dienstleistern

- Strukturierte, eigenständige und umsetzungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Das bieten wir dir

- Flexible Arbeitsformen für eine optimale Balance zwischen Arbeiten am Arbeitsplatz und von zu Hause aus

- Zahlreiche Trainings- und Lernangebote, um fit für den Arbeitsalltag zu bleiben und eine individuelle Weiterentwicklung zu ermöglichen

- Unterstützung bei deiner Karriereplanung - von der Potenzialanalyse bis hin zur individuellen Förderung

- Eine moderne, offene und transparente Arbeitsumgebung, die Kreativität und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit fördert

- Ob Fitness in der Gruppe vor Ort oder virtuelles Achtsamkeitstraining von zu Hause: Unser vielfältiges Gesundheitsangebot unterstützt eine gesunde Work ‑ Life ‑ Balance

- Bikeleasing, vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, ein Mitarbeitenden ‑ Aktienprogramm und weitere tolle Benefits

Z usätzliche Informationen

Die Zurich Gruppe Deutschland unterstützt in Abhängigkeit zur individuellen Stellenanforderung und der persönlichen Eignung grundsätzlich sowohl flexible als auch Teilzeit-Arbeitsformen. Wenn du Interesse an dieser Stelle hast und deine persönliche Situation nicht ganz mit dem angegebenen Pensum (Voll- und Teilzeit) zusammenpasst, wende dich gerne an uns ( elif.yabas@zurich.com ), um die potenziellen Möglichkeiten zu besprechen.

- Arbeitsort: Köln

- Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: Vollzeit

Elif Yabas freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellungen und des möglichen Starttermins über das Karriereportal (“Jetzt Bewerben”-Button). Leider können wir Bewerbungen per E-Mail nicht berücksichtigen.

Willkommen in deiner Zukunft

55.000 Kolleginnen und Kollegen in 215 Ländern und Gebieten. Gemeinsam auf dem Weg, Versicherung jeden Tag neu zu denken – und die Zukunft für alle zu gestalten. Willkommen in einer starken Gemeinschaft, in der du von Anfang an etwas bewegst. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir uns weiter!

Sei pronto a contare sul meglio?

A Zurigo riviviamo l'assicurazione. Al fine di soddisfare i desideri dei nostri clienti ancora meglio, andiamo nuovi modi, pensare creativamente, lavorare agile. La nostra cultura aziendale vi dà maggiore flessibilità in ogni aspetto – e molta libertà di sviluppare in modo ottimale. Pensate grande – e anche a livello internazionale! Perché le tue possibilità di sviluppo non conoscono limiti con noi. Pronto a prendere il futuro in mano?

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

- Presso la sede di Colonia, parteciperai attivamente allo sviluppo strategico e operativo della gestione degli input e dell'output del Gruppo e contribuirai ad impulsi innovativi per l'ulteriore sviluppo della gestione dei documenti.

- Analizzerai, modella e ottimizza i processi end-to-end nella gestione dei documenti (input & output) - dai documenti in arrivo al trattamento, alla classificazione e all'estrazione dei dati specialistici ai processi di spedizione e comunicazione

- Elimina la trasparenza sui flussi di documento, informazione e comunicazione e deriva dai potenziali di ottimizzazione, standardizzazione e digitalizzazione concreti.

- Per IT, piattaforme e fornitori di servizi esterni, traduci i requisiti professionali in concetti strutturati, storie utente, modelli decisionali e soluzioni implementabili

- Potrai accompagnare lo sviluppo professionale della nostra piattaforma di gestione degli input e le soluzioni rilevanti nella gestione dell'output e supportare la loro implementazione da un punto di vista aziendale.

- Hai moderato workshop, requisiti di struttura di diversi stakeholder e unisci aree specialistiche, IT, Platform Manager e fornitori di servizi per raggiungere obiettivi comuni

Lo porti con te.

- Studi con successo completati con un orientamento economico, tecnico, informativo o comparabile

- Esperienza nell'analisi aziendale, nella gestione dei processi, nel lavoro di progetto o nel supporto professionale dei progetti di digitalizzazione e IT/platform

- Comprendere i processi end-to-end, idealmente nella gestione degli input, nella gestione dell'output o nei processi operativi/servizio comparabili

- Capacità di analizzare, modellare e visualizzare complessi processi end-to-end, flussi di dati e requisiti tecnici, nonché la loro traduzione in concetti di destinazione

- Forte forza analitica e una buona comprensione dei dati, delle figure chiave, del potenziale di automazione e digitalizzazione

- Resistenza alla comunicazione e alla moderazione in collaborazione con settori specializzati, IT e fornitori di servizi

- Metodo di lavoro strutturato, indipendente e orientato all'attuazione

- Tedeschi a prova di negoziazione e buone competenze in inglese

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

- Forme di lavoro flessibili per un equilibrio ottimale tra lavoro e casa

- Numerose opportunità di formazione e apprendimento per rimanere in forma per il lavoro quotidiano e consentire lo sviluppo individuale

- Supporto nella pianificazione della tua carriera - da un'analisi potenziale alla promozione individuale

- Un ambiente di lavoro moderno, aperto e trasparente che promuove la creatività e la collaborazione cross-team

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you ready to count on the best?

At Zurich we are re-living insurance. In order to fulfill the wishes of our customers even better, we go new ways, think creatively, work agile. Our corporate culture gives you more flexibility in every respect – and a lot of freedom to develop optimally. Think big – and also internationally! Because your development possibilities know no limits with us. Ready to take the future in hand?

This is what awaits you

- At the Cologne location, you will actively participate in the strategic and operational development of input and output management in the Group and contribute innovative impulses to the further development of document management.

- You will analyze, model and optimize end-to-end processes in document management (input & output) - from incoming documents to processing, classification and specialist data extraction to shipping and communication processes

- You eliminate transparency about document, information and communication flows and derive concrete optimization, standardization and digitalization potentials from this

- For IT, platforms and external service providers, you translate professional requirements into structured concepts, user stories, decision templates and implementable solutions

- You will accompany the professional development of our input management platform as well as relevant solutions in output management and support their implementation from a business perspective.

- You moderate workshops, structure requirements of different stakeholders and bring together specialist areas, IT, platform managers and service providers to achieve common goals

You bring that with you

- Successfully completed studies with an economic, technical, information science or comparable orientation

- Experience in business analysis, process management, project work or the professional support of digitization and IT/platform projects

- Understanding end-to-end processes, ideally in input management, output management or comparable operations/service processes

- Ability to analyse, model and visualise complex end-to-end processes, data flows and technical requirements as well as their translation into viable target concepts

- Strong analytical strength as well as a good understanding of data, key figures, automation and digitalization potential

- Communication and moderation strength in cooperation with specialist areas, IT and service providers

- Structured, independent and implementation-oriented working method

- Negotiation-proof German and good English skills

This is what we offer you

- Flexible forms of work for an optimal balance between work at work and from home

- Numerous training and learning opportunities to stay fit for everyday work and enable individual development

- Support in your career planning - from potential analysis to individual promotion

- A modern, open and transparent work environment that promotes creativity and cross-team collaboration

- Whether fitness in the group on site or virtual mindfulness training from home: Our diverse range of health services supports a healthy work-life balance

- Bike leasing, discounted Germany ticket, asset-generating services, an employee share program and other great benefits

Z additional information

Depending on the individual job requirements and personal suitability, the Zurich Group Germany generally supports both flexible and part-time work. If you are interested at this point and your personal situation does not quite match the specified amount (full and part-time), please contact us (elif.yabas@zurich.com ) to discuss the potential possibilities.

- Place of work: Cologne

- Part-time or full-time: full-time

Elif Yabas is looking forward to your application documents with your salary expectations and the possible start date via the career portal (“Apply now” button). Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications by e-mail.

Welcome to your future

55,000 colleagues in 215 countries and territories. Together on the way to rethink insurance every day – and to shape the future for everyone. Welcome to a strong community where you move from the beginning. Together we continue to develop!

Gestionar de forma eficiente el equipo de emisión, mantenimiento y despacho de pólizas con el fin de garantizar los resultados de la compañía mediante el cumplimiento de Indicadores Claves de Gestión.

-
Gestionar tableros de control y KPIs operativos para monitorear eficiencia y productividad.

- Implementar metodologías de mejora continua como Lean y Six Sigma.

-
Garantizar los resultados operativos de la compañía mediante una gestión eficiente del equipo y procesos.

- Liderar y dar seguimiento al equipo de emisión y mantenimiento de operaciones.

PERFIL REQUERIDO

- Estudios universitarios concluidos en, Ingeniería IndustrialIngeniería Comercial, Administración de empresas o carreras afines.

-
Experiencia mínima de 3 a 4 años en empresas de seguros, especialmente en áreas operativas o de emisión.

COMPETENCIAS

- Liderazgo

- Orientación a resultados

- Pensamiento analítico

- Manejo de equipos

En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor!

Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

Enviar candidatura ahora »

jobs.description:
Zurich North America is looking for a Cyber and Technology E&O Underwriter for our Middle Market segment. This position reports to the Head of Middle Markets within the Professional Liability & Cyber Business Unit.

You will be responsible for achieving key performance metrics to drive profitability, shifting portfolio mix, identifying paths for operational efficiency, and developing and executing our go-to-market strategy to drive new business and renewal retention. The Middle Market Professional Liability & Cyber Business Unit manages the growth and placement of the following lines of coverage for customers with up to $750M in revenue: Cyber, Technology E&O, Miscellaneous Professional Liability, Manufacturers E&O, and Employed Lawyers.

While this position is based out of the Philadelphia office, you will have the flexibility to work on a hybrid basis. You will partner with your manager to set a flexible work schedule that supports you, our customers, and our brokers and agents. This role requires visibility in the marketplace, with the expectation of being in the office or market three days per week.

The Cyber and Technology E&O Underwriter is responsible for:

- Underwrite and manage a portfolio of Cyber, Technology E&O, Miscellaneous Professional Liability, Manufacturers E&O, and Employed Lawyers policies.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with brokers, clients, and internal stakeholders.

- Contribute to the development and implementation of underwriting strategies and initiatives.

- Actively pursue new business opportunities and work to expand Zurich’s portfolio.

- Comply with underwriting rules and guidelines, insurance laws and regulations and rating manual rules

- Continuously monitor and assess emerging Cyber and Technology E&O trends—including threat vectors, claims patterns, legal/regulatory developments, and coverage evolution—and translate those insights into disciplined risk selection, pricing, and portfolio strategy.

- Manage and optimize portfolio performance, balancing growth, profitability, and risk selection in alignment with underwriting strategy.

- Develop deep expertise in Zurich’s Cyber and Professional Liability products and policy forms, and confidently communicate coverage positions, changes, and underwriting appetite to brokers to support deal execution and relationship development.

- Understand client needs and priorities and work collaboratively with brokers to develop solutions that create value for customers while maintaining underwriting discipline.

This role will be filled at either the Underwriting Specialist or Executive Underwriter level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Basic Qualifications:

Underwriting Specialist:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

OR

Executive Underwriter:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support are
AND

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office

- Experience working on time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree

- CPCU

- Experienced background in Professional Liability and Cyber

- Ability to leverage existing relationships with Agents, Brokers, internal, and external business partners

- Portfolio Management Experience

- Excellent communication & presentation skills

- Collaborative

- Results oriented

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $79,600.00 - $172,300.00. The proposed salary range for the Underwriting Specialist is $79,600.00 - $130,300.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%. Le marché moyen Responsabilité professionnelle et cyberentreprise L'unité gère la croissance et le placement des lignes de couverture suivantes pour les clients dont les revenus peuvent atteindre 750 M$ : Cyber, E&O technologique, responsabilité professionnelle diverse, E&O manufacturiers et avocats employés.

Bien que ce poste soit basé sur le bureau de Philadelphie, vous aurez la flexibilité de travailler sur une base hybride. Vous vous associerez à votre gestionnaire pour fixer un horaire de travail flexible qui vous accompagne, nos clients et nos courtiers et agents. Ce rôle exige une visibilité sur le marché, avec l'attente d'être au bureau ou sur le marché trois jours par semaine.

Le sous-traitant de Cyber et technologie est responsable :

- Instaurer et gérer un portefeuille de politiques Cyber, E et O de la technologie, Responsabilité professionnelle diverse, E et O des fabricants et Avocats employés.

- Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les courtiers, les clients et les intervenants internes.

- Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la mise en oeuvre de stratégies et d'initiatives de souscription.

- Rechercher activement de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires et travailler à élargir le portefeuille de Zurich.

- Respecter les règles et directives de souscription, les lois et règlements en matière d'assurance et les règles du manuel de notation

- Surveiller et évaluer en permanence les nouvelles tendances en matière de cybersécurité et de technologie, y compris les vecteurs de menace, les modèles de revendications, les développements juridiques et réglementaires et l'évolution de la couverture, et traduire ces connaissances en stratégies de sélection des risques, de tarification et de portefeuille disciplinées.

- Gérer et optimiser les performances du portefeuille, équilibrer la croissance, la rentabilité et la sélection des risques en conformité avec la stratégie de souscription.

- Développez une expertise approfondie dans les produits et les formulaires de politique de responsabilité cyber et professionnelle de Zurich, et communiquez avec confiance les positions de couverture, les changements et l'appétit de souscription aux courtiers pour soutenir l'exécution des contrats et le développement des relations.

- Comprendre les besoins et les priorités des clients et travailler en collaboration avec les courtiers pour élaborer des solutions qui créent de la valeur pour les clients tout en maintenant la discipline de souscription.

Ce rôle sera assumé soit au niveau des sous-traitants, soit au niveau des sous-traitants. Le gestionnaire d'embauche déterminera le niveau approprié en fonction de l'expérience et des compétences du candidat choisi par rapport aux qualités énumérées pour ce poste.

Qualifications de base :

Spécialiste de la souscription :

- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 3 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la souscription ou de la gestion du marché.
OU

- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine des réclamations ou de l'appui à la souscription
OU

- Zurich Apprentis certifié d'assurance comprenant un diplôme associé et 1 ou plusieurs années d'expérience dans le domaine de la souscription ou face au marché
OU

- Zurich Apprenti d'assurance certifié comprenant un diplôme associé et 4 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine des réclamations ou de l'aide à la souscription
PAYS

- Connaissance des secteurs d'activité et des lignes directrices juridiques et réglementaires

- Connaissance des contraintes de temps pour les soumissions sur les affaires nouvelles et de renouvellement

- Expérience avec Microsoft Office

OU

Directeur exécutif :

- Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 5 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la souscription ou de la gestion du marché.
OU

OU

- Zurich Apprentis certifié d'assurance comprenant un diplôme associé et 3 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la souscription ou de la gestion du marché
OU

- Zurich Apprenti certifié d'assurance comprenant un diplôme associé et 8 années ou plus d'expérience dans les réclamations ou soutien de souscription sont
PAYS

- Connaissance de Microsoft Office

- Expérience de travail sur les contraintes de temps pour les devis sur les affaires nouvelles et de renouvellement

Qualifications préférées :

- Licence

- CPCU

- Expérience en responsabilité professionnelle et cyber

- Capacité de tirer parti des relations existantes avec les agents, les courtiers, les partenaires commerciaux internes et externes

- Expérience en gestion de portefeuille

- Excellentes compétences en communication et présentation

- Collaboration

- Orientation vers les résultats

Votre salaire à Zurich est basé sur votre rôle, votre emplacement, vos compétences et votre expérience. Nous suivons les lois locales pour garantir une juste indemnisation. Vous pouvez également être admissible à des primes et des augmentations de mérite. Si vos attentes sont supérieures à la fourchette indiquée, nous vous encourageons toujours à présenter votre candidature, ce qui compte pour nous. L'échelle salariale combinée pour ce poste est de 79 600,00 $ - 172 300,00 $. L'échelle salariale proposée pour le spécialiste de la souscription est de 79 600,00 $ - 130 300,00 $, la prime incitative à court terme étant fixée à 10 %. L'échelle salariale proposée pour le sous-traitant exécutif est de 105 200,00 $ - 172 300,00 $, et l'admissibilité au régime d'encouragement global de spécialité est fixée à 30 %.

Nous offrons une rémunération concurrentielle et des avantages complets aux employés et à leur famille. [En savoir plus sur Total Rewards ici .]

Pourquoi Zurich ?

À Zurich, nous apprécions vos idées et votre expérience. Nous offrons la croissance, l'inclusion et un environnement favorable, afin que vous puissiez aider à façonner l'avenir de l'assurance. Zurich L'Amérique du Nord est un chef de file en gestion des risques, avec plus de 150 ans d'expertise et de couverture dans plus de 25 industries, dont 90% du Fortune 500®.

Rejoignez-nous pour un avenir meilleur, pour vous et nos clients.

En Amérique du Nord, Zurich ne fait pas de discrimination fondée sur la race, l'ethnicité, la couleur, la religion, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'expression sexuelle, l'identité de genre, l'information génétique, l'âge, le handicap, le statut de vétéran protégé, l'état matrimonial, l'orientation sexuelle, la grossesse ou d'autres caractéristiques protégées par la loi applicable. Égalité des chances Invalidité/veuves de l'employeur.

Zurich est conforme au code américain 18 § 1033.

jobs.description:
Interessierst du dich für vielfältige HR-Themen und möchtest Mitarbeitende sowie Führungskräfte in einem Grossunternehmen kompetent beraten? Gehst du Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an und schätzt den Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen über verschiedene Kanäle?

Das HR Advisory Team ist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Personalfragen – sowohl für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte des Konzerns als auch der Ländereinheit Zurich Schweiz. Wir unterstützen bei unterschiedlichsten HR-Anliegen, bearbeiten Anfragen über mehrere Kanäle und kommunizieren dabei in vier Sprachen. In unserem zehnköpfigen Team kannst du dein HR-Fachwissen kontinuierlich erweitern, Verantwortung übernehmen und aktiv dazu beitragen, ein hervorragendes Serviceerlebnis zu schaffen.

Bist du kundenorientiert, umsetzungsstark und ein Teamplayer? Dann ist dies dein nächster Karriereschritt.

Erfahre hier , weshalb Zurich Schweiz zu den «Top 3» Arbeitgebern der Schweiz zählt. Werde auch du Teil davon und bewirb dich als HR Advisory Specialist.

Was du tust

- Du bearbeitest Anfragen via HR-Portal, Chat, E-Mail oder Telefon und stellst eine professionelle Betreuung unserer Kundinnen und Kunden sicher.

- Du findest rasch passende Lösungen oder koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit den zuständigen HR-Fachbereichen.

- Du administrierst HR-Prozesse und sorgst für deren termingerechte, korrekte Umsetzung sowie die Pflege relevanter Daten in SAP und SuccessFactors.

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung für definierte HR-Themen und Prozesse und stellst die Einhaltung gesetzlicher sowie interner Vorgaben sicher.

- Du arbeitest aktiv an HR-Projekten und Prozessoptimierungen mit und bringst Ideen zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Services ein.

Was du mitbringst

- Kaufmännische Grundausbildung, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine HR-Weiterbildung

- 2–5 Jahre Erfahrung im HR-Umfeld, vorzugsweise im HR Service Center, HR Operations oder in einer vergleichbaren Dienstleistungsfunktion

- Ausgeprägte Kunden- und Dienstleistungsorientierung sowie eine flexible, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

- Hohe IT-Affinität, schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Interesse an digitalen HR-Systemen (vorzugsweise mit SAP und/oder SuccessFactors) und Prozessen

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Französisch oder Italienisch sind ein Plus

Dein Kontakt

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Robert Friedrich (+41 44 628 28 85)

Zusätzliche Informationen

Tei lzeit oder Vollzeit: 80 - 100%

Arbeitsort: Zürich, Oerlikon

Reisetätigkeit: keine

Hybride s Arbeiten: bis zu 40%

#LI-Hybrid

Wir freuen uns auf deine Onlinebewerbung – auch ohne Bewerbungsschreiben.
Gerne kannst du uns bei einem persönlichen Kennenlernen von deiner Motivation überzeugen.

Wer wir sind

Zurich ist eine starke Marke – mehr als 1,4 Millionen Schweizer Kundinnen und Kunden vertrauen auf unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen. Die Basis unseres Erfolgs bilden unsere 53‘000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit, die unseren Kunden in 210 Ländern und Gebieten helfen, ihre Risiken besser zu verstehen und sich gegen diese zu schützen. Um die tägliche Leistung zu erbringen, bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden flexible Arbeitsmodelle und interessante Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Als Zurich-Mitarbeitender profitierst du von einer Vielzahl an Vorteilen und einer starken Kultur, geprägt von Akzeptanz, Vielfältigkeit und Teamorientierung.

Bei Zurich pflegen wir eine Kultur der Vielfalt und Inklusion. Unsere Ziele und Werte sind geschaffen, um unsere Mitarbeitenden zu schützen, Vertrauen zu fördern und zu helfen, ihr volles Potential auszuschöpfen. Wir stehen ein für Gerechtigkeit und Gleichheit unter unseren Angestellten, unabhängig vom Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Religion, etc. Die Gewinnung unserer Talente sowie die Rekrutierungsprozesse spiegeln dieses Bekenntnis im Alltag. Steige bei uns ein und werde Teil dieser Kultur.

Weshalb ist Zurich seit über 150 Jahren erfolgreich? Siehe hier selbst und werde Teil davon .

Information für Personalvermittler

Zurich nimmt für diese Position keine unaufgeforderten Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlern entgegen. Personalvermittler reichen daher bitte keine Bewerberunterlagen an unsere Mitarbeitenden oder über unser Online-Karriere-Portal ein. Wir lehnen jegliche Verantwortung für unaufgefordert eingereichte Bewerbungen sowie etwaige Gebühren ab und danken für das Verständnis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei interessato a una vasta gamma di argomenti HR e vorresti fornire consigli competenti a dipendenti e manager in una grande azienda? Affronta le sfide in modo orientato alla soluzione e apprezzi lo scambio con diversi stakeholder attraverso diversi canali?

Il HR Advisory Team è il punto centrale di contatto per le questioni del personale, sia per i dipendenti che per i dirigenti del Gruppo e dell'unità di paese della Svizzera di Zurigo. Sosteniamo una vasta gamma di questioni HR, richieste di processo tramite diversi canali e comunichiamo in quattro lingue. Nel nostro team di dieci, puoi espandere continuamente le tue competenze HR, assumerti la responsabilità e contribuire attivamente alla creazione di un'esperienza di servizio eccellente.

Sei orientato al cliente, forte e un giocatore di squadra? Questo è il tuo prossimo passo di carriera.

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro "Top 3" in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e si applica come specialista di consulenza HR.

Cosa fai

- Elabori richieste tramite il portale HR, chat, e-mail o telefono e fornisci assistenza professionale ai nostri clienti.

- Troverete rapidamente soluzioni adeguate o coordinare la cooperazione con i dipartimenti HR rilevanti.

- Gestisci i processi HR e assicurati la loro tempestiva, corretta implementazione e la manutenzione dei dati rilevanti in SAP e SuccessFactors.

- L'utente si assume la responsabilità di temi e processi HR definiti e garantisce il rispetto dei requisiti legali e interni.

- Sei attivamente coinvolto in progetti HR e ottimizzazioni di processo e contribuire idee per lo sviluppo continuo dei nostri servizi.

Cosa porti

- Formazione commerciale di base, integrata idealmente dalla formazione HR

- 2–5 anni di esperienza nell'ambiente HR, preferibilmente nel Centro Servizi HR, nelle Operazioni HR o in una funzione di servizio paragonabile

- Forte orientamento al cliente e al servizio, nonché un metodo di lavoro flessibile e orientato alla soluzione

- Alta affinità IT, rapida comprensione e interesse nei sistemi HR digitali (preferibilmente con SAP e/o SuccessFactors) e processi

- Conoscenza molto buona di tedesco e inglese; francese o italiano sono un plus

Il tuo contatto

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Robert Friedrich (+41 44 628 28 85)

Ulteriori informazioni

Durata o tempo pieno: 80 - 100%

Luogo di lavoro: Zurigo, Oerlikon

Attività di viaggio: nessuna

Ibridi di lavoro: fino al 40%

#LI-Hybrid #

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online – anche senza una lettera di richiesta.
Siete invitati a convincerci della vostra motivazione durante un incontro personale.

Chi siamo

Zurigo è un marchio forte – oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti svizzeri si affidano ai nostri prodotti e servizi. La base del nostro successo è la nostra 53.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, che aiutano i nostri clienti in 210 paesi e territori a comprendere e proteggere meglio se stessi dai loro rischi. Al fine di fornire prestazioni quotidiane, offriamo ai nostri dipendenti modelli di lavoro flessibili e interessanti opportunità di formazione. Come dipendente di Zurigo, si beneficia di una moltitudine di vantaggi e di una forte cultura caratterizzata da accettazione, diversità e orientamento del team.

A Zurigo, coltiviamo una cultura della diversità e dell'inclusione. I nostri obiettivi e valori sono progettati per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, promuovere la fiducia e aiutarli a raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Siamo per la giustizia e l'uguaglianza tra i nostri dipendenti, indipendentemente dal sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, origine, etnia, religione, ecc. L'acquisizione dei nostri talenti e dei processi di reclutamento riflettono questo impegno nella vita quotidiana. Unisciti a noi e diventare parte di questa cultura.

Perché Zurigo ha avuto successo da oltre 150 anni? Vedere qui e diventare parte di esso.

Informazioni per i reclutatori

Zurigo non accetta applicazioni non richieste dai reclutatori per questa posizione. Pertanto, i reclutatori non inviano documenti candidati ai nostri dipendenti o tramite il nostro portale di carriera online. Rifiutiamo ogni responsabilità per applicazioni non richieste e qualsiasi commissione e ringraziamo per la vostra comprensione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you interested in a wide range of HR topics and would like to provide competent advice to employees and managers in a large company? Do you tackle challenges in a solution-oriented manner and appreciate the exchange with different stakeholders via different channels?

The HR Advisory Team is the central point of contact for personnel issues – both for employees and executives of the Group and the Zurich Switzerland country unit. We support a wide range of HR issues, process requests via several channels and communicate in four languages. In our team of ten, you can continuously expand your HR expertise, take responsibility and actively contribute to creating an excellent service experience.

Are you customer-oriented, strong and a team player? This is your next career step.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as an HR Advisory Specialist.

What you do

- You process inquiries via HR portal, chat, e-mail or telephone and provide professional support to our customers.

- You will quickly find suitable solutions or coordinate cooperation with the relevant HR departments.

- You administer HR processes and ensure their timely, correct implementation as well as the maintenance of relevant data in SAP and SuccessFactors.

- You take responsibility for defined HR topics and processes and ensure compliance with legal and internal requirements.

- You are actively involved in HR projects and process optimizations and contribute ideas for the continuous development of our services.

What you bring

- Basic commercial training, ideally supplemented by HR training

- 2–5 years of experience in the HR environment, preferably in the HR Service Center, HR Operations or in a comparable service function

- Strong customer and service orientation as well as a flexible, solution-oriented working method

- High IT affinity, fast comprehension and interest in digital HR systems (preferably with SAP and/or SuccessFactors) and processes

- Very good knowledge of German and English; French or Italian are a plus

Your contact

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Robert Friedrich (+41 44 628 28 85)

Additional information

Duration or full time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Zurich, Oerlikon

Travel activity: none

Hybrids working: up to 40%

#LI-Hybrid

We look forward to your online application – even without an application letter.
You are welcome to convince us of your motivation during a personal meeting.

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. The basis of our success is our 53,000 employees worldwide, who help our customers in 210 countries and territories to better understand and protect themselves against their risks. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. We stand for justice and equality among our employees, regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, religion, etc. The acquisition of our talents and the recruitment processes reflect this commitment in everyday life. Join us and become part of this culture.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? See here and become part of it.

Information for recruiters

Zurich does not accept unsolicited applications from recruiters for this position. Therefore, recruiters do not submit applicant documents to our employees or via our online career portal. We reject any responsibility for unsolicited applications and any fees and thank you for your understanding.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous intéressé par un large éventail de sujets liés aux RH et aimeriez-vous fournir des conseils compétents aux employés et aux gestionnaires d'une grande entreprise? S'attaquez-vous aux défis de manière à les résoudre et appréciez-vous l'échange avec les différentes parties prenantes par différents canaux?

L'équipe consultative des RH est le point de contact central pour les questions de personnel, tant pour les employés que pour les cadres du Groupe et de l'unité de Zurich Suisse. Nous soutenons un large éventail de questions de RH, traitons les demandes par plusieurs canaux et communiquons en quatre langues. Dans notre équipe de dix personnes, vous pouvez continuellement développer votre expertise en RH, prendre des responsabilités et contribuer activement à créer une excellente expérience de service.

Êtes-vous orienté client, fort et un joueur d'équipe? C'est votre prochaine étape de carrière.

Découvrez ici pourquoi Zurich Suisse est l'un des employeurs "Top 3" en Suisse. Devenez membre et appliquez-vous comme spécialiste-conseil en RH.

Ce que tu fais

- Vous traitez les demandes de renseignements via le portail RH, le chat, l'e-mail ou le téléphone et fournissez un soutien professionnel à nos clients.

- Vous trouverez rapidement des solutions appropriées ou coordonnerz la coopération avec les services RH concernés.

jobs.title: Executive Underwriter OR AVP Underwriting Director-Workers Compensation
jobs.description:
We are seeking a market-facing Underwriter. This position can be filled at two different levels, Executive Underwriter or AVP Underwriting Director, to build and manage a specialized Workers Compensation portfolio within the franchised auto dealer segment. This role combines production underwriting with subject matter leadership, partnering closely with sales while driving disciplined risk selection, pricing, and profitable growth. The position is well-suited for a self-starter who operates with strong ownership and autonomy—able to identify opportunities, shape direction, and elevate team capability through training and support in Workers Compensation. Over time, the role will expand to a broader underwriting focus across Property & Casualty, supporting integrated account management and overall portfolio performance. This position will need to have Strong Workers Compensation expertise.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Monitor and review work undertaken across a number of small to medium scale projects or a large complex project in order to ensure appropriate use of resources and adherence to schedules.

- Provide advisory services to colleagues on a daily basis, measuring exposure and analyzing risk in order to provide appropriate coverage that meets the organization´s risk and compliance processes.

- Research primary data sources, select relevant information, analyze key themes and trends and make recommendations to support operational decision-making such as which coverage to provide.

- Research best practice and provide consultancy to support senior management in developing and improving processes and systems relevant to underwriting.

- Assess complex customer cases, evaluate their unique needs and apply technical techniques and know-how to recommend a solution.

- Build relationships with customers by handling a range of queries and provide advice with the development of an account to create additional value for the organization and customers.

- Apply rating tools and methodologies to own work area to deliver to customers and offer suggestions for improvements.

This role will be filled at either the Executive Underwriter or AVP Underwriter Level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Basic Qualifications:

Executive Underwriter:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an associate degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an associate degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office

- Experience working on time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience working in a team environment

OR

AVP Underwriter:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 7 or more years of experience in the Underwriting, Market Facing area, Accounting, Banking, or Risk Management.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 14 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an associate degree and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting, Market Facing area, Accounting, Banking, or Risk Management.
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an associate degree and 12 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Experience with Microsoft Office

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Microsoft Office experience

- Strong Workers Compensation expertise; experience underwriting franchised auto dealers.

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $100,000.00 - $215,000.00. The proposed salary range for the Executive Underwriter is $100,000.00 - $165,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%. The proposed salary range for the AVP Underwriting Director is $130,000.00 - $215,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 20%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Stiamo cercando un Underwriter di mercato. Questa posizione può essere riempita a due diversi livelli, Executive Underwriter o AVP Underwriting Director, per costruire e gestire un portafoglio specializzato di Compensazioni Lavoratori all'interno del segmento concessionario automatico in franchising. Questo ruolo combina la sottoscrittura di produzione con la leadership di materia soggetto, collaborando a stretto contatto con le vendite mentre guida la selezione di rischio disciplinato, i prezzi e la crescita redditizia. La posizione è ben adatta per un auto-starter che opera con una forte proprietà e autonomia, in grado di identificare opportunità, la direzione della forma e aumentare la capacità del team attraverso la formazione e il supporto nella Compensazione dei Lavoratori. Nel corso del tempo, il ruolo si espanderà a un più ampio focus di scrittura su Property & Casualty, supportando la gestione integrata degli account e le prestazioni globali del portafoglio. Questa posizione avrà bisogno di una solida competenza per la Compensazione dei Lavoratori.

In questo ruolo sarete responsabili di:

- Monitorare e rivedere i lavori intrapresi in vari progetti di piccola o media scala o in un grande progetto complesso al fine di garantire l'uso appropriato delle risorse e l'adesione ai programmi.

- Fornire servizi di consulenza a colleghi su base giornaliera, misurare l'esposizione e analizzare il rischio al fine di fornire una copertura adeguata che soddisfi i processi di rischio e conformità dell'organizzazione.

- Fonti di dati primarie di ricerca, selezionare informazioni pertinenti, analizzare temi chiave e tendenze e fare raccomandazioni per sostenere il processo decisionale operativo come quale copertura per fornire.

- Le migliori pratiche di ricerca e fornire consulenza per sostenere la gestione senior nello sviluppo e nel miglioramento dei processi e dei sistemi pertinenti alla sottoscrizione.

- Valutare i casi complessi del cliente, valutare le loro esigenze uniche e applicare tecniche tecniche e know-how per raccomandare una soluzione.

- Costruire relazioni con i clienti trattando una serie di query e fornire consigli allo sviluppo di un account per creare valore aggiuntivo per l'organizzazione e i clienti.

- Applica strumenti di valutazione e metodologie per la propria area di lavoro per fornire ai clienti e offrire suggerimenti per i miglioramenti.

Questo ruolo sarà riempito sia al livello esecutivo Underwriter o AVP Underwriter. Il gestore di assunzione determinerà il livello appropriato in base all’esperienza e alle competenze del richiedente selezionato rispetto alle qualifiche elencate per questa posizione.

- Diploma di High School o Equivalent e 5 o più anni di esperienza nell'area Sottoscrittura o Market Facing.

O

- Apprendista di assicurazione certificata di Zurigo, che include un grado associato e 8 o più anni di esperienza nell'area di supporto per i reclami o sottoscrittura
E

- Conoscenza di Microsoft Office

- Esperienza di lavoro sulle restrizioni di tempo per preventivi su nuovo e rinnovo business

- Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente di team

O

AVP Underwriter:

- Diploma di High School o Equivalent e 7 o più anni di esperienza nell'area Underwriting, Market Facing, Contabilità, Banking, o Risk Management.
O

- Diploma di High School o Equivalent e 14 o più anni di esperienza nell'area di supporto Claims o Underwriting
O

- Apprendista di assicurazione certificata di Zurigo, tra cui una laurea associata e 5 o più anni di esperienza nella zona di sottoscrizione, Market Facing, Contabilità, Banking, o Risk Management.
O

- Apprendista di assicurazione certificata di Zurigo, che include una laurea associata e 12 o più anni di esperienza nell'area di supporto per i reclami o sottoscrittura
E

- Esperienza con Microsoft Office

- Corso di laurea

- Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta

- Esperienza Microsoft Office

- Forti competenze di Compensazione dei lavoratori; esperienza di sottoscrivere concessionari auto in franchising.

Si può anche essere idonei per bonus e aumenti di merito. Se le vostre aspettative sono al di sopra della gamma elencata, vi incoraggiamo ancora ad applicare – il vostro background unico conta per noi. Wir suchen einen marktorientierten Underwriter. Diese Position kann auf zwei verschiedenen Ebenen besetzt werden, Executive Underwriter oder AVP Underwriting Director, um ein spezialisiertes Workers Compensation-Portfolio im Franchise-Autohändlersegment aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Diese Rolle kombiniert das Underwriting in der Produktion mit der Themenführung, die enge Partnerschaft mit dem Vertrieb, während disziplinierte Risikoauswahl, Preisgestaltung und profitables Wachstum. Die Position eignet sich gut für einen Selbststarter, der mit starker Eigenverantwortung und Autonomie arbeitet - in der Lage, Chancen zu erkennen, die Richtung zu gestalten und die Teamfähigkeit durch Training und Unterstützung bei der Arbeitnehmerentschädigung zu erhöhen. Im Laufe der Zeit wird sich die Rolle auf einen breiteren Underwriting-Fokus in Property & Casualty ausdehnen, der das integrierte Account-Management und die Gesamtleistung des Portfolios unterstützt. Diese Position muss über starkes Fachwissen zur Arbeitnehmerentschädigung verfügen.

In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für:

- Überwachung und Überprüfung der in einer Reihe kleiner bis mittlerer Projekte oder eines großen komplexen Projekts durchgeführten Arbeiten, um eine angemessene Nutzung der Ressourcen und die Einhaltung der Zeitpläne sicherzustellen.

- Beraten Sie Ihre Kollegen täglich, messen Sie die Exposition und analysieren Sie das Risiko, um eine angemessene Abdeckung zu bieten, die den Risiko- und Compliance-Prozessen des Unternehmens entspricht.

- Recherchieren Sie primäre Datenquellen, wählen Sie relevante Informationen aus, analysieren Sie wichtige Themen und Trends und geben Sie Empfehlungen zur Unterstützung der operativen Entscheidungsfindung, z. B. welche Abdeckung bereitgestellt werden soll.

- Recherchieren Sie Best Practices und bieten Sie Beratung an, um die Geschäftsleitung bei der Entwicklung und Verbesserung von versicherungsrelevanten Prozessen und Systemen zu unterstützen.

- Bewerten Sie komplexe Kundenfälle, bewerten Sie ihre individuellen Bedürfnisse und wenden Sie technische Techniken und Know-how an, um eine Lösung zu empfehlen.

- Bauen Sie Beziehungen zu Kunden auf, indem Sie eine Reihe von Anfragen bearbeiten und beraten Sie bei der Entwicklung eines Kontos, um einen zusätzlichen Wert für das Unternehmen und die Kunden zu schaffen.

- Wenden Sie Rating-Tools und -Methoden auf den eigenen Arbeitsbereich an, um Kunden zu liefern und Verbesserungsvorschläge zu unterbreiten.

Diese Rolle wird entweder auf der Executive Underwriter- oder AVP Underwriter-Ebene besetzt. Der Einstellungsmanager bestimmt das geeignete Niveau basierend auf der Erfahrung und den Fähigkeiten des ausgewählten Bewerbers in Bezug auf die für diese Position aufgeführten Qualifikationen.

- High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 5 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Underwriting oder Market Facing Bereich.

ODER

ODER

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice mit einem Associate Degree und 5 oder mehr Jahren Erfahrung im Underwriting, Market Facing Bereich, Accounting, Banking oder Risikomanagement.
ODER

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice inklusive Associate Degree und 12 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Claims oder Underwriting Support
UND

- Erfahrung mit Microsoft Office

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

- Bachelor-Abschluss

- Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

- Microsoft Office Erfahrung

- Starke Workers Compensation Expertise; Erfahrung Underwriting Franchise-Autohändler.
