- Contribuer aux processus budgétaires annuels et de prévision périodique en partenariat avec les équipes interfonctionnelles.

- Élaborer, maintenir et examiner des modèles financiers modérément complexes pour appuyer la planification et l'analyse.

- Agir en tant qu'expert en matière de comptabilité des projets et initiatives internes.

- Surveiller et améliorer les processus comptables en identifiant les possibilités d'automatisation et d'efficacité à l'aide de technologies appropriées.

À Zurich, nous aimons penser en dehors de la boîte et défier le statu quo. Nous adoptons une approche optimiste en nous concentrant sur les positifs et nous demandons constamment ce qui peut aller bien?

Nous sommes un employeur à chances égales qui sait que chaque employé est unique - c'est ce qui rend notre équipe si géniale!
Rejoignez-nous en explorant constamment de nouvelles façons de protéger nos clients et la planète.

jobs.description:
Zurich gives you the tools and support to construct a rewarding career in the Insurance industry. We are looking for an Underwriter or Underwriting Specialist, Construction Casualty to work remotely in Tennessee or Alabama supporting our Southeast region.

As Construction Casualty Underwriter you will have a chance to use your marketing and analytical skills along with your knowledge to analyze and underwrite new and renewal Construction Casualty business both in the US. This is a market facing position and we are seeking someone with a strong sales execution mindset and knowledge of commercial Construction Casualty policies. There will be 15%-20% travel for this position.

This role will be filled at either the Underwriter, Construction Casualty or Underwriting Specialist, Construction Casualty . The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Key Accountabilities of this role:

- Administer and monitor underwriting rules and guidelines, rating manual rules, and insurance laws and regulations.

- Develop, maintain & collaborate with Line of Business representatives and other business-related needs, as appropriate.

- Develop and maintain relationships with distributors (agents & brokers) in support of business retention and acquisition and works with customers and distributors (agents & brokers) to determine their insurance related needs and provide solutions.

- Support the organization's sales culture by being a Help Point for agents, brokers and customers.

- Proactively seek renewal and new account opportunities.

- Complete detailed opportunity assessment with key distributors to identify growth opportunities.

- Qualify accounts to meet with the organization's appetite, balanced with sound business opportunity.

- Make broker/customer and on-sight calls with a planned and well-prepared purpose.

Basic Qualifications: Underwriter, Construction Casualty:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 1 or more years of experience in the Insurance, Banking, Mortgage, Finance, Construction or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 2 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of the insurance industry and the legal and regulatory environment

- Knowledge of underwriting philosophy, techniques, national/local filing regulations and guidelines

OR

Basic Qualifications: Underwriter Specialist, Construction Casualty:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree

- Commercial Construction Casualty underwriting experience and broker relationships in the Southeast region

- Ability to effectively assess risk

- Superior skills in relationship building, active listening, needs analysis, and win-win negotiating
Possess knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Excellent oral and written communication skills

- PC and related software skills

- CRIS or CPCU

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $57,000.00 - $117,900.00. The proposed salary range for the Underwriter is $57,000.00 - $93,300.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%. The proposed salary range for the Underwriting Specialist is $72,100.00 - $117,900.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

jobs.description:
#ZCC

Zurich Capability Center is looking for:

Digital Project Manager

As a Digital Project Manager within Zurich Cover‑More’s Rapid Learning Lab , you will be responsible for the planning, execution, and delivery of digital optimisation and content initiatives across our global travel insurance business.

This is a high‑impact, coordination‑intensive role embedded within a globally distributed team . You will lead cross‑functional workstreams, align onshore and offshore stakeholders, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . The role suits someone with strong project discipline, digital delivery experience, and the communication skills to bridge time zones and cultures effectively.

What You’ll Do

Project Planning & Delivery

- Lead cross‑functional, onshore and offshore teams to plan and deliver multiple digital optimisation and content initiatives

- Develop and manage detailed project plans , timelines, resource allocations, and dependencies across geographically dispersed teams

- Own the day‑to‑day operational delivery of concurrent projects, ensuring progress remains on track

- Estimate project effort and costs in collaboration with internal teams and third‑party vendors

- Facilitate clear definition of project goals, scope, and deliverables from initiation through to delivery

- Create and maintain project documentation , including plans, schedules, agendas, minutes, and business requirements

Stakeholder Communication & Alignment

- Facilitate clear, structured communication across stakeholders in multiple geographies and time zones

- Act as the primary point of coordination between offshore teams, onshore IT, vendors, and business partners

- Demonstrate strong asynchronous communication practices to keep distributed teams informed and unblocked

- Adapt communication approach and meeting cadence to accommodate global time zone differences

- Chair cross‑functional meetings, ensuring decisions are captured and actions are followed through

Risk, Issues & Performance Management

- Identify, track, and report risks, issues, impediments, and dependencies impacting delivery

- Monitor project performance, milestones, and outcomes, implementing corrective actions where required

- Coordinate problem‑solving across teams and recommend practical, delivery‑focused solutions

Optimisation & Digital Delivery

- Provide project leadership for digital marketing, optimisation, and application development initiatives

- Partner with the Rapid Learning Lab and optimisation tools teams to improve content generation, review, approval, and execution processes

- Coordinate optimisation roadmaps at individual business‑partner level , including integrated and non‑integrated partners

- Ensure all outputs comply with local regulatory, legal, financial, and brand requirements

- Maintain adherence to Zurich and partner compliance and approval processes across all optimisation activity

Continuous Improvement

- Drive continuous improvement through project management best practices and lessons learned

- Contribute to the development of standards, templates, and ways of working for a fast‑moving global team

- Share knowledge and insights across onshore and offshore teams to build collective capability

What You’ll Bring

Experience & Education

- Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Business, Digital Marketing, Project Management , or a related field

- 2+ years’ experience in project management, ideally within a multinational organisation

- Recognised project management certification ( PMP, PRINCE2 , or equivalent); Agile experience is a plus

- Demonstrated success working with offshore or globally distributed teams

- Experience in travel, insurance, or financial services is advantageous

Technical & Domain Skills

- Proven familiarity with content management systems and digital marketing platforms

- Working knowledge of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

- Experience managing digital optimisation or A/B testing initiatives is an advantage

Nice to Have

- Exposure to Adobe Experience Cloud tools (e.g. AEM, Target, Analytics)

- Experience delivering projects with technology‑integrated and non‑integrated partners

- Understanding of multi‑market regulatory and compliance requirements

Who You Are

- Highly organised, detail‑oriented, and able to manage complex initiatives end to end

- A clear, proactive communicator who keeps stakeholders aligned without prompting

- Comfortable working independently across competing priorities and time zones

- Culturally aware, collaborative, and effective in international team environments

- Resilient, solutions‑focused, and comfortable navigating ambiguity and change

- A team player who understands that strong connections drive strong outcomes

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we’re building a brighter future — together. The Zurich Cover‑More Rapid Learning Lab is where experimentation meets impact, and your work will directly influence how we deliver high‑performing digital experiences worldwide.

We offer a supportive, inclusive culture where your ideas matter, your growth is prioritised, and distance is never a barrier to belonging.

Zurich is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees

descriptionByLocale.it:
#ZCC #

Zurigo Capability Center sta cercando:

Direttore del progetto digitale

In qualità di responsabile del progetto digitale all’interno del Rapid Learning Lab di Zurigo Cover‐More, sarai responsabile della pianificazione, dell’esecuzione e della consegna delle iniziative di ottimizzazione digitale e di contenuto nel nostro business globale dell’assicurazione viaggi.

Questo è un ruolo ad alto impatto, intensivo di coordinamento incorporato all'interno di un team distribuito a livello globale. Potrai condurre flussi di lavoro interfunzionali, allineare le parti interessate onshore e offshore, e garantire i progetti vengono consegnati in tempo, entro il campo di applicazione e all'interno del budget . Il ruolo si adatta a qualcuno con forte disciplina di progetto, esperienza di consegna digitale, e le capacità di comunicazione per colmare fusi orari e culture in modo efficace.

Cosa farai

Pianificazione e consegna dei progetti

- Leader team interfunzionali, onshore e offshore per pianificare e fornire molteplici iniziative di ottimizzazione digitale e contenuti

- Sviluppare e gestire piani di progetto dettagliati, linee temporali, allocazioni delle risorse e dipendenze attraverso team geograficamente dispersi

- Proprio la consegna operativa quotidiana di progetti concomitanti, assicurando che i progressi rimangano in pista

- Stimolare lo sforzo e i costi del progetto in collaborazione con team interni e fornitori di terze parti

- Facilitare la definizione chiara degli obiettivi del progetto, della portata e dei risultati dall'iniziazione fino alla consegna

- Creare e mantenere la documentazione del progetto, compresi i piani, gli orari, gli ordini del giorno, i minuti e i requisiti aziendali

Stakeholder Comunicazione e allineamento

- Facilitare una comunicazione chiara e strutturata tra le parti interessate in più geografie e fusi orari

- Agire come punto principale di coordinamento tra le squadre offshore, IT onshore, venditori e partner commerciali

- Dimostrare forti pratiche di comunicazione asincrono per mantenere i team distribuiti informati e sbloccati

- Adapt approccio di comunicazione e cadenza di incontro per ospitare le differenze di fuso orario globale

- Sedia incontri interfunzionali, assicurando che le decisioni vengano catturate e le azioni vengono seguite attraverso

Rischio, problemi e gestione delle prestazioni

- Identificare, tracciare e segnalare rischi, problemi, impedimenti e dipendenze che influiscono sulla consegna

- Monitorare le prestazioni del progetto, le pietre miliari e i risultati, implementando azioni correttive laddove necessario

- Coordinare la risoluzione dei problemi tra i team e consigliare soluzioni pratiche e orientate alla consegna

Ottimizzazione e consegna digitale

- Fornire leadership di progetto per le iniziative di digital marketing, ottimizzazione e sviluppo delle applicazioni

- Partner del Rapid Learning Lab e dei team di strumenti di ottimizzazione per migliorare i processi di generazione, revisione, approvazione e esecuzione dei contenuti

- Coordinate roadmap di ottimizzazione a livello individuale di partner commerciali, inclusi partner integrati e non integrati

- Assicurarsi che tutti gli output siano conformi alle normative locali, legali, finanziarie e requisiti di marca

- Mantenere l'adesione a Zurigo e ai processi di conformità e approvazione dei partner in tutte le attività di ottimizzazione

Miglioramento continuo

- Guidare il miglioramento continuo attraverso le migliori pratiche e le lezioni di gestione del progetto

- Contribuisci allo sviluppo di standard, modelli e modi di lavorare per un team globale in rapida evoluzione

- Condividere conoscenze e approfondimenti tra i team onshore e offshore per costruire capacità collettive

Cosa porterai

Esperienza e istruzione

- Corso di laurea (o equivalente) in Business, Digital Marketing, Project Management , o un campo relativo

- 2+ anni di esperienza nella gestione del progetto, idealmente all’interno di un’organizzazione multinazionale

- Certificazione di gestione del progetto riconosciuta (PMP, PRINCE2 o equivalente); l'esperienza Agile è un plus

- Successo dimostrativo che lavora con team offshore o distribuiti a livello globale

- L'esperienza in viaggio, assicurazione o servizi finanziari è vantaggiosa

Abilità tecniche e di dominio

- Approvata familiarità con i sistemi di gestione dei contenuti e le piattaforme di marketing digitale

- Conoscenze di lavoro di tecnologie web (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

- La gestione dell'ottimizzazione digitale o delle iniziative di test A/B è un vantaggio

Bello da avere

- Esposizione agli strumenti Adobe Experience Cloud (ad esempio AEM, Target, Analytics)

- Esperienza nella fornitura di progetti con partner integrati e non integrati dalla tecnologia

- Comprensione dei requisiti di regolamentazione e conformità multi-mercato

Chi sei

- Altamente organizzato, orientato al dettaglio, e in grado di gestire iniziative complesse finiscono alla fine

- Un comunicatore chiaro e proattivo che mantiene le parti interessate allineate senza sollecitare

- Confortevole lavoro indipendente su priorità e fusi orari concorrenti

- Culturalmente consapevole, collaborativo ed efficace negli ambienti di team internazionali

- Resiliente, orientato alle soluzioni e confortevole ambiguità di navigazione e cambiamento

- Un giocatore di squadra che capisce che le connessioni forti portano risultati forti

Perché Zurigo?

A Zurigo, stiamo costruendo un futuro più luminoso — insieme. Lo Zurich Cover‐More Rapid Learning Lab è dove la sperimentazione incontra l'impatto, e il vostro lavoro influenzerà direttamente il modo in cui offriamo esperienze digitali di alta qualità in tutto il mondo.

Offriamo una cultura solida e inclusiva in cui le vostre idee sono importanti, la vostra crescita è priorità, e la distanza non è mai una barriera all'appartenenza.

Zurigo è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Celebriamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti

Zurich Capability Center sucht:

Digitaler Projektmanager

Als Digital Project Manager im Rapid Learning Lab von Zurich Cover‐More sind Sie für die Planung, Durchführung und Bereitstellung digitaler Optimierungs- und Content-Initiativen in unserem globalen Reiseversicherungsgeschäft verantwortlich.

Dies ist eine einflussreiche, koordinationsintensive Rolle, eingebettet in ein global verteiltes Team. Sie leiten funktionsübergreifende Workstreams, richten Onshore- und Offshore-Stakeholder zusammen und stellen sicher, dass Projekte pünktlich, innerhalb des Umfangs und innerhalb des Budgets geliefert werden. Die Rolle passt zu jemandem mit starker Projektdisziplin, digitaler Liefererfahrung und den Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um Zeitzonen und Kulturen effektiv zu überbrücken.

Was du tun wirst

Projektplanung und -lieferung

- Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende Onshore- und Offshore-Teams an, um mehrere digitale Optimierungs- und Inhaltsinitiativen zu planen und durchzuführen

- Entwickeln und verwalten Sie detaillierte Projektpläne, Zeitpläne, Ressourcenzuweisungen und Abhängigkeiten in geografisch verteilten Teams

- Eigenständigkeit bei der täglichen operativen Durchführung von gleichzeitigen Projekten, um sicherzustellen, dass der Fortschritt auf Kurs bleibt

- Schätzung des Projektaufwands und der Kosten in Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams und Drittanbietern

- Erleichtern Sie eine klare Definition der Projektziele, des Umfangs und der Ergebnisse von der Initiierung bis zur Lieferung

- Erstellen und Pflegen von Projektdokumentationen, einschließlich Plänen, Zeitplänen, Tagesordnungen, Protokollen und Geschäftsanforderungen

Stakeholder-Kommunikation & Alignment

- Erleichterung einer klaren, strukturierten Kommunikation zwischen Stakeholdern in mehreren Regionen und Zeitzonen

- Handeln Sie als primärer Koordinationspunkt zwischen Offshore-Teams, Onshore-IT, Anbietern und Geschäftspartnern

- Demonstrieren Sie starke asynchrone Kommunikationspraktiken, um verteilte Teams zu informieren und zu entsperren

- Anpassung des Kommunikationsansatzes und der Trittfrequenz an globale Zeitzonenunterschiede

- Vorsitz in funktionsübergreifenden Sitzungen, um sicherzustellen, dass Entscheidungen getroffen und Maßnahmen verfolgt werden

Risiko, Themen & Performance Management

- Identifizieren, verfolgen und melden Sie Risiken, Probleme, Hindernisse und Abhängigkeiten, die sich auf die Lieferung auswirken

- Überwachen Sie die Projektleistung, Meilensteine und Ergebnisse und implementieren Sie erforderlichenfalls Korrekturmaßnahmen

- Koordination der Problemlösung über Teams hinweg und Empfehlung praktischer, lieferungsorientierter Lösungen

Optimierung & Digital Delivery

- Projektleitung für digitales Marketing, Optimierung und Anwendungsentwicklung

- Partnerschaft mit dem Rapid Learning Lab und Optimierungstools zur Verbesserung der Prozesse für die Generierung, Überprüfung, Genehmigung und Ausführung von Inhalten

- Koordination von Optimierungs-Roadmaps auf der Ebene der einzelnen Geschäftspartner, einschließlich integrierter und nicht integrierter Partner

- Sicherstellen, dass alle Outputs den lokalen regulatorischen, rechtlichen, finanziellen und Markenanforderungen entsprechen

- Einhaltung der Compliance- und Genehmigungsprozesse von Zurich und Partnern in allen Optimierungsaktivitäten

Kontinuierliche Verbesserung

- Steigern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen durch Best Practices im Projektmanagement und gewonnene Erkenntnisse

- Beitrag zur Entwicklung von Standards, Vorlagen und Arbeitsweisen für ein schnelllebiges globales Team

- Wissen und Erkenntnisse über Onshore- und Offshore-Teams auszutauschen, um gemeinsame Fähigkeiten aufzubauen

Was du mitbringen wirst

Erfahrung & Bildung

- Bachelor-Abschluss (oder gleichwertig) in Business, Digital Marketing, Projektmanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich

- 2+ Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise innerhalb einer multinationalen Organisation

- Anerkannte Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (PMP, PRINCE2 oder gleichwertig); Agile Erfahrung ist ein Plus

- Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Arbeit mit Offshore- oder global verteilten Teams

- Erfahrung in Reise-, Versicherungs- oder Finanzdienstleistungen ist von Vorteil

Technische und Domänenkenntnisse

- Nachgewiesene Vertrautheit mit Content Management Systemen und digitalen Marketingplattformen

- Kenntnisse in Webtechnologien (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

- Erfahrung in der Verwaltung digitaler Optimierungs- oder A/B-Testinitiativen ist von Vorteil

Nizza zu haben

- Exposition gegenüber Adobe Experience Cloud-Tools (z. B. AEM, Target, Analytics)

- Erfahrung bei der Durchführung von Projekten mit technologieintegrierten und nicht-integrierten Partnern

- Verständnis der multi-market regulatorischen und Compliance-Anforderungen

Wer du bist

- Hoch organisiert, detailorientiert und in der Lage, komplexe Initiativen durchgängig zu managen

- Ein klarer, proaktiver Kommunikator, der die Stakeholder auf einer Linie hält, ohne aufzurufen

- Komfortables unabhängiges Arbeiten über konkurrierende Prioritäten und Zeitzonen hinweg

- Kulturbewusst, kooperativ und effektiv in internationalen Teamumgebungen

- Resiliente, lösungsorientierte und komfortable Navigation durch Mehrdeutigkeit und Veränderung

descriptionByLocale.fr:
#ZCC

Zurich Centre de capacités est à la recherche de:

Gestionnaire de projet numérique

En tant que responsable de projet numérique au sein du laboratoire d'apprentissage rapide de Zurich, vous serez responsable de la planification, de l'exécution et de la livraison d'initiatives d'optimisation numérique et de contenu dans notre entreprise d'assurance voyage mondiale.

Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact et à forte intensité de coordination intégré dans une équipe distribuée à l'échelle mondiale. Vous dirigerez des flux de travail interfonctionnels, alignerez les intervenants terrestres et extracôtiers et veillerez à ce que les projets soient exécutés dans les délais, les limites et le budget. Ce rôle convient à quelqu'un qui a une forte discipline de projet, une expérience de prestation numérique et des compétences en communication pour combler efficacement les fuseaux horaires et les cultures.

Ce que vous allez faire

Planification et exécution des projets

- Diriger des équipes transfonctionnelles, terrestres et offshore pour planifier et livrer de multiples initiatives d'optimisation numérique et de contenu

- Élaborer et gérer des plans de projet détaillés, des échéanciers, des allocations de ressources et des dépendances pour les équipes dispersées géographiquement

- Posséder la prestation opérationnelle quotidienne de projets concomitants, en veillant à ce que les progrès restent sur la bonne voie

- Estimation de l'effort et des coûts du projet en collaboration avec des équipes internes et des fournisseurs tiers

- Faciliter la définition claire des objectifs, de la portée et des produits livrables du lancement à la réalisation

- Créer et tenir à jour la documentation du projet, y compris les plans, les calendriers, les ordres du jour, les procès-verbaux et les exigences opérationnelles

Communication et alignement des parties prenantes

- Faciliter une communication claire et structurée entre les intervenants dans de multiples géographies et fuseaux horaires

- Agir comme principal point de coordination entre les équipes offshore, les TI terrestres, les fournisseurs et les partenaires commerciaux

- Démontrer de solides pratiques de communication asynchrones pour tenir les équipes distribuées informées et débloquées

- Adapter l'approche de communication et la cadence de rencontre pour tenir compte des différences de fuseau horaire au niveau mondial

- Réunions interfonctionnelles du président, en veillant à ce que les décisions soient prises et à ce que des mesures soient prises

Risque, enjeux et gestion du rendement

- Identifier, suivre et signaler les risques, les problèmes, les obstacles et les dépendances ayant une incidence sur la prestation des services

- Surveiller le rendement, les jalons et les résultats du projet, mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives au besoin

- Coordonner la résolution de problèmes entre les équipes et recommander des solutions pratiques et axées sur la prestation

Optimisation et livraison numérique

- Diriger les projets de marketing numérique, d'optimisation et de développement d'applications

- Partenariat avec le laboratoire d'apprentissage rapide et les équipes d'optimisation pour améliorer les processus de production, d'examen, d'approbation et d'exécution du contenu

- Coordonner les feuilles de route d'optimisation au niveau individuel des partenaires commerciaux , y compris les partenaires intégrés et non intégrés

- Veiller à ce que tous les produits soient conformes aux exigences réglementaires, juridiques, financières et de marque locales

- Maintenir le respect de Zurich et les processus de conformité et d'approbation des partenaires dans toutes les activités d'optimisation

Amélioration continue

- Favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce aux pratiques optimales de gestion de projet et aux enseignements tirés

- Contribuer à l'élaboration de normes, de modèles et de façons de travailler pour une équipe mondiale en mouvement rapide

- Partager les connaissances et les points de vue des équipes terrestres et extracôtières pour renforcer les capacités collectives

Ce que vous apporterez

Expérience et éducation

- Baccalauréat (ou équivalent) en affaires, marketing numérique, gestion de projet, ou un domaine connexe

- 2+ ans d'expérience en gestion de projet, idéalement au sein d'une organisation multinationale

- Certification de gestion de projet reconnue (PMP, PRINCE2 ou équivalent); L'expérience agile est un plus

- Un succès démontré en travaillant avec des équipes offshore ou distribuées à l'échelle mondiale

- L'expérience en matière de voyages, d'assurance ou de services financiers est avantageuse

Compétences techniques & domaine

- Connaissance des systèmes de gestion de contenu et des plateformes de marketing numérique

- Connaissance pratique des technologies Web (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

- L'expérience de gestion de l'optimisation numérique ou des initiatives de test A/B est un avantage

Sympa d'avoir

- Exposition aux outils Adobe Experience Cloud (par exemple AEM, Target, Analytics)

- Expérience de la réalisation de projets avec des partenaires intégrés à la technologie et non intégrés

- Compréhension des exigences réglementaires et de conformité multimarchés

Qui vous êtes

- Très organisé, axé sur les détails et capable de gérer des initiatives complexes

- Un communicateur clair et proactif qui maintient les intervenants alignés sans inciter

- Travail confortable et indépendant entre les priorités concurrentes et les fuseaux horaires

- Sensibilisation culturelle, collaboration et efficacité dans les équipes internationales

- Résilient, axé sur les solutions et confortable navigation ambiguïté et changement

- Un joueur d'équipe qui comprend que les connexions fortes conduisent à des résultats forts

Pourquoi Zurich ?

À Zurich, nous construisons un avenir meilleur — ensemble. Le Zurich Cover‐More Rapid Learning Lab est l'endroit où l'expérimentation rencontre son impact, et votre travail influencera directement la façon dont nous livrons des expériences numériques performantes dans le monde entier.

Nous offrons une culture solidaire et inclusive où vos idées comptent, votre croissance est prioritaire, et la distance n'est jamais un obstacle à l'appartenance.

Zurich est un employeur à chances égales. Nous célébrons la diversité et sommes déterminés à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés

jobs.title: Beca Claims - Análisis de Datos
jobs.description:
¡Hola!

Soy Leyre, recruiter de esta posición. Me encanta escribir y leer historias de terror, pero de lo que más disfruto es de una buena comida familiar con las personas que más quiero. Si te gusta la música de los setenta y ochenta tanto como a mí, ¡conectaremos seguro!

Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales.

¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo.

Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega!

¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN:

- Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2024 hicimos más de 20.000 horas de activismo.

- En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección). ¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas.

Y te preguntarás: Leyre, ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento):

- Aportar perspectivas y análisis de datos en favor de clientes, distribuidores y/o Unidades de Negocio internas.

- Ayudar en el desarrollo, mantenimiento y análisis de informes y cuadros de mando internos y externos , indicadores clave de rendimiento, información financiera u operativa y proyecciones usando múltiples fuentes de datos.

- Solucionar consultas de Unidades de Negocio internas para respaldar las decisiones diarias , la planificación estratégica y los problemas específicos de rendimiento empresarial.

A estas alturas, te estarás preguntando, ¿cómo sé si encajo?

No te preocupes, no te voy a pedir que salves el planeta ni que cumplas el 100% de los requisitos.

- Capacidad analítica.

- Experto/a en uso de Excel.

- Se valorarán conocimientos de otras herramientas de Bases de Datos y BI.

- Conocimiento de Uipath, Python y Power Automate.

- Experto en uso de Power BI.

¿Te interesa? Estamos deseando conocerte, pero antes tienes que saber…

- Se requiere poder realizar un convenio de colaboración con la Universidad y/o Escuela de Negocios de un mínimo de 12 meses.

- No paramos de crecer y si esto funciona, ¡nos encantaría contar contigo!

- Jornada parcial (5 horas al día en horario de mañana de lunes a viernes).

- La ubicación será en nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

- Son prácticas remuneradas de 800€.

- Además, tendrás acceso a formación, ¡y mucho más!

Ahora mismo, o estás con la emoción de cuando un pantalón te entra perfecto o estás pensando: “esto no es para mí” (si no es para ti, no pasa nada, ya nos volveremos a encontrar en el futuro). Puedes hacer de celestina compartiendo mi contacto con quien creas que pueda encajar.

Si has llegado hasta aquí, GRACIAS por leerme. ¿Qué te ha parecido? ¿Molamos o no? Si has sentido mariposas en el estómago y crees que encajamos, manda señales de humo, o el CV, si no te va bien lo del humo.

Y para ir terminando, ¿quieres saber qué opinan otras personas que forman parte de Zurich? Yo te diría que seguimos estando en lo más alto en Top Employers España como carta de presentación, pero te animo a echar un vistazo a nuestro perfil de Glassdoor para que sean ellas quiénes te lo cuenten. Sin trampa ni cartón.

Espero conocerte muy pronto.

Leyre Romea

Enviar candidatura ahora »

- Solucionar consultas de Unidades de Negocio internas para respaldar las decisionses diarias , la planificación estratégica y los problemas específicos de rendimiiento empresarial.

jobs.title: Senior Claims Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Summary

To handle single and multi-party personal or commercial line claims of moderate to high exposure and complexity within specific authority limits, to ensure that claims are handled in the most efficient, effective way while delivering a customer-centric claims service.

Job Qualifications
Required:
• Bachelor’s Degree and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims and/ or Litigation Management area.

OR
• Juris Doctor and 2 or more years of experience in the Claims and/ or Litigation Management area.

OR
• Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including an Associate Degree with 6 or more years of experience in the Claims and/ or Litigation Management area.

OR
• Completion of Zurich Claims Training Program and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims and/ or Litigation Management area.

OR
• High School Diploma Equivalent and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims and/ or Litigation Management area.

AND
• Must obtain and maintain required adjuster license(s)
• Microsoft Office experience
• Knowledge of insurance regulations, markets and products

Preferred:
• Effective verbal and written communication skills
• Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills
• Strong multi-tasking and prioritization skills
• Experience collaborating in a team environment and building cross functional working relationships
• Proactively shares and promotes sharing of insights
• Ability to gather unique perspectives from other teams/functions to optimize outcomes.
• Understands, analyzes, and applies the component parts of an insurance policy for complex claims
• Ability to follow reserving process for indemnity and expense in analyzing the potential exposure of complex claims
• Ability to determine the scope and exposure for complex claims
• Ability to leverage trend and relationships to provide high-quality customer service
• Well-versed in identifying, understanding and explaining complex financial and/or actuarial trends/concepts.
• Ability to effectively communicate coverage determinations to customers/clients/brokers for complex claims
• Ability to direct counsel on an ongoing basis to guide the course of complex litigation and settlement strategies

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

• Document claims file by accurately capturing and updating claims data/information in compliance with best practices for single and multi-party personal or commercial line claims of moderate to high exposure and complexity.
• Exercise judgment to determine liability by gathering and analyzing relevant facts; utilizing applicable law; establishing basic principles of negligence.
• Exercise judgment to determine policy verification and coverage determination by analyzing applicable coverage for claims and determining whether the loss falls within the coverage.
• Work to have a timely resolution to claims by developing case strategy; developing a case evaluation; escalating issues as appropriate.
• Establish timely reserves and perform ongoing review throughout claims cycle within authority limit by estimating and validating value of claims.
• Assess damages by calculating applicable damages or range of damages allowed by law.
• Negotiate settlement of claim by establishing appropriate negotiation strategy and utilizing available tools and resources within authority limits.
• Meet quality standards by following best practices

Job Functions

• May participate in customer marketing efforts.

Business Accountabilities

• Lead a team of claims handling specialists to develop and implement business processes and manage performance across all activities in order to achieve business objectives and continuously improve performance.
• Translate business objectives into clearly defined business cases, costs or schedules in order to support the achievement of claims.
• Monitor and control allocated human and material resources assigned to project work, maintaining financial and progress forecasting in order to ensure projects are delivered according to schedule and within budget.
• Supervise and quality-assure the drafting of key claims handling policy documents to ensure full compliance to the organization's rules and regulations governing transactions.
• Oversee compliance with claims policies, procedures, systems and processes across multiple countries/Line of Business to protect the organization's interests.
• Analyze key themes from a wide range of data sources in order to identify trends and areas for business improvement providing potential solutions.
• Contribute to the development of process and lead the implementation of systems and process improvements in claims handling.
• Provide technical guidance and recommendations as a subject matter expert in order to support the resolution of the most complex customer cases and develop precedents to improve customer service.
• Manage key internal and external stakeholder relationships across the organization in order to ensure colleagues are informed on relevant issues.
• Act as a technical expert for own team and internal customers and maintains up to date knowledge of own area of expertise so that operational claims team can best serve customers.

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

- Location(s): MY - Kuala Lumpur

- Remote working:

- Schedule: Full Time

- Recruiter name: Marina Destiana

- Closing date:

Sintesi del lavoro

Per gestire le richieste di linea personali o commerciali di singole e multiparti di esposizione da moderata a elevata e complessità entro limiti di autorità specifici, al fine di garantire che i reclami siano gestiti in modo più efficiente, efficace, durante la fornitura di un servizio di reclami incentrati sul cliente.

Qualifiche di lavoro
Richiesto:
• Bachelor’s Degree e 6 o più anni di esperienza nell’area Claims and/ or Litigation Management.

O
• Juris Doctor e 2 o più anni di esperienza nell'area Reclami e/o Litigation Management.

O
• Apprendistato di assicurazione certificato di Zurigo, tra cui una laurea associata con 6 o più anni di esperienza nell'area Claims and/ or Litigation Management.

O
• Completamento del programma di formazione per i reclami di Zurigo e 6 o più anni di esperienza nell'area Reclami e/o Gestione delle controversie.

O
• Diploma High School Equivalent e 8 o più anni di esperienza nell'area Claims and/ or Litigation Management.

E
• Deve ottenere e mantenere necessaria la licenza di regolazione(i)
• Esperienza Microsoft Office
• Conoscenza delle normative, dei mercati e dei prodotti assicurativi

Preferito:
• Capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta efficaci
• Forte analitica, pensiero critico e capacità di problem solving
• Forte multi-tasking e competenze di priorità
• Esperienza di collaborazione in un ambiente di team e costruzione di rapporti di lavoro funzionali
• Proattivamente condivide e promuove la condivisione di approfondimenti
• Capacità di raccogliere prospettive uniche da altre squadre / funzioni per ottimizzare i risultati.
• Comprende, analizza e applica le parti componenti di una polizza assicurativa per crediti complessi
• Capacità di seguire il processo di conservazione per indennitÃ e spese nell'analisi della potenziale esposizione di crediti complessi
• Capacità di determinare la portata e l'esposizione per reclami complessi
• Capacità di sfruttare la tendenza e le relazioni per fornire un servizio clienti di alta qualità
• Ben diversificato nell'individuazione, nella comprensione e nella spiegazione di tendenze/concetti finanziari e/o attuariali complessi.
• Capacità di comunicare efficacemente le determinazioni di copertura a clienti/clienti/brokers per reclami complessi
• Capacità di orientare il consiglio su base continuativa per guidare il corso di complesse strategie di contenzioso e di regolamento

Capacità di lavoro - Capacità di contabilità chiave

• Documento sostiene file catturando e aggiornando con precisione i dati/informazioni di reclamo in conformità alle best practice per le richieste di linea personali o commerciali singole e multiparti di esposizione e complessità moderata a elevata.
• Giudizio di esercizio per determinare la responsabilità raccogliendo e analizzando fatti pertinenti; utilizzando la legge applicabile; stabilire principi fondamentali di negligenza.
• Giudizio di esercizio per determinare la verifica della politica e la determinazione della copertura analizzando la copertura applicabile per i reclami e determinare se la perdita rientra nella copertura.
• Lavorare per avere una risoluzione tempestiva ai reclami attraverso lo sviluppo di una strategia di caso; lo sviluppo di una valutazione di caso; l'escalation di problemi come appropriato.
• Stabilire riserve tempestive e eseguire la revisione in corso durante il ciclo di rivendicazioni entro il limite di autorità stimando e convalidando il valore dei crediti.
• Valutare i danni calcolando i danni applicabili o la gamma di danni consentiti dalla legge.
• Negoziare la liquidazione del reclamo stabilendo una strategia di negoziazione appropriata e utilizzando strumenti e risorse disponibili entro limiti di autorità.
• Soddisfare gli standard di qualità seguendo le migliori pratiche

Stellenbeschreibung

Handhabung von Einzel- und Mehrparteienforderungen von mittlerer bis hoher Exposition und Komplexität innerhalb spezifischer Behördengrenzen, um sicherzustellen, dass Forderungen auf die effizienteste und effektivste Weise behandelt werden, während ein kundenorientierter Schadensdienst bereitgestellt wird.

Berufsqualifikationen
Vorgeschrieben:
• Bachelor-Abschluss und 6 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Claims und / oder Litigation Management.

ODER
• Juris Doctor und 2 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Claims and/oder Litigation Management.

ODER
• Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, einschließlich eines Associate Degree mit 6 oder mehr Jahren Erfahrung im Bereich Claims und / oder Litigation Management.

ODER
• Abschluss des Zurich Claims Training Program und 6 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Claims and/oder Litigation Management.

ODER
• High School Diploma Equivalent und 8 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Claims und / oder Litigation Management.

UND
• Muss die erforderliche(n) Adjuster-Lizenz(en) erhalten und beibehalten
• Microsoft Office Erfahrung
• Kenntnis der Versicherungsvorschriften, Märkte und Produkte

Bevorzugt:
• Effektive verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• Starke analytische, kritische Denk- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten
• Starke Multitasking- und Priorisierungskompetenzen
• Erleben Sie die Zusammenarbeit in einer Teamumgebung und den Aufbau funktionsübergreifender Arbeitsbeziehungen
• Proaktiv teilt und fördert den Austausch von Erkenntnissen
• Fähigkeit, einzigartige Perspektiven von anderen Teams / Funktionen zu sammeln, um die Ergebnisse zu optimieren.
• Versteht, analysiert und wendet die Bestandteile einer Versicherungspolice für komplexe Ansprüche an
• Fähigkeit, den Reservierungsprozess für Entschädigung und Kosten bei der Analyse des potenziellen Risikos komplexer Forderungen zu befolgen
• Fähigkeit, den Umfang und die Risikoposition für komplexe Forderungen zu bestimmen
• Fähigkeit, Trends und Beziehungen zu nutzen, um qualitativ hochwertigen Kundenservice zu bieten
• Versiert in der Identifizierung, Verständnis und Erklärung komplexer finanzieller und / oder versicherungsmathematischer Trends / Konzepte.
• Fähigkeit, Abdeckungsbestimmungen für Kunden / Kunden / Broker für komplexe Forderungen effektiv zu kommunizieren
• Fähigkeit, laufend zu beraten, um den Verlauf komplexer Rechtsstreitigkeiten und Abwicklungsstrategien zu leiten

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

• Dokumentieren Sie die Schadensakte durch genaue Erfassung und Aktualisierung der Schadensdaten/-informationen in Übereinstimmung mit bewährten Verfahren für persönliche oder kommerzielle Einzel- oder Mehrparteienforderungen von mittlerer bis hoher Exposition und Komplexität.
• Üben Sie ein Urteil aus, um die Haftung zu bestimmen, indem Sie relevante Fakten sammeln und analysieren; Anwendung des geltenden Rechts; Festlegung der Grundprinzipien der Fahrlässigkeit.
• Üben Sie ein Urteil aus, um die Überprüfung der Richtlinien und die Bestimmung der Deckung zu bestimmen, indem Sie die anwendbare Deckung für Ansprüche analysieren und bestimmen, ob der Verlust in die Deckung fällt.
• Arbeiten Sie daran, Ansprüche rechtzeitig zu lösen, indem Sie eine Fallstrategie entwickeln; eine Fallbewertung entwickeln; Probleme gegebenenfalls eskalieren.
• Richten Sie rechtzeitige Reserven ein und führen Sie eine laufende Überprüfung während des gesamten Schadenzyklus innerhalb der Autoritätsgrenze durch, indem Sie den Wert der Forderungen schätzen und validieren.
• Beurteilen Sie den Schaden, indem Sie den anwendbaren Schaden oder die gesetzlich zulässige Schadensspanne berechnen.
• Verhandeln Sie die Beilegung von Ansprüchen, indem Sie eine angemessene Verhandlungsstrategie festlegen und verfügbare Werkzeuge und Ressourcen innerhalb der Zuständigkeitsgrenzen nutzen.
• Qualitätsstandards erfüllen, indem Sie Best Practices befolgen

Job Funktionen

• Kann an den Bemühungen des Kundenmarketings teilnehmen.

Unternehmensbuchhaltung

• Führen Sie ein Team von Schadenbearbeitungsspezialisten, um Geschäftsprozesse zu entwickeln und umzusetzen und die Leistung in allen Aktivitäten zu verwalten, um Geschäftsziele zu erreichen und die Leistung kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
• Übersetzen Sie Geschäftsziele in klar definierte Geschäftsfälle, Kosten oder Zeitpläne, um die Erreichung von Ansprüchen zu unterstützen.
• Überwachung und Kontrolle der zugewiesenen personellen und materiellen Ressourcen für die Projektarbeit, Aufrechterhaltung der Finanz- und Fortschrittsprognosen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Projekte nach Zeitplan und innerhalb des Budgets durchgeführt werden.
• Beaufsichtigen und Qualitätssicherung der Erstellung von Schlüsselansprüchen, die politische Dokumente behandeln, um die vollständige Einhaltung der Regeln und Vorschriften der Organisation für Transaktionen sicherzustellen.
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Einhaltung von Schadensrichtlinien, -verfahren, -systemen und -prozessen in mehreren Ländern/Line of Business, um die Interessen der Organisation zu schützen.
• Analysieren Sie Schlüsselthemen aus einer Vielzahl von Datenquellen, um Trends und Bereiche für Geschäftsverbesserungen zu identifizieren, die potenzielle Lösungen bieten.
• Tragen Sie zur Entwicklung von Prozessen bei und leiten Sie die Implementierung von Systemen und Prozessverbesserungen im Schadenmanagement.
• Bieten Sie technische Anleitung und Empfehlungen als Fachexperte an, um die Lösung der komplexesten Kundenfälle zu unterstützen und Präzedenzfälle zur Verbesserung des Kundenservice zu entwickeln.
• Verwalten Sie wichtige interne und externe Stakeholder-Beziehungen im gesamten Unternehmen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Kollegen über relevante Themen informiert sind.
• Handeln Sie als technischer Experte für das eigene Team und interne Kunden und halten Sie aktuelle Kenntnisse des eigenen Fachgebiets, damit das operative Schadenteam die Kunden bestmöglich bedienen kann.

Du bist das Herz und die Seele von Zürich!

Bei Zurich denken wir gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hinterfragen den Status Quo. Wir gehen optimistisch vor, indem wir uns auf das Positive konzentrieren und ständig fragen: Was kann richtig gehen?

Wir legen großen Wert auf die Erfahrung und das Know-how unserer Mitarbeiter und bieten eine breite Palette von Möglichkeiten in allen Geschäftsbereichen, um Sie zu ermutigen, sich für neue Möglichkeiten innerhalb von Zürich zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit für Ihren nächsten Karriereschritt sind.

Lasst uns gemeinsam weiter wachsen!

Résumé de l'emploi

Traiter les réclamations individuelles ou commerciales d'exposition modérée à élevée et de complexité dans des limites d'autorité précises, afin de s'assurer que les réclamations sont traitées de la manière la plus efficace et la plus efficiente tout en fournissant un service de réclamations axé sur la clientèle.

Qualifications professionnelles
Requis :
• Baccalauréat Diplôme et 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine des réclamations et/ou de la gestion des litiges.

OU
• Juris Doctor et 2 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la gestion des réclamations et/ou des litiges.

OU
• Apprentis d'assurance agréé de Zurich, y compris un diplôme associé de 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine des réclamations et/ou de la gestion des litiges.

OU
• Achèvement du programme de formation sur les réclamations de Zurich et de 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la gestion des réclamations et/ou des litiges.

OU
• Diplôme d'études secondaires Équivalent et 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine des réclamations et/ou de la gestion des litiges.

PAYS
• Doit obtenir et maintenir la ou les licences de réglage requises
• Expérience de Microsoft Office
• Connaissance des règlements, des marchés et des produits d'assurance

Préféré:
• Compétences efficaces en communication verbale et écrite
• Forte capacité d'analyse, de pensée critique et de résolution de problèmes
• Fortes compétences multitâches et hiérarchisation
• Expérience de collaboration dans un environnement d'équipe et d'établissement de relations de travail interfonctionnelles
• Partage et promotion proactive des idées
• Capacité de recueillir des perspectives uniques auprès d'autres équipes/fonctions pour optimiser les résultats.
• Comprendre, analyser et appliquer les composantes d'une police d'assurance pour les réclamations complexes
• Capacité de suivre le processus de réservation pour l'indemnisation et les dépenses dans l'analyse de l'exposition potentielle de revendications complexes
• Capacité de déterminer la portée et l'exposition des allégations complexes
• Capacité de tirer parti des tendances et des relations pour fournir un service à la clientèle de haute qualité
• Bien cerner, comprendre et expliquer les tendances/concepts financiers et/ou actuariels complexes.
• Capacité de communiquer efficacement les déterminations de couverture aux clients/clients/courtiers pour les réclamations complexes
• Capacité de diriger les avocats de façon continue afin de guider le déroulement des litiges complexes et des stratégies de règlement

Responsabilités au travail - Principales responsabilités

• Documenter le dossier des réclamations en saisissant et en mettant à jour avec précision les données et les renseignements sur les réclamations conformément aux pratiques exemplaires pour les réclamations individuelles et multipartites de lignes personnelles ou commerciales d'exposition et de complexité modérées à élevées.
• Faire preuve de jugement pour déterminer la responsabilité en recueillant et en analysant les faits pertinents; utiliser la loi applicable; établir les principes fondamentaux de la négligence.
• Faire preuve de jugement pour déterminer la vérification de la politique et la détermination de la couverture en analysant la couverture applicable pour les réclamations et en déterminant si la perte relève de la couverture.
• Faire en sorte que les demandes soient réglées en temps opportun par l'élaboration d'une stratégie de cas; élaborer une évaluation de cas; accroître les questions au besoin.
• Établir des réserves en temps opportun et procéder à un examen continu tout au long du cycle des réclamations dans les limites de l'autorisation en estimant et en validant la valeur des réclamations.
• Évaluer les dommages-intérêts en calculant les dommages-intérêts applicables ou l'ensemble des dommages-intérêts autorisés par la loi.
• Négocier le règlement des revendications en établissant une stratégie de négociation appropriée et en utilisant les outils et les ressources disponibles dans les limites des pouvoirs.
• Respecter les normes de qualité en suivant les meilleures pratiques

Fonctions de travail

• Peut participer aux efforts de marketing des clients.

Responsabilités des entreprises

• Diriger une équipe de spécialistes du traitement des réclamations pour élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des processus opérationnels et gérer le rendement dans toutes les activités afin d'atteindre les objectifs opérationnels et d'améliorer continuellement le rendement.
• Traduire les objectifs commerciaux en analyses de rentabilisation, en coûts ou en calendrier clairement définis afin d'appuyer la réalisation des réclamations.
• Surveiller et contrôler les ressources humaines et matérielles affectées aux travaux des projets, en maintenant des prévisions financières et des progrès afin de s'assurer que les projets sont exécutés conformément au calendrier et dans les limites du budget.
• Superviser et assurer la qualité de la rédaction des principaux documents de politique sur le traitement des réclamations afin d'assurer la pleine conformité aux règles et règlements de l'organisation régissant les opérations.
• Surveiller la conformité aux politiques, aux procédures, aux systèmes et aux processus relatifs aux réclamations dans plusieurs pays/secteur d'activité afin de protéger les intérêts de l'organisation.
• Analyser les thèmes clés d'un large éventail de sources de données afin d'identifier les tendances et les domaines d'amélioration des entreprises offrant des solutions potentielles.
• Contribuer à l'élaboration du processus et diriger la mise en oeuvre des systèmes et l'amélioration du processus de traitement des demandes.
• Fournir des conseils et des recommandations techniques en tant qu'expert en la matière afin d'aider à résoudre les cas de clients les plus complexes et de créer des précédents pour améliorer le service à la clientèle.
• Gérer les principales relations entre les intervenants internes et externes dans l'ensemble de l'organisation afin de s'assurer que les collègues sont informés des questions pertinentes.
• Agir en tant qu'expert technique pour son équipe et ses clients internes et maintenir à jour la connaissance de son domaine d'expertise afin que l'équipe des réclamations opérationnelles puisse le mieux servir ses clients.

Vous êtes le cœur et l'âme de Zurich !

À Zurich, nous aimons penser en dehors de la boîte et défier le statu quo. Nous adoptons une approche optimiste en nous concentrant sur les positifs et nous demandons constamment ce qui peut aller bien?

Nous apprécions hautement l'expérience et le savoir-faire de nos collaborateurs et offrons un large éventail d'opportunités dans tous les secteurs d'activité pour vous encourager à postuler de nouvelles opportunités à Zurich lorsque vous êtes prêt pour votre prochaine étape de carrière.

Les lets continuent de grandir ensemble !

jobs.description:
Purpose

- Performing analytical and actuarial pricing duties in order to provide strong data governance and highly accurate data and analyses for use by more senior pricing actuaries in relation to reserving, reporting, quantitative risk management or the pricing of business.

- Advise on the pricing and design of new products (covering technical and market-based pricing), with a focus on protection products.

- Solves business challenges with statistical and predictive modeling techniques such as Exposure Curves, GLMs, machine learning, decision trees, probability networks, association rules, clustering, regression, and neural networks and their application to business decisions.

Key Accountabilities

- Lead and develop a high-performing actuarial pricing team to deliver accurate and timely pricing solutions.

- Oversee the development, implementation, and maintenance of models such as but not limited to pricing, capital, P&L, APMP, ZRC, conversion and retention ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.

- Perform complex statistical analyses, data mining, and modeling to support pricing and financial decisions.

- Leverage advanced analytical techniques to identify trends, assess risks, and optimize pricing strategies.

- Ensure data integrity through robust data governance practices.

- Manage data collection, cleaning, and validation processes.

- Develop and maintain pricing databases to support model development and analysis.

- Collaborate closely with business partners to understand their needs and provide actuarial expertise.

- Communicate complex technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Support business decision-making through insightful statistical and actuarial analysis and recommendations.

- Drive new product development initiatives through actuarial pricing expertise.

- Conduct market analysis and competitor benchmarking to inform pricing strategies.

- Develop and implement pricing methodologies for new products.

- Maintain compliance with actuarial standards and regulatory requirements.

- Prepare and submit required pricing reports and product documentation in navigating local filings and global product/risk authority approval process.

- Stay updated on industry trends and regulatory changes.

- Guide, train and mentor and professional development of pricing staff under supervision.

- Monitor business unit’s performance through actuarial and financial measures on key performance indices and present deep dive results & variances in company’s forum.

- Participate and contribute to business unit’s Country Underwriting Plan and other quarterly business review event.

- Support business unit’s Propositions in new product development and repricing/refresh initiatives with a focus on protection products and identify opportunities/need for product repricing in protection, based on demand from Business Units (BUs) and competitive landscape from market trends.

- Demonstrate and continuously expand increasing knowledge of actuarial disciplines and procedures to build value adding, relevant technical knowledge.

- Actively pursue local actuarial qualification.

Performance Management Accountabilities

- Demonstrate commitment to corporate values.

- Take accountability for participating in the performance management cycle.

- Take action to improve team performance on the job.

- Provide input into team performance management discussions of project team members.

- Educate team members and business partners in the area of technical expertise.

- Assist and support co-workers.

- Take action to manage own/team personal development and encourage others to do the same.

Skills

- Having strong language proficiency (listening, speaking and writing) in Malay and English

- Critical Thinking – Proficiency Level Advance

- Problem Solving - Proficiency Level Advance

- Statistical Concepts - Proficiency Level Expert

- Actuarial Pricing Concepts – Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Actuarial Reserving Concepts – Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Financial Mathematics - Proficiency Level Advance

- Probability - Proficiency Level Advance

- Effective Communication - Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Stakeholder Management - Proficiency Level Advance

- Relationship Management - Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Leadership – Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Data Tools and Management Literacy - Proficiency Level Advance

Education and Experience

- Bachelors degree in Actuarial Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistic, or equivalent in relevant field at minimum.

- Typically four or more years of experience in related field.

- Pursuing professional actuarial qualification (UK,US or Australia)

- H aving experience in working with either of thse programming statistical tools such as MS Excel-VBA, Power BI, SAS, SQL, R, Python, Emblem, Radar or Prophet

Disclaimer and Caveat

This job profile is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of all duties, responsibilities and activities that may be required in this job. Further, duties, responsibilities and activities may change from time to time due to business needs of the Company. This job profile is a guideline only and does not establish any type of guarantee as to duties, responsibilities and activities and, in Malaysia, it does not alter the at-will employment status of your employment.

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

Oggetto

- Esecuzione dei dazi analitici e attuariali in materia di prezzi al fine di fornire una forte governance dei dati e dati e analisi altamente accurate per l'uso da parte di più alti attuatori di prezzi in relazione alla conservazione, alla segnalazione, alla gestione dei rischi quantitativi o ai prezzi delle imprese.

- Consigliare i prezzi e la progettazione di nuovi prodotti (copertura dei prezzi tecnici e basati sul mercato), con un focus sui prodotti di protezione.

- Sostenere le sfide aziendali con tecniche di modellazione statistica e predittiva come le curve di esposizione, GLM, machine learning, alberi di decisione, reti di probabilità, regole di associazione, clustering, regressione e reti neurali e la loro applicazione alle decisioni aziendali.

- Durchführung analytischer und versicherungsmathematischer Preispflichten, um eine starke Data Governance und hochpräzise Daten und Analysen für die Verwendung durch hochrangigere Preismathematiker in Bezug auf Reservierung, Berichterstattung, quantitatives Risikomanagement oder die Preisgestaltung von Unternehmen bereitzustellen.

- Führen und entwickeln Sie ein leistungsstarkes versicherungsmathematisches Preisteam, um genaue und zeitnahe Preislösungen zu liefern.

- Exécuter des fonctions d'analyse et d'évaluation actuarielle afin d'assurer une bonne gouvernance des données et d'obtenir des données et des analyses hautement précises à l'intention des actuaires supérieurs chargés de la tarification en ce qui concerne la réservation, la déclaration, la gestion quantitative des risques ou la tarification des entreprises.

- Conseiller sur la tarification et la conception de nouveaux produits (couvrant la tarification technique et fondée sur le marché), en mettant l'accent sur les produits de protection.

- Détermine les défis d'affaires avec des techniques de modélisation statistique et prédictive telles que les courbes d'exposition, les GLM, l'apprentissage automatique, les arbres de décision, les réseaux de probabilité, les règles d'association, le regroupement, la régression et les réseaux neuronaux et leur application aux décisions d'affaires.

Principales responsabilités

- Dirigez et développez une équipe de tarification actuarielle à haut rendement afin de fournir des solutions de tarification précises et opportunes.

jobs.description:
Purpose

- Performing analytical and actuarial pricing duties in order to provide strong data governance and highly accurate data and analyses for use by more senior pricing actuaries in relation to reserving, reporting, quantitative risk management or the pricing of business.

- Advise on the pricing and design of new products (covering technical and market-based pricing), with a focus on protection products.

- Solves business challenges with statistical and predictive modeling techniques such as Exposure Curves, GLMs, machine learning, decision trees, probability networks, association rules, clustering, regression, and neural networks and their application to business decisions.

Role Overview

This role requires a seasoned actuarial professional to provide technical leadership and expertise in pricing and product development. The successful candidate will be responsible for complex data analysis, model development, and implementation, as well as mentoring junior staff and contributing to strategic business initiatives.

Core Accountabilities

- Data Management and Analysis:

- Oversee data quality and integrity, including reconciliation, risk factor management, and database maintenance.

- Conduct advanced statistical analysis and data manipulation to inform pricing and product decisions.

- Develop and implement data strategies to support business objectives.

- Model Development and Validation:

- Lead the development, implementation, and validation of complex pricing models.

- Perform in-depth model performance analysis and recommend enhancements.

- Stay abreast of industry best practices and emerging modeling techniques.

- Financial Analysis and Reporting:

- Produce comprehensive financial and statistical reports for senior management.

- Conduct in-depth analysis of portfolio performance and identify trends.

- Support business decision-making through insightful data-driven insights.

- Product Development:

- Lead pricing and product development initiatives, providing technical expertise and guidance.

- Conduct advanced market analysis and competitor benchmarking.

- Develop and implement pricing strategies to optimize profitability and market share.

- Team Leadership and Development:

- Mentor and develop junior actuarial staff.

- Foster a collaborative and high-performing team culture.

- Share knowledge and expertise to enhance team capabilities.

- Regulatory Compliance:

- Ensure adherence to actuarial standards and regulatory requirements.

- Support local regulatory filings and global group empowerment initiatives.

- Collaboration and Communication:

- Effectively communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives.

- Contribute to a positive and collaborative work environment.

Core Competencies

- Proven experience in actuarial pricing and product development.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Good foundation of statistical and modeling skills.

- Good self-initiatives and mentoring abilities.

- Proficiency in any relevant statistical software and programming languages (e.g., VBA, SAS, Python, R, or SQL)

- Strong foundation understanding of actuarial principles and practices on pricing methodologies

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- Attention to detail and accuracy

- Have progress towards actuarial qualifications or other professional equivalent

- Experience with data visualization tools

- Understanding of local BNM regulatory requirement in General Insurance and General Takaful landscape

Performance Management Accountabilities

- Demonstrate commitment to corporate values.

- Take accountability for participating in the performance management cycle.

- Take action to improve performance on the job.

- Provide input into performance management discussions of project team members.

- Educate team members and business partners on area of technical expertise.

- Assist and support co-workers.

- Take action to manage own personal development and encourage others to do the same.

Skills

- Having strong language proficiency (listening, speaking and writing) in Malay and English

- Analytical & Critical Thinking – Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Problem Solving - Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Statistical Concepts - Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Actuarial Pricing Concepts – Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Actuarial Reserving Concepts – Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Financial Mathematics - Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Probability - Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Effective Communication - Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Stakeholder Management - Proficiency Level Intermediate

- Relationship Management - Proficiency Level Basic

- Data Tools and Management Literacy - Proficiency Level Intermediate

Education and Experience

- Bachelors degree in Actuarial Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistic, or equivalent at minimum.

- Typically two or more years of experience in related field.

- Not Required but having these skillsets will better facilitate your transition into this role.

- Having experience in working with programming statistical tools such as MS Excel-VBA, Power BI, SAS, SQL, R, Python, Emblem, Radar or Prophet

- Pursuing professional actuarial qualification (UK,US or Australia)

Disclaimer and Caveat

This job profile is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of all duties, responsibilities and activities that may be required in this job. Further, duties, responsibilities and activities may change from time to time due to business needs of the Company. This job profile is a guideline only and does not establish any type of guarantee as to duties, responsibilities and activities and, in Malaysia, it does not alter the at-will employment status of your employment.

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Casualty & Professional Indemnity Underwriter

Place of work: Warsaw

Job purpose:

Shape the future of Casualty and PI insurance in our new Polish branch! If you enjoy making decisions, negotiating with business partners, and want to have a tangible impact on the mid-market and industrial/large corporate insurance segment, this opportunity is for you.

Responsibilities:

- Independently manage underwriting for mid-sized and large (corporate and industrial) clients with a focus on liability and professional indemnity coverages

- Conduct risk analyses, prepare quotations, negotiate terms, and renew insurance contracts in line with local and group standards

- Implement and manage insurance contracts for domestic and international business

- Monitor market trends and emerging liability risks; adapt strategies to maintain competitiveness

- Collaborate closely with Risk Engineering, Sales, and Claims

Candidate’s profile:

- 5+ years of experience in Casualty and/or Professional Indemnity underwriting within mid-sized or industrial corporate insurance

- Proven track record in managing profitable underwriting portfolios and strategic initiatives

- Deep understanding of liability insurance markets, products, and regulations

- University degree in Business, Finance, or related field; professional insurance qualifications preferred

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and analytical skills

- Proactive, independent, customer-focused, and collaborative mindset

- Fluent in Polish and English (spoken and written); German language skills are an advantage

-

Private medical care

jobs.title: RCIS Crop Claims Specialist (Kansas)
jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for a to join our Rural Community Insurance Services (RCIS) team. RCIS is one of the leading crop insurance providers in the U.S. RCIS offers insurance protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 3,600 licensed agents. RCIS offers a wide range of private product coverages, including a diverse selection of named-peril options, supplemental and stand-alone insurance products as well as federal crop insurance plans through the United States Department of Agriculture’s Risk Management Agency. Together with RCIS agents, we protect America’s farmers and ranchers.

Zurich is looking for an RCIS Crop Claims Specialist to work out of Kansas state. This incumbent will work from a home-based office. This position is scheduled to work 40 hours per week. Approximately 50% travel is expected to cover the territory.

The ideal candidate will need to live and service within these following counties in Kansas: Mitchell, Cloud, Jewell, Lincoln

RCIS provides insurance and superior services through leading agents to protect America’s farmers and ranchers. It’s been an innovator in crop insurance since the crop insurance business was privatized by the federal government in 1980. Today it’s one of the nation’s largest crop insurance providers, offering risk management protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 4,000 professionally trained and licensed agents. This is a great opportunity to serve the agricultural community.

As an RCIS Crop Claims Specialist, your primary accountabilities will include:

- Work the most complex claims, involving multiple causes of loss, multiple quality issues, subrogation claims

- Exercise judgement to determine liability by gathering and analyzing relevant facts, utilizing applicable procedures

- Exercise judgement to determine policy verification and coverage determination by analyzing applicable coverage for claims and determining whether the loss falls within the coverage

- Assists with training of lower-level adjusters for both Multi-Peril Crop Insurance (MPCI) and Crop Hail (CH)

- Completes Quality Assurance type reviews such as conflict of interest, actual production history and high dollar reviews on MPCI policies with the ability to change unit structure pending review outcome

- Completes claims on specialty crops as designated by the local manager or area

- Completes Crop Hail re-inspections when requested for quality assurance purposes

- Works claims of 508H (Risk Management Agency pilot) crops

- Assist the national training team in adjuster trainings

- Serve as subject matter expert for projects and committees as assigned by management

- Assist with Team Member reviews and aid in identifying trends or issues that could affect the quality assurance of the Crop Claims team

- Assists with claims that may require subrogation and/or claims that may lead to litigation

- Protect Zurich’s reputation by keeping claims information confidential

- Maintain professional and technical knowledge by participating in education opportunities, staying current with industry trends, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies

Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 4 or years of experience in the agricultural or the crop insurance industry

AND

- Crop Adjuster Proficiency Program Certification (CAPP) must be obtained with 180 days of hire date

- Personal transportation and travel within assigned territory and travel outside of assigned are to assist with workload(s), participate on CAT team and/or provide remote assistance for the CROP Claims Care Center calls and/or CCP Claims

- RCIS Crop Adjuster Physical Requirements: walk in agricultural fields up to 3 miles, climb agricultural storage bins up to 25 feet, lift 25 lbs. to 50 lbs., work outdoors in varying temperatures/weather conditions

Preferred Qualifications:

- Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills

- Strong organization and prioritization skills

- Intermediate Microsoft Office skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed Salary range for this position is $49,500-$81,000, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.
