Do you want to accompany people in challenging life situations and support them with expertise and empathy?

In the area of damage collective life, we accompany insured persons and employers in crucial life situations. We ensure that performance requirements are tested and processed fairly, transparently and customer-oriented. For us, the focus is not only on regulations and legal requirements, but also on the people behind them.

In our team, you are an important point of contact for insured persons, employers and internal and external partners. You ensure professional case management, check performance requirements during incapacity for work and move safely between legal requirements, regulations and the individual needs of our customers. With your networked thinking, you recognize connections, find solutions and help ensure that performance cases are handled fairly, efficiently and customer-oriented.

We live “flexwork” and the hybrid workplace. You can work at the headquarters in Zurich-Oerlikon and in the home office, situationally and in consultation with your team. The flexibility must be designed in such a way that our business can be operated optimally at any time. The high-quality provision of our services to our customers and business partners must be guaranteed at all times, regardless of the respective working model.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become part of it and apply as a specialist services BVG.

What you do

- You check and assess benefits claims in cases of incapacity for work on the basis of the regulations.

- You obtain medical records, powers of attorney and insurance records, assess medical issues and initiate the necessary steps in the performance process.

- You coordinate the cooperation with day-time allowance, accident and social insurers as well as other internal and external stakeholders and assess the need for case management measures.

- You actively control your performance cases throughout the entire process, determine revisions and resubmissions and ensure their timely processing.

- You advise insured persons, employers and internal and external partners by telephone and in writing and ensure customer-oriented, transparent and timely case handling.

What you bring

- Commercial education, further education as a social security specialist (f/m/d)

- You already have experience within the 2nd pillar, experience in damage handling is an advantage

- Affinity in dealing with various IT applications

- High service and customer orientation

- Mother tongue in French

Your contact

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Eleni Bourtzakis +41 44 628 20 51

Additional information

Part-time or full-time: 80-100 %

Place of work: Oerlikon, Zurich

Hybrid work: 40%

I-REMOTE

We look forward to your online application – even without an application letter.
You are welcome to convince us of your motivation during a personal meeting.

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. The basis of our success is our 53,000 employees worldwide, who help our customers in 210 countries and territories to better understand and protect themselves against their risks. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. We stand for justice and equality among our employees, regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, religion, etc. The acquisition of our talents and the recruitment processes reflect this commitment in everyday life. Join us and become part of this culture.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? See here and become part of it.

Information for recruiters

Zurich does not accept unsolicited applications from recruiters for this position. Therefore, recruiters do not submit applicant documents to our employees or via our online career portal. We reject any responsibility for unsolicited applications and any fees and thank you for your understanding.

jobs.description:
#ZCC

Zurich Capability Center is currently hiring a:

Cloud Engineer - DevOps

In the Cloud Engineer – DevOps position you will oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of our CI/CD pipelines. You will understand software development methodologies and be able to work with development, platform, security, and infrastructure teams to refine the Infrastructure as Code (IaC) delivery process. The successful candidate will possess very strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to work independently to research and resolve issues.

Essential Functions:

- Engineer, automate and orchestrate system provisioning and maintenance processes using modern cloud tools and technologies. Evaluate, design, and implement supporting technologies in alignment with global and local requirements.

- Author requirements and design document for public cloud services and patterns to be deployed within the environment. Engage with architects, engineers, developers, and security officers to develop solutions.

- Manage repositories for IaC services, resources, and patterns. Develop SDLC standards for IaC and ensure they are communicated and adhered to. Mentor cloud engineers on key systems related to SDLC.

- Solve complex architecture challenges, apply architectural standards, and start using them on new projects.

- Design and build public cloud solutions using automation, orchestration, and deployment tools including Terraform, PowerShell, Ansible, Bash.

- Lead by example, contributing to code reviews, documentation and take on complex bug fixes, especially on high-risk problems.

- Perform system administration tasks including deployments, configuration, systems monitoring, troubleshooting, and support while innovating to automate as much as possible.

- Install, configure, maintain, and support applications, services, and servers in public cloud environments.

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues reported by monitoring systems and submitted through the ticketing system. Fully document issues, actions taken, and steps for resolution.

- Engineer and maintain operational processes and procedures.

- Focus on continued professional development to maintain knowledge and application of current industry best practices and security concepts.

- Exhibit an innovative mindset by suggesting improvements as well as engineering and implementing related recommendations. Strong desire to learn, implement, and teach others in new processes and technologies.

- Perform other tasks as defined, planned, and approved by leadership.

Experience Required:

- Advanced English level, with a focus on conversational skills

- Good understanding of DevOps process, standards, best practices followed in enterprise level with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps

- Demonstrated experience with software engineering, scripting, automation, and orchestration tools (Terraform, PowerShell, Ansible, GitHub)

- Demonstrated experience provisioning, configuring, and maintaining cloud computing services such as Azure and AWS.

- Demonstrated experience administering, monitoring, and maintaining both Microsoft and Linux server-based operating systems.

- Operational understanding of security best practices and standards around cloud computing and access management.

- Experience with management/maintenance of AWS Sagemaker

Educational Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or other related field with relevant work experience of 5+ years experience in the IT field, or equivalent experience in the IT field.

If you are interested, please apply directly through this link or send your CV to nathalia.huerta@mx.zurich.com

Position available only for candidates located in Mexico City, State of Mexico, or Guadalajara. Please apply only if you reside in one of these areas.

Who we are

Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. #ZCC

Zurich Capability Center is currently hiring a:

Cloud Engineer - DevOps

In the Cloud Engineer – DevOps position you will oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of our CI/CD pipelines. You will understand software development methodologies and be able to work with development, platform, security, and infrastructure teams to refine the Infrastructure as Code (IaC) delivery process. The successful candidate will possess very strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to work independently to research and resolve issues.

Essential Functions:

- Engineer, automate and orchestrate system provisioning and maintenance processes using modern cloud tools and technologies. Evaluate, design, and implement supporting technologies in alignment with global and local requirements.

- Author requirements and design document for public cloud services and patterns to be deployed within the environment. Engage with architects, engineers, developers, and security officers to develop solutions.

- Manage repositories for IaC services, resources, and patterns. Develop SDLC standards for IaC and ensure they are communicated and adhered to. Mentor cloud engineers on key systems related to SDLC.

- Solve complex architecture challenges, apply architectural standards, and start using them on new projects.

- Design and build public cloud solutions using automation, orchestration, and deployment tools including Terraform, PowerShell, Ansible, Bash.

- Lead by example, contributing to code reviews, documentation and take on complex bug fixes, especially on high-risk problems.

- Perform system administration tasks including deployments, configuration, systems monitoring, troubleshooting, and support while innovating to automate as much as possible.

- Install, configure, maintain, and support applications, services, and servers in public cloud environments.

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues reported by monitoring systems and submitted through the ticketing system. Fully document issues, actions taken, and steps for resolution.

- Engineer and maintain operational processes and procedures.

- Focus on continued professional development to maintain knowledge and application of current industry best practices and security concepts.

- Exhibit an innovative mindset by suggesting improvements as well as engineering and implementing related recommendations. Strong desire to learn, implement, and teach others in new processes and technologies.

- Perform other tasks as defined, planned, and approved by leadership.

Experience Required:

- Advanced English level, with a focus on conversational skills

- Good understanding of DevOps process, standards, best practices followed in enterprise level with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps

- Demonstrated experience with software engineering, scripting, automation, and orchestration tools (Terraform, PowerShell, Ansible, GitHub)

- Demonstrated experience provisioning, configuring, and maintaining cloud computing services such as Azure and AWS.

- Demonstrated experience administering, monitoring, and maintaining both Microsoft and Linux server-based operating systems.

- Operational understanding of security best practices and standards around cloud computing and access management.

- Experience with management/maintenance of AWS Sagemaker

Educational Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or other related field with relevant work experience of 5+ years experience in the IT field, or equivalent experience in the IT field.

If you are interested, please apply directly through this link or send your CV to nathalia.huerta@mx.zurich.com

Position available only for candidates located in Mexico City, State of Mexico, or Guadalajara. Please apply only if you reside in one of these areas.

Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. Cloud Engineer - DevOps

- Ingenieur, Automat und orchestrieren Systembereitstellung und Wartungsprozesse mit modernen Cloud-Tools und -Technologien. Evaluierung, Design und Implementierung unterstützender Technologien in Übereinstimmung mit globalen und lokalen Anforderungen.

- Anforderungen und Design-Dokument für Public Cloud-Dienste und -Muster, die in der Umgebung eingesetzt werden. Engagieren Sie mit Architekten, Ingenieuren, Entwicklern und Sicherheitsbeauftragten, um Lösungen zu entwickeln.

- Beispielweise, indem Sie zu Code-Reviews, Dokumentation und nehmen Sie komplexe Fehlerbehebungen, vor allem bei Hochrisiko-Problemen beitragen.

- Führen Sie Systemverwaltungsaufgaben einschließlich Bereitstellungen, Konfiguration, Systemüberwachung, Fehlerbehebung und Unterstützung während der Innovation zu automatisieren so viel wie möglich.

- Installieren, konfigurieren, warten und unterstützen Sie Anwendungen, Dienste und Server in öffentlichen Cloud-Umgebungen.

- Problembehandlung und Lösung von Problemen, die von Überwachungssystemen berichtet und über das Ticketing-System eingereicht werden. Voll dokumentiert Probleme, Maßnahmen und Schritte zur Auflösung.

- Engineering und Wartung der operativen Prozesse und Verfahren.

- Fokus auf die weitere berufliche Entwicklung, um Wissen und Anwendung der aktuellen branchenbesten Praktiken und Sicherheitskonzepte zu erhalten.

- Zeigen Sie eine innovative Denkweise durch Verbesserungsvorschläge sowie Engineering und Umsetzung der entsprechenden Empfehlungen. Starker Wunsch, andere in neuen Prozessen und Technologien zu lernen, umzusetzen und zu lehren.

- Führen Sie andere Aufgaben wie definiert, geplant und genehmigt von der Führung.

Erforderliche Erfahrung:

- Fortgeschrittene Englisch-Ebene, mit einem Fokus auf gesprächsbezogene Fähigkeiten

- Gutes Verständnis des DevOps-Prozesses, Standards, Best Practices, die in Unternehmensebene mit Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps verfolgt werden

- Vorgestellte Erfahrung mit Software Engineering, Skripting, Automatisierung und Orchestrierungswerkzeugen (Terraform, PowerShell, Ansible, GitHub)

- Vorgestellte Erfahrung Bereitstellung, Konfiguration und Wartung von Cloud-Computing-Diensten wie Azure und AWS.

- Vorgestellte Erfahrung Verwaltung, Überwachung und Wartung sowohl Microsoft und Linux-Server-basierte Betriebssysteme.

- Operationelles Verständnis von bewährten Sicherheitspraktiken und Standards rund um Cloud Computing und Access Management.

- Erfahrung mit Management/Wartung von AWS Sagemaker

Bildungserfordernisse:

- Bachelor in Informatik, Informationssystemen oder anderen verwandten Bereichen mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung mit mehr als 5 Jahren Erfahrung im IT-Bereich oder gleichwertiger Erfahrung im IT-Bereich.

Nur für Bewerber in Mexiko-Stadt, im mexikanischen Bundesstaat oder Guadalajara verfügbar. Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur, wenn Sie in einem dieser Gebiete wohnen.

Wer wir sind

Auf der Suche nach einem herausfordernden und inspirierenden Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Sie etwas bewirken können? In Zürich vertrauen Millionen von Menschen und Unternehmen täglich auf unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen. Unsere 53.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit bilden die Basis unseres Erfolgs, sodass Unternehmen und Gemeinden einer Welt voller Risiken vertrauensvoll gegenüberstehen. Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie könnten Menschen in aller Welt dabei helfen. Sie würden ihnen Vertrauen und Sicherheit geben, indem Sie das, was sie am meisten lieben, schützen.

Es ist eine große Herausforderung, aber Sie werden von einem Team von Weltklasse unterstützt, das Ihnen hilft, Ihr volles Potenzial zu erreichen und unsere Versprechen einzuhalten.

Also, seien Sie herausgefordert, lassen Sie sich inspirieren. Helfen Sie uns, etwas zu bewirken.

Job Summary

To drive growth and profitability in all assigned products through risk selection, pricing, negotiation, sales, retention, and quality service.

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

• Actively manage daily work processes of designated territory to achieve operational and strategic objectives.
• Analyze needs, develop and recommend alternatives for improvements to processes, customer service or products.
• Lead short term (3 to 9 months), defined scope projects.
• Develop and maintain profitable relationships with new and existing customers.
• Assist customers with loss prevention meetings, claims issues, and product training.
• Provide training to customer and Strategic Business Unit personnel on products and services.
• Provide technical advice that enables a customer to solve a problem or improve business.
• Develop and maintain positive customer relationships by meeting regularly with customers when no specific initiative is underway.
• Anticipate customer needs, monitor trends in order to recommend changes.
• Resolve technical issues within function or unit.

Required:
• High School Diploma or Equivalent and 1 or more years of experience in the Sales area

OR

AND
• Knowledge of principles of sales, sales techniques, and sales terminology
• Knowledge of requirements within insurance industry regulatory environment
• Knowledge of Microsoft Office
• The ability to be licensed to sell insurance in the states where required

Preferred:
• 2 or more years of sales experience
• Licensed to sell insurance in the states where required
• Experience analyzing financial statements

Business Accountabilities

• Carry out tasks, such as the preparation of customer and distributor reports, to support the implementation of projects to time and quality standards.
• Assess and evaluate business processes in order to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Investigate and drive research/analysis around potential business development opportunities.
• Review assigned customer cases, prioritize case load and interpret established policies, applying discretion within authority limits in order to resolve customer issues.

• Kurzfristige Führung (3 bis 9 Monate), definierte Zielgebiete.
• Entwicklung und Pflege profitabler Beziehungen zu neuen und bestehenden Kunden.
• Unterstützung der Kunden bei Verlustpräventionstreffen, Schadenbehebungen und Produktschulungen.
• Schulung des Personals der Kunden- und strategischen Business Unit zu Produkten und Dienstleistungen.

• Technische Beratung, die es einem Kunden ermöglicht, ein Problem zu lösen oder das Geschäft zu verbessern.
• Entwicklung und Pflege positiver Kundenbeziehungen, indem er regelmäßig mit Kunden zusammentrifft, wenn keine spezifische Initiative im Gange ist.
• Vorausschauende Kundenbedürfnisse, Trends beobachten, um Änderungen zu empfehlen.
• Technische Probleme innerhalb der Funktion oder Einheit lösen.

• High School Diplom oder gleichwertige und 1 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb Bereich

• Zürcher zertifizierter Versicherungs-Lehrer mit Associate Degree und keine Vorkenntnisse im Vertrieb erforderlich

• Kenntnisse über die Grundsätze des Verkaufs, der Verkaufstechniken und der Verkaufsterminologie
• Kenntnisse über Anforderungen im regulatorischen Umfeld der Versicherungsbranche
• Kenntnisse über Microsoft Office
• Die Möglichkeit, in den Staaten, wo erforderlich, Versicherungsverträge zu verkaufen

Bevorzugt:
• 2 oder mehr Jahre Vertriebserfahrung
• Lizenziert zum Verkauf von Versicherungen in den Staaten, wo erforderlich
• Erfahrung Analyse der Abschlüsse

Geschäftsbuchhaltung

• Durchführung von Aufgaben, wie die Erstellung von Kunden- und Händlerberichten, um die Umsetzung von Projekten nach Zeit- und Qualitätsstandards zu unterstützen.
• Assess und Evaluierung von Geschäftsprozessen, um Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu ermitteln.
• Untersuchung und Förderung der Forschung/Analyse von potenziellen Geschäftsentwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Lasst uns zusammen wachsen!

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Résumé de l'emploi

Favoriser la croissance et la rentabilité de tous les produits attribués par la sélection des risques, la tarification, la négociation, les ventes, la rétention et le service de qualité.

Responsabilités en matière d'emploi - Principales responsabilités

• Gérer activement les processus de travail quotidiens des territoires désignés pour atteindre des objectifs opérationnels et stratégiques.
• Analyser les besoins, développer et recommander des solutions de rechange pour améliorer les processus, le service à la clientèle ou les produits.
• Diriger des projets à court terme (3 à 9 mois), à portée définie.
• Développer et maintenir des relations rentables avec les clients nouveaux et existants.
• Aider les clients à rencontrer des réunions sur la prévention des pertes, à traiter les réclamations et à former les produits.
• Former le personnel de la clientèle et de la cellule commerciale stratégique sur les produits et services.

• Fournir des conseils techniques qui permettent à un client de résoudre un problème ou d'améliorer son activité.
• Développer et maintenir des relations client positives en rencontrant régulièrement ses clients lorsqu'aucune initiative spécifique n'est en cours.
• Anticiper les besoins des clients, suivre les tendances afin de recommander des changements.
• Résoudre les problèmes techniques au sein de la fonction ou de l'unité.

Qualifications d'emploi requises:
• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 1 ou plusieurs années d'expérience dans le domaine des ventes

OU
• Zurich Apprenti d'assurance certifié comprenant un diplôme associé et aucune expérience préalable requise dans le domaine des ventes

ET
• Connaissance des principes de vente, des techniques de vente et de la terminologie des ventes
• Connaissance des exigences dans le cadre réglementaire de l'industrie de l'assurance
• Connaissance de Microsoft Office
• Capacité d'être autorisé à vendre des assurances dans les États où cela est nécessaire

Préféré:
• 2 ans ou plus d'expérience en vente
• Concédant une licence pour vendre une assurance dans les États lorsque cela est nécessaire
• Expérience en analyse des états financiers

Responsabilités des entreprises

• Mener des tâches, telles que la préparation de rapports clients et distributeurs, pour soutenir la mise en œuvre de projets selon les normes de temps et de qualité.
• Évaluer et évaluer les processus d'entreprise afin de déterminer les possibilités d'amélioration.
• Étudier et orienter la recherche/analyse autour des possibilités de développement commercial.
• Examiner les cas clients assignés, classer par ordre de priorité les cas et interpréter les politiques établies, en appliquant des pouvoirs discrétionnaires dans les limites des pouvoirs afin de résoudre les problèmes des clients.

Vous êtes le cœur et l'âme de Zurich!

A Zurich, nous aimons penser en dehors de la boîte et défier le statu quo. Nous adoptons une approche optimiste en nous concentrant sur la région de la capitale et en demandant constamment ce qui peut aller bien?

Nous apprécions hautement l'expérience et le savoir-faire de nos collaborateurs et offrons une large gamme d'opportunités dans tous les domaines d'activité pour vous encourager à postuler pour de nouvelles opportunités à Zurich lorsque vous êtes prêt pour votre prochaine étape de carrière.

Laissez, les gens continuent de grandir ensemble!

jobs.description:
Zurich, aseguradora líder a nivel internacional te invita a ser parte de su equipo como:

“Sales Expert II Hermosillo”

Objetivo del puesto

Gestionar y desarrollar oportunidades comerciales, contribuyendo al crecimiento del portafolio de clientes y a la consolidación de relaciones de largo plazo, brindando un servicio de calidad y soluciones a medida. Su meta principal es alcanzar y superar los objetivos de ventas, respetando las políticas y lineamientos de Zurich.

Tus habilidades y experiencia:

- Escolaridad: Licenciatura concluida en Administración, Mercadotecnia, Negocios, Economía o carrera afín.

- Experiencia requerida: Mínimo de 2 a 3 años en posiciones comerciales o de ventas de productos de autos y daños. Prospección, atención y seguimiento de clientes.

- Competencias y habilidades: Orientación a resultados . Comunicación efectiva y persuasión . Gestión de relaciones y servicio al cliente . Planeación y organización

Responsabilidades principales :

- Desarrollar estrategias para el cumplimiento de ventas del portafolio de agentes asignado.

- Atención a los canales de distribución (agentes, despachos consolidados y perfil de promotorías) e implementación de estrategias de comercialización.

- Atención a cuentas (Daños y Autos) así como el mantenimiento de la posventa para lograr la meta del plan asignado.

- Gestión y ejecución del plan de Cross- Sell

- Gestionar la estrategia de clientes, capacitar y desarrollar a la fuerza externa de ventas, reforzar la relación comercial con clientes, crear sinergias y articulación entre áreas. especialmente UW.

- Mantener altos niveles de atención y servicio al cliente.

Ofertamos:

- Atractivo esquema de compensación.

- Prestaciones superiores a la ley.

- Grandes oportunidades de desarrollo y crecimiento.

Zurich reconoce las diferentes dimensiones que individualizan a una persona en identidad y/o expresión de género, edad, raza, capacidad física, orientación sexual, experiencia, línea de pensamiento y cultura; no aceptando acto alguno de discriminación.

Por qué elegir Zurich

En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor!

Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

Enviar candidatura ahora »

Su meta principal es alcanzar y superar los objetivos de ventas, respetando las políticas y lineamientos de Zurich.

Tus habilidades y experiencia:

- Escolaridad: Licenciatura concluida en Administración, Mercadotecnia, Negocios, Economía o carrera afín.

- Experiencia requerida: Mínimo de 2 a 3 años en posiciones comerciales o de ventas de productos de autos y daños. Prospección, atención y seguimiento de clientes.

- Competencias y habilidades: Orientación a resultados . Comunicación efectiva y persuasión . Gestión de relaciones y servicio al cliente . Planeación y organización

Responsabilidades principales :

- Desarrollar estrategias para el cumplimiento de ventas del portafolio de agentes asignado.

- Atención a los canales de distribución (agentes, despachos consolidados y perfil de promotorías) e implementación de estrategias de comercialización.

- Atención a cuentas (Daños y Autos) así como el mantenimiento de la posventa para lograr la meta del plan asignado.

- Gestión y ejecución del plan de Cross- Sell

- Gestionar la estrategia de clientes, capacitar y desarrollar a la fuerza externa de ventas, reforzar la relación comercial con clientes, crear sinergias y articulación entre áreas. especialmente UW.

- Mantener altos niveles de atención y servicio al cliente.

Ofertamos:

- Atractivo esquema de compensación.

- Prestaciones superiores a la ley.

- Grandes oportunidades de desarrollo y crecimiento.

Zurich reconoce las diferentes dimensiones que individualizan a una persona en identidad y/o expresión de género, edad, raza, capacidad física, orientación sexual, experiencia, línea de pensamiento y cultura; no aceptando acto alguno de discriminación.

Por qué elegir Zurich

En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor!

Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

Enviar candidatura ahora »

jobs.title: Senior Reinsurance Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Are you looking for a caring, collaborative, values-driven workplace with inspiring teammates and leaders? Do you have the ambition and desire to be the best and thrive at the most impactful global insurance provider in the world? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have experience in reinsurance and are looking for a new challenge, we would love to hear from you.
Zurich Canada is currently looking for a Senior Reinsurance Financial Analyst to handle complex reinsurance transactions, ensuring compliance with reinsurance agreement terms and conditions, proper accounting methodology, and adherence to departmental standard operating procedures.

Reporting to the Reinsurance Financial Manager, you will be responsible for team workflow, governance, financial and performance analysis, resolving complex issues, and providing technical training. You’ll also collaborate with cross-departmental partners and act as a subject matter expert for governance and analytics relating to reinsurance operations.

This is a unique opportunity to build your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice matters. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.

Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring three days per week of in-person presence, which may include time in the office or market-facing engagements.

What you will do

• Analyze and apply proper accounting and operational procedures for complex reinsurance contracts.
• Provide direction and/or perform proper calculations, recording, accounting, reporting, and settlement of complex reinsurance transactions.
• Handle reinsurance claims of medium to high complexity as needed.
• Provide or perform oversight for complex reinsurance-related activity (e.g., commutations, deposit or retroactive accounting, clash cessions, complex multi-policy or multi-claim cessions, cessions with occurrence issues), identify issues, and coordinate resolution.
• Communicate with supervisors, reinsurers, customers, and high-level representatives from other departments (e.g., Claims, Actuarial, Finance).
• Develop, prepare, analyze, or review complex internal or external reinsurance reports, financial statements, key performance indicators, premium plans, or scorecards.
• Provide complex reinsurance agreement and transactional oversight responsibilities for team and vendor governance and oversight functions.
• Collaborate on project management efforts of cross-departmental initiatives.
• Act as a subject matter expert on the relationship between team workflows, key control elements, and administration of governance functions, along with dependencies and outputs from Group Reinsurance processing.
• Provide complex reporting analysis to resolve issues and inquiries using data query tools, including Business Objects.

Job Qualifications - What you bring to the table

Required:
• Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance and 6 or more years of experience in the Reinsurance area within the insurance industry.
• OR
• High School Diploma or Equivalent and 8 or more years of experience in the Reinsurance area within the insurance industry.

Preferred:
• CPA, CPCU, CFA, or CTP designation(s)
• Advanced knowledge of reinsurance contracts
• Advanced knowledge of reinsurance claim recoverable processes and their link to direct claim processing
• Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Office skills
• Technology experience with one or more of the following: general ledger, financial reporting systems, Business Objects or other query tools
• Strong verbal and written communication skills

At Zurich Canada, we are committed to pay equity. We determine compensation based on objective criteria such as skills, experience, and internal equity. The salary range for this position is $75,000 - $119,000. This range reflects the expected pay for the role across Canada and may vary depending on factors like office location, specific responsibilities, and individual qualifications. As required by local law, Zurich provides in good faith a reasonable compensation range, but starting salaries may exceed this range based on a candidate’s skills and experience.

Our Culture

• At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). We want you to bring your whole self to work, and we want our employees to be reflective of the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives are creating an environment where everyone feels welcome.
• We have a collaborative culture where diversity of thought is valued. We value your input and strive to give our employees the tools they need to make an impact.
• We care about our employees’ well-being and offer a comprehensive health/benefits plan with varying levels of coverage to suit your specific needs, along with a competitive total compensation package.
• We understand how important it is to rest, recharge and do the things you love. At Zurich, all employees receive a minimum of four weeks of vacation per year.
• Employees also receive four personal days per year to be used at their discretion for personal appointments, cultural or religious holidays, or mental health.
• We are committed to continuous improvement and offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.
• We care about our communities—where our customers, people, and shareholders live and work. Zurich employees give back to their communities through their talent, time, and resources.
• We have won numerous awards for our workplace culture, including being one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers and receiving Insurance Business Canada’s 5-Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award.

Make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

About Us

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-line insurer with approximately 55,000 employees worldwide serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada has been a leading insurance provider serving mid-sized and large companies, including multinational corporations, in the Canadian commercial market for 100 years. With over 650 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a top insurance provider combined with in-depth knowledge of industries and local markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be risk management professionals’ first choice as their premier partner to help meet the risk challenges of today and tomorrow. Read more at www.zurichcanada.com .

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich strives to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We recruit talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion bring us closer to our common goal: exceeding our customers’ expectations. Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on behalf of, Zurich. We strive to achieve a workplace free of discrimination of all forms, including discrimination on the basis of physical or mental disability, or medical condition. If you are interested in a job opportunity, please advise if you require an accommodation, so we can work with you to provide a more accessible process.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Any unsolicited resume will become the property of Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. If you are a preferred vendor, please use our Recruiting Agency Portal for resume submission.

Only applicable for Canada: For Zurich Canada's commitment to diversity and accessibility please click here . If you would prefer to not receive future electronic messages from Zurich Insurance Company Ltd's recruitment management system, please email your request to have your job profile deleted from the system by clicking here . Zurich Insurance Company Ltd 100 King St., W., Suite 5500, Toronto, ON, M5X 1C9. www.zurichcanada.com

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Stai cercando un posto di lavoro attento, collaborativo e orientato ai valori con compagni di squadra e leader ispiranti? Hai l'ambizione e il desiderio di essere il migliore e prosperare presso il fornitore di assicurazioni globali più efficace nel mondo? Non guardare oltre Zurigo Canada.

Se avete esperienza nella riassicurazione e siete alla ricerca di una nuova sfida, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.
Zurigo Canada è attualmente alla ricerca di un Senior Reinsurance Financial Analyst per gestire complesse operazioni di riassicurazione, garantendo il rispetto dei termini e delle condizioni di contratto di riassicurazione, la corretta metodologia contabile e l'adesione alle procedure operative standard dipartimentali.

Segnalando al Reinsurance Financial Manager, sarai responsabile del flusso di lavoro di squadra, della governance, dell'analisi finanziaria e delle prestazioni, della risoluzione di problemi complessi e della formazione tecnica. Potrai anche collaborare con partner interdipartimentali e agire come esperto di materia tematica per la governance e l'analisi relativi alle operazioni di riassicurazione.

Questa è un'opportunità unica per costruire la vostra conoscenza ed esperienza per il futuro in un ambiente di supporto in cui la vostra voce conta. Questa pubblicazione è per un posto vacante esistente.

Zurigo Canada utilizza strumenti di intelligenza artificiale abilitati a sostenere alcuni aspetti del processo di reclutamento, tra cui la revisione iniziale e la screening delle applicazioni. L'intelligenza artificiale non è l'unica base per la shortlist o la selezione dei candidati. Tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono esaminate e prese da professionisti qualificati di assunzione.

Zurigo segue un modello di lavoro ibrido che richiede tre giorni alla settimana di presenza in persona, che può includere il tempo in ufficio o gli impegni di mercato.

Cosa farai

• Analizzare e applicare procedure contabili e operative adeguate per contratti di riassicurazione complessi.
• Fornire la direzione e/o eseguire calcoli adeguati, registrazione, contabilità, reporting e regolamento di complesse transazioni di riassicurazione.
• Manigliare rivendicazioni di riassicurazione di media ad alta complessità come necessario.
• Fornire o eseguire la supervisione per attività complesse di reassicurazione (ad esempio, commutazioni, deposito o contabilità retroattiva, concessioni di scontri, complesse multi-policy o multi-claim, concessioni con problemi di evento), identificare i problemi, e coordinare la risoluzione.
• Comunicare con supervisori, riassicuratori, clienti e rappresentanti di alto livello di altri dipartimenti (ad esempio, Claims, Actuarial, Finance).
• Sviluppare, preparare, analizzare o rivedere report di riassicurazione interni o esterni complessi, rendiconti finanziari, indicatori chiave di performance, piani premium o schede di punteggio.
• Fornire un accordo di riassicurazione complesso e responsabilità di supervisione transazionale per le funzioni di team e vendor governance e supervisione.
• Collaborate con gli sforzi di project management di iniziative cross-departmentali.
• Agire come esperto di materia di relazione tra flussi di lavoro di squadra, elementi di controllo chiave, e l'amministrazione delle funzioni di governance, insieme con dipendenze e uscite dal processo di Riassicurazione di Gruppo.
• Fornire analisi di report complesse per risolvere problemi e richieste utilizzando strumenti di query dati, tra cui oggetti aziendali.

Qualifiche di lavoro - Cosa porti al tavolo

Richiesto:
• Laurea in contabilità o finanza e 6 o più anni di esperienza nell'area di assicurazione all'interno del settore assicurativo.
• O
• Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente e 8 o più anni di esperienza nell'area di assicurazione all'interno del settore assicurativo.

Preferito:
• Denominazione CPA, CPCU, CFA o CTP
• Conoscenza avanzata dei contratti di riassicurazione
• Conoscenza avanzata dei processi recuperabili di reclamo di riassicurazione e il loro collegamento al trattamento diretto di reclamo
• Intermedio alle competenze avanzate di Microsoft Office
• Esperienza tecnologica con uno o più dei seguenti: registro generale, sistemi di reporting finanziario, oggetti aziendali o altri strumenti di query
• Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta

A Zurigo Canada, siamo impegnati a pagare l'equità. Determinamo la compensazione in base a criteri oggettivi quali competenze, esperienza e equity interna. La fascia salariale per questa posizione è di $ 75.000 - $119,000. Questa gamma riflette la retribuzione prevista per il ruolo in tutto il Canada e può variare a seconda di fattori come la posizione dell'ufficio, responsabilità specifiche e qualifiche individuali. Come richiesto dal diritto locale, Zurigo fornisce in buona fede un range di compensazione ragionevole, ma gli stipendi iniziali possono superare questa gamma in base alle competenze e all’esperienza di un candidato.

La nostra cultura

• A Zurigo siamo orgogliosi della nostra cultura. Siamo appassionati di Diversità, Inclusione, Equità e Belonging (DIEB). Vogliamo che tu porti tutto il tuo lavoro, e vogliamo che i nostri dipendenti siano riflessivi delle comunità in cui viviamo e lavoriamo. Le nostre iniziative DIEB stanno creando un ambiente in cui tutti si sentono benvenuti.
• Abbiamo una cultura collaborativa dove la diversità del pensiero è apprezzata. Apprezziamo il vostro contributo e ci sforziamo di dare ai nostri dipendenti gli strumenti di cui hanno bisogno per fare un impatto.
• Ci preoccupiamo del benessere dei nostri dipendenti e offriamo un piano completo di salute/benefici con diversi livelli di copertura per soddisfare le vostre esigenze specifiche, insieme a un pacchetto di compensazione totale competitivo.
• Sappiamo quanto sia importante riposare, ricaricare e fare le cose che ami. A Zurigo, tutti i dipendenti ricevono un minimo di quattro settimane di vacanza all'anno.
• I dipendenti ricevono anche quattro giorni personali all'anno per essere utilizzati a loro discrezione per appuntamenti personali, feste culturali o religiose, o salute mentale.
• Siamo impegnati a un miglioramento continuo e offriamo l'accesso a una gamma completa di opportunità di formazione e sviluppo.
• Ci preoccupiamo delle nostre comunità, dove vivono e lavorano i nostri clienti, persone e azionisti. I dipendenti di Zurigo tornano alle loro comunità attraverso il loro talento, il tempo e le risorse.
• Abbiamo vinto numerosi premi per la nostra cultura del posto di lavoro, tra cui essere uno dei migliori datori di lavoro di Toronto e ricevere Assicurazione Business Canada 5-Star Diversity, Equity e Inclusion Award.

Fai la differenza. Sii sfidato. Sii ispirato. Sii supportato. Adoro quello che fai. Lavora per noi.

Informazioni su di noi

Zurigo Canada fa parte del Zurich Insurance Group, un'assicurazione multi-linea con circa 55.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo che servono clienti nei mercati globali e locali. Zurigo Canada è stato un fornitore di assicurazioni leader che serve società di medie e grandi dimensioni, comprese le multinazionali, nel mercato commerciale canadese per 100 anni. Con oltre 650 dipendenti in uffici in tutto il paese, Zurigo offre la forza globale di un fornitore di assicurazione superiore combinato con la conoscenza approfondita delle industrie e dei mercati locali. Zurigo Canada aspira ad essere la prima scelta dei professionisti della gestione del rischio come partner principale per soddisfare le sfide di rischio di oggi e domani. Leggi tutto su www.zurichcanada.com .

Un futuro con Zurigo

Ora è il momento di andare avanti e fare la differenza. A Zurigo, vogliamo che tu condivida le tue prospettive, esperienze e idee uniche in modo da poter crescere e guidare un cambiamento sostenibile insieme. Nell'ambito di un'organizzazione globale leader, Zurigo Nord America ha oltre 148 anni di esperienza nella gestione del rischio e nel supporto alla resilienza. Siamo un fornitore leader di soluzioni di assicurazione proprietà-casualty commerciali e una vasta gamma di prodotti e servizi di gestione del rischio per le imprese e gli individui. Oggi, serviamo più di 25 industrie, dall'agricoltura alla tecnologia e assicuriamo il 90% della Fortune 500®. La nostra strategia di crescita non è limitata al nostro business. Come datore di lavoro, Zurigo si sforza di fornire opportunità di sviluppo della carriera in corso e promuovere un ambiente in cui le voci sono diverse, i comportamenti sono inclusi, le azioni guidare equità, e la nostra gente sente un senso di appartenenza. Fai parte della prossima evoluzione del settore assicurativo. Unisciti a noi nella costruzione di un futuro più luminoso per la nostra gente, i nostri clienti e le comunità che serviamo.

Come società globale, Zurigo riconosce la diversità della nostra forza lavoro come risorsa. Assumiamo persone di talento da una varietà di background con prospettive uniche che sono veramente benvenuti qui. Insieme, la diversità e l’inclusione ci avvicinano al nostro obiettivo comune: superare le aspettative dei nostri clienti. Zurigo si impegna a fornire un ambiente diverso, inclusivo e privo di barriere, con l'obiettivo di un'organizzazione accessibile per dipendenti, clienti e altre parti che interagiscono con, o per conto di Zurigo. Ci sforziamo di raggiungere un posto di lavoro privo di discriminazione di tutte le forme, compresa la discriminazione sulla base di disabilità fisica o mentale, o condizione medica. Se siete interessati a un'opportunità di lavoro, si prega di consigliare se avete bisogno di un alloggio, in modo da poter lavorare con voi per fornire un processo più accessibile.

Zurigo non accetta curriculum non sollecitati da società di ricerca o agenzie di lavoro. Qualsiasi curriculum non richiesto diventerà di proprietà di Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. Se sei un fornitore preferito, utilizza il nostro Recruiting Agency Portal per la presentazione del curriculum.

Solo applicabile per il Canada: Per l'impegno di Zurigo Canada per la diversità e l'accessibilità clicca qui . Se si preferisce non ricevere messaggi elettronici futuri dal sistema di gestione delle assunzioni di Zurich Insurance Company Ltd, si prega di e-mail la vostra richiesta di avere il vostro profilo di lavoro cancellato dal sistema facendo clic qui . descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Suchen Sie einen fürsorglichen, kollaborativen, werteorientierten Arbeitsplatz mit inspirierenden Teamkollegen und Führungskräften? Haben Sie den Ehrgeiz und den Wunsch, der Beste zu sein und bei dem wirkungsvollsten globalen Versicherungsanbieter der Welt erfolgreich zu sein? Suchen Sie nicht weiter als Zürich Kanada.

Wenn Sie Erfahrung in der Rückversicherung haben und eine neue Herausforderung suchen, würden wir uns freuen, von Ihnen zu hören.
Zurich Canada ist derzeit auf der Suche nach einem Senior Reinsurance Financial Analyst, der komplexe Rückversicherungstransaktionen abwickelt und die Einhaltung der Bedingungen des Rückversicherungsvertrags, die ordnungsgemäße Rechnungslegungsmethodik und die Einhaltung der Standardbetriebsverfahren der Abteilung gewährleistet.

Wenn Sie dem Reinsurance Financial Manager Bericht erstatten, sind Sie für den Teamworkflow, die Governance, die Finanz- und Leistungsanalyse, die Lösung komplexer Probleme und die Bereitstellung technischer Schulungen verantwortlich. Sie arbeiten auch mit abteilungsübergreifenden Partnern zusammen und fungieren als Fachexperte für Governance und Analysen im Zusammenhang mit Rückversicherungsgeschäften.

Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, Ihr Wissen und Ihre Erfahrung für die Zukunft in einer unterstützenden Umgebung aufzubauen, in der Ihre Stimme wichtig ist. Dieses Posting ist für eine bestehende Vakanz.

Zurich Canada verwendet künstliche Intelligenz-fähige Tools, um bestimmte Aspekte des Rekrutierungsprozesses zu unterstützen, einschließlich der Erstprüfung und des Screenings von Bewerbungen. Künstliche Intelligenz ist nicht die einzige Grundlage für die Auswahl oder Auswahl von Kandidaten. Alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden von qualifizierten Einstellungsexperten überprüft und getroffen.

Zurich folgt einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell, das drei Tage pro Woche persönliche Präsenz erfordert, was Zeit im Büro oder marktorientierte Engagements umfassen kann.

Was du tun wirst

• Analyse und Anwendung ordnungsgemäßer Rechnungslegungs- und Betriebsverfahren für komplexe Rückversicherungsverträge.
• Anweisung und/oder Durchführung ordnungsgemäßer Berechnungen, Aufzeichnung, Bilanzierung, Berichterstattung und Abwicklung komplexer Rückversicherungstransaktionen.
• Behandlung von Rückversicherungsforderungen mittlerer bis hoher Komplexität nach Bedarf.
• Bereitstellung oder Durchführung einer Aufsicht über komplexe Tätigkeiten im Zusammenhang mit Rückversicherungen (z. B. Kommutierungen, Einlagen oder rückwirkende Rechnungslegung, Abtretung von Zusammenstößen, Abtretung von komplexen Multipolicy- oder Multiforderungen, Abtretung von Abgängen mit Eintrittsproblemen), Ermittlung von Problemen und Koordinierung der Abwicklung.
• Kommunizieren Sie mit Aufsichtsbehörden, Rückversicherern, Kunden und hochrangigen Vertretern anderer Abteilungen (z. B. Forderungen, Versicherungsmathematiker, Finanzen).
• Entwickeln, erstellen, analysieren oder überprüfen Sie komplexe interne oder externe Rückversicherungsberichte, Abschlüsse, wesentliche Leistungsindikatoren, Premiumpläne oder Scorecards.
• Bereitstellung komplexer Rückversicherungsvertrags- und Transaktionsaufsichtsbefugnisse für Team- und Lieferanten-Governance- und Aufsichtsfunktionen.
• Zusammenarbeit bei Projektmanagement-Bemühungen von abteilungsübergreifenden Initiativen.
• Handeln Sie als Fachexperte für die Beziehung zwischen Team-Workflows, wichtigen Kontrollelementen und der Verwaltung von Governance-Funktionen sowie Abhängigkeiten und Outputs aus der Gruppenrückversicherung.
• Bereitstellung komplexer Berichtsanalysen zur Lösung von Problemen und Anfragen mit Datenabfragetools, einschließlich Business Objects.

Job Qualifikationen - Was Sie an den Tisch bringen

Vorgeschrieben:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Rechnungswesen oder Finanzen und 6 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Rückversicherungsbereich in der Versicherungsbranche.
• ODER
• High School Diplom oder gleichwertig und 8 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Rückversicherungsbereich in der Versicherungsbranche.

Bevorzugt:
• CPA-, CPCU-, CFA- oder CTP-Bezeichnung(en)
• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Rückversicherungsverträgen
• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse der Rückversicherungsforderungen erstattungsfähiger Prozesse und deren Verbindung zur direkten Schadenbearbeitung
• Mittlere bis fortgeschrittene Microsoft Office Fähigkeiten
• Technologieerfahrung mit einem oder mehreren der folgenden Themen: General Ledger, Finanzberichterstattungssysteme, Business Objects oder andere Abfragetools
• Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Bei Zurich Canada sind wir verpflichtet, Gerechtigkeit zu zahlen. Wir bestimmen die Vergütung anhand objektiver Kriterien wie Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und interne Gerechtigkeit. Die Gehaltsspanne für diese Position beträgt 75.000 $ - 11.000 $. Dieser Bereich spiegelt die erwartete Bezahlung für die Rolle in ganz Kanada wider und kann abhängig von Faktoren wie Bürostandort, spezifischen Verantwortlichkeiten und individuellen Qualifikationen variieren. Wie vom örtlichen Recht vorgeschrieben, bietet Zurich in gutem Glauben eine angemessene Vergütungsspanne, aber die Anfangsgehälter können diese Spanne aufgrund der Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen eines Kandidaten überschreiten.

Unsere Kultur

• Bei Zürich sind wir stolz auf unsere Kultur. Wir sind begeistert von Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). Wir möchten, dass Sie sich ganz in die Arbeit einbringen, und wir möchten, dass unsere Mitarbeiter die Gemeinschaften widerspiegeln, in denen wir leben und arbeiten. Unsere DIEB-Initiativen schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sich jeder willkommen fühlt.
• Wir haben eine kollaborative Kultur, in der die Vielfalt des Denkens geschätzt wird. Wir schätzen Ihren Input und bemühen uns, unseren Mitarbeitern die Werkzeuge zu geben, die sie benötigen, um etwas zu bewirken.
• Wir kümmern uns um das Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeiter und bieten einen umfassenden Gesundheits- / Leistungsplan mit unterschiedlichen Deckungsniveaus für Ihre spezifischen Bedürfnisse sowie ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gesamtvergütungspaket.
• Wir verstehen, wie wichtig es ist, sich auszuruhen, aufzuladen und die Dinge zu tun, die Sie lieben. In Zürich erhalten alle Mitarbeiter mindestens vier Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr.
• Mitarbeiter erhalten auch vier persönliche Tage pro Jahr, die nach eigenem Ermessen für persönliche Termine, kulturelle oder religiöse Feiertage oder psychische Gesundheit verwendet werden.
• Wir setzen uns für kontinuierliche Verbesserung ein und bieten Zugang zu einem umfassenden Angebot an Ausbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
• Wir kümmern uns um unsere Gemeinschaften - wo unsere Kunden, Menschen und Aktionäre leben und arbeiten. Die Mitarbeiter von Zurich geben ihren Gemeinschaften durch ihr Talent, ihre Zeit und ihre Ressourcen etwas zurück.
• Wir haben zahlreiche Auszeichnungen für unsere Arbeitsplatzkultur gewonnen, darunter als einer der Top-Arbeitgeber von Greater Toronto und den 5-Sterne Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award von Insurance Business Canada.

Machen Sie einen Unterschied. Werden Sie herausgefordert. Lassen Sie sich inspirieren. Unterstützt werden. Liebe, was du tust. Arbeitet für uns.

Über uns

Zurich Canada ist Teil der Zurich Insurance Group, einem Multiline-Versicherer mit rund 55.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit, der Kunden in globalen und lokalen Märkten betreut. Zurich Canada ist seit 100 Jahren ein führender Versicherungsanbieter für mittelständische und große Unternehmen, einschließlich multinationaler Unternehmen, auf dem kanadischen Handelsmarkt. Mit über 650 Mitarbeitern in Büros im ganzen Land bietet Zurich die globale Stärke eines Top-Versicherungsanbieters in Kombination mit fundierten Kenntnissen der Industrie und der lokalen Märkte. Zurich Canada strebt danach, die erste Wahl für Risikomanagement-Profis als erstklassiger Partner zu sein, um die Risikoherausforderungen von heute und morgen zu meistern. Lesen Sie mehr unter www.zurichcanada.com.

Eine Zukunft mit Zürich

Jetzt ist es an der Zeit, voranzukommen und einen Unterschied zu machen. Bei Zurich möchten wir, dass Sie Ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und Ideen teilen, damit wir gemeinsam wachsen und nachhaltige Veränderungen vorantreiben können. Als Teil einer führenden globalen Organisation verfügt Zurich North America über mehr als 148 Jahre Erfahrung im Management von Risiken und der Unterstützung von Resilienz. Wir sind ein führender Anbieter von gewerblichen Unfallversicherungslösungen und einer breiten Palette von Risikomanagementprodukten und -dienstleistungen für Unternehmen und Einzelpersonen. Heute bedienen wir mehr als 25 Branchen, von der Landwirtschaft bis zur Technologie und versichern 90% der Fortune 500®. Unsere Wachstumsstrategie beschränkt sich nicht auf unser Geschäft. Als Arbeitgeber ist Zurich bestrebt, kontinuierliche Karriereentwicklungsmöglichkeiten zu bieten und ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Stimmen vielfältig sind, Verhaltensweisen inklusiv sind, Handlungen Gerechtigkeit fördern und unsere Mitarbeiter sich zugehörig fühlen. Seien Sie Teil der nächsten Entwicklung der Versicherungsbranche. Begleiten Sie uns beim Aufbau einer besseren Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeiter, unsere Kunden und die Gemeinschaften, denen wir dienen.

Als globales Unternehmen erkennt Zurich die Vielfalt unserer Belegschaft als Aktivposten an. Wir rekrutieren talentierte Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen mit einzigartigen Perspektiven, die hier wirklich willkommen sind. Diversität und Inklusion bringen uns unserem gemeinsamen Ziel näher: die Erwartungen unserer Kunden zu übertreffen. Zurich verpflichtet sich, ein vielfältiges, integratives und barrierefreies Umfeld zu schaffen, das zu einer barrierefreien Organisation für Mitarbeiter, Kunden und andere Parteien führt, die mit oder im Auftrag von Zurich interagieren. Wir sind bestrebt, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, der frei von Diskriminierung jeglicher Art ist, einschließlich Diskriminierung aufgrund von körperlicher oder geistiger Behinderung oder Gesundheitszustand. Wenn Sie an einer Jobmöglichkeit interessiert sind, informieren Sie bitte, wenn Sie eine Unterkunft benötigen, damit wir mit Ihnen zusammenarbeiten können, um einen zugänglicheren Prozess bereitzustellen.

Zurich akzeptiert keine unaufgeforderten lebensläufe von suchfirmen oder arbeitsagenturen. Jeder unaufgeforderte Lebenslauf wird Eigentum der Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité

Cherchez-vous un milieu de travail bienveillant, collaboratif et axé sur les valeurs avec des coéquipiers et des leaders inspirants? Avez-vous l'ambition et le désir d'être le meilleur et de prospérer auprès du fournisseur d'assurance le plus impacté du monde? Ne cherchez pas plus loin que Zurich Canada.

Si vous avez de l'expérience en réassurance et êtes à la recherche d'un nouveau défi, nous aimerions avoir de vos nouvelles.
Zurich Canada est actuellement à la recherche d'un analyste financier principal en réassurance pour gérer des opérations de réassurance complexes, assurer le respect des modalités des accords de réassurance, une méthodologie comptable appropriée et le respect des procédures opérationnelles normalisées du Ministère.

Sous l'autorité du gestionnaire financier de la réassurance, vous serez responsable du déroulement de l'équipe, de la gouvernance, de l'analyse financière et du rendement, de la résolution des problèmes complexes et de la formation technique. Vous collaborerez également avec des partenaires interministériels et agirez comme expert en matière de gouvernance et d'analyse des opérations de réassurance.

C'est une occasion unique de développer vos connaissances et votre expérience pour l'avenir dans un environnement favorable où votre voix compte. Cette affectation correspond à un poste vacant.

Zurich Canada utilise des outils d'intelligence artificielle pour appuyer certains aspects du processus de recrutement, y compris l'examen initial et la présélection des demandes. L'intelligence artificielle n'est pas la seule base pour la présélection ou la sélection des candidats. Toutes les décisions d'embauche sont examinées et prises par des professionnels qualifiés.

Zurich suit un modèle de travail hybride exigeant trois jours par semaine de présence en personne, ce qui peut inclure du temps dans le bureau ou des engagements face au marché.

Ce que vous ferez

• Analyser et appliquer des procédures comptables et opérationnelles appropriées pour les contrats de réassurance complexes.
• Fournir l'orientation et/ou effectuer les calculs, l'enregistrement, la comptabilité, la déclaration et le règlement des opérations complexes de réassurance.
• Traiter les demandes de réassurance de complexité moyenne à élevée au besoin.
• Fournir ou exercer une surveillance pour les activités complexes liées à la réassurance (p. ex., les commutations, les dépôts ou la comptabilité rétroactive, les cessions de conflit, les cessions complexes de plusieurs politiques ou de plusieurs réclamations, les cessions avec des problèmes d'événements), cerner les problèmes et coordonner la résolution.
• Communiquer avec les superviseurs, les réassureurs, les clients et les représentants de haut niveau d'autres ministères (p. ex., les réclamations, l'actuariat, les finances).
• Élaborer, préparer, analyser ou examiner des rapports complexes de réassurance interne ou externe, des états financiers, des indicateurs de rendement clés, des plans de primes ou des cartes de pointage.
• Fournir des responsabilités complexes en matière d'entente de réassurance et de surveillance transactionnelle pour les fonctions de gouvernance et de surveillance des équipes et des fournisseurs.
• Collaborer aux efforts de gestion de projets d'initiatives interministérielles.
• Agir en tant qu'expert sur la relation entre les flux de travail de l'équipe, les éléments clés de contrôle et l'administration des fonctions de gouvernance, ainsi que les dépendances et les extrants du traitement de la réassurance de groupe.
• Fournir des analyses de rapports complexes pour résoudre les problèmes et les demandes de renseignements à l'aide d'outils de recherche de données, y compris des objets commerciaux.

Qualifications d'emploi - Ce que vous apportez à la table

Requis :
• Baccalauréat en comptabilité ou en finance et 6 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la réassurance au sein de l'industrie de l'assurance.
• OU
• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent et 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine de la réassurance dans le secteur de l'assurance.

Préféré:
• Désignations CPA, CPCU, FCA ou CTP
• Connaissances avancées des contrats de réassurance
• Connaissances avancées des processus de récupération des sinistres de réassurance et de leur lien avec le traitement direct des sinistres
• Compétences intermédiaires à avancées de Microsoft Office
• Expérience technologique avec un ou plusieurs des outils suivants : grand livre général, systèmes d'information financière, objets d'affaires ou autres outils de requête
• Fortes compétences en communication verbale et écrite

À Zurich Canada, nous sommes déterminés à assurer l'équité salariale. Nous déterminons la rémunération en fonction de critères objectifs comme les compétences, l'expérience et l'équité interne. L'échelle salariale pour ce poste est de 75 000 $ - 119 000 $. Cette fourchette reflète la rémunération prévue pour le rôle à l'échelle du Canada et peut varier selon des facteurs comme l'emplacement du bureau, les responsabilités particulières et les qualifications individuelles. Comme l'exige le droit local, Zurich fournit de bonne foi une fourchette de rémunération raisonnable, mais les salaires de départ peuvent dépasser cette fourchette en fonction des compétences et de l'expérience d'un candidat.

Notre culture

• À Zurich, nous sommes fiers de notre culture. Nous sommes passionnés par la diversité, l'inclusion, l'équité et l'appartenance (DIEB). Nous voulons que vous mettiez tout votre moi au travail, et nous voulons que nos employés reflètent les communautés dans lesquelles nous vivons et travaillons. Nos initiatives DIEB créent un environnement où tout le monde se sent bienvenu.
• Nous avons une culture de collaboration où la diversité de pensée est appréciée. Nous apprécions vos commentaires et nous nous efforçons de donner à nos employés les outils dont ils ont besoin pour avoir un impact.
• Nous nous soucions du bien-être de nos employés et offrons un régime complet de soins de santé et d'avantages sociaux avec des niveaux de couverture variables pour répondre à vos besoins spécifiques, ainsi qu'un régime de rémunération totale concurrentiel.
• Nous comprenons combien il est important de se reposer, de se recharger et de faire ce que vous aimez. À Zurich, tous les employés reçoivent un minimum de quatre semaines de vacances par année.
• Les employés reçoivent également quatre jours personnels par année à leur discrétion pour des rendez-vous personnels, des vacances culturelles ou religieuses ou la santé mentale.
• Nous nous engageons à améliorer continuellement et à offrir un large éventail de possibilités de formation et de perfectionnement.
• Nous nous intéressons à nos collectivités, où vivent et travaillent nos clients, nos gens et nos actionnaires. Les employés de Zurich rendent à leurs communautés par leur talent, leur temps et leurs ressources.
• Nous avons remporté de nombreux prix pour notre culture du milieu de travail, y compris être l'un des meilleurs employeurs du Grand Toronto et recevoir le Prix de la diversité, de l'équité et de l'inclusion 5 étoiles d'Entreprise d'assurance Canada.

Faites une différence. Soyez défiés. Soyez inspiré. Soyez soutenu. J'adore ce que tu fais. Travaille pour nous.

À propos de nous

Zurich Canada fait partie du Zurich Insurance Group, un assureur multiligne comptant environ 55 000 employés dans le monde qui servent des clients sur les marchés mondiaux et locaux. Zurich Canada est l'un des principaux fournisseurs d'assurance au service des grandes et moyennes entreprises, y compris les multinationales, sur le marché commercial canadien depuis 100 ans. Avec plus de 650 employés dans des bureaux à travers le pays, Zurich offre la force mondiale d'un fournisseur d'assurance de premier plan combiné avec une connaissance approfondie des industries et des marchés locaux. Zurich Canada aspire à être un professionnel de la gestion des risques.Le premier choix est d'aider à relever les défis d'aujourd'hui et de demain. En savoir plus à www.zurichcanada.com .

Un avenir avec Zurich

Il est temps d'avancer et de faire une différence. À Zurich, nous voulons que vous partagiez vos perspectives, vos expériences et vos idées uniques afin que nous puissions grandir et conduire ensemble un changement durable. Dans le cadre d'une organisation mondiale de premier plan, Zurich Amérique du Nord a plus de 148 ans d'expérience en gestion des risques et en soutien de la résilience. Nous sommes un fournisseur de premier plan de solutions d'assurance de la propriété commerciale et une large gamme de produits et de services de gestion des risques pour les entreprises et les particuliers. Aujourd'hui, nous servons plus de 25 industries, de l'agriculture à la technologie et nous assurons 90 % du Fortune 500®. Notre stratégie de croissance ne se limite pas à nos activités. En tant qu'employeur, Zurich s'efforce d'offrir des possibilités de développement continu de carrière et de favoriser un environnement où les voix sont diverses, les comportements sont inclusifs, les actions stimulent l'équité, et nos gens se sentent un sentiment d'appartenance. Faites partie de la prochaine évolution du secteur de l'assurance. Rejoignez-nous pour bâtir un avenir meilleur pour nos gens, nos clients et les communautés que nous servons.

En tant qu'entreprise mondiale, Zurich reconnaît la diversité de ses effectifs comme un atout. Nous recrutons des personnes talentueuses de divers horizons avec des perspectives uniques qui sont vraiment les bienvenues ici. Ensemble, la diversité et l'inclusion nous rapprochent de notre objectif commun : dépasser les attentes de nos clients. Zurich s'engage à offrir un environnement diversifié, inclusif et sans obstacles, ce qui permettra d'offrir une organisation accessible aux employés, aux clients et aux autres parties qui interagissent avec Zurich ou pour son compte. Nous nous efforçons de parvenir à un lieu de travail exempt de discrimination de toutes les formes, y compris de discrimination fondée sur un handicap physique ou mental ou un état de santé. Si vous êtes intéressé par une possibilité d'emploi, veuillez vous informer si vous avez besoin d'un logement, afin que nous puissions travailler avec vous pour offrir un processus plus accessible.

Zurich n'accepte pas les curriculum vitae non sollicités des agences de recherche ou d'emploi. Tout CV non sollicité deviendra la propriété de Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. Si vous êtes un fournisseur privilégié, veuillez utiliser notre portail de recrutement pour soumettre un curriculum vitae.

Seulement applicable pour le Canada : Pour l'engagement de Zurich Canada en matière de diversité et d'accessibilité, cliquez ici . Si vous préférez ne pas recevoir de futurs messages électroniques du système de gestion du recrutement de Zurich Insurance Company Ltd, veuillez envoyer votre demande par courriel afin que votre profil d'emploi soit supprimé du système en cliquant ici. Zurich Insurance Company Ltd 100, rue King, W., bureau 5500, Toronto (Ontario) M5X 1C9. www.zurichcanada.com

jobs.title: RCIS Crop Claims Field Adjuster I (Ohio)
jobs.description:
Zurich is currently looking for a RCIS Crop Claims Field Adjuster I to join our Rural Community Insurance Services (RCIS) team. RCIS is one of the leading crop insurance providers in the U.S. RCIS offers insurance protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 3,600 licensed agents. RCIS offers a wide range of private product coverages, including a diverse selection of named-peril options, supplemental and stand-alone insurance products as well as federal crop insurance plans through the United States Department of Agriculture's Risk Management Agency. Together with RCIS agents, we protect America's farmers and ranchers.

Zurich/RCIS is currently looking for a Crop Adjuster to work out of the state of Ohio. This incumbent will work from a home-based office. This position is scheduled to work 40 hours per week. Approximately 50% travel is expected to cover the territory.

The ideal candidate will need to live and service within the following counties in Ohio:

- Adams

- Brown

- Clermont

RCIS provides insurance and superior services through leading agents to protect America’s farmers and ranchers. It’s been an innovator in crop insurance since the crop insurance business was privatized by the federal government in 1980. Today it’s one of the nation’s largest crop insurance providers, offering risk management protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 4,000 professionally trained and licensed agents.

This is a great opportunity to serve the agricultural community.

As a Crop Adjuster, your primary responsibilities will include:

-

With minimal supervision, completes field inspections and related responsibilities such as reading maps and aerial photos, measuring fields, storage bins, and discussing findings of crop loss with farmers on the most complex non-routine, problematic claims including controversial claims.

Ability to convey complex regulations and interpretations to claimants, agents, and industry people on claim situations.

Performs fact finding regarding crop damage, records information and transmits loss information to accurately determine potential indemnities.

Gather relevant facts, utilizing applicable law and establishing basic principles of negligence.

Complete claim reviews and audits on lower-level adjusters as assigned.

Ensure legal compliance by maintaining a strong working knowledge of regulatory and company policies and procedures.

Contribute to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed.

Basic Qualifications:

High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more months of experience in the agricultural area

Crop Adjuster Proficiency Program Certification (CAPP) must be obtained with 180 days of hire date

Reliable personal transportation and travel within territory

Valid Driver’s License

RCIS Crop Adjuster Physical Requirements: walk in agricultural fields up to 3 miles, climb agricultural storage bins up to 25 feet, lift 25 lbs. to 50 lbs., work outdoors in varying temperatures/weather conditions

Preferred Qualifications:

Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills

Strong organization and prioritization skills

Experience as a Crop Claims Field Adjuster

Intermediate Microsoft Office skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. For this position, the salary is $22.40-$30.87, plus a short-term incentive bonus of 5%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Zurich is currently looking for a RCIS Crop Claims Field Adjuster I to join our Rural Community Insurance Services (RCIS) team. RCIS is one of the leading crop insurance providers in the U.S. RCIS offers insurance protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 3,600 licensed agents. RCIS offers a wide range of private product coverages, including a diverse selection of named-peril options, supplemental and stand-alone insurance products as well as federal crop insurance plans through the United States Department of Agriculture's Risk Management Agency. Together with RCIS agents, we protect America's farmers and ranchers.

Zurich/RCIS is currently looking for a Crop Adjuster to work out of the state of Ohio. This incumbent will work from a home-based office. This position is scheduled to work 40 hours per week. Approximately 50% travel is expected to cover the territory.

The ideal candidate will need to live and service within the following counties in Ohio:

- Adams

- Brown

- Clermont

RCIS provides insurance and superior services through leading agents to protect America’s farmers and ranchers. It’s been an innovator in crop insurance since the crop insurance business was privatized by the federal government in 1980. Today it’s one of the nation’s largest crop insurance providers, offering risk management protection in all 50 states through a national network of about 4,000 professionally trained and licensed agents.

This is a great opportunity to serve the agricultural community.

As a Crop Adjuster, your primary responsibilities will include:

-

With minimal supervision, completes field inspections and related responsibilities such as reading maps and aerial photos, measuring fields, storage bins, and discussing findings of crop loss with farmers on the most complex non-routine, problematic claims including controversial claims.

Ability to convey complex regulations and interpretations to claimants, agents, and industry people on claim situations.

Performs fact finding regarding crop damage, records information and transmits loss information to accurately determine potential indemnities.

Gather relevant facts, utilizing applicable law and establishing basic principles of negligence.

Complete claim reviews and audits on lower-level adjusters as assigned.

Ensure legal compliance by maintaining a strong working knowledge of regulatory and company policies and procedures.

Contribute to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed.

Basic Qualifications:

High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more months of experience in the agricultural area

Crop Adjuster Proficiency Program Certification (CAPP) must be obtained with 180 days of hire date

Reliable personal transportation and travel within territory

Valid Driver’s License

RCIS Crop Adjuster Physical Requirements: walk in agricultural fields up to 3 miles, climb agricultural storage bins up to 25 feet, lift 25 lbs. to 50 lbs., work outdoors in varying temperatures/weather conditions

Preferred Qualifications:

Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills

Strong organization and prioritization skills

Experience as a Crop Claims Field Adjuster

Intermediate Microsoft Office skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. For this position, the salary is $22.40-$30.87, plus a short-term incentive bonus of 5%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Location(s): Ohio Virtual Office
Remote Working: Yes
Schedule: Full Time

Employment Sponsorship Offered: No
