jobs.title: Security Test Engineer
jobs.description:
At Zurich Capability Center, we are looking for a:

Security Test Engineer

Security Test Engineer is responsible to assure that Security Testing deliverables are meeting the highest quality Security Standards from the technology perspective and with focus on providing Penetration testing and App sec toolset administration support for the Security Testing BTS Team.

As part of this role, it is expected to support the Test Service Manager and Test Manager on anything related to Manual Pen Testing deliverables, assess on team technical requirements in terms of equipment and toolset and be the team’s SPOC on technical discussions / meetings with unit’s stakeholders and clients and assuring global support to Zurich IT projects to enable them to perform penetration testing , SAST, DAST and IAST toolset management.

Responsibilities:

• Act as subject Matter Expert, SME. and support Security Test Engineering team on any

technical related activity.

• Conduct and/or support authorized penetration testing on enterprise network assets.

• Review reports and recommendations from findings, include issues uncovered and

levels of risk when required.

• Lead Finding agreements sessions with Internal clients and go propose solutions to

vulnerabilities identified.

• Collaborate with other internal and external partner organizations on target access and operational issues.

• Create comprehensive exploitation strategies that identify exploitable technical or operational vulnerabilities.

• Perform penetration testing as required for new or updated applications.

• Responsible to supervise the thorough documentations of implementations, via technical documentation and run books.

• Lead the internal and external teams to apply adept understanding and experience with systems automation platforms and technologies.

• Interpret security and technical requirements into business requirements and communicate security risks to relevant stakeholders ranging from business leaders to engineers.

• Responsible for automating security controls, data, and processes to provide improved metrics and operational support.

• Stay abreast of emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and controls.

• Spot and execute new security technologies and best practices

Who we are

Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, enabling, businesses and communities to face a world of risk with confidence. Imagine if you could help people do this all over the world. You’d give them confidence and reassurance by protecting what they love most. It’s a big challenge, but you will be supported by a world-class team who believe in helping you to reach your full potential and deliver on our promises.

So be challenged. Be inspired. Help us make a difference.

At Zurich we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best qualified individuals available, without regard to race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel & Data Privacy Assistant Manager
jobs.description:
Summary

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Legal Counsel and Data Privacy Specialist to join our Legal team in Malaysia. This dual-role position is responsible for providing practical legal support and ensuring Zurich’s compliance with data protection laws. You’ll collaborate across functions to guide and protect our business and customers.

Key responsibilities:

- Review, draft, and negotiate commercial contracts and other legal documents, ensuring legal soundness and effective risk mitigation.

- Provide practical, business‑focused legal advice on day‑to‑day operational, commercial, insurance, and takaful matters in line with Zurich’s policies and standards.

- Partner with cross‑functional stakeholders to support contract negotiations and ensure compliance with applicable laws and internal governance requirements.

- Contribute legal expertise to company projects and broader business initiatives as assigned.

- Support in implementing and maintaining data protection governance frameworks, including DPIAs, privacy reviews, and compliance documentation.

- Assist with incident management, internal escalation processes, and preparation of data protection reports for management and regulatory purposes.

What we look for:

- Experience in data protection, privacy compliance, and contract law

descriptionByLocale.de:

Sie arbeiten funktionsübergreifend zusammen, um unser Geschäft und unsere Kunden zu leiten und zu schützen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

- Überprüfung, Entwurf und Verhandlung von Handelsverträgen und anderen rechtlichen Dokumenten, um rechtliche Solidität und wirksame Risikominderung zu gewährleisten.

- Sie bieten praktische, unternehmensorientierte Rechtsberatung in betrieblichen, kaufmännischen, Versicherungs- und Sachfragen im Einklang mit den Richtlinien und Standards von Zurich.

- Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern, um Vertragsverhandlungen zu unterstützen und die Einhaltung der geltenden Gesetze und internen Governance-Anforderungen sicherzustellen.

- Tragen Sie Rechtsexpertise zu Unternehmensprojekten und breiteren Geschäftsinitiativen bei, wie zugewiesen.

- Unterstützung bei der Implementierung und Pflege von Datenschutz-Governance-Frameworks, einschließlich DPIAs, Datenschutzüberprüfungen und Compliance-Dokumentation.

- Unterstützung beim Incident Management, internen Eskalationsprozessen und der Erstellung von Datenschutzberichten für Management- und Regulierungszwecke.

Worauf wir achten:

- Erfahrung in Datenschutz, Datenschutz-Compliance und Vertragsrecht

- Verständnis von malaysischer PDPA, globalen Datenschutzstandards und Geschäftsbetrieb

- Starke Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten

- Proaktiv, organisiert und kooperativ, mit einem starken Gefühl der Eigenverantwortung

- Fließend in Englisch; Bahasa Malaysia ein Vorteil

Bildung :

- Degree in Law

- Professionelle Zertifizierungen im Datenschutz sind ein Plus

Erfahrung :

Bei Zürich sind wir stolz auf unsere Kultur. Wir sind begeistert von Vielfalt und Inklusion. Wir möchten, dass sie ihr ganzes selbst zur arbeit bringen, wir haben eine vielfältige mischung von kunden, und wir möchten, dass unsere mitarbeiterbasis dies widerspiegelt.

jobs.title: Claims Analyst (6 months contract)
jobs.description:
Job Summary

With moderate direction, handles single and multi-party personal or commercial line claims of low to moderate exposure and complexity within specific limits of authority by following established protocols to ensure that claims are handled in the most efficient, effective way while delivering a customer-centric claims service.

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

- Document claims file by accurately capturing and updating claims data/information.

- To determine liability by gathering and analyzing relevant facts.

- Analyse and determine policy coverage.

- Work to have a timely resolution to claims by developing case strategy, developing a case evaluation, escalating issues as appropriate.

- Establish timely reserves and perform ongoing review throughout the claims cycle within authority limits.

- Assess damages.Negotiate settlement of claim by establishing an appropriate negotiation strategy.

- Meet quality standards by following best practices.

- Ensure customer service by proactively communicating information, responding to inquiries, following customer protocols.

- Aligned to the organization's Claims Vendor Management strategy.

- Ensure legal compliance by following laws and regulations and internal control requirements.

- Refer claim to subrogation and fraud teams.

- Contribute to profitable growth by providing risk insight, information and trends to Business

- Unit or customer as needed.Protect Zurich's reputation by keeping claims information confidential.

- Understand the current with industry trends and establish personal networks and participate in professional societies.

Job Qualifications

Required:

- Bachelor’s Degree in Insurance, Business Administration, Finance, or related disciplines

- Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply; internship or exposure to insurance/claims will be an added advantage

Preferred:

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and interpret information

- Good attention to detail and accuracy in handling documentation and data

- Good communication and interpersonal skills to liaise with internal and external stakeholders

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

- Location(s): MY - Kuala Lumpur

- Schedule: Full Time

jobs.title: Regional Income Development Executive - West Division
jobs.description:
Due to continued sales success, Zurich is looking for a Regional Income Development Executive to support the sales efforts in our West Division. The ideal candidate will live in the Wstern Division which includes California, Arizona, Oregon, Washington, Utah, Idaho, Colorado and Nevada.

Zurich Direct Markets specializes in providing Finance & Insurance (F&I) products, to the automotive industry. We have a dedicated sales force of F&I professionals who meet regularly and directly with our customers.

Our Regional Income Development Executives support growth and profitability in an assigned region through sales related to Finance & Insurance book of business to maintain profitable relationships with new and existing customers. They will also:

- Cultivate relationships and assist in driving production in current accounts and obtaining referrals for new F&I business opportunities in the Large Franchised Automotive Dealers space

- Support performance and key initiatives to help drive growth and profitability through ongoing training and development within the dealerships

- Communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders via the relevant medium – e-mail/intranet/newsletter to maintain good relationships.

- Attend conferences, seminars, training events and other meetings to promote Zurich’s marketing efforts, as needed

- Understand and respond to changing technology/IT requirements of customer accounts and gain internal buy-in to maintain good relationships.

- Work from home in an entrepreneurial atmosphere

- Earn a competitive base salary with a generous no cap incentive plan

- Receive excellent benefits and a company car (All candidates are subject to a driving record check)

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree and 2 or more years of experience in the sales area

OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 4 or more years of experience in the sales area

Preferred Qualifications:

- Strong knowledge of principles of sales, sales techniques, and sales terminology

- Dealership training experience

- Advanced knowledge of technology within the dealership

- Basic knowledge of all F&I products

- Knowledge of techniques and terminology of warranty claims

- Ability to multi-task

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

This position includes a variable component that is based on an individual's performance under the applicable sales incentive plan. The annual variable compensation range, based on performance under the sales incentive plan for this role will range between $145,000 and $170,000 depending on geographic location.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Remote Working: Yes
Schedule: Full Time

Employment Sponsorship Offered: No

Zurich Direct Markets è specializzata nella fornitura di prodotti Finance & Insurance (F&I), all'industria automobilistica. Abbiamo una forza di vendita dedicata di professionisti F&I che si incontrano regolarmente e direttamente con i nostri clienti.

I nostri dirigenti di sviluppo regionale di reddito sostengono la crescita e la redditività in una regione assegnata attraverso le vendite relative al libro di affari Finance & Insurance per mantenere relazioni redditizie con i clienti nuovi e esistenti. Saranno anche:

- Coltivare le relazioni e assistere nella produzione di guida in conti correnti e ottenere riferimenti per nuove opportunità di business F&I nello spazio Large Franchised Automotive Dealers

- Supporta le prestazioni e le iniziative chiave per favorire la crescita e la redditività attraverso la formazione e lo sviluppo in corso all'interno delle concessionarie

- Comunicare efficacemente con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni tramite il relativo mezzo – e-mail/intranet/newsletter per mantenere buone relazioni.

- Partecipare a conferenze, seminari, eventi di formazione e altri incontri per promuovere gli sforzi di marketing di Zurigo, come necessario

- Comprendere e rispondere a cambiare tecnologia / requisiti IT dei clienti account e ottenere buy-in interno per mantenere buone relazioni.

- Lavoro da casa in un'atmosfera imprenditoriale

- Guadagnare uno stipendio base competitivo con un generoso piano di incentivazione senza cap

- Ricevi eccellenti vantaggi e un'auto aziendale (Tutti i candidati sono soggetti a un controllo record di guida)

Qualifiche di base:

- Laurea e 2 o più anni di esperienza nella zona di vendita

O

- Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente e 4 o più anni di esperienza nell'area di vendita

Preferiti:

- Forte conoscenza dei principi delle vendite, delle tecniche di vendita e della terminologia delle vendite

- Esperienza di formazione di concessionari

- Conoscenza avanzata della tecnologia all'interno della concessionaria

- Conoscenza di base di tutti i prodotti F&I

- Conoscenza delle tecniche e terminologia dei crediti di garanzia

- Capacità di multi-task

La tua paga a Zurigo si basa sul tuo ruolo, posizione, competenze e esperienza. Seguiamo le leggi locali per garantire una giusta compensazione. Si può anche essere idonei per bonus e aumenti di merito. Se le vostre aspettative sono al di sopra della gamma elencata, vi incoraggiamo ancora ad applicare – il vostro background unico conta per noi.

Questa posizione include un componente variabile che si basa sulle prestazioni di un individuo nell'ambito del piano di incentivazione delle vendite applicabile. La gamma annuale di compensazione variabile, basata sulle prestazioni in base al piano di incentivazione delle vendite per questo ruolo si estenderà tra $145,000 e $170,000 a seconda della posizione geografica.

Offriamo vantaggi competitivi e completi per i dipendenti e le loro famiglie. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Perché Zurigo?

A Zurigo, apprezziamo le tue idee e le tue esperienze. Offriamo crescita, inclusione e un ambiente di supporto, in modo da poter contribuire a plasmare il futuro dell'assicurazione. Zurigo Nord America è leader nella gestione dei rischi, con oltre 150 anni di esperienza e copertura in 25 settori, tra cui il 90% della Fortune 500®.

Unisciti a noi per un futuro più luminoso, per te e per i nostri clienti.

Zurigo in Nord America non discrimina in base a razza, etnia, colore, religione, origine nazionale, sesso, espressione di genere, identità di genere, informazioni genetiche, età, disabilità, stato veterano protetto, stato civile, orientamento sessuale, gravidanza o altre caratteristiche protette dalla legge applicabile. Pari opportunità Disabilità del datore di lavoro/vet.

Zurigo è conforme al codice 18 degli Stati Uniti § 1033.

Nota bene: Zurigo non accetta CV non richiesti dalle agenzie. I fornitori preferiti dovrebbero utilizzare il nostro Recruiting Agency Portal.

Aufgrund des anhaltenden Verkaufserfolgs sucht Zurich einen Regional Income Development Executive, der die Vertriebsbemühungen in unserer Division West unterstützt. Der ideale Kandidat wird in der Wstern Division leben, die Kalifornien, Arizona, Oregon, Washington, Utah, Idaho, Colorado und Nevada umfasst.

Zurich Direct Markets ist spezialisiert auf die Bereitstellung von Finanz- und Versicherungsprodukten (F&I) für die Automobilindustrie. Wir haben eine engagierte Verkaufsmannschaft von F & I-Profis, die sich regelmäßig und direkt mit unseren Kunden treffen.

Unsere Regional Income Development Executives unterstützen Wachstum und Rentabilität in einer zugewiesenen Region durch Verkäufe im Zusammenhang mit Finanz- und Versicherungsbuch, um profitable Beziehungen zu neuen und bestehenden Kunden zu pflegen. Sie werden ferner

- Pflegen Sie Beziehungen und unterstützen Sie die Produktion in Girokonten und erhalten Sie Empfehlungen für neue F & I-Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Bereich der großen Franchise-Automobilhändler

- Unterstützung von Leistung und Schlüsselinitiativen, um Wachstum und Rentabilität durch kontinuierliche Schulungen und Entwicklungen in den Händlerhäusern zu fördern

- Kommunizieren Sie effektiv mit internen und externen Stakeholdern über das relevante Medium - E-Mail / Intranet / Newsletter, um gute Beziehungen zu pflegen.

- Besuchen Sie Konferenzen, Seminare, Schulungen und andere Meetings, um die Marketingbemühungen von Zurich nach Bedarf zu fördern

- Verstehen und reagieren Sie auf sich ändernde Technologie- / IT-Anforderungen von Kundenkonten und gewinnen Sie internes Buy-in, um gute Beziehungen zu pflegen.

- Arbeiten von zu Hause in unternehmerischer Atmosphäre

- Verdienen Sie ein wettbewerbsfähiges Grundgehalt mit einem großzügigen No-Cap-Incentive-Plan

- Erhalten Sie hervorragende Vorteile und ein Firmenauto (Alle Kandidaten unterliegen einer Fahrprüfung)

Grundqualifikationen:

- Bachelor-Abschluss und 2 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Verkaufsbereich

ODER

- High School Diplom oder Äquivalent und 4 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Verkaufsbereich

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

- Starke Kenntnisse der Verkaufsprinzipien, Verkaufstechniken und Verkaufsterminologie

- Erfahrung im Dealer-Training

- Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse der Technologie innerhalb des Händlers

- Grundkenntnisse aller F&I Produkte

- Kenntnis der Techniken und Terminologie der Gewährleistungsansprüche

- Fähigkeit zum Multi-Task

Ihre Bezahlung in Zürich basiert auf Ihrer Rolle, Ihrem Standort, Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung. Wir befolgen lokale Gesetze, um eine faire Entschädigung zu gewährleisten. Möglicherweise haben sie auch anspruch auf boni und leistungssteigerungen. Wenn Ihre Erwartungen über dem aufgeführten Bereich liegen, empfehlen wir Ihnen dennoch, sich zu bewerben - Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund ist für uns wichtig.

Diese Position umfasst eine variable Komponente, die auf der Leistung einer Person im Rahmen des geltenden Verkaufsanreizplans basiert. Die jährliche variable Vergütungsspanne, basierend auf der Leistung im Rahmen des Verkaufsanreizplans für diese Rolle, wird je nach geografischer Lage zwischen 145.000 und 170.000 US-Dollar liegen.

Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Bezahlung und umfassende Leistungen für Mitarbeiter und ihre Familien. [Erfahren Sie hier mehr über Total Rewards.]

Warum Zürich?

Bei Zurich schätzen wir Ihre Ideen und Erfahrungen. Wir bieten Wachstum, Inklusion und ein unterstützendes Umfeld - damit Sie die Zukunft der Versicherung mitgestalten können. Zurich North America ist ein führendes Unternehmen im Risikomanagement mit über 150 Jahren Erfahrung und Abdeckung in über 25 Branchen, darunter 90 % der Fortune 500®.

Begleiten Sie uns für eine bessere Zukunft – für Sie und unsere Kunden.

Zürich in Nordamerika diskriminiert nicht aufgrund von Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Religion, nationaler Herkunft, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsausdruck, Geschlechtsidentität, genetischer Information, Alter, Behinderung, geschütztem Veteranenstatus, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung, Schwangerschaft oder anderen durch geltendes Recht geschützten Merkmalen. Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber Behinderung / Vets.

Zürich erfüllt 18 US-Code § 1033.

En raison du succès des ventes, Zurich est à la recherche d'un directeur régional du développement du revenu pour soutenir les efforts de vente dans notre division Ouest. Le candidat idéal vivra dans la division Wstern qui comprend la Californie, Arizona, Oregon, Washington, Utah, Idaho, Colorado et Nevada.

Zurich Direct Markets se spécialise dans la fourniture de produits financiers et d'assurance (F&I) à l'industrie automobile. Nous avons une force de vente dédiée de professionnels F&I qui rencontrent régulièrement et directement nos clients.

Nos dirigeants régionaux de développement du revenu soutiennent la croissance et la rentabilité dans une région assignée grâce à des ventes liées au livre d'affaires Finance & Assurance pour maintenir des relations rentables avec des clients nouveaux et existants. Ils :

- Comprendre les exigences changeantes en matière de technologie et de TI des comptes clients et y répondre, et obtenir l'adhésion interne pour maintenir de bonnes relations.

- Travailler à domicile dans une atmosphère entrepreneuriale

- Obtenez un salaire de base concurrentiel avec un généreux plan incitatif sans plafond

Qualifications de base :

OU

Vous pouvez également être admissible à des primes et des augmentations de mérite. Si vos attentes sont supérieures à la fourchette indiquée, nous vous encourageons toujours à présenter votre candidature, ce qui compte pour nous.

Cette position comprend une composante variable qui est basée sur le rendement d'un particulier en vertu du plan d'encouragement aux ventes applicable. L'échelle annuelle de rémunération variable, fondée sur le rendement en vertu du plan d'incitation aux ventes pour ce rôle, se situera entre 145 000 $ et 170 000 $ selon l'emplacement géographique.

À Zurich, nous apprécions vos idées et votre expérience. Nous offrons la croissance, l'inclusion et un environnement favorable, afin que vous puissiez aider à façonner l'avenir de l'assurance. jobs.description:
En Sabadell Zurich formarás parte del equipo de Analytics & Pricing con el objetivo de generar valor de negocio a través del análisis avanzado de datos, apoyando la toma de decisiones estratégicas en pricing y gestión del porfolio.

Tu contribución será clave para maximizar el valor del porfolio mediante análisis avanzados y decisiones de pricing basadas en datos, trabajando en un entorno colaborativo y orientado a negocio.

Además, participarás en iniciativas de analítica avanzada y pricing relacionadas con:

- Extracción, transformación y análisis de datos para la toma de decisiones.

- Elaboración de reporting y cuadros de mando para el seguimiento del porfolio.

- Creación, análisis y calibración de tarifas en ramos de seguros de No Vida.

Por otro lado, colaborarás estrechamente con los equipos de Negocio, Producto y Tecnología para asegurar que los modelos y análisis se traduzcan en decisiones accionables con impacto real en el negocio.

¿Qué necesitamos de ti?

Buscamos a una persona con experiencia demostrada en analítica de datos y pricing , capaz de trabajar con autonomía, aportar criterio analítico propio y colaborar de forma transversal con distintos equipos.

Para tener éxito, necesitarás:

Experiencia y conocimientos esenciales

- Licenciatura o Grado en Actuariales, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física o titulaciones equivalentes.

- Poseer un mínimo de 2 años de experiencia en puestos similares.

- Experiencia en el sector de seguros, banca, retail, venta online u otros sectores afines.

- Experiencia en herramientas analíticas y tratamiento de datos (SQL, Python, SAS u otras similares).

- Conocimientos en analítica avanzada, modelización y explotación de datos.

Qué marcará la diferencia en tu perfil

- Fuerte capacidad analítica y orientación a resultados, con foco en impacto en negocio.

- Capacidad de organización, priorización y gestión de múltiples iniciativas.

- Visión de negocio aplicada al pricing, entendiendo el equilibrio entre riesgo, rentabilidad y crecimiento.

- Experiencia en trabajo colaborativo y transversal con equipos de negocio, actuarial y tecnología.

- Comunicación clara, estructurada y orientada a stakeholders no técnicos.

- Proactividad y mentalidad de mejora continua, cuestionando y optimizando procesos y modelos.

- Interés por la innovación y nociones de inteligencia artificial/ machine learning aplicadas a analítica (valorable, no imprescindible).

Valorable

- Nivel medio/alto de inglés.

- Conocimientos en machine learning o modelización predictiva.

- Experiencia en entornos de big data (PySpark, Databricks, etc.).

- Experiencia en entornos corporativos complejos.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

- Modelo híbrido y flexibilidad tras el primer mes de tu incorporación.

- Seguro de salud y ventajas exclusivas.

- Retribución flexible.

- Acceso a formación continua y plan de desarrollo.

- 26 días de vacaciones + día de cumpleaños.

- Beneficios sociales y entorno inclusivo.

Sobre nosotros

Sabadell Zurich es la alianza entre Banco Sabadell y Zurich Insurance Group. Somos más de 350 profesionales en España con un propósito común: Estar para cuidar.

Promovemos un entorno inclusivo basado en la igualdad de oportunidades, sin discriminación por género, edad, origen, discapacidad, orientación sexual u otras circunstancias personales.

Si buscas un entorno exigente, colaborativo y con impacto real en negocio, queremos conocerte.

En Sabadell Zurich, el talento se convierte en valor.

Enviar candidatura ahora »

#ZCC

Zurich Capability Center is looking for an Integrations Developer

Guidewire Developer (PolicyCenter / Integration)

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Guidewire Developer to join our team and support the design, development, and integration of Guidewire-based insurance solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter , strong integration capabilities, and a solid foundation in Java and modern API-driven architectures.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain solutions within the Guidewire PolicyCenter platform (or broader Guidewire suite).

- Build and enhance integrations using Integration Gateway (Apache Camel) and other integration frameworks.

- Develop and maintain RESTful APIs , ensuring best practices in design, security, and versioning.

- Work with Gosu for entity modeling, business logic, and plugin development.

- Analyze and leverage Guidewire data model and event framework for system enhancements.

- Implement and support event-driven and messaging-based integrations .

- Perform data validation, SQL queries, and performance tuning .

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (architecture, QA, DevOps) to ensure high-quality delivery.

- Participate in code reviews, testing, and troubleshooting across development cycles.

- Support deployments and ongoing improvements in a cloud-enabled environment (AWS/Azure) .

Core Skills & Qualifications

Guidewire Expertise

- Strong experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter (or Guidewire suite).

- Deep understanding of Guidewire data model, entities, and events .

- Hands-on experience with Gosu , including:

- Entity manipulation

- Business rules

- Plugin development

Integration & APIs

- Experience with Integration Gateway (Apache Camel) .

- Strong understanding of API development and integration patterns .

- Hands-on experience with:

- RESTful services (design, security, versioning)

- JSON/XML processing

Programming

- Strong proficiency in Java .

- Knowledge of other object-oriented languages is a plus.

Data & Persistence

- Strong SQL skills:

- Query writing

- Performance tuning

- Data validation

Integration & Architecture

- Knowledge of event-driven architectures and messaging patterns.

- Clear understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous integration models .

- Experience designing scalable, maintainable integration solutions.

DevOps & Delivery

- Experience with source control tools (Git) .

- Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure or AWS) is a plus.

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern development practices.

Nice to Have

- Experience with SOAP-based services (legacy integrations).

- Performance tuning and troubleshooting experience.

- Familiarity with testing frameworks :

- Unit testing

- Integration testing

What We Offer

- Opportunity to work on cutting-edge insurance technology platforms .

- Collaborative and high-performance team environment.

- Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.

- Flexible work environment.

Who we are
Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, enabling, businesses and communities to face a world of risk with confidence. Imagine if you could help people do this all over the world.
You’d give them confidence and reassurance by protecting what they love most.
It’s a big challenge, but you will be supported by a world-class team who believe in helping you to reach your full potential and deliver on our promises.
So be challenged. Be inspired. Help us make a difference.
At Zurich we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best qualified individuals available, without regard to race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

jobs.title: Underwriting Specialist OR Executive Underwriter - Large Contract Surety
jobs.description:
Join a team where your expertise is valued, your voice is heard, and your career has room to grow. Zurich’s Large Contract West Region Surety Team is looking for a motivated Contract Surety Underwriter to help us strengthen our portfolio, elevate our client relationships, and make a lasting impact across the 13 Western States.

This is a highly technical position and requires experience with Surety lines of business.

At Zurich, we foster a collaborative, purpose-driven culture with the backing of a global brand . You’ll have the opportunity to:

- Lead with impact by managing complex large accounts

- Travel with purpose , approximately 20% across the region

- Grow your network working with top-tier agents and brokers

- Make decisions that matter with clear accountability and broad authority

This market-facing role will be within the West region and we’re open to talent located anywhere in the following states: Colorado, Utah, Idaho, Washington, Montana, Oregon, California, Nevada and Arizona. You’ll play a critical role in managing and expanding a portfolio of domestic and international large accounts while driving business development and retention.

- Underwriting and analyzing new and renewal business for large contract surety

- Navigating complex assignments with confidence and autonomy

- Building and maintaining strategic broker and agency relationships

- Ensuring compliance with underwriting guidelines and regulatory requirements

This role will be filled at either the Underwriting Specialist or Executive Underwriter level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Underwriting Specialist Required Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting, Banking, Mortgage, Finance, or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 6 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an associate degree and 1 or more years of experience in the Underwriting, Banking, Mortgage, Finance, or Market Facing area.
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an associate degree and 4 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area.
AND

- Knowledge of line/s of business and the legal and regulatory guidelines

- Knowledge of time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience with Microsoft Office

OR

Executive Underwriter Required Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area, Finance, Accounting or Banking experience
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area, Finance, Accounting or Banking experience
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office

- Experience working on time restraints for quotes on new and renewal business

- Experience working in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:

- College Degree Highly preferred

- Strong Finance and accounting background needed

- Advanced knowledge and practice of Surety Bonds

- Established Broker relationships

- Ability to interact with the C-Suite

- Ability to investigate and analyze complicated credit assessments, trends, business strategies and organizational character among other aspects of our customers

- Ability to coherently articulate these strategies and financial concepts formulating fact based conclusions and recommendations.

- Prior experience managing/growing profitable portfolio of customers

- Negotiation experience with large, international and national organizations

- Strong team building and organizational skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The combined salary range for this position is $75,000.00 - $165,000.00. The proposed salary range for the Underwriting Specialist is $75,000.00 - $125,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%. The proposed salary range for the Executive Underwriter is $100,000.00 - $165,000.00, with Global Specialty Incentive Plan bonus eligibility set at 30%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

Bei Zurich fördern wir eine kollaborative, zielgerichtete Kultur mit der Unterstützung einer globalen Marke. Sie haben die Möglichkeit:

- Zeichnung und Analyse von Neu- und Erneuerungsgeschäften für große Vertragsbürgschaften

Diese Rolle wird entweder auf der Ebene des Underwriting Specialist oder des Executive Underwriter besetzt. Executive Underwriter erforderliche Qualifikationen:

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice inklusive Associate Degree und 8 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Claims oder Underwriting Support
UND

- Kenntnisse von Microsoft Office

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einer Teamumgebung

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

- College Degree Sehr bevorzugt

- Starker Finanz- und Buchhaltungshintergrund erforderlich

- Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse und Praxis von Surety Bonds

- Etablierte Brokerbeziehungen

- Fähigkeit zur Interaktion mit der C-Suite

Ihre Bezahlung in Zürich basiert auf Ihrer Rolle, Ihrem Standort, Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung. Wir befolgen lokale Gesetze, um eine faire Entschädigung zu gewährleisten. Wenn Ihre Erwartungen über dem aufgeführten Bereich liegen, empfehlen wir Ihnen dennoch, sich zu bewerben - Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund ist für uns wichtig. jobs.title: Suscriptor/a Mercado Pymes Madrid
jobs.description:
¡Hola!

Soy Mariana, recruiter de esta posición. Viajar es una de mis mayores alegrías, y lo que lo hace aún más especial es poder vivir esas experiencias con mi familia y nuestra querida gata Rosita.

Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales.

¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo.

Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega!

¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN:

- Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2024 hicimos más de 20.000 horas de activismo.

- En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección).

¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas.

Y te preguntarás: Marian ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento):

Buscamos un/a Suscriptor/a de Pymes, dentro de la Dirección Territorial MADRID, con sede en Madrid, cuyas funciones se basan en analizar y suscribir riesgos, tanto en nuevo negocio como en renovaciones (dentro del marco The Zurich Way of Underwriting) garantizando un alto nivel de servicio a los clientes y también te responsabilizarás de la búsqueda proactiva de oportunidades de negocio en el mercado de agentes y corredores con el fin de hacer crecer la cartera y lograr los resultados requeridos del plan (nuevo negocio, objetivos de retención, siniestralidad, etc.).

Tu día a día consistirá en:

- Desarrollar y mantener buenas relaciones con distribuidores (agentes y corredores) para lograr la retención y adquisición de negocio y colaborar con clientes y distribuidores (agentes y corredores) para determinar sus necesidades en materia de seguros y aportar soluciones.

- Presupuestar y establecer la cobertura y negociar las condiciones.

- Buscar de forma proactiva nuevas oportunidades de suscripción de pymes.

- Seguimiento mensual y consecución del plan de su zona (cartera, Nuevo Negocio, siniestralidad, retención...)

- Seguimiento y revisión de la correcta ejecución de las iniciativas de suscripción.

- Apoyar en la suscripción en el proceso de renovaciones importantes de nuestra cartera de pymes.

- Evaluación y comprensión pormenorizada de carteras de mediadores para detectar oportunidades de crecimiento de cada mediador de pymes asignado a tu panel.

- Realizar ventas cruzadas con otras líneas de negocio, para aumentar la densidad de productos por cliente.

- Interaccionar con los equipos de ventas que guarden relación con el territorio o los corredores asignados.

- Crear redes sólidas de agentes y corredores relacionados con los seguros para Pymes.

- Reportar feedback de la mediación internamente para poner en marcha las mejoras oportunas.

- Colaborar con marketing para agentes/corredores y dinamizar el lanzamiento de productos.

- Diagnosticar y elaborar recomendaciones para solucionar problemas específicos de la unidad de negocio, del corredor o del agente.

- Investigar, recomendar e implantar soluciones basadas en la Gerencia de Riesgos, que satisfagan las necesidades de corredores y agentes.

A estas alturas, te estarás preguntando, ¿Cómo sé si encajo?

No te preocupes, no te voy a pedir que salves el planeta ni que cumplas el 100% de los requisitos.

- Licenciatura en ADE, Empresariales, Económicas, Ingeniería o equivalente.

- Experiencia mínima de 3-4 años en suscripción, idealmente relacionada en riesgos de Empresas.

- Conocimientos sobre los productos de suscripción específicos para Pymes.

- Buenas habilidades de negociación, así como capacidad de interacción con mediadores y equipos de mercado.

- Enfocado a resultados y a objetivos

Ahora mismo, o estás con la emoción de cuando un pantalón te entra perfecto o estás pensando: “esto no es para mí” (si no es para ti, no pasa nada, ya nos volveremos a encontrar en el futuro). Puedes hacer de celestina compartiendo mi contacto con quien creas que pueda encajar.

En Zurich somos muy disfrutones , nos gusta vivir la vida. Ya me contarás cómo podemos hacerte feliz, pero a mí me encanta poder conciliar mi trabajo con mi vida personal. Aquí la flexibilidad horaria y la desconexión digital son reales.

#PorSerDeZurich , puedes escoger los beneficios que mejor se adaptan a tus necesidades. Ya sabemos que, para gustos, los colores.

- Te ofrecemos un modelo híbrido mega flexible para trabajar cómo y dónde quieras dentro de España. Te ayudamos con un bono de oficina en casa.

- Confiamos en la filosofía de aprender haciendo para que puedas moverte a otras áreas a nivel local o internacional gracias a nuestro programa “Talento en Movimiento”. Y para que sigas con tu desarrollo y crecimiento: clases de inglés, formación y programa de mentoring personalizado.

- Queremos romperte los esquemas de la retribución flexible. Con nuestra bolsa de beneficios, podrás elegir lo que mejor se amolde a ti y a tus necesidades: seguro médico, guardería, formación, tickets restaurante... ¡y mucho más!

- Nos gusta dibujar sonrisas y en Zurich sabemos que es más fácil de lo que parece, por eso somos activistas. ¿Y por qué no dedicar un día entero a la causa que más te motive?

- Referral bonus si nos recomiendas algún talento como tú. No buscamos a nadie perfecto, pero si conoces a alguien que mola, compártele mi contacto, me encantará conocerle.

- ¡Si tienes espíritu deportivo, en Zurich vamos a por el oro! Maratones, carreras, descuentos en gimnasio y mucho más. 3,2,1… ¡calienta que salimos!

- ¿Eres más de playa o de montaña? Tendrás 25 días de vacaciones, más el día del seguro y el día de tu cumpleaños para que disfrutes de lo que más te gusta. Pero que no te engañen, desconexión de verdad. Porque sí, todos nos merecemos un descansito y disfrutar de la vida, que son dos días.

- En Zurich, pensamos en tu futuro y te ofrecemos plan de jubilación y seguro de vida.

- ¡Buscamos los mejores precios para ti! Tendrás acceso a miles de descuentos en productos aseguradores y bancarios.

Si has llegado hasta aquí, GRACIAS por leerme. ¿Qué te ha parecido? ¿Molamos o no?

Si has sentido mariposas en el estómago y crees que encajamos, manda señales de humo, o el CV, si no te va bien lo del humo.

Y para ir terminando, ¿quieres saber qué opinan otras personas que forman parte de Zurich? Yo te diría que seguimos estando en lo más alto en Top Employers España como carta de presentación, pero te animo a echar un vistazo a nuestro perfil de Glassdoor para que sean ellas quiénes te lo cuenten. Sin trampa ni cartón.

Espero conocerte muy pronto.

Mariana Malnis

Enviar candidatura ahora »

- Queremos romperte los esquemas de la retribución flexible. Con nuestra bolsa de beneficios, podrás elegir lo que mejor se amolde a ti y a tus necesidades: seguro médico, guardería, formación, tickets restaurante... ¡y mucho más!

- Nos gusta dibujar sonrisas y en Zurich sabemos que es más fácil de lo que parece, por eso somos activistas. ¿Y por qué no dedicar un día entero a la causa que más te motive?

- Referral bonus si nos recomiendas algún talento como tú. No buscamos a nadie perfecto, pero si conoces a alguien que mola, compártele mi contacto, me encantará conocerle.

- ¡Si tienes espíritu deportivo, en Zurich vamos a por el oro! Maratones, carreras, descuentos en gimnasio y mucho más. 3,2,1… ¡calienta que salimos!

- ¿Eres más de playa o de montaña? Tendrás 25 días de vacaciones, más el día del seguro y el día de tu cumpleaños para que disfrutes de lo que más te gusta. Pero que no te engañen, desconexión de verdad. Porque sí, todos nos merecemos un descansito y disfrutar de la vida, que son dos días.

- En Zurich, pensamos en tu futuro y te ofrecemos plan de jubilación y seguro de vida.

- ¡Buscamos los mejores precios para ti! Tendrás acceso a miles de descuentos en productos aseguradores y bancarios.

Si has llegado hasta aquí, GRACIAS por leerme. ¿Qué te ha parecido? ¿Molamos o no?

Si has sentido mariposas en el estómago y crees que encajamos, manda señales de humo, o el CV, si no te va bien lo del humo.

Y para ir terminando, ¿quieres saber qué opinan otras personas que forman parte de Zurich? Yo te diría que seguimos estando en lo más alto en Top Employers España como carta de presentación, pero te animo a echar un vistazo a nuestro perfil de Glassdoor para que sean ellas quiénes te lo cuenten. Sin trampa ni cartón.

Espero conocerte muy pronto.

Acts under direct instruction, performing actuarial duties in order to provide highly accurate data and analyses for use by more senior actuaries in relation to reserving, reporting, quantitative risk management or the pricing of business.

Required:

- 4–5 years of experience in actuarial/pricing roles, preferably in life insuranceStrong understanding of individual life products and pricing principles.

jobs.title: Country Manager Resilience Solutions
jobs.description:
Country Manager Resilience Solutions to Zurich Sweden

At Zurich Resilience Solutions (ZRS), we help organizations build resilience and adapt to an ever-changing risk landscape. By offering expert risk advisory, innovative solutions, and practical support, we empower our clients to safeguard their people, assets, and reputation.

Country Manager for Sweden, Zurich Resilience Solutions | Risk Engineering

Zurich is one of the most specialized insurance companies within non-life commercial insurance for local and international businesses in the Nordic market. We support both the medium sized companies as well as global corporations around the world in the understanding of risk and the protection of their assets and revenue streams. We are now looking for an individual with a driven, positive and engaging attitude to join our Nordic organization as Country Manager for Risk Engineering within Property.

Zurich Risk Engineering is the strategic partner of our industry clients focusing on the identification, evaluation, quantification and reduction of overall risks and their possible impact. We have over 1000 risk professionals with industry expertise operating in over 40 countries working with first-class methods and tools covering a broad variety of disciplines.

As Country Manager for ZRS Sweden, you will provide strong, visible leadership. You will develop and enhance the services delivered by the Risk Engineering team, ensuring they align strategically with our business goals. Your contribution will help us achieve the objectives of both Zurich Nordic and Zurich Resilience Solutions

Job description

As the Country Manager, you will lead a team of approximately 8 Risk Engineers in Sweden, with P&L responsibility for the unit. You will be based at our Nordic head office in Stockholm, where most of the team is located. In this role, you will be the face of the unit both internally and externally, contributing to Zurich Nordic’s leadership team and supporting Zurich’s reputation in the market.

You will act as a role model, meeting customer demands and inspiring your team and colleagues to deliver their best. You will coach your team to become trusted advisors for our customers, while also supporting their personal development.

You will foster a learning culture by encouraging continuous improvement and open dialogue, drawing on the experiences of peers, co-workers, and customers. Visible leadership will be central to your role, and you will contribute significantly to the management team within Underwriting & Risk Engineering.

Additionally, you will have account engineering responsibility and conduct risk assessments both in the field and through desktop assessments for prospect and renewal accounts, playing a key role in new business and renewals.

Key Accountabilities:

jobs.title: Investment Operations Associate Director
jobs.description:
Zurich Group Investment Management, Inc. (ZGIM), a part of Zurich North America, is seeking an Investment Operations Associate Director to join the Investment Administration and Accounting (IAA) team. The candidate selected will be located at our Parsippany, NJ office.

At Investment Administration & Accounting (IAA), expertise and quality are the foundations of everything we do. As the investment landscape grows more complex and technology rapidly evolves, we rely on deep technical competence, strong analytical capability, and a commitment to excellence to deliver high quality outcomes for the business. Our thorough understanding of investment processes, financial instruments, and regulatory frameworks enables us to adapt quickly, uphold rigorous standards, and provide timely, meaningful support to our partners and stakeholders.

IAA is a global function within Zurich Investment Management, responsible for ensuring the accuracy, transparency, and governance of investment accounting, valuation, and reporting activities across the organization. We safeguard the integrity of investment data, ensure compliance with regulatory and audit requirements, and deliver insights that shape strategic portfolio and business decisions. Through this critical work, our team plays a central role in strengthening the reliability and credibility of investment information enterprise wide.

We are continuously enhancing and standardizing our processes across regions, leveraging technology, automation, and cross-team collaboration to drive efficiency and build operational resilience. As a trusted partner to Investment Management, Finance, and Operations, we are committed to delivering reliable, transparent, and high-quality investment information that supports effective decision making across the company.

Responsibilities:

- Managing the end-to-end processing, posting, and clearing of transactions related to private debt instruments

- Overseeing income payments, capital calls, distributions, and lifecycle events for private market assets

- Ensuring accurate and timely month-end closing activities for private debt instruments and alternative investments products

- Performing monthly reconciliations of private asset holdings, alternative investments products and related cash accounts

- Acting as a subject matter expert for private markets operations, supporting internal initiatives, system enhancements, and client-specific requirements.

- Collaborating with investment teams, custodians, and third-party administrators to resolve complex operational issues.

- Leading automation and digitalization efforts tailored to the nuances of private and illiquid assets

- Leading the development, enhancement, and maintenance of internal controls and quality assurance processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and risk mitigation across investment accounting and reporting activities.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Finance, or Accounting with 5 or more years of experience in the Investment Operations area OR

- High School Diploma (or equivalent) and 7-10 or more years of experience in the Investment Operations area

Preferred Qualifications:

- CFA designation

- 5 or more years of experience with exposure to private debt and alternative investment products

- Experience with FSCM, FAM, or TRM modules in SAP Treasury; financial technical skills are an asset

- A proactive, solutions focused mindset to support reporting and operational activities.

- Willingness to learn new tools, processes, and evolving Operational requirements

- Ability to work independently while managing day-to-day priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and effectively

- Ability to cultivate and manage productive relationships with internal stakeholders, key business partners, asset managers, and custodians, with a particular emphasis on supporting private debt operations and alternative investment products

- Ability to enhance and standardize processes across regions, leveraging technology, automation, and cross team collaboration to drive efficiency

- Demonstrated ability to manage complex operational workflows and contribute to cross functional initiatives, particularly within private markets

- Strong problem solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to resolve operational issues and escalate more complex matters appropriately

- Strong motivation to stay current with emerging technologies, including the practical application of AI features, to drive innovation and continuous improvement.

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed salary range for this position is $109,000 - $178,375, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Please note: Zurich does not accept unsolicited CVs from agencies. Preferred vendors should use our Recruiting Agency Portal.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Zurigo Group Investment Management, Inc. (ZGIM), una parte del Nord America di Zurigo, sta cercando un Investment Operations Associate Director per aderire al team Investment Administration and Accounting (IAA). Il candidato selezionato sarà situato presso il nostro ufficio Parsippany, NJ.

A Investment Administration & Accounting (IAA), competenze e qualità sono le basi di tutto ciò che facciamo. Poiché il paesaggio di investimento cresce più complesso e la tecnologia si evolve rapidamente, ci affidiamo a una profonda competenza tecnica, una forte capacità analitica, e un impegno per l'eccellenza per fornire risultati di alta qualità per il business. La nostra profonda comprensione dei processi di investimento, degli strumenti finanziari e dei quadri normativi ci consente di adattare rapidamente, rispettare standard rigorosi e fornire un supporto tempestivo e significativo ai nostri partner e stakeholder.

IAA è una funzione globale all'interno della gestione degli investimenti di Zurigo, responsabile per garantire l'accuratezza, la trasparenza e la governance delle attività di contabilità, valutazione e reporting in tutta l'organizzazione. Garantiamo l'integrità dei dati di investimento, garantiamo il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e di audit, e forniamo informazioni che modellano il portafoglio strategico e le decisioni aziendali. Attraverso questo lavoro critico, il nostro team svolge un ruolo centrale nel rafforzare l'affidabilità e la credibilità dell'impresa di informazioni sugli investimenti.

Promuoviamo e standardizziamo continuamente i nostri processi in tutte le regioni, sfruttando la tecnologia, l'automazione e la collaborazione cross-team per aumentare l'efficienza e costruire resilienza operativa. Come partner affidabile per la gestione degli investimenti, le finanze e le operazioni, ci impegniamo a fornire informazioni di investimento affidabili, trasparenti e di alta qualità che supportano un efficace processo decisionale in tutta l'azienda.

Responsabilità:

- Gestione del trattamento end-to-end, postazione e compensazione delle operazioni relative agli strumenti di debito privato

- Supervisione dei pagamenti di reddito, delle chiamate di capitale, delle distribuzioni e degli eventi del ciclo di vita per le attività di mercato privato

- Garantire attività di chiusura accurate e tempestive di fine mese per strumenti di debito privati e prodotti di investimento alternativi

- Esecuzione di conciliazioni mensili di partecipazioni private, prodotti di investimento alternativi e relativi conti in denaro

- Agire come esperto di materia tematica per le operazioni dei mercati privati, sostenendo iniziative interne, miglioramenti del sistema e requisiti specifici del cliente.

- Collaborare con team di investimento, custodi e amministratori di terze parti per risolvere problemi operativi complessi.

- I principali sforzi di automazione e digitalizzazione su misura per le sfumature dei beni privati e illiquidi

- Conducendo lo sviluppo, la valorizzazione e la manutenzione dei controlli interni e dei processi di garanzia della qualità, garantendo accuratezza, conformità e mitigazione dei rischi nelle attività di contabilità e reporting degli investimenti.

Qualifiche di base:

- Laurea in Business Administration, finanza o contabilità con 5 o più anni di esperienza nell'area Operazioni di investimento O

- Diploma di scuola superiore (o equivalente) e 7-10 o più anni di esperienza nell'area Operazioni di investimento

Preferiti:

- Denominazione CFA

- 5 o più anni di esperienza con esposizione al debito privato e prodotti di investimento alternativi

- Esperienza con moduli FSCM, FAM o TRM in SAP Treasury; competenze tecniche finanziarie sono un asset

- Una mentalità proattiva e focalizzata sulle soluzioni per supportare le attività di reportistica e operativa.

- Volontà di imparare nuovi strumenti, processi e requisiti operativi in evoluzione

- Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, gestendo le priorità quotidiane in un ambiente frenetico

- Forte capacità analitiche con alta attenzione ai dettagli

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale, con la capacità di trasmettere informazioni complesse in modo chiaro ed efficace

- Capacità di coltivare e gestire le relazioni produttive con gli stakeholder interni, i principali partner commerciali, gli asset manager e i custodi, con particolare enfasi sul sostegno alle operazioni di debito privato e ai prodotti di investimento alternativi

- Capacità di migliorare e standardizzare i processi in tutte le regioni, sfruttando la tecnologia, l'automazione e la collaborazione tra team per aumentare l'efficienza

- Dimostrata capacità di gestire complessi flussi di lavoro operativi e contribuire a attraversare iniziative funzionali, in particolare all'interno dei mercati privati

- Forte problem solving e capacità decisionali, con la capacità di risolvere i problemi operativi e di escalare questioni più complesse in modo appropriato

- Forte motivazione a rimanere attuale con le tecnologie emergenti, inclusa l'applicazione pratica delle caratteristiche AI, per guidare l'innovazione e il miglioramento continuo.

La tua paga a Zurigo si basa sul tuo ruolo, posizione, competenze e esperienza. Seguiamo le leggi locali per garantire una giusta compensazione. Si può anche essere idonei per bonus e aumenti di merito. Se le vostre aspettative sono al di sopra della gamma elencata, vi incoraggiamo ancora ad applicare – il vostro background unico conta per noi.

L'intervallo di pagamento indicato è una media nazionale e può variare in base alla posizione. L'intervallo di stipendio proposto per questa posizione è $109,000 - $178,375, con bonus di incentivazione a breve termine eleggibilità impostata al 15%.

Offriamo vantaggi competitivi e completi per i dipendenti e le loro famiglie. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Perché Zurigo?

A Zurigo, apprezziamo le tue idee e le tue esperienze. Offriamo crescita, inclusione e un ambiente di supporto, in modo da poter contribuire a plasmare il futuro dell'assicurazione. Zurigo Nord America è leader nella gestione dei rischi, con oltre 150 anni di esperienza e copertura in 25 settori, tra cui il 90% della Fortune 500®.

Unisciti a noi per un futuro più luminoso, per te e per i nostri clienti.

Zurigo in Nord America non discrimina in base a razza, etnia, colore, religione, origine nazionale, sesso, espressione di genere, identità di genere, informazioni genetiche, età, disabilità, stato veterano protetto, stato civile, orientamento sessuale, gravidanza o altre caratteristiche protette dalla legge applicabile. Pari opportunità Disabilità del datore di lavoro/vet.

Zurigo è conforme al codice 18 degli Stati Uniti § 1033.

Nota bene: Zurigo non accetta CV non richiesti dalle agenzie. I fornitori preferiti dovrebbero utilizzare il nostro Recruiting Agency Portal.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Zurich Group Investment Management, Inc. (ZGIM), ein Teil von Zurich North America, sucht einen Investment Operations Associate Director, der dem Investment Administration and Accounting (IAA) Team beitreten soll. Der ausgewählte Kandidat befindet sich in unserem Büro in Parsippany, NJ.

Bei Investment Administration & Accounting (IAA) sind Fachwissen und Qualität die Grundlage für alles, was wir tun. Da die Investmentlandschaft komplexer wird und sich die Technologie schnell weiterentwickelt, verlassen wir uns auf tiefe technische Kompetenz, starke analytische Fähigkeiten und ein Engagement für Exzellenz, um qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse für das Unternehmen zu liefern. Unser gründliches Verständnis von Anlageprozessen, Finanzinstrumenten und regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen ermöglicht es uns, uns schnell anzupassen, strenge Standards einzuhalten und unsere Partner und Stakeholder rechtzeitig und sinnvoll zu unterstützen.

Die IAA ist eine globale Funktion innerhalb von Zurich Investment Management, die dafür verantwortlich ist, die Genauigkeit, Transparenz und Governance von Anlagebilanzierungs-, Bewertungs- und Berichtsaktivitäten im gesamten Unternehmen sicherzustellen. Wir sichern die Integrität von Anlagedaten, stellen die Einhaltung von regulatorischen und Prüfungsanforderungen sicher und liefern Erkenntnisse, die strategische Portfolio- und Geschäftsentscheidungen prägen. Durch diese kritische Arbeit spielt unser Team eine zentrale Rolle bei der Stärkung der Zuverlässigkeit und Glaubwürdigkeit von Unternehmensinformationen.

Wir verbessern und standardisieren unsere Prozesse in allen Regionen kontinuierlich, nutzen Technologie, Automatisierung und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit, um die Effizienz zu steigern und die betriebliche Widerstandsfähigkeit zu stärken. Als zuverlässiger Partner von Investment Management, Finance und Operations sind wir bestrebt, zuverlässige, transparente und qualitativ hochwertige Anlageinformationen bereitzustellen, die eine effektive Entscheidungsfindung im gesamten Unternehmen unterstützen.

Zuständigkeiten:

- Verwaltung der End-to-End-Verarbeitung, -Verbuchung und -Clearing von Transaktionen im Zusammenhang mit privaten Schuldtiteln

- Überwachung von Einkommenszahlungen, Kapitalabrufen, Ausschüttungen und Lebenszyklusereignissen für private Marktaktiva

- Gewährleistung präziser und zeitnaher Schließungsaktivitäten zum Monatsende für private Schuldtitel und alternative Anlageprodukte

- Durchführung monatlicher Überleitungsrechnungen privater Vermögensbestände, alternativer Anlageprodukte und damit verbundener Geldkonten

- Als Fachexperte für private Marktoperationen tätig und unterstützt interne Initiativen, Systemverbesserungen und kundenspezifische Anforderungen.

- Zusammenarbeit mit Investmentteams, Depotbanken und Administratoren von Drittanbietern, um komplexe operative Probleme zu lösen.

- Führende Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungsbemühungen, die auf die Nuancen privater und illiquider Vermögenswerte zugeschnitten sind

- Leitung der Entwicklung, Verbesserung und Aufrechterhaltung interner Kontrollen und Qualitätssicherungsprozesse, um Genauigkeit, Compliance und Risikominderung bei allen Anlagebuchhaltungs- und Berichtsaktivitäten sicherzustellen.

Grundqualifikationen:

- Bachelor-Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Finanzen oder Rechnungswesen mit 5 oder mehr Jahren Erfahrung im Bereich Investment Operations ODER

- High School Diploma (oder gleichwertig) und 7-10 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Investment Operations

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

- CFA-Bezeichnung

- 5 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung mit Exposition gegenüber privaten Schulden und alternativen Anlageprodukten

- Erfahrung mit FSCM-, FAM- oder TRM-Modulen in SAP Treasury; finanztechnische Fähigkeiten sind ein Gewinn

- Eine proaktive, lösungsorientierte Denkweise zur Unterstützung der Berichterstattung und operativen Aktivitäten.

- Bereitschaft, neue Werkzeuge, Prozesse und sich entwickelnde betriebliche Anforderungen zu erlernen

- Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und die täglichen Prioritäten in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu verwalten

- Starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit hoher Liebe zum Detail

- Hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen klar und effektiv zu vermitteln

- Fähigkeit, produktive Beziehungen zu internen Stakeholdern, wichtigen Geschäftspartnern, Vermögensverwaltern und Depotbanken zu pflegen und zu verwalten, mit besonderem Schwerpunkt auf der Unterstützung von Private Debt-Operationen und alternativen Anlageprodukten

- Fähigkeit, Prozesse über Regionen hinweg zu verbessern und zu standardisieren, Technologie, Automatisierung und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zu nutzen, um die Effizienz zu steigern

- Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, komplexe operative Workflows zu verwalten und zu funktionsübergreifenden Initiativen beizutragen, insbesondere in privaten Märkten

- Starke Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, operative Probleme zu lösen und komplexere Angelegenheiten angemessen zu eskalieren

- Starke Motivation, mit neuen Technologien, einschließlich der praktischen Anwendung von KI-Funktionen, auf dem neuesten Stand zu bleiben, um Innovationen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben.

Ihre Bezahlung in Zürich basiert auf Ihrer Rolle, Ihrem Standort, Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung. Wir befolgen lokale Gesetze, um eine faire Entschädigung zu gewährleisten. Möglicherweise haben sie auch anspruch auf boni und leistungssteigerungen. Wenn Ihre Erwartungen über dem aufgeführten Bereich liegen, empfehlen wir Ihnen dennoch, sich zu bewerben - Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund ist für uns wichtig.

Die gezeigte Lohnspanne ist ein nationaler Durchschnitt und kann je nach Standort variieren. Die vorgeschlagene Gehaltsspanne für diese Position beträgt $ 109.000 - $ 178.375, wobei die kurzfristige Anreizbonusberechtigung auf 15% festgelegt ist.

Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Bezahlung und umfassende Leistungen für Mitarbeiter und ihre Familien. [Erfahren Sie hier mehr über Total Rewards.]

Warum Zürich?

Bei Zurich schätzen wir Ihre Ideen und Erfahrungen. Wir bieten Wachstum, Inklusion und ein unterstützendes Umfeld - damit Sie die Zukunft der Versicherung mitgestalten können. Zurich North America ist ein führendes Unternehmen im Risikomanagement mit über 150 Jahren Erfahrung und Abdeckung in über 25 Branchen, darunter 90 % der Fortune 500®.

Begleiten Sie uns für eine bessere Zukunft – für Sie und unsere Kunden.

Zürich in Nordamerika diskriminiert nicht aufgrund von Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Religion, nationaler Herkunft, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsausdruck, Geschlechtsidentität, genetischer Information, Alter, Behinderung, geschütztem Veteranenstatus, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung, Schwangerschaft oder anderen durch geltendes Recht geschützten Merkmalen. (ZGIM), une partie de Zurich Amérique du Nord, cherche un directeur associé des opérations de placement pour rejoindre l'équipe de l'administration et de la comptabilité des investissements (IAA). Le candidat sélectionné sera situé à notre bureau de Parsippany, NJ.

Chez Investment Administration & Accounting (IAA), l'expertise et la qualité sont les fondements de tout ce que nous faisons. À mesure que le paysage de l'investissement se complexifie et que la technologie évolue rapidement, nous comptons sur des compétences techniques profondes, une solide capacité d'analyse et un engagement envers l'excellence pour obtenir des résultats de haute qualité pour l'entreprise. Notre compréhension approfondie des processus d'investissement, des instruments financiers et des cadres réglementaires nous permet de nous adapter rapidement, de respecter des normes rigoureuses et de fournir un soutien opportun et significatif à nos partenaires et intervenants.

L'AAI est une fonction mondiale au sein de Zurich Investment Management, chargée d'assurer l'exactitude, la transparence et la gouvernance des activités de comptabilité, d'évaluation et d'établissement de rapports dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Nous protégeons l'intégrité des données sur les investissements, nous assurons le respect des exigences réglementaires et de vérification et nous fournissons des renseignements qui façonnent les décisions stratégiques en matière de portefeuille et d'affaires. Grâce à ce travail critique, notre équipe joue un rôle central dans le renforcement de la fiabilité et de la crédibilité de l'entreprise d'information sur les investissements.

Nous améliorons et standardisons constamment nos processus dans toutes les régions, en tirant parti de la technologie, de l'automatisation et de la collaboration entre les équipes pour accroître l'efficacité et renforcer la résilience opérationnelle. En tant que partenaire fiable de la gestion des investissements, des finances et des opérations, nous nous engageons à fournir des renseignements fiables, transparents et de haute qualité sur les investissements qui appuient la prise de décisions efficaces dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.

Responsabilités :

- Gestion du traitement de bout en bout, de l'affichage et de la compensation des opérations liées aux titres de créance privés

- Supervision des paiements de revenus, appels de capitaux, distributions et événements du cycle de vie pour les actifs du marché privé

- Assurer des activités de clôture de fin de mois précises et opportunes pour les titres de créance privés et les produits d'investissement alternatifs

- Rapprochement mensuel des avoirs privés, des produits de placement alternatifs et des comptes de trésorerie connexes

- À titre d'expert en la matière pour les opérations sur les marchés privés, appuyer les initiatives internes, les améliorations du système et les exigences propres à la clientèle.

- Collaborer avec des équipes d'investissement, des gardiens et des administrateurs tiers pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels complexes.

- Diriger les efforts d'automatisation et de numérisation adaptés aux nuances des actifs privés et illiquides

- Diriger l'élaboration, l'amélioration et le maintien des contrôles internes et des processus d'assurance de la qualité, en assurant l'exactitude, la conformité et l'atténuation des risques dans l'ensemble des activités de comptabilité et de déclaration des investissements.

Qualifications de base :

- Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances ou comptabilité avec 5 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine des opérations d'investissement OU

- Diplôme d'études secondaires (ou équivalent) et 7-10 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine des opérations d'investissement

Qualifications préférées :

- Désignation CFA

- 5 ans ou plus d'expérience dans l'exposition à la dette privée et aux produits d'investissement alternatifs

- Expérience des modules FSCM, FAM ou TRM dans SAP Treasury; les compétences techniques financières sont un atout

- Un état d'esprit proactif et axé sur les solutions à l'appui des rapports et des activités opérationnelles.

- Volonté d'apprendre de nouveaux outils, processus et évolution des besoins opérationnels

- Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante tout en gérant les priorités quotidiennes dans un environnement rapide

- Fortes compétences analytiques avec une grande attention aux détails

- Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, avec la capacité de transmettre de l'information complexe clairement et efficacement

- Capacité de cultiver et de gérer des relations productives avec les intervenants internes, les principaux partenaires commerciaux, les gestionnaires d'actifs et les dépositaires, en mettant particulièrement l'accent sur le soutien aux opérations de la dette privée et aux autres produits d'investissement

- Capacité d'améliorer et de normaliser les processus dans les régions, en tirant parti de la technologie, de l'automatisation et de la collaboration entre les équipes pour stimuler l'efficacité

- Capacité démontrée de gérer des flux de travail opérationnels complexes et de contribuer à des initiatives interfonctionnelles, en particulier sur les marchés privés

- Compétences solides en matière de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décisions, avec la capacité de résoudre les problèmes opérationnels et d'intensifier les questions plus complexes

- Une forte motivation à rester au courant des technologies émergentes, y compris l'application pratique des caractéristiques de l'IA, pour stimuler l'innovation et l'amélioration continue.

Votre salaire à Zurich est basé sur votre rôle, votre emplacement, vos compétences et votre expérience. Nous suivons les lois locales pour garantir une juste indemnisation. Vous pouvez également être admissible à des primes et des augmentations de mérite. Si vos attentes sont supérieures à la fourchette indiquée, nous vous encourageons toujours à présenter votre candidature, ce qui compte pour nous.

L'échelle de rémunération indiquée est une moyenne nationale et peut varier selon le lieu. L'échelle salariale proposée pour ce poste est de 109 000 $ - 178 375 $, et l'admissibilité à une prime incitative à court terme est fixée à 15 %.

Nous offrons une rémunération concurrentielle et des avantages complets aux employés et à leur famille. [En savoir plus sur Total Rewards ici .]

Pourquoi Zurich ?

À Zurich, nous apprécions vos idées et votre expérience. Nous offrons la croissance, l'inclusion et un environnement favorable, afin que vous puissiez aider à façonner l'avenir de l'assurance. Zurich L'Amérique du Nord est un chef de file en gestion des risques, avec plus de 150 ans d'expertise et de couverture dans plus de 25 industries, dont 90% du Fortune 500®.

Rejoignez-nous pour un avenir meilleur, pour vous et nos clients.

En Amérique du Nord, Zurich ne fait pas de discrimination fondée sur la race, l'ethnicité, la couleur, la religion, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'expression sexuelle, l'identité de genre, l'information génétique, l'âge, le handicap, le statut de vétéran protégé, l'état matrimonial, l'orientation sexuelle, la grossesse ou d'autres caractéristiques protégées par la loi applicable. Égalité des chances Invalidité/veuves de l'employeur.

Zurich est conforme au code américain 18 § 1033.
